title: alexbu512/milancat-bot
description: Grok-bot-style AI organization in the sidebar: a chief-of-staff agent creates departments, roles and per-department group chats, dispatches each task to child agents running on this machine, and reports finished work back as one assistant message. Its HTTP routes have no DSH access check, and they can create agents and dispatch tasks to them.

title: Anmulzhao/DSH-AGINT
description: Self-evolving agent framework on DeepSeek Harness (dsh): 40 Cordis plugins and 4 presets covering memory, reflection, gates, metrics and an auditable evolution loop. Not a one-command install. Clone the repo and run install/install.sh --profile=web (needs bash, Node 20+, python3, DSH 0.1.7-rc.1 or newer with an initialized profile), then restart.

title: AnonyJcy/dsh-j-space
description: J-Space Cognition Suite SV1 native agent preset and standalone Cordis plugin: 13 modules, persistent controller and decoupled workspace.

title: anticbv/dsh-preset-deep
description: A fifth DeepSeek Harness work mode that requires a falsification design (at least two pieces of evidence that could disprove the plan) in every plan and tags each factual claim with its source (\[文件]/\[检索]/\[记忆]) or \[未知]; evidence grading follows the project's AGENTS.md.

title: Asiu-x/dsh-harness2
description: Harness² recursive self-improvement for DSH agents: Propose–Probe–Compose, isolated probes, anonymous selection, and a per-domain experience library.

title: benrong2048-boop/dsh-prompt-polish
description: Turns a one-line DSH draft into a complete task brief (role / goal / constraints / output format). The engine is a byte-verified port of linshenkx/prompt-optimizer (three modes, 10 templates identical to upstream); history is consent-gated with version chains and structural comparison; every run reports its token usage. Nothing is written back or sent without a click.

title: buaaflyaway/dsh-progress-nudge
description: Counts the assistant rounds that call tools without writing anything to the user, then inserts a short progress reminder as a visible user message at the next model-request boundary, so a long silent tool loop reports what it has done before continuing. A Settings page adjusts the silence threshold (default 10), the reminder wording, the language (en / zh-CN / zh-TW), whether the reminder repeats every further threshold of silent rounds, whether subagent sessions are counted, and whether Agent Teams nudges the lead only or every member.

title: burning-frappuccino/dsh-turbo
description: Per-session execution gears for the DSH composer: an OVERDRIVE toggle turns Turbo on for the current session only, the Fast and Max gears swap the agent's planning and verification policy and may lower the request's reasoning effort, and the Host keeps the authoritative mode plus per-turn latency, step count, tool calls and whether a verification command ran.

title: dsh-answer-reviewer
description: Agentic answer reviewer for DeepSeek Harness: each final assistant turn is re-reviewed by a separate LLM graded 1-100; below-threshold scores steer the agent back with concrete feedback. The score is shown as a chip on the answer's action row (green pass / red needs-work, with retry count and reason on hover). Live gate config from the Reviewer 配置 tab in the conversation view ring above the composer (对话 / 轨迹 / 记忆系统 / Reviewer 配置), from a 127.0.0.1 HTTP server, or from an optional right-sidebar tab via dsh-better-sidebar.

title: CAI-MH/dsh-quality-review
description: Audit each finished assistant turn with an independent reviewer model and steer the agent to fix failed output, with at most 2 review rounds per turn and SOP-folder standards injected as an extra review dimension.

title: CanaryJing/dsh-big-fat-whale-maid-adaptive
description: Agent preset with adaptive tool presentation and environment-aware shell routing. Ports modules from yjh051108/dsh-routing-suite and xiaobright/dsh-anchored-standard (the former is listed here), so do not enable it alongside those presets. Requires DSH 0.2.2 or later; high uses PTC with on-demand tool unlocks and max uses PTC with the full available tool catalog.

title: ccll/dsh-advisor-flow
description: Executor/advisor workflow ported from pi-advisor-flow: the executor calls ask_advisor for a second opinion at key decisions, after repeated failures and before completion; equivalent repeated tool calls are intercepted before execution for an advisor review with a proceed/revise/blocked verdict, and hard mode force-reviews every turn before it closes. Per-call token and cost ledger with /advisor status readout, privacy tiers for repo context and file contents, six-shape secret redaction, and a web settings card; advisor failures never stall the main loop.

title: Clearailhc/clearai-dsh
description: An agent preset for evidence-checked research: every step advances only through system-verified observations, L3+ claims go to an independent evaluator, and the session folds into a replayable ledger that grows into a browsable domain ontology. Requires DSH >=0.1.7-alpha.1.

title: DDL095/dsh-moa-native
description: Native generation-time Mixture-of-Agents: every turn, reference models run the same session context in parallel as pre-run drafts and one aggregator executes with full tooling; config-as-model recipes, F mirror / R trimmed views, enforced subagent gating (dual-shape session indexing), derived per-recipe vision (vision refs relay image reads to text-only aggregators), tiered cadence with separate steering and patrol rosters plus frozen reuse between beats, degeneration guard dropping degenerate reference output, anonymized model face (failure notices carry no provider identity), and cache-friendly guidance placement (the rehearsal record is pinned where it was produced instead of appended to every request, so the cached prefix covers it and each step pays only for what was added since - on by default across every cadence).

title: Domush/dsh-plugin-antigravity-agents
description: Native Google Antigravity agents loader and subagent orchestration engine with model selection and Web UI settings integration. Loads agent definitions from ~/.agents/agents and the workspace's .agents/agents; the selected main agent's instructions go into the system prompt, and a matching agent's instructions are prepended to DSH's own subagent and spawn_teammate calls. Settings are written to .agents/agents/settings.json in the workspace.

title: DoreiHime/dsh-help-me-to-ask
description: On the first real work message of each chat window, asks for the missing goal, deliverable, constraints and acceptance criteria, then turns the answers into a short task sheet and injects it into the chat. Pure greetings are ignored.

title: duahciM/dsh-lessons
description: Records task boundaries and structured reflections, stores reusable lessons, and injects them into later tasks according to scope.

title: FelixJiashengFu/dsh-force-collab
description: Forced collaboration: a composer picker sets 0–6 sub-agents, and while it is on every hands-on task must be split across exactly that many child agents through a collab_fanout tool that has no count parameter, then merged by the main agent.

title: FelixJiashengFu/dsh-muse-code
description: Meta's Muse Code CLI inside DSH: a composer switch starts muse serve, a right-sidebar panel and five chat tools (muse_open, muse_prompt, muse_read, muse_status, muse_interrupt) share one Muse session, approvals are decided only in the panel, and a local spend guard hard-stops at $10 by default. Windows only; needs the Muse Code CLI installed and signed in. The $10 cap is a local estimate for the muse serve this plugin starts.

title: ff66ccff/dsh-ATN
description: Adaptive topology multi-agent preset for DeepSeek Harness with peer messaging, task handoff and live network visualization.

title: Funny1Potato/dsh-outsourcing-expert
description: Agent presets whose leader does no work itself: every non-management tool call is denied at the harness boundary so the task has to go to a subagent, after a one-time lookup of the available subagent models and a per-task model choice; a second preset deliberately picks the model least suited to the task.

title: FuRongJun-1999/dsh-memory
description: White-box AGI architecture exploration: metacognition (self-cognition loop), continual learning (knowledge flywheel), world model (condition space, spatiotemporal memory graph), self-improvement (bootstrap discipline), zero-LLM white-box pipeline, and auditable trust guardrails.

title: highho/dsh-game-studio-presets
description: Eleven game-development agent presets cut by workflow stage — concept, design, build, art and audio, QA, release, narrative, level, engine — plus one orchestrator that delegates across them, carrying 37 bundled skills. Regroups the 48 agent prompts of Claude Code Game Studios (MIT) by stage so each preset loads only the skills its stage needs. Installs with dsh plugin add; run node install.mjs once afterwards to deploy the skills the presets reference.

title: HYClub/deepseek-harness-game-studios
description: DeepSeek Harness port of Claude Code Game Studios (CCGS v1.1.2, MIT): 76 skills, 49 agents, hook bridge.

title: icyaaaww/dsh-soul
description: Records recurring task corrections and tool failures locally, then compiles them into changes to eight harness components through explicitly started evolution, paired baseline/candidate checks, trial activation and rollback. Includes a budget and audit ledger; requires Node.js 24+ and a compatible DSH 0.2.1-rc.2 or later 0.2.x host.

title: imcaibaicai/dsh-todo-keeper
description: Counts the tool calls the agent makes without calling todo_write and injects an advisory reminder when it goes too long, and warns when the list is batch-checked at the end, so the Tasks panel stops showing a stale snapshot.

title: imcaibaicai/dsh-zh-language-policy
description: Re-anchors two contracts at the very top of the system prompt before every model step: English chain-of-thought with Simplified-Chinese user-facing prose, and final summaries that carry every fact the user saw.

title: JiewiW/dsh-cot-anchor
description: Injects conclusions already established in the previous reasoning block after each tool result, so the model continues from them instead of re-deriving the same conclusions.

title: jiuaiwo/dsh-expert
description: Expert roster for DeepSeek Harness: 636 experts across 22 divisions with full Chinese names and bios, summoned as subagents from the @ menu or by the model through list_t_experts / summon_t_expert / summon_t_experts, plus custom experts and a skill on/off switch.

title: dsh-proactive
description: Host-level proactive wake-ups for DeepSeek Harness: the model schedules its own alarms (once, recurring interval, or cron, with optional random jitter), cold sessions are woken on time by session resume, model-initiated follow-ups are gated by quiet hours and a daily delivery budget, silent wake turns end with proactive_reclaim and fold out of model context as tombstones, declared schedule files glob-sync JSON schedules into host alarms idempotently, min_idle_seconds defers wakes until the destination session quiets down, and a web panel (settings section plus per-session tab, SSE live refresh) manages alarms and wake history — the heartbeat engine for AI companions and roleplay characters with their own daily routines and world evolution.

title: john-walks-slow/dsh-simulated-life
description: Simulated life context for DeepSeek Harness: every turn injects the past 24h of simulated life events from the workspace .life/ directory (sliding-window filter, session-level deduplication with delta updates, world summary) as a collapsed context notice, and the life_react tool lets the agent record feelings, thoughts and actions back into its life log for the next round of world evolution — turning a DSH agent into a roleplay character with a persistent daily life.

title: Jonah-Wu23/dsh-gungnir#dsh-plugin
description: Evidence-driven goal verification plugin for DeepSeek Harness. Locks goals via /ultragoal and verifies completion against command exit codes and generated artifacts, preventing the model from falsely reporting task completion.

title: Kanadego/dsh-heartbeat
description: An agent that wakes up on its own schedule: by default every 60 minutes, ±20% (48–72). It browses the interests you set, drops what it finds into a local pool of notes, and keeps a profile of what you like. When it has enough worth sharing it hands the session you linked a short package of notes — whether to speak, and which note to use, is that session's agent's call in the moment. Quiet hours, busy windows, a daily limit and a cooldown are decided in code; when the answer is no, the decision and expression phases after the gate call no model at all — browsing runs before the gate and is counted separately. Windows, Linux and macOS (Linux and macOS are minimal support).

title: kenz1117/dsh-engram
description: Cross-session long-term memory as a local SQLite store: dual scopes (user + per-git-origin project), hybrid FTS5 + local-vector retrieval fused with RRF, an evidence gate that forces an explicit sufficiency judgement, provenance audit chains, SM-2 spaced-repetition review, consolidation distillation and decay forgetting, and a nine-view "Memory Palace" sidebar panel. 22 narrow-parameter tools, no external service, no API key, no Docker.

title: KunKun24/dsh-global-prompt
description: Add one global prompt or persona that is injected into every new DeepSeek Harness conversation.

title: KunKun24/dsh-until-done
description: Keep working when a turn ends without finishing, and only stop once the reply ends with a completion keyword.

title: leeyoung1/dsh-advisor-plugin
description: Pairs the running executor with a stronger reviewer model through zero-parameter advisor() calls and step-based patrol checks, returning plan, correction, or stop guidance.

title: liangzz1998/dsh-thinking-language
description: Injects one system-prompt section that makes the agent reason and answer in a chosen language (Simplified Chinese by default), with separate thinking and answer settings, a custom extra line, and support for standard, PTC and custom presets; the minimal preset is not affected.

title: lifangjin/dsh-maoying
description: Web-novel writing assistant preset for DeepSeek Harness: the main agent acts as editor-in-chief and delegates outlining, drafting, review, lore-keeping and research to five helpers across a seven-phase workflow, with the whole novel kept as a structured markdown/YAML novel/ directory (character cards, a foreshadowing state machine, timeline, narrative memory), plus a sidebar creator panel and six zero-dependency CLI commands.

title: LittleAlety/dsh-team-conductor
description: Control plane for the harness's own Agent Teams: members are ordinary independent sessions created through the same seam the GUI uses, each with its own model, so they open and continue like any other conversation while a sidecar roster and task board coordinate them. Task entries carry a definition of done, a member's completion is submitted and waits for the Lead's review, and availability tells idle apart from awaiting-review or a failed last turn. With delegationEngine=auto it uses independent sessions, continuable subagents, or the kernel roster depending on what the composition provides.

title: mazov2love/dsh-remote-control
description: Let Agents directly control independent local DSH instances with zero intrusion—no plugins or components required on the target. Isolated environments enable autonomous configuration and testing, while Agents with different models and personalities can chat, role-play, or form nested control chains. Supports conversational setup, user-like operations, incremental reading, saved references, and remote session/workspace search.

title: MichengAI/dsh-pua
description: Adds /pua to steer the agent to try another approach and verify results before claiming completion, with 15 company styles, persona modes, global and per-conversation settings, and an optional loop that continues until a verification command passes, the iteration limit is reached, or the user cancels.

title: NEINC1/muche-dsh-plugin
description: Chat panel for the MuChe companion with per-user backend settings, plus an outbound bridge that runs tasks on the user's local dsh.

title: nlflora/dsh-empty-turn-guard
description: Recovers a DeepSeek Harness turn that ended with reasoning only, with no text and no tool call, by steering the same turn one more step. Structure-only detection, so it costs no extra model call.

title: panando/dsh-pua
description: Fork of @michengai/dsh-pua that removes the upstream global kill-switch so the composer entry is always visible while the feature stays off by default and can be toggled per session; the entry is a dropdown (Turn on / Turn off / Options) with a more compact options panel.

title: penghao73551/dsh-prompt-balance
description: Measures what your assembled system prompt is actually made of - rules, identity, workspace policy, tool descriptions - in bytes and percentages, then moves the operating protocol ahead of the rule block so the model reads who it works for before it reads the prohibitions. Config-driven via ~/.dsh/prompt-balance.json; two hooks, no build step, no dependencies.

title: pf-sjtu/dsh-early-stop-guard
description: Keeps a DSH agent turn open when the model ends it by narrating work it has not done: on agent/turn-stopping the guard replays the turn log and classifies the trailing message with regexes — in the default mode wait / ask / done / gray end the turn with no model call, and only a promise of pending work reaches the judge — then has a judge chain of four dialect kinds (System One three-question noul, OpenAI-compatible, OpenAI Decisions, or the session LLM) rule on whether the turn is really over, and steers the same turn with agent.steer when it is not.

title: pgmi-builds/super-dsh#super-dsh
description: Multi-agent orchestration hub: bridges six foreign agent runtimes (Codex, Claude Code, OMP, Pi, Hermes, Antigravity) into the DSH Web UI — roster, session create/prompt/resume, exec/PTY/task/file lanes, local or cross-machine over SSH/Docker/Incus/Hub. Its HTTP routes have no DSH access check, so a web page open in your browser could call them.

title: pk14742952-AD/dsh-host-rsi
description: Reflective self-evolution plugin for local Qwen3.8 27B/3.8 Flash and online APIs: a coding-loop convergence steerer curbs Qwen3.8 27B/Flash repeated-verification deep-thinking to converge faster and cut thinking time; a five-state delivery guard detects and corrects stuck turns and infinite loops; model-agnostic host logic, mostly compatible with online APIs; per-use continual self-improvement with counter-reason self-checks, critic escalation, inverted-index memory retrieval, coding-loop convergence steering, and a five-state delivery guard.

title: qian-dsh/dsh-as-mcp-server
description: Exposes DSH as an MCP server so another agent can watch its thinking, tool calls and file writes in real time, share intent, take a floor lock that denies DSH's write/edit/git tools, inject mid-turn alerts, and delegate reviews.

title: qian-dsh/dsh-outer-brain
description: A philosopher's way of thinking made executable: dialectics and practice-testing to govern hallucination and long-session drift, so done is a verifiable fact rather than a claim.

title: Qiao-Fang/dsh-chinese-thinking-mode
description: Delivers one required user-role runtime context that makes the agent reason in Simplified Chinese and keep a whale-loli in-thinking persona (calls itself 本鱼, lazy-arrogant tone) in both reasoning and the final reply, while proper nouns, identifiers, paths, commands, URLs and error text stay verbatim; persona, extra proper nouns and context order are configurable. Enabled by default for every agent in the profile, subagents included.

title: Qulierm/orbital-agents
description: Persistent Endeavour and Challenger peer sessions for DeepSeek Harness that plan, execute sequential tasks, and verify reported results.

title: rootsbymenda/dsh-second-angle
description: Checks each claim in a finished answer against the tool output that same turn read: a contradiction whose quote is found in that output steers one correction in the same turn, and claims the output does not back are flagged in the session log and on stderr. A free scan for absolute words and unmatched numbers runs first, and a turn that ran no tool never reaches the model.

title: samirliu/dsh-goalloop-agentteams
description: Deterministic goal-completion gate for DSH: a contract-first AC grammar with named failable check commands, a gate that re-runs every check itself (zero model trust), verdicts bound to a tree digest so file changes void passing verdicts, and a hard deny on false completion at update_goal via tools/pre-execute with a false-complete counter that blocks after two catches; scope-aware task-level claim handling (strict or goal-only) keeps multi-task Agent Teams loops from deadlocking.

title: shiliuyu316/dsh-optimization-2027
description: Five-tier reasoning protocol injected into the system prompt — off / light / standard / deep / multi-agent, 0 / 3 / 9 / 17 / 19 rules — with the tokens each tier adds per request shown beside it. Alongside it: a claim ledger that marks a load-bearing claim with no evidence or check as unsupported, read-only analyst briefs, JSON-declared custom tools that work in the same turn, one persistent PowerShell session, and re-injection of host context after a configurable message gap. Tier 0 injects nothing and mounts no tools. A derivative of husongan/dsh-deepseek-2027 (MIT); do not install both — each injects its own reasoning-protocol section into the system prompt.

title: sososilencing/dsh-network-engineer
description: Standalone Network Engineer Assistant agent preset plus a bundled 32-doc command knowledge base skill for DPtech, H3C, Huawei and Ruijie switches and routers: KB-first retrieval, cross-vendor command translation, topology and CLI-output screenshot reading, online manual lookup with cited sources, and mandatory risk annotations for dangerous commands; answers networking topics only.

title: STARDUSTLC666/dsh-dream
description: Experience memory and reflection for DSH agents: automatically extracts candidate lessons after tasks and recalls user-reviewed lessons in relevant later tasks. Supports source provenance, project-scoped retrieval, conflict handling, usage feedback and expiry review; capture and recall have separate controls, and writing lessons to AGENTS.md requires preview and explicit application. A step-by-step first-run guide (4 steps) now opens inside its settings panel.

title: starkingcn/dsh-story#story-mode
description: Story Mode preset for DeepSeek Harness: role-play GM persona, three-way choices, .md character cards and world book, context distillation and prompt wrapping.

title: StarsHarryZhu/dsh-assistant
description: General-purpose chat agent on a parent agent + worker sub-agent split, for DSH Desktop only: a sidebar row opens each assistant's long-running conversation, where the parent chats, records schedule, lists, memos, logs, profile, persona and projects as plain files in that assistant's workspace folder, and hands other work to background workers through the bundled complete-subagent, picking each worker's model from the ones you enable and approving their write access. A heartbeat wakes it for reminders, a daily brief and wake-ups it sets itself, and holds back during quiet hours. Through the bundled im-robot it chats over WeChat: the model decides per reply with im_route whether the reply also goes to WeChat, and images and files sent from WeChat appear in the conversation and stay in the workspace's IM/WeChat folder for a set number of days. Its tools never appear in normal sessions.

title: StellaryToucher/dsh-muse-code
description: Adds a `muse` subagent provider and the `subagent_muse` tool to DeepSeek Harness, so the main agent can hand one self-contained task to the Meta Muse Code CLI and get back only its final report. A patched fork of `@pascapone/dsh-muse-code` that loads on DSH 0.2.1: it carries local equivalents of the removed `settleRun` export and `subagents.start` method, and documents an optional proxy for the gateway stream-phase bug. Needs the `muse` CLI installed. Install either this fork or the upstream @pascapone/dsh-muse-code, not both: both register the same subagent-muse loader row.

title: StudentBuilding-Studio/dsh-search-pull
description: Adds a static prompt section that makes the agent call the built-in web_search before answering questions about existing libraries, versions, errors or selection, plus an optional JSONL audit trail.

title: suifei/dsh-ai-team
description: Wenyuan Pavilion: an AI Team workbench for DSH with owned tasks, independent acceptance, an append-only ledger and concurrent projects. Install it into its own profile (dsh plugin --profile ai-team add @suifei/dsh-ai-team), not web or desktop: its patch sets that profile's sandbox to danger-full-access and approvals to never, and the member agents run with full access. The project's PMO acts automatically by default (every 60 s it resolves pending decisions and wakes owners to dispatch the next tasks); turn off PMO auto to send decisions to your inbox.

title: sxwpskd/dsh-milieu
description: Prepares a workspace management protocol for an agent — three libraries (cognition, tools, external information), an optional preloaded session that has already read the workspace, and a re-read card when the workspace has changed enough.

title: syyr1987/dsh-linghun
description: A judgment core for DeepSeek Harness: a cognition loop that gives every decision a source and attribution and drives planning to a close, hippocampus memory that condenses running experience into knowledge (journal ledger, episodic archive, low-confidence decay), judgment identity responsibilities in the architecture (consistent rubric, judgment bound to its source), and an A2A memory-management team via dsh-linghun-assembler. Requires DSH ^0.1.0-rc.7 (rc.2 supported).

title: syyr1987/dsh-linghun-assembler
description: Memory-assembly team for DeepSeek Harness: every message triggers a five-step cognition loop (judge, retrieve, assemble, feedback, calibrate) carried by role-playing subagents (judge, retriever, archivist, advocate, editor, scribe), using BM25 retrieval, time-ordered material, and LLM assembly to build useful material packs injected into linghun. Works with dsh-linghun.

title: taoziliyouchong/dsh-evolve-preset
description: Evolution mode in one package: a thinking mode that aligns on your goal and boundaries each turn plus the task tree, profile injection and panel, alignment-bar styling, self-check tools and plan-mode entry — install one package and you have the whole set. It helps the model understand requests more accurately, get noticeably better results at the same cost, and build a long-term profile of your preferences. Its HTTP routes have no DSH access check, so a web page open in your browser could call them.

title: Tests4gptplay/deepseek-servant
description: Autonomous AI assistant and multi-agent collaboration for DSH: discuss goals, plan work in the background, coordinate multiple Workers to execute tasks and review results, pause and resume work, recover after interruptions, keep task history and deliverables, and build working memory and skills; offers a standard local mode and optional experimental private-Git collaboration.

title: Tisitan/dsh-my-go
description: Multi-agent orchestration preset: a lead agent dispatches subagents from a built-in role roster over separate read and write lane pools with per-role model binding, and collects each subagent report on a shared board; adds go_work/continue/need_help/forward tools, a tree-view panel and a settings page.

title: tyr1105/dsh-buddy#dsh-buddy
description: AI team with a pixel-art office showing each teammate's status and daily trail. A lead runs project sessions; daily caps per teammate. DSH Desktop, macOS only.

title: Velestia-star/agent-skill
description: Build named subagents and skills in a sidebar panel, then call any subagent by name in a conversation. Each subagent selects a model, reasoning effort, spawn or fork mode, a tool allowlist and skills; skills can be global, per workspace or per conversation.

title: WDahah/portable-dsh-multi-agent-plugin
description: Route each task to one model and its review to a different one, with qualification evidence, failover and a durable journal.

title: ws1234567891011/dsh-interim-narration
description: Makes the agent narrate its process: every turn opens with how it reads the message and what it will do first, then short interim notes between tool-call batches, with in-app settings for style, sentence cap and toggles.

title: wuanthony397-hash/dsh-codex-peer
description: Peer collaboration between a DeepSeek Harness agent and the local Codex CLI: split a goal into a shared work list, hand tasks over, review what comes back, and keep every prompt, event stream, and answer on disk.

title: xfgil/dsh-second-opinion
description: Expose a second-opinion tool: when the main agent is stuck it hands the problem to an independent session, receives a plan back, and continues — without waking or impersonating the user.

title: xingyanghaifu/dsh-reqtrace
description: Requirement-to-evidence audit for DSH sessions: maps each requirement to tool calls, files and commands, records per-requirement verification, and sends missing items back to the agent.

title: YingshuoZhang/dsh-chinese-reasoning
description: Makes a DeepSeek Harness agent reason in Simplified Chinese: each turn it appends one runtime-context instruction at the end of the conversation, and it can keep a stable declaration in the system prompt as well. Settings pick Simplified Chinese or off, and whether that declaration is included.

title: Yukikaze-Ai/dsh-ladder-superagents
description: Ranks models in a ten-slot ladder, routes each subagent by a 1-10 difficulty, and falls back a tier when one fails. Windows only; applies to sessions that opt in. Subagents can also launch local agent CLIs (Codex verified, nine others experimental), and a subagent granted full authority runs its CLI with --dangerously-skip-permissions, --yolo or --force. Run records go to .dsh-supa/ in the workspace.

title: yunxiyang/dsh-loop-continue
description: Resumes an agent turn that ended after narrating its next action without calling a tool: the guard replays the turn log on agent/turn-stopping, asks a judge model one true/false question, and steers the same turn to run one more step.

title: yyty947/dsh-advisor-chain
description: Asks a configured advisor model chain for a second opinion on demand; the advisor inherits the full conversation, fails over along the chain, and logs consultations as replayable chat cards.

title: ZekaiShi/Orivii
description: Animated AI companion for DSH with image and file chat, shared memory, reminders and background work; reads Bilibili videos through an installed dsh-bili-watch or dsh-bili-scroll plugin.

title: zhoulvyuan/dsh-plugin#dsh-claude-code-web
description: Claude Code-style workbench in DSH: workspace/session sidebar, streaming document-style transcript with unified tool cards and thinking, Markdown and Mermaid rendering, dark theme, and a draggable overlay panel backed by an in-host HTTP/WebSocket service.

title: 01men/DeptAI-UI-DSH
description: A collaboration front-office for AI agents and humans — department boards, tickets, approvals and industry calculations run inside the DSH conversation and panel, so agents do the work in chat while humans stay accountable in the panel. It calls the 01men/ybkkasi governance base over existing contracts (asset ledger, IAM, OIDC SSO, RBAC and scene-level authorization) instead of re-implementing governance. Ships as a Cordis bundle and mounts at /gate01; the selftest suite is green on every push. Do not install this and 01men/ybkkasi as dsh bundles in the same profile: both register the ops-platform-core / ops-iam / ops-authn rows. Requires DSH >=0.1.0-rc.7 <0.2.0.

title: 01Virex/dsh-status-rotator
description: Rotates the dsh turn-status label through 1059 bilingual phrases with typewriter output, an animated rainbow gradient, danmaku, 12 toggleable theme packs, live placeholders and tab-title rotation. Two star packs ship disabled by default; the stargazer pack carries one phrase per stargazer, refreshed weekly by a workflow.
