description: Coding workbench for DSH: docked workspace panels, a grouped project sidebar, split editor tab groups with hibernate/resume, file preview and diff views — built on parallel git worktree development with cross-session collaboration primitives.

title: Aeroscis/dsh-workspace-manager
description: Sorts the DSH sidebar workspace list: the workspace you last sent a prompt in rises above the first non-running one, with pin, drag-to-reorder, name filtering and one-click tidy; also removes empty workspaces and relocates a workspace folder to a new path while carrying its conversations over.

title: afawfawffaf/dsh-plugin-lx-music
description: Shows the lyrics LX Music is playing in a floating panel on the right of the DSH conversation page, with previous / play-pause / next controls. Scroll the lyric window to read ahead, double-click a line to start the song there, and if the player is not running, pressing play starts it in the system tray. Windows only, and LX Music has to be installed with its local Open API enabled.

title: afoxsss/dsh-conversation-map
description: Conversation minimap docked on the right edge of the dsh Web chat: colour-block and to-scale thumbnail modes, drag-to-resize (10–320px), hover loupe preview, click-to-jump and drag-to-scroll with a live viewport indicator, and collapse to a 4px strip.

title: ags-neto/dsh-status-telemetry
description: Adds a session status pill to the composer dock that expands into a panel of turn, token, performance and context readings.

title: AhaCrazy/dsh-nav-history
description: Global back/forward navigation for the DeepSeek Harness Web UI: remembers every session and whole-page panel you visit, shows a configurable 1-7 entry history strip you can click, and supports browser-style shortcuts plus mouse side buttons.

title: AhaCrazy/dsh-stock-quotes
description: Watchlist panel for A-share, Hong Kong and US quotes plus Eastmoney boards, with intraday sparklines and an agent stock_quote tool.

title: Ai-design-001/-DSH_mod-
description: Adds a delete entry to every session row in the dsh sidebar, including the blank New Session row, plus a settings section for font sizes and per-region colors. The entry archives the session (recoverable from Archive) rather than erasing it.

title: ai-eks/dsh-docking-layout
description: Dockable DSH Web UI layout that organizes conversations as tabs across draggable split groups.

title: Aicksion/dsh-clean-desktop-shell-pro
description: Enhanced desktop shell for DSH: auto-starts the local backend on launch (no browser tab), asks before closing the backend on quit, and starts the backend in parallel with Electron for faster cold start. Fork of dsh-clean-desktop-shell.

title: AiCoderChenweishi/dsh-workspace-topbar
description: Adds a workspace (project) switcher to the window title bar; selecting a project filters the session list to that project's sessions.

title: Aik358/dsh-anchored-monitor
description: A whip for DeepSeek V4 Pro: it watches the reasoning fingerprint of every thinking block and pulls the model back when it slips from focused "We will / I will" mode into scattered "let me" mode.

title: AikawaNaya/dsh-agents-md-editor
description: Left-sidebar panel that views, edits and saves ~/.dsh/AGENTS.md live, with version-guarded saves and atomic writes.

title: AikenFra/dsh-alive
description: Zero-token online status indicator for the DeepSeek Harness web UI: an always-visible online/offline dot in the conversation header, auto-refreshed every 15 seconds with no LLM calls.

title: AIMentalModel/prompt-manager
description: Prompt manager for DSH: imports prompts from JSON or Markdown sources and DSH's own system sections, then controls what is injected into the system prompt — per prompt, or per agent preset — with title editing, drag ordering, LLM translation and the option to inject either the original text or its translation.

title: AIpRoBuilder/FlowX#deepseek-harness-flowx
description: View FlowX workflow graphs and artifacts in DeepSeek Harness. Web only; needs Python 3.10 or newer with the FlowX SDK installed separately.

title: AirPineApplea/feiyu-chat-companion
description: Desktop companion for DeepSeek Harness: a Win32 layered window that keeps a whale-girl above other applications, speaks through a bubble, comments on its own when you stay on one window for ten seconds, and answers a single question typed into a right-click input box.

title: Aisland-SJL/dsh-worktable#01_content
description: Workbench plugin for the DeepSeek Harness web UI: collects your own projects and mounted plugin entries with rename, icon, sort, show/hide, project-to-session binding and a per-project file cabinet, adds a split-pane workspace engine with draggable panes, tabbed windows and built-in Explorer, terminal, browser, animation and custom panes, and auto-mounts an agent output into the matching window when it writes widget-result.json.

title: aiyacharley/dsh-at-sider
description: Enhances the native right-sidebar Files tab rather than replacing it: each row gets an @ reference button that inserts the canonical path mention into the composer, plus a size column, a sortable modification-time column, and a status dot for untracked, unstaged and staged files. Below the tree a git bar shows the branch with ahead/behind counts and expands upward into the 20 most recent commits, with a repository selector when a workspace has independent repositories in subdirectories. A header search box walks the workspace recursively and can open a result or expand the tree at it, preview tabs offer reveal-in-tree and one-click @, the tree is keyboard navigable with ARIA tree semantics, and a right-click entry on the Files tab switches back to the native tree at runtime.

title: AK-blank/dsh-plugin-offpeak-badge
description: Shows whether the DeepSeek API is currently billing at the off-peak or peak rate in the sidebar brand row, with the Chinese statutory-holiday calendar built in and zh/en copy.

title: akilonewbility/dsh-workspace-optimize
description: Redraw the left-hand workspace sidebar to add color highlighting, sorting, status indicators, and system notifications. You can also switch back to the original sidebar, which likewise implements some of these features.

title: AkiNoYo-desu/dsh-effort-slider-universal
description: Reasoning-effort slider in the model menu for DeepSeek Harness that also appears for providers and models with no declared effort metadata. Based on Microqian2th/dsh-codex-effort-slider — uninstall that upstream plugin before installing this one.

title: AKIRACOD/dsh-drag-and-drop
description: File-drag fork: drop documents as removable chips above the composer, send without typing.

title: aklnaaw/dsh-xiaoke-widget
description: A Claude-persona desktop pet pinned to the bottom-right corner of the DSH web GUI — shows balance, today's usage, peak/off-peak pricing and per-turn cost, with editable bubbles (text, balance, usage, pricing, images, random lines and weighted choices), per-line styles and fonts, a floating quick editor, sound effects, and custom character/audio. Ships animated roles that breathe and blink, plus a balance-alert variant that switches to a crying face when the balance falls below the alert line; 256/384 animation tiers and an optional 512 HD pack installed from the resource manager. 63 Claude-flavored lines. A derivative of MeteorNOX/DeepSeek-Balance-Whale-Widget (MIT).

title: AKS1st/dock
description: VSCode-style workbench shell for the DSH Web UI: activity bar, side bar, editor area, panel and status bar, with a registry service (ctx.workbench) for mounting panels, views and commands.

title: AKS1st/dock-editor
description: Text viewer and editor for the dock workbench: undo/redo, Ctrl+S save, unsaved-change confirmation and binary detection, registered as the default file viewer.

title: AKS1st/dock-files
description: File explorer for the dock workbench: tree browsing of the session workspace with create/rename/copy-paste/delete, drag-and-drop import and paste of local files and clipboard images.

title: AKS1st/dock-git
description: Git history visualization for the dock workbench: swimlane commit graph, branch and tag management, stage/commit/push and remote operations.

title: AKS1st/dock-images
description: Image viewer for the dock workbench: PNG, JPEG, GIF, WebP, BMP, SVG, ICO and AVIF, with SVG rendered as image data only.

title: AKS1st/dock-markdown
description: Markdown viewer for the dock workbench: GFM rendering with DOMPurify sanitization, document outline and relative-path image/link resolution, with one-click switch to editing.

title: AKS1st/dock-spreadsheet
description: Read-only XLSX, XLS, ODS, CSV and TSV viewer for dock-files with worksheet tabs, sorting, filters, search and cell links.

title: AKS1st/dsh-sysmon
description: System status floating widget: live CPU/memory/disk usage in the bottom-right corner of the DSH Web UI with threshold colour warnings.

title: AL-Yichen/dsh-fullscreen-input
description: Adds a full-screen panel to the DSH composer for writing multi-line text, movable and resizable, sharing one draft with the composer; Enter inserts a newline and only Ctrl+Enter sends, so an IME cannot turn Shift+Enter into a send.

title: AL1ghtm3ter/dsh-right-click-menu
description: Adds a right-click menu to the DSH web UI for files and for links: a file-tree row, a file path or file mention in a chat message, or a hyperlink opens a menu that previews a file in DSH, opens it in the default application or a chosen associated one, reveals it in the file manager, copies the path, the workspace-relative path, the file name, the link address, the link text or the file contents, saves a copy elsewhere, and opens an HTTP(S) link in the sidebar browser or in the system browser, while a right-click that is not on a file or a link keeps the browser's own menu.

title: AlannerFranklin/dsh-cutout-pet
description: Turns an uploaded picture into a floating desk pet by cutting out its background in the page, with idle animation and a live account-balance bubble.

title: alccs/dsh-visual-intelligence-engine
description: Render interactive diagrams, charts and staged learning visuals alongside native prose in DeepSeek Harness.

title: AlexPeng07/dsh-custom-plugin
description: Web GUI convenience suite with appearance controls, timeline navigation, project folders, prompts, conversation export, Mermaid rendering, quote reply, and DeepSeek balance and daily token usage.

title: AlexYin-Tongji/dsh-ui-enhancer
description: Desktop-style UI enhancements for the DSH Web client: adaptive wallpapers, a desktop pet companion with an activity feed and feeding economy, @file workspace references, and the resizable file/preview right panel.

title: Aliboder/dsh-prompt-forge
description: Composer prompt refinement: rewrite the draft through the harness LLM, preview the result, then apply or send it, with style presets, model-aware reasoning effort, cost estimate and a settings page.

title: AliceLJY/dsh-thumb
description: A phone shell for the web GUI - the sidebar becomes an overlay drawer that closes when a session is tapped, the settings sheet goes full-screen single column, and the transcript is retuned for phone reading.

title: alingalingling/ui-status-label
description: Customize the "deep diving" thinking status label to anything you like.

title: Aliuyanfeng/dsh-soul
description: Personalization for the agent: a Web UI panel (about-you, reply style & tone, traits for headings/lists and emoji, output language, custom instructions) and `/soul` commands, with nickname/occupation/bio/style/traits/language compiled into a system prompt and re-injected into active sessions. Exposes `soulConfig` for other plugins and a `set_persona` tool the agent can call.

title: ALIve114514awa/dsh-prompt-optimizer
description: Refine prompts with guided questions and editable previews using Harness AI or native Codex across Web, desktop and TUI, applying drafts only after user confirmation.

title: All3nCN/dsh-better-sidebar-N23
description: Full workbench fork of dsh-better-sidebar: explorer, editor, terminal, Git, browser and split panes, plus a VSCode-like shell refactor with a full-width compact header and activity rail; publishes as @all3cn/dsh-better-sidebar-n23 on npm.

title: AlLHHH/dsh-perf-boost
description: Performance optimization and smoothness enhancement for DSH Desktop (renderer-side only; host code untouched, no on-disk config): skips offscreen message rendering, stops frames and timers while the window is hidden, lazily loads media, coalesces session-list repaints and pre-warms large session files; shows the measured main-thread saving in settings. A lightweight speed-up for lag, dropped frames, slow large-session opening and background CPU use.

title: almazom/dsh-needs-attention-sidebar
description: Hospital-triage board for the DSH sidebar: sessions whose latest turn ended in an error (red = fatal, amber = 429/rate-limit) or is waiting for approval are grouped under an Attention tab, next to Working and Finished tabs, with ticking durations, dismiss with undo, unseen markers and EN/中文 auto-locale. An eye icon hides the session list (the header then shows Workspaces · N) and a Duty-gated chevron folds the nav bar; clicking a row opens the session across workspaces. Needs the zstd tool (zstdcat) on PATH. On-request log scan through a guarded same-origin route — no background daemons, zero core edits.

title: Alone-show/dsh-quick-keys
description: Two composer actions for the DSH Web UI: /new in the slash-command menu starts a new conversation without sending anything to the model, and Shift+Tab toggles plan mode while the conversation has focus.

title: AloneFu/dsh-calendar-plugin
description: Obsidian daily notes, tasks and Day Planner time blocks in the DSH sidebar: a Monday-first month grid with per-day word-count and task dots, a compact timeline for HH:mm time blocks, the selected day's diary excerpt and task list, and write-back of checkbox state, task text and times to the Markdown files; a first-run wizard detects the vault or accepts a path.

title: AlseFum/dsh-pluginlet
description: Turns every .pluginlet file under a repo's .dsh/pluginlets/ (directories configurable) into its own sandboxed Conversation View tab, gated by a capability grant bound to the file content hash.

title: altamkp/dsh-middle-click
description: Middle-click closes a session or a sidebar tab in the DeepSeek Harness Web UI. A session closes through the row's own archive action, so the confirmation for running work and the undo notice stay exactly as the Harness renders them; a tab closes through its own close control, leaving the rule that a lone guide tab cannot be closed untouched. The gesture settles on press-and-release on the same element, so a middle drag never closes anything. Two switches on the plugin's own Settings tab turn each half off, remembered per browser.

title: Altermoe/dsh-model-logos
description: Model brand marks in the composer model selector; vendor and model marks across Settings → Models (provider rows, model rows, the add-provider dropdown); and a per provider/model icon picker that stores overrides in the DSH user settings document.

title: altmanWang/dsh_plugin_btc_dashboard
description: DeepSeek Harness plugin adding an OKX perpetual-futures price dashboard: BTC/ETH candlesticks at 1m/3m/15m/1h/4h/1D, EMA overlays, line/Fibonacci/ruler drawing tools, close-line alerts through desktop notification, sound or email (email delivery additionally needs the dsh-qq-email plugin), and an in-panel backtester. Market data comes from OKX public endpoints and no API key is required.

title: AlyceStocking/hover-glossary
description: Shows local glossary definitions when hovering over terms in chat messages.

title: amazing-fish/dsh-piano-nav
description: Conversation navigation with full-history turns, collapsible process steps, final-result and structured question-and-answer keys, and pointer-following piano interaction.

title: Amengclass/dsh-settings-hub
description: Unify third-party plugin settings in DeepSeek Harness. Auto-discover, group, and reorder plugin settings under one collapsible nav entry with drag-and-drop support.

title: amstlkqp114514/dsh-desktop-tweaks
description: Desktop tweaks: F11 fullscreen toggle; enables Ctrl+C / Ctrl+V copy and paste in the terminal, both switchable in the General settings.

title: amyaxy/dsh-prompt-boost-model
description: Prompt enhancement for the DSH composer, with a model picker that lists the models the host actually offers: a Boost button beside the composer sends the current draft to a model on the Host, shows the rewrite in a before/after overlay, and replaces the draft only when you confirm. While boosting, the button glyph becomes a spinning arc; once a rewrite is applied the same button becomes an in-place Undo that restores the original draft and then returns to its idle state. Settings hold the enable switch, a provider/model choice rendered as a grouped dropdown built from the live provider list (including configurable providers that are not set up yet) rather than free-text fields, temperature, output limit, timeout and optional custom instructions. Empty or reasoning-only model answers are reported with their real cause instead of a generic failure, and the Host endpoint only answers loopback requests from the same origin.

title: an-an-618/dsh-hook-followup
description: Adds a lightweight follow-up row under each DSH answer: one anchor question plus 1-3 user-voice quick replies, so the next turn is one click away; supports always / balanced / conservative strategies and optional refusal or emotional-context skips.

title: an-an-618/dsh-intelligent-ui
description: Declarative interactive cards for DSH: the model writes a spec, the Host compiles it into a JSON program, and the client renders forms, tables, charts and lists with local state and explicit submit.

title: Analoty/dsh-auto-click
description: Mouse gestures for files in the DSH Web GUI: Ctrl+click a file-tree row, a file mention in a chat message or a file link to open it with the desktop default application; right-click opens a menu with open, the operating system own Open With chooser, save a copy, copy the absolute path, copy the file contents and reveal in the file manager, while a right-click on an ordinary hyperlink offers Copy Link. A plain click is left to DSH own sidebar preview and directory rows are left to the page. Open and reveal go through DSH own sessionController, the Open With chooser is the operating system dialog (Windows Shell verb, open -a on macOS) rather than an application list kept by the plugin, and file reads stop at 8 MiB.

title: Ananpng123/dsh-disk-manager
description: Windows disk manager for the DeepSeek Harness right sidebar: volume overview with usage bars, a session-grouped list of the documents each conversation produced, drag files straight into the chat composer, multi-select with batch delete to Recycle Bin, an expandable folder tree with real app icons, workspace documents no session touched, on-demand folder sizes, and an explorer-style context menu. Delete goes to the recycle bin.

title: Andor-Z/dsh-turn-outline
description: Adds a sidebar tab that folds a session into user turns (input, tool steps, output) with one-click jump back into the conversation.

title: androidly/dsh-restart-control
description: Adds a restart control at the DSH Web sidebar foot: the host exits through its own graceful path and the detected supervisor (systemd, Kubernetes or Docker) boots the replacement, or the plugin starts one directly when it finds no supervisor; a frame-wide notice polls the host pid until a new process answers.

title: AngleNaris/fanframe
description: FanFrame (繁界, “Fanxing’s realm”) lightly polishes the DeepSeek Harness Desktop UI for a more comfortable everyday experience.

title: angls4/dsh-window-drag
description: Restores title-bar window dragging and double-click zoom in DeepSeek Harness Desktop on macOS.

title: anitman/dsh-plugin-video-player
description: TikTok-style video feed in a floating sidebar window: swipe local or SMB-NAS folders, or paste online video URLs (yt-dlp, bilibili/YouTube, cookies.txt login state); the window auto-fits the video aspect ratio, with fullscreen, drag-resize, Range streaming and an agent video-queue endpoint.

title: AnJiaqi0926/dsh-plugin-switchboard
description: Toggles installed plugins from a sidebar panel, groups them by origin (official, marketplace, local), flags changes that need a Host restart, and installs curated plugins from a Discover tab.

title: ankesu/dsh-live2d-pet
description: Live2D companion for DSH: a floating Cubism model with state-driven expressions and mouse tracking; config-driven geometry (size/position from the plugin config); official Haru sample bundled (© Live2D Inc.).

title: Anna-la/dsh-simplify
description: Clean-mode for the Web GUI: hover any element and right-click to remove it; removals survive reloads and are restorable from the settings page.

title: anneheartrecord/dsh-desk-pet
description: macOS desk pet that lives outside the DSH page: a real always-on-top window that clears fullscreen Spaces, six states driven by local DSH, a native right-click menu with quiet mode and a session list, and a bundled skill that turns one photo into a full eighteen-pose skin on your own image tool and credentials; system Python and ctypes, no Electron and no dependencies.

title: anonamerjaxon-dev/dsh-model-grid
description: Responsive card grid for the DeepSeek Harness composer model picker, grouped by provider. Host-only: injects a stylesheet through webserver/index-inject without rebuilding the client bundle, and supports both the stock picker and the dsh-peakrate menu.

title: antnesswcm/dsh-shell-card-plus
description: Replaces the stock bash/pwsh terminal rows in the DSH web UI with shell command cards: long commands soft-wrap with line numbers instead of truncating, plus separate copy-command and copy-output buttons.

title: anye-99/dsh-next-step-suggest
description: Next-step suggestions for the DSH composer: after each completed turn, one auxiliary call on the session's current model returns 3 clickable follow-up suggestions above the input box, and clicking one fills the draft.

title: anzhaohao/DragView
description: Drag-and-drop file attachments as Codex-style cards, with in-app PDF/text/video/audio previews and system-default opening for other formats.

title: AomiRaku/dsh-accountDisplayName-edit
description: Customize the username (phone number or email) and avatar shown at the bottom-left account row — for personalization, or to keep screenshots from exposing them. The editor opens from the menu you get by clicking that row.

title: AomiRaku/dsh-ui-alt
description: Keeps the overall layout of the stock UI while tightening its radii, spacing and tidiness for a calmer, more professional and more efficient look. Also adds an account balance display. Most changes can be switched on or off individually in Settings.

title: aooom4/dsh-qq-dice
description: Adds a DSH settings panel for QQ proactive-message dice rolls, showing per-conversation progress, hit statistics and quiet/guarantee countdowns, with editable parameters that apply immediately. Reads from an auto-detected local bridge, a custom HTTP status endpoint, or a built-in demo engine.

title: apanzinc/dsh-no-preview-badge
description: Removes the Preview badge on DSH.

title: AppliedYuu/dsh-WallpaperAndCost
description: Merged plugin: wallpaper customization (original-resolution uploads, crop editor, per-area opacity, MP4/WebM dynamic wallpapers) + Steam Workshop wallpaper extraction (parses scene.pkg/.tex via a bundled Python script, preview/download) + DeepSeek balance & usage widget + OpenCode Go plan usage (rolling/weekly/monthly percents in a top header pill; expand for progress bars & reset countdowns). API keys are read from DSH's credential store by the host — never stored in source or the browser.

title: appthin/dsh-mcp-manager-plus
description: MCP management page in DSH Settings: list, enable/disable, restart and delete MCP servers, edit them in form or JSON mode, expand a server to see the tools it registers, paste-import MCP configs from 14 tools (Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, VS Code and more) in one go, and bind a server to project directories so only sessions working inside them can see or call its tools.

title: AprilCrystal/dsh-client-ui-font-scale
description: Conversation font-size controls for the Web UI: a stepper in the composer row, keyboard shortcuts, and Ctrl+wheel zoom, all writing through the theme service setFontSize.

title: AprilCrystal/dsh-client-ui-gpt-helper
description: ChatGPT-desktop-style model picker whose thinking-level slider carries a particle trail, plus a visual-only fast-mode toggle and a hold-to-lock for it.

title: aQasrt/dsh-side-chat-pro
description: Select text in a DSH conversation to ask it in a side chat, translate it with context-aware one-to-five candidate renderings, or explain the term, without touching the main transcript. Its HTTP routes have no DSH access check, so a web page open in your browser could call them.

title: Arc-huangjingtong/dsh-restart
description: Adds a restart button to the macOS DSH desktop sidebar that fully quits and reopens the app; on other platforms the button hides itself.

title: ArcaneOrion/dsh-model-selector-search
description: Session model selector with search: two-stage loose matching (normalised substring first, subsequence as fallback, so glm53 finds GLM-5.3 and ds finds DeepSeek), providers with recent successful calls pinned first, and a reasoning-effort pane that remembers each model's last explicitly chosen effort.

title: ArcaneOrion/dsh-teaching-board
description: Teaching board view: agent-generated self-contained HTML is projected into a sandboxed iframe as a board, annotated by hand (brush, four colours, eraser, undo), extended in place across several tool calls, and screenshotted back into the conversation as a real user message.

title: Archaofan/dsh-source-deck
description: In-conversation source deck for DSH Desktop (supports DSH 0.2.2-rc.2): the current chat model runs LLM search rounds, candidates render as GitHub-aware cards, and keep/exclude feedback, favorites, and the selected sources stay in the same conversation.

title: arcnapan/dsh-chat-answer-anchor
description: Freezes the DSH chat scroll position: new replies no longer drag the viewport to the bottom — it stays where you left it. Only after you send a message does it follow to the bottom so you can see your own input, then it locks again once the answer starts streaming. Each session remembers its own position (persisted across reloads), a settings toggle turns it off, and it never intercepts your own scrolling.

title: ardesp0630/dsh-work-progress
description: Persistent work-progress row in the band below the composer: task completion, a progress bar, and what the agent is doing right now (generating a reply or running a tool), expandable into the full task list with turns, steps, timings and context usage.

title: Arfrsa/dsh-sidebar-sections
description: Split the DSH sidebar workspace list into Active, Session tasks and Inactive sections with manual pins and an activity threshold, keeping the official search, archive filters, row menus and drag and drop, with a one-click switch back to the shipped list. The Session tasks section uses a fixed Windows workspace at D:\files\history-tasks; other platforms must create that directory manually.

title: Ariakage/dsh-claude-effort-slider
description: Replaces the composer Effort switch with a Claude Desktop-style five-level slider (Low/Medium/High/Max/Ultracode): a pill opens a popover above the composer, dragging snaps with a spring and writes once, and Ultracode maps to the model's maximum reasoning effort. Ships the Ultracode WebGL2 energy grid, a per-session Ultracode mode, and passes modifier-click through to the shipped level list.

title: ArimaKana-Akane/dsh-whale-tools
description: Replace the dsh-whale-widget mascot with your own image through a built-in cutout pipeline, plus a session-header restart button, a browser heartbeat, and an opt-in patch self-heal that is off by default.

title: Arrosam/dsh-better-workspace-file-manager
description: Adds upload, download, new folder, delete, drag-to-move, drag-to-chat and in-place text editing with auto-save to the workspace Files tab and file previews.

title: Arrosam/dsh-model-quick-selector
description: Adds a quick-select model list to the DSH composer model button: a settings icon on the Model row of the model menu opens a dialog to pick and reorder favourite models, dragging vertically on the model button switches between them on release, and dragging left or right steps the reasoning effort; the menu's reasoning-effort row also gets a draggable slider (based on Microqian2th/dsh-codex-effort-slider). Text follows the DSH language setting (English / Chinese).

title: Arrosam/dsh-smart-prompt
description: One-click prompt refinement for the DSH composer: the ✦ button next to Send rewrites the draft into an agent-ready prompt in Standard or Light mode, with Revert and Retry; asks follow-up questions through the question card when the draft is missing information; checks that paths, identifiers, numbers, URLs, inline code and @mentions survive the rewrite and adds back any that were dropped; runs on the conversation model or a dedicated model chosen on the Plugins page.

title: ARustamA/dsh-strata-monitor
description: Live monitor of a local Strata model server inside the DeepSeek Harness GUI: state, token rate, VRAM, GPU and CPU temperatures, and the last request, next to the message composer.

title: Arvin-work/dsh-plugin-file-annotate
description: Annotatable file editor for the DSH right sidebar with a lazy file tree, inline annotations, cross-file annotation navigation, Markdown preview, and composer-draft handoff.

title: asd13006/dsh-multi-lang-ui
description: Add six languages (繁體中文, 日本語, 한국어, Français, Deutsch, Español) to the DeepSeek Harness Web UI language options, with hand-polished per-language translations and automatic fallbacks (Simplified-to-Traditional conversion for zh-TW, English for the others) covering upstream updates and third-party plugins.

title: asfre/dsh-mcp-global-manager
description: Scans MCP configs from the tools it knows (28 built-in sources plus custom ones), syncs diffs into DSH, and lets you import, sync back, or edit MCP servers from the DSH sidebar.

title: ashz555/dsh-term-glossary
description: Select a term in a DeepSeek Harness conversation and press the Search button beside it to read the explanation in place: basic meaning, purpose and usage, with the token cost of that answer. The call is auxiliary — it writes nothing to the session log.

title: asots/dsh-longsession
description: Adds a reversible “Collapse history” toggle to the session header with a light/dark status dot: it unloads the history already rendered by the page and keeps the latest two turns, then shows “History collapsed”; clicking again restores the saved window. A manual restore keeps auto-collapse off for the rest of that session; thresholds and request caps live on Settings → Long session.

title: astelirons-ai/dsh-local-monitor
description: Floating, draggable sensor dashboard for the Harness Web UI on Windows: GPU-Z GPU temperature, clock and dedicated VRAM on the left, CPU temperature/clock and system memory on the right.

title: Asterlyra/dsh-panel-organizer
description: Hides unused panels in the left rail grouped by origin, and turns the rail More button into an expand/collapse toggle that lays out every panel.

title: Asteroid-Code-Channel/dsh-workspace-atlas
description: AGENTS & Skills Studio: edit AGENTS.md, create spec-compliant SKILL.md files with structured frontmatter, manage and rename skill folders, and install from Anthropic, OpenAI, Cursor, and Matt Pocock catalogs.

title: AstralHorizon4/dsh-shared-reading
description: Read books inside DSH: import EPUB, TXT, Markdown or HTML into a paginated reader, highlight a passage and ask about it in that book's own agent session; four reading tools stop at unread chapters and everything stays in plain local files. Its routes are mounted with webServer.register and carry no DSH Host/Origin admission check, so a web page open in your browser can create reading sessions and change the library through them.

title: asukasec/dsh-message-preview
description: Right-edge user-message navigator with an adaptive block layout that fits the available height, plus hover previews, keyboard controls, and click-to-jump navigation.

title: asun-labs/dsh-plugin-agent-switch
description: Adds interactive agent-switch CLI terminals with tab and grid layouts, Codex delegation cards, and live or saved task output in the right sidebar. Requires agent-switch on PATH, at least one target coding CLI, and a node-pty build allowlist; implemented and tested on Windows.

title: asxiuxiu/dsh-quick-open
description: Quick-open palette for the Web GUI: Ctrl+P fuzzy-searches an in-memory index of the session workspace (about 51k entries, median query 5 ms) with per-segment path anchoring, dir: and file: prefixes, Tab directory drilling and :line jumps, opens the picked file in the native right sidebar, and drops a file reference into the conversation draft with Ctrl+Enter. Also adds in-file find (Ctrl+F) and a selection-to-reference action to the built-in file preview.

title: Asza-other/dsh-narrator
description: Watches a turn for long silences and, once the threshold passes, injects a user message asking the model to state in prose what it is doing before carrying on, so the turn keeps going. The same text is mirrored in a lower-left overlay above the composer. The silence threshold and the minimum gap between reports are set in minutes, the prompt can be replaced wholesale, and it runs with no runtime dependencies. Requires DSH 0.2.1+ and Node.js 18+.

title: atattier/local-model-speedtest
description: Adds model speed tests to the DSH model picker and, on desktop, a plain-language "explain this error" button on failed turns with a user-selectable explainer model.

title: atrestandbed-bot/dsh-agents-viewer
description: View and edit the AGENTS.md / CLAUDE.md instruction chain in a native right-sidebar tab — global, shared, and every project directory down to the session working directory — with in-place save that creates missing files, a chat-header toggle, and an /agents command that works without the panel.

title: aug-245/dsh-plugin-market-entry
description: Adds a plugin market entry button to the left sidebar that opens the installed market in a main panel.

title: AumiSatori/dsh-ui-beautify
description: Personalize DSH with glass surfaces, independent light and dark themes, image/video/HTML backgrounds, particles, custom greetings, overlay sidebars, task and Artifact cards, message bubbles, smooth answer streaming, and settings import/export.

title: AvenYQ/dsh-clipforge
description: Video workbench for DeepSeek Harness that parses a link, downloads the source, transcribes it, trims or merges clips and exports GIFs. Requires ffmpeg/ffprobe and yt-dlp; whisper.cpp plus a model is optional for videos without subtitles.

title: AvenYQ/dsh-quiet
description: A grey ASCII ocean behind the whole window: whales swim continuously across the sidebar and the chat area, so a creature can drift from one column into the other. Once a conversation starts, every creature leaves through its own edge — up, down, right, or left — while the sea calms, and the sidebar keeps one frosted surface whose height follows its content, so a passing whale becomes a soft shadow behind the labels; an empty conversation brings them back in from the edges. Streaming replies reveal from blur to clear, and reduced motion falls back to a still frame and the native renderer. Neutral ink only, with day and night palettes.

title: AvenYQ/dsh-rigui
description: A personal life workbench as a sidebar panel: sleep, meals, workouts, spending, weight, schedule and to-dos share one page of cards that react to one another, and one sentence typed at the top is turned into structured records by the model configured in DSH. Records and card layout stay in local browser storage.

title: AvenYQ/dsh-vellum
description: Native cards inside DSH replies: when the model writes a vellum code block, it renders as a theme-following metrics, chart, comparison, checklist, steps, timeline, form, quiz or sortable table card; clicks, submits and answers come back to the conversation as the next message.

title: AvigatorC/dsh-conversation-width
description: Pins the conversation column of the dsh UI to a fixed width — a pixel value or a percentage of the column — from a row in General settings, and hides the built-in drag handles so the width stays put.

title: awaYFawa/dsh-plugins-folders
description: Folders for the DSH Plugins page: group installed plugins, toggle a whole group, batch move with undo, search across groups, long-press drag to reorder, reinstall removed plugins from their record, and restart Harness with one click.

title: AWL-MC2/DSH-Plugin_awl
description: Wallpaper-aware readability repair for the DSH Web GUI: it lifts the three low-contrast secondary text tokens with color-mix plus an adjustable text halo, adds content rules (bold, permanently underlined or recoloured links, tinted headings and body text) scoped to conversation Markdown only, offers adjustable rainbow-edge and gradient-fill heading effects, loads custom fonts from the plugin folder or the DSH home, and ships a draggable WYSIWYG preview with a WCAG contrast badge.

title: Awu12277/dsh-sleep-send
description: Schedule-send button and panel to the right of the composer, with smart time slots, a custom date/time picker, several queued sends at once, and localStorage persistence that restores pending tasks after a page reload.

title: ayachinene285/dsh-composer-resize
description: Adds a drag handle above the chat composer so its height can be set by hand at any content length, with double-click to restore auto-grow capped at 168px.

title: ayahunter/dsh-trail#bundle
description: Replaces the Web GUI trajectory tab with a new-user-friendly round-by-round storyline, plain-language tool labels, category filters and fuzzy search.

title: ayingQAQ/dsh-web-launcher
description: Windows desktop launcher bundle for DSH Web that creates a managed shortcut, then restarts DSH in the background and refreshes the existing browser page.

title: ayuanxx-max/dsh-session-accordion
description: Chat turn accordion: every interaction folds into one row with a time pill and question summary, only the newest turn stays open, and switching sessions or starting a new turn resets the open state; the execution process opens only on its own click.

title: AZ-666316/dsh-prompt-optimizer-button
description: Prompt optimizer inside the DSH composer. One click rewrites the current draft with the model you already selected: it classifies the scenario (paper / repo evaluation / agent task / daily question / English writing), returns a compact three-check diagnosis panel (is acceptance testable? missing information or capability? raising depth or widening scope?), and lets you pin a scenario manually. A running rewrite can be stopped without writing a half result back, a selected fragment can be rewritten on its own, and every rewrite keeps an undo history per session in the browser (up to ten steps). The draft is replaced in place, with no extra chat turn. Its HTTP routes have no DSH access check, so a web page open in your browser could call them.

title: azazo1/dsh-deep-diving-back
description: Restores the blue shimmering Deep diving turn status row that DSH 0.1.6 and earlier showed at the end of the transcript.

title: azazo1/dsh-reduce-effects
description: Adds a UI effects page to Settings that switches off DSH Web animations and transitions, loading and progress animations, backdrop blur, smooth scrolling, hover title scroll, shadows, gradients and JS motion one category at a time, to cut browser rendering cost.

title: Azerz/dsh-video-insight
description: Video analysis panel in the DeepSeek Harness sidebar. Paste a YouTube or Bilibili link to fetch its subtitles and generate a summary, chapters, a mind map and citation-backed Q&A over the transcript, with an embedded player whose timestamps jump to that moment and keep playing. Videos without subtitles fall back to local Whisper / SenseVoice transcription (audio stays on the machine); silent videos fall back to frame OCR with macOS Vision, or to vision-model frame descriptions. Per-video analysis caching, a 20-item history, and two agent tools: video_digest and video. A Bilibili SESSDATA cookie, if you enter one, is stored in ~/.dsh/video-credentials.json (mode 0600), transcripts are sent to your current model, and its HTTP routes have no DSH access check.

title: Azetus/dsh-quorfloat
description: System-level desktop floating-window plugin for DeepSeek Harness (DSH): a global hotkey opens a floating window; the plugin supports workspace and session switching, approval and follow-up handling, and export of its own diagnostic logs for plugin troubleshooting.

title: azkbzxf/dsh-account-balance-pill
description: Shows the signed-in DeepSeek account's remaining balance in the DSH composer bottom bar, next to the shipped turn/step and token-usage pills, and refreshes it periodically and after each turn.

title: azkbzxf/dsh-vscode-scrollbar
description: Gives the DSH conversation the Visual Studio Code editor chrome: a 14px always-visible scrollbar with a flat, translucent thumb, plus a VS Code-style minimap in the right margin (half-window column, media not painted, hover-only minimapSlider, click/wheel scrolling) and auto-expanded older pages.

title: AzureSkyHuHu/dsh-chinese-mode-modern
description: Adds a Chinese-mode toggle beside the composer that opens a panel for switching reply, reasoning, and tool-narration language, persisted in the profile.

title: Azusa-299/dsh-ba-click-fx
description: Adds Blue Archive style click and touch effects plus a cursor trail to the DSH Web GUI, with theme color, scale, opacity, glow, speed and on/off switches on a Click FX page in Settings.

title: B612wang/dsh-ui-transparency
description: Whole-window opacity for the DSH desktop window from one button at the sidebar foot: a 0-90% slider whose value is remembered between runs. It only sets the window alpha - no restyling, no extra panels, and no other feature is touched. Windows only.

title: bagpipe1289/dsh-paperflight#plugin
description: PaperFlight is an experimental future-retro DSH Web workbench with session management, file previews, approvals, and optional preset-scoped browser and terminal tools.

title: Bai-2008/dsh-better-panel
description: Replaces the model button in the DSH composer with its own two-level panel (provider list, then a searchable model list) built around a continuous draggable reasoning-effort slider: blue-to-violet fill, nebula and star particles on higher levels, and a distinct color per level. Picking a model keeps the panel open and moves the slider to that model's middle level. The implementation started from Microqian2th/dsh-codex-effort-slider 1.0.0 (credited in the README); the panel, the seat takeover, the offline test suite and the docs are new here.

title: baifagg/dsh-plugin-busy-workspace
description: Ranks workspaces holding a session that wants attention to the top of the sidebar session list - waiting on you first, then running, then finished-but-unopened, then just read - and draws those rows with a state bar, tinted surface and coloured title, plus a one-shot settle pulse when a run stops. Every colour is taken from the active theme's own tokens, and the three windows that decide how long a finished session stays promoted are settings.

title: bailishta/dsh-sidebar-mode-indicator
description: Shows the mode (agent preset) each Session runs under as a colored pill in the left sidebar, with a settings page for per-mode dot colors.

title: bainianlaoyao/easy-archive
description: Two-step inline archive on workspace sidebar rows — one click arms a red confirm, the second click archives; the archive entry is removed from the ⋮ menu.

title: baisama-cloud/dsh-composer-history
description: Command history for the DSH composer: press Up/Down to cycle through previously sent instructions, then restore the draft at the end of the history; works in the official desktop app and web-profile builds.

title: Baisbt/dsh-GreaterClarity-plugin
description: Enhances the DSH web session view — one-click collapse of reasoning and tool chains, numbered history quick-jump, Markdown export, AI avatars.

title: baitouwuya/dsh-super-cards
description: Native UI cards instead of Markdown: the assistant calls render_ui and the answer renders as a card in the conversation — 29 block types (metrics, tables, charts, timelines, kanban, flow charts, clickable actions), a content auto-layout mode, four placements (inline, process, dock board above the composer, turn-tail next-step card), a schema-backed settings form, and an optional automatic next-step card. Cards are rebuilt from the recorded tool arguments, so they survive replay and fork; 253 offline tests, no build step.

title: BAIYE0303/dsh-ask-first
description: Adds a button to the composer that restates your draft, then asks a few questions with clickable options — every question offers an "I don't know, you decide" escape — and only then rewrites the draft into a request an agent can start on. The whole flow can be finished without typing, and it never sends for you.

title: balue8246-maker/dsDragPasteALL
description: Drag or paste any local file onto the DSH page; it resolves the real absolute path (Spotlight + size/mtime + head/tail fingerprint match) and inserts it into the composer, with a content-cache fallback.

title: BangBang-03/dsh-client-ui-quote
description: Turn any DSH selection into a reviewable quote — chat, file preview, terminal and diff; code quotes carry path#line. A sent quote keeps a source highlight and ordinal and jumps back, then joins a searchable review list with status, tags, multi-select insert, and Markdown/JSON export. Quotes collect above the composer as a 引用 ×N bar with per-chip edit and remove; side threads can bring their conclusion back to the main draft; a sent quote can be revised, with the old capsule marked superseded; replies can answer each quote by number.

title: BaoBao1996121/dsh-huaci-pinglun
description: Selection comments and quoted conversations (dsh划词评论 / dsh-huaci-pinglun), based on the MIT-licensed BangBang-03/dsh-client-ui-quote 0.11.1 with attached textarea measurement, border-aware height and long-text scrolling.

title: BaoBao1996121/dsh-restart-ui
description: Adds a restart button to the DSH Web UI through a loopback-only endpoint that requests a relaunch using the current process executable, arguments and working directory.

title: Basspoom/dsh-nextline
description: NextLine suggests a personalized next message in the DSH composer and lets you accept it as an editable draft.

title: bd233/dsh-bottom-tabs
description: Browser-style Session tab strip docked at the bottom of the DSH Web UI window. Each tab is an open Session - click to switch, the close button removes it from the strip without archiving it, and "+" starts a new Session. Sessions can also be added from the sidebar Session context menu.

title: dsh-keep-awake
description: Holds the OS wake lock while any agent, subagent, or background job runs, releases it after a configurable grace period, and provides a bilingual web settings page with live status, manual hold, and display-on options.

title: BeckChiang/dsh-rsa
description: Configurable startup splash screen for the DeepSeek Harness desktop app on Windows only — a real main-process splash with live preview and light/dark themes. Deploys by rewriting the app's app.asar (a backup is kept) and takes effect on the next launch after you quit DSH; redeploy after each DSH upgrade.

title: Beellix-dev/beellix-dsh-ui
description: Beelli X UI brings searchable settings to DSH NEXT on Windows. Appearance groups themes, skins, fonts, pets, and effects, while Models has its own page. Use images or MP4 wallpaper, adjust frosted panels, and save skin presets. Switch between pets and upload default and extra animations for each one. Preview, time, or skip MP4 and GIF startup animations. Add model connections from provider presets or a custom endpoint, fetch and select models, or enter model IDs manually. You can also restore or bulk-delete archived chats by workspace and switch or add plugin catalogs on the same page. Replaces the built-in Settings page and sidebar (disables ui-settings-general and ui-sidebar); run only one plugin that takes them over.

title: Beership/dsh-download-progress
description: Live download progress in the DSH session header — percentage, transfer speed, ETA and phase per download, with file-size probing before a transfer starts and byte-range resume after an interruption. The progress cards render as a fixed overlay at the top-right of the chat window.

title: begin2023/dsh-weight-journal
description: A daily weight journal for the Web GUI: one reading per calendar day, a monotone-cubic trend chart over 7/30/90-day and all-time windows with the entries' 7-reading mean and a goal line, weekly-mean comparison bars, a sidebar panel, a weight_journal tool (record, list, delete) that writes through the same store as the page, and a frame-wide reminder capsule that rotates through eight languages.

title: BEIDAOU/dsh-boot-animation-custom
description: Customizable startup animation for DeepSeek Harness with eight bundled clips, random rotation, tail fade and time-of-day greetings. Based on lxj5820/dsh-boot-animation, so do not install it with the upstream plugin; bundled clips and the welcome voice carry their own media terms.

title: BenHanks303/dsh-shortcut-extensions
description: Keyboard-driven quick switching for DSH — model palette with colored provider tags, suffix tags and pins, a two-column session palette with per-question prompt preview and archived-session restore, recency-ordered session cycling, find-next-answered jump, composer focus, and configurable permission cycling, managed from a sidebar control panel.

title: BestQ-A/dsh-session-tree
description: Hierarchical session tree for the sidebar - native subagent trees plus an optional organization-derived hierarchy, with collapsed branch counters and orphan/cycle defense.

title: Betsy20/dsh-magpie
description: Embeds the original Magpie web UI in the DSH sidebar: downloads the Magpie binary from the yetone/magpie GitHub releases when missing, starts `magpie serve --web` in the background, and serves it through a local reverse proxy that injects the login cookie server-side.

title: better-er/dsh-classic-coding
description: Slides out a Monaco editor plus a lazy-loaded file-tree panel in the DSH Web conversation, so you can edit the local workspace inline without switching to an external editor.

title: better-er/dsh-edit-diff
description: Client-side re-render of edit/write tool cards with a near-linear line-level diff that drops duplicate unchanged lines and underlines the actual changed characters inside replaced lines.

title: better-er/dsh-mobile-drawer
description: Below 1024px the sidebar collapses to a 44px floating square and expands into a 280px overlay drawer; picking a session collapses it again and the focus grab that would raise the soft keyboard after a session switch is suppressed.

title: better-er/dsh-tool-autoexpand
description: Auto-expands newly arrived tool-call cards in the DSH Web UI, with a sidebar toggle cycling no-op/expand/collapse and the state persisted to localStorage.

title: BeyondandSharp/dsh-plugin-scaling
description: Independent per-pane zoom for the DSH web shell: Ctrl+wheel over a pane, Ctrl+± / Ctrl+0 for the focused pane. Works with the official look and every skin.

title: beyondgjc/dsh-persona-presets
description: Three custom agent presets, one editable character card each, with three built-in personas out of the box; import SillyTavern character-card PNGs or md/txt/json setting files, and the settings section handles naming, editing, and card-image display — edits apply on the next turn with no restart.

title: bf185003/dsh-favicon-status
description: Browser tab status indicator for dsh web: paints the document favicon from the session list (blue spinning while work runs, amber while waiting on the user, green when finished).

title: big-head-pigeon/dsh-session-menu
description: Adds mark-unread, copy session info, reveal in Finder or open with your IDE, and permanent delete (with child sessions) to the DSH sidebar session menu, plus error and unread status dots, hover-card details, one-click delete for archived rows, and a settings panel that switches each menu item on or off; the interface is available in English and Chinese.

title: bigbigman-001/dsh-quote-to-composer
description: Select text anywhere in DeepSeek Harness, click the quote pill next to the pointer, and the selection lands in the composer as a small quote chip; hover the chip to read the full quote.

title: bigfatorangecatjohn/opening-free-0.21.0#dsh-opening
description: Full-screen boot animation for DeepSeek Harness: a wave sweeps the screen, a whale assembles from particles inside three breathing dot rings, and a four-language salute lands over a segmented progress bar; ships an 18-second cut and 3.8-4.5-second short cuts, a language picker in settings, and a four-language preview queue.

title: biggerboy/dsh-conversation-anchors
description: Codex-style left-gutter tick rail for each user turn, with hover preview and click-to-scroll.

title: bilbillm/dsh-steam-startup-animation
description: Steam Big Picture-style six-second Canvas startup animation for DSH Desktop with a variable-width terminal-to-whale transition, optional stereo startup audio, volume controls, preview, Escape skip, and reduced-motion support.

title: bill9109/dsh-drag-and-drop
description: Cross-platform file drag-and-drop with raw path insertion, no file copying.

title: 图片缩放查看器（dsh-image-zoom）
description: In-chat image viewer for DeepSeek Harness: wheel and trackpad pinch zoom at the pointer, two-finger and drag panning, gallery navigation, downloads named from the image description and timestamp, and opening workspace originals in the system default app.

title: 便签墙（dsh-sticky-wall）
description: A sticky-note wall in the DSH sidebar: nine paper colors, categories, search, archive, to-do checklists with stable item ids, and agent read/write tools.

title: bingying-project/dsh-provider-model-switcher
description: Groups the composer model picker by provider, labels the native model button with the owning provider, and links each provider row to Settings → Models.

title: bitterSmilezzz/dsh-model-selector
description: Enhanced model selector for the DSH composer with searchable provider groups, keyboard and accessibility support, and an inline reasoning-effort slider.

title: bitxeno/dsh-github-picker
description: Composer GitHub picker: click the GitHub icon at the bottom-right of the input box to search the workspace repository's issues and pull requests via the gh CLI, and insert the reference as a URL or @owner/repo#number mention.

title: Biu-Bong/dsh-menu-hidden
description: Lazy Menu for DSH — hide the duplicate DeepSeek account / official API entries in the model picker, in Settings → Models and in the subagent model list, plus sidebar and account-menu items (14 toggles); auto-fill reasoning levels (low / medium / high / max), context window and image input for new models; on DSH Desktop, add Reload / Restart to the application menu with a one-click patch to the app shell main.js (backup and one-click restore included; needs an app restart, and a DSH update reverts the patch).

title: BlackBearCC/dsh-pet-sprite
description: A pixel companion living in the chat area: hatches from an egg into one of three sprites or an LLM-drawn custom one from a text description, platform-jumps over message bubbles on its own, WASD controllable, chats in character through the models you already configured, and carries a nurture system (mood/power/health, levels, shop) driven by real token usage.

title: Blackman99/codsh#codsh-bundle
description: Terminal coding agent for DeepSeek Harness with a full-screen alternate-screen UI, turn-aware session navigation, and a gated /ship workflow that takes one-line requirements through specification, TDD, and rerun acceptance checks.

title: blacktaoK/dsh-skill-zh-overlay
description: Chinese summaries for the dsh-skill-mcp-panel skill cards: each expanded card gets a short Chinese overview, a category tag and a few bullet points, while the English description the panel already renders is folded behind a "原文" toggle. Skills missing from the bundled map are translated on demand by the host with your current default model and cached on disk, keyed by a hash of the original text, so a new skill needs no manual entry. Skills whose own description is already Chinese are skipped.

title: Blacstar7/dsh-fps-workbench
description: Four-pointed star (FPS) adds long-task status, tool summaries, session outputs, persistent attachment drafts, native voice integration, provider usage, compatibility checks, and optional image generation to DSH.

title: BlazeNebula/dsh-todo-notes
description: A three-scope TODO board for DeepSeek Harness (user, workspace and session) with nested folders that can reference one item from several places, T0–T9 priorities, drag reordering, batch actions, a floating panel that also opens as a right-sidebar tab, Markdown preview windows that can stay open with autosaving title and body editing, and agent read/write tools, with every write gated by DSH approval.

title: Blueteemo/dsh-audio-rail-macos
description: macOS 14.2+ only: the macOS counterpart to Lingwuxin/dsh-audio-rail — the DSH conversation rail pulses with whatever the Mac is playing, a real 12-band spectrum that only changes bar length, leaving the host state colours and lengths untouched. Requires the Audio Recording permission on first run. Do not install it alongside dsh-audio-rail: both drive the same rail and register the same /audio-rail/events and /audio-rail/status routes.

title: blueziii/dsh-peakvalley
description: Composer-dock badge showing DeepSeek peak/off-peak pricing on a Beijing-time calendar whose China holiday schedule is fetched online at runtime (off-peak costs half the peak rate); auto-hides for non-DeepSeek models and cycles seven readouts on click.

title: bmhty123/dsh-comfyui-rp
description: Local text-to-image automation for DeepSeek Harness: captures the conversation, sends it to a prompt session, renders with your own ComfyUI, and brings the images back to a sidebar tab, a floating frame and a gallery.

title: Bobnemimimmi/dsh-visible-action-row
description: Pins each message's action row — copy/like/dislike/branch controls, timestamp, and third-party additions — so it stays visible without hovering.

title: boogoo619/dsh-focus-overlay
description: Focus mode with a full-screen reading overlay that hides the header and composer and folds AI tool calls into summaries.

title: Boris-boomer/dsh-icon-grid
description: Scene-independent floating icon grid container for DSH plugins, with drag-and-drop sorting, theming, and persistence.

title: Boris-boomer/dsh-project-cockpit
description: Floating cockpit panel (draggable, resizable, default 400x600) with five tabs — orchestration, matching, cost, signal, graph — aggregating four engines into unified /__dsh/project-cockpit/* webServer routes. Opens via a built-in launcher button; dsh-icon-grid icon is an optional extra entry.

title: breakc0re/dsh-yandex-music
description: Yandex Music inside the DSH sidebar: search, a draggable queue with repeat and shuffle, playlists with drag-and-drop editing, 700 My Wave stations plus a wave by any artist, karaoke lyrics with real timecodes and a Russian translation, volume, media keys, and playback that resumes where it stopped after a restart. Requires a Yandex account and a Plus subscription.

title: BrianHIO-x/dsh-think-expand
description: Keeps manually opened Think rows expanded by default, with a per-session switch to open or close every Think row; tool cards stay collapsed and state resets on page reload.

title: brickhu/dsh-plugins#icon-studio
description: Project-level icon library: a right-sidebar Icons panel plus four agent tools (icon_list, icon_get, icon_save, icon_annotate) that turn SVG shapes into named, rule-described assets. Artwork can be pasted, imported from Iconify or IconMCP, adopted from a workspace scan, or generated; editing one drawing rewrites every code reference to it.

title: brickhu/dsh-plugins#references
description: Right-sidebar Reference Links tab that collects every http(s) URL from a conversation, with pins, per-link turn counts and a click-through list of the turns that mentioned it, search, manual renaming, single-link or whole-host hiding, and a Cmd/Ctrl+Shift+L shortcut. Titles come only from the conversation (markdown labels, web search results, fetched page titles) — no remote title scraping and no model calls.

title: BroCC57/dsh-pending-review-glow
description: Highlights sidebar session rows by state (pending approval, running, just finished) with color, animation and a matching status dot.

title: btsd321/dsh-oh-my-terminal
description: Bottom terminal panel for the DSH Web GUI, providing multi-tab interactive terminals powered by node-pty (Windows ConPTY / POSIX openpty) with split panes, a side terminal list, and a dropdown new/split menu. Also compatible with DSH-better-sidebar — auto-detected at runtime, it switches to a bottom workbench tab so PTY sessions do not bind the DSH session write handle.

title: buaaflyaway/dsh-question-note
description: Adds an optional note field under each selected option in the DSH Web UI ask_user_question popup; submitted notes travel to the model in the answer's custom field.

title: BuildWithAIHub/dsh-boot-animation-plus
description: A fork of dsh-boot-animation that plays an intro clip when DSH opens, ships four embedded clips with an in-app library, and adds batch deletion for clips you added yourself. It reuses the same plugin id as upstream, so the two cannot be installed together.

title: burningg/dsh-workspace-categories
description: Sidebar category groups for DSH workspaces: the flat project list becomes collapsible named sections, workspaces re-file by dragging a row onto a group or picking one from a dropdown, one toolbar button collapses every group at once, an appearance panel sets font size, text color and background tint for each of the three levels, and Ctrl+Tab cycles recently opened sessions.

title: dsh-code-collector
description: Session code collector for DeepSeek Harness: a composer-side panel gathering every code block the model produced in the current session, with by-language / by-file views, per-file version history, live search, per-entry copy, copy-all, download-all as Markdown, and click-to-jump back to the exact turn (Alt+Shift+C).

title: dsh-conversation-timeline
description: Conversation timeline dock bar for DeepSeek Harness: a turn-level timeline above the composer with user-prompt hover tooltips and click-to-jump back to the exact chat position.

title: byf1999/dsh-plugin-workspace-split

title: CAI-KUN-MAX/prompt-polish#dsh-plugin-prompt-polish
description: PromptPolish is an icon-only prompt optimizer beside the DeepSeek Harness model selector: it rewrites the current draft with the active session model and DSH quota, with no API key, no auto-send, and draft-change protection.

title: CAI-MH/dsh-agent-group-panel

title: caidows/dsh-codex-model-picker

The slider snaps only to whole stops and updates the effort label while dragging; selecting a model or effort still goes through the session model directory, so it stays in sync with the rest of the composer.

title: caimc21069065-prog/dsh-my-music
description: Full-page NetEase Cloud Music player for DSH: daily recommendations, playlist browsing by category, charts, new releases, search, playlist/album/artist pages, QR-code login, synced lyrics, queue and downloads, plus four agent tools for search, song URLs, lyrics and playlist tracks.

title: caisiyang123/dsh-tick-rail
description: Tick-rail conversation navigator: one tick per message you sent, a lit peak that follows the mouse with an even falloff, hover previews, click or keyboard to jump.

title: Canary-Builds/dsh-mobile-ui
description: Adds touch-friendly navigation, layout refinements, and standalone PWA styling to the existing DeepSeek Harness web interface.

title: CAOGGL/dsh-port-token
description: Puts a key badge in the bottom-right corner of the dsh Web GUI that shows the port this instance is listening on and the remote-access token printed by dsh web at startup, with a copy button per value; clicking the badge rotates the key into a cross, and clicking it again or anywhere beside it collapses the panel.

title: captainyufei/dsh-dock
description: UI plugin for DeepSeek Harness with a persistent customizable left Dock, cross-workspace pinned chats, a draft-first home, global search, a completion inbox and right-panel video previews.

title: CarrotFish/dsh-file-and-terminal
description: Adds host file management and an interactive Bash terminal to the DSH WebUI.

title: CaT-Hode/DSH-app
description: Windows Electron companion sharing the DSH Web profile, conversations and plugins, with startup logs, update recovery and diagnostics.

title: CatLollipop/dsh-composer-draft-cache
description: Composer enhancements: caches unsent drafts per workspace for new sessions and per Session id for existing ones, restoring them after switching away and dropping them once sent or cleared; adds an @plugin completion group that mentions an installed plugin so the agent receives that plugin's metadata as runtime context for the turn.

title: causebefore/dsh-pomodoro
description: Pomodoro focus-and-break timer for DSH Web with configurable cycles, a draggable mini panel, and in-app, sound, and browser notifications.

title: cayan0x/dsh-fold-context
description: Auto-fold context/system messages in DSH conversation — collapse think blocks, tool calls, and tool results into grouped expandable bars.

title: ccch1mneyyy/dsh-TUI
description: Claude Code-style full-screen terminal UI: pixel-whale header, live status line, and streaming thought expansion.

title: ccfeeling/dsh-host-file-explorer
description: Left-sidebar panel that browses the filesystem of the machine the Harness runs on: directory listings with sizes and modification times, a summary of the open folder (files, folders, total size, largest file types), text and image previews, file downloads, file uploads by file picker or drag and drop, folder creation, and exporting a listing as CSV or JSON. The panel speaks twelve languages. Reads and writes run with the privileges of the account that runs the Harness.

title: ccll/dsh-activity-pane
description: Activity overview pane for the DSH web UI: running, awaiting-response and recent sessions with child agents, progress, model and reasoning level in one sidebar pane.

title: ccq1/dsh-side-panel
description: Side panel with file browser, terminal, and Git review for quick file previews.

title: cdredfox/dsh-prompt-shortcuts
description: Pinned prompt shortcuts in a single row above the composer — one click replaces the draft with the saved text — plus a searchable panel for pinning, editing and deleting prompts, overflow collapsed into a "More" menu, storage in a Host-side JSON file, and a prompt_shortcuts agent tool that reads and writes the same file.

title: Ceelog/dsh-plugins#dsh-plugin-setting-mcp
description: Manage MCP servers from the Web settings panel: view, add, edit, remove, enable or disable them, with hot reload on save.

title: Celebrate-W/dsh-topic-trail
description: Turns each long dsh conversation into a three-level trail (topic to progress steps to milestone timeline) and shows it in a draggable overlay, where one click jumps back to the matching message in the transcript. Topics are distilled by the DeepSeek model with a zero-cost rule-based fallback, can be renamed, locked, merged by drag and drop, and support per-conversation notes plus a vector drawing board.

title: Centaurea5547196/dsh-page-zoom
description: Page zoom for the DSH Web UI: Ctrl+mouse wheel scales the entire interface in 5% steps (30%-200%), remembers the zoom level locally, and shows a magnifier with the percentage in the bottom-right corner.

title: Cerbur/clutch-dsh#clutch-dsh-office
description: Brings active DSH sessions into a 3D 'Overcooked' kitchen: AI agents work, whale-girls wander the kitchen, and you watch from the side; status bubbles show who's cooking, waiting, or done with one-click navigation — originally built to check progress, now you just can't stop watching the whales.

title: cgartlab/dsh-tac
description: Project and session board in the native right sidebar, a floating session list, a keyboard-first command palette over sessions, projects and settings, and task notifications.

title: CH4ACKO3/dsh-turn-fold
description: Codex-style turn folding for the DSH Web UI: keeps final answers visible, groups consecutive reasoning and tool activity, and shows configurable live duration, tool-call, and token metrics with multilingual summaries.

title: Chaiyahang/dsh-scratchpad
description: Scratchpad panel for DeepSeek Harness: tagged notes, image/file attachments, Markdown task lists, send-to-chat, a wake-up shortcut, JSON export/import, and Agent tools.

title: chanyuenpang/dsh-better-file-viewer
description: An independent file session view for DSH, with tree and column navigation, image galleries, JSON inspection, and document previews without replacing the original sidebar.

title: chaochaokongbai/dsh-beginner-hub
description: Beginner panel for DeepSeek Harness: routes a plain-language request into ready-to-use plans (prompt variants, matching skills, advanced moves) with a local keyword engine and fills the chosen plan into a new session in one click.

title: charce526/dsh-logo-swap
description: Customize DeepSeek Harness branding — swap the sidebar and hero logos, rebuild the DeepSeek and Harness wordmark halves, edit the welcome headline, and toggle the preview badge.

title: chargeduck/xechat-dsh
description: Dockable side panel that keeps an XEChat chat session connected over a single WebSocket: markdown messages with images and emoji, server switching through #showServer and #login, an online member list, a full-screen panic overlay, and dock side, width and visibility persisted to localStorage.

title: charliesbyte/dsh-workspace-activity
description: Shows a spinner on a sidebar workspace row while any of its sessions are running, and a short-lived finished mark after they stop.

title: charrywhite/dsh-sticky-notes
description: Draggable sticky notes with 9 skins, image notes, and agent-readable to-do lists for DeepSeek Harness.

title: CheeseFox259/dsh-better-composer
description: Markdown visual enhancement and session workbench for DSH Web Composer: live syntax presentation with caret-row source reveal (inactive-line markers can be hidden or faded), deterministic local completions, and list/quote continuation on line break with ordered-list renumbering; long pastes fold into persistent chips with inline context or file-mode delivery (@path across 50+ extensions) plus sidebar LLM rewrites (stop, preview diff, undo/redo); real-time context map with token gauge, composition breakdown, per-turn growth chart with anchor lines, in-place /compact, turn forking, and a Context Doctor workspace (overview, diagnostics, analysis, feedback).

title: chen731215-dev/dsh-muv-engine
description: MUV engine for DeepSeek Harness: runs the regex_scripts from a character card against model output, tracks variables, renders a status bar, expands macros and LaTeX, and styles tagged code blocks such as letter, terminal, newspaper and phone. Needs dsh-muv-table installed as well, which is its companion plugin.

title: chen731215-dev/dsh-muv-table
description: MUV variable table editor for DeepSeek Harness: a tree view of the variables being tracked, a macro test panel for random, pick and roll, a dice shortcut bar and pick-cache management. Companion plugin for dsh-muv-engine.

title: chen8923/dsh-task-progress
description: Live progress for long-running DSH tasks: a script appends JSON lines to a per-session progress file, the Web UI draws them in a floating overlay and a right-sidebar tab that also lists background jobs which reported nothing, and `dsh-progress run -- <cmd>` wraps a command that cannot report for itself.

title: ChendarCe/dsh-perf-hud
description: A transparent, draggable performance HUD for the DeepSeek Harness Web UI: CPU, GPU and memory usage in three compact rows that float directly over the interface without any card background, snapping to the nearest window corner so resizing or maximising keeps them in place; CPU package temperature comes from an optional elevated helper (LibreHardwareMonitor + PawnIO) and the plugin itself stays at a fraction of a percent of CPU. Windows only.

title: chendefine/dsh-composer-markdown
description: Markdown editing aids for the DSH web composer: ordered and unordered list continuation with continuous renumbering, Tab-nested list levels, inline-code styling, and code-fence auto-closing, with the sent draft kept as literal Markdown.

title: ChengX0721/dsh-client-ui-skin-alice-greyrat
description: A pale rose-and-gold Mushoku Tensei skin for the DSH web GUI: an arcane sigil and two full-body Eris figures behind the conversation, a young Eris standee and gilt plugin glyphs in the sidebar, and its own settings card.

title: chengzhi43/dsh-file
description: VS Code-style file manager: browse the conversation workspace in a sidebar tree and edit files in the center column with Monaco, with theme import/export and Markdown preview.

title: chengzhicao/llm-capture
description: Web UI for capturing and reviewing raw LLM requests, streamed responses, token usage and tool calls.

title: chenxiachan/thoughtdag#dsh
description: Adds an editable conversation canvas to DeepSeek Harness, where graph connections select context for canvas requests, with branching, merging, and local agent session imports.

title: ChenYichener/dsh-nce
description: New Concept English Book 1 study panel: 144 lessons with text, IPA vocabulary, grammar and a Bilibili video on one page, Anki-style spaced repetition, a mistake notebook, and fillable exercise papers graded by your own model.

title: ChenYiming-aaa/dsh-ui-ux-pro-max
description: Offline-first UI/UX design intelligence library for DeepSeek Harness: design_recommend, design_review and design_search tools with a built-in database of 84 design styles, 192 color palettes, 74 font pairings, 99 UX guidelines, 25 chart types and 22 tech stacks, Chinese-first with zero runtime dependencies.

title: ChiffonOwO/dsh-diff-review
description: Change review for a turn's edited files: a pill above the composer counts this turn's files and lines and floats the file list up on hover, and a right-sidebar page shows each file's diff with syntax highlighting and a one-click revert.

title: ChimeSky/dsh-a2ui
description: Renders Google A2UI 1.0 surfaces (cards, tables, charts, forms, sliders and function plots) inside DSH conversations; local interactions need no model call, and action buttons return one user message to the agent.

title: china-wkz/dsh-window-state
description: Remembers the DSH desktop window position, size, and maximized state on Windows, and restores them on the next launch.

title: ChineseRyan/dsh-plugin-workspace-archive
description: Adds an Archive workspace item to the workspace row menu: archives the sessions under that workspace through the official command, leaving the one you are currently viewing open, and refusing the batch while any session is still running. The host hides archived sessions but keeps the emptied workspace row in the sidebar; this plugin hides that row too, and restores the whole group from a footer panel backed by a ledger under $DSH_HOME/storages written behind a cross-process lock. Its count badge can be set to always, on-new-only, or never.

title: CHNAQW/dsh-app-row-brand
description: Custom text and image in the Windows desktop title bar, with multi-item rotation, per-item fonts, colors, alignment and shimmer, and a Settings page. Renders nothing outside the Windows desktop shell.

title: choco9527/dsh-add-to-chat
description: Adds lightweight selected-text references to DSH assistant replies: selections stay outside the editor as removable draft contexts, remain marked beside the source, and render as hoverable annotations after submission.

title: choco9527/dsh-product-preview
description: Browse local image, video, and SVGA artifacts from conversation nodes in a Finder-style column view.

title: Choi-Peng/dsh-footer-order
description: DSH sidebar footer ordering: forces the sidebar.footer.action slot into a vertical stack and lets users configure the top-to-bottom order of its entries.

title: chokingson/dsh-travel-wallpaper
description: Travel wallpaper for DeepSeek Harness: pick one of three built-in characters (DeepSeek whale girl, GPT dragon girl, Claude young lady) or upload your own reference photo, or observe a world without any character; choose a world and one of 20 art styles, and the plugin assembles the image prompt, generates the wallpaper through your own image channel (ChatGPT or Google subscription, OpenAI-compatible API, Gemini, Volcengine Seedream, or local ComfyUI/MOSS) and applies it to the Windows desktop or lock screen. Character trips also return world events and a letter from the character, and replying to the letter shapes the next scene; observe-world trips return world events only. Every trip stays in a browsable archive with image and ZIP export. Ships daily wallpaper, instant blind-box trips and scheduled blind-box trips. Data lives in ~/.dsh/planet-news; provider credentials are read from DSH's credential store, and the plugin provides no image quota.

title: cholot-Zhou/dsh-ui-overrides
description: File-based CSS overrides for the DeepSeek Harness Web UI — edit ~/.dsh/ui-overrides.css and reload to restyle any plugin's elements, for example making the quote bar fully opaque.

title: chongfengdy-dev/dsh-message-outline
description: Current-session message outline rail for the DSH web UI — your messages show as slim bars on the left edge; hover to expand the full outline (line number + text), click to jump instantly to that message. Pure frontend, zero external service dependencies, sessions-snapshot driven with zero polling.

title: chopperH0824/dsh-annotate-sync
description: In-place HTML document preview annotation: pick elements, leave notes saved per file, send batches to the conversation, and let the agent apply changes directly.

title: ChuanTianML/dsh-chat-tidy
description: One stylesheet that retypesets the DSH conversation to measured Codex metrics: 14/22 px body, tighter headings, lists and blocks, a rounded quote bar, and Tidy Tables with a themed header, row/column rules, full-width short tables and contained scrolling for wide tables; no settings or DOM rewriting, with real before/after captures.

title: ChuanTianML/dsh-open-with
