description: Open the current registered Workspace from the Session Header or Workspace menu in a detected or configured editor, with hot re-detection and a remembered browser preference.

title: ChuanTianML/prompt-for-me
description: Context-aware next-message suggestions in the DSH composer, with repeated Trigger cycling and explicit user review before sending.

title: chumoe/dsh-file-manager
description: Replaces the sidebar workspace Files pane with a file manager that adds real composer chips for "@" file mentions, word and line selection across syntax highlighting, archives in and out, upload and download, and a jump menu to any directory on the machine.

title: chzisnull/dsh-file-finder
description: File search palette for the DSH workspace: find files by name or content, open results in DSH's native right-sidebar preview, and edit text files inline with version-conflict checks.

title: CIBUDAYI3906/dsh-prompt-trove
description: Composer prompt library: reusable global and per-project prompts are stored as Markdown files and appended to the draft on click or @ mention; the global library works out of the box, while project groups appear only after "config.root" is set in the profile patch.

title: CIBUDAYI3906/dsh-workspace-nest
description: Sidebar workspace tree: create nested sub-workspaces at any level, start a session on any level, and pin a session to the top of its nearest folder.

title: Cieux/dsh-zoom-scale
description: Whole-interface zoom from 75% to 200% in 5% steps via a Settings row, a session-header stepper or Ctrl/⌘+wheel, with a shim that converts rects, viewport units, media queries and pointer coordinates so fixed overlays stay anchored to their triggers.

title: Cillivian/wecom-file-dsh
description: A WeCom WeDrive picker for the DeepSeek Harness composer: a draggable floating window with list, column and gallery views, search, sorting and multi-select inserts selected files, documents and folders as official `@` reference chips. Data comes from a local wecom-cli with the official doc.weixin.qq.com selector as fallback, and a bundled wecom-wedrive-ref skill routes the chips to the matching wecomcli-* document readers.

title: cinewave0/cinewave0-dsh-quick-panel
description: Windows companion window for DSH Desktop: todos, reminders, live session messages, approval handling and quick input. The standalone window reuses the Electron binary at %USERPROFILE%\.dsh\electron\electron.exe (usually installed by dsh-pet) and fails to open when it is missing.

title: cinewave0/dsh-quick-panel-mac
description: macOS companion window for DSH Desktop: todos, reminders, live session messages, approval handling and quick input. The first open downloads Electron 43.3.0 to ~/.dsh/electron; after installing or updating, press ⌘Q (Command + Q) to quit DSH completely and reopen. macOS only. Tested on DSH 0.2.2-rc.1 and macOS 27 arm64.

title: Citrusrr/dsh-think-fold
description: The row that is running expands itself and folds back when it settles. A running turn keeps its whole procedure in one height-capped window that scrolls itself; a finished turn merges into the built-in finished header, leaving only the final answer. It works by driving the official disclosure rows rather than drawing its own panel, leaves rows you opened by hand alone, and restores the official settings on uninstall.

title: cjjchina3088191870-sudo/dsh-plugin-ekko-skin-manager
description: Legacy compatibility entry for the bundled Skirk, Rose Queen and Hatsune Miku themes; new users only need dsh-plugin-miku-theme.

title: cjm-m/dsh-paste-code-block
description: Cherry Studio-style paste: multi-line/indented/fenced text or code pasted into the DSH Web composer collapses into a bordered, collapsible, language-tagged card and is restored as a fenced code block on send.

title: Cjrrrrrrrr/dsh-plugins#dsh-sidebar-tidy
description: Sidebar layout fix for the DSH Web UI: caps and scrolls the plugin-action area, shrinks the inline pairing QR code and tightens the brand row, so the workspace and session list stays clickable when footer plugins grow tall.

title: clarag0d/dsh-locale-multilingual
description: Adds four extra UI locales to DeepSeek Harness — Traditional Chinese (zh-TW), Japanese, Korean and French. All translation data is bundled, so it works fully offline.

title: ClockworkParrot/dsh-prompt-optimize
description: Adds an optimize-prompt button to the left of the composer's send button; it rewrites the draft with the session's own model route and writes the result back through the normal editor path, so a single undo restores the original.

title: Cloud017/dsh-prompt-reforge
description: Adds a reforge control to the DSH composer that rewrites the current draft into a sharper prompt in place, as one undoable edit, with one-click revert and cancellation.

title: cloudatlasx/dsh-pet-plus#dsh-pet
description: An enhanced fork of PC2005-cloud/dsh-pet (do not install it alongside the upstream dsh-pet): a desktop pet for DSH with schedule reminders, approval and question bubbles you can answer in place, a 20-entry history ledger, double-click corner cycling, a configurable data directory, a step/elapsed progress line, snooze and one-hour mute, a right-click menu whose order and hidden items you can edit in settings (chat first by default), and a task-queue progress bar inside the work bubble.

title: clown139880/dsh-live2d-avatar
description: Live2D avatar stage and desktop companion for DSH: bundled Haru sample, custom Cubism 2/3+ model loading with scale and position controls, a draggable in-page pet, an optional transparent always-on-top desktop pet window, per-conversation expression prompt control, and opt-in voice with self-hosted ASR/TTS.

title: cm860712ch-cloud/dsh-quick-input
description: A 3×3 pad of saved phrases sitting to the left of the composer and tracking the input box's height: clicking a cell inserts its text at the caret as one undoable edit. Presets are editable in place, 9 cells per page up to 12 pages, and the UI follows the DSH language setting. Falls back to a panel above the composer when the window leaves no room.

title: CMoyuer/dsh-cad-viewer
description: Adds a 3D model library in its own conversation tab, where agents store models built from CadQuery scripts or supplied as tessellated meshes; the library previews them with three-cad-viewer, organises them into folders and exports them to 10 formats including STEP, BREP, STL and DXF.

title: CNSeniorious000/dsh-generative-ui
description: Lets the AI insert streaming-generated UI into the conversation or a side panel, written in TSX — already one of the model's native languages, so there is no JSON schema to teach it. Rendered without flicker, state kept across frames with no hard remount, and a click in the card driving the next chat turn. Inline is where streaming matters most; the side Canvas is the more agentic shape. Cards get agentic capabilities of their own — run bash, curl, call the model, read and write files.

title: cococo1ng/dsh-jianxian-widget#plugin
description: Qingyun Jianxian (青云剑仙, Azure Cloud Sword Immortal) — a resident bottom-right widget for the DeepSeek Harness Web UI: a sword-cultivator character that reads your account balance and token spend, keeps a local ledger broken down by model, and has 10 switchable sound effects. Reminders cover low balance, a model waiting on your answer, a pending approval, and staying up too late. Ships 23 idle poses plus a 24-frame sword dance, 22 menu-icon skins, six panel tabs, a line-by-line speech-bubble editor, and black or white robes that follow the light or dark theme. Runs entirely locally and registers no agent tools.

title: coii08o0o/dsh-bot-board
description: A floating board over the chat for DS Bot's team: who is running and on which tool, who is waiting for another Bot to hand work back, who needs your approval or answer, and who failed, with a hand-off table grouped by sender, a per-Bot drawer showing the pending command or question, and a collapsed one-line pill. Read-only — it never writes to DS Bot's data. Needs the DS Bot plugin installed (built against 0.1.7 and 0.2.0); the panel stays hidden without it.

title: ColdRainLab/dsh-workspace-plus
description: Replaces the sidebar workspace folder picker with a name box (type a name, get a same-named folder and a new workspace), adds a Move to workspace action that clones a session into another workspace and archives the original, and optional per-workspace memory that opens a continuation session after compaction and adds a workspace_memory search tool.

title: ColdRainLab/dsh-workspace-vault
description: Pin workspaces and tasks in the sidebar, with a password-protected hidden space and a workspace access lock. The lock only hides items in the interface and does not encrypt session files on disk; dsh-workspace-sync skips hidden and locked items.

title: ComlaiGonnann/dsh-codex-rail
description: Transforms DSH into a dual-column Codex workspace with an integrated Activity Bar, unified topbar, avatar quick access, session history navigation.

title: Como44/dsh-zh-more
description: Chinese-first UI enhancement: translates slash-command names and plugin-inventory cards with three display modes (Chinese only / Chinese + English / off), switching instantly without losing English.

title: constraint21/dsh-long-message-fold
description: Folds a user message whose body renders taller than 360px in the Web chat down to 360px with a fading bottom edge and an Expand/Collapse toggle. Short messages keep their exact original look, and the expanded state is remembered per message while the page stays open.

title: converk/dsh-tweaks#git-bash-terminal-tool
description: Replaces the terminal tool on Windows with Git Bash.

title: converk/dsh-tweaks#prompt-history
description: Recalls prompts sent earlier in the current session with the up and down keys in an empty composer, and shows a position badge while browsing.

title: converk/dsh-tweaks#smart-list
description: Continues numbered and bulleted lists in the DSH composer, so Shift+Enter after "1. item" starts a new line with the next marker.

title: cookiesheep/whale-on-desk
description: Pixel-art whale desktop companion with 29 frame-audited states — taps the glass and flashes the tab title when an approval waits, speaks a completion report when a turn ends, and adds a slash-command palette to the web client.

title: Coprexist/Copree#dsh-copree
description: Embeds Copree (formerly AIsChat) into the DSH web UI as a native sidebar board. Copree is an open-source framework for AI group chat and programmable worlds: the AIs are residents, not tools — each has its own memory, state and personality, they talk to each other on their own, and you can watch or join in. Group World goes further: every group chat can bind a living world (its own web page + world AI + code + clock) that the world AI builds and edits through DSH workspace tools. This plugin ships the native sidebar board (contacts, pinned DMs and groups), real-time chat over a same-origin HTTP/WS proxy, Markdown/LaTeX rendering, group invites and image messages, immersive full-frame pages, and one-click mirroring of your worlds into DSH workspaces (folder + DSH session + world_* tools). Front end only: it proxies to a Copree backend you run yourself (default 127.0.0.1:5228, same repository).

title: copylee711/dsh-better-display
description: Renders assistant replies with numbered citation chips and a sources panel for web-search results, inline pictures with their source captions, and KaTeX formulas, Mermaid diagrams and highlighted code in streaming Markdown.

title: CoraxEldridge/dsh-managed-workspaces
description: Creates DSH workspaces under a configurable base directory, links several external folders into one workspace, and relocates a workspace without losing its conversations. Its managed_workspace tool lets the agent create, adopt, link, move and unregister workspaces (moving relocates the whole folder and leaves a link at the old path when it has conversations), and its HTTP routes (/dsh-managed-workspaces/api/...) have no DSH access check beyond a marker header.

title: cosmoliu2002/dsh-prompt-enhancer
description: Adds a ✨ button and an /enhance command to the composer that rewrite the draft into a structured prompt, flag open questions below the input, follow the current session model, and offer an undo.

title: cozylove-girl/dsh-appearance-master
description: Manage skins, themes, backgrounds, and widgets in separate layers and save appearance presets for DeepSeek Harness.

title: creatjy/dsh-plugin-update-entry
description: Adds an update entry to every updatable card in the DSH plugin page: pick a version, hover to read that version's release notes, and update all updatable plugins in order from a toolbar button that can be stopped at any time.

title: crisvollerei/dsh-persona-shell
description: Re-speaks each assistant report in a chosen persona outside the working prompt, with four built-in presets, per-session switches, and the original available on demand.

title: Crosery/dsh-drop
description: Drag or paste files into the Web composer with one image-and-file preview rail; native PNG/JPEG/WebP/GIF keep the image attachment path, while other files reuse a matching local path or stream to Host staging and become @ references only at send time. Includes browser media/PDF and bounded text previews; Office and archives show identity cards, and unsent file entries are page-local.

title: Crosery/dsh-viewer
description: Model-facing display_file tool that renders 36 file extensions inline in the web UI: images with a click-to-zoom lightbox, seekable video, audio, PDF, Office and OpenDocument files converted to PDF on the host via LibreOffice, and local HTML in a sandboxed frame; bytes stream from a signed HTTP route with range support, and PNG/JPEG/WebP/GIF also enter model context on image-capable routes.

title: CsBpRd/dsh-split-view
description: Splits the DSH main area into vertical columns, one live conversation per parallel task, with mouse-wheel paging past four columns, draggable dividers, a split toggle on every session-list row, a progress-only compact view and a one-click exit.

title: cshengyi023-collab/dsh-deepsea-echo
description: Arknights-flavoured startup animation for the DSH Web GUI: a PRTS terminal boot, sonar scan, hologram lock-on and an operator-file splash that end in a deep-sea lockup, about 4.6 seconds, with four selectable original score presets (or sound off), skippable with a click or Esc and switchable, re-timed or replayed from Settings.

title: cshengyi023-collab/dsh-pet-companion
description: Adds a low-key companion panel with a pomodoro timer, a todo list, drink-water and stand-up reminders, plus lesson explanations and homework tutoring through the installed desktop pet.

title: CTX666666/dsh-prompt-polish
description: Polish button in the composer that rewrites the draft with the model the current conversation already uses: four styles, a fidelity guard that keeps every concrete fact verbatim, one-click revert, and no API key of its own.

title: cuhaitiang0405-collab/dsh-indexbookmark
description: Conversation question index for the DSH Web UI: every question you asked in a session, searchable, paginated, with one-click jump to the exact message.

title: CVEO/dsh-digital-earth
description: Digital Earth: opens a 3D globe beside the chat where you can load city models or drone-scanned scenes, measure distances, take screenshots, and run flood or sunlight analysis — or just ask the AI to do it (3D Tiles / 3DGS).

title: cxv117793-blip/dsh-sidebar-overflow
description: Puts a More row at the end of the sidebar main panel list and lets you decide, entry by entry, which panels stay visible and which move into it: a menu lists every entry with a one-click switch in either direction, a search box filters long lists, and a single Restore all clears both kinds of key. Also hides the footer action buttons, keeps the plugins entry un-collapsible, and writes each choice to the profile config so it survives a restart.

title: CXZAAA/dsh-radio
description: Adds a 24px capsule to the composer status row that plays seven preset internet radio stations, with a live spectrum, now-playing metadata for Nightride FM and Radio Paradise, and remembered volume and station.

title: cyh3436332528/dsh-float-chat
description: Pops the DSH side chat into a frameless, always-on-top Windows desktop window that can sit over any other application, with its own settings page for appearance, pinning, remembered geometry, opacity, ephemeral threads and cache cleanup.

title: cyjyyd/dsh-ssh-tui
description: Terminal UI for DeepSeek Harness on jump hosts and high-latency links: plain ANSI, incremental repaint, and a session that survives a dropped SSH connection (resume it from the log).

title: cyrus123456/dsh-johari-cognition-quadrant-dialog-composer
description: Johari cognition-quadrant dialog prompt composer — adds a button above the composer that opens a 2×2 quadrant panel (known/unknown × AI-known/AI-unknown) to groom conversation context into a structured prompt written back into the draft.

title: czxgg0630/dsh-html-annotate
description: Preview local HTML in the right sidebar, annotate elements or regions, and send the selections with current and target styles into the current session.

title: CZY1326/dsh-restart-button
description: Adds a circular restart button to the session header, plus an optional app.asar patch that also puts a Restart row in the tray menu.

title: d0ublecl1ck/dsh-flow
description: Small DeepSeek Harness affordances for everyday actions — locate the current session from the sidebar header (Cmd/Ctrl+Shift+D), copy a session ID from the session row menu (Cmd/Ctrl+Shift+C), open links in the system default program including localhost, open or copy inline code from a context menu, open changed-file cards with a local IDE or reveal them in the file manager, swap Enter with Cmd/Ctrl+Enter, recall sent messages with Up/Down, and show the current workspace name inside the header open button; every one of them has its own switch in a Flow settings page.

title: d0ublecl1ck/dsh-hide-empty-workspace
description: Auto-hide a sidebar workspace the moment its last unarchived session is archived, and add a "隐藏工作区" entry to each workspace row's own "..." menu. The restore entry sits at the bottom of the sidebar. It only toggles display and never archives, deletes or rewrites a workspace.

title: d0ublecl1ck/dsh-scratchpad-plus
description: Workspace-free chats that promote real files into their own project workspace - a maintained fork of dsh-scratchpad, kept working on current DSH.

title: d0ublecl1ck/dsh-search-enhance
description: Search inside the New-Session workspace picker: pinyin initials and full pinyin spelling for Chinese titles, substring matching anywhere for English titles, and separator-insensitive matching.

title: Da0Mine/dsh-hide-update-badge
description: Hides the built-in DSH Desktop update badge (the download-arrow "新版本" pill beside the account button): a CSS rule for the current build plus accessible-label matching with a throttled MutationObserver, so it keeps working after a DSH upgrade. Update checking, the manual "Check for updates" menu item and the connection indicator are untouched.

title: Da0Mine/dsh-inline-image-ref
description: DSH plugin: images dropped or pasted into the composer become @path reference chips at the caret, with a hover preview.

title: dadazhangn/dsh-prompt-snippets
description: Save reusable prompt snippets with categories and {{placeholders}}; manage them with /snippet commands (add, list, rm, optimize) and insert into the composer from a draggable dock panel, with one-click AI refinement through the default model.

title: dadgrand/dsh-agent-teams-dashboard
description: Adds a Teams sidebar dashboard that lists every Agent Teams chat with its roster and task roadmap, token spend in USD and RUB, work and online time, and an archive of older teams. Requires the Agent Teams plugin.

title: daetz-coder/dsh-multi-chat
description: Multi-window wall for the DSH Web UI: run and monitor N conversations side-by-side in one screen, with auto-discovery, per-window controls, and an authenticated LAN gateway for phone/tablet access.

title: damlys99/dsh-morning-paper
description: A newspaper-style front page for a session you left running, as a Conversation View tab beside Chat and Trajectory: a per-turn timeline (duration, steps, tools, tokens, outcome), file churn counted per file, where the wall clock went and how much of it was the model rather than tools, which single turn ate the spend, failures nobody retried quoted with their failing command, and a context-pressure gauge measured against the routed model's own declared capacity. The briefing is folded from the durable session log and never generated by a model, so it costs no tokens, cannot hallucinate, and is byte-identical for the same log and clock; it appends nothing to the session and reaches no model, and it reports a pending approval without ever answering it. Pages are offered only when they have content, and the tab refreshes itself on turn settle and on a two-speed poll backed by a metadata-only tail probe.

title: damlys99/dsh-queue-reorder
description: Reorder the messages queued while a DSH agent is busy, from inside the official queue dock: a drag handle and per-row ↑ / ↓ buttons on the dock's own rows, applied on the host as one concurrency-checked inbox splice. The dock is decorated rather than replaced, so previews, inline editing, steering, removal and attachments stay as shipped. A move is refused when the queue has changed since the caller last saw it, when the row is not a user prompt (a goal round prompt, for example), or when the queue belongs to a subagent session.

title: DamonKoy/dsh-web-ui#dsh-aionui-panel
description: Right-panel system for the dsh web GUI: a pixel-faithful AionUi Explorer + Preview (file tree, diff view, preview).

title: DamonKoy/dsh-web-ui#dsh-liangshen
description: LiangShen (梁神) agent preset for the dsh web GUI: a two-phase anchored-standard preset.

title: DamonKoy/dsh-web-ui#dsh-task-board
description: Task board for the dsh web GUI: a sidebar entry plus a multi-column kanban view with local persistence.

title: DamonKoy/dsh-web-ui#dsh-web-ui-settings
description: Web UI plugin group card in the dsh settings page: enable switches and config for the dsh-web-ui family.

title: Daneel0001/dsh-plugin-zh-cn
description: Renders installed DSH plugin titles and descriptions in Simplified Chinese: at startup it translates the plugins the local JSON cache lacks through the harness LLM service, then projects { en, zh } metadata for resolveText() to render — no DOM changes, no third-party API.

title: DanZai233/dsh-webask
description: Adds a button beside the composer and a global hotkey palette (default mod+shift+k) that hand one-off questions to a web chat instead of into the harness context: the draft is lifted out of the composer, copied to the clipboard and opened in the templated URL. Ships target-site presets (DeepSeek, Kimi, Qwen, 豆包, 腾讯元宝, GLM, Gemini), a local question history that can be re-opened, copied, or inserted back into the composer, and a settings tab for site, URL template, hotkey, clipboard and history.

title: darkneu/dsh-finesse-visualizer
description: Visualizes Finesse 3 KatScript in the conversation and adds a drag-and-drop optical bench designer that generates the Finesse model. It scans every user and assistant message for KatScript or a Finesse Python cell and renders them in the background with the first Python interpreter that can import finesse (Finesse 3, NumPy and Matplotlib required; interpreter overridable with FINESSE_VIZ_PYTHON), keeping the code and figures under ~/.dsh/finesse-vis.

title: darlingsakurua/dsh-novels
description: A bookshelf panel for reading .txt novels beside the conversation: import a local file, decode UTF-8, UTF-8 with BOM, UTF-16 or GB18030, split it into chapters, then read with a table of contents, chapter navigation, adjustable font size, line height and column width. Each book resumes at the chapter and scroll position you left it at.

title: datit309/dsh-live-inspector
description: Real-time inspector of the files the agent reads and edits, with a file tree, in the DeepSeek Harness right sidebar: M/A/R badges, side-by-side diffs and live agent activity tracking.

title: day-day-dream/dsh-page-refresh#dsh-page-refresh
description: Adds a refresh button and a power menu (restart / close DeepSeek Harness) to the conversation header. Client-only, zero tokens, no dependencies. The power menu is Windows-only.

title: dayutech/dsh-handy
description: Adds a per-session notebook with autosave, a draggable key-information panel with collapsible items and queue injection, notebook and key-information inheritance for native and /fork forks, workspace-scoped session groups, session highlighting, running-workspace prioritization with a blue spinner, and close-current/left/right/all actions on every right-sidebar tab.

title: dbcaskml183-dotcom/dsh-prelude
description: Optimize prompts in the DeepSeek Harness composer: identify missing requirements, insert a sentence from 90 method cards, or compare and edit a full rewrite before you send.

title: dcrzsy/dsh-enhance-tool
description: All-in-one UI enhancement layer for DeepSeek Harness web: prompt library with quick-insert and management, two-step AI polish, predicted-reply dock with click-to-send, MCP tool management, scheduled automation, smart session titles, adjustable chat width, full-width AI messages without gray background, auto-collapse for long user messages with smooth expand/collapse animations, and scene-specific entrance animations across all plugin surfaces.

title: dddaniel1/dsh-ref-autofill
description: Reference-image picker for the DSH web composer: browse face, costume and pose libraries, then insert high-resolution images and a generated prompt into the current draft in one click.

title: DDSG-X/dsh-workspace-dir
description: Shows the current conversation's working directory in a draggable directory panel with adjustable opacity.

title: ddy-007/dsh-client-resume-button
description: Adds a Continue button left of the model selector: after a turn ends aborted by the user, interrupted by a crash or errored, one click sends notices asking the model to pick that turn back up, and the button collapses while you type or attach a file.

title: deanzhang2026-max/dsh-lived-pet#dsh-pet-bridge
description: Writes the harness agent live state (thinking, working, waiting, done, error) to a state file that a bundled Electron Live2D desktop pet polls, so the pet bubble and face follow what the agent is doing.

title: DedsecLemon/dsh-obsidian
description: Your real Obsidian vault in the DSH right Sidebar: vault tree, full-vault search, read-view typography, wikilinks and heading anchors, properties, backlinks, highlights, in-place editing, an outline, and a right-click menu for handoff, rename and .trash.

title: deepseekbluefish/dsh-screenshot-plugin
description: WeChat-style in-app screenshot button: drag a region, fine-tune with 8 resize handles, Enter to capture and Esc to cancel; auto-numbered PNGs plus a \[Shot N HH:mm] marker written into the composer. Windows-only, tested on DeepSeek Harness Desktop.

title: delaydai/dsh-jumpbar
description: User message jump bar for the DSH web GUI: a minimap-style dash strip on the right edge of the conversation, with hover preview, click-to-jump, drag-to-scrub and a viewport marker.

title: demacia1314/dsh-airdrop
description: ⭐ Drag-and-drop uploads of any file or whole folders, anywhere in the window; remote-safe — bytes go straight into the session workspace on the server, so a DSH deployed on a remote machine works exactly like localhost.

title: dengsixue-stack/dsh-file-context-menu
description: Right-click menu for file links in chat: open with registered apps, save as, copy path or content, reveal in Finder or Explorer.

title: dengyinxi100-crypto/ai-calendar-deepseek-harness
description: Embeds a full calendar app as a sidebar panel and adds a draggable, resizable scheduled-task widget on the DSH page. Registers six agent tools (status, list, create, update, delete, summarize) that read and write the same SQLite database. The calendar's own AI is routed to the DeepSeek route already configured in DSH, and each reply shows token usage and cost, accumulated per day.

title: Dengzi555/dsh-quotalk
description: Select response text or code to ask contextual follow-ups with streaming replies in a native sidebar.

title: dennisrongo/dsh-plugins#dsh-weather
description: Draggable weather bar in the shell overlay with forecast and geocoding from Open-Meteo; the position persists across sessions.

title: DeveloperYe/dsh-local-files
description: Local file manager served by the DSH web server itself: whole-disk browsing, previews for images, PDF, video and audio, text, Markdown, JSON, CSV, sandboxed HTML, docx and xlsx, Range downloads, folder ZIP, drag-and-drop upload, copy/paste, conflict-checked text editing, create/rename/delete-to-trash, and xlsx cell editing saved as a copy.

title: Devin-AXIS/deepseek-design#deepseek-idesign
description: Visual design studio for websites, app prototypes, posters, cards, reports, and magazines, with templates, direct element editing, selection-aware AI draft handoff, and export.

title: Devin-AXIS/deepseek-design#deepseek-ivideo
description: Visual video studio with an editable timeline, animation and media controls, 27 templates, whole-video and selection-aware AI draft handoff, validation, preview, and export.

title: DevinMx520/dsh-selection-translator
description: Adds a right-click menu to selected text in the Harness Web UI that replaces it with a Simplified Chinese translation in place, and restores the original on a second right-click.

title: devome/dsh-panel-layout
description: Sidebar panel menu layout: switch between a button row and a list, cap the button row at one to three rows, drag any entry to reorder it, hide the entries past the cap and list them in the shell More menu, and absorb Settings, Feedback and Sign in from the bottom-left launcher. Based on ruanimal/dsh-sidebar-panel-buttons; the two cannot be enabled at the same time.

title: devzer0o0/dsh-grok-buddy
description: Puts Grok Bot's own face in the DSH sidebar session list: each row's status dot becomes a living GrokBot avatar whose six motions read as idle, working, waiting, blocked, thinking and done — color marks the project, motion marks the state.

title: dgy970516/dsh-status-turbo
description: A status bar in the composer footer showing the current phase, how long it has been running, the current step token count and a no-progress warning, projected from session logs without polling the host, plus a detail panel that opens on click.

title: dhb861832993-star/pbr-render
description: PBR 3D model preview for game art: GLB/GLTF with textures, IBL environment lighting, orbit controls, and a material channel inspector (baseColor/normal/roughness/metallic/AO/emissive/wireframe); scalar channels shown as grayscale per PBR spec, via the pbr3d fence and pbr_render tool.

title: dhdkfkfkf/dsh-pull-to-send
description: Send by dragging instead of clicking. Press the composer and pull up to arm the gesture; releasing sends, dragging back into the composer cancels, and dragging outside the conversation area cancels on the spot. Mouse and pen only.

title: dhdkfkfkf/dsh-qbuddy-prompt-enhance
description: Button beside the composer that rewrites the current draft into a more executable prompt in place. Ships four built-in presets spanning light polish to aggressive expansion, accepts user-defined presets, and switches preset, prompt model and reasoning effort directly from the button without leaving the composer. The button appears only when the draft has content, shows a running timer while enhancing, and surfaces failures with a retry.

title: DIAG5/dsh-better-input
description: Input experience enhancement: voice input, AI polish, anti-overwrite, prompt optimization with diff preview, and auto locale switching following DSH UI language.

title: dialling/dsh-galaxy-view
description: Draws workspaces and conversations as a 3D star map in the stock panel slot: eight layouts (spiral, rings, armillary sphere, solar system, double helix, irregular web, cubic lattice, radial tree), eight colour themes, a memory-library map of instruction files, skills and skill calls, star-to-star fly-throughs, and a 中/EN switch. Links are drawn only where a workspace owns a conversation or one conversation descends from another.

title: diexianxiang/dsh-custom-splash
description: A customizable video splash screen plugin for DSH. Replace the default startup with your own local video.

title: dingchenhui0618-arch/dsh-market-sidebar
description: Adds the dshmarket plugin market to the DSH sidebar as a panel of its own, ordered above the built-in Plugins entry. Clicking the entry renders the market through the client service dshmarket publishes for hosts, so the catalog, category filters, comments and install and update flows are the ones dshmarket ships rather than a copy of them. Nothing to learn or configure: the panel is the market, with its own sidebar entry, label in Chinese or English to match the interface language, and icon. If dshmarket is not loaded the panel says so instead of failing client composition, and its locale keys, slots and style tag are released when the plugin unloads.

title: dingchenhui0618-arch/dsh-pnl-attribution
description: A-share holdings contribution card for DeepSeek Harness: today's P&L and portfolio return next to the Shanghai Composite, the top five contributors by P&L with each stock's strength versus the index in pp, and a 15:00 close-summary PNG export with the contributor list, intraday chart and a numbers-only summary. Holdings come from a local holdings.csv/holdings.json and quotes from the public Tencent market-data API; the plugin never reads cookies or broker credentials. Requires DSH 0.2.x; the card and the export are covered by a test suite that runs in CI.

title: dingchenhui0618-arch/dsh-signal-pet
description: A small pet in the corner of the interface that reads the real event stream instead of guessing: it drifts when idle, speeds up while the agent is thinking, draws a flowing line per running tool call, turns red and shakes with the error summary on a failure, and celebrates a turn that ran longer than ten seconds. The same widget is the at-a-glance busy and error indicator, so there is no spinner to stare at. The host half folds real harness events into a snapshot and the client half only draws it; it performs no content recognition, and it positions itself away from the composer so it never sits over what you are typing.

title: DingL0312/dsh-long-input-window
description: Adds a full-screen dialog for writing long messages: Markdown on the left rendered live by marked on the right, with a draggable splitter that remembers its ratio. Confirming writes the text back to the composer draft, keeping command tokens and @-reference chips as a fixed prefix; Esc asks whether to discard or write back before closing.

title: dingyi580/dsh-conversation-rail
description: Left-edge conversation rail for the Web UI: one bar per turn, length scaled to the turn text, hover for a question and answer preview, click to jump; bars come from a host-side outline of the whole session log, so turns outside the loaded window are drawn too and history is paged in on click.

title: Dippppper/dsh-hero-motto
description: Custom main-screen headline: replaces the new-session headline with a rotating pool of custom text; plus an independently switchable composer border marquee with glow, band speed, brightness, width, breathing, per-view scope and a focus-only mode in Settings.

title: djs326/dsh-plugin-width-slider
description: All-in-one UI plugin for DSH Desktop (Windows): conversation-width slider with fullscreen preview and follow-window mode, thinking-block enhancements (forced Chinese, expand/collapse, Markdown rendering), an Open With header button, UI label localization, a resizable settings dialog, session delete, and workspace tabs.

title: Dkrillex/dsh-macos-pet
description: macOS desk pet forked from anneheartrecord/dsh-desk-pet, in a real always-on-top window that covers fullscreen Spaces: the pose follows whatever the local DSH is doing across six states, the right-click menu is a real AppKit one carrying quiet mode and a session list, and seven skins ship with it. Two of the seven are drawn from geometry by a script in the repo rather than generated, so making a skin needs no image model and no API credits; the bundled skill still expands one photo into all eighteen poses on your own image tool and credentials. There is no Electron and nothing to install alongside it: the window is driven through ctypes on the Python that ships with macOS.

title: dlgrv/dsh-remove-deepseek-logo
description: Removes the DeepSeek Harness logo, brand name, version string, and the conversation hero fish from the sidebar.

title: dmscode/dsh-peak-valley
description: Tints the strip above the composer green or red to match DeepSeek's off-peak and peak billing windows, shows the remaining time of the current window as a progress bar, and ships six themes plus a custom-CSS hook.

title: dmscode/dsh-rightbar-tab-gestures
description: Closes right-sidebar tabs with a middle click or a left double click, reusing the built-in close button so the native rules (such as the last docked guide card being unclosable) still apply.

title: Dogwind221/img2img-studio#dsh-img2img-config
description: Adds two UI surfaces: a composer image editor (numbered marks with per-mark instructions, background removal, brush-mask erase, resize with crop/padding preview, keyboard-accessible markers; results return as attachments plus a version-1 manifest) and a Settings → vision/generation provider panel (explicit provider picker, providerId normalization, ChatGPT-web accounts synced into channels, per-channel test/try-run/copy-command, script readiness scan, save validation with .env preview, probing that only disables on explicit quota errors, Chinese/English UI) that writes providers back to the skills .env files.

title: domitor-syh/dsh-ui-skin-switcher
description: Replaces the model button with a Claude Desktop-style model and reasoning-effort switcher, with per-model effort memory, theme-aware styling, smooth slider feel, rounded track, hover highlight, and pixel-dot animation.

title: domparent/OLEDCare
description: OLED burn-in care for the Web GUI with pure-black surfaces, gamma-aware text dimming on an idle/focus ladder, a true-black nap screensaver with live agent status, and slow accent-hue rotation.

title: Domush/dsh-plugin-message-history
description: Shell-style Up/Down arrow key message history navigation for DSH Web UI with cross-session persistence and draft restoration. It keeps up to 100 of your past messages as plain text in ~/.dsh/message-history.json, filling it at startup from the session records already under ~/.dsh/sessions, and makes no network requests.

title: dongasai/dsh_editor
description: A file editor in the DSH web GUI right sidebar: open any text file, edit it, and save in place, with a version gate on every save — if the file changed on disk during the edit it stops and asks instead of overwriting. The document preview gains an edit button and a two-step delete button, and a separate File editor sidebar tool brings its own file tree for create, rename or move, copy, cut and paste (including a file taken from the system clipboard), delete and drag to reorganize. Two renderer bands cover 107 plain-text, config and source extensions; the second is offered only as an open-with choice, leaving the shipped Markdown and highlighted-code views as the default. All mutations run through the plugin's own trusted host routes, behind the connection trust fence, the workspace containment check and the sandbox policy.

title: dongasai/dsh_setting_pro
description: Enlarges the DSH web settings dialog (default 1180x920, 20px steps, remembered per browser) and adds an Advanced Settings page that resizes it and hosts Host operations: restart dsh with a 3-second delay and a busy confirmation, restart once all sessions have been idle for 10s (cancellable, repeat clicks idempotent), last start time with uptime, and a dsh version/update check that compares npm dist-tags across selectable channels without upgrading. The same bundle replaces the sidebar brand area with a machine name, adds a read-only provider, model and thinking-level cell beside the composer stats pills, and a switch that registers or unregisters the three dsh_restart_* agent tools at runtime. Zero dependencies, no build step; all routes sit behind the connection trust fence.

title: DONGBIN007/dsh-sidebar-restart
description: Adds a Restart row to the desktop app's sidebar foot beside Settings that restarts the app and reloads the page onto the newly installed plugin bundle.

title: dongfangxy/dsh-agents-md-settings
description: Adds a Settings → General row that opens ~/.dsh/AGENTS.md in the system editor, so the instruction file can be opened without hunting for it. On Windows it launches Notepad and raises the window.

title: dongfangxy/dsh-open-project
description: Adds a Windows Explorer folder context-menu entry that registers the folder as a DSH project, with a switch for the menu entry in Settings → General. Windows only, and nothing extra has to be installed.

title: dongsheng123132/dsh-workspace-plugins#dsh-workspace-move-top
description: Adds one action to the workspace menu that moves a workspace to the top once, without a favorites system or automatic reordering.

title: dongwenxiu83-web/dsh-friendly-steps
description: Folds Think and tool-call rows into a floating summary pill with red failure counts, for a cleaner writer-friendly chat view.

title: donyue7/dsh-aoci-panel
description: AOCI cognition panel for DSH: multi-workspace AOCI overview, per-repo index and governance view, MCP binding diagnosis, and guided or batch initialization. Governance, verification and guided/batch initialization require the external aoci CLI on the host; index browsing works without it.

title: DQS-PUBLIC/dsh-price-chip
description: Sidebar chip showing the current DeepSeek price period (peak or off-peak), the selected model's price per million tokens for cache hits, cache misses and output, the account balance and today's spend.

title: dream-office/dsh-note-wall
description: Sidebar sticky-note wall for DeepSeek Harness: capture notes locally, color-code and group them, attach links and images; data stays on your machine.

title: Dreamaniax/dsh-model-effort-chips
description: Splits the composer model seat into a model chip and a reasoning-effort chip: the effort chip opens a draggable, wheel-adjustable slider, and the panel behind it animates 36 canvas effects across 12 categories.

title: dreamfarer-space/deepseek-harness-intelligent-ui
description: Generative, interactive UI for DeepSeek Harness: the agent picks per reply between 26 validated native components and sandboxed streaming HTML widgets, patches a rendered UI in place by component ID, restores tabs, sorts, filters and form values after a reload, and computes slider and filter changes in the browser without another model call.

title: dreamlee0/dsh-sticky-notes
description: Sticky-note memo board beside a month calendar: notes carry a date, an optional time and one of five paper colours, checking a note off moves it to a Done tab that keeps its completion timestamp, and the calendar shows each day as a large centred number with coloured dots for that day's notes and a hand-drawn red pen ring on today. Its HTTP routes have no DSH access check, so a web page open in your browser could call them.

title: DreamLoomStudio/dsh-primitive-pulse
description: A floating panel that lights up which HowNet semantic primitives the current answer touches, as a brain-shaped node graph, EEG-style channel traces and a composition card.

title: dreammaker2016/dsh-file-menu
description: Right-click menus for the DSH Web UI — copy, cut, paste and select all on text and input areas, plus copy path, reveal in the file manager and open with the default app on file references and links.

title: dreamxjy/dsh-settings-resizer
description: Makes the DeepSeek Harness settings window resizable and configurable in size, with presets, drag resizing, and sizes saved to the profile config.

title: drliuhuan/dsh-plugin-agy-bg
description: Paints a mouse-following WebGL particle field behind the DSH Web UI. The palette follows the light/dark theme; Settings → General has an on/off switch and a selectable frame-rate cap (30/60, plus 120 when the display supports it). It inserts nothing into the composer or transcript scroll tree.

title: drliuhuan/dsh-plugin-zoom
description: Manually zoom the Harness Web UI from 75% to 200% via a Settings row, Ctrl+wheel, or a Session-header control, keeping text crisp and readable on high-DPI displays.

title: drowsylazy/dsh-thinking-effort-rheostat
description: A Claude Desktop-inspired composer slider for adjusting model reasoning effort with click, drag, or keyboard controls.

title: drscrewdriver/dsh-arrowkey-nav
description: Arrow-key navigation for the DSH Web GUI: Up/Down switch sessions inside the current workspace and Left/Right switch workspaces, reading session identity from the client controllers rather than the DOM, and yielding the keys back to the composer while a draft is being edited.

title: drscrewdriver/dsh-brief-sidebar
description: A dsh-better-sidebar tab that renders a session brief — a todo board read from the `todos` projection plus a deliverables section listing the files written this turn — and hides the official todo panel above the composer while it is mounted.

title: drscrewdriver/dsh-canvas-tsx-sidebar
description: A dsh-better-sidebar tab that statically parses Qoder Canvas `*.canvas.tsx` files into structured pages in the DSH right sidebar (the source is never executed: no eval, no bundler, no sandbox iframe), with a file-viewer takeover for `.tsx` and a bundled Skill for authoring the format.

title: drscrewdriver/dsh-input-traffic
description: Three-tier now/next/later input planning dock for the DeepSeek Harness web GUI: a red/yellow/green priority strip replaces the busy-Enter queue, plain Enter queues to later, with in-place multi-line editing, drag reorder, and session-isolated freeze/resume; the freeze button bridges a separate plugin, [dsh-session-guard](https://github.com/drscrewdriver/dsh-session-guard) (installable from dsh-market), via stopNextTurn/resume RPC + composer lock for a real per-session lock, pairing with its global peak-hour auto-pause to stop sessions during DeepSeek's high-cost windows and resume off-peak.

title: drscrewdriver/dsh-paste-dock
description: Turns large text pastes into pastes/*.txt attachments with a dock above the composer and a minimal, recognisable badge in the draft.

title: drscrewdriver/dsh-sidebar-fold
description: Folds the sidebar's add-on panel rows (schedules, agent teams, plugin market, context pages, …) under the shipped "More" row: a 28x28 chevron toggle on that row collapses them into a single header line and expands them back, the fold state persists per window, the rows kept visible are chosen with per-row switches read from the live sidebar, and each managed row's icon + label can be aligned left, centre or right. Client-only plugin: adds DOM, patches no host bundle, and uninstalls back to the shipped sidebar. Requires DSH 0.2.1-rc.3 exactly; other versions install but stay inert.

title: drscrewdriver/dsh-tidy-display
description: Honest merge of two community plugins into one calmer display: the streaming reading view from dsh-better-display (fork) and the message rail from dsh-tidychat. For theme lovers it wraps reasoning prose and tool-call output in translucent message bubbles, so text no longer sits directly on busy wallpapers or skins where it is hard to read. Cross-version rc adaptation attempted across DSH 0.1.0-0.2.0 (all rc); no obvious problems so far.

title: dsh-blue/blue#blue
description: Plugin-tree terminal UI for DeepSeek Harness — streaming markdown transcript, tool cards, fuzzy slash commands, and live theming, with every component a hot-swappable Cordis plugin.

title: dsh-niao/dsh-niao-quick-open
description: UI enhancement suite for DeepSeek Harness: one-click workspace open (copy path, reveal in Finder, open in an auto-discovered editor), DeepSeek-web-style user-message nav rail, session to-do marks, flat-list polish, and a hard-restart button.

title: dsh-plugin-collection/dsh-group-status
description: Aggregated status badges on collapsed sidebar groups in DSH: a folded folder row shows in-progress / awaiting-approval / done / scheduled / review-pending counts, with numbers and hover detail. (sidebar badge / group status / aggregate)

title: dsh-plugin-collection/dsh-suggest-ghost
description: Input prediction for the DSH composer: your next prompt suggested as ghost text after each turn, accepted with Tab. (autocomplete / input prediction / prompt suggestion)

title: du-u-uck/DSH-Prompt-Optimization
description: Adds a one-click prompt optimization button to the DSH composer, with undo and an optional dedicated optimizer model.

title: duanyunlun/dsh-session-actions
description: Sidebar conversation actions: open the row menu on right-click, rename by double-click, copy the session id, and delete a conversation together with its storage after a confirmation.

title: Duanyy0813/dsh-prompt-clarifier
description: Adds a prompt-refine button to the DSH composer and, when auto mode is on, refines the prompt before the agent starts by rewriting the text with recent session context through a side-channel model call, asks on the native question card when the rewrite cannot be decided, reports each stage as a command card in the chat, and keeps the original text when analysis fails.

title: dungcsnd1133/dsh-dl-brand
description: Replaces the sidebar brand mark with a custom one and registers a Vietnamese locale covering 45 namespaces and 1897 interface strings, falling back to English for anything untranslated.

title: dustcpu/dsh-geometric-splash
description: Page-level startup splash: a Penrose triangle light sweep over a living isometric diamond ocean, where the frame itself is the progress gauge, paced by the intro but capped by real DSH boot milestones. Any bare key skips it, ten palettes come from Monument Valley and Geometric Islands, and when the intro ends the triangle stays on as a small mark beside the composer that reflects what the agent is doing.

title: Dusty-Dustin55/dsh-file-context-menu
description: Right-click files, folders, web links, and workspaces in the DeepSeek Harness chat and sidebars to reference, copy, preview, open in a chosen app or browser, reveal, or save.

title: DWJZ/dsh-restart
description: Adds a Restart page to the DSH Web settings panel. The page shows the PID, port, start time and uptime of the running host and restarts it through a detached helper that waits until the port stops answering before replaying the same launch invocation; the page reloads itself once the replacement host answers with a new boot id.

title: dygin/dsh-recover-context
description: Roll back to before any of your questions or edit the last one and resubmit, with the workspace files of the discarded turns restored.

title: e2mcc/dsh-popout-sidebar
description: Pop-out sidebar: lists artifacts and a file tree with multiple preview formats, pops out into a separate browser tab you can drag to another monitor, and coexists with other sidebar plugins simultaneously.

title: EastMG/dsh-gacha-calendar
description: Gacha banner and event schedule lookup for anime games: sidebar button with current banners, events and countdowns for 28 gacha games, with auto-refresh, search, Windows expiry reminders and .ics export.

title: ebrontower/dsh-workspace-pin
description: Workspace pinning plugin with an effect close to the built-in session pin.

title: ecbob/dsh-window-size-keeper
description: Keeps the DSH desktop window the size you left it: records the last outer frame of the main window in physical pixels and restores it, centred on the work area, on the next start - and it acts before the window is ever shown, so the boot animation plays at the right size. The settings page offers 12 presets (1024x768 to 3840x2160), free-form custom width and height, a centre-on-restore switch and an apply-now action; a choice takes effect immediately and persists. Resizing goes through a small helper executable compiled on the user's own machine: the C# source ships inside the plugin, is built on first run with the in-box Windows csc.exe (measured ~110 ms once, cached next to the state file, ~90 ms to start), and falls back to a short-lived powershell.exe process when that is not possible. The package ships no binary, declares no npm dependencies and makes no outbound network request. Windows only.

title: EchoTint/dsh-notes-wall
description: A sticky-notes wall pinned to the sidebar: one click opens a full-page wall, notes save as you type, and writing #tags in the text turns them into one-click filter chips. Six paper colors, pinning, search, JSON export and import.

title: EchoTint/dsh-pomodoro
description: Pomodoro timer with a sidebar workspace, independent desktop widgets, task tracking, focus statistics, and WebDAV/S3 backups. Desktop widgets require a separate Electron runtime.

title: echoVic/dsh-workspace-ide
description: A VS Code-like workspace panel with a JetBrains-inspired editor: lazy file tree, TypeScript code viewer with syntax highlighting, soft-wrap, find & replace, Quick Open, multi-tab drafts, bracket matching/auto-pair, workspace-wide text search, git status/history with coloured diffs, six VS Code palettes plus follow-DSH, Markdown and image/SVG previews. Nine authenticated host routes serve the filesystem, images, git reads and a quick-open file index.

title: ECNU/EduWork#dsh-annotation
description: Select reply text, edit numbered annotations, and send several with a question using native DSH composer references, draft persistence, and submission; requires DSH 0.2.1-rc.2 or later within the 0.2.x series.

title: Edge-HH/GrokBot_in_DeepseekHerness
description: Bring GrokBot into DeepSeek harness.

title: EdwardXiao-bit/dsh-run-button
description: Adds a Run button to shell code blocks in replies, executing the snippet through the host shell service and showing its output in a floating bottom-right dock, or in one bottom-panel tab per run.

title: einfachllm/dsh-pomodoro-timer
description: Pomodoro focus timer docked under the composer with long-break cycles, daily focus tracking, phase-change signals, and agent tools that read and control the timer. Its HTTP routes have no DSH access check, so a web page open in your browser could call them.

title: el16z3c/dsh-think-ux
description: Smooth think-row experience for the DSH Web UI: think rows expand as a capped 24-line preview that glides to the bottom while reasoning streams, collapse with a short height animation on settle, and the main conversation view follows with a reader-safe smooth chase (no snaps, no yanks).

title: elangan1997-cmyk/canvas-workbench#canvas-workbench
description: Pluggable design canvas inside DSH — standalone Excalidraw board, session image tools (edit, erase, background removal, OCR, vectorize, PSD/text rebuild), project asset library, and a Photoshop/Illustrator ⇄ canvas bridge.

title: Elefseus/dsh-pet-progress
description: Folds the durable todo and goal events the dsh pet ignores into a percentage bubble on the pet, and falls back to a one-line activity summary for a session that never wrote a todo list. Requires the dsh web pet plugin (@linxin666/dsh-pet >= 0.4.0).

title: eloimovo/better-dsh-codex-effort-slider
description: Takes over the model button in the DSH composer and opens its own two-level panel (provider list, then model list with search) built around a continuous draggable reasoning-effort slider: the fill runs blue to violet, higher levels add nebula and dust particles, and every level has its own color. Drag moves one level at a time, and picking a model keeps the panel open and repositions the slider to that model's middle level.

title: Elycheng/dsh-article-annotator
description: Article Review page in DSH's native right sidebar: turns Markdown, Word, PowerPoint and PDF articles into sentence-addressable text, lets you comment on any sentence, and hands the open review to the agent as a composer draft. Six agent tools let the model read every comment, revise the article (in place for Markdown, as a sibling <name>.revised.md for binary formats), resolve the comments, and record recurring wording preferences into a long-term writing-style memory injected into later prompts. Extraction includes a dependency-free DOCX/PPTX reader; PDF text extraction runs locally through the host's Python + pypdf (or poppler's pdftotext) and is unavailable without one of them. No network calls, no telemetry.

title: enteguo/dsh-plugin-quick-chat
description: Adds a Quick Chat entry to the Web UI sidebar that opens a floating chat window with its own model and reasoning-effort picker, optionally seeded with the current session's transcript, and keeps every side conversation in a resumable, renamable, deletable history.

title: enterhalf/dsh-session-colorful-unread-pin-jobs
description: Colors each DSH sidebar session title by state: unread (blue while the model is running, green once it has finished) and pinned (yellow, read from DSH's own pinned set), composed into one left-to-right gradient. Pinning, archiving and ordering stay with DSH itself — the plugin reimplements no pinning and rewrites no official bundle — and a settings section lists every unread session.

title: eomis/packhub-workbench-assistant
description: Adds quick installation and switching for workbench templates in DSH Desktop.

title: Ephemeral-AI-Lab/mayfly#mayfly
description: Interactive terminal UI for DeepSeek Harness: tables, Mermaid and chart rendering, side conversations, and the same Cordis plugin model as dsh Web.

title: Ernesto-yuan/dsh-conversation-tools
description: A floating in-conversation find bar docked over the DSH composer (Ctrl/⌘+F or the magnifier beside the input): hits list with a match counter as you type, Enter jumps to the next hit, hovering a hit pops a scrollable full-text card with a one-click copy of the whole message, the up arrow in an empty composer recalls previously sent messages one at a time with their image and file attachments restored as drafts, hovering any image in the conversation shows a copy button that writes it to the clipboard as PNG, and every finished answer gains a regenerate button while the newest also gets continue. Client-side only, searches the messages already loaded in the conversation, and never jumps.

title: EternalNight996/dsh-theme
description: Theme skin plugin for DeepSeek Harness — built-in themes / static image / dynamic 360°-follow video, one-click from the sidebar & Settings; imports persist, default skins protected.

title: EternalNight996/dsh-ui-agents-pixe
description: Adds a "Work Roles" tab and a pixel-art office overlay to the DeepSeek Harness Web UI: 508 built-in role cards (The Agency 255 + agency-agents-zh 253) with search, EN/ZH toggle and department filter; draggable Canvas 2D pixel characters that stand, type and pace, with idle chat that can plug into AI. One-command npm install, no dsh source changes.

title: EternalNight996/dsh-ui-three-body
description: Adds a sentient floating eye to DeepSeek Harness — injects a taming kernel that makes the AI truly understand you, with 11 dynamic eye skins, ghost mode, and zero token cost when AI mode is off.

title: Ethan1999991231/dsh-sidebar-dock
description: Docks the workspace and session list to the left, right, top or bottom edge, optionally folding it into a 5px edge band that expands on hover, with the reveal zone and the left rail width adjustable in Settings → General; the plugin rail, brand row and settings button stay where they are.

title: EugeneVl/dsh_session_folders
description: One-level session folders for the web sidebar - group sessions per workspace, move them by drag-and-drop or context menu, archive and restore, server-side persistence.

title: EventHorizonXT/dsh-model-navigator
description: Replace the model picker with global search, favorites, recent selections, model-family navigation, and reasoning effort selection.

title: exoticknight/dsh-better-left-sidebar
description: A clearer DeepSeek Harness sidebar with separate navigation and conversation regions and built-in widgets.

title: exoticknight/dsh-just-chat
description: One-click native conversations with independent workspaces for DeepSeek Harness.

title: Eyeing0721/dsh-cot-en2cn
description: Shows a Chinese translation under each English thinking block in the DSH web chat, without modifying the session transcript; per-chunk caching, a configurable translation model, and a settings panel.

title: Faide-cyber/dsh-model-in-use
description: Marks models in use by other running sessions in the DSH model menu, and restores the remembered reasoning effort and group collapse state for each model.

title: Fakek0f3sT/dsh-mcp-diff
description: Renders every file mutation in the web chat as one collapsed diff card with per-line highlighting — MCP filesystem edit_file/write_file and the built-in edit/write.

title: FallenWings27/dsh-provider-card-release
description: Plays a character entrance card beside the composer when you switch model: identity name, six scored axes (intelligence, coding, speed, stability, cost, context), quota hint and a dialogue line. 23 curated cards across 15 providers; models without a curated card fall back to a data card derived from public benchmarks, or a generic card when no benchmark data exists. A web client plugin with no dependencies and no hooks.

title: fan56/dsh-tui-pi
description: Full-featured TUI for DeepSeek Harness: streaming conversation, powerline status bar, real-time think/tool/todo panels, subagent dual-view, theme hot-switch — all as pure cordis plugins with zero upstream patches.

title: fangwen9527/dsh-composer-ux
description: Configurable send and newline keys, a composer context menu with three sources (leave it to DSH and other plugins / browser menu / plugin-styled custom menu), a quick-command panel with categorized prompt lists where each prompt can append on every send or only on the first message of a session, a create-and-move row at the bottom of each category, a prompt optimizer that rewrites the draft with a separate model call, settings-panel size memory, and automatic x-opencode-session header injection for OpenCode routes. Prompt lists live in a global ~/.dsh/quick-prompts.json that is independent of the session and the project.

title: Fantasy421/dsh-whiteboard
description: Shared editable Excalidraw whiteboards with per-session multi-board management, quick navigation, incremental AI edits, curves, polylines, and image exports.

title: FanXi1230/fanxi#dsh-nova
description: A cosmic reasoning-effort slider for the DeepSeek Harness composer. Off, Low, High, and Max each have their own starfield and aurora, with smooth cross-fades and real per-session model selection.

title: FAVKTOXIC/dsh-caption-bar
description: Moves conversation views into the Windows caption row and header utilities into a compact right rail on DSH Desktop with Codex UI, reclaiming a full row of vertical space while preserving the session title, fullscreen control, dynamic status counts and menus.

title: faxble/dsh-model-picker
description: Model quick picker for DeepSeek Harness: a button left of the model dropdown opens a full model-selection dialog with provider grouping, live search, provider filter, capability tags read from the user's own input config, reasoning badges, recent-model shortcuts and a reasoning-effort picker; the choice writes back to the native dropdown immediately.

title: faxble/dsh-open-with-vscode
description: Adds a button left of the built-in Open In... in the session header that opens the current workspace directory in VS Code, fixing the desktop ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE environment leak that makes the built-in open-in-app fail with HTTP 502. Windows only: it locates Code.exe, so macOS and Linux are not supported yet.

title: Fayelin12/dsh-office
description: Office workspace & session dashboard: a floating 6-column sprite panel visualizing workspaces, sessions, token usage and subagents, plus Agent Mail and an office log tab. Feishu/Lark views (message feed, meeting schedules, transcripts) additionally require the `@larksuite/cli` tool installed and authenticated separately.

title: Feahter/dsh-plugins#mind-canvas
description: Infinite-canvas mind map in the sidebar: grow nodes with Tab, tidy a branch into a tree, ask the assistant to expand a node into child ideas, and export to Markdown, OPML, FreeMind, JSON or PNG.

title: FeatherHunter/dsh-im-companion
description: IM Companion for dsh-im: groups Feishu/WeChat/QQ bots by Agent in DSH workspaces and enhances DSH native session states (blue/orange/red rail markers for running, needs-review and error), with left badges, one-click filter, fleet overview and drag-to-move. Clean uninstall.

title: FeatherHunter/dsh-prompt
description: 🌹 Save every repetitive, tiresome templated prompt — one mouse click injects it into the composer and spares you the effort.

title: FeatherHunter/ilife#dsh-life-pack
description: ⚠️ Internal beta, do not download ⚠️ iLife: one DSH settings card for the iLife home-life suite — memo, calorie, chef, home, schedule and bill in a tab bar — covering every part of your home life.

title: feifandiv/dsh-annotation
description: Inline annotations for DeepSeek Harness replies and sidebar documents, with a composer card and a right-sidebar list.

title: feiniao1933/dsh-whale-icon
description: Replaces the DSH composer send/stop button with the DeepSeek blue whale and animates it while the agent runs.

title: feiyaochang123-sys/dsh-starred-turns
description: Right-click a dash in the conversation's right-edge turn rail to bookmark that turn: the dash grows to the rail's full width and takes the accent colour so it stays easy to find, and right-clicking again unbookmarks it. Bookmarks are scoped per conversation, keyed by the selected Session id, and persisted so they survive reloads. No layout shift - the rail keeps its fixed pitch.

title: Feizhaiqianqian/dsh-email-board
description: Read-only unread-mail board for the accounts configured in dsh-email — unread messages appear as per-account cards in the DSH right sidebar (sender, subject, time) and refresh on demand.

title: FeiZhuNiU-INFJA/dsh-stock-ticker
description: A floating, semi-transparent market ticker for DeepSeek Harness showing real-time level and change percentage for the Shanghai Composite, ChiNext, STAR 50 and Hang Seng Tech indices.

title: FelixJiashengFu/dsh-recent-deliverables
description: Draggable recent-deliverables panel for DSH Web that merges declared deliverables with recently modified workspace files, with filename search, type filters, inline PDF/HTML/image/text previews, and desktop open or reveal actions.

title: feng-yifan/dsh-plugins#dsh-ask-highlight
description: Highlights answered ask blocks (the “question n/n answered” tool rows) in the conversation with a soft brand-tinted card that follows the light/dark theme; pending asks and other tool blocks keep their native look. Settings can toggle highlighting and expand-by-default.

title: feng-yifan/dsh-plugins#dsh-at-enhancement
description: External @ file references: extends the Web GUI `@` completion so it can browse and reference absolute-path files and directories outside the workspace, level by level (`@/`, `@~/`), inserting the absolute path (quoted when it contains spaces) for the model to read. Toggleable in Settings; when off, completion matches native behaviour. On by default, and the model's reads of those paths are not limited by the sandbox; POSIX-style absolute paths only (no Windows drive letters).

title: feng-yifan/dsh-plugins#dsh-pwa-icon
description: PWA icon: replaces the icon and app name used when the Web GUI is installed or added to the desktop, covering desktop browsers and the iOS home screen. Ships a ready-to-use bundled icon set and accepts your own image plus manifest overrides.

title: feng-yifan/dsh-plugins#dsh-vertical-layout
description: Portrait layout for desktop windows: when the browser window is portrait, navigation takes the full left column and the file/terminal panel moves to the upper right above the conversation, with a draggable splitter setting its height (initial height configurable). Phones and tablets are untouched.

title: fengb3/dsh-session-icons
description: Sidebar session-title icons: an auxiliary model call on the same route as title generation draws a 24x24 monochrome SVG metaphor shown before each session row title, with disk caching.

title: fengMax1997/dsh-line-select
description: Line-range selection: browse workspace files, preview code with line numbers, visually select a line range, and write a `@path:start-end` reference into the composer; the agent receives the exact selected lines on send.

title: fengzhaoy/dsh-best-workspace
description: Codex-style left sidebar for the dsh web client: a project/session tree with grouping, pinning, drag reordering, unread and archive state, context menus for both project and session rows, and up/down arrow keys in the composer to recall previously sent messages.

title: fengzhaoy/dsh-web-ide
description: IDE tab in the dsh web client: a Monaco editor with the Dark Modern theme plus a file tree, git source control (stage/commit/push), an integrated xterm terminal and ripgrep workspace search, opened as a conversation view tab.

title: fengzhaoy/dsh-web-vscode
description: VS Code tabs for the dsh web client: one after the chat view and one in the right sidebar, both an embedded code-server workbench on the current session's directory; the iframe stays mounted outside React so switching tabs only hides it, one code-server process per session on 127.0.0.1 with no auth, and a missing code-server shows the probed paths with install commands and a retry button. Each code-server runs with --auth none on 127.0.0.1, so anything on this machine that can reach that port gets the workbench, including its integrated terminal.

title: ferrisching/dsh-prompt-predict
description: Predicts the user's next prompt after each assistant reply and shows it as gray ghost text inside the composer; Tab accepts it, ↓ generates the next suggestion, ↑ returns to the previous one, and Esc dismisses it. Each assistant reply triggers an extra call to the session's model, carrying the most recent user and assistant text.

title: fewoot/dsh-whale-particles
description: Dot-matrix backdrop for the DSH Web UI: the dots form the DeepSeek whale or a transparent PNG you import (alpha-masked), each dot carries its own low-frequency force and follows the cursor in manual mode, while an auto screensaver mode sweeps 360-degree waves and full-screen breathing across the artwork; sliders and toggles live under Settings > Plugins.

title: FFFFFFcn/dsh-intent-translator
description: Adds a composer control that turns a plain-language draft into a structured, terminology-precise prompt, shows the professional term behind selected colloquial phrases with a one-line explanation, and offers a terms-only mode that returns professional terminology without rewriting the draft.

title: Fictional-Historians/dsh-villager-widget
description: Community fork of the DSH whale balance widget that renders Minecraft villagers from your own local Java Edition install. At startup it reads the villager textures and sounds out of your .minecraft client jar (no game assets are bundled), draws a green-robed villager and a swamp librarian, and swaps between them automatically as DeepSeek pricing moves between peak and off-peak. Clicking the pet flashes it red the way Minecraft mobs do and plays a greet, hurt or death sound across a six-click cycle, each pitched one hertz above vanilla. Requires Minecraft Java Edition on the same machine — without it the villager skins and sounds are simply absent and the rest of the widget behaves like upstream.

title: FideFeiPlane/dsh-auto-maximize
description: Maximizes the DeepSeek Harness desktop window automatically on startup, equivalent to clicking the maximize button once. Cross-platform (Windows/macOS/Linux), best-effort, host-only.

title: fightingFirefox/dsh-web-terminal
description: Claude-styled terminal panel for the DSH web GUI: agent shell commands run in a persistent real PTY with a genuine prompt, echo and exit codes, auto-open in the right sidebar and are scoped per conversation; optional live_terminal_* tools for reading, searching and screenshotting. Fork of Lancang-hzau/dsh-live-terminal (MIT); it shares its live_terminal_* tools and right-sidebar panel, so do not install it together with the upstream plugin in the same profile.

title: Finalbingo/dsh-local-board
description: A local-first todo board for the DSH sidebar with Todo/Doing/Done columns organised by project, storing everything in one Markdown file inside a folder you pick on first run. Cards carry due dates down to the minute, a colour stripe, a private blur that hides the title until you reveal it, notes and per-project roles, and can be dragged between columns or onto another project. The agent also gets a kanban tool that reads and edits every card, masked ones included. On macOS it installs three launchd jobs that run /usr/bin/python3 and post system notifications (a 09:00 digest, a check every 30 minutes for cards due within 2 hours, a Monday weekly review), which you can retime or disable in the in-panel Automations tab.

title: FinalLawer/dsh-native-code-workbench#dsh-code-workbench
description: Code workbench in the right sidebar: a workspace file tree and a multi-tab Monaco editor with syntax highlighting and version-guarded saving, Tab completion from DeepSeek fill-in-the-middle, per-save checkpoints with rollback, codebase search (plus a codebase_search tool for the agent), and reference chips that insert a selection into the chat as an @path mention.

title: Findly-qwb/dsh-model-picker
description: Two-pane model picker that replaces the composer model menu with a searchable provider-grouped list on the left and a detail card on the right showing the selected model's context window, output cap, capability tags and reasoning-effort levels, all read from that model's own provider. The npm name dsh-model-picker belongs to another author; install through this GitHub source.

title: Firefly-TheHerta/dsh-boot-video-manager
description: A companion playlist panel for the dsh-boot-animation intro-video plugin: add clips without leaving the app, order them, and switch between sequential, random and single-clip playback. Sequential order is made deterministic by parking every clip except the one due to play in a disabled/ subdirectory of the same asset folder and rotating it back in on each boot, leaving the upstream plugin unpatched. Also supports recycling instead of deleting, pinning one clip for every launch, per-clip opt-out, and .mp4/.webm/.m4v/.mov files including non-ASCII names.

title: fishcg/dsh-input-prediction
description: Input prediction: the likely continuation of your draft appears as grey ghost text after the caret and Tab accepts it, and after each assistant turn 1-3 clickable follow-up suggestions appear above the input box and send on click. Ghost completion, suggestions and the suggestion count can be toggled in Settings, Built-in plugins.

title: fishcg/dsh-recent-tasks
description: A collapsible Recent tasks folder at the top of the sidebar above 工作区: the most recently updated sessions, pinning that ignores recency, running-state spinners, and a per-row menu with rename, fork and archive.

title: flowers-59f/dsh-petpal
description: Download pets from petdex.dev and keep one on the desktop, following the DSH session status; the appearance is adjustable and an enterprise WeChat bot can push a notification when the agent needs confirmation or finishes a turn. Desktop mode needs macOS 12+ or Windows 10 1903+; the bundled companion is prebuilt.

title: flycucu/dsh-icon-changer
description: Replaces the DeepSeek Harness desktop app icon (exe, tray and Start Menu) with any uploaded .ico, and restores the stock icon on demand.

title: flyfly6/dsh-panes
description: Full-screen workspace panel for DSH: a project sidebar with per-project tabs for session, files, explorer, project search, terminal, browser, source control and a Markdown notes vault.

title: flyhigao/dsh-file-transfer
description: Adds download buttons to the document preview toolbar and the Files tree, packs a folder download into a streamed ZIP, and adds a Files-tree upload button that streams to the Host one file at a time, capped at 1 GiB and renamed with an (n) suffix instead of overwriting.

title: flyhigao/dsh-sticky-notes
description: Workspace sticky notes for DSH, saved as multiple Markdown files under the current workspace.

title: FM1503/dsh-ui-layout
description: Declares a UI layout contract, measures pages in headless Chrome or Godot scenes and declared layouts, and audits overlap, occlusion, overflow, clipped text, undersized targets, dead controls, spacing drift and z-order traps, with a breakpoint matrix and a sidebar panel. Page measurement needs Chrome, Edge or Chromium and the puppeteer-core package installed where the DSH profile can resolve it; Godot scenes and declared layouts need neither.

title: foooold/dsh-message-nav
description: Adds a Codex-style message navigation rail for quickly locating earlier prompts in long DeepSeek Harness Web UI conversations.

title: foreee/dsh-app-restart
description: Adds a Restart application section to the desktop app Settings; quits gracefully and relaunches the whole application.

title: foreee/dsh-net-dashboard
description: Live network inspection dashboard in the sidebar: interfaces with IP/MAC, traffic rates, TCP/UDP session counts and latency curves, refreshed every 3 seconds. macOS only (the collectors run ifconfig, netstat, scutil and /sbin/ping).

title: ForsakenDelusion/dsh-branchnest
description: Project canvas for DSH sessions, with linked conversation cards, text-selection follow-up branches, notes, and a document-style reader.

title: fountainhead-gq/dsh-weread-gather
description: Digital Study: a private WeRead study in the DSH sidebar, in a calm light-green paper palette. The shelf folds into ten categories and carries a slightly deeper paper tint of its own; highlights and thoughts page through, copy per item, and export as front-matter Markdown (one file per book or a cross-book batch) into a folder you choose; the whole study backs up and restores as a single JSON bundle. Thoughts read like handwritten notes: looser line height, the source book shown in full, long entries folding behind a show-all control, and a same-chapter highlight block for context. A five-shade reading heatmap draws only the days up to today, keeps its numbers on one line underneath, and a year-scoped KPI dashboard sits above it.
