Sync is incremental: a local ledger plus per-book counts mean an unchanged library refreshes in 2-3 seconds instead of a full pull, and a banner reports progress and dismisses itself after eight seconds. Search covers shelf, books, highlights and thoughts with type filters. Reads WeRead through the official agent gateway using your own API key, keeps everything in local JSON and never writes back. Requires DSH >=0.2.2-rc.1.

title: FragrantLotus/dsh-plugin-chinese
description: Fills in a Chinese description for every installed DSH plugin that ships only an English one, at startup and again after each plugin change, and never rewrites a plugin name. Plugins that already export a locale folder show the new text on refresh; the rest are patched too — the in-memory layer shows Chinese immediately, and the on-disk locale pack it writes needs one restart.

title: FragrantLotus/dsh-sidebar-entries
description: Sidebar overhaul for the dsh web UI: long-press drag to reorder the panel icon rail, one arrow to fold it away, whole-row height caps on both the panel list and the pinned section (30% of the rail, rounded down to whole rows), a pinned-session section that mirrors the shipped row's live status (spinner, waiting-for-reply, relative time), drag-to-reorder conversation view tabs, archived Sessions sunk to the bottom of each group newest-first, forked child Sessions following their parent into the pinned section, and a generic lift that moves any plugin's sidebar-footer entry up into the rail. Each subsystem starts behind its own guard, so one that fails returns null and the rest of the plugin still mounts.

title: framefutura/dsh-mode-seat
description: Persistent agent-preset (mode) selector docked in the composer input bar: switch the mode for new tasks, and set the new-task default from any running session.

title: Free-corner/dsh-chat-tools
description: Chat column width and alignment control, numbered question history with keyboard navigation and auto-load of older questions, and markdown outline rails for both the conversation and the file preview.

title: Friedeggrice/dsh-stealth-reader
description: Reads a few lines of a txt or epub novel inside the sidebar bottom panel, styled to pass for scratch notes; pages with Ctrl+Alt+J/K and keeps progress locally. Requires dsh-better-sidebar 0.26+ - the reader exists only as a tab in its bottom panel.

title: Frog755/dsh-prompt-vault
description: Prompt library above the DSH composer — a 📚 button expands a searchable panel to insert saved prompts into the draft with one click (appends, never overwrites), persisted in a host-side JSON file.

title: Frog755/dsh-wallpaper
description: Persistent image or MP4 wallpaper for the DSH Web profile: a wallpaper card under Settings -> General selects a local image or MP4 (up to 300 MB), tunes surface opacity and blur, compresses video locally to H.264 when ffmpeg/ffprobe are on PATH, stores media under ~/.dsh/wallpapers, and pins the Web server to port 9191 so the saved wallpaper survives restarts.

title: FrontierMindLab/dsh-quick-compact#dsh-quick-compact
description: Context ring gauge in the DSH composer toolbar: view usage, open a breakdown panel, and run /compact from the panel, with a fireworks animation.

title: FSMargoo/dsh-at-file
description: Codex-style `@file` mentions: search workspace files in the composer and attach their contents to prompts.

title: fu-silent/dsh-sidebar-home
description: Adds a Home panel to the sidebar for choosing a workspace; focus mode then shows only that workspace's sessions and folds the other workspaces below, and exiting focus restores the shipped sidebar.

title: fujingzhai/youxia-dsh-plugins#dsh-settings-customizer
description: Overrides the order, names and icons of DeepSeek Harness settings navigation entries from a personal profile configuration, without patching other plugins. Shipped defaults contain no rules, so the interface is unchanged until configured. The rules are written by hand in the profile's cordis.patch.yml; needs DSH 0.2.2-rc.1 or newer and Node.js 24.9+.

title: fujingzhai/youxia-dsh-plugins#dsh-speed-pair
description: Replaces the stat-bar output speed with two figures, for example 207(122) tok/s: outside the parentheses the decoding speed after the first token, inside it the speed over the whole request including first-token latency. Clicking it opens a breakdown of turns, steps, TTFT and per-phase timings. It replaces the native session-stats item; needs DSH 0.2.1-rc.5 or newer.

title: fujingzhai/youxia-dsh-plugins#dsh-zh-slash
description: Typing the Chinese enumeration comma 、 at the start of the DSH input box opens the native / command menu; the existing filtering, keyboard and mouse handling and argument panels are unchanged, and 、 used mid-sentence is unaffected. A 、 typed as the first character always becomes / (there is no escape); needs DSH 0.2.1-rc.5 or newer.

title: FujiwaraReisen/dsh-live2dwaifu
description: Shows a Live2D character in the bottom-right corner of the DSH web UI: blinking, breathing, lip-sync while talking, seven moods, and a speech bubble with its own chat, memory, corpus and stickers. Models are never bundled; every user drops in their own folder.

title: functy23/dsh-fullscreen-settings
description: Opens the DSH settings dialog as a full-page screen and moves the close control to a back row at the top left.

title: FunnyBishop/dsh-better-tooluse
description: Tool-use visibility for dsh: an act wrapper and guard make every ordinary tool call carry a describe field (direct calls are rejected by default), the model narrates decisions in plain text, and live act cards with thinking, purpose, status and result show in a strip under the composer and, with the optional dsh-better-sidebar plugin, in a right-side digest panel. Also adds a background event tool for long tasks.

title: FunnyDiodio/dsh-workspace-picker-path
description: Adds a General settings row choosing where the Add-workspace directory picker opens: a fixed custom path (typed, pasted, or picked visually) or the last directory you confirmed. Quoted and CJK paths are accepted, and a This PC level reaches other Windows drives.

title: funswe/dsh-resizable-settings
description: Makes the DSH Settings dialog resizable from its edges and corners and movable by its top strip, remembering the chosen size across opens.

title: FuqiangCraft/dsh-desktop#packages/dsh-desktop-plugin
description: Desktop-grade companion: browser native notifications for user questions and approval interactions, screen capture model tool, multi-agent tiling grid view, and lightweight Tauri desktop shell.

title: FurinaEsE/dsh-ui-zoom-regions
description: Per-region UI zoom for DeepSeek Harness — Ctrl + wheel sets independent zoom levels for the conversation header, the left sidebar, the conversation body and the right sidebar (sidebars 25%-300%), and dragging the header bottom edge makes that header shorter or taller, growing by height only so label size stays unchanged.

title: FurinaLiF/dsh-tab-complete
description: Predicts the next user message as composer ghost text using the configured DSH model; Tab fills the draft without sending, with time-aware context and cached suggestions.

title: FuriousKinght/dsh-restart-button
description: Adds a Windows-only button at the foot of the sidebar that restarts the DSH desktop app and reloads the page when it comes back.

title: furkancak1r/dsh-composer-plus
description: Composer and sidebar helpers in one plugin, each switchable in Settings: a git Changes panel, Turn rollback, Resume after an AIProxy outage, Project memory (notes per project that later chats read, off by default), a Task board (kanban board of chats by their live state), Assistant (one lasting chat named Damon that sets reminders with dsh scheduled tasks and reads your other chats; it changes a chat only after an approval) with Assistant callouts, Assistant always free (long steps go to background subagents) and Assistant news from chats (off by default), Remote computers (another Mac's dsh over Tailscale, off by default), 11 extra UI languages and Automatic updates.

title: FurryBear2025/dsh-session-drag-move
description: Drag a session onto another workspace in the DSH sidebar and it really moves: the session-log header cwd is rewritten and the log directory is re-homed under the target project, with a progress bar while it runs.

title: future007s/dsh-peak-indicator
description: Session header badge showing DeepSeek peak/off-peak status, per-model token prices on hover, and real session/turn costs from actual usage.

title: Fyerl/dsh-2d-model-picker
description: Select a model and its reasoning effort in one drag with a two-dimensional grid.

title: fyisgod/dsh-selection-tools
description: Select text in any Windows app to explain or translate it with the Harness agent, answered in a native always-on-top overlay.

title: fysh1010/mcp-server-fanqie#deepseek-harness
description: Fanqie reader for the DeepSeek Harness sidebar: search book and media metadata, browse covers and chapter lists, read website-visible chapters, and view your bookshelf and saved highlights after QR sign-in.

title: FzqxDedafeiyu/dsh-approval-reason-dock
description: Add an optional rejection reason to approval prompts: the text is steered into the running turn before the rejection is answered, and the panel only follows the session you are currently viewing.

title: g-yixuan/dsh-sidenote
description: Side chats and selection annotations for DeepSeek Harness, preserving full conversation history and bringing findings back to the main thread.

title: G57651/dsh-diy-layout
description: Customizes the DSH home sidebar plugin entries without harness source changes: one- or two-column panel list, icon-only mode with 500ms hover tooltips, and per-entry ordering, hiding, and a settings page for the upper panel area and the footer plugin row.

title: gaog88666-boop/dsh-legal-workbench
description: A right-sidebar workbench for legal practice backed by a folder of Markdown notes: SOP lookup, recordings with live transcription and line-level annotations, an inline glossary, and full-text search. Optional email rules library, Pkulaw points and usage badges. Notes, recordings and annotations stay on the local machine; live transcription needs your own Volcengine key and sends audio to Volcengine.

title: gaor0605-kq/dsh-workspace-explorer
description: Adds a Chats/Files switch to the left-sidebar Workspace header that swaps the session list for a lazily loaded tree of the current session's workspace. Files and folders can be dragged into the composer as @path references; clicking a file opens the built-in preview; the right-click menu reveals a file in the system file manager or copies its path; entries carry VS Code-style Git status (modified, untracked, added, deleted, conflict, ignored) relative to the last commit.

title: gaoyinxin/dsh-mode-switcher
description: Adds a Plan/Build mode toggle to the composer, switched with the Tab key or a toolbar button, and remembers a separate model for each mode from the native model selector.

title: garrisonz/dsh-sidebar-width
description: Control the Web UI left sidebar width: lower the 264px drag minimum and optionally tune the drag maximum and the expanded default width, applied by a startup patch of the ui-layout bundle.

title: gbeta/dsh-token-speed
description: Draggable ring gauge showing live model output speed (tok/s) with an expandable per-step detail panel (exact speed, TTFT, cache-hit rate, cache read/write, reasoning and input tokens, model, cumulative tokens).

title: gcolt888/dsh-screenshot-hotkey
description: WeChat-style screenshot and annotation for the DSH composer, with a system-wide hotkey that captures without raising the DSH window. Windows only; on first use it compiles its helper executables from bundled C# source with the built-in csc.exe.

title: GeekRicardo/dsh-balance
description: Composer-dock balance/usage readout for DeepSeek, Kimi Coding, OpenCode Go, Zhipu, MiniMax, OpenRouter and OpenAI Codex — provider-based, 2s polling, 5min cache.

title: GeekRicardo/dsh-convmap
description: Conversation-map rail down the left edge of the transcript: one tick per user turn, read from the full session log on the host rather than from the rendered page, so long sessions are covered end to end. Hovering fans the neighbouring ticks open by pixel distance and floats a scrollable preview of that turn prompt and its last reply; clicking scrolls to the turn, paging older history in first when it has not been rendered yet; the tick for the visible turn stays highlighted while you scroll.

title: geguanming/dsh-office-plugin
description: Renders live multi-agent session activity as a pixel-art office in a Web UI side panel - each session is an ox/horse worker typing at its desk when busy or wandering off when idle, with click-to-view work monitors and in-place approval cards.

title: GEMLZC/dsh-font-studio
description: Typography settings page: text, code and terminal font size and family, plus interface, conversation and code text colour, weight, italic, letter spacing and line height, with a live preview.

title: Genesi599/dsh-plugins#hub-callout
description: Renders GitHub admonition syntax in messages as alert cards, matching the Hermes desktop look.

title: Genesi599/dsh-plugins#hub-desktop-ui
description: Reworks the DSH shell into a compact layout: a denser session sidebar, a status card at the bottom of the sidebar, and a project and task-line view that groups sessions by what they are working on.

title: Genesi599/dsh-plugins#project-room
description: Turns the sidebar into a project view and gives each project a room with a shared board, task-line columns filled from message routing, and per-project member avatars.

title: genius-alray/dsh-model-picker
description: Requires DSH 0.1.5-rc.2+. Dialog-style model picker for the DSH Web UI: fuzzy search, collapsible provider groups, favorites with a favorites-only filter, and a thinking-level dropdown, replacing the built-in model selector with official UI primitives and DSW tokens.

title: GeniusHu-tgty/dsh-prompt-better
description: Adds a button to the composer that rewrites the current draft into a clearer, more specific prompt through a one-shot LLM call, with one-click revert and cancel.

title: germyGao/dsh-select-assist
description: Select text in any Windows app to explain, summarize, translate, or read it aloud with DeepSeek Harness — answered in a streaming always-on-top overlay with a horizontal capsule menu.

title: gezi-wen/sage-reminder
description: A time module in the DSH session header: current time, time since your last message, reminders, and countdowns. Pure browser-side - data lives in localStorage and the host half registers nothing. Alerts are a border glow plus an in-app toast; no system notifications.

title: gf691271/dsh-quote-reply
description: Quote and reply the way Claude Code does it: select text, answer it in a popover, stack the pairs as blocks above the composer, send them as one message.

title: gghyoo/dsh-download-image
description: Adds a Download PNG button next to the assistant message copy button in the DSH Web UI.

title: Ghidorahchaos/dsh-cherry-quote
description: Quote selected text from a DSH message into the composer as a blue chip, hover to read the full quote, and remove it with X or Backspace; sent quotes reach the model as a blockquote.

title: giiiiiithub/terminal
description: Real PTY terminal panel for the DSH Web UI: host half spawns shells with node-pty (cmd.exe default on Windows), rendered in the browser with xterm.js; multi-tab sessions, dock/floating window, clipboard support.

title: GinoXiang/dsh-dailyboard
description: DailyBoard — a daily work task board for the DSH Web GUI with a one-month calendar of colored timeline bars and day tasks, a daily checklist, a seven-day week view with completion checkboxes and drag-to-reschedule, a draggable 24-hour day timeline, ordered per-day subtasks, weekly and every-N-days recurring tasks with per-occurrence result records, a long-term progress view opened from the calendar header, per-day completion for long-term tasks, tasks that can be marked “For others” by choosing one of the added recipients (shown as note + email), a collapsible daily email reminder that can be pushed to WeChat and can remind other people such as partners or relatives (each extra recipient has an email, a note and its own send time), AI task extraction from natural language with smart date parsing (single dates become day tasks, “this week/month” starts from today, Enter extracts, indented lines become visible subtasks that can be promoted), completion rewards on the calendar (completed days turn solid green with a large check, plus “N days this month · X-day streak” stats), and CSV export with an auto-generated records.csv mirror, and a specific-day all-day strip that lets long-term tasks be dragged onto the 24-hour timeline to create draggable scheduled blocks. Its HTTP routes have no DSH access check, so a web page open in your browser could call them.

title: GinoXiang/dsh-output-style
description: Two split composer controls for output style: a tone switch with its own preset menu, and an output-form switch with its own preset menu; each session's system prompt follows the selections, with a preset settings page.

title: gitByteFree/dsh-pomodoro-pet
description: Pomodoro timer with four-quadrant tasks: bind focus rounds to a task, grow a desktop pet with EXP and achievements, and let the agent start rounds or propose tasks.

title: gjj-star/dsh-conversation-navigator
description: Conversation navigator panel: turn-folded outline of the current session with per-step kind badges (assistant, tool, command, compaction, error), a hover bubble showing the full user question, a minimal mode that hides turn numbers for an all-badge view, keyword filter over user questions and assistant replies, click-to-jump with reading-position tracking, and load-earlier/load-all history paging. Host >= 0.1.2-rc.1; legacy hosts install @legacy/0.2.5.

title: GLFzr/dsh-file-upload
description: Codex-style drag-drop: drag any file into the DSH web GUI, it lands in ~/.dsh-dropbox, and the path is inserted into the composer as a whole blue chip.

title: GnaneshKunal/dsh-menubar#plugin
description: The menu bar app itself is a separate AppKit build from the repo's app/ directory (swift build -c release on macOS); the plugin only provides the host bridge.

title: GodLike2020/dsh-mqtt-tools
description: MQTT client and embedded broker for DeepSeek Harness: one sidebar panel with saved connections, a live message log and a local broker, plus nine mqtt_* agent tools.

title: golddream-y/ratel-dsh-lumina
description: Make development more fun. A subtle layer of motion for DeepSeek Harness, with customizable effects and reduced-motion support.

title: GoldenLoaf24h/dsh-prompt-suggestion
description: Predicts your next message after each turn and shows it as gray ghost text in the composer: Tab takes the whole line, Alt+Right takes one word at a time, Enter takes it and sends, Esc dismisses, and Alt+R asks the model again without repeating the old one. Typing a few characters completes from prompts already sent in the session, Up in an empty composer recalls the last one, and a plugin-page form sets the provider, model, reasoning effort, per-key toggles and generation limits.

title: gongstudent/dsh-quote-to-agent
description: Quote text selected in a DSH Web conversation, then either attach it to the current composer or dispatch it to a subagent session: the quote sits on a bar above the composer, or opens that subagent in a new pane on the right. When the target has no subagent yet, the quote is held and the composer is seeded with a spawn request, then picked up automatically once the new session appears. Client-only.

title: GooDAnDReaDY/dsh-russian-lang
description: Adds Russian as a native option in Settings - General - Language for DeepSeek Harness, covering both the core UI and companion plugins. Localized Markdown export, in-message translation, live typography, slash-command aliases and an Alt+L layout fix, plus a settings card, all applied through a runtime locale snapshot rather than by modifying core files.

title: goodboys155/dsh-github-radar
description: Right-sidebar GitHub panel with four rising-repository lists — created within 2 days, 7 days, 30 days, and 20k+ stars still pushed — where the first three are ranked by star velocity (stars per day) rather than total stars, so repositories that gained traction fast surface above older ones with more stars. Each row shows the repository name, its own description, language, the stars-per-day rate and up to two topics, and links to the repository. A keyword search box queries the GitHub Search API directly, debounced and IME-aware so a Chinese or Japanese composition costs one request instead of one per keystroke. Reads the public GitHub Search API anonymously: no token, no login, no account, nothing else contacted. Lists cache for 30 minutes and search results for 5; outbound requests go direct first and fall back to a listening local proxy port only if direct fails.

title: GooodWei/arcana
description: A floating command deck that lists every slash command in DeepSeek Harness as runnable buttons, sorted by usage.

title: gorban/dsh-job-stop
description: Stop a running background job from the session-header job list, with a confirmation dialog that restates the full command.

title: gordan-code/dsh-jev-advisor
description: Adds human-facing TypeSafe Jev advice to DSH multiple-choice prompts, on demand by default with optional automatic requests, recommendations, probabilities, confidence, close-call warnings, copyable suggestions, one-click adoption, profile-scoped card layouts, temporary decision preferences, optional request previews with common-credential masking, and local health checks with sanitized diagnostic exports.

title: Gorkaseto/dsh-effort-picker
description: Adds a sticky effort slider inside the composer model menu to select reasoning levels, with generic stops for custom models.

title: gosutry/dsh-conversation-float
description: Turns a DSH conversation into a floating window that stays usable over plugin and automation pages — on screen, minimised to a left-sidebar taskbar row, or docked into the right sidebar.

title: Grampusworld/dsh-prompt-optimizor
description: Rewrites the composer draft into a tighter prompt in one click and restores the exact original in another, running on Harness's own models by default or any OpenAI-compatible endpoint, with an editable polishing prompt.

title: GraptK/dsh-composer-enhance
description: Rewrites the composer draft, or only the selected text, with one model call that uses the recent conversation as context, with cancel, revert, fidelity and length checks, and an optional preview.

title: GraptK/dsh-quick-restart
description: Adds a Restart item to the DeepSeek Harness desktop account menu, with confirmation, progress and failure reporting.

title: Grawl/dsh-screen-switcher
description: Ctrl+Tab switcher over every visited screen — Sessions, Settings sections and plugin pages — shown while Ctrl is held; release to switch, Esc to stay. Browsers reserve Ctrl+Tab for their own tabs, so use it in the desktop app or in a browser that delivers the shortcut to the page.

title: GT-610/dsh-workspace-organize
description: Grouped workspace browser for the DSH sidebar: named groups over group > workspace > session, group-level archive and delete that show the affected count, a three-way archived-session filter, and a group document the Host half writes to $DSH_HOME/storages. Drawn with the shell's own --dsw-* tokens and official components, so rows, menus and theme switching match the native sidebar.

title: gu040303-ai/dsh-prompt-enhancer
description: One-click plain-text prompt enhancement with optional local checks and sentence review in DeepSeek Harness.

title: GuanYang14700/dsh-hermes-panel
description: Hermes in the DSH sidebar: start and stop the gateway and dashboard, watch the dashboard beside the chat, and bridge DSH to Hermes. Windows only; requires an existing Hermes install.

title: guchang/draw2code
description: An Excalidraw prototyping tab for dsh-better-sidebar with structured product clarification, conflict-aware human and Agent board updates, and prototype-guided frontend generation.

title: guhanfei-ai/dsh-mindmap
description: Conversational Markdown mindmap workspace: edit complete documents step by step, keep a live right-side visualization synchronized, and open, manage, and export mindmaps from the working directory.

title: GuihaiHU/dsh-temp-note
description: A temp note in the DSH right sidebar with session, workspace, and global scopes, browser-local autosave, one-click copy, and one-click LLM polish through the default model.

title: guiyuan77/dsh-peek
description: Reads EPUB, TXT, Markdown and HTML from the workspaces registered in dsh in a right-sidebar tab, restores the last reading position, and collapses the whole sidebar with Esc to return to the conversation. No runtime dependencies and no build step.

title: gulagala001/dsh-deepseek-workbench
description: Desktop only. DeepSeek web chat, temporary side conversations, the API platform and conversation migration in DSH.

title: gulagala001/dsh-intelligent-ui
description: Native interactive answers, editable cards and on-demand UI skills for DSH.

title: guo-ziao/dsh-interrupt-button
description: A green interrupt button beside the send box: silently stops a running agent, which then summarizes its progress and asks for your new requirements, with a customizable interrupt prompt.

title: guoliyuan97-png/dsh-game-hud
description: Game-style floating HUD: balance HP bar, context MP bar, official peak/valley pricing with countdown, auto-compaction under 5% remaining, and memory-carrying new conversation.

title: gushengsheng/dsh-conversation-overview
description: Conversation turn overview: a header button turns the chat into a per-turn list with jump-to-turn, focus selection, cross-session distribution, browsing other sessions for that agent to read, and multi-session task composition into a brand new session.

title: guyue55/dsh-disk-panel
description: Left sidebar disk panel for the DSH Web UI: volume free space, per-Workspace folder sizes, moving build artifacts to the macOS Trash with an audit log and restore, sending scan results to an agent, and a host-side low-space watchdog with OS notifications. macOS and Linux only; Trash cleanup works on macOS only, while Linux gets the scan, trend and watchdog without cleanup. Cleanup is limited to a fixed list of build-artifact folder names directly under a registered Workspace.

title: H1Kariiiiiii/dsh-icon-console
description: Icon console for the DSH desktop app: import one icon and apply it to the desktop and Start Menu shortcuts (immediately), the application window image and the system tray image (after a restart), with automatic backup, one-click restore, a named icon library, and restart/exit controls.

title: hadesybil-hub/dsh-restart-button
description: Adds a restart button next to the shutdown button in the bottom-right of the DSH Web GUI; the server comes back up and the browser reopens.

title: hahajing233-source/dsh-sticky-wall
description: Sticky notes on a wall, with five paper stocks, five inks, seven typefaces, four text sizes and your choice of pin, tape or clip.

title: HAN-050917/dsh-plugin-dsweb-harness
description: Use DeepSeek's web chat inside DSH: real chat history in the leftmost sidebar, a Chat/Work switch beside the agent mode, plus streaming answers, thinking, web search and file uploads.

title: Han-1413141/dsh-jev-thinkout
description: Shows JeV-selected task plans, progress updates and stage summaries in DSH chat, with native translation or lightweight summaries. Requires a JeV key; the Jev service is called externally and may bill. and hierarchical serial/parallel task flows.

title: Han-1413141/dsh-sticky-disclosure
description: One-click collapse of every expanded section (Think rows, tool cards) with a live-count pill and a customizable hotkey.

title: Han-1413141/dsh-ui-hub
description: UI butler for every plugin UI: official/plugin categories, per-widget toggles, drag move/resize, collision avoidance and one-click auto arrange.

title: han8421/dsh-desktop-ball
description: Windows-only desktop floating ball with a bilingual WebView2 quick-chat window, including in-window question and approval cards.

title: HanaAyane/dsh-reasoning-effort
description: Adds an animated DeepSeek Chan reasoning-effort slider to DSH's native model selector, following model-declared levels with a running animation that speeds up while dragging.

title: hanbernate/dsh-save-button
description: Adds a Download button to DSH Web GUI delivery cards, so files delivered with present save straight from the browser.

title: HandsYe/dsh-input-history
description: Persistent prompt history for the DSH composer — Up/Down recalls sent prompts across restarts, Up with text typed filters by prefix, and cleared drafts are not recorded.

title: HandsYe/dsh-lock-screen
description: One-click lock screen: a sidebar button covers the whole interface with the current Windows wallpaper, and two Esc presses unlock it.

title: hanfang5057-byte/dsh-plugin-quote-comment
description: Asks for a comment when you quote a selection, then inserts the quote and the comment as one block.

title: Hankai233/dsh-mermaid-studio
description: Renders mermaid and mmd code fences in DSH messages as diagram cards with zoom, pan, a full-screen viewer and SVG export, caching each render in memory and IndexedDB so the same diagram is not drawn twice.

title: Hanmiao33/dsh-bubble-explain
description: Select any text in a conversation and tap the Explain button to get a streaming Markdown explanation bubble, with recursive follow-up questions.

title: hanrr92/dsh-code-quote
description: Composer code-quote collapse for the DSH Web UI: pasting a `path:line` header followed by code folds the input into one compact inline quote chip, and at send time the `agent/pre-step` hook injects the full pasted snapshot to the model as a separate context message. 0.5.x also folds sidebar file-selections that insert only a `path:lines` line (large selections), fetching the code from disk by session cwd, and preempts Ctrl+V paste interception.

title: HansHuang2683/dsh-quote-annotate
description: Select any passage in a DSH conversation to annotate it in place; the quoted text, the turn it came from and your comment are folded into the message on send, so the model can tell exactly what each remark refers to.

title: hansomgar/dsh-settings-resize
description: Resize the Settings dialog and set its transparency from three sliders in General settings; the choice persists across restarts.

title: HanYu-me/dsh-project-kanban
description: A project kanban in the dsh sidebar. Every project gets its own section with four fixed columns (todo, in progress, feedback, done); add, rename, recolor, reorder and delete projects and tasks, advance a task with one click, reorder by drag and drop or with the card menu, undo a deletion, and collapse a project. Clicking a project opens a page for its key data and results: two trees (data on the left, results on the right) you arrange by drag and drop and merge into chapters, lines that show which result came from which data, stars with a star-only view of the same tree, relations between results, colours by category, and undo or redo with Cmd+Z. Colours, radii and shadows come from the dsh theme, so it follows light and dark, and the layout reflows from four columns to two to one.

title: haonan108/dsh-plugin-screenshot-tool
description: A macOS screenshot button in the composer tool row: the scissors split button runs the native screencapture marquee — optionally hiding the Harness window first, chosen from its caret menu — then copies the PNG to the clipboard and attaches it to the composer draft; Screen Recording is preflighted, so an un-granted capture points at the settings instead of returning a wallpaper-only image.

title: HaoyueQin/dsh-diff-stat
description: Inline +N −M badges on edit/write tool rows and a collapsible per-turn file-change summary card with aligned diffs, review and undo — covers native edit/write, str_replace_editor and Code Dispatch sub-calls, no git required.

title: HapyRain/dsh-router-laya
description: Auto thinking-effort routing for dsh: a locally fine-tuned 7-question classifier (ModernBERT, 842MB, <1s CPU inference) picks low/high/max for no-intent messages; in-session retries escalate the tier (low to high to max) under exclusion constraints; the judge service fails safe to low if unreachable. A tier chip in the input bar shows the live tier and the last 20 judgments. All inference is local - task text never leaves the machine.

title: Harzva/dsh-superterminal
description: Native terminals for DSH 0.1.1-rc.2 on macOS, with local terminal AI sessions, SSH terminals that reconnect to the same remote task, bounded Terminal Group discussions, and handoffs with acceptance and rework.

title: hatsuyuki0103/dsh-at-any
description: Codex-style `@file` mentions for the web GUI: search and reference workspace files of every format (.java, .vue, PDF, images, extension-less, hidden) with no index truncation. Replaces dsh-at-file.

title: hawkongz/dsh-chat-locator
description: Turn-rail settings for the DSH conversation locator: tick thickness, rail on the left or right, a curved length gradient on the hovered tick, and a plain-text hover preview with adjustable line count, font size and width.

title: HaydenSmith1121/dsh-wallhaven-wallpaper
description: Searches wallhaven.cc from a settings page and sets any wallpaper as the DSH web GUI background, with opacity, blur and scrim controls, a sidebar shuffle button and one-click original download; all fetching runs in the host process, so the browser never needs to reach wallhaven.

title: He2way/dsh-task-console
description: Flip the DSH page over to a glass task board showing live jobs, subagents and session state, with an infinite canvas that unrolls a card into draggable controls, embedded web-app frames, and a conversation box that edits the canvas.

title: HEArtattaCK2332/dsh-text-explain
description: Select a passage in a DSH conversation and read a plain-language explanation in a floating panel, which carries the surrounding message as the context. Three explanation depths (plain / general / pro) that re-explain on the spot when switched; optional web search and local file lookup (the model decides by default, and a button can force one lookup that reports only what is new); follow-up questions; and a button that hands the whole exchange to a new session in standby mode - the background is queued without waking the model or spending tokens. Settings live on the host in settings.json, and nothing is written until you press save. The repository also ships an OpenAI-compatible endpoint and a browser extension (source).

title: Heeweelee/dsh-prompt-suggestions
description: Composer suggestions for the DSH chat input: Up / Down step back and forth through every prompt sent in the current session — read from the session event log, so a message accepted from a prediction or sent by queueing counts too — Ctrl+Up opens a searchable history picker, and grey ghost text predicts the next message, accepted with the Right arrow. Every key only edits the draft; nothing is ever sent automatically.

title: heiheiha798/dsh-plugin-response-window
description: Web UI plugin that folds each staged response's think and tool calls into per-segment bounded, scrollable slide windows with a configurable height, keeping every intermediate response visible.

title: heiyedehen/dsh-half-page
description: Half Page (dsh-half-page) — a reading room kept for the agent: through reading_* tools it reads a book from ~/.dsh/reading one chapter at a time, writes notes beside chapters and keeps its own writing there, and a panel shows its reading progress. It adds lines to the system prompt telling the agent the room is its own and optional. Not a to-do list.

title: heiyedehen/dsh-whale-whispers
description: Quote books in the conversation header: one markdown file per chat, with search, a random pick, line and favourite counts, a keep button under every reply, and a trash with restore. The agent gets four tools (append, list, remove, merge) and a system-prompt guide, so by default it may save up to a line or two per chat on its own; capture rules can be set per chat or globally. Local-only. Needs DSH 0.2.1+ (below 0.3).

title: hellmage/dsh-chat-lanes
description: Splits the DSH chat window into two columns: your messages pinned in a clickable left rail and the model replies flowing on the right, with Enter-to-search across the conversation.

title: hellofuture2068/dsh-simple-view
description: Declutters the DSH chat: hides agent execution-log rows, tightens spacing and fonts, wraps messages in bubbles, and injects an editable reply-concisely system instruction.

title: helloworld010234/dsh-fluid-chat-width
description: Fluid conversation width for the DSH web UI: the chat column follows the window minus a 64px margin, capped at 1560px and floored at 640px, while the built-in drag handles still override it.

title: HelmsmanOfDesire/dsh-countdown
description: A workday countdown shown as an hourglass on every DSH page. The sand volume follows the elapsed fraction of the current work period; periods can be added, removed and edited, including ones that span midnight, and when the clock is outside every period the panel says so instead of counting.

title: 逐段翻译 · dsh-bilingual
description: Adds paragraph-by-paragraph translation and a bilingual view to assistant replies in the DeepSeek Harness desktop app: each Chinese paragraph gets an English translation underneath and each English paragraph gets a Chinese one underneath, behind a session-header toggle; code blocks and formulas stay untranslated, and tables get a translated copy underneath. Translations come from the DeepSeek API (the plugin reuses DSH's saved DEEPSEEK_API_KEY, or a key you paste in its settings), so it needs network access and each uncached paragraph is a billable request.

title: HengryLiang/dsh-plugin-ai-drama
description: AI short-drama workspace for DeepSeek Harness, with a dedicated drama agent preset, 35 agent tools and 10 bundled skills covering outline, characters, script, storyboard and export.

title: henry1996-yl/dsh-weather-badge
description: Weather plugin for the sidebar account row: a serif clock dial and a weather dial sit beside the account, a one-line weather strip sits below it, and both dials switch between circle and square, six dial themes, five fonts and local or network time; a weather tool and a full forecast panel (current conditions, 24-hour chart, 7-day outlook) share three forecast sources that fail over automatically.

title: HERO476/dsh-sidecard-ask
description: Select text in the DSH Web GUI and ask about it in place (floating button, or the Alt+Q shortcut): an independent subagent that inherits no parent context answers, streaming into a side card hosted by the native right sidebar, dsh-better-sidebar, or a built-in overlay — and the question can be routed to the main conversation instead.

title: HeShen-1/dsh-composer-enhance
description: Composer prompt enhancement for DSH Web: a ✨ button rewrites the current draft in place after asking only about genuine ambiguity, and an empty composer shows a grey next-message ghost that Tab or a click fills into the draft without sending.

title: heshuren371/dsh-music-player
description: Local music player: scans a folder for audio and video files, plays them in a Music tab with crossfade, a 10-band EQ and ReplayGain, and can write matched tags, covers and filenames back to the files with atomic replacement.

title: hexuntt/dsh-gundam-0083
description: Turns the DSH Web UI into the Albion's U.C.0083 panoramic cockpit: hangar-door boot sequence, seven-step EFSF self-check, parallax canopy frame, three-section MFD deck, local BGM and a cold dark theme.

title: hffek/dsh-steer-note
description: Adds a compact mid-turn steering box above the composer for text, images, and files, with read and pending status, cancel, and unfinished-draft rescue.

title: hg1048596-pixel/dsh-ppt-canvas
description: PowerPoint workbench for DeepSeek Harness: drag in a PPTX, annotate objects or regions across slides, review AI changes on the canvas, and confirm one batch with undo and redo.

title: hg1048596-pixel/dsh-recall-unread
description: Adds a strip above the composer that lists sent-but-unread (steering) text messages and recalls them before the model reads them, one by one or all at once.

title: HighToward/dsh-plugins-sidebar-manager
description: Sorts the entries of the DSH sidebar panel list into one or two levels of categories, draws a titled collapsible header for each group, and shows or hides each entry, all edited from a Plugin Sidebar page in Settings and mirrored to $DSH_HOME/plugins-sidebar-manager.json.

title: hiJoeLee/dsh-suggest-actions
description: Up to 5 clickable next steps under every reply: click one to send it, or fill it into the composer and edit first. The suggestions come from the main model as it closes the turn — no extra model call.

title: hiJoeLee/dsh-whale-brand
description: Puts your own animated vector logo over the DSH brand mark in the sidebar and beside the start-page headline, taking over the three single slots sidebar.brand.mark, sidebar.brand.name and conversation.hero.brand.mark. The bundled patch only inserts the plugin into the loader — the official brand plugin (@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-brand-official) holds those slots too, so you must disable it in the profile's cordis.patch.yml and restart. Ships a swimming whale that follows light and dark themes through currentColor and is tuned to stay legible at the sidebar's 24 px.

title: hijoywell/dsh-tjing-reading
description: Read EPUB, PDF, DRM-free MOBI/AZW3 and TXT in the DSH sidebar. WeChat Read style typography with TOC, bookmarks, highlights and progress memory; select any passage to translate it into Chinese; the Ask-the-Book AI answers only from passages retrieved from the open book. Books and progress stay in local IndexedDB. Four themes including an eye-care green paper, and PDF paper follows the theme.

title: Hilbert-beinghappy/seektty
description: Terminal workspace for DeepSeek Harness with local VS Code JSON/JSONC theme import, inherited terminal background effects, mouse text selection, structured tool and diff views, Session/Profile/plugin management, and Skill/MCP browsers.

title: Him666233/dsh-inline-diff#plugin
description: Inline diff cards for every edit, write and str_replace_editor call: old/new line numbers, character-level highlighting, 57-language detection with a red/green-safe syntax palette, a side-by-side viewer, Read-row line ranges, and a settings page for display style and highlighting.

title: HimA6652/dsh-client-ui-model-seat
description: Merges AprilCrystal/dsh-client-ui-gpt-helper and zszz3/dsh-model-provider-prefix — two composer model-seat plugins that cannot be installed together — into one control: a Provider / Model trigger opening a two-column card where hovering the provider column swaps the models without moving the card, a separate reasoning-effort trigger with a particle slider, and a search that spans every provider while the card keeps its size.

title: himeope/dsh-queue-first-enter
description: Pressing Enter with an empty composer steers the first queued message into the running turn while the agent is busy.

title: HimLeoing/dsh-progress
description: Code can Vibe, progress must be Visible. No guess, less stress. See progress you can assess. Make project progress visible with local algorithms, optional AI assistance, task checklists, and subagent tracking. View overall progress, subagent activity, current operations, and estimated time remaining in a draggable panel. Supports DeepSeek Harness Web and Desktop. Requires Harness ≥0.2.2-rc.1 and Node.js ≥24.9.0. Local estimates require no additional model requests. AI assistance is off by default; enabling it incurs charges from the selected model provider. Probe usage and estimated costs are available in the panel.

title: hiocobueno653-pixel/dsh-ui-polish
description: UI polish layer for the DSH web client: frosted-glass menu surfaces, a draggable reasoning-effort slider that replaces the level radio list, and model-menu navigation that reaches the model list in one click and closes on a single Esc.

title: hj9178/dsh-throwtomatoes-plugin
description: Turns the composer send button into a tomato button while a task is running and the draft is empty. One or two taps hand the model a hidden note on its next step asking it to reflect on the approach and to finish by asking the user how to continue; three taps within a second stop the run first and send the same kind of note. Thrown-tomato animations and sound can be switched off in settings, which also counts every tomato thrown.

title: hjj345/dsh-sm-context-piano
description: A Codex-style conversation navigator for the DeepSeek Harness Web GUI.

title: hl3207/dsh-movie
description: Adds a left-sidebar panel to the DSH Web GUI: one ranked board of the films and series released in the past 21 days or due within the next 31 days, taken from JustWatch for the US, five European countries, Japan and Korea and from Douban for China. Each row carries a poster (or a drawn placeholder when the poster CDN will not load), a synopsis of five sentences or fewer, Douban and Rotten Tomatoes ratings and popular Douban comments. A search box filters the board as you type and asks Douban, TVMaze and the iTunes storefront about a title, merging the three into one record and listing the matches already on the board separately. Synopses, comments and titles are translated through the host translator service, so the Chinese/English switch re-renders the board. No API key and no account.

title: hmr-BH/dsh-round-rightclick
description: Radial right-click menu on conversation turns in the DSH web GUI for forking a session from a chosen turn, interrupting generation, copying the working directory path or session ID, opening the working directory, and exporting session logs.

title: Hobartoakes/dsh-model-shelf
description: Replaces the chat model picker with a collapsible provider-grouped list (640x720 max) that shows each model name, provider name, provider ID and exact model ID, plus a manually managed uncommon list and a separate favorites list. Classification is user-driven only: no usage tracking and no auto-sorting. Search covers model name, model ID, provider name, provider ID and account notes.

title: Hocete/dsh-skill-card
description: Skill card gallery for DSH: every installed skill becomes a game-style card you can browse in four carousel modes, filter by category, source or tag, and edit — rarity, stars, five stats, tags and card art — while the card data lives in a side-car file, so SKILL.md is left untouched. Also creates and deletes skill folders.

title: hongcha-dsh/dsh-watchlist
description: Follow list above the sidebar conversation list: a status dot per conversation (unread, waiting for you, running, failed), newest reply first, running ones last, and a follow toggle beside the model selector. Marking a row unread lifts it to the top, opening one expands and scrolls to its row in the Workspace list below, a finished turn always counts as unread until the conversation is opened, and a conversation whose delegated subagents are still working keeps counting as running until the last child reports back.

title: HongMing-Huang/dsh-file-upload
description: Claude-style drag-and-drop/paperclip file upload with content sniffing, document-to-Markdown via Microsoft MarkItDown (built-in JS fallback), text inlining, and a read_document tool for agents.

title: hongshunanhai/dsh-subor-startup
description: Subor-style CRT boot animation for DeepSeek Harness: the tube powers on, the pixel logo drops in with a "DeepSeek, endless fun" voice line, then 108 classic FC game windows fill the screen along a snake-like inward spiral, ending in a white flash that fades into the app. Auto-plays, skippable, zero configuration.

title: hongxin/dsh-tvision
description: Turbo Vision-style character-cell window manager for dsh agents: overlapping framed windows with drop shadows, a Borland menu bar, a function-key strip, mouse drag and resize, approvals as modal dialogs, and five skins including the classic Borland blue.

title: honlnk/dsh-input-assist
description: Ghost-text completion for the composer: FIM suggestions stream in inline after a typing pause (SSE, first token rendered immediately), Tab accepts one word at a time and Shift+Tab takes all, in-flight requests are truly cancelled on retyping or Esc. Plus two-layer typo checking: a browser-local dictionary scan (Chinese wrong phrases, English misspellings and proper-noun capitalization, user-defined per-browser entries) with a debounced LLM context pass, underlined in red in the text with per-item navigation and click-to-fix.

title: Hope2023Dcr/dsh-gallery
description: Output gallery in the DSH sidebar, built to fix DSH reporting produced files only after a task ends: it watches your on-disk output folders and shows files as they appear, so you can verify and intervene mid-task instead of after. Auto-refreshing image thumbnails with zoom and pan, documents, code, data, archives and links that open in DSH native preview, per-conversation filtering, and multi-folder support for sessions whose cwd is outside the default output folder. Zero dependencies.

title: houdinicc/dsh-poster-studio
description: Left sidebar poster workshop with a live deepseek.com/harness fluid-shader background: edit an eyebrow, a two-line headline, subtitle, body copy and footer, switch between four ratios and four palettes, then export a PNG or a self-contained SVG. The official Montserrat font is embedded, so no network is needed.

title: houdinicc/dsh-raindrop
description: Read-only Raindrop.io dashboard in the sidebar with collection and tag distribution, top source domains, content types, a 12-month trend and a cleanup backlog, plus two read-only agent tools for analyzing saved bookmarks. Requires a Raindrop.io API token (create an app and paste the token).

title: houdinicc/dsh-todos
description: Todoist-style todo management in the sidebar with projects, labels and priorities, CJK-aware natural-language quick-add, repeat rules, a stats dashboard, import and export, seven agent tools and due-time reminders.

title: houyanchao/dsh-timeline
description: DSH productivity plugin: timeline navigation, prompt library, conversation export, quick notes, and more.

title: hoyyang/dsh-improve-prompt
description: One-click prompt improvement for the DSH composer: press the sparkle button to rewrite the draft into an agent-ready prompt, replaced in place and undoable, with a deterministic fidelity check that keeps every path, identifier, number, URL and backticked token verbatim, plus a length ceiling that blocks inflation.

title: HPNY/dsh-portfolio
description: A-share and OTC fund dashboard forked from SuCriss/dsh-leekbox (MIT): indices, market boards, limit-up sentiment thermometer, dragon-tiger list, full-market search, a watchlist with in-place position editing and price alerts, a stock detail window with K-line, money flow and F10, a signal screener, 7x24 news, AI stock analysis, and an OTC fund tab with NAV, estimated NAV and a fund detail window showing stage returns, a NAV chart and the disclosed top-10 holdings with live quotes. It keeps upstream's /api/leekbox/* routes and $DSH_HOME/.leekbox-*.json data files, so install it instead of SuCriss/dsh-leekbox rather than alongside it.

title: HQD2938/dsh-file-reveal
description: Click a file path in a DSH conversation to reveal it in the OS file manager; Alt+click opens it with the default app.

title: HsiangNianian/dsh-auto-continue
description: Auto-resumes interrupted DSH Web requests: sends a queued 「继续」 after network, timeout or host-crash failures, with error classification, adaptive backoff, templated continue text and browser notifications.

title: hsthanb4/dsh-magpie-usage
description: DeepSeek Harness (DSH) plugin: Embeds upstream quota and usage progress rings from your local Magpie gateway (127.0.0.1:3425) right beside the composer context meter, with session-aware active model tracking and 5-hour limit reset tooltips.

title: Htao-uu/dsh-mobile-shell
description: DeepSeek App-style mobile shell for the DSH Web UI with drawer navigation, app-like composer and settings; best paired with the dsh-android app, which supplies the native Android back key (standalone use works but is not recommended).

title: hu669293657/dsh-turn-tools
description: Adds deliverable-file buttons to the end of each agent turn (opens files with the OS default app) and a floating dot rail for jumping between conversation turns.

title: Hu9956/DSH-model-controls
description: Switch providers and models, adjust reasoning effort; each model remembers its own level.

title: hua-1111/dsh-logos-forge
description: Prompt forge for DeepSeek Harness: one draft becomes three parallel rewrites, read for intent first and scored blind by the model, with the sentences each version added highlighted — then bind one back into the composer.

title: huaguoxingkong/dsh-prompt-rewriter
description: Adds one button beside the composer that rewrites the draft into a more complete prompt in place, with no preview step, plus undo, a stop action, and optional conversation context.

title: huahuazz/DSH_question_map
description: Select text in a conversation to ask a context-free side question in a floating card, and browse every question as a network graph.

title: hualidan42-beep/dsh-plugin-task-radar
description: Monitor workspace sessions, subagents, todo progress and token usage in a floating panel.

title: huang-chunc/dsh-user-message-timeline
description: User Message Timeline - floating pill rail with hover preview, click/drag jump and pagination, switchable left/right.

title: huangfuren/dsh-conversation
description: Conversation outline panel for the DSH web surface: user questions as root nodes (index, time, tool count and text volume per turn) with the Markdown headings of assistant replies hanging beneath them, plus level slider, search scope, bookmarks, copy and export as Markdown, section jump, keyboard navigation, a right-edge density rail and per-session reading-position memory. Read-only UI: it never touches prompts, tool results or provider traffic, and writes nothing outside its own localStorage keys.

title: huanghai-lab/dsh-custom-instructions
description: Manage global AGENTS.md in DSH Web with Markdown preview, reusable templates, version history, import/export, failed-import rollback, and revision-conflict protection.

title: huanglianqi/dsh-math-render
description: Renders LaTeX in the chat — formulas inside your own message bubble, plus a live preview of the composer draft while you type.

title: huanglianqi/dsh-math-snippets
description: LaTeX snippet expansion in the composer, built from Obsidian LaTeX Suite's own defaults — 138 triggers expand as they are typed, Tab walks the tabstops, and the table of 142 is editable in one JSON file.

title: huangxp12/dsh-plugin-search
description: Search field on the DeepSeek Harness Plugins page that filters the installed and official plugin cards as you type, matching each card title, description and package name; space-separated keywords must all match.

title: huanleyabo/dsh-selection-translate
description: Select text in the DSH web client and a translate button appears at the end of the selection; clicking it translates that text in place. Translation goes through the host llm service, so it reuses the model the current session already has selected and needs no separate API key; an OpenAI-compatible endpoint can be configured instead. The result opens in a popover that stays inside the viewport, with one-click copy, a row of language buttons for instant retranslation, and smart Chinese-to-English / other-to-Chinese as the default. Configuration is stored host-side and its API key is never sent to the browser.

title: huaxiren6/DSH-QrPairing
description: Floating phone-pairing QR button for the DSH WebUI. One click opens the dsh-remote-link pairing QR (image + 6-digit code + TTL) in an in-app overlay — works in both browser and DSH Desktop (same-origin img, no iframe).

title: Hudson-Junior-Wang/dsh-search-switcher
description: One-click search-engine switcher beside the DeepSeek Harness model picker; changes the dsh-free-search provider, handy on overseas university networks that block the DeepSeek Official search endpoint.

title: hufeide/dsh-sidebar-assistant
description: A sidebar assistant plugin for the Web interface, allows users to select any text, displays the model’s reasoning process and final answer in a floating panel.

title: huhu23333/dsh-plugin-subagent-model-route
description: Annotates every subagent with the model route it actually ran on: a badge line in each parent-catalog row and a readout in a child session's own header.

title: huihuangdi/dsh-model-provider-badge
description: Shows the provider behind a session's current model as a compact badge in the DSH Web composer tool row, left of the model selector.

title: huiliyi37/dsh-tianshu-tui
description: A terminal UI (TUI) for DeepSeek Harness.

title: HUITianYi/dsh-whale-desktop-launcher
description: Windows desktop launcher for DSH with a whale-girl icon, background server startup, and a Chromium app-mode window without browser chrome.

title: hulibuld/dsh-lifecard#plugin
description: Local-first character archive in the DSH sidebar: it interviews you about someone and writes the answers into Markdown cards, imports SillyTavern character cards, writes a novel chapter by chapter, and roleplays with a card plus its world book; anything written into a card has to be quotable from material you wrote.

title: hulibuld/dsh-reading
description: Reads EPUB, MOBI, AZW3, TXT and PDF books in a side panel with pagination, table-of-contents jumping, highlights, notes, bookmarks, full-text search, anchored AI questions, per-chapter distillation, Legado-compatible book-source search that adds online books chapter by chapter, and a bundled reading-coach skill. PDF support is text-based only; scanned or encrypted PDFs are rejected.

title: hulibuld/dsh-refresh-restart
description: Adds two buttons beside the sidebar toggle at the top-left of the DSH desktop UI, on macOS, Windows and Linux. Reload refreshes only the UI layer while a turn already generating keeps running; restart asks for one confirmation, quits the whole app and reopens it with sessions and workspaces intact. Restart is a POST that must carry a random per-boot token read from the plugin's status route. The plugin makes no network calls, reads no session content and has zero runtime dependencies.

title: hulibuld/dsh-salary-flap
description: A split-flap salary board for the DSH Web UI. Enter monthly salary, hours per day, working days per month and a start time, and the board settles today's earnings every 2 seconds on eight flip cells (currency symbol, four integer digits, decimal point, two decimals). Shows 0.00 before the shift, caps at the daily wage after it, and handles shifts that cross midnight. Six color schemes, drag anywhere (the position is kept on this machine), and a close button that collapses the board into a pill in the session header. Pure client-side bundle: no network calls and no dependencies.

title: HumXC/dsh-nestquay
description: Workspace groups for the DSH sidebar with group navigation and session status indicators.

title: huningsong/dsh-todos-diy
description: Work todo reminders in a sidebar panel with four stage tabs (not started, in progress, overdue, done) plus separate recurring and paused filters, priority derived from the end time in real time, pinning that survives overdue, and enable/disable for recurring tasks. Recurrence covers workdays (following China's statutory holidays and make-up workdays), selected weekdays, monthly dates with month-end rollover, and 5-field cron; one-off tasks default to start and end reminders (start optional, end required); meetings can disable the end reminder. Alerts appear in a page overlay with optional browser notifications, snooze and quiet hours. Twelve agent tools; weekly/monthly reports, natural-language quick add, and cross-view search; data is a single local JSON file with completed tasks archived per quarter.

title: hunter118/dsh-s7r
description: A retro macOS System 7-style workstation UI for DeepSeek Harness with desktop windows, Workspace and Agent management, Finder, Terminal, Monitor, context tools, and desk accessories.

title: Huuuuung/dsh-artifact-index
description: The missing backend for the dsh-artifacts sidebar tab — serves the /report artifact index and the artifact bytes it renders.

title: huzhengcai471-crypto/dsh-startup-secret
description: Full-screen Changzhengji-themed boot animation for DSH with a six-step authorization sequence, seven built-in real-voice packs, two switchable emblems, five switchable character portraits, and an optional access-password gate.

title: HwFee/HwFee-dsh#genui
description: Generative UI: the model calls render_ui with a React snippet and the answer renders as an interactive card in the conversation. The snippet runs in a sandboxed iframe with an opaque origin, so it cannot read the host page, its storage or its cookies, and the frame CSP blocks the network; a message from a card is only sent after the user confirms it, and a failing card shows its error with the source behind a toggle.

title: HwFee/HwFee-dsh#predict
description: Next-prompt suggestions: after each answer it predicts your next message as grey ghost text in the composer. Tab fills it without sending, and the prediction model is selectable.

title: HwFee/HwFee-dsh#system-fonts
description: Separate font slots for content, code and terminal text, plus an interface font, an interface-size stepper and an inline-code size stepper, with line-height and letter-spacing controls. Typography only — it never touches colour.

title: hyperion2144/dsh-desktop-tauriapp
description: Tauri 2 desktop app for DeepSeek Harness (macOS + Windows; installers on the repository's Releases page) with a built-in dsh runtime: tray-resident launcher with per-profile ports and windows, a process guardian that auto-heals up to three times, local or remote dsh, task-completion notifications with a Dock badge, and a live startup console. This plugin is the app's in-page half — its desktop chrome and notification bridge only take effect when DSH runs inside the desktop app; added to a regular DSH with `dsh plugin add`, it provides the bundled skill for packaging a DSH Web GUI as a Tauri app.

title: hyrinx/dsh-plugin-open-with

title: hytime/dsh-client-ui-shortcuts

title: hyzyn/dsh-plugin-kit#kit-settings

Installing it alone shows an empty page; cards appear as slot-registering kit plugins are installed.

title: hyzyn/dsh-plugin-kit#tty
description: Terminal panel for the DSH Web GUI: a sidebar "Terminal" entry opens a multi-tab xterm.js interactive terminal over a real PTY (node-pty), with SSH remote tabs (ssh2, agent / key / password auth), a cwd following the current session, and tty_list / tty_capture / tty_send agent tools.

Greetings and small talk pass through untouched without calling the model.

title: I-WANNASLEEP/dsh-process-narration

title: Iambatman1928/dsh-lawagent-ui

title: Iambatman1928/dsh-lawkb-ui
description: Legal knowledge-base workbench: hybrid keyword/statistical/vector retrieval over local statute .doc/.docx corpora, faceted filtering, charge-name and civil-cause trees, a document editor, and four AI tools (citation check, contract review, AI analysis, AI drafting).

title: Iambatman1928/dsh-xingye
description: Chat agent for a DeepSeek Harness session: create characters and write their personas, keep several archive threads per character, undo or rewind the locally stored transcript, and record story beats in an event book.

title: Icather/dsh-clean-desktop-shell

Reuses your existing web profile, no restyling of the web UI. Windows + macOS.

title: ice5kysl/dsh-file-explorer-kit

Bilingual zh/en.

title: ice5kysl/dsh-workspace-kit

Bilingual zh/en.

title: IDKURLOVE/dsh-reset-button

Client-side only, no dependencies.

It takes over the composer model slot, so it cannot be enabled alongside dsh-effort-dial or reasoning-slider.

title: imcaibaicai/dsh-chat-spacing

title: Iwctwbh/dsh-flowglass

title: j62268781-alt/dsh-skills-mcp-manager

Each expanded card lists the tools that server actually registered, and a per-server allow/deny rule keeps only the ones you need — a blocked tool never enters the tool registry, so it costs no context on every turn. Every MCP card carries a connection status tag (connected with a tool count, retrying, gave up, activation failed) plus a one-click reconnect, so a server that fails at startup is visible instead of silently missing its tools. Imports existing configs from 26 other MCP clients.

Windows-verified, with macOS and Linux backends; no dependencies and no build step.

Requires DSH 0.2.x.

description: Mobile-first DeepSeek Harness UI with an installable PWA, responsive navigation, and Web Push notifications when an agent completes successfully.

title: jcx3915-pixel/dsh-subtopic

title: jediliu005/dsh-fairy-zzz-for-jediliu
description: Fairy III (Zenless Zone Zero) H.D.D skin for DeepSeek Harness: boot video, an eye-core dock that can be dragged vertically so it never covers text, and time-of-day greeting voices written by a model every day (5 lines, each <= 20 characters) and synthesized locally with GPT-SoVITS, with a fallback chain of today -> latest -> bundled audio so there is always something to hear. Replies can be spoken: a trailing marker line takes priority over length heuristics, and long replies can be compressed into one sentence first. The reader hashes the utterance it just played (MD5) so each reply is voiced exactly once, and switching sessions stays silent. Personal fork of dsh-fairy-zzz with its own package, route and storage namespace, plus a rate-limited summarize endpoint, POST-only engine control and bounded TTS and greeting caches. Two diagnostic logs (client revision, decision trace) are written next to the plugin and stay on the local machine. A personal fork of AssassinVIX/fairy-zzz-plugin (upstream package dsh-fairy-zzz): install this fork or the upstream, not both - both mount the full-screen skin on the same DSH surfaces. Dynamic greetings and spoken summaries need a DeepSeek-compatible API key in ~/.dsh/fairy-tts.json (or DEEPSEEK_API_KEY); without it only the bundled greeting audio plays.

description: Mobile-first Web UI quality-of-life pack for the DeepSeek Harness: a Chrome-style active-session tab bar, full-screen sidebar swipe open/close, overlay sidebar, collapsed-sidebar recents, keyboard-suppressing session switching, viewport/IME keyboard adaptation, touch feedback, code/table inner scrolling, hidden permission dropdown, a full-screen settings rewrite with tab memory, and a compositor-driven status pulse, no-touch-drag long-press protection — 14 features, each independently toggleable from the Settings QoL section with instant effect, persisted per browser in localStorage; pure client-side CSS/JS, mobile rules locked to viewports of 768px and below so desktop stays untouched.

title: john-walks-slow/dsh-zen
description: Zen Mode view tab and foreground time tracker for DeepSeek Harness: while the agent works, a calm conversation view shows running/done status, your latest user message, live activity hints and the final AI reply in markdown with one-line turn stats, plus screen-watching (focus) time tracking with daily/weekly Zen scores, a chat-hide toggle that hides tool calls and reasoning rows, auto enter/exit Zen on task start/complete, an Alt+Z shortcut and a Zen settings panel — pure client-side, stored in localStorage, no network.

title: johnnycls/dsh-no-setup-mode
description: No-setup mode for the DSH web UI: hides advanced surfaces, auto-applies best defaults (chat mode, full access, account balance), and one-click role-play personas (maid/butler).

title: JohnshyCY/dsh-multi-window
description: Windows desktop only (Windows 10/11, DSH desktop 0.2.1-rc.5 or newer; not available in `dsh web`). Open any DSH conversation in its own native window, so several conversations can be shown at once.

title: JosephHy/dsh-md-plus
description: Markdown display enhancements for the DSH Web chat, applied on top of the host renderer rather than replacing it: code blocks become cards with a language label and icon-only wrap and copy buttons, long code blocks, tables and Mermaid diagrams fold behind an expand control, Mermaid fences render as SVG with a diagram and code toggle, a fullscreen viewer with wheel zoom, drag and double-click to fit, and SVG or PNG export, tables get a sticky header and CSV or Markdown copy buttons, and a settings panel adjusts the diagram palette, code font size, the default diagram view and the three fold thresholds.

title: joshua05100413-cmd/dsh-AcidCore-plugins#dsh-composer-meter
description: Composer meter for the DeepSeek Harness Web UI: a pill under the input shows draft character count, estimated tokens and this session's estimated cost from DeepSeek's published prices (peak/off-peak, Flash/Pro or custom rates), and opens a panel with the token breakdown, a six-snapshot per-session draft vault and a draft cleaner; every write goes through the host setDraft API instead of touching the editor DOM.

title: Js2Hou/dsh-mcp-manager
description: Visual MCP manager for the DSH web UI: inspect, add, remove, enable/disable MCP servers and view their live connection status from Settings → MCP.

title: jsdvjx/dsh-strata
description: Session minimap in the scrollbar gutter: to-scale bands coloured by event kind, anchor dots for user messages and failures, auto-loading history at the top, a hover wall of every prompt in the session, and a three-step map scale switcher.

title: jue5hen/dsh-window-size
description: Set the startup window size of DeepSeek Harness Desktop from a settings page, with 4:3, 16:9 and 16:10 presets and up to 12 custom presets.

title: juliankang4/dsh-locale-ko
description: Adds Korean (한국어) as a native option in Settings - General - Language and translates all 2,775 Web UI strings of dsh 0.2.0-rc.2 and 0.2.1-alpha.2, experimental features included. Works in dsh web and the desktop app.

title: juliankang4/dsh-ui-scale
description: Scales the whole DeepSeek Harness interface from 50% to 200%, menus and pop-ups included, set from Settings - General with a slider, a percent field or presets. Works in dsh web and the desktop app, which has no zoom of its own.

title: JungleYXu/dsh-minichat
description: A floating quick-ask panel that answers without touching the conversation: a 10-turn scratch window, question-and-answer favourites that do not take up a turn, the conclusion dropped into the composer on request, and an empty window on every restart.

title: JupiterWalker/dsh-section
description: Cross-project session grouping for the DSH sidebar: define named sections, assign sessions from any project into them, then collapse, rename, archive or move a whole project in one action; a toggle in the Sections panel swaps the host session browser for the section tree and restores it on demand, and each row flags live work — its own turn, a subagent it delegated to, or a background job still going — or a completion you have not looked at yet.

title: Justin-Mai/dsh-stock-view
description: A collapsible, draggable popup in the top-right corner of the DSH web interface for watching A-shares, ETFs, Hong Kong and US stocks and OKX spot crypto side by side: real-time quotes, intraday and daily/weekly/monthly candlestick charts with moving averages, buy/sell target prices, group switching with drag-to-reorder, rename and delete, cross-market search, and light/dark themes. A fork of Awu12277/dsh-stock-watch that adds US quotes via Eastmoney and crypto via OKX.

title: JuYueYe/dsh-personal-model-picker
description: Switch providers from the left column and choose a model from the right; hover, focus or click a provider to update the model list.

title: jxhsjxhs/dsh-coin-ticker
description: A crypto ticker card in the DeepSeek-Harness sidebar footer, above the balance and Settings, showing BTC, ETH and SOL prices, 24-hour change and 24-point sparklines, sourced from OKX with automatic fallback to Binance then CoinGecko (CoinGecko has no sparkline history); clicking the header folds the whole card into a single small button, and the folded state is remembered. A fork of 18569663yz-web/dsh-plugin-crypto-ticker: do not install both.

title: jy007/dsh-calendar-board
description: Month calendar panel in the DSH main column: add and edit a day's entries inline, overlay the Host's scheduled reminders for today and tomorrow coloured by run state, and merge iCalendar subscriptions with the calendars already synced into this Mac's Calendar.app; a calendar_board tool exposes the same entries to any agent session.

title: k-ying/dsh-vsceditor
description: Embeds a real VSCode editor (code-server, or your local desktop VS Code via the bundled bridge extension) as a GUI tab: agent file edits open turn-scoped red/green diffs that survive tab closes and page reloads, files lock while the agent writes, and a watchdog supervisor keeps zero orphan processes.

title: k623615746/dsh-chat-split
description: Splits the conversation area into up to four panes inside a sidebar panel: drag a session from the sidebar onto the conversation and it opens as a new pane, drag one pane header onto another to swap them, fill a single pane across the whole area, and keep the host title bar, view tabs and sidebar untouched by portalling the grid into the conversation body; every pane carries its own index, workspace and title header, and the pane-count controls (+ / - / x) sit in the host tab row.

title: k623615746/dsh-sysload
description: CPU, GPU and memory load in the DeepSeek Harness Session header: three compact cells with a percentage and a 2 px bar, coloured at 75 % and 90 %; CPU from os.cpus() deltas, GPU from nvidia-smi (Windows counter fallback).

title: Kadima-code/dsh-subagent-fold
description: Folds the built-in subagent dropdown into History / Today / Previous / Current groups by usage batch, keeping the current batch expanded; the original header is left untouched.

title: Kadima-code/dsh-subagent-toolkit
description: Subagent Toolkit: folds the built-in subagent dropdown into History / Today / Previous / Current groups by usage batch, adds per-row and whole-group deletion of subagent sessions, and keeps the subagent model allowlist live per delegation. The original header is left untouched.

title: kahomesl/dsh-chat-diff-summary-legacy
description: A per-turn change bar above the composer showing which files the turn changed and the line deltas, for DeepSeek Harness 0.1.5-rc.1 through 0.1.7.

title: Kaiji-Z/dsh-plugin-lookatstudy
description: A study tab with course-map, tutor and blackboard columns that turns markdown files, local folders or GitHub repos into guided courses, with lesson unlocking, mastery tracking, spaced repetition and a tutor-designed course import.

title: kaijia323/dsh-mobile-ui
description: Mobile web shell for DSH Web with drawer navigation, touch-sized controls, safe areas and a full-width conversation; the desktop layout stays unchanged.

title: kandsome1/dsh-image-blur
description: Blurs every image in the conversation body until you click the Show button in its corner, leaving side panels, plugin pages and icons untouched.

title: kang7897/dsh-account-glance
description: Compact card above the sidebar account avatar showing the signed-in DeepSeek account balance, the current peak or off-peak billing window with a countdown to the next switch, and the rate of both windows. The window is computed locally in Beijing time without a network request; the balance refreshes every 60 seconds and on window focus or visibility. zh/en copy, no runtime dependencies.

title: kankezhiyan/dsh-awesome-fonts
description: Font switcher for DeepSeek Harness Web GUI: 99 UI fonts + 31 code fonts with CJK-Latin pairing.

title: KannaKuron/dsh-better-workspace
description: Hierarchical workspace tree for the DSH sidebar: every slash in a workspace title becomes a virtual folder (arbitrarily deep), the add-workspace directory flow gains a parent-group popup, renames re-derive the tree instantly, sessions nest on the same rule with separate visual styling, and every row carries right-click actions plus per-row appearance customization (color, text-only glow, font weight, primitives-family icon).

title: kanpengfei/dsh-prompt-sortable
description: Fork of FeatherHunter/dsh-prompt with draggable custom template ordering — drag the handle in Settings to reorder custom prompts (saved to the host); preset ordering unchanged. Do not install alongside upstream dsh-prompt: both register the same UI and /_dsh/dsh-prompt/ route.

title: KDDKBD/DeepSeek-splash-animation
description: Plays a video while DSH opens, then dissolves over 0.3 seconds once it has played out. Ships with a default video so it works on install, and the path can be changed or cleared from the plugin settings page.

title: kelearns/dsh-navigation-bar
description: Piano-key in-conversation navigation for the Web UI: one key per user message with hover ladder, message-preview tooltip, and active-message highlight; click to smooth-scroll.

title: kenz1117/dsh-ui-rainbowspeak
description: RainbowSpeak — a flowing rainbow marquee border around the chat composer card, driven by a conic-gradient ring. Live settings for speed, width, seven color schemes, direction, sides and breathing, plus session-state awareness that reacts to running, attention, error and celebration moments.

title: KevinZhangNothing/dsh-task-graph
description: Adds a Graph tab that renders one session's execution as an interactive DAG of turns, LLM steps, tools, skills, subagents, code changes and tests, with live status, retry aggregation, critical path and trajectory linkage.

title: keyboard-leo/dsh-reading-workbench
description: Reading workbench for DSH: a cover-grid bookshelf and a paginated single/double-page reader for Markdown, TXT, HTML, EPUB, MOBI and PDF, with highlight notes anchored to text offsets and three agent tools for listing books, reading highlights and pulling text excerpts.

title: kfat77/dsh-stock-ticker
description: Adds a ticker strip above the DeepSeek Harness interface that scrolls right to left, with a customizable watchlist of CN, HK and US stocks and indices, a configurable refresh interval and alert threshold, and a click-through quote card.

title: kfirsch/dsh-hebrew-rtl
description: Hebrew RTL rendering for the web GUI: any line with Hebrew reads right-to-left (messages, GenUI, question cards, the composer and input fields), and RTL-aware Cmd+Left/Right line navigation.

title: kgwdonkey/dsh-header-controls
description: Restart / exit power buttons in the conversation header.

title: kialajin-l/DSH_Plus#dsh-quote-selection
