description: Floating toolbar on text selection in conversations: add the quote to the composer, start a new discussion from it, or copy it; quotes collapse into a card aligned to the composer and double-clicking jumps back to the quoted turn.

title: kiefeng/dsh-avatar-top
description: Moves the sidebar account avatar out of the bottom strip with four placements, including a zero-height inline mode in the brand row, and three heights down to an avatar-only row, with adjustable spacing and a settings card on the Plugins page, while other plugins' footer widgets stay pinned at the bottom.

title: kimaky/dsh-copy-as
description: Copy an assistant message as Markdown, plain text, rich text for Word, TSV, LaTeX or a JSON block tree, from a per-message button or the chat context menu.

title: kingofpowers/dsh-chat-ctxmenu
description: Right-click menu for DeepSeek Harness conversation content: copy the selection or the whole message, copy message images and the preview lightbox to the clipboard as PNG (or save them), open file paths (absolute, relative to the session working directory, or ~/), reveal them in the file manager, open them with another registered application, and copy paths or links. Every candidate path is verified by the Host filesystem before an open action appears.

title: Kirkice/dsh-plugin-makima-tui
description: A terminal workbench for dsh with streaming chat, tool execution, session management, provider management, and image input.

title: kissear/dsh-splash-screen-haavk
description: Full-screen HAAVK-themed boot animation for DSH, rewritten from dsh-startup-secret 1.5.2 (which is listed separately): an intro video, a cold-blue console board and a five-step access sequence with recorded voice lines and a looping background track. Text and two accent colours are editable in DSH settings, and the intro video and BGM can be switched there; replacement media files go into lib/assets. Install it instead of dsh-startup-secret, not alongside it — the two share ~/.dsh/dsh-startup.json and the same settings section.

title: kk112222/dsh-chat-index
description: Per-session question index for the DSH Web UI: a time-proportional dot rail on the right edge and an expandable chain panel showing every user question with its time, including branch/subagent sessions; clicking a node jumps to that message and highlights it.

title: kkbsgg/dsh-balance
description: Shows the selected model provider's account balance next to the composer's model seat once a model and reasoning effort are selected.

title: kkhsu/dsh-conversation-icons
description: Assign per-session duotone SVG icons and colors from the sidebar menu or a model tool, with browser-local persistence and cross-tab updates.

title: kkisok0123/dsh-sidechat
description: Side conversations forked from the main session, with native conversation rendering, selection annotations and handback.

title: klaus-2/dsh-nextsteps
description: Suggested next-step prompts under every finished agent turn in the DeepSeek Harness chat: the model proposes a few followup prompts at the end of each turn, they render as clickable cards under that turn, and clicking one sends it verbatim as your next message. Each card stays attached to the turn that produced it across reloads and restarts, the generation language can be chosen from 15 languages or follow the conversation, and a settings page in the dsh settings covers the language, how many suggestions per turn, the header and the in-app update check. Requires DeepSeek Harness 0.2.x (web profile) and Node.js 20+.

title: KNGLOKIKO/dsh-plugin-approval-zh
description: Localizes the DeepSeek Harness approval panel in the web client and translates authorization reasons from English to Chinese, with a built-in phrase dictionary first and a model-router fallback for reasons the dictionary does not cover.

title: Knight-Zjy/dsh-workspace-categories
description: Category tree for the DSH sidebar workspace browser: workspaces and their sessions nest under user-made categories (collapsed state remembered), rows drag between categories, a new workspace can be created straight into one through the directory picker, categories rename and delete in place, sessions archive and unarchive from their own row (the built-in browser's stop-active-work confirmation included) alongside a hide / show / only-archived filter, row buttons carry the app's own hover tooltips, and a footer toggle switches the panel back to the built-in list.

title: kongbai-shike/dsh-novel-wallpaper
description: Renders a TXT novel as a dim text layer behind the DSH chat, with a draggable controller for table of contents, chapter paging, auto-scroll and reading settings.

title: kongbaiming5/dsh-pet-button
description: macOS arm64 only; requires dsh-pet installed (the bundled binary is a closed prebuilt). Desktop switch for the dsh-pet pet: one click to show or hide it, and it can start DeepSeek Harness when that is closed.

title: kongdexu/dsh-nav-pointer
description: Vertical message pointer rail on the left edge of the chat: one dash per user message, click to scroll to that message, hover for a preview bubble.

title: kongkongya367-glitch/dsh-bingo-ren
description: Adds a draggable restart button and a plugin panel to the DeepSeek Harness desktop app: it prompts when the profile plugin list changes, records additions and removals per profile, tracks trials, reports host startup state, and offers rollback, minimal boot and recoverable cleanup.

title: konglong87/dsh-input-list
description: DSH prompt library and reusable snippets plugin: save, edit, delete, and append prompt templates, workflow instructions, and reusable text from a button beside the composer without sending.

title: konnga/dsh-hud
description: Read-only Git panel for the current workspace — branch, changed files, diffs and image before/after compare — plus three capsules above the composer (Git status, tool and skill activity, session running time) and per-session change attribution with review progress.

title: KorionCN/dsh-d2-diagrams
description: Previews D2 diagrams in the DSH sidebar using the local D2 CLI, with live rendering, source editing, zoom, and chart, code, or split views.

title: kouyichi/dsh-tui-app
description: Interactive terminal chat app for dsh: streaming conversation, tool cards, jobs panel, full-text search, trajectory replay, multi-session tabs, and A2A dispatch (Ink-based).

title: KouzakiUmi/dsh-code-pill
description: Renders inline code in DSH chat as pills with syntax colours and optional file badges, styles chat file paths, and offers optional folded-row tinting and thinking-text ink, with a settings page for six presets, colours and fonts.

title: kouzerror/dsh-retry
description: Adds a native Restart DeepSeek Harness item to the Windows system tray menu and the account menu of the DSH desktop app: the plugin prepares a patched resources/app.asar at startup, a detached helper backs up the original and swaps it in after a normal exit, the patch is re-applied after each desktop update, and either item relaunches the app gracefully on the next launch. Windows desktop only; other hosts report 409 not_desktop.

title: Kseleven/dsh-pomodoro-timer
description: A pomodoro timer docked below the composer in DeepSeek Harness, with focus/short/long cycles, a resumable countdown, chime, optional system notifications and bilingual settings.

title: kuanfu0430/dsh-sidebar-branch-chat
description: Adds a Branch Chat tab to dsh-better-sidebar that opens independent archived sessions with a head/middle/tail context digest and the same tools as the main agent.

title: KukaNo996/dsh-prompt-optimization
description: Composer prompt refinement for DSH: rewrites a rough draft into a structured, unambiguous prompt with one-click undo, reference-chip protection, three model sources (composer / account / any OpenAI-compatible endpoint) and disconnect-aware cancellation.

title: KungerChen/dsh-next-message-predictor
description: Predicts your next message after each completed turn and shows it as grey ghost text in the empty composer: Tab or → fills it in without sending, Esc hides it, and a rebindable shortcut (Alt+\ by default) predicts on demand or steps through several candidates. Off until enabled in its settings page, which has three one-click modes (balanced, saver, quality), an optional left-sidebar entry, daily request and token limits, masking of keys, tokens and e-mail addresses before sending, and a 7-day usage summary; short messages repeated in the session and a list of pinned phrases come after the model suggestion when stepping through candidates, without a model call, and the interface is available in nine languages.

title: KunKun24/dsh-enter-newline
description: Enter inserts a newline instead of sending in the DeepSeek Harness composer.

title: kw12121212/writing-anything#dsh-writing-viewer
description: Read-only writing-workspace panel for projects that contain a .writing-anything/ workspace: per-work overview cards, a unit tree, YAML artifact views as semantic cards or highlighted source, the source list and the decision/review queues, and in-panel unit review whose feedback is written back by wa-cli.

title: kw78/academic-agent#academic-dsh-ui
description: DSH sidebar and panel for courses, tasks, plans, connections, course materials, automation and settings.

title: kyanray-dev/dsh-markdown-input
description: Markdown input for the composer that keeps the typed Markdown as the sent text while drawing bullets and checkboxes, styling bold, italic, inline code, strikethrough, headings, quotes and fenced code blocks, continuing lists on Shift+Enter, and wrapping selections with Cmd/Ctrl+B, I and E.

title: KylinQ01/dsh-startup-animation
description: Startup splash for DeepSeek Harness: an animated avatar with aurora, stardust, pointer parallax and a module-assembly entrance, plus the same image as the main-UI wallpaper; both images can be swapped from a settings page that previews the animation live.

title: kyoukisu/dsh-rich-ui
description: ChatGPT-style rich answers inside DeepSeek Harness: entity panels, KPI cards, series charts, sortable tables, nested layers, flow diagrams and local controls.

title: kyrsieger/dsh-up-session
description: Adds cross-workspace pinned and recent session sections to the DSH sidebar, with status indicators and display settings.

title: l541402398/dsh-file-uploads
description: Upload arbitrary local files from the Web composer, show pending cards, and manage stored files in Settings.

title: Lacquervii/smooth-cursor
description: Smooth comet-mode animated caret for the DSH Web composer: a glowing comet trail replaces the native blinking caret and glides across the input as you type, with configurable accent color, thickness, and trail, IME-aware for CJK input.

title: lakabuji-arch/dsh-model-accordion
description: Provider-folded model selector for the DSH Web composer with catalog-driven reasoning effort choices.

title: lalalaleo/dsh-draft
description: A Markdown-based draft-board plugin for dsh: live-preview editing and local persistence.

title: lamp23333/dsh-balance-simple
description: A simple, information-dense DeepSeek status display for the DSH sidebar: balance, usage, and peak/off-peak countdown. Requires the DSH Web GUI with a signed-in DeepSeek account.

title: Lancang-hzau/dsh-live-terminal
description: Visible terminal panel that streams the agent's shell commands into an in-app terminal and lets the agent capture the terminal screen as text.

title: LanFeng97/dsh-workspace-create-dialog
description: Codex-style Create Workspace dialog: name it and the folder is created for you, or pick one with a native chooser that remembers where you were (the native chooser is Windows-only; elsewhere use the name field).

title: langyo/dsh-mobile-upgrade
description: Requires DSH 0.1.5-rc.1. Mobile UI fixes for the dsh web profile: narrow-screen drawer and settings tabs, a full-width model menu, a stuck-request network chip, and a narrow-header collector that folds the lineage, subagent and background-job chips into one tappable sheet.

title: LaoganR/dsh-novel-reader
description: Local TXT novel reader in the DSH right sidebar: bookshelf with file, directory and path import, chapter table of contents with jump, click-to-turn or vertical-scroll paging, reading progress restored across restarts, and font, line-spacing, background and night themes.

title: laoye666-6/dsh-plugin-media-wallpaper
description: Image and video wallpapers for the DSH web workspace: auto-detected GIF/APNG/animated WebP/PNG/JPEG/MP4/WebM backgrounds with blur, brightness and dimming, tint-following UI, per-component transparency, and one-click preset wallpapers.

title: Laplace-bit/dsh-smooth-stream
description: Fluid streaming rendering and smooth scrolling for the DeepSeek Harness Web UI.

title: Larliers/dsh-skill-prompt-injector
description: Adds a right-sidebar panel that lists the skills available to the current session, searches and tags them, combines them with your own saved prompts, appends the selection to the composer in one click, and can pin skills and prompts as always-on context injected through the system prompt.

title: Larrtroffen/dsh-workspace-folders
description: Folder organization for the DeepSeek Harness sidebar: display-only Workspace folders (drag a Workspace onto a folder block to file it, nest and re-order folders, collapse with counts), durable per-Workspace nested Session folders, per-row icons chosen from 40 host icons or 48 emoji, and a Workspace-level "archive all sessions" cleanup. A fork of WSNMM3/dsh-session-keeper (MIT, itself derived from ht719/dsh-session-categories); it replaces the sidebar.workspaces region, so do not install it alongside the upstream plugins.

title: laughmaker/dsh-enhance
description: DeepSeek Harness UI polish: one Markdown style across every renderer, select-text annotations with numbered pins, a sidebar that drags down to 214px and remembers its width, a first launch that fills the screen, sidebar panel and plugin icons collected into one top row of five, and a colour-cycling marker for running sessions.

title: lavapapa/dsh-composer-layout
description: Web Composer placement for long prompts: keep it at the bottom or dock it in a resizable right column beside a long answer.

title: LCQ-1024/dsh-prompt-enhancer
description: Adds a prompt-enhancement button to the DSH composer that rewrites drafts into agent-ready prompts.

title: lcthe/dsh-skills-hub
description: DSH Skill Manager: browse, enable/disable, import from Codex/Claude Code/ZCode/WorkBuddy/QCoderWork, auto-discover skills with symlink support.

title: lcthe/dsh-timeline-rail
description: Message timeline rail for DeepSeek Harness web chat: evenly spaced ticks for each user message on the right edge, click to jump, hover to preview.

title: lczment/dsh-window
description: Window close behaviour for DeepSeek Harness Desktop — ask, minimise to tray, or quit, with a remembered choice editable in Settings, plus per-session and per-workspace child windows. Windows only: requires DSH Desktop 0.2.1-rc.5+ and a PowerShell installer that patches the app shell (resources/app); re-run it after every DSH upgrade, otherwise closing keeps DSH default behaviour.

title: Ledas-as/dsh-claude-video-slider
description: Unofficial Claude UI-inspired model and reasoning-effort selector using the current model's available levels, with animated purple pixel effects.

title: lee259/dsh-workbench
description: A right-side file workspace for DeepSeek Harness Web with source previews, captured DSH diffs, tabs, and a workspace tree.

title: LeemanCheung/dsh-whale-animation
description: A 60-frame theme-aware monochrome whale-dive animation with reactive water for the DSH Web turn status: embedded assets, seamless closed-loop playback, a reduced-motion PNG fallback, and lifecycle-clean removal.

title: LeeScenic/dsh-sidebar-sections
description: Collapsible section headers for the DSH sidebar: fold the functions list, the workspace list and the footer status area behind labelled header rows; sections are identified by position so cards the host or other plugins append to the footer join the status section automatically, and the account row stays pinned to the bottom (client-only DOM enhancement, no host patch).

title: leexiaode4/dsh-launch-buttons
description: Multiple named launch targets in the DSH composer: left-click starts the default target, right-click opens the list.

title: left0ver/dsh-file-review
description: Review agent file changes in a Diff panel, add comments for follow-up edits, and undo edited or newly created files.

title: lemon0-00/dsh-file-menu
description: Adds a right-click context menu to delivered file cards, the changed-files card, inline file references and http(s) links in DSH chat. Actions are open with the default app, open with the system chooser, reveal in the file manager, copy the file itself, copy its path, save a copy to a chosen folder, download, and open a link in the browser. Delivery cards are addressed by Session coordinates the Host re-derives from the session log; inline references and the changed-files card are addressed by an absolute path the Host re-verifies.

title: lemonorangeapple/dsh-effort-switcher
description: A Codex-like effort switcher for Deepseek Harness.

title: Leni-More/dsh-market-watching
description: A market card pinned to the DSH sidebar: live price and 24-hour change for crypto pairs, A-share / Hong Kong / US stocks and world indices, FX majors and London spot gold and silver. An optional long or short cost basis plus a position size turn the change column into a P&L percentage and a cash amount; symbols, order and refresh interval are chosen in DSH settings. No login and no API key. Quotes come from public endpoints of Gate.io, Eastmoney and Sina, and the symbols you choose are sent to them on every refresh.

title: lenrendre/dsh-screenshot-native
description: WeChat-style screenshot: freeze the desktop, drag a region or click a window, and the crop lands in the composer. A Windows-only fork of Durandalw/dsh-plugin-screenshot; do not install it alongside the upstream plugin.

title: leogottadothebest/dsh-settings-beautify
description: Normalize the DSH settings UI onto one design language: unified typography, cards, controls, focus and motion across every settings page, including pages contributed by other plugins.

title: lerwa2025-a11y/dsh-plugin-groups
description: Adds a My Groups tab to the DSH Installed plugins page: custom groups with drag reordering, colored text tags, Chinese notes, group locking, real enable switches, and two preset snapshot slots.

title: Lessthinker66/dsh-open-native
description: Click a delivered-file card to open the file with the system default application instead of DSH's built-in sidebar preview; hold Shift to keep the original preview.

title: levodoubt/dsh-longtext-input
description: Adds a Long text button to the composer tool row: write or paste the body in an editor overlay, and on save it is written to <workspace>/.dsh-longtext/<timestamp>_<title>.md and an @ path reference to that file is appended to the composer, leaving the conversation free of the long text itself.

title: lewisyoung0914/dsh-better-todo
description: Floating todo panel in the DSH Web UI — a draggable window that snaps to any screen edge, today/more grouping in the home tab, a separate all-items tab with uncompleted/completed filters and incremental loading, items that open read-only with an edit toggle in the corner, image attachments that zoom in place and other files that download, a pomodoro timer (15/30/45/60 or custom, with configurable rounds and break interval) that sends a Windows notification and waits for confirmation before the next phase, and five agent tools plus a /todo slash command for reading and editing the list.

title: lg320531124/dsh-declutter-ui
description: Three client-only fixes for the web UI: unfolds the session list past its 5-row fold, collapses long tool-call runs behind one toggle, and restores the mobile sidebar drawer above its own mask.

title: LHF198/dsh-prompt-optimizer
description: Improve the current chat draft before sending with a confirm-before-apply comparison.

title: lhuans/dsh-genui
description: Renders OpenTiny GenUI charts, forms, calculators and mini apps inline in DSH replies via schemaJson fences, with user actions flowing back into the conversation.

title: Li-Mingshuang/dsh-audio-control
description: Floating audio control panel in the Web GUI: play/pause/next/previous for Windows media sessions (SMTC) and the system master volume/mute, served by a Node route half that runs a PowerShell helper.

title: LiangshouX/dsh-ide-workbench#workbench
description: JetBrains-style IDE workbench in the DSH sidebar: Project file tree, Commit panel, Git history with a swimlane graph, a real PTY terminal and an embedded editor with Markdown preview and Find in Files, plus chat file links and send-to-chat references. Code intelligence is a separate plugin, dsh-ide-codeintel.

title: liangzz1998/dsh-workspace-session-drag
description: Moves a session from one workspace to another by dragging it in the sidebar: a confirmation dialog first, subagent sessions travel with the parent, the list auto-scrolls at its edges, and an open idle session takes the move immediately through a registry refresh; moving into or out of the ungrouped group works both ways.

title: liaoangbo-droid/dsh-notewall
description: Sticky notes wall in the sidebar: rich text, images, ink, drag-to-reorder, per-note alarms, and scheduled delivery of a note into a session. Its read-only /state and /media routes have no authentication.

title: liaohongrao/dsh-session-dates
description: Groups the sessions of every workspace in the DSH sidebar by day, with explicit date labels, a live running indicator and date-based search.

title: liaoyuqing/dsh-shutdown-idle
description: Runs a chosen power action (shutdown / restart / hibernate / sleep / lock / logoff) once every Agent session and background job has gone idle: the plugin samples in-process sessions once per second, counts running sessions as always busy, checks running background jobs through a configurable option (considerJobs, on by default, shown with its live count in Settings), waits a confirm window and then a cancellable countdown, and shows a draggable bottom-right card with the current phase and remaining seconds; the enable toggle never survives a host restart, any newly started session or Cancel aborts the countdown, and if the agents service is unavailable the machine is treated as busy so nothing ever fires. Windows only (the built-in shutdown / rundll32 actions); every action except none degrades to none elsewhere.

title: lidongbei/dsh-session-view
description: Session-first DSH sidebar: pinned, active and recent sections, workspace grouping, focus groups, search and a session trash bin.

title: liggest/dsh-alt-enter-newline
description: Adds Alt+Enter as a newline to the DeepSeek Harness (dsh) web composer.

title: LighghtEeloo/dsh-next-actions
description: Adds up to 3 clickable next-action chips under a reply; clicking one fills the input draft and never sends.

title: light-cheng/DSH-Translate
description: Bilingual reasoning, selection translation, composer polish, an offline English–Chinese dictionary with IPA, pronunciation and a vocabulary notebook for DeepSeek Harness. Instant selection translation is on by default and, on the cloud engine, sends the selected text to the model; pronunciation audio is fetched from Youdao when clicked or hovered; the bundled dictionary data (ECDICT and ipa-dict) is GPL-3.0.

title: Light-EI/dsh-chat-perf-css
description: A long conversation that renders many LaTeX formulas at once can become laggy, because the browser keeps styling, laying out and painting content that is off screen. This plugin applies content-visibility: auto to the off-screen message bodies, so that work is skipped and the lag is reduced.

title: liguobao/dsh-file-viewer
description: Read-only Web client file-preview panel with image, PDF, CSV/TSV, text, source-code, Markdown, JSON and YAML renderers, large-file range loading, and a provider API for non-local content.

title: lihang-lh/dsh-moon-light
description: A marquee mood-light ring around the DSH web UI edge that reacts to session state, turning green while the agent works, pink when done, and yellow when something needs attention, with colors, ring width, rotation speed, and flash frequency configurable from the settings panel.

title: lihang-lh/dsh-task-panel
description: Task panel for the DSH Web sidebar: publish tasks, auto-distill related sessions, and drive plan/develop/review stages with subagents plus in-panel acceptance.

title: lihengxi20/dsh-session-tabs
description: Adds a session tab bar under the DSH conversation header: open sessions appear in order with workspace/title labels and status dots; click to switch, use the hover × or the right-click menu to close, rename, close others or close all; the tab list persists in localStorage. Plugin only; it does not change DSH core or stop background work.

title: LihiHe/dsh-thinking-slider
description: Turns the composer's reasoning-effort menu into a draggable slider and takes over the stock model-and-reasoning-level chip. Dragging follows the pointer continuously; releasing snaps to the nearest level and submits one session update per drag. The track draws its own fill, tick marks and white knob, only the highest levels (xhigh, max, ultra) get a flowing brand-colour gradient, and both ends carry the lowest and highest level names. The same card expands into the official model list. Arrow keys step one level, PageUp and PageDown two, Home and End jump to the ends, and each move submits. A generation counter on the directory object discards late responses, and reduced-motion turns the animations off. All data comes from the stock modelDirectories directory; no new capabilities are added.

title: lihongxu0221/dsh-workspace-browser
description: Replaces the shipped sidebar workspace browser with Recents, a project editor that adds extra source folders, and pin, rename, fork, and archive row actions.

title: lijianbin2/dsh-subtitle-remover
description: Sidebar page that removes burned-in subtitles from a video with a local video-subtitle-remover checkout: frame preview with a start/end range, drag-drawn regions (up to six), automatic region detection reviewed by a DSH chat model, live before/after comparison, and open-file/open-folder on the result. Requires the video-subtitle-remover checkout with its models and a Python environment with torch, paddle and OpenCV.

title: lijinhao315/dsh-question-index
description: Question index: an ordered, collapsible list of your asked questions floating on the right side of the conversation; click a question to jump the session to that point. Auto-indexes each session's full history on open, persists it locally, and jumps to older questions by growing the window on demand.

title: likaileave/dsh-direct-open
description: Open delivered files, changed-file rows and inline file mentions in the system default app with a left click; right-click takeover is configurable: all menus, only where DSH has none, or never. Desktop app only: the Web client has no system-open capability, so clicks stay with DSH.

title: liliuCourier/dsh-chat-outline
description: Persistent conversation outline: per-turn questions and final replies, keyword filter, one-click jump, light/full history modes, and Ctrl/Shift+click to open the same position in the Trajectory view.

title: lim1202/dsh-agent-theater
description: A conversation view beside Chat and Trajectory that turns a DSH session into a character stage, with Codex Pet sprites, comic bubbles and a completion report listing the files and attachments the turn produced.

title: lima1217/dsh-bookshelf
description: Personal reading log panel: track books as want to read, reading or finished with dates, page progress, ratings, tags, notes and excerpts; yearly reading stats; covers looked up from Apple Books, Google Books and Open Library; Goodreads and Douban CSV import and CSV export; and five agent tools: bookshelf_list, bookshelf_stats, bookshelf_add, bookshelf_update and bookshelf_add_excerpt.

title: Limitinfinitude/DSH-Right-Sidebar
description: DSH Web right-side output dock: session-scoped tabs for reports, images, data, video, and audio, with inline previews, output quality checks, and a searchable per-turn history.

title: Lin-AxiomSight/dsh-zh-layer
description: A bilingual overlay layer for DSH: it overlays Chinese names and functional descriptions for plugins, commands and skills, supports three display modes and manually-triggered AI translation, and does not modify a single line of DSH source code.

title: linandadada-pixel/dsh-screenshot
description: Native, instant region-screenshot button for the DeepSeek Harness composer: one click freezes the screen, a WeChat-style overlay (gray mask, green selection) appears, and the cropped PNG is inserted into the current draft. An optional eye toggle hides the whole DSH window before capturing, then restores it. No ms-screenclip, about 10 ms per drag frame, coexists with voice input. Windows 10/11 x64 only; the first capture compiles a helper with the built-in .NET Framework csc.exe.

title: LingHXiao/dsh-effort-mascot
description: Replaces the composer's reasoning-effort dropdown with a card that shows one illustration per level (off / low / high / max); the four levels keep their original meanings, and swapping an illustration only means replacing a file in assets/.

title: linglanxin/dsh-feng-gu-lite
description: Offline Beijing-time peak/idle indicator below the conversation composer, with a 2026 calendar, uncertainty labels, and brief peak reminders; no API key or runtime network access required.

title: LingMoe404/dsh-cot-translation-reader
description: Shows the official COT machine translation inside dsh-better-display's reading view, with a per-card original/translated toggle on better-display 0.3.12 and later.

title: lingr7/dsh-reversed-chat
description: Moves the composer to the top of an active conversation and renders the transcript plus the turn navigator newest-first, so replies appear right under the composer.

title: LINGTIAN303/dsh-layout
description: Layout plugin for DSH: customize the structure, order, width and visibility of the left sidebar, right sidebar, conversation area and settings page. Drag-sort and resize the three columns, per-layer teardown of sidebar/conversation/right/settings, grid slot arrangement, draw-a-frame region relocation, entry consolidation into More menus, conditional linkage rules, multiple named layout schemes, and a fullscreen layout whiteboard with a four-layer structure tree. Config persists host-side; dangerous configs have multi-layer recovery entries.

title: LingYun3241/dsh-space-approve
description: Answers a pending DeepSeek Harness permission prompt with Space (allow once) or Escape (reject) without focusing the card first, and leaves typing untouched.

title: linhx1999/dsh-writing-pad
description: Session-scoped Markdown writing pad docked beside the conversation, with edit/preview modes, selection-based AI rewrites, diff review, undo, and draft recovery.

title: LinJohn8/dsh-model-group-collapse
description: Makes the provider groups in the composer model menu collapsible, keeping only the provider of the current model expanded.

title: linkbag/dsh-capyreporter
description: Always-on-top capybara task reporter for DSH Web — a transparent floating pet that narrates each trajectory step in a speech bubble, names the project it reports for, and alerts you when a task completes while you work elsewhere.

title: Linnnkkk/dsh-plugin-suggest-bar
description: Predicts up to three candidate replies you may send next and shows them above the input box after each turn, cycling between them; adopting one appends it to the draft on a new line and leaves the rest in place, and any of them can also be sent directly or dismissed for the turn.

title: linshufan21/dsh-boot-compass
description: Desktop full-screen boot splash. It covers DSH's loading card before first paint, plays a 4.5 s five-stage compass sequence, then hands off to the app; clicking anywhere skips ahead, and reopening the window from the tray replays it. The first cold start may hitch once, then runs smoothly.

title: Linsongrong/dsh-prompt-suggest
description: Inline next-message prediction in the DSH composer: a grey ghost line, Tab to accept, ArrowUp to recall sent prompts.

title: Lionad-Morotar/dsh-jump
description: Press a chord, then type a letter label to click or focus any visible target.

title: liqiGeGe/dsh-plugin-execution-graph
description: Adds an Execution graph conversation-view tab that renders each turn's prompts, replies, and tool calls/results as a foldable timeline with a detail panel and PNG export.

title: liqiming-whu/dsh-status-card
description: Adds a configurable dsh-ui status card before each DSH agent reply, with bilingual templates and a live settings preview. Requires @omdsh-dev/dsh-genui from dsh-market; without it, the card markup is emitted unrendered.

title: lisihao/dsh-intelligent-UI
description: Optional source-preserving chat rendering with selectable themes, offline Uiverse component tools and a report-local evidence workspace. Preview for DSH 0.2.1-rc.2.

title: lisniuse/dsh-modal-enhancer
description: Window-like controls for every Web UI modal: drag by title bar, eight-way resize, pin against outside clicks, maximize to the full viewport, removable backdrop blur, and per-dialog persistent state.

title: lisusuba/Hardworking-donkey
description: A full-viewport donkey-mill background for the DSH Web UI: an animated top-down donkey or a Chinese-character form circles the millstone, accelerating with the model's live token throughput and plodding slowly when idle; a bottom-right panel switches form, adjusts opacity and hides the scene, persisting in localStorage.

title: little-thing/claude-code-mode
description: A session workspace for DeepSeek Harness modeled on the Claude app, with forked sessions nested in one tree, up to four sessions on one screen, and a right rail per pane.

title: littleboylittlegirl/dsh-community-hot
description: Floating community panel for the Web UI: 24h hot topics and hot plugins TOP10 with a draggable, always-on-top button.

title: LittleLemonJam/dsh-quick-notes
description: A floating sticky-note pad for the DeepSeek Harness Web GUI with a note directory, text editing, pasted images and local persistence.

title: liu19666/dsh-model-block-picker
description: Composer model selector grouped by provider: pick a provider card, then drill into that provider to choose a model, with cross-provider search and Reasoning Effort kept.

title: liu19666/dsh-screenshot
description: Windows screenshot overlay: highlights the window, screen or taskbar under the cursor and dims the rest, then annotates (shapes, arrows, pen, text, mosaic) and drops the image into the composer without sending it.

title: liu3734/jira-tasks-dsh-plugin
description: JIRA task panel under the DSH composer: per-workspace project key and optional JQL, listing the issues assigned to the current user with status, priority and issue-type chips, a total count, collapse and refresh, links to JIRA, plus a settings card for the base URL and token with a connection probe.

title: liudapeng0311/dsh-pwa-launcher
description: Turns the browser PWA shortcut already on your desktop into a real launcher: it adopts that shortcut and keeps its icon, then starts dsh web silently on double-click and opens the app window; adds restart and dsh self-update (with rollback) controls to the web UI. Windows only.

title: liufeicc/dsh-model-provider-label
description: Shows the provider name in the current-model button and its menu, so same-named models from different providers stay distinguishable.

title: liufeicc/dsh-split-workspaces
description: Tiles several workspaces side by side or stacked in the Web UI, one conversation per pane, with draggable splitters and pane swapping.

title: liuhaolong16/dsh-quote-reply
description: Keeps quotes out of the message body: quoting any passage from an assistant turn opens an editable quote tray above the composer, the quotes are injected into the next turn as system-prompt context (attributed with source and time), and an expandable quote row under that turn shows exactly which quotes were used. Quotes persist across page reloads and are claimed per turn; the host and client halves hand-shake on version and report a compatibility verdict.

title: liuhusk/dsh-status-card
description: A permanent status card in the top-right corner of the DSH content area: one line for where this turn's time went (model, tools, waiting), plus collapsible to-dos with a progress bar, the session goal (edit/pause/resume/clear), submitted plans that open in the preview pane, the files this session changed, subagents with their token and duration figures, and this session's background jobs: running rows carry a two-step stop button, finished ones fold into a count line that stays collapsed until opened; it yields space to the content as the area narrows and folds into a round button at the limit.

title: liujia-io/dsh-image-picker
description: Adds a paperclip image-picker button to the conversation composer - pick reference images through the system file dialog and feed them straight into the official attachment pipeline (thumbnails, limit checks, upload with message).

title: liujiangnanchenjbguo/dsh-gufa-code
description: Cursor-style IDE mode for DeepSeek Harness: one click on a workspace menu turns the main panel into a VS Code-like workbench with a Monaco editor, file tree, Git panel (commit graph, push/pull, per-file revert), SSH hosts and a real PTY terminal on the left, while the official DSH conversation stays docked on the right so tool calls, file edits, approvals and session history keep working as you code. Built on a craft-first belief: write it by hand, understand every change, treat AI as an assistant and stay the first owner of your software.

title: liujuntao123/dsh-mobile-keys
description: Adds a mobile hotkey mode to the DSH web composer that auto-detects touch and mobile devices and switches to Ctrl+Enter for send and plain Enter for a newline while leaving the desktop keymap untouched, with a Settings toggle, a /mobilekeys command and a window.__dshMobileKeys console API.

title: liuke-zhu/dsh-toonflow-canvas
description: Embed the Toonflow infinite canvas as a dsh sidebar panel. Companion plugin: requires you to self-host and run Toonflow locally (default http://127.0.0.1:6017). Configurable URL, connect / reload / open in new window.

title: liuming-dev/dsh-plugins#annotation-rewind-scroll
description: Annotate replies and documents for the next message, edit past user messages and rerun from that point, and use keyboard shortcuts to navigate user messages or recall previous inputs in the composer.

title: liumorrisclaw/dsh-composer-input-history
description: Recalls messages you already sent in the DSH composer with ArrowUp; ArrowDown walks forward, restores the draft you were writing, and one more press discards it and clears the composer.

title: liunianlh/dsh-aihot
description: AI news panel for the sidebar: 24-hour picks, recent stories, a top-ten trending board, the daily digest and keyword search, all read from the public AIHOT JSON API. Picks and All filter by six categories; feed cards show category, source, time, heat score, summary and, when AIHOT supplies one, its recommendation note. The Picks, All and Search feeds group stories by Beijing-time day and page ten at a time with cursor endless scroll plus a Load more fallback. Read-only and client-side only, with no API key, no build step and colors taken from the host theme tokens.

title: LiuPack/dsh-beads-panel
description: Beads issue-graph panel in the left sidebar of the Web GUI: filter ready, in-progress, open, and all beads, read a bead's description, notes, dependencies, and comments, and create, claim, or close beads through the bd CLI. Requires the bd CLI on PATH and a workspace with a Beads database.

title: liupengprivate-blip/dsh-baidu
description: A simulated search engine page in the DSH sidebar that queries the local web search API and lists the top 10 results.

title: liushimu/dsh-workspace-detached
description: Windows x64 preview that detaches workspace/session navigation into a separate .NET Framework 4.6.2+/WebView2 Evergreen window, with grouped trees, overview/focused modes, logical drag-and-drop, activity/manual ordering and a resizable focused-view preview; no DSH Core patch and no Better Workspace runtime dependency. Derived from KannaKuron/dsh-better-workspace — do not install both.

title: liushQAQ/dsh-prompt-optimizer
description: Smart prompt optimization & dynamic thinking effort adaptation with composer capsule, DSH/custom models, undo/re-optimize, and native settings.

title: liushuchang-2012/dsh-boot-splash
description: Boot film for the web UI: a blue whale floods black from below as the page loads, then glides left and pulls the | deepseek HARNESS wordmark out of itself before the app appears.

title: liuyifeng-code/dsh-read-zoom
description: A reading layer for long DeepSeek Harness sessions. A fixed enlarge button on every answer opens a two-pane view with 80-300% type, an outline of every turn in the session (turns not yet loaded are fetched on demand), and a composer that fills the real DSH input without sending. Formulas, tables and code stay exactly as rendered; over-wide formulas shrink to fit, failed ones degrade quietly, and turns whose answer was cut off are labelled as truncated.

title: liuzwZYW/dsh-pwa-ui
description: Gives an installed dsh web app a native-looking window caption through Window Controls Overlay - the manifest route is served with display_override, the app's own sidebar brand row and session header become the drag region, and the app's own trailing controls are inset clear of the browser's caption chrome.

title: liwangzimo/dsh-calendar-diary
description: A plain-notebook calendar in the DSH sidebar: a 70-day, Monday-first grid whose cells print that day's note; one note per day is stored in a .xlsx you choose, in the DesktopCal two-column layout (Excel date serial plus free text, newest date first). Clicking a day opens the editor for it, and import/export move that same format in and out, with a preview step and a conflict policy (keep, overwrite, concat or skip).

title: liweidong1722/dsh-work-list
description: Local-first DSH Web work checklist with rich-text notes, categories, folding, drag reordering, search, JSON import/export, and a restorable trash.

title: liyansong0015/dsh-sao-link-start
description: Adds a configurable SAO-inspired full-screen startup animation to DeepSeek Harness.

title: liyutongzuishuai/plugin-organizer
description: Files the settings entries your installed plugins add below the ones dsh ships, behind a divider with a live count, and keeps up automatically as plugins come and go.

title: lizilong1993/dsh-plain-talk
description: Composer toggle that shapes replies: conclusion first, inline quotes, no cross-turn references.

title: lizilong1993/dsh-unlimited-effort
description: Composer infinity switch: while the highest reasoning effort is selected, one click appends a configurable notice to the system prompt.

title: lizixuan200410-cmd/dsh-bright-text
description: Sets the UI text colour for light and dark themes separately, plus the body font size and the interface typeface, with system Kai/Xing/Li/Song families, four open-source calligraphy fonts and support for importing your own font file.

title: lizixuan200410-cmd/dsh-ink-whale-leap
description: Plays a short ink-wash whale-leap animation over the DeepSeek Harness web UI when it loads, then fades out on its own.

title: lj100886/dsh-team-canvas
description: Renders an Agent Teams swimlane canvas above the composer: lead centred with members below, tasks laid out in lanes by longest dependency path, and four SVG connector families drawn as dashed paths (task dependency as a cubic bezier from the upstream card edge to the downstream card edge, lead bus, peer bus, member-to-task tether). Cards are absolutely positioned DOM, connectors are one SVG layer sharing the same geometry constants. Layout constants and path algorithms are ported from cc-haha. Reads the live per-session agentTeam projection (roster, shared tasks, dependency edges, running state) and falls back to the session todo list when the session has no team; team messages are not part of the projection yet, so the communication panel shows an empty state. Body colours come from host theme tokens; the eight member identity colours are the deliberate exception — fixed hues mixed with the theme accent via color-mix, declared as CSS variables because the same values feed an SVG stroke attribute that rejects colour functions. Ships zh/en dictionaries with identical keys.

title: ljxdsg12/dsh-composer-polish
description: Adds a Polish button to the composer tool row right of the permission control: it reads the draft you have already typed, has the current model infer your intent and rewrite the draft into a clearer prompt, then turns the button into Cancel so one click restores the exact pre-polish text.

title: lk251066/dsh-tui-pro
description: A full-screen terminal workbench for DeepSeek Harness with a durable assistant, workspace-grouped project sessions, transcript-only scrolling, and structured thinking, tool, diff, plan, and subagent views.

title: Lkrain821/dsh-pixelwhale
description: Turns the "deep diving" thinking status into a pixel font, with an animated pixel blue whale spouting and wagging its tail beside it.

title: lkuliuying/dsh-mutipleagent
description: 3D office view for DeepSeek Harness: the sidebar panel turns the real main session, its sub-agents, tool activity and reports into animated desks, with per-desk screen details and a notification centre for collaboration events; sessions are picked per working directory. Read-only: it starts no tasks, calls no model, needs no API key, and ships its own scene and models (no CDN). Requires DSH 0.2.2-rc.1 (or a later 0.2.x) and Node ^22.19.0 || >=24.0.0.

title: Lli-WenZe/dsh-model-console
description: Model console panel: switch the model for every conversation at once or one at a time, filter sessions by idle time, fold subagents under their parent session, and bulk archive or release sessions.

title: LMhuo/dsh-snap-line
description: Hangs a clothesline of polaroid photos under the DeepSeek Harness message composer, on the session page and the new-session home screen; photos from a local folder refresh within seconds and clicking one opens a lightbox preview.

title: lmmcsb/dsh-quad-layout
description: Four-column layout: split the DSH left sidebar into a 56px icon rail plus a full-height workspace column, and keep the icon rail visible when the sidebar is collapsed.

title: lmmzss-jk/dsh-plugin-balance
description: Balance and live session usage for the DSH web UI: header balance button (left of the Session log), dropdown with account balance, real-time token breakdown (cache miss/hit, cache write, output), cache hit rate, and official-rate cost estimates with peak/off-peak auto-switch.

title: LN334/dsh-netease-float
description: Full-page NetEase Cloud Music player for DSH, reworked from stardream-1/dsh-netease-float (it reuses that package name, so the two cannot be installed side by side): now playing, full-screen lyrics, playlists, search and account sign-in.

title: lo2589/dsh-plugin-rightbar
description: A shared right sidebar for the DSH web client — other plugins register tabs into the `rightbar.tab` slot instead of each pinning a `position:fixed` panel; ships a `rightbar-tab` skill for agents and an opt-in mode that moves legacy fixed panels aside.

title: loadingvx/deepseeh-harness-ultra-slash
description: Separate slash-command group in the Web UI composer: /steer injects text on the agent's next step without interrupting the turn, /new starts a blank session, /skill and /docs wrap /steer with post-turn skill or docs tasks, and custom /steer aliases are configurable in Settings.

title: loadingvx/deepseek-harness-workbench-plugin
description: Fills in the Web UI's missing IDE workbench: resizable chat / editor / files-and-Git columns in Conversation, multi-tab file editing with save and new-file, workspace Terminal, a file tree with name filter and open-in-external-editor, SCM (stage/commit/push/pull, branch switch, Git graph, inline diffs), a status bar, and git_* model tools.

title: lof6yo/dsh-just-settings
description: Replaces the sidebar's More menu with a single button that opens Settings.

title: lokih1028/dsh-plugin-canvas-pro
description: Adds a Canvas drawer and eight model tools to create, patch, version, and export HTML, Markdown, Mermaid, SVG, and React artifacts.

title: lokih1028/dsh-prompt-optimizer
description: One-click prompt enhancement and structuring button for DSH composer.

title: LoneLeave/aiplug#dsh-ai-import-ui
description: Web panel for the DSH AI history importer — a floating button and a three-column wizard to preview conversations, pick which ones to import, and file them into workspace folders.

title: LonelyHerbivore/dsh-image-question#plugin
description: Ask the user a question about a local image; the DSH Web card offers zoom, pan, box, brush and lasso annotation, NG/OK/unsure verdicts and a note, and the agent receives annotations back in source-image pixel coordinates.

title: long6177/dsh-markdown-input
description: Markdown live rendering for the DSH Web UI composer: typed Markdown (bold, lists, code fences) renders as you type in a CodeMirror-based takeover composer; sent user messages render as Markdown; pasted rich text becomes clean Markdown.

title: LoongYun/dsh-mindmap
description: View XMind, FreeMind, OPML, KityMinder and VYM mind maps in the sidebar, edit and save all of them except read-only XMind (convert it to .mm first), export to .mm, and read or edit outlines through agent tools.

title: lov0vo/dsh-composer-autopair
description: Auto-pairs brackets and quotes in the DSH chat composer, inserting the closing half with the caret in between; it also wraps selected text with the typed pair and handles brackets committed by an IME.

title: LoveIrishCoffee/dsh-effort-ultra
description: A native reasoning-effort control for the composer: a blue-to-violet tier bar with a starfield and a sheen sweep. It owns the model seat and drives the official model-directories service, so the ladder comes from each model's own reasoning declaration and no other plugin is required.

title: LoveStudyXin/dsh-sticky-notes
description: Sticky-note wall in the sidebar: six paper colors, pin and search, up to six images per note, local backups, and an agent tool that lets a session or an IM bot add a note without opening the browser.

title: lovvvve/dsh-quick-actions#composer-quick-actions
description: Global Quick Actions beside every session-backed composer in DSH. One press sends a preset or your own saved text, with per-action send confirmation.

title: loyalchiiina/dsh-artifact-linker
description: Adds a resident system-prompt rule asking the assistant to report every file it produces as a full absolute path (a soft rule, not enforced), and replaces the official context menu on a file link with eight actions: open in the sidebar, open in a floating window, open with the default app, reveal in Explorer, save a copy elsewhere, copy the file, copy its path, and add it to the chat box, so a result reaches a friend in one click (copy-file and save-as are Windows only). Adapts DSH kernel 0.2.2-rc.1.

title: loyalchiiina/dsh-chat-image-lightbox
description: Shows chat images as a thumbnail grid inside the message body instead of one collapsed icon, so several pictures are readable at a glance, with the column count adjustable from 1 to 12 (3 by default) and a hide-images switch. Clicking a thumbnail opens a lightbox that zooms by wheel or buttons, drags to pan, pages between images and downloads the original. Adapts DSH kernel 0.2.2-rc.1.

title: loyalchiiina/dsh-font-enhancer
description: Global font DIY: change size, weight, colour and family at any place in the DSH interface, per element or for the whole window, then hide the floating ball when you are done. No CSS writing and no restart. Adapts DSH kernel 0.2.2-rc.1.

title: loyalchiiina/dsh-lobsterai-daddy
description: Bridges LobsterAI (Youdao Lobster) into DSH: its free daily check-in credits become usable inside DeepSeek Harness, so conversations, workflows and skill packs run on those credits. Requires the LobsterAI desktop app (Windows); new-account login and gateway sync need the separate LobsterDaddy console (not in this repo). Unmaintained since 2026-10-21.

title: loyalchiiina/dsh-schedule-calendar
description: Sidebar schedule assistant for dsh-better-sidebar (required: the tab registers through it; DSH 0.2.2+): a today view with city weather refreshed at 8:30 / 12:00 / 17:30, an almanac and a collapsible horoscope block; a lunar month calendar whose cells let the wallpaper show through; events and to-dos; daily and weekly reports and a daily check-in; per-person rest-day schemes with an off-work countdown. A multi-account mail client for QQ Mail and Foxmail (@qq.com / @foxmail.com, both using imap.qq.com / smtp.qq.com and an app password): IMAP receive + SMTP send, seven tabs, search, star / spam / trash with restore, read-unread state, drafts, group send with a per-mail interval, and attachments in both directions — clickable links in message bodies open in the system browser. Reminders (sitting / water / eye-care / music) appear as in-app capsules floating above the whole DSH client with adjustable dwell time (3-60 s) and position, optional Windows notifications and a manual preview button. A rotating wallpaper appearance (sequential or shuffled), adjustable opacity and frosted glass, and adjustable text colour. Data stays local and is never uploaded. Adapts DSH kernel 0.2.2-rc.1.

title: loyalchiiina/dsh-skill-browser
description: Skills and MCP browser behind one floating ball with five tabs: Skills (native folder picker, two-level categories plus custom groups, tree or flat view, manual, keyword and AI grouping on metadata only, search, and per-card or whole-library enable/disable with timestamped backups), Call Ledger (counts, success rate, trend, ranking), MCP (live loader config, real Fiber states, per-server tools and call stats, enable, disable, reconnect, export to mcpServers JSON, plus scan-and-AI-fix for unconfigured servers), Market (MCP marketplace: the official MCP Registry plus 29 curated free servers, 19 flat categories with per-category counts, grid and list views with 3-6 cards per row, one-click install into cordis.patch.yml with automatic backup, one-click uninstall, every server shown with its own real icon, two-way instant sync with the MCP tab, and the last scroll position is recalled) and Quick Start. 130 skins sync across the three balls. Adapts DSH kernel 0.2.2-rc.1.

title: loyalchiiina/dsh-todo-float-ball
description: Forces a todo list at the start of every turn and rewrites it in full each time, so finished items stay listed instead of being replaced. The floating ball shows the complete history, including plans that were lost when you cut in mid-turn, so what got done and what got dropped is always clear. Adapts DSH kernel 0.2.2-rc.1.

title: lp86ndlb/dsh-todo-note
description: A draggable sticky note beside the chat: short-term tasks and a long-term plan whose phases carry real progress, plus three todo_note_* tools (read, update, complete) so the agent works from the same note. A task only counts as done after the user ticks it off, and the state stays on the local machine.

title: Lphehe/dsh-composer-assist
description: DSH input assistant for next-message prediction, draft autocomplete (text completion), and prompt polishing/rewrite. Session-local suggestions; Tab accepts into the draft without sending. Requires a configured model; calls may incur charges. Source-available; modifications require prior written permission.

title: lrplrplrp/dsh-live2d
description: A Live2D waifu plugin for DSH.

title: lsdt45/dsh-plan-plus
description: Plan review enhancement for DeepSeek Harness Web: reply to the plan-review card inline to have the model revise the plan, and browse, compare, edit and archive every plan version in a full-screen overlay.

title: lsdt45/dsh-workspace-plus
description: Hierarchical workspace tree plus browser-style session tabs for the DSH sidebar: a "/" in a workspace or session title creates a virtual folder, with sections, pinning, time buckets, drag ordering, unified 6px status dots, per-row appearance customization (colour, glow, weight, icon) and a floating full-text search over session titles and message bodies. Several settings switches restore any behaviour to the host default, and a host-side route deletes sessions permanently (DSH ships archive only). Fork of KannaKuron/dsh-better-workspace.

title: lsfcy/dsh-composer-predictions
description: Shows a dimmed suggestion of the user's next message in the empty composer after a settled turn; Tab accepts it into the draft and Escape or typing dismisses it.

title: lsh2002/dsh-custom-fonts
description: Customize the UI's Chinese and English fonts, code font, and global font-size offset on a settings page, with a live preview and one-click reset.

title: lsq-dsh-plugins/dsh-workbench-layout
description: Rearranges DSH Web into a three-column workbench with file editing, Git views, Markdown preview, and workspace terminals.

title: LTao96/dsh-plugin-overview
description: A local overview of installed DSH plugins. It does not install packages — pair it with a plugin market. Fold third-party settings, organize notes/groups with AI, check health and toggle plugins, so nothing gets lost in clutter.

title: ltayshark0637/dsh-Shutdown-Guard
description: Adds a sidebar card to DeepSeek Harness that runs a chosen action once every task finishes and the card is armed — shut down, restart, sleep, hibernate, lock, sign out, or a script you uploaded to its shared library; it holds back with a stated reason while background jobs, errored sessions or a manual interruption are still in play. Verified on Windows, macOS and Linux.

title: LTP414/dsh-btw-marginalia
description: Read-only /btw side questions for DeepSeek Harness: forks the current session, injects the running turn's task, recent tool calls and partial answer so a mid-turn question has context, denies every tool call at execution time, and keeps a per-session topic history with follow-up, stop, retry and delete.

title: Luaphes/dsh-web-attention-badge
description: Attention reminders: frame badge, tab-title count, and a status-colored whale favicon for sessions waiting for input or finished unopened.

title: lucagiftzek/dsh-artifacts
description: An Artifacts tab in the DSH sidebar that lists the files an agent produced and previews them in place with live reload, plus artifact template tools for agents.

title: lucagiftzek/dsh-workspace-rail
description: Replaces the DSH sidebar list with a workspace rail: pinned chats and folders, projects that are folders with their own AGENTS.md and files, a virtualized Recents list ordered by the last finished turn, a project_search tool, unread markers, a collapsed icon column with an unread count and a live browser tab title.

title: lucas07814-hub/dsh-pet-guardian-dragon
description: A draggable desktop pet for the DSH web interface with interactive actions and growth states.

title: lucky01222/dsh-workbench-shell
description: Compact 56px app navigation rail with a separate conversation list and sidebar collapse control for the DSH web UI; also hides embedding, rerank and image/video generation models from the chat model menu and /model.

title: lucyVan/dsh-side-chat-slash
description: Side chat for the DSH Web GUI with a /side slash command, forked from @flyer103/dsh-side-chat 0.7.0 and adding a host /side command, an open-request bridge, and approval pinned to never. It cannot be installed alongside the upstream @flyer103/dsh-side-chat — both register the same routes and side-chat tab type.

title: LUgABeEEE/dsh-adapt-packs
description: Adaptation packs for third-party DSH plugin panels on phones — 44px touch floor, width reclaim, shell hit targets and floating-widget clearance — loaded by the dsh-mobile plugin from its extensions directory (dsh-mobile must be installed for them to take effect), with a settings page that installs them and a per-plugin compatibility list.

title: LUgABeEEE/dsh-global-todo
description: Global cross-session todo list in the sidebar that the person and the agent both write to: ten global_todo_* tools add, batch-capture, update, attach documents and links to, append progress notes to and complete items from any session, and each item can be handed to an agent session in one of four modes with the outcome recorded on the item. The list is a single JSON file.

title: LUgABeEEE/dsh-sidebar-density
description: Lightweight sidebar UI for DeepSeek Harness: five fold switches, three density presets and three width presets, served from one footer row plus a settings section — no dependencies and no background service.

title: lukeinx/dsh-workboard
description: Adds a Workboard page with a configurable grid of built-in widgets, including agent sessions and jobs, to-dos, ICS calendar, weather, trending lists, RSS feeds, markets and a system monitor, plus sandboxed custom widgets the agent writes from a one-line request.

title: LUMIAO9527/DSH-Focus
description: Reorganize the home sidebar entries into groups above and below the workspace, toggle each installed plugin entry, and save every change immediately.

title: LUMIAO9527/DSH-suggestions
description: Context-based next-message suggestions and draft rewriting for DeepSeek Harness, with candidate paging, shortcut recording, and companion MCP tools.

title: lumine-423/dsh-session-popout
description: Drag a session out of the DSH sidebar and it opens in its own native OS window, showing the full standard conversation UI (Markdown, toolbar, settings) with only the sidebar trimmed away, so several sessions can be watched side by side instead of switching back and forth. Windows verified; macOS and Linux untested. Runs in the DSH desktop app (Electron).

title: Luminet-LT/dsh-inapp-chat
description: Adds a sidebar entry that opens DeepSeek web chat in an in-app window for quick questions while working. Fork of zerorigin-studio/dsh-deepseek-chat (already listed); it uses its own settings namespace, so both can coexist. Needs the desktop bridge (window.dsh.desktop.openWindow).

title: lumoping/dsh-todo-inbox
description: Global cross-session todo inbox for DSH web: any session's agent records human-action todos (merge MRs, approve work orders, reviews) via inbox_add/inbox_done/inbox_list; a sidebar entry shows a count badge and an expandable list to open and complete them, persisted to ~/.dsh/todo-inbox.json.

title: lunasi27/dsh-daily-todo
description: Daily todo board in the main panel with one list per calendar day split into Work and Life; local midnight archives the day and carries unfinished tasks into the new day.

title: luoshuizhiwei/dsh-desktop-restart
description: Adds a restart button to the DeepSeek Harness desktop app — it asks before restarting while work is running, and afterwards reports how long the app was down. Entries can live in the sidebar, the conversation header, the account menu or the settings page, and each one can be turned off. Extras include checking how much sign-in data is stored (a cause of startup failures) and previewing leftover temp files, counted but never deleted. Desktop app only.

title: Lushdawn/dsh-effort-dial
description: Codex-style reasoning-effort card for the composer: takes over the model selector and shows the current level, the model row and a segmented slider over the model's own adapter-provided levels, with a model list, a reset, and a purple aurora with twinkling particles at the maximum level.

title: LusJourney/dsh-limitup-widget
description: Floating A-share limit-up card in the DSH overlay showing limit-up, broken-board and limit-down counts, break rate, consecutive-board height, previous-day limit-up premium, top themes and a localStorage watchlist; closable with no floating remnant (restore from the sidebar footer). Needs the separate Python dashboard backend from the repo's dashboard/ folder (Python 3.9+, akshare; not shipped in the package), which the same-origin proxy can health-check and optionally autostart.

title: LUX09947-CMYK/dsh-re
description: Adds a refresh button to the DeepSeek Harness desktop title bar next to the Edit menu, reloading the interface without restarting the app.

title: luxi233/dsh-settings-nav-scroll
description: Adds a visible vertical scrollbar to the DSH Web settings navigation when its sections exceed the viewport.

title: luyiheng1111/dsh-context-window-picker
description: Adds a session-scoped context window selector next to the reasoning-effort row in the DeepSeek Harness model popup: a pill showing the effective window opens a dropdown of presets below the model default, the choice applies to the next request of that session only, and a new session falls back to the profile default. It writes no config file and appends nothing to the session log.

title: LWLAymh/dsh-tool-emoji
description: Replace tool-card leading icons with emoji while preserving the original cards.

title: lxj5820/dsh-boot-animation
description: Replaces the kernel boot page with a full-window video clip that dissolves into the app; the clip pool, enter mode and fade length are configurable in Settings → Plugins.

title: ly14278/dsh-prompt-brief
description: Adds an Optimize button to the composer that rewrites a one-line idea into a structured product brief: a positioning sentence, 3–6 key features, visual references and design tokens; it sits beside your original text in a compare dialog where you can accept it into the input, generate another version, or cancel and keep the draft untouched. No settings page and no API keys — it calls the model channel you already configured.

title: LyaxZ/dsh-fonttune
description: A font plugin for the DeepSeek Harness Web GUI: the conversation gets its own font, size, line height, weight, tracking, word gap, paragraph gap and first-line indent, the interface font follows it, code keeps its own axis with ligature control; light and dark can each hold their own set, whole setups save as presets, and a floating panel puts every axis a dot away.

title: LyaxZ/dsh-goodies
description: Effort slider in the model menu, a live tokens-per-second and turn-total readout beside the running status, a per-answer input/output/cached report, and a completion notification when a turn finishes, for the DeepSeek Harness Web GUI.

title: LyaxZ/dsh-quick-toc
description: Conversation outline for DeepSeek Harness: the Markdown headings of the whole session, grouped by turn, in a side panel or a full-width curtain; hover previews can be pinned for comparison, bookmarks keep the places you come back to, and a right-click jumps to a section or copies a heading and the levels below it. Six theme colours and a translucent material, title/prompt/full-text/cross-session search, reading-position follow and a Chinese/English interface.

title: lyhue1991/dsh-soup
description: Project file explorer in the details column (multi-select, drag-move, upload, download, rename, trash, system-open) with an in-session read-only preview tab for Markdown/HTML/JSON/CSV/notebook/PDF + code highlighting, a live model throughput badge, and a multiline GoalBar.

title: lyonleeeee/dsh-steer
description: Adds a live status badge to the session header and delivers guidance added mid-task without interrupting the turn.

title: lysforge/dsh-lamplit
description: One shelf for WeChat Reading, GitHub book repos and your own EPUB/PDF/Markdown, with an immersive reader and AI notes.

title: lyx0717/dsh-washer
description: An always-on-top desktop pet (a washing machine) that renders session state as washing actions: four switchable skins, multi-session counters, and proactive done / stuck / approval alerts on macOS and Windows, plus a detail panel with recent turns and timings.

title: lyy-hast/dsh-coros-plugin
description: COROS Sport panel for DeepSeek Harness: sign in to COROS inside the panel, read the account, bound devices, recovery, fitness, recent workouts, daily health and the training schedule in one dashboard, and get a plan from the model with /coros-plan. The plan page writes a fixed four-week, 16-session plan to the account only after a two-step confirmation.

title: Lzh3070/dsh-file-review-tab
description: Review agent file changes as a dsh-better-sidebar sidebar tab or chat turn-tail row — line-level diffs and undo.

title: lzpway-jpg/dsh-plugin-brand-custom
description: Custom brand icon and name for the DSH Web sidebar and conversation hero, editable live from a settings card on the plugin detail page.

title: Lzz2133/dsh-manutd-fixtures
description: Manchester United 2026/27 fixtures in the sidebar with kickoff times in your local timezone, finished matches with W/L/D results.

title: m724523/dsh-deepseek-live-status
description: Sidebar footer widget that shows DeepSeek service health: a status dot plus the live latency of four probes (API, chat, docs, status page) run from this machine, with a popover listing official component statuses read from status.deepseek.com. Refresh cadence 15s-2min.

title: mackwan84/dsh-ui-mockup#ui-mockup
description: Generates UI wireframes and high-fidelity mockups in DeepSeek Harness with selectable DashScope and Volcengine image providers.

title: magian1127/deepseek-harness-zh_pro
description: UI enhancement suite for the DSH web client: Chinese locale completion, one-row stats, auto-expanded thinking, chat width, session archiving and delete, plus an optional prompt-injection switch (off by default).

title: magic-tab-01/dsh-notes
description: Rich-text notes with images, links, symbols, categories, backgrounds, heading folding, and export.

title: magicOF2/dsh-autoload-history
description: Automatically loads the full conversation history when a session opens, so older messages are ready without clicking "Load earlier".

title: magicOF2/dsh-chat-width-customizer
description: Session-header button that cycles the conversation width (748-1600px), widening the chat column, composer, and user bubbles together.

title: magicOF2/dsh-schedule
description: Local long-term schedule panel: top-bar "日程" text button, today/week/history month-calendar views with stats, completion checkmarks with per-day history, schedule↔conversation links with click-to-jump, recurring tasks (daily/weekly), optional auto carry-over for unfinished one-time tasks, and dailytask_* agent tools.

title: magicOF2/dsh-turn-marks
description: Left-edge turn-marks strip in chat: one bar per user message, click to jump to that message, hover for a preview, active bar turns white.

title: maimaiqwe/prompt-enhancer#dsh-prompt-enhance-cn
description: Four-tier prompt enhancer for the composer — the system tier always emits a LangGPT-structured system prompt (# Role / Profile / Skills / Rules / Workflows / Initialization), upgrading task drafts into the system prompt of the agent that runs them, while the other tiers rewrite as a light tidy-up, a single paragraph, or a five-section brief; the iterate workbench refines an editable base under an optional requirement, with fill-back and undo. Never changes intent, never invents requirements.

title: Makk9609/dsh-find-viewer
description: Find bar in the sidebar text preview, with whole-file match counts for plain text and code, highlighted hits, and jumps between them.

title: Makk9609/dsh-send-lock
description: Changes how DSH Web sends messages: Enter inserts a newline and sending takes Cmd on macOS or Ctrl elsewhere.

title: Makk9609/dsh-session-mark
description: Right-click a session in the left session list to choose one of eight gradient washes or three hand-drawn line patterns; the last blank row clears it.

title: MannixHu/dsh-statusbar-config
description: Configurable statistics row below the composer via a ${variable} display template — which segments appear and how they are labelled is fully user-defined.

title: mantonlove/dsh-margin-notes
description: Margin annotations for DSH: select text in a document preview or an assistant reply, queue a note on each passage, then send the whole batch into the composer as one numbered block so the model answers item by item.

title: maqian1632/dsh-tray-restart
description: Adds a single “Restart DeepSeek Harness” item to the Windows system tray menu of the DSH desktop app by patching the installed app.asar in place and re-applying that patch after each desktop update; it needs a writable DSH installation directory and adds no other tray actions.

title: MarchLiu/dsh-rich-editor
description: Rich Markdown notebook for the composer region: a tool-row toggle plus a CodeMirror editor card with Codex-style list editing, submitted through the conversation service.

title: MaRi23333/dsh-agent-instructions-editor
description: Edit global AGENTS.md and project AGENTS.md/CLAUDE.md custom instructions in DeepSeek Harness settings, with project-chain discovery, byte-budget display, and save-conflict handling.

title: markmuteki/dsh-session-prompt-optimizer
description: A composer button that rewrites the draft into a clearer prompt (Shift for a structured brief, Alt to compress it), reading a bounded excerpt of the current session, and showing the result beside the draft until you accept it.

title: MarkTina/dsh-activity-heat
description: Scores sessions and workspaces 0-100% by time since their last activity, then shows that heat as a sidebar icon, a small heat dot before every session title, a heat line in the session hover card, and a filterable sessions/workspaces panel that also totals the turns, steps, tokens and conversation time of each workspace.

title: Martlet-Tech/dsh-open-folder-fix
description: Fixes the Windows workspace-open action. The shipped opener runs `explorer.exe "<file:// URI>"`, which on some hosts reports success without raising a window — the exit-code verdict cannot tell an opened window from nothing happening. This routes that one action to `explorer.exe /e,<dir>`, which raises a window reliably, and leaves every other application in the menu on the shipped path.

title: MarushiruDonato/dsh-rgb
description: RGB lighting effects for DeepSeek Harness: animated composer ring, sidebar rail, session indicator, and glowing brand logo.

title: MasterLTX/dsh-session-icon
description: Draws an icon in front of every session row in the DSH sidebar, decided from the session itself: keyword rules on the title first, then the session content (title, first user message and tool names), then an optional one-shot model verdict, then a workspace fallback. 445 Ant Design outlined icons are inlined for offline use, and the rules, colours, keywords and row indent are editable in a settings page.

title: matata2017/dsh-paste-collapse
description: Codex-style paste collapse for the DeepSeek Harness composer: a paste of more than 1000 characters becomes a `[Pasted Content N chars]` placeholder, a second paste of the same size is numbered `#2`, and the host expands it back to the full text before the model reads it, so the model still receives every character. A pill on the top edge of the composer shows the preview, the sent message shows the same pill, and clicking either opens the whole paste in a side panel with a copy button. Pure in memory: nothing is written to disk and no token is saved.

title: Matcha-Eason/dsh-answer-highlighter
description: Automatically highlights key points, definitions, warnings, and questions in completed assistant answers using one separate model call.

title: Matthew-Laplace/dsh-conversation-archive
description: Codex conversation panel for DeepSeek Harness: lists local Codex threads, renders their history, and sends messages back to the original thread through the Codex CLI. Needs the Codex CLI and Python installed locally.

title: Max-Null/dsh-chat-rail
description: Scroll-painting message rail for DeepSeek Harness: a slim right-edge rail with one indicator per user message, scroll-spy follows the reading position, hover unfolds a canvas with full message previews, and clicking jumps to any history message; animates in sync with better-sidebar panels.

title: Max-Null/dsh-node-appearance
description: Conversation node appearance for the DeepSeek Harness web GUI: configurable per-category and per-tool colors (left accent bar + tinted background), plus a show-thinking toggle; pure frontend rendering, takes effect instantly and persists to the DSH user settings file.

title: Max-Null/dsh-quick-toolbar
description: Plugin-button aggregator with carrier + on-site-LLM extensibility: gather any plugin's scattered buttons into one entry (SSiD title bar / web floating ball), LLM registers per environment, right-click deregisters — pure data, no plugin source touched.

title: maxy1817/dsh-inline-edit
description: Edit user messages and add or remove attachments inline, with settings to fork a conversation or regenerate its latest eligible task-starting message in place.

title: mdalboni/dsh-mobile
description: Mobile viewport lock, overscroll containment, virtual keyboard resizing, and sidebar auto-retraction.

title: mdktelmdktel/dsh-agent-status
description: Live step pill in the DSH session header: folds the durable session event stream into the agent's current action (tool name plus its argument summary), the step index inside the running turn, the elapsed turn time and the todo progress, polls it every 1.2 seconds, and renders blue pulse while working, green for a finished turn and red for a failed tool call; hides itself 9 seconds after a turn ends. On Windows it also opens an always-on-top desktop HUD (set DSH_AGENT_STATUS_HUD=0 to disable).

title: MDR-EX1000/dsh-desktop-kit
description: macOS desktop shell for the DSH web UI: a plugin plus a small Tauri/WKWebView window over the loopback web surface — real macOS fullscreen, single instance, external links delegated to the system browser, and browser-style zoom.

title: Meatware-Engineering/DSH-AnnotateAnything
description: Annotates elements or dragged regions in the Harness interface and Desktop Browser pages, then sends comments and cropped PNG screenshots to the current conversation.

title: meihaoyidian/life-workbench
description: Personal workbench panel with an overview dashboard, custom kanban boards, a note pad and a file library, persisted to local JSON by the host.

title: meihuaanying/dsh-panel-fold
description: Folds the DSH sidebar's global panel launchers into the More button it already renders, so the workspace and session list below regains up to seven 36px rows. A row in the More menu toggles the fold back, and the choice is kept in localStorage.

title: meijieYUan/dsh-work-pay-note
description: A draggable sticky note that counts today's and this month's earnings in real time from your work hours, with an optional photo, GIF or video background.

title: meiyuxuan2007/dsh-ask-selection
