description: Right-click selected text in a chat answer or a right-sidebar preview (Markdown, text, code, PDF, Office, Excel) to quote it to the model together with its source — file path, heading and line range, or page number (Excel: the current cell and sheet) — then send it at once or insert it into the composer for editing.

title: meiyuxuan2007/dsh-sidebar-more
description: Fold left-sidebar panel entries into a More menu on demand, freeing height for the workspace and session list; entries can be opened from the menu, restored in one click, and the choice persists across reloads. Nothing is folded on first install; entries that appear later are folded by default (switchable).

title: melt502/DSH-Session-Reference-UX-Patch
description: Durable, reversible installer that patches DSH Desktop session-reference UX — workspace-prioritized @ candidates, title-first display, two-line menu layout, and sidebar drag-to-composer session references.

title: MEMZ-JZY/DSH-Claude-Style-Reasoning-Slider
description: Animated Claude-style reasoning-effort slider and model picker that replaces the native DSH model selector.

title: MengLs1620/dsh-deepseek-status
description: Shows DeepSeek's official service status in the DSH session header, including overall and per-component status, uptime percentages, and active or recent incidents. A maintained fork of KekuKase/dsh-deepseek-status (published as @mengls1620/dsh-deepseek-status since 0.1.6); do not install it alongside the original dsh-deepseek-status — both register the same /deepseek-status route and plugin row id.

title: mengqinlol/dsh-mobile-shell
description: Adapts the DSH Web GUI for mobile screens and adds a workspace file browser with previews and downloads.

title: mengyun233/dsh-codex-pet
description: Auto-migrate Codex desktop-pet skins into DSH: an animated corner pet that mirrors agent state (thinking, tool use, awaiting approval, failed, done), with per-session frosted-glass dialogs and a full settings panel.

title: mengzhongjie/dsh-codex-sidebar
description: Turns the DSH sidebar into a message view, where a bell button groups sessions by priority and date and each row carries its preview and workspace name.

title: mercurynomercy/dsh-chat-mode
description: Adds a Chat entry to the DSH sidebar for project-free chats that use DSH's own sign-in and models, limited to web search, images and files dragged into the chat. Built for the DSH desktop app 0.2.2-rc.1 and tested on macOS only; do not enable it together with Starp1ume/dsh-chat-mode.

title: mercy719/dsh-client-ui-weather
description: Weather dashboard for the DeepSeek Harness Web GUI with city switching, current conditions, an eight-hour trend, and a five-day forecast.

title: Meredith2328/dsh-sticky-note
description: Quick sticky notes on the composer toolbar: jot ideas or TODOs, auto-saved as Markdown, one click to send into the chat.

title: mervin1944/dsh-version-badge
description: Version badge above the sidebar settings button: shows the current dsh version, expands to list every core package version, and checks npm for updates with one-click deploy.

title: mervyn-teo/dsh-plugin-collapsible-steps
description: Collapses consecutive tool-use and thinking steps between messages into a single bracketed, expandable item.

title: MeteorNOX/DeepSeek-Balance-Whale-Widget
description: A fixed-corner whale widget for the DSH web GUI — balance, today's usage and per-turn cost with peak/off-peak pricing, editable balance-alert and daily-budget bubbles, a module-based custom bubble queue with A/B weighted choices and random lines or images, 30+ vendor templates (OpenAI, OpenRouter, Kimi, SiliconFlow, Ark, Zhipu, MiniMax and more) with per-model balance and subscription quota, plus task-end sound, imported audio, custom roles and a resource manager. Local-only, no telemetry.

title: mewcoder/power-dsh
description: A DSH Desktop enhancement plugin offering Skills/MCP management, global instructions, task notifications, and other practical features, with options to streamline built-in functionality as needed.

title: meyaomiao/dsh-files-native
description: Native-feel DSH attachments: official PNG/JPEG/WebP/GIF thumbs plus 64px cards for other files via drag, paste, or paperclip; non-images land in .dsh-uploads and sent cards sit on the user bubble.

title: mhlywxl/dsh-split-workspace
description: Split the DSH conversation area into unlimited native panes — side by side, stacked, 2×2 and an automatic grid — each a real session with its own composer, streaming and approvals.

title: mhxy13867806343/dsh-plugin-edit-files
description: In-place text editing from the right-Sidebar document preview with ⌘S save and an external-change conflict check, plus a workspace Files tab (fuzzy search, create/rename/delete, per-file git status) and a Git changes tab whose baseline is the remote upstream — files that match the remote drop off the list.

title: mhxy13867806343/dsh-sidebar-account
description: Sidebar balance row for DSH Desktop — account balance and a top-up button, right under the version row; refreshes every 10 minutes and whenever the window regains focus, with explicit signed-out and error states.

title: mhxy13867806343/dsh-update-vd
description: DSH Desktop control center: one-click app updating (progress dialog, unattended install, resume), plus Skills / MCP / Agents / Import settings pages — import agent presets and chat history from Codex, Claude Code, TRAE and WorkBuddy, search remote sources by address, and push notes straight into the composer.

title: mhxy13867806343/my-dsh-desktop-extra
description: DSH Desktop enhancement: one-click update checker, DeepSeek balance & API key viewer, and import other AI tools.

title: Mi-Chuan/box-select-copy
description: Alt+drag a rectangular box over the DSH conversation to copy the text inside it.

title: miaomiao636/dsh-message-navigator
description: Codex-style message navigator for the DeepSeek Harness Web UI: a tick per user message along the conversation edge, hover or click to preview and smooth-jump to the message, with full history auto-loading.

title: MichengAI/dsh-codex-ui
description: Rebuilds the DeepSeek Harness web sidebar, workspace tree, search, and turn navigation in a Codex-style layout.

title: Microqian2th/dsh-codex-effort-slider
description: Drags the official reasoning-effort row into a continuous track: blue-to-violet fill, a starfield on the higher levels, and the official value text tinted to the current level. Off stays gray; no official text is rewritten.

title: Midnight-1991/dsh-term-explainer
description: Adds a "Terms" action to finished assistant answers that explains the computer-science terms it detects with Chinese definitions, occurrence counts, highlighted context snippets, and clickable nested explanations from a built-in offline dictionary, with no model calls.

title: mihoojj/dsh-prompt-spark
description: Composer button that rewrites the current draft with four style presets, selection-only rewriting, a keyboard shortcut and instant undo; no settings page.

title: miisaka19800/dsh-restart-fab
description: Floating restart button for the DSH web GUI: restarts the dsh process in place with a full-screen overlay and auto-reloads the page; no launcher script required, works on Windows/macOS/Linux.

title: miiy/dsh-terminal-keybar
description: On touch devices, supplies the keys a phone's soft keyboard lacks (Escape, Tab, Enter, Ctrl-C and the arrow keys) as a translucent on-screen column beside the active terminal.

title: milestone-17/dsh-git-branch-switcher
description: Keep your git workflow inside DeepSeek Harness. A composer chip shows the current branch at a glance; the TRAE-style popup lets you switch or create branches, fetch remotes, commit & push a subset of changes, merge with a clear source -> target flow, and stash / restore partial changes — all without leaving the chat. Popovers dock above the composer so your draft stays visible; the change list is prefetched when the menu opens; and the plugin confirms before touching a dirty tree.

title: milu7/dsh-directory-plugin
description: Starts the DSH desktop New Workspace folder picker in a directory you configure (Windows only) and adds a settings page for it, falling back to the stock picker when the saved folder is missing.

title: mimateinn/dsh-i18n
description: Adds 20 locales (Traditional Chinese HK/TW, Japanese, Korean, French, German, Spanish, Portuguese, Italian, Russian, Ukrainian, Polish, Dutch, Turkish, Arabic, Hindi, Indonesian, Vietnamese, Thai, Swedish) to the DeepSeek Harness Web UI, with hand-polished translations, runtime fallbacks, and automatic translation of market and third-party text.

title: mimidor/dsh-stock-dock
description: Configurable A-share, Hong Kong and US quote strip under the DSH composer: mini K-line per card, intraday, 5-minute, daily, weekly and monthly charts, five-level order book, A-share turnover and limit prices, session-aware polling and a Sina fallback source. Quotes come from public Tencent and Eastmoney endpoints; its HTTP routes have no DSH access check.

title: Minajka/dsh-todo-list
description: A to-do list that lives in the right sidebar instead of the conversation: add an item, tick it off, delete it, and drag rows to reorder them. Items are kept only in the browser's localStorage, and the plugin registers no model-facing tools; a button in the conversation header opens the panel.

title: Minecraftbe/dsh-toolfold
description: Codex-style tool call folding, collapsing multiple tool calls into a single line.

title: MingoYung/dsh-awakening
description: Startup animation picker with three bundled DeepSeek, Codex and Claude Code themes, local MP4/WebM imports and an in-app community library; optional first-screen install and restore on supported Windows DSH NEXT builds.

title: MingoYung/dsh-superagent-power
description: Adds a shared Sup composer switch on Windows to start or gracefully stop a separate Super-agent process and release its memory. Requires a working DSH NEXT install with Node 24+, the standalone DSH CLI and an already-configured independent Super-agent profile (verified on DSH 0.2.1-rc.4/rc.5); the bundled bridge.js must also be registered in the Super-agent profile — installing the desktop package alone does not complete setup.

title: minhaoli/dsh-ui-reload
description: Reload the whole frontend from a button in the conversation session header. A press first reads the next document and waits until its bundle addresses resolve, so it does not boot into a failed graph after a client bundle is rebuilt.

title: minivv/dsh-activity-bell
description: Sidebar activity bell: a red badge counts sessions that finished, and clicking it swaps the sidebar list from workspace grouping to a day-grouped recent-activity list with a green dot on completions that have not been opened.

title: Missher12/dsh-missher-enhance
description: Adds usage statistics, a highlighted footer, piano navigation, projectless sessions, and model and document helpers to DeepSeek Harness.

title: Missher12/Missher-DSH-Output-Renderer
description: Four assistant output layouts with full reasoning, independent tool details, and frame-synchronized or fading text.

title: MitsukiJoe/dsh-better-ux
description: Web interface enhancements for DeepSeek Harness with session rename/fork shortcuts, a searchable model picker with provider filters, mobile layouts, global font scaling, context usage alerts, DeepSeek balance and tariff rates, sent-message navigation, and conversation summaries.

title: miuzel/dsh-subagent-ui
description: Search, monitor, interrupt, and batch-archive workspace subagents, featuring real-time activity streaming and an active-agent floating panel.

title: MjxUpUp/dsh-visual
description: Interactive HTML or flowchart cards inside the conversation: the tool blocks until the user submits, then returns the clicked action, fields, comments and card state.

title: MKInori/dsh-oneclick-desktop
description: Windows desktop integration, a one-click launcher and tray controller for DSH, plus a sidebar button that puts DSH and a chat.deepseek.com window side by side with one shared taskbar button. Installing it writes a desktop shortcut and registers a dshsplit: protocol, both removed by lib/desktop.ps1 -Mode remove.

title: mkpoli/dsh-workspace-sessions-first
description: Renders a workspace's own sessions above its nested workspace folders in the sidebar's Workspace Tree.

title: ml020/dsh-workbuddy
description: Reskins the DSH conversation hero — brand mark and workspace picker — with a Wordless-style landing view. The native composer stays untouched, and the picker still adds new workspaces (the entry declares its own directory-flow child hole, exactly like the shipped picker).

title: mm24trg2gy-star/dsh-window-keeper
description: Remember the DeepSeek Harness desktop window position, size and maximized state, restoring it on next launch. The window logic lives in a standalone PowerShell script that does not depend on the client version; the plugin shell only installs it, keeps it autostarted and exposes a toggle.

title: MM998LI/dsh-dock-vitals
description: Live CPU, memory and GPU readout in the DeepSeek Harness composer status bar — a clickable badge with a details panel, per-metric toggles, and three refresh speeds.

title: mmyddd/dsh-ccd
description: Rewrites the reasoning row: instead of the raw chain of thought it shows first-person working notes, written segment by segment while the reasoning streams in, with a toggle back to the original. Notes are stored per session so history rows keep them after a reload, the note writer runs on a configured provider or a downloadable local llama.cpp model, and the model still reads the full reasoning.

title: Mobai-read/dsh-chat-index-rail
description: Client-only right-edge chat input index rail: one bar per user message, two-stage hover preview (15 chars, expandable to 40), click-to-jump, and scroll-follow highlight; static npm bundle with no host half.

title: MochiNek0/dsh-ghost-prompt
description: Predicts your next message after each completed turn and shows it as ghost text in the composer: press → to accept, or keep typing and finish it word by word with Ctrl+→, Esc to dismiss. The prediction model follows the session by default or can be picked in the settings card, which also has an on/off switch and a speed test.

title: modusensus/dsh-artifacts
description: Sidebar artifact shelf that collects the images, videos, files and links sessions deliver, deduplicated by SHA-256 content hash, with five filter tabs and counts, keyword search, video thumbnails, a lightbox, manual link saving, image paste, upload up to 25 MB, one-time backfill of past session logs, and a save_artifact tool the model can call. Copies each collected file into ~/.dsh/artifacts (up to 50 MB per file, 200 MB per video).

title: moeform-re/dsh-review-md-preview
description: Markdown preview and rendered side-by-side compare for the changes-review tab.

title: Moh114514/dsh-image-context-menu
description: Adds a right-click menu with five original-image actions — open in a tab, copy the PNG, add to the composer without sending, reveal the file, download — to Codex-generated images and to images you send yourself, as a companion to dsh-codex-subscription.

title: moluotianshen/pro-202611#context-broom
description: A broom button beside the context-usage readout under the web composer. Its frame draws the current occupancy, shifting green to yellow to red as the session fills, with stronger wording and a faster pulse as pressure rises; clicking it compacts the session, preferring a native compact or compress command when one is registered and otherwise folding the oldest ranges that contain no user message through the plugin host route.

title: Mombrane/dsh-subagent-monitor
description: Live subagent run monitor for the Web UI: a sidebar footer trigger plus a fixed top-right card panel showing each subagent of the current session in real time (running/elapsed, terminal outcomes, tree indent), with one-click jump into the child conversation and a return button, refresh-surviving and mobile-hidden by default.

title: momijijin/dsh-session-grove
description: A free-form grouping layer for the DSH sidebar: nest sessions from different workspaces into draggable groups without changing workspace membership or logs.

title: Moolight/dsh-shader-workbench
description: Node-based GLSL workbench: wire a shader graph on a canvas and preview it live, compile it to Shadertoy-compatible GLSL with multi-pass buffers (BufferA–D), hot-reload as you edit, cross-compile to HLSL / MSL / SPIR-V, and keep projects, materials, snapshots and resources (images, audio, lyrics) in a local workspace. Ships 57 built-in nodes, 8 bundled examples and 11 agent tools. No runtime dependencies.

title: Mooling0602/dsh-web-file-uploader
description: A file-upload plugin for the DeepSeek Harness.

title: MoonlitDropOfBlood/DSH-Desktop#whaleharbor-promo
description: Turns a plain-browser DSH session into the WhaleHarbor lite client: a standalone browser --app window with a client-style top bar and task notifications, while the full desktop installer downloads in the background (multi-source, SHA-256 verified) and an install prompt appears when ready.

title: MoonSand/dsh-desktop-restart
description: Adds two buttons to the sidebar footer: one reloads the interface and client plugins only, the other restarts the desktop app together with its Host. A restart is refused while a plugin install is running. Restart is Windows only and returns 409 elsewhere; reload works on all platforms.

title: MoonSand/dsh-ui-optimize
description: Switches that tune how DeepSeek Harness looks and behaves across the whole interface, not just a few screens; each works on its own and more arrive as the shell grows. Theme gallery of eight minimalist themes, each defining one palette for light and one for dark and applied through a single theme-token layer, plus sidebar panel folding that collapses the rail rows into one Panels launcher with search and keyboard control, and reload/restart actions at the sidebar foot. Each feature is gated by runtime detection: what the current build cannot do is disabled with a stated reason, and an unknown probe stays enabled. The sidebar Reload/Restart buttons are ported from the separately listed MoonSand/dsh-desktop-restart; uninstall that plugin before installing this one — with both, the sidebar foot shows two sets of buttons.

title: Moonshile/moonshile-dsh-plugins#dsh-workspace-sort
description: Re-sorts sidebar workspaces by last activity once per day; stable order within the day.

title: moophone/dsh-sidebar-fold
description: Folds every panel row in the sidebar (slot-registered and plugin-injected alike) into one Plugin Hub entry, giving the workspace list its vertical space back.

title: MorGogh/widget-dock
description: Draggable grid-aligned workbench of 28 mini-cards in the margins of the conversation (API balance, token usage, cost, context pressure, todos, goal, usage heatmap, GitHub repo, image relay), with S/M/L/XL size tiers.

title: MorixMa/dsh-download-progress
description: A download-progress indicator for the DSH session header: it reads the background-job roster and parses what downloaders already print — curl --progress-bar, wget, aria2, or a JSON progress file — into a progress ring, animated bars, transfer speed and ETA. Jobs that report nothing show as unknown progress instead of being hidden. A finished file opens with one click, or reveals in the file manager. No third-party plugin required; the package ships zero runtime dependencies.

title: MosCloud/dsh-provider-show
description: Shows which provider the composer's currently selected model belongs to, and stays silent for providers another plugin already presents.

title: mostkia/dsh-htmlui
description: Renders agent-authored HTML/CSS/JS inside the conversation as sandboxed iframes, with POST and SSE back to the model and reusable templates.

title: mostkia/dsh-launcher
description: Adds a power button to the DSH sidebar - Shut down or Restart, each behind a confirmation - and ships a Windows tray launcher that starts DSH without a console window, supervises it so Restart can relaunch it, and offers the same start-at-logon switch.

title: Mr-Elk/dsh-composer-assistant
description: Adds next-message prediction, inline draft completion, and prompt optimization to the DSH composer, with a call budget, request stats, and glossary protection in Settings. A fork of Somnus678/dsh-input-assistant; both put their controls on the same composer, so do not install the two together.

title: Mr-giraffe1/dsh-file-drag
description: Drag a file or folder from the right Sidebar's file tree onto the composer to insert an @ reference to it; also works while answering a question card.

title: Mr-Luo0036/dsh-whale-greeting
description: A greeting card that speaks — 156 prebuilt voice clips with a one-click mute — plus per-turn completion reports, long-run companionship notes and a takeover approval panel in the DSH conversation area.

title: MrGnUm/dsh-continue-button
description: Adds a one-click Continue button beside Send that resumes a stopped turn by sending the "continue" prompt; hidden while a turn is running or the session is empty.

title: mrSutivu/plugin-effort-slider
description: Notched reasoning-effort slider grouped with the model picker in the composer, with theme variables and English, French and Chinese labels.

title: mu915275-cmd/dsh-boot-animation
description: Plays an intro full-frame on a new conversation, or every time you open the one you pinned. Four clips ship inside the plugin itself, embedded in code with no separate video files, and an in-app library switches between them, previews the choice, and accepts your own clip. The picker has two independent sections, so the intro animation and the workspace wallpaper are picked separately; the wallpaper can be a still or a looping tail of the last N seconds, with independent transparency for the picture and the sidebar plus three blur levels. The sidebar and the workspace also get a text colour each, for when the picture is at full strength and the theme own text no longer reads.

title: MuFeng262/dsh-thinking-slider
description: Replaces the composer model selector with a "model · reasoning level" trigger: a slider across every level a model reports, three switchable modes (the DSH native selector, a gradient particle rail, an energy-charge track), and a per-provider one-click fill for models that declare no reasoning levels.

title: mujiannan/dsh-synced-tabs
description: Session tabs for the DeepSeek Harness Web GUI whose open-session set is shared across every device attached to the same host, with workspace grouping, status dots, and a bottom bar that collapses into a drawer on narrow screens.

title: Mulibaixi/dsh-translation-plugin
description: Translation and refinement workspace with topic memory, revision history, and main-model coordination; Normal mode uses the companion Composer extension.

title: MurasakiIzumi/dsh-ticker-jp
description: A floating stock ticker for DeepSeek Harness: real-time quotes for Nikkei 225 and TOPIX ETF out of the box, plus worldwide markets via Yahoo Finance — Japan (.T), US, Hong Kong (.HK), China (.SS/.SZ) and any other symbol — with a customizable watchlist, display aliases and 16 UI languages.

title: mustakimabdullah25-tech/dsh-screen-translator
description: Universal on-screen translator for DeepSeek Harness Web UI: translates text, attributes, Shadow DOM, and iframes across 45+ languages.

title: Muxiuesd/dsh-pixel
description: Pixel art editor in a DSH conversation tab: pencil, eraser, bucket fill and eyedropper on a grid canvas that zooms in whole steps around the cursor; up to eight layers with merge, reorder, rename and full undo; a 36-slot palette whose edits move the old colour to a free slot so existing pixels never change; PNG export written straight into the session directory.

title: MYanhui/DSH-plug-in
description: Adds three settings pages to DeepSeek Harness: add, edit, enable and remove MCP servers; write agent skills by hand or install them from a GitHub repository; and keep a library of global personas with one active.

title: mzjqwq/dsh-sidebar-expand-all
description: Expands every session in the DSH Desktop sidebar. Its control page (/dsh-sidebar-expand-all) applies four equal-length patches to the app.asar workspace client bundle, with backup and one-click restore; after that the "Expand remaining N sessions" row reveals all hidden sessions in one click, collapsing returns to exactly 5, and a workspace reopens fully expanded instead of resetting to five. Needs an app restart, and a DSH update reverts the patch.

title: mzzsfy/dsh-plugin#dsh-context-manager
description: Conversation enhancements: a history-input overlay (Alt+Up, with workspace/session/global/favorite-prompt scopes), recall of interjected messages that were not applied, rewrite-style forking (fork a child session from before a turn and backfill that turn input for editing, including turns whose reply is still running), optional auto-resend after forking (off by default), and a copy-session-id action in the title bar.

title: mzzsfy/dsh-plugin#dsh-settings-nav-icons
description: Section icons for the settings navigation: replaces the uniform gear icons with per-section glyphs and fills the plugin-market card avatar slot with a semantic icon chosen per plugin name; a page reload after uninstall restores the official icons.

title: mzzsfy/dsh-plugin#dsh-think-expand
description: Auto-expands streaming thinking: always keeps the latest thinking block expanded, manual actions take priority, only the last block expands when opening a session, and nothing remains after uninstall.

title: n431mn/lazy-workspace-manager
description: Folder-scoped sidebar for DSH Web: by default only folders you load are listed with their sessions; unload a folder without deleting its registration, mark folders to load at startup, and opening a session loads its registered workspace so it does not fall into Ungrouped.

title: N9-Developer-Empowerment/DSH-Vibeify#dsh-vibeify-experience
description: Turns completed DeepSeek Harness public-content work into a browser-local visual magazine with explicit updates and reviewed one-article sharing.

title: Nagi-ovo/dsh-visualize
description: In-conversation generative UI: the model renders interactive HTML cards into the chat stream, with streaming preview and sandboxed rendering.

title: nailing10086-zx/dsh-custom-ui
description: Right-side file-tree sidebar that opens workspace files, plus a DeepSeek account balance meter in the composer stats line.

title: Naitang1207/dsh-macos-quicklook
description: Adds a space-key Quick Look preview to DSH deliverable cards. Hovering a card and pressing Space opens the native macOS QLPreviewPanel for the file, which covers docx, xlsx, pptx, pdf, images and media that the sidebar preview cannot render. The panel zooms out from the card's position, returns focus to the composer when closed, and exposes hover delay, focus-return and double-click behaviour in Settings > General.

title: Nancy0-0/dsh-code-nav#file-tree-actions
description: Right-click menu and drag support for the Files sidebar on Windows - copy absolute or workspace-relative paths, create files and folders, rename, move entries to the Recycle Bin, and drop a row into the composer to insert an @ reference.

title: NanoShiki/dsh-anki
description: Native Anki workspace backed by one real headless Anki collection: browse, edit, add and review notes, suspend cards, import and export APKG, and sync with AnkiWeb, with the same collection exposed to the anki AI tool. No Anki desktop app, AnkiConnect or Qt is started. Supports Windows x64 and macOS 12 or later (Apple Silicon and Intel). The matching headless Anki core, CPython and all Python runtime dependencies are bundled, so no separate Anki or Python installation is required.

title: NanQing233/dsh-rimlight
description: Adds a comet-like light band that flows along the window edge of DeepSeek Harness — up to four in parallel, colored by each session's model, reversing direction while waiting for your reply, and returning to the composer or the workspace once the conversation ends.

title: nanshang328/dsh-power
description: Windows-only power card injected into the DSH page: the artwork carries two hit zones (left shuts down, right restarts), the first click only turns the card into a yes/no question and the second click fires, and the restart engine stops only this instance's process tree, waits for the port to free, relaunches outside the host's Job Object and confirms the new instance answers on the plugin's own status route.

title: narkco-kang/dsh-team-workbench
description: A named-agent-team chat workbench for DSH: per-member model routes with fallback and 3D mascot avatars; private and group chats with mention relay and bounded parallel lanes; a whole department as one agent whose lead dispatches sub-agents that run in parallel on their own models before the lead synthesizes; record search with hit highlighting and today/yesterday/earlier buckets; a four-layer memory system (raw chats → atomic facts → scene summary → user persona) recalled by hybrid BM25 + embedding RRF; plus an avatar library and local/cloud speech input. Hybrid recall needs an embedding endpoint (default: local Ollama qwen3-embedding:0.6b; otherwise BM25 only); speech input needs a local jianchang512/stt service or a cloud ASR key, otherwise it falls back to the browser speech API.

title: NativeDog1/dsh-boot-animation
description: Plays an intro full-frame on a new conversation, or every time you open the one you pinned. Four clips ship inside the plugin itself — embedded in code, with no separate video files — and an in-app library switches between them, previews the choice, and accepts your own clip. The pin button sits beside Settings.

title: Natsubrei/dsh-comfyui-panel
description: The real ComfyUI editor as a sidebar tab in DeepSeek Harness, with per-session tools that read and edit the graph on screen and a panel that can start, stop and restart ComfyUI without installing anything into it.

title: Natsubrei/dsh-mermaid-panel
description: Renders the open conversation's Mermaid diagrams as a right-sidebar page, one card per diagram, each clickable to open full screen with zoom and pan; the chat's own code block is left untouched, so copying or quoting the source still works.

title: NattoCB/dsh-plugin-pin-session
description: Adds Pin/Unpin to the sidebar session-row menu and a collapsible Pinned Sessions group above the session list, with host-side persistence, hover quick-unpin, collapse memory, and live running-state dots.

title: NattoCB/dsh-plugin-sidebar-views
description: Adds a Workspaces / Recent-sessions switcher above the sidebar list, with a pinned-sessions group, a per-row menu (pin/unpin, copy session id), title filtering, and browser-local pin storage with a one-shot migration from dsh-plugin-pin-session.

title: NattoCB/dsh-widget-center
description: Native macOS desktop widgets for DSH: manage any number of widget instances — share quote tickers (5-provider fallback, trading-phase-aware throttling) and notes memos — each an independent NSPanel+WKWebView window spawned detached from the host, dragged anywhere, with a type-aware right-click menu. Instances are edited as cards in a three-view settings page (list / type picker / detail), and a market_quote model tool serves standardized quotes to any session. A Type Studio flow seeds a creation-mode session with an issue-template prompt for authoring new widget types.

title: NecromanAlbert/dsh-show-media
description: Shows a local image or short video in the current conversation card, with click-to-preview.

title: neobones/dsh-locale-es-cl
description: Adds Chilean Spanish (es-CL) to the Web UI language list: 2,603 strings across 57 namespaces, with per-key fallback to English.

title: NeoXider/neoxider-agent-deck#dsh-agent-deck
description: Opens the NeoXider Agent Deck desktop widget (chat, the slime pet avatar or the hinge handle) from a Harness session, and reports its mode, installed version, running state and whether it follows the same Harness.

title: Neptune810/dsh-power-button
description: Adds a draggable power pill to the DeepSeek Harness Web GUI: a live status dot plus restart and stop actions, where restart is handed to a detached helper that resumes the same boot invocation once the port is released.

title: Nethur-auro/dsh-multi-root-explorer
description: Replaces the sidebar workspace region with a two-tab browser: several workspace roots stay registered side by side while conversations are filed under the real working directory of each session, with a read-only resource tree that previews files in the right sidebar. Hiding is per tab, display-only and fully reversible; a resource folder or file can be copied as a path or dragged into the composer as a native reference, and @ completion covers every registered root rather than the working directory alone.

title: Neumannzc/dsh-archive-manager#plugin
description: Beautified archive-manager settings section listing archived sessions grouped by workspace, with a hover unarchive action and relative timestamps.

title: NEVSTOP-LAB/dsh-gfm-alerts
description: Renders GitHub-flavored Markdown alerts (the `> [!NOTE]`, TIP, IMPORTANT, WARNING and CAUTION callout blocks) in DSH replies as theme-aware boxes with localized titles, and registers a system-prompt section asking the model to prefer them.

title: new2023start/dsh-pomodoro-clock
description: Pomodoro timer for the right sidebar: a draggable edge handle whose floating card follows it, one-shot or full cycle counting, and four synthesized alerts including a spoken airport-style announcement.

title: newbieQQ/dsh-better-workspace-group
description: Fork of z-col/dsh-workspace-groups (MIT): a grouped workspace sidebar for the DSH web client, with a science icon set and a docked default workspace; cannot be installed alongside the upstream plugin (same bundle row).

title: nico-zhuang/dsh-chat-file-actions

title: Nihao7-L/dsh-prompt-chain

title: ninepoin4/dsh-rich-cards

title: NingTiAn-byte/dsh-intelligent-ui

title: NingTiAn-byte/dsh-linked-workspaces
description: Link local project directories from a project context menu, with scoped search, source reading and explicit per-session snapshot synchronization. Supports DSH 0.2.1-alpha.4 and 0.2.1-rc.2 only.

title: NingYuanLee/dsh-image-viewer-pro
description: In-chat image viewer for the web UI: takes over content image clicks (Markdown images, message attachments rendered as blob: URLs, and read_image results) and opens a dialog with pointer-centered wheel zoom and an editable percentage, drag pan, 90° rotation, download with progress, copy as PNG, open with the default app, and ←/→ gallery browsing across the conversation.

title: nirvanaslash/dsh-artifact-preview
description: Adds a produced-files card row to the chat and a resizable split-screen preview panel for workspace artifacts (Markdown, source code, CSV, JSON, images, HTML), plus a localhost port preview.

title: Nishikinov/dsh-sidebar-settings-button
description: Adds a Settings row to the sidebar header before Plugins, which opens the shell's Settings panel.

title: Nixz0824/dsh-composer-alcove
description: Collapses the composer to an iPhone-style home indicator while you scroll, then restores it on hover, click, or scroll up. Corner arcs dock the real composer into the left or right gutter.

title: NKUhan123/dsh-jupyterlab
description: JupyterLab-style notebook for DSH: code and output side by side with a draggable divider, outputs that stick to the viewport while a long cell scrolls, Jupyter keyboard shortcuts (a/b/dd, m/y, Shift+Enter vs Ctrl+Enter), a scissors button to delete a cell and a chip to switch it between code and Markdown. Modified fork of @beihaizb/dsh-notebook: both register the same nb_* tools, so remove the original before installing; the Python kernel you pick needs ipykernel, jupyter_client and nbformat.

title: nnnanann/Deepseek-harness-freeze-content-on-window-resize

title: NoCandles/dsh-stock-bar
description: Always-on quotes strip pinned to the top of the DSH window: watchlist, holdings with share counts and cost price, P&L, candlestick and intraday charts, 5-level order book, trade ledger, price alerts, and streamed AI review of the selected symbol.

title: nohappiness/dsh-linux-shortcut

title: nohappiness/dsh-rightbar-max-keep-rail

title: NOirBRight/dsh-codex-sidebar
description: Codex-style details sidebar for DSH with Files, Review, Browser, and Terminal panes, transcript file links and diff stats, annotations, and Host-managed browser controls.

title: NOirBRight/dsh-llm-assistant
description: Resident Web overlay seat with its own assistant session: chat, images, reminders, a duty heartbeat, and on-demand read-only task reference.

title: NOirBRight/dsh-llm-providers-ui
description: Mounted owner of the LLM Providers Settings page: provider cards, drag-reorder card order, and picker sort.

title: nomxy/dsh-workspace-resizer
description: Draggable splitter between the sidebar panel list and the workspace region, so the session list can grow. Double-click restores the default layout.

title: NoneadChina/dsh-nonead-prompt-recall
description: Shell-style prompt history in the DSH composer: ↑ in an empty composer recalls the previous prompt and keeps walking back, ↓ walks forward to the empty draft; history is kept per workspace, persisted across restarts and records only human input, while typing or editing a draft returns ↑/↓ to normal caret movement. Adds a Settings page to export, import and clear the history.

title: NONEMIN/dsh-sidebar-panels
description: Manage the left global panel list from Settings → General: show or hide entries, reorder them by dragging in the sidebar or in the dialog, and keep entries that have their own sidebar switch in step with it.

title: NormanFxxkingRockwell/dsh-keyboard-history
description: Minimal ↑/↓ input history for the DSH web composer: press ↑/↓ to walk back through sent messages. Nothing else.

title: Nothree-code/folder-tree-sh
description: Workspace file tree for the Web UI: multi-tab preview (text/DOCX/PDF/Markdown/CSV/images), inline Markdown editing, a Git changes panel, and file operations (rename/delete/copy/move/create) via context menu.

title: nothurry/stronger-dsh
description: UI and motion, team sidebar, scoped peer messaging, layered memory and opt-in WeChat notifications.

title: nuet9/dsh-internal-folder-browser
description: Browse local file directories inside Harness with target highlighting and eight view layouts; image thumbnails and native file icons are Windows-only.

title: Nuke0519/dsh-status-box
description: macOS menu-bar status box for DSH: a whale status item shows running / waiting / completed counts and colours, its menu lists sessions grouped by workspace, a top-bar pill mirrors the counts inside the window, and the global hotkey ⌥⌘⇧D opens a single-field capture window that queues a task and sends it to the chosen workspace as a new session (queued while DSH is closed, delivered when it opens). A settings page adds an open-after-send switch. Needs macOS 11 or later, the Xcode command-line tools and the desktop app. The menu-bar part is a separate native helper that you build and install with menubar/install.sh from a copy of the repo: it compiles with clang, registers a login item (LaunchAgent) and listens on 127.0.0.1:59421, where the plugin posts session titles and status every few seconds.

title: null-dat/dsh-whale-tail
description: Four whale-tail animations for the DeepSeek Harness thinking indicator, cycling on every thinking turn.

title: Num86/dsh-functions
description: Adds an extensible Functions menu to the DSH top bar, where plugins register one-click actions with staged confirmations and submenus. Since 0.4.0 it bundles a built-in "Restart DSH" action, so no separate restart plugin is needed.

title: Nyco1d/dsh-prompt-optimizer
description: One-click prompt optimizer next to the composer, with a side-by-side diff panel and per-mode settings. Output length follows your request: ask for a short version and it writes a 350–650 character brief, otherwise it expands to as many as 1400 characters. The prompt templates are original; the official-template comparison mode needs a local Prompt Optimizer installation.

title: NYSM803/dsh-restart-button
description: Draggable floating restart button for the dsh Web GUI (Windows only, dsh >= 0.2.2-rc.1): confirm, then the app and its host close and come back on their own, with a cancel button, a watchdog and a clear failure message. Icon, background colour and position lock are edited in Settings.

title: Oak-liuhj/dsh-todo-progress
description: A task progress sidebar for DeepSeek Harness Web and desktop with a top-right Tasks button, completion percentage, current step, status filters and details; declares DSH 0.2.1-rc.5 or >=0.2.2-rc.1 <0.3.0-0 compatibility.

title: objectivex666/dsh-settings-search
description: Instantly find DSH settings pages, tabs and rows by keyword, pinyin, intent or AI — and jump straight to them.

title: Odefined/dsh-mobile-webui
description: Mobile-viewport fixes for the dsh web GUI: overlay drawer sidebar with swipe gestures, icon-only composer with a mode · model · effort status line, centered popovers, and horizontal-overflow/scrollbar centering fixes.

title: oioiphainon/dsh-widget
description: A transparent always-on-top desktop fish that mirrors the current DSH session - turn, step, tool calls, todos, background jobs and team tasks - with optional login autostart, an option to stay after DSH exits, and a right-click hide.

title: olivine13/dsh-image-scope

title: omdsh-dev/ex-setting
description: Settings extensions for DSH.

title: omdsh-dev/web-components
description: Web Components support.

title: onlyinliu/dsh-ambient-gallery
description: A wall of photographs hung behind the main panel - uneven sizes at their own angles with room to breathe, twenty real landscape photographs shipped to fill it on first run, up to twenty rotating images per frame, rectangles only, the three lowest frames playing a local video, and one shortcut that sends the video back into the rotation.

title: onlyinliu/dsh-session-console
description: Session Console: a sidebar dashboard over every conversation that shows run state, token spend, cache hit rate, context pressure and a heat score, resolves a plain-language sentence such as "how is the example project going" to the matching session, and dispatches that sentence as a queued task into it. Ships five agent tools (overview, find, tail, dispatch, cancel) over the same data.

title: OnTheWay111/dsh-plugin-path-completion
description: Completes @path references in the Web composer: type @ (optionally ./src/ma) to list matching files and directories, pick one with the arrow keys, and the draft receives an @./relative/path reference (quoted when the path has spaces).

title: OolongBlackCoffee/dsh-wuwa-pet
