Talks to the pet over CDP, enabling its debug port with a one-time, revertible byte patch.

title: openAGFS/dsh-agfs
description: File-browser web app for DSH: React frontend and REST API served by the host webserver, a /dsh-agfs command that opens at the current session workspace, and a browse_files model tool.

title: opencues/opencues#integrations-dsh
description: Word alternatives and underscore-gated fill-ins in the composer. End a line with _ and it is filled; misspellings are flagged as you type. Routes through the model dsh is already configured with, so it needs no API key.

title: openma-ai/Martty#npm
description: A DSH-first Rust/ratatui agent TUI with streamed tool calls, subagents, durable sessions, and a Cordis-extensible client UI.

title: orchivo/dsh-conversation-tree
description: A collapsible column beside the conversation that organises conversations into a workspace/topic tree, opens the real sessions in place, and exposes the tree to the assistant through 9 model tools.

title: OrderG-X/dsh-design-studio
description: Design workbench in the right sidebar. Its tools sit in floating groups at the canvas corners and a bottom dock with text labels, and a home screen offers one prompt box, recent designs and large template cards. When the home screen's style is Auto, the plugin picks a style card that fits the subject and hands its colors and fonts to the model; your own words, a chosen card, a reference image or a default brand design system take precedence. Each design gets its own folder. When a design needs photos, the model can copy from a library of 64 AI-generated placeholder images in 8 themes (about 8 MB, downloaded from npm the first time they are needed; made with OpenAI image generation and screened by a person, not real places, products or people); export and handoff remind you to replace them before launch. When the model builds web pages, app screens, desktop app windows, WeChat mini programs, posters, slides, emails or diagrams (mind maps, grant-proposal style technical route charts, product roadmaps and architecture diagrams, with lines and arrows laid out automatically and a fixed size for export to Word or PowerPoint), each HTML file shows up as a screen on a canvas inside a device frame and refreshes when the file changes; screens far from the view show a background thumbnail and load the live page when you move closer; while the model writes a page, the sidebar grows with it and a few cursors draw boxes, fill colors and type where it is writing, with a timer in the status bar; local dev servers are proxied with hot reload intact, and an existing HTML file or folder opens by browsing or by dragging it into the sidebar (desktop app). A design library gathers every design you made in any session, your saved inspiration (reference images, URLs, style cards) and a design market of shared templates, design systems and style cards (16 templates, 3 design systems and 20 style cards to start; search, filters, full-size screens and a live view; an offline copy ships with the plugin): start from one in a click, or share your own design to the market after a personal-data scan and an offline design check; after connecting GitHub once (public repositories only), submitting takes one click, and the web form still works. Mini program screens get the WeChat capsule in the top-right corner, which turns white over a dark top bar, and the design check flags text and buttons hidden under it. App and mini program screens follow platform layout (status and nav bars, a tab bar of 2 to 5 items, safe areas), desktop app screens get macOS traffic lights or Windows caption buttons, and the design check flags content under the Dynamic Island, the home indicator or the window buttons. Click an element or drag a region to put its selector, source file and styles into the composer, or draw on the preview (pen, highlighter, arrow, box, circle, text) and hand the marked-up screenshot to the model; picks, markup and style changes appear in the composer as small chips while the model still gets the full text. It can extract a brand design system from your website or project (colors by role, fonts, type scale, radius, shadows, buttons, inputs and cards) and use it for every new design. The model adds a few tweak sliders to each design (spacing, radius, brand color, layout variants) that update all screens live and write back to the stylesheet in one click. A finished design can be turned into React, Vue, Next.js or plain HTML code, or for mini programs into uni-app or native WeChat code; existing uni-app (including HBuilderX projects without package.json), Taro and native mini program projects are recognized so new pages go straight in, and each built screen is diffed pixel by pixel against the design. Also has a design tokens panel, twenty style presets (each a live sample screen you can open full size), a style panel (font size, colors, radius, padding and more) that writes back to the HTML or hands the change to the model together with the CSS rule and line behind each property, versions saved before and after each turn with drag-to-compare and restore, export to images, PDF and PPTX (links between screens stay clickable), a LAN QR link for viewing on a phone, link arrows and a click-through try-it mode, a multi-size view, in-place text editing, reference-image palettes, and a design check (overflowing, clipped or overlapping text, contrast, tap target size and more). Bundles a ui-design skill and seven tools: preview_page opens a preview; check_design measures every screen at real sizes in a hidden local Chrome or Edge (bars covering content, script errors, missing assets, dead links; CSS file and line for contrast and font-size issues; cropped screenshots of serious problems); look_design hands real screenshots to the model; extract_design_system builds a design system from a site or project; handoff_design writes a handoff pack (screenshots, routes, tokens, shared components); compare_design diffs the built local page against the design and marks what differs. find_photos copies matching placeholder photos from the photo library into the design. Adds a Design mode for new sessions (Standard mode's tools plus the skill, the seven tools and a design persona); each part has its own switch on the Plugins page. When DSH is opened from a phone or another computer, local-file designs are bundled into a sandboxed frame so they still show, and unchanged screens are not sent again. An experimental option, off by default, has the model also write business annotations (rules, states and edge cases the UI does not show), shown as numbered markers on the page and cards in the sidebar and passed on in code handoff.

title: OrderG-X/dsh-pages
description: Lets the model turn an answer into a web page that lives right inside the chat. The show_page tool either fills one of 10 built-in templates (report, compare, checklist, dashboard, timeline, flashcards, quiz, flow, mind map, roadmap), where the model writes only the content and the plugin does layout, interaction and saving, or saves a full page the model wrote itself (calculators, games, custom layouts). The mind map spreads branches to both sides with collapsible nodes; the roadmap draws either a research-proposal style layered technical route, with links that route around boxes, or a quarterly swimlane roadmap with milestones. Hand-written pages get the same design as base styles inside a CSS @layer, so the page's own CSS still wins. The page appears under the reply at its content height, interactive and following DSH's light/dark theme. The page's localStorage is stored in DSH per page, so what users tick or type survives reopening and new versions, and the same page open in the chat and the right sidebar stays in sync. Each edit is saved as a new version you can flip back to. After saving, the page is checked in a hidden local Chrome or Edge (script errors, horizontal overflow, dark mode not applied) and problems go back to the model. The right sidebar shows the page full-size with versions, a gallery of all pages and export to PNG, PDF or HTML. Pages run in a sandboxed, separate-origin frame with a strict CSP: no access to DSH data and no fetch, XHR or WebSocket. Works on phones with dsh-mobile.

title: OrderG-X/dsh-video-preview
description: Plays local video and audio inside the conversation. Media files the model writes during a turn - screen recordings, transcodes, voiceovers - get a player under its final reply automatically when their paths appear in its commands, the command output or the reply; the play_video tool plays any other file. Video shows as compact cards with a hover preview, audio as a slim seek bar, streamed over HTTP Range so long files seek instead of loading into memory. Also registers a sidebar media preview renderer, since the built-in previewer treats mp4 as unviewable. The look_video tool lets the model see a video itself: a hidden local Chrome or Edge grabs frames into a time-labelled contact sheet (or big frames at given times, or a short range frame by frame), checks the audio (silence, too quiet, clipping, one channel only) and the picture (black or frozen frames), and reads MP4 / MOV headers for phone compatibility (codec, HDR, faststart and more), with ffmpeg fixes.

title: orphiczhou/dsh-region-probe
description: A read-only Cordis Inspect provider that lets an agent see the interface it is driving: outline() reports which UI regions the running shell actually rendered, with occupancy, geometry and current or past failure state; snapshot() returns one region's rendered node tree (tag, role, aria-label, own text, geometry, computed styles) addressed by slot key or CSS selector; failures() keeps a history of regions that failed to render and whether they recovered. Regions are addressed by the anchor the shell already writes for every slot, so it needs no region list and covers regions added later or contributed by other plugins. No UI, no tools, no dependencies, no network access.

title: orphiczhou/dsh-session-tree
description: Replaces the left sidebar session list with a tree of every session and its nested subagent descendants, with click-through to each conversation's multi-turn history and a tree_send tool for messaging any continuable session anywhere in the tree.

title: osman3n/dsh-spell-suggestions
description: Right-click menu inside the message composer: for the word under the cursor it checks a bundled English frequency dictionary of about 30,000 words plus a curated list of 182 common misspellings, and offers corrections ranked by edit distance and then word frequency. The same menu keeps add-to-dictionary, cut, copy, paste, select all, undo and redo. The dictionary and the menu are local, so nothing is sent over the network.

title: OStarsO/dsh-processing-status
description: Shows processing time and rotating Chinese tips above the DSH composer.

title: oumaekumiko0821/dsh-splash-gojo
description: Full-screen boot animation for the DSH web client: the boot HTML paints a cover-fit artwork on its first frame, adds a slow settle, a scanning light sweep and a progress HUD, then hands the viewport over when the app mounts. Click or press Esc / space / Enter to skip.

title: outmanwt/dsh-chat-privacy-blur
description: Draws every question and answer in the DSH Web conversation blurred until the pointer rests on that row, and locks the mask to always-blurred while the window is unfocused; one control below the composer switches between off, hover to reveal, and always blurred, remembered per browser.

title: outmanwt/dsh-team-fishbone
description: Session-header fishbone panel for sub-agent assignments, live status, available token and duration metrics, shared task-board entries, and native child-session navigation.

title: overact/dsh-statusline-plus
description: Displays account quotas, Git state, context usage, public API reference costs, Subagent activity, and streaming speed in DeepSeek Harness Web.

title: overFloweee/dsh-foresight
description: Composer add-on for DSH: next-message prediction shown as ghost text, history prefix completion, a one-line recap after each turn, and ↑/↓ recall of earlier prompts.

title: OverToWind/dsh-todo
description: To-do list in the session header: the button cycles through unfinished items and is tinted red, amber or green by due time, and the floating panel adds, edits and ticks off tasks with an optional deadline, with a collapsible done section. Items persist in localStorage and follow the DSH theme.

title: oxlyn/dsh-flyout-sidebar
description: Flyout sidebar with a file tree, uncommitted-changes list and multi-tab file/diff previews; pops out into a standalone browser tab.

title: Oxygen-Wang/dsh-cursorlike-sidebar
description: A Cursor-like sidebar for DeepSeek Harness with file browsing, code editing, Git diffs, terminal, side chat, and Ctrl+L references.

title: oxygenforce/dsh-agent-activity
description: Live done/now/next card above the composer while the agent is still working.

title: ozjxnxh/dsh-prompt-enhance-keyless
description: Adds a sparkle button left of the model selector in the composer toolbar: one click rewrites the draft in place through the host and briefly offers an undo that restores the original text. A Prompt Enhancement settings section picks the lane — the conversation model (the provider/model the next message would use, falling back to the configured default) or a keyless Pollinations channel that needs no login and no token budget but allows one reply per 30 seconds. During that cooldown a click completes through the conversation model instead of being refused, and the first click after the window reopens returns to the keyless channel on its own. The rewrite keeps the draft's language, and a result in a different language is rejected rather than pasted over the draft.

title: OZONGO/dsh-keyboard-shortcut
description: Adds a Keyboard Shortcuts page to the DSH Settings panel with six rebindable commands — permission-mode cycling, reasoning-effort stepping, a status-page and a task-list shortcut — plus PgUp/PgDn input navigation and an optional composer Enter remap.

title: P-PPJ/dsh-chat-search
description: Find text inside the open conversation with Ctrl+F: matches are highlighted in the message text, previous/next step through them, clicking the count lists the matches and jumps to any of them, and the count grows while the scan runs. No collapsed block is opened and the reading position does not move.

title: P1gG0dG0d/dsh-study-ask
description: Opens a dedicated question chat in the right sidebar for text selected in a DSH conversation, so follow-up questions do not push the main conversation away and never appear in the session list.

title: p56568833/dsh-plugin-groups
description: Category tabs (All, Appearance & UI, Usage & account and more) for the Installed list on the Plugins page, remembering the chosen tab; patch plugins named in an editable parent table are indented under the plugin they patch. Display-only, writes no files.

title: Paimonshen/dsh-coding-plugin
description: Coding-learn floating panel: edits and runs Python/JavaScript/TypeScript/PowerShell with exit code and timing, grades JSON course lessons with progress export, keeps Markdown notes and snippet library, and sends code plus a question into the current conversation for the main model to answer.

title: panando/dsh-prompt-optimizer
description: One-button prompt optimizer: rewrites the composer draft via a configurable strategy, with an editable template, few-shot examples, pinned models and reasoning effort.

title: panando/dsh-quote-sidechat
description: Select text in a reply and quote it into the composer as an atomic reference chip: delete the whole chip in one keystroke, click it to scroll back and highlight the quoted turn, and expand it into a bounded reference block at send time so the model can tell the quote apart from what the user typed. Also opens the snippet in a side chat, or copies it to the clipboard.

title: pandaman0759/dsh-msg-queue
description: Adds a message queue to the sidebar foot: park a thought in a collapsible list, then send one entry to the current session when you choose instead of interrupting the running turn. Entries can be edited or deleted, the list holds two rows and scrolls beyond that, and an unsent composer draft is moved into the queue before a send rather than overwritten.

title: PangXitong/dsh-restart-button
description: Power button in the DSH Web UI session header that lets you close or restart the whole DSH process.

title: PaoMoXML/dsh-paste-names
description: Paste non-image files or folders into the chat composer as native @path references, or drag them in as absolute paths, instead of the images-only error.

title: Pasumao/dsh-plugin-workbench
description: Adds a VS Code-style workspace file explorer to the dsh web GUI: file tree, editable preview with syntax highlighting, tabs, line numbers, right-click file operations, and inline image preview.

title: pc439527/dsh-model-provider
description: Provider-first three-level model selector for the DSH Web model seat: pick a provider, then a model from that provider, with inline search on both levels, failed-provider retry rows, and a Model · Provider trigger.

title: pc439527/dsh-side-monitor
description: Sidebar system monitor for the DSH Web UI: live host overview (CPU/memory/network/disk), process list, and Docker container status, all read-only.

title: pearjelly/dsh-heros#agent-loadout
description: DSH-Heros adds a bilingual loadout screen for Agent Presets, tools, and plugins. Preview capability changes, open the selected loadout in a DSH session, and earn XP and cosmetic rewards from completed work.

title: peilopielo/dsh-Visualization
description: Turns a live session into a layered instrument: seven toggleable rings (session, steps, skills, tools, jobs, approvals, file changes), a per-turn timeline, hover and click on every ring node, and per-step ladders drawn beneath the rings. It reads the session log directly and updates as the conversation runs, in Chinese and English.

title: penghao73551/dsh-desktop-quick-actions
description: Two round buttons at the foot of the DSH desktop sidebar on Windows: restart the app without a console window ever flashing on screen, and open the DeepSeek top-up page in your browser. The restart path launches the helper through WMI and wscript so the new process never inherits a console; it verifies the executable path before killing anything and preserves the original command line. Windows 10/11 only (the package declares os: win32).

title: penguin-oo/dsh-pathlink
description: Ctrl+click file paths and links in chat: paths open their folder in the OS file manager (with the file selected), links open in a new browser tab.

title: pengyue-polaron/deepseek-harness-genui
description: Code-first React and TypeScript task apps rendered inline, in Canvas, full screen, or on localhost, with interaction state available to later agent turns and approval-gated MCP and API access.

title: perdakovich/dsh-prompt-edit
description: In-place prompt editing in the web chat: cleanly forks session history at the edited turn, preserves image and file attachments, and auto-archives the superseded branch.

title: PerryLink/dsh-community-bench
description: Adds a Community Bench tab that reads the public task-conditioned registry and shows the same score everyone sees; it does not compute a local score.

title: PerryLink/dsh-composer-history
description: Terminal-style input history for the web composer: edge-first arrow-key recall with exact draft/caret restore, browser-local persisted history, Ctrl+R reverse search, and sliding-context awareness; 0.5.0 adds a smart input layer — cross-session snippets (/save, /load), prompt templates with variables, reuse insights, and compaction-summary highlighting.

title: peter0429-ux/dsh-task-dock
description: A draggable dock in the top-left corner of the DSH window that stacks three groups in one fixed order: sessions blocked on a person (a tool waiting for approval or the model waiting on an answer), then sessions running right now, then results that finished while you were not looking. Each row opens its session, the collapsed chip shows one count per group, dragging the chip or the title bar moves it anywhere while rows stay clickable, and a single Settings row can switch the whole dock off. It observes only: the Host half records the two blocking paths and hands the request straight to the real answerer without changing the decision.

title: ph4310822/dsh-edex-jarvis-ui#bundle
description: JARVIS-style sci-fi HUD shell over the DSH web GUI: electric-cyan VITAL SIGNS / RT-MONITOR / RT-LOG left bar, POWER CORE gauges and a rotating RADAR scan disc on the right with up/down traffic chart, filesystem browser with file preview, and a terminal-styled composer with a JARVIS header strip that follows the active workspace.

title: ph4310822/dsh-edex-ui#bundle
description: eDEX-UI-style shell over the DSH web GUI: system-telemetry left bar with per-core CPU sparklines, encom-globe world-map right bar with up/down traffic chart, filesystem browser with file preview, and a terminal-styled composer that follows the active workspace.

title: Phant0Meow/dsh-meow-smooth
description: Mobile-first UX polish for the DSH Web UI: composer auto-fold, enter-as-newline on phones, compact sidebar/header/settings, zoom and overscroll lock, plus approval/question/completion notifications via in-page cards, Web Push, and webhook — zero dsh changes.

title: philomelcc/dsh-ui-design
description: UI design knowledge base: 99 filterable design cards with live demos, implementation prompts and per-design usage notes, plus an agent tool that finds and applies them.

title: philomelcc/dsh-workbench#workbench
description: Workbench shell: mirrors native sidebar entries into a fixed system bar, adds a second row of page tabs for modules, and exposes a small module API for full-page plugins. The restart button needs an external supervisor (DSH_RESTART_CMD or a scheduled task named by DSH_RESTART_TASK).

title: Phoeky/dsh-refresh-plugin
description: Adds F5 / Ctrl+R page reload to the DeepSeek Harness desktop web UI, which production builds lack by default (the "Reload Page" menu item and bare-F5 accelerator are development-gated). Binds soft reload (F5, Ctrl+R) and cache-busted hard reload (F5 with a modifier, Ctrl+Shift+R, appending a _dsh_refresh timestamp) through a capture-phase client key listener.

title: phoenixyun/dsh-plugin-dlidl
description: Danmaku and live-chat overlays for DSH: stream reasoning and answers as a right-hand chat timeline (bottom anchored, per-row fade, adjustable lifetime) or as Bilibili-style flying bullets across the whole window; mode-specific settings, content filters, and semantic edit announcements while files are being written.

title: phoenixyun/dsh-plugin-live-diff
description: Live streaming diffs for DSH file edits: a floating panel and an edit/write transcript card render the change while the model is still emitting the tool call, and the same reading is painted behind the whole app as a frosted-glass backdrop with liquid-glass refraction, pointer light and an in-app appearance tuner. Relies on DSH-internal client surfaces and replaces the built-in edit/write tool cards; verified on DSH 0.1.5-rc.1 and the desktop app 0.2.1-rc.5 (Windows).

title: Physicolor/dsh-lifeline
description: Right-side message navigation rail for DeepSeek Harness: per-message tick marks, hover-to-expand preview drawer, smooth jump to any historical message, star bookmarks, realtime slide animation with interrupt support, full session index with virtualization, dynamic panel avoidance, official --dsw-* token styling.

title: Physicolor/dsh-ui-harmonizer
description: UI harmonizer for DeepSeek Harness: normalizes unfinished or self-contradictory official UI, reconciles style conflicts between installed plugins, and unifies the visual language via official design tokens — with live-customizable chat width, markdown font size, workspace scale, UI font stack and a rounded center-column card from Settings → General; client-only dsh bundle, zero model cost, no host side, removable without residue.

title: Physicolor/dsh-widgets
description: A customizable widget rail for the right side of DeepSeek Harness: 61 cards covering session stats, tokens and cache, context, background jobs, subagents, machine metrics, OpenCode Go and Command Code quota, session cost, peak pricing and the GitHub review queue. Cards install from an in-rail market into 1-4 column grids and 2x2 or 2x4 tiles, with per-instance settings, a magnification wave under the pointer and a one-click hide. Works on DSH 0.1.x and 0.2.x, web UI and desktop app.

title: picklerick422/dsh-conv-progress
description: Live per-turn progress capsule with an empirical ETA table and a click-to-open turn history, docked under the composer.

title: picklerick422/dsh-motion
description: Popup and overlay motion for DeepSeek Harness: spring clip-morph entrances for nearby popups, fade-up far dialogs, coherent hover bubbles, image-zoom FLIP, and a live-preview settings page.

title: pingg02/dsh-plugins#dsh-desktop-entry
description: Creates a Windows desktop shortcut that starts DeepSeek Harness when needed and opens the Web UI in a Chrome or Edge app window.

title: pingg02/dsh-plugins#dsh-quote-selection
description: Lets users quote selected conversation text with optional notes, then attaches the references to their next message.

title: pkui1mpression-design/dsh-sidebar-installed-plugins
description: Sidebar panel that lists every plugin installed in the current profile and gives each one an enable/disable switch.

title: plolpl789/dsh-raw-html
description: Renders agent HTML output as real UI in the DeepSeek Harness web GUI, with visual cards, KaTeX math, Mermaid diagrams, built-in open-source fonts, and design-spec injection.

title: plyflai/dsh-ux-plus
description: A UX enhancement pack for the DSH web chat: one plugin that collects small interface conveniences, each with its own switch under Settings → UX Plus applied immediately — chat-area font size and reading width under Settings → General → Chat area, a session-row menu that copies the session ID or inherits the conversation into a new session on a chosen model, workspace and session rows ordered by recent activity with 24-hour idle auto-collapse and age labels, and settled ask_user_question cards left expanded. The switch list is generated from its own feature registry, so the pack grows as conveniences are added instead of being fixed at a count.

title: pokereva/dsh-no-enter-send
description: Takes Enter away from sending in the DSH composer: Enter inserts a line break, every Ctrl/Cmd/Alt+Enter variant is swallowed, and messages leave only from the send button. A gray hint in the input box says so before the first keystroke and stays beside the button while typing.

title: poluce/dsh-chat-embed
description: A multi-tab AI chat panel for the desktop app: seven services (DeepSeek, 豆包, ChatGPT, MiniMax, Kimi, Gemini, Grok) each run in their own webview and login partition, and the chat can live in the left navigation panel or in a right sidebar tab — whichever one you open owns it. Desktop app only; logins last until the app restarts unless you apply the optional shell patch (tools/shell-patch) to the desktop app's resources/app.asar, which the panel can check and whose exact command it prints.

title: polychromate/dsh-sidebar-footer-rows
description: Stacks the sidebar footer actions into one full-width row each, and lines their icons up on one left edge.

title: pomelo-ccc/dsh-pi-composer
description: Swaps the composer's model control for a PI-Desktop style picker: a two-pane menu with search and provider grouping, a reasoning-effort slider, ArrowUp/ArrowDown prompt-history recall, and a prompt-rewrite button with undo.

title: PPsz-qqq/dsh-restart-button
description: Restart button at the right end of the session header that restarts the whole client: the Windows desktop app (Electron shell and Host, through the Host's own graceful shutdown) or the dsh web server. It can wait until running turns and background jobs finish, reopens the open session afterwards with one-click continue for interrupted sessions, flags plugin updates that only take effect after a restart, and shows Host uptime and memory on hover.

title: prettyfox/dsh-selection-quote-auto
description: Copies selected assistant text to the clipboard and shows a Comment chip that opens the inline comment box in DeepSeek Harness; the right-click quote menu and Cmd+L still work.

title: prgrmrwy/dsh-sidebar-session-provider-icon
description: DeepSeek Harness plugin: show a provider + model icon in the sidebar for every session, updated live from the composer model selector with a last-request fallback for history sessions; aggregator routes render the provider logo with a 10px model logo in the corner.

title: PrismScopes/dsh-aide
description: VS Code-style local IDE for DeepSeek Harness: Monaco editor, explorer, search, Git, terminal, and language services. With pnpm, run `pnpm approve-builds --all` so the native build of node-pty is allowed.

title: psychiiii/dsh-three-window#personal-web
description: Three-window workbench for dsh web: chat, construct, and a read-only review window side by side for each workspace, per-window hooks, and an anonymous multi-model review that asks before it runs, groups findings by issue, and reports in Markdown.

title: Pudge1996/dsh-composer-stretch
description: Expand button for the DSH Web UI composer — appears at 3+ lines, stretches to near-fullscreen height, auto-collapses on send, and inserts a newline on Enter or Shift+Enter in expanded mode while Cmd/Ctrl+Enter sends.

title: pure-craft/dsh-actions
description: Deterministic project actions shared by people and agents: one actions.json, a right-sidebar run panel, and agent tools.

title: pure-craft/dsh-capability-panel
description: Manage MCP servers, skills, and tools for your agent — true in-context state (loaded/truncated/evicted) and per-session switches.

title: pyf2818/dsh-bili-widget
description: Floating Bilibili video mini-player for DSH — always-on-top window with discover/search/follow-UP channels, auto-playlist, mini & focus modes, persisted watch history and window minimize-to-ball.

title: python3603/dsh-weather-panel
description: Sidebar weather panel: current conditions, 5-day and 24-hour forecasts, an hourly rain chart, temperature history, CMA alerts with graded reminders and county-level matching, a radar mosaic, FY-4B satellite imagery, typhoon tracks, and ECMWF / NW Pacific sea surface temperature charts.

title: pzr-Ryan/dsh-plugins#dsh-always-on-top
description: Adds a pin button to the left of the Windows caption buttons that keeps the DSH window always on top of the desktop.

title: Qcsj777/dsh-process-panel
description: Adds a per-answer Process drawer that streams, in Simplified Chinese, the agent thinking, tool calls and errors for that turn.

title: QDNBD/dsh-panel-pins
description: Sidebar panel management for DeepSeek Harness: a grouped Panels launcher collects global panel rows and third-party plugin entry rows into one searchable menu — the full panel inventory (pinned and unpinned, unpinned open via temporary-pin peek), collapsible group memory, in-menu search with hit highlighting and keyboard navigation, Alt+1..9 direct activation of the Nth visible item, and hover pin/top quick-actions. A Ctrl+K command palette mirrors the inventory with quick commands, a Recent group of last-used panels (MRU, persisted), and named layout presets — save your whole arrangement (pins, top pins, folds, whitelist, icon-only, compact footer) and re-apply it in one click. v1.0.0 adds custom panel groups: define your own groups (inline rename, member picker in Settings) and they render as first-class groups with accurate counts in the menu and palette. Plus a keyboard-reachable right-click context menu, icon-only panel rows, top-pinning with drag-to-reorder, a compact footer with granular sub-toggles, and a Settings page with height sliders, a locale-safe whitelist, pin management, and settings export/import.

title: qgd1850890306-rgb/dsh-todo-checklist
description: Todo sidecar for DeepSeek Harness: turn selected text into a todo, capture todos from a conversation, review them in a left sidebar panel, get due reminders as an in-app popup or an IM bot message, and export everything to HTML, Markdown, Excel, CSV or JSON.

title: qgx1992/dsh-ui-tools
description: Five web UI tools in one plugin: a provider + model two-button selector with reasoning-level control, collapse/expand-all for sidebar workspace groups, a session tab listing the files the session changed (needs kernel 0.1.2-alpha.1+, silently absent on older kernels), a workspace badge next to the session title, and a settings page that toggles them.

title: qgynisc/dsh-inline-pastes
description: Inline image chips for the DeepSeek Harness composer — paste an image and it lands in the text as a numbered chip (image-1.png) with hover preview. Images still ship through the official attachment pipeline, names restart per message, the dock and sent-message thumbnails carry a sequence badge, and a pre-send self-check warns when the names in the text no longer match the images in that message.

title: QianLuo-Ly/dsh-weather
description: Top-centered weather bar for the DSH Web UI: geolocation, current conditions, 12h/7d forecasts and severe-weather notifications via Open-Meteo (free, no API key).

title: QiaoSchoco/dsh-fleeting-light
description: Draws an ambient glow along the window edge and a moving light band around the composer, sharing one colour table and each with its own switch.

title: QiaoSchoco/dsh-lit-shot
description: Screenshot button for the DSH composer on Windows: drag a region over the frozen screen and the picture lands in the draft as a normal image attachment, with a global hotkey and an editable shortcut.

title: qiaozheng9/dsh-side-chat
description: Native DSH /side conversation tabs with a clean transcript and inherited context, hidden from the main session list using independent Session forks and the official chat UI, with timestamps, token usage, streaming and the command menu. Extracted from dsh-better-sidebar 0.29.0 (MIT); do not enable it alongside dsh-better-sidebar's own /side entry — the two command entries conflict, so stop one before using the other. Requires Windows DSH Desktop 0.2.1-rc.5 and dsh-delete-session for confirmed permanent cleanup.

title: qichuang321/dsh-web-terminal
description: Windows terminal dock inside the DSH web GUI. It is the occupant of the shipped shell.bottom slot: showing it splits the screen (the columns shrink instead of being covered), hiding it returns the space and keeps the PTY session alive. Each session is a local ConPTY child spawned through node-pty and rendered by xterm.js over a loopback-fenced WebSocket (backpressure, debounced resize). Other plugins can add terminal or DOM views through a host registerView API and a window CustomEvent channel.

title: qinpeizhan77/deepseek-harness-novel-studio
description: Local-first fiction workspace that links outlines, chapters, characters, timelines, writing rules, and continuity checks to the conversation.

title: qipengxiang/dsh-chat-actions
description: Hide or show each button under an assistant reply, reorder them by dragging, and collect the hidden ones behind a single ⋯ button.

title: qipengxiang/dsh-enter-combination
description: Rebind which key sends a message and which key starts a new line in the DeepSeek Harness composer; Enter sends and Cmd/Ctrl+Enter breaks the line by default, and either chord can be re-recorded from a settings page.

title: qipengxiang/dsh-message-quote
description: Quote any message of the current conversation into the composer: pick one from the @ menu, click the quote button on a user or assistant message, or select text and use Quote in the right-click menu. Quotes show as numbered chips in the composer and as summary bubbles above it; after sending, each quote becomes a fenced block so the model can tell quoted text from new text.

title: QIRSHENG/dsh-tray-restart
description: Adds Restart App and Host, Reload Page and Force Quit items to the Windows system tray of the official DSH desktop app by patching app.asar in place, and re-applies that patch after each desktop update.

title: QIUZAIYOU/dsh-composer-rewind
description: Composer history that restores the whole input state: composer contents, image and file attachments, @ references and slash commands, plus the model, thinking effort, permission and agent preset used.

title: QIUZAIYOU/dsh-panel-control
description: Rearranges the panel entries at the top of the DSH sidebar: drag to reorder or sort alphabetically, hide an entry without unloading its plugin, and split entries into named groups that render as titled separators; group headers collapse on click. A layout guard caps the entry list height and makes it scroll, so a growing list no longer squeezes the session and workspace panes out of view. An optional switch lets the profile's default model propose groups, and the host whitelists the returned ids and labels before they are stored locally.

title: qiuzhiyei/dsh-companion
description: Desktop pet companion for DSH with live task HUD, token and cost stats, balance and peak-hour alerts, reasoning-effort control, current and history conversation search, and session management.

title: qiweiii/dsh-brand-studio
description: Custom branding for the shared DSH Web UI: a Settings → Branding panel for the name, badge, and local logo/wordmark images with size and rounding, live preview, optional page-title brand, and reset to the official look.

title: qjcnmd/dsh-reasoning-slider
description: Codex-style reasoning-effort slider embedded in the model selector.

title: qrak/dsh-mode-switcher
description: Adds a Plan/Build switch to the composer chip and to the Tab key, keeping a separate model and reasoning effort per mode and restoring them on every toggle, /plan, and plan approval.

title: qrxf/dsh-workspace-graph
description: Draggable bubble graph of DeepSeek Harness workspaces and sessions in the Web UI: workspaces are large bubbles, sessions are small ones, and lines show real membership. The canvas supports pan, zoom and fit; filters cover workspace, status, type and archive state; search covers workspace names, paths and session titles; native actions open or create sessions, rename workspaces, and archive or restore sessions. Layouts are saved in the browser.

title: qt9494/dsh-seeyon-workbench
description: Seeyon workbench that mounts OA to-dos and meetings, the skill catalog, and one-click aTrust VPN in one panel. Its vendored modules replace the author's dsh-seeyon-todo, dsh-skillhub and dsh-vpn — install this bundle or those plugins, not both. Requires a Seeyon OA account; the VPN part is Windows-only and needs the Sangfor aTrust client.

title: Quinn2006/dsh-guise
description: Persona wardrobe for DeepSeek Harness: save multiple personas, apply them globally or per workspace, with a master switch, an adjustable API balance guard, and a lazy token-loving tired mode that speaks on the agent's behalf when quota runs out. Files-as-config, hot reload, zero dependencies.

title: Qulierm/dsh-macos-settings-shortcut
description: Restores Cmd+, to open the existing Settings dialog in DeepSeek Harness on macOS.

title: qwert702/dsh-auto-translate
description: Full-pipeline Chinese translation for the dsh web GUI: live translation of the model reasoning as it streams, in-place Chinese below each English reply, and one-line Chinese summaries for tool outputs and tool-call glosses — a standalone provider request that never enters the session transcript.

title: qwerty-k-de/dsh-attach-picker
description: Toolbar picture button in the DSH Web composer: click to pick multiple images through the native file dialog — they join the same draft-image rail as drag-and-drop and paste, with the host image-format, per-message-count and per-image-size limits enforced inline.

title: qwh15622336051/dsh-prompt-optimizer
description: Rewrites the composer draft into a precise prompt with a configurable model and a fully editable rewriting instruction; reads the content behind @file, @folder and @session references for context and keeps the reference chips intact; offers a one-click undo that restores the text you wrote yourself, and places the button in either composer toolbar with an adjustable colour and size.

title: qwq-wny/dsh-eta-forecast
description: Adds an ETA widget to the DSH web and desktop UI that estimates when the current turn will finish from the todo list and step pace, and shows the remaining time, a progress bar and a confidence badge.

title: qwq1999/dsh-panellist
description: Panellist manager: reorder the entries on the left rail, rename them, replace their icons, hide them, and fold several into a Group with a flyout menu, from a Settings tab.

title: qys0012/dsh-hotspots
description: Real-time hot topics panel for the DSH web GUI: AI news and engineering news, each item with a distilled summary and the source link, shown from a sidebar entry with three views, keyword/source filters, read-state marking and hotkeys.

title: qyw233/dsh-deeplink
description: Deep links: open a specific session or workspace via `?session=` / `?workspace=`.

title: qzz19970504/dsh-model-picker-control
description: Model picker control for the DSH composer: a settings section beside the built-in Models page renames model display names and provider group names, adds a short coloured suffix capsule after a name, groups models from different providers into a new partition, reorders provider groups by drag or keyboard, sorts models inside a group by catalog order or name, and hides a provider or a single model without removing it from the catalog. Edits stay in a draft until you press Save, and the built-in 1017 tag and a custom capsule can be shown side by side.

title: Rabbit-bot-No-002/dsh-chat-avatar
description: Adds an avatar to the left of each turn's final AI reply and to the right of each user message; upload your own image and set its size and circle or square frame.

title: RadicalGitter/dsh-ui-translate
description: Translates visible Chinese UI and content in DeepSeek Harness Web, using a browser-local OPUS-MT model for session titles, workspace names, messages, search results, and opted-in plugin prose while keeping remote translation limited to allowlisted UI labels.

title: RAFOLIE/dsh-desktop-windowos
description: Windows tray desktop shell: auto-installs and auto-updates the exe from GitHub Releases, creates desktop shortcuts for both the app and the web UI, and exposes a desktop_launch tool to start it from the conversation.

title: Ragnoryok1/dsh-client-locale-ru
description: Russian for the dsh web GUI: the whole interface plus the menus of 520 third-party plugins — 584 sections, 67,666 strings.

title: railgun20001/dsh-session-row-actions
description: Turns the buttons at the end of each sidebar session row into a configurable row: every action of the official "…" menu can be ticked as a hover button and reordered by dragging, and right-clicking a row opens the official "…" menu (pin / rename / fork / archive / copy session ID). The hover-button list and the more-menu list sort independently, and both are configured on this plugin's own page.

title: RAK7S/dsh-task-tree
description: A draggable task-tree panel inside the chat page: capture tasks by voice or text, drag to reorder, edge-snapping collapse, and a plain-text queue file you can edit or version yourself.

title: RAK7S/dsh-weather-whisper
description: Weather card once per session: remembers your home city so a VPN never moves it, inline city picker, theme presets, custom separators, optional TTS hook for third-party voices.

title: Rakanrkk/dsh-sidebar-scroll
description: Shares sidebar navigation scrolling with Projects lists; supports native workspace scroll handoff and legacy outer scrolling (DSH 0.2.2-rc.1).

title: rakibulrocky14/dsh-cli
description: Full-screen terminal TUI for DeepSeek Harness with Web-GUI parity, live streaming, agent presets, and DeepSeek blue styling.

title: ralcer-he/dsh-progress-lens
description: A right-side panel for long-running tasks: every so often it says in plain words what has been finished, what is happening now, and what comes next — and now and then it mutters a thought of its own, the kind that is not progress at all: a doubt, a small smugness, something that looks off. Progress notes stay dry and third-person; the asides are rewritten into a short first-person sentence, shown as a lighter italic line beneath, and stay silent when nothing is worth saying. Read-only, never touches your session, and you can ask it a question or just chat while the task keeps running. Requires the dsh-better-sidebar plugin, whose right sidebar hosts the panel.

title: ramwin/dsh-workspace-tree-status
description: Shows an aggregated session-status dot in front of every folder in DSH Web's sidebar workspace tree — waiting for input, just finished, or running — and bubbles the sessions of nested workspaces up to their parent folder.

title: rans725/dsh-workspace-ranswork
description: Sidebar workspace panel that switches between running tasks and all conversations, shown as one freely sortable card list with per-card pin, rename, copy ID, fork, stop, and archive actions.

title: Raphaelutumn/dsh-mood
description: A tiny behavioral mood ring for AI coding agents — folds session behavior (consecutive failures, repeated calls, activity) into a four-state Mood (GOOD / CONFUSED / FRUSTRATED / OVERWHELMED) shown as a low-friction session-header status light.

title: Ratevoid/dsh-aseprite
description: A browser pixel-art and sprite animation editor with Aseprite-compatible files, local crop/outline blueprints, and optional LLM workflow nodes.

title: RaulLazaro/dsh-preview-plugin
description: Live preview tab for DSH — embed any dev server in an iframe with transparent SPA proxying.

title: raven3005672/dsh-plugin-highlight-notes
description: Highlight or quote any passage of an answer, attach a note to it, then send the excerpt back to the composer as a quoted instruction.

title: Ravi666688/dsh-screen-glow
description: Edge glow for DeepSeek Harness: blue while it drives your mouse and keyboard, amber while it asks a question, red while it waits for approval, plus a top banner naming the current action. Desktop only: the overlay is a separate Electron process (auto-detected from the DSH desktop app or dsh-pet; override with DSH_ELECTRON_PATH) and stays dark without one.

title: rayafriandion/dsh-oc-tui
description: An opencode-inspired terminal UI for DeepSeek Harness that boots as a dsh profile app plugin, with a session sidebar, streaming chat, markdown tool cards, todo lists, slash-command suggestions, a telemetry footer with a context meter and inline approval prompts.

title: Rayle8/dsh-aside-note
description: Per-session note list beside the conversation: a button at the top right of the chat badges the open count and opens a resizable right-side panel where notes are added, checked off, copied, edited or appended to the chat input, with panel size and drafts kept in the browser.

title: RCYD857/857-dsh-file-attach
description: Drag or paste files or pictures into the DSH Web composer as one scrolling row of chips, sent as @path references.

title: ReachGa0/dsh-desktop#plugin
description: DSH plugin (dsh-desktop-launcher) that launches the dsh-desktop Windows Electron shell from the conversation: double-click to run the DSH web in a standalone window, region screenshot with GPU-accelerated selection that auto-pastes into the chat (works with vision bridges), system tray, session manager, auto environment setup, configurable port, single-instance lock.

title: realguan/dsh-deepseek-chat-embed
description: Embeds chat.deepseek.com directly inside DeepSeek Harness desktop with persistent login sessions and dual-entry chat panels.

title: realguan/dsh-mermaid-preview
description: Render Mermaid fenced code blocks as native diagram cards with 8 design-system themes and adaptive layout.

title: realhacker/dsh-theme-colorizer
description: A Deepseek Harness plugin that gives its UI color themes.

title: REALOIYO/dsh-ember
description: Composer UI for DeepSeek Harness that does two things. The reasoning-effort row in the model menu becomes a continuous slider drawn on the row itself, with the rungs read live from the model adapter so any ladder length works; each rung paints its own ember plume into a canvas behind the knob. Separately, the permission trigger renders in the theme error colour whenever full access is the active preset, including its row in the permission menu.

title: REALOIYO/dsh-settings-button
description: Adds a gear button beside the sidebar account row that opens the Settings panel in one click. It runs the host's own settings.open command, so it reaches the shell store directly instead of going through the account menu, and the behaviour is identical on desktop and on a phone over the LAN where no keyboard shortcut is available.

title: Rearpoem/dsh-link-start
description: Replaces the DSH startup screen with an ~18 s anime-style Link Start dive whose check, language, log-in and confirmation scenes show your own DSH status (profile, plugins, default model, workspaces, sessions, UI language). Click or press any key to skip; plays a gentle ~10 s version under reduced motion and lowers effect quality on slow machines. Unofficial fan work.

title: rebornace/dsh-agent-enhancer
description: Agent enhancements for DeepSeek Harness Desktop: prompt history, one-click optimize with undo, next-prompt prediction, conversation and tracked-file restore, model bill, context details with compact, Auto routing, and per-provider DeepSeek balance.

title: redfox-data/redfox-skill-gallery
description: Adds a sidebar entry that opens a card gallery of all Red Fox Community skills from the redfox-community-dsh plugin.

title: reg4916/dsh-bar#plugin

title: rex178178/dsh-turnbar
description: Video-style turn navigation for the Web UI: full-map progress bar with hover preview cards (tools/files/tokens), drag scrub, ⌘K in-conversation search, ⌘↑/⌘↓ stepping, Esc-return. Event-log powered — works beyond the loaded window. Dual-half plugin on the official composer.dock slot.

title: rezon-aki/dsh-streamfold
description: Streaming fold for the DSH web transcript: the newest thinking window opens itself, older process rows fold into one summary, and a finished turn glides back to your prompt, which stays pinned while you read.

title: rg2304luyue/dsh-pa
description: A diamond button in the composer that rewrites your draft into a structured prompt and puts the original draft back when clicked again.

title: Ri0n72Y/dsh-workspace-scope
description: Per-workspace Skill and MCP enablement for DeepSeek Harness: control which skills and MCP servers new sessions load, per project.

title: Rice00/dsh-job-progress
description: Live progress for long-running background jobs in the DSH web GUI: a draggable floating ball in the session that owns the job, expanding into a panel with done/total, speed and ETA.

title: Rice00/dsh-loupe
description: Explain a selected word or sentence from a DSH conversation in a floating window: a channel of its own that leaves the session untouched, and the answer can be pinned to a session of its own.

title: Rick1125/dsh-beads-viewer
description: Beads issue browser in the right sidebar: filter and search the tracker with live ready and waiting counts, read issue Markdown with clickable project-file and issue links, and copy or insert the issue id. Requires the bd CLI on PATH and a project with a Beads workspace.

title: Ricketts-Guo/dsh-shortcuts
description: Fully customizable keyboard shortcuts for the Web UI: 34 pre-registered features (sessions, views, clipboard, models, silent permission cycling, settings), one-click recording to bind your own, and a shortcut cheatsheet with built-in diagnostics.

title: ridistant8-art/dsh-cookie-meter
description: Windows-only floating percentage meter for the DSH desktop (0.2.x) cookie jar: it estimates how much of the request-header budget the dsh-auth cookies occupy, turns red past half, and clears the jar on the next launch with one click, avoiding the lockout that hits after roughly 72 launches.

title: riesbri/dshline#dshline
description: Terminal-native TUI frontend for DeepSeek Harness that presents sessions, models, plugins, jobs, subagents, todos, and provider configuration through Harness capabilities while preserving real terminal scrollback.

title: rinsoraa/dsh-pulse-rail
description: Turns the DSH turn-navigation rail into a music visualiser: each thin bar grows and thickens with its own frequency band, from system audio captured with WASAPI loopback. Geometry only, no colour or glow, and the rail keeps its native hover preview, click-to-jump and wheel scrolling.

title: rivenshanghai/dsh-toomuch-plugins
description: Collapses the global panel entries above the workspace in the DSH Web sidebar into a single toggle in the sidebar footer.

title: RockChen87/colorful-notes-dsh
description: Colorful sticky notes for the DeepSeek Harness sidebar, with add, edit, bulk delete, and daily, weekly, monthly or one-time reminders.

title: Roilkl/dsh-daicat-pet
description: An animated cat companion for the DSH chat UI. It reacts to session states, shows editable click-to-read lines and per-turn token counts, and supports dragging with a squish effect, left/right flipping and Ctrl+wheel resizing.

title: romany-saad/dsh-plugins#dsh-drafts
description: Get back what you typed and walked away from: a new Web conversation you leave before sending never appears in the sidebar, so its draft is out of reach. This plugin lists those drafts above the composer of the next new conversation, newest first, with their workspace and time; Open takes you back with the text and chips in place, and Discard drops one, with Undo.

title: romany-saad/dsh-plugins#dsh-quote
description: Show the model exactly which part you mean: select passages in a Web conversation and they go into your next message as composer chips, each with an optional note you can edit. Quoted passages stay highlighted until you send, hovering a chip shows the full quote, and the sent message shows each quote as a card.

title: roninni/dsh-central-editor
description: Workbench panel that browses, edits and reviews workspace files next to the chat, with per-hunk keep and rollback.

title: rsbsnv/dsh-mobile-adapt
description: Mobile layer for DSH Web: swipe-gesture drawer sidebar with adjustable width, layered back key, bigger tap targets, Enter inserts a newline instead of sending, keyboard avoidance and a 15px font floor.

title: ruaibeite/dsh-files-to-chat
description: Right-click a file or folder in the right sidebar file tree to add it to the composer as an @ reference (⌘/Ctrl and Shift multi-select insert a whole batch), open it with the default application, or reveal it in the system file manager. Open and reveal go through the built-in open-in-app host capability, so those entries appear unless the host explicitly reports the capability as unsupported.

title: ruaibeite/dsh-input-polish
description: A polish button in the composer trailing controls that rewrites the draft in place with the model. Context is matched by topic, not by recency: anchors from the draft (paths, identifiers, quoted text, CJK bigrams) pick the earlier messages about the same task, so a session that interleaves several tasks does not leak another task goal or files into the rewrite — and the prompt explicitly lets the model ignore the extract when it does not fit. The result goes back through the same undo-able editor path a human edit uses. Drafts holding reference chips (@file, folder, session) or a claimed /command, and drafts mid-submission, disable the button instead of silently dropping references.

title: ruanimal/dsh-sidebar-panel-buttons
description: Collapses the DSH Web sidebar panel menu (plugins, extensions, scheduled tasks, IM) from a vertical labelled list into a horizontal row of 36×36 icon buttons with hover tooltips; a Settings → General option switches back to the list and is remembered per browser.

title: Rudyy898/dsh-drag-path
description: Like Codex/Claude Code: drag any file or folder (no format limit) onto the DSH web page and its real absolute path is inserted into the composer instantly — no typing paths by hand. Workspace-first smart lookup, size checks, same-name picker, batch and clipboard paste support, Windows/macOS.

title: ruide92/dsh-project-atlas
description: Project Atlas: a local-first DSH workbench that gives every project a readable name and one-sentence intent, merges duplicate project folders after confirmation, and tidies stale projects without deleting files.

title: Ruiming-cn/dsh-ask-in-sidebar
description: Ask a sidebar assistant about selected assistant text: an ephemeral right-side panel answers from a snapshot of the main conversation's LLM history with streaming Markdown, collapsible thinking and multi-turn follow-ups, without touching the main conversation.

title: Ruiming-cn/dsh-better-at
description: Fast `@` file/session reference caching for the DSH Web GUI: preloaded indexes, browser-local keystroke filtering and native mention serialization.

title: ruisenbai/dsh-turn-fold

Changes browser presentation only. Requires DSH 0.1.5-alpha.1.

title: ruiyukirin/dsh-prompt-optimization-master

Bytes stream over a Host HTTP Range route (with a tokenized loopback source so the progress bar can actually be scrubbed inside the desktop app), and the player adds wheel zoom, drag pan, frame stepping, speed and volume popovers, and a built-in guide that points at every control.

title: Ryuu-64/dsh-find-all
description: Search titles and saved text across ordinary DeepSeek Harness (DSH) conversations in all workspaces, optionally including archived chats, with Ctrl+F / Cmd+F search inside the current conversation.

title: S-anZZz/dsh-deepseek-web-sync

No check-ins, no model calls, no chat uploads.

title: SkyblueeeLabs/dsh-iconic-launcher
description: Customize the DeepSeek Harness desktop shortcut icon: pick a preset or upload an image, auto-remove the white backdrop, build a multi-size ICO, and write the shortcut in one click.

title: skyhancloud/dsh-client-ui-quote
description: Adds a removable quote banner above the web chat composer for text selected from an AI reply, included in the next message.

title: SkylerFee/dsh-sidebar-rail
description: Adds an auto-hiding icon rail to the collapsed macOS Desktop sidebar, with workspace pinning and flyouts for recent sessions, scheduled tasks, user-installed plugins and account information.

title: skyline66/dsh-desktop-clock
description: A draggable floating clock for the DSH Web GUI with analog and digital faces, a focus timer, four themes, and persistent placement.

title: skyline66/dsh-family-budget
description: Monthly household budget page in the sidebar: income, fixed and variable expenses, savings, emergency fund, debt and a month-by-month review, with totals, per-item budget differences and a savings, debt or home goal. Bookkeeping only, no investment advice.

title: skyline66/dsh-sticky-notes-wall
description: Sticky-note wall in the sidebar with pasted images and text, due reminders, done state, shortcuts, a pin-on-top floating window, appearance skins, and a native always-on-top Windows desktop window.

title: skyzzq/dsh-file-view
description: Converts file paths in chat to clickable links with sidebar preview, external editor opening, and theme customization.

title: skyzzq/dsh-think-timestamp
description: High-precision East-8 thinking timestamp and duration counter for DeepSeek Harness desktop without prompt modification.

title: sleep123937/dsh-assist-chat
description: Side chat for the right dock: branches the current conversation into its own Session so follow-ups never derail the main thread. Reuses the product Conversation surface, so streaming, tool calls, Stop and the composer behave exactly like the main chat.

title: SmailPang/dsh-effort-slider
description: Replaces the native DSH reasoning-level option list in place with a draggable Off, Low, High, and Max slider while preserving the official model-selection flow.

title: smellingtiger/dsh-files-menu
description: Right-click menu for the DSH workspace file tree: open a file, expand or collapse a folder, copy the absolute path, relative path or name, and reveal the item in the file manager.

title: SmileBuild/dsh-planchart
description: Publishes a project plan the agent writes: ordered steps in a panel docked to the right of the frame, and the framework graph as an auto-laid-out diagram in its own centre tab, downloadable as SVG or PNG. Charts are rebuilt from the session log, so they survive restart and resume.

title: smithtomge-alt/dsh-shortcuts-prompt
description: Adds a strip of saved prompts above the composer: click a chip to insert its text at the draft caret, and manage the list — add, edit, reorder, delete — in an inline panel that opens in place. Prompts persist per profile and are also exposed to the agent as a quick_prompts tool; a fresh install starts with no entries.

title: smj-1680/dsh-plugin-liquid-glass
description: A liquid glass UI plugin for the DSH desktop app. Works alongside most wallpaper plugins. Currently supports dark mode only.

title: SMSMy/dsh-arabic
description: Bidi-safe RTL rendering for mixed Arabic and English text, a full Arabic interface pack (3,307 strings) registered through the DSH locale service, and three thmanyah cuts — Sans for the interface, Serif Text for reading, Serif Display for headings — placed behind whatever font the app itself is set to.

title: snnnnke/dsh-folder-launcher
description: Adds folders to a running DSH Web workspace from the Windows Explorer context menu and starts dsh web automatically when needed; the menu itself requires a one-time per-user PowerShell installer run from a repository clone (no admin rights).

title: SnowBeatRain/dsh-offwork
description: A DeepSeek Harness page companion with animated characters, a clock-out countdown, estimated earnings, hydration reminders, quiet time and salary masking, with separate cards opened from the context menu.

title: SnowCrescenter-tech/dsh-milestone
description: Git-style dot timeline on the right edge of the DSH web UI: one dot per user message, hover for content and metadata (time, turn, duration, TTFT, tokens), click to jump. Also adds a full-session message list, in-session and cross-session search, bookmarks with #msg= deep links, and keyboard navigation.

title: snowowowo/dsh-manim-card
description: Adds a manim_card tool that renders Manim Python into a playable animation card in the chat stream; the code runs in the browser on a bundled runtime, so no local Python is needed, and video export goes through the local Manim CLI when installed or frame by frame in the browser otherwise.

title: Sodapopper-pixel/dsh-cot-translator-plus
description: Reasoning translation for the DSH Web UI: template HTTP translation sites, or a model route through a Harness-registered provider or a custom OpenAI-compatible provider declared in the plugin.

title: SOH4C4759/dsh-ui-sound
description: Audible feedback for the DSH web interface: button presses are classified by semantics (normal, primary, toggle, send, close, danger, link) and the current session's task transitions (started, finished, failed) plus any pending interaction play a cue, each scenario with its own cue picker and switch on a settings page. All 78 cues and 12 sound packs are synthesised in the browser with the Web Audio API, so the package ships no audio files and makes no network request. A community port of dsh-plugin-uisfx to DSH 0.2.0, with the ported changes recorded in PROVENANCE.md.

title: solstice621/dsh-better-answer-view
description: Embeds charts, comparison tables, and interactive blocks between answer paragraphs, with locally saved state and revision history.

title: Somnus678/dsh-input-assistant
description: Prompt optimization, next-sentence prediction, inline completion, and per-session draft stashing for the DSH input box.

title: SonettoGu14/dsh-mcp-status
description: MCP server panel for the DeepSeek Harness Web GUI: the sidebar lists every @deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client row — including rows inserted by other plugins — and derives its connection state from the loader fiber, the mcp__<server>__* tools still registered, a TCP probe of HTTP endpoints and the last connection test; it shows the row's configuration, enables or disables it by editing only that row of the patch file, reconnects once after a failed attempt, and reports unavailable servers to the agent through a system-prompt note plus a call gate that refuses their tools instead of letting each call fail at the transport.

title: songliu1992-glitch/dsh-fenggu-time
description: Titlebar badge showing the current DeepSeek API pricing period — peak hours in yellow, off-peak hours in green (off-peak rates are half of the peak rates) — with a holiday table that refreshes itself once a year.

title: SongMiao-tech/dsh-prompt-optimizer
description: Optimize Prompt button under the composer: one click rewrites your draft into a clearer, more executable prompt, with a before-and-after dialog and one-click replacement.

title: songoao25/dsh-bottom-info-bar#plugin
description: Bottom info bar for the DSH Web UI: provider/model, live balance, peak/off-peak pricing with countdown, and real persisted per-session spend in a single line.

title: songshuhuoban/dsh-next-input
description: Suggests the next user reply in an empty composer after the assistant finishes, using the session model and rolling context summaries, with Tab to accept.

title: SorenLorn/dsh-otaku-study-board
description: Sorchron Study Board, a study workspace plugin with pomodoro timer, task management and activity heatmap for DSH harness. Records stay in the browser's localStorage (JSON export for backup) and the plugin makes no network requests.

title: SoulZhou/dsh-multi-root-files
description: Sidebar file tree that covers the session workspace root together with every additional root registered through multi-root-workspace, so sibling checkouts are browsable from one tab. Directory levels load lazily, changed and untracked files carry Git markers, and clicking a file opens its content inline beside the tree. Read-only: it never writes, renames or deletes anything. Needs the dsh-better-sidebar plugin, which serves the directory listings; its own routes (roots, git status/diff, image preview) take absolute paths from the page and have no DSH access check.

title: southcul/demian-trade-suite-dsh-plugin
description: Adds a Trade Desk panel to the DSH sidebar for foreign-trade documents and container loading: quotation, PI/CI/PL/contract/customs documents, carton loading plans and a step-by-step loading animation. The existing offline single-file workbench is served same-origin inside the panel.

title: SouthernSibyl/dsh-quick-prompt
description: Adds a composer button that rewrites the current draft into a precise prompt in place, in one click, with a revert action.

title: southsnowL/dsh-bulletin#dsh-bulletin-panel
description: Sidebar panel for the announcement file and the ticket status table. It lists the announcements together with how many sessions have seen each one, shows the delivery status, and lets the user post, edit and delete entries. Requires the third-party dsh-better-sidebar plugin.

title: SOVLOOKUP/dsh-cloud-download
description: Adds download actions to DSH delivery cards, changed-file review, and the document preview, and hides native open controls that cannot work when the Host is remote or headless. Needs DSH Web; the native open controls are hidden by default and can be restored per browser.

title: SOVLOOKUP/dsh-settings-footer
description: Moves Settings out of the sidebar footer account menu into its own row at the top of the sidebar, hides the 新会话 new-session button, and hides the sidebar footer: the account launcher, the footer settings cell, and the plugin-runtime badge. Cmd/Ctrl+N still starts a session and Settings is still reachable.

title: spidu-lee/dsh-refresh
description: Make F5, Ctrl+F5, and Ctrl+Shift+R reload the DeepSeek Harness page.

title: SpookySandwich/dsh-plugin-smooth-stream
description: Better streaming text animation for DeepSeek Harness.

title: sqfcyily/dsh-workspace-files
description: Browse the directories/files of the workspace in DeepSeek Harness Web GUI and display file changes in conjunction with Git.

title: SSShooter/dsh-mindmap-live
description: Live, bidirectional mind map for DSH Web built on Mind Elixir: the agent and the user edit the same tree in real time in a docked panel or fullscreen, with PNG export and open-in-desktop.

title: stallenlu/dsh-sticky-notes
description: A sticky-notes panel for DSH with a draggable floating window, a full sidebar page, Markdown preview, pasted images and configurable settings.

title: starighterily-art/dsh-line-tight
description: Sets the chat transcript's markdown line height and paragraph gap, both adjustable under Settings > General.

title: StarMoon-win/dsh-restart-plugin
description: Adds a sidebar Restart button to DeepSeek Harness Desktop on Windows that stops the whole application process tree and reopens the app.

title: StarsHarryZhu/dsh-intelligent-UI
description: Interactive cards in replies, built from a fixed catalog of 31 components (sliders, inputs, sortable tables, charts, function plots, typeset formulas, tabs, checklists, flowcharts, quiz buttons, an animation player): controls recompute in the browser without another model call, and the model never writes HTML or JavaScript. Includes a calculus engine (integrals, derivatives, limits, sums, roots, Taylor polynomials) and a bundled skill that teaches the model when to use a card.

title: stephenlzc/dsh-swarm-panel#dsh-swarm-plugin
description: Conversation Flow observability for DeepSeek Harness swarms, with topology, routed-message inspection, HITL pauses, Live follow, and child-session navigation.

title: SternChiri/dsh-panel-tidy
description: Drag any sidebar panel to reorder it, or drop one onto More to fold it into the More submenu; the order and the folded set are remembered across restarts.

title: Stijnus/dsh-composer-predictions
description: Tab autocomplete for the DeepSeek Harness desktop and web composer: next-message ghost text, inline draft completion, and Alt+Up/Alt+Down candidate cycling.

title: Stijnus/dsh-moodboard
description: Visual reference moodboard for DeepSeek Harness: drag-and-drop images with tags and notes, and pinned style guides the agent reads before it generates or restyles UI.

title: Stijnus/dsh-prompt-optimizer
description: Adds an Optimize prompt control next to the composer send button that rewrites the draft into a structured prompt (plain, sections, or role-task-goal) streamed from the session model, with Use, Undo, Copy and Close.

title: Stijnus/dsh-workspace-status
description: Colored status marks on DeepSeek Harness sidebar workspace rows — waiting for you, running, or recently finished — aggregated per workspace, plus a pinned-conversations section above the list and pinned-only notifications, persisted across restarts.

title: stitchmaps/dsh-marketboard
description: Quote board for A-shares, Hong Kong and US stocks, FX, Chinese and global commodity futures and indices, with watchlists, custom groups, auto-refresh and host-side persistence.

title: stoner-byte/dsh-annotations
description: Select text in assistant replies, add optional comments, and send the annotations with the next message.

title: striver8/dsh-context-effort
description: A composer control: shows the current model's context window, the tokens in use and a rough system / tools / messages breakdown, switches the model's reasoning effort in one click (writing reasoningEfforts into the model config when the provider declares none), and edits the model's contextWindow from the same panel so custom-provider models stop silently inheriting the adapter default. Makes no model calls; reads only the official session projections, model directory and config-forms services.

title: studyzy/dsh-suggest-prompt
description: After each completed agent turn, a bounded auxiliary LLM call writes one suggested next prompt into the session log; the web composer renders it as ghost placeholder text, adopted via Tab.

title: Stylelinzzz/dsh-chat-history
description: Adds a "History" conversation view tab listing the session's user messages as a clickable directory, with auto-paging and click-to-jump back into the chat.

title: sueqet/dsh-todo-board
description: Cross-session TODO board as a draggable floating panel: tasks are grouped by working directory and reorderable by drag, each one carries a run mode (remind only, continue in the current session, or open a new session in the same directory), up to four attached images sent to the model as real image attachments, and an optional local time it may run at; two checkboxes track AI-done and user-verified, and the agent picks up the next unfinished task in that directory when it finishes one.

title: Suibianlilili/dsh-always-on-top
description: Adds a pin button to the DSH Desktop title bar that toggles always-on-top for the main window. Windows 10/11 only.

title: sujalmandal/dsh-tab-plan-toggle
description: Tab to toggle plan mode on/off.

title: sujingkpo/dsh-change-review-live
description: Live change review for DeepSeek Harness: tracks write/edit tool calls per session, lists changed files above the composer and opens each file's line-level diff in a plugin-registered right-sidebar tab, with session-log / initial-version / Git comparison modes, per-change and per-file revert, subagent aggregation and SSE updates. A fork of cirelir/dsh-change-review rebuilt around the right sidebar.

title: sumomok/dsh-plugins#quote-message
description: Quote earlier content of the current session into the composer: select text in any message for a Quote pill, or type @ to pick a whole message; the quote travels as a native reference chip and is serialized into the prompt as a blockquote. Client-only, no host routes, no custom session events.

title: sun04222/dsh-prompt-enhance
description: Adds an ✦ button to the DSH composer that rewrites the current draft into a clearer, more specific prompt in the same language, with one click to restore the original, plus an enhance_prompt tool the agent can call; the rewrite replaces the draft and is never sent automatically.

title: Sunday530/dsh-sidebar-panel-collapse
description: Adds a chevron row under New Session that folds the sidebar panel list in place, returning the height to the workspace and session list. The hiding is driven by one attribute on the page root plus CSS: no host bundle is patched and no row is unregistered, and plugin entries injected outside the panel slot fold too because they are matched by their own data attributes. The state is remembered per browser and the control hides itself in the 56px rail.

title: sunnystarye-ui/dsh-plugin-text-quote
description: Codex-style text annotation for conversations: select text, add a quote with your comment, inject it into the composer, and expand sent annotations as a pill.

title: sunshaobei/dsh-file-mention
description: Codex-style @file/@folder mentions for the DSH web composer: workspace file/folder picker menu, plain-text colored mention tokens via the platform lexicon scan, and a nested-git-aware file index.

title: sunshaobei/dsh-input-history
description: Input history switcher for the DSH composer that locally persists every submitted prompt (text plus attachments, max 50) and re-fills the empty composer with ArrowUp/ArrowDown, re-attaching file references and image previews.

title: Sunshine334419520/smart-selection-translate
description: Select English text in the conversation or the sidebar file preview to translate it in place — single words get a dictionary entry with IPA, part-of-speech senses, web meanings and pronunciation, while sentences use machine translation.

title: suntianc/dsh-ui-settings-icons
description: Adds custom icons to the DSH Settings sidebar and exposes a keyed `settings.section.icon` slot for third-party settings sections.

title: sunxiuguo/dsh-a2ui
description: Development-preview A2UI v0.9/v0.9.1 conversation surfaces using official schemas and renderer, session-scoped form actions and non-executing history replay; verified only in bounded synthetic DSH 0.2.0-rc.2 workflows.

title: sunyuhuirong/fsviewer
description: Codex-style right-edge workspace for the dsh web UI: file tree with preview tabs (Markdown/source), an embedded browser (direct/proxy iframe), and a side chat streaming from the host LLM — all as switchable tabs in the native details column.

title: superltmajor-pixel/dsh-minimal-ui
description: Refines the DeepSeek Harness interface for reading by adjusting layouts and reducing persistent controls. Built for DSH 0.2.2-rc.1 (Web UI); other versions are untested.

title: Surtr-crimson/dsh-turn-dial
description: Renders the chat turn navigator as a clock-like half dial: one graduation per turn, a purple graduation every fifth turn, and a blue needle on the current turn.

title: suyunxing/dsh-compact-sidebar
description: Draws the sidebar navigation as a compact two-column grid at every viewport; on narrow, short or coarse-pointer screens it additionally caps the navigation at 34vh with scrolling so the workspace and session history keep a 38vh floor. Also repairs dsh-resource:// records whose protocol the browser URL parser reports as empty.

title: suyunxing/dsh-effort-slider
description: Replaces the composer's model selector with a starfield popup that sets the model and its reasoning effort in one control, and remaps the current effort to the nearest level the new model declares instead of failing the switch.

title: suyunxing/dsh-welcome-greeting
description: Rewrites the New Session hero headline with a short greeting written by the model the session already uses, from the local time, the current city and the live weather; falls back to a local time-based greeting when no model is reachable.

title: SUZUNAMI/dsh-workspace-hide
description: Hide chosen workspaces from the DSH sidebar and archive their sessions along with them, so those sessions never spill into the ungrouped list. Fully local and reversible; with dsh-archive-manager installed the archiving is real and undoable, otherwise it stays a display-only layer. Restore any hidden workspace from Settings.

title: sw503544488/dsh-harness-launcher
description: A Windows desktop shortcut for DeepSeek Harness: it opens the authenticated UI when the harness is running and starts it with no console window when it is not. A Settings page adds the shortcut action, a two-click restart and close, and a switch that keeps the launcher out of the sidebar.

title: sweet-boby/dsh-markdown-outline
description: Adds a Markdown outline and full-reply search to conversations, with section references, reversible turn hiding, and new sessions from selected turns.

title: sweet560/dsh-plugin-deepseek-chat
description: Sidebar panel that embeds chat.deepseek.com full-width in the DSH main area (desktop shell only), restores the last conversation, and keeps a crashed embedded page inside the panel.
