title: swenbo1-web/dsh-web-search-button
description: Direct web search button and /search slash command plugin for DeepSeek Harness.

title: swiftlc/dsh-annotation
description: Adds text selection annotation tools and annotation chips to the dsh web composer.

title: swyc520/dsh-plugin-model-whitelist
description: Tick which models appear in the DSH model selector, and fold provider groups in the settings panel.

title: syx2bzd/dsh-ricewhale
description: A draggable whale-maid physics widget for the DSH Web UI: throw it around, catch token coins, and eat rice bowls.

title: syzke/dsh-translate-on-select
description: Select foreign text in a DSH conversation and a Simplified Chinese translation card appears right below the selection.

title: Takeoff0518/dsh-katex-inline-copy
description: Makes copying math from DSH chat put LaTeX source ($...$ or $$...$$) on the clipboard instead of rendered KaTeX markup; code blocks and the prompt box keep native copy behavior.

title: tangu2023/dsh-menu
description: Adds a custom right-click context menu to the sidebar workspace files tree, with new folder, rename, reveal in file manager, open in browser, open in VS Code, copy path, streaming ZIP download, and delete.

title: Tansukii/dsh-screenshot
description: Region screenshot tool with annotations, a magnifier colour picker and clipboard output, following the DSH UI language. Windows only.

title: tao1020/dsh-global-pins
description: Keep pinned conversations from every workspace at the top of the sidebar, with drag insertion hints, manual or recent-first sorting, and completion-unread dots. Includes Codex-style row actions: a live spinning indicator while a session runs, archive and restore, inline rename that selects the whole title, and a right-click menu for fork and reordering. A magnifier beside the Global pins heading opens a search overlay: it matches session titles and workspace names instantly, then searches message content through the Host index when the deployment enables it, splitting results under small Sessions and Content headings with snippets. A crosshair button jumps to the session currently open in the main view, expanding its workspace when folded; each section heading sits on a translucent grey band and rows stay compact so more sessions fit. v1.0.6 adds a Recent section under the pins: conversations used today and not pinned collect there newest-first from every workspace, then return to their own workspace the next day; section headings fold and keep their screen position while folding.

title: TaoruiLiu19/DSH-LLSA#hud
description: Read-only heads-up display over a DeepSeek Harness conversation: one state word in the centre, fixed seats around the ring for terminal, code, search, documents, web and a catch-all, and a sub-agent ring when more than one agent runs.

title: taotao7/dsh-pretty-cool
description: Compact interface with borderless messages, a light queue, composer controls, and adjustable corners. Built for DSH 0.2.1-rc.2 only; while enabled it replaces the stock sidebar module, and removing it restores the original.

title: taoziliyouchong/dsh-at-menu
description: Adds a row of category tabs on top of the @ reference menu so candidates can be filtered by kind.

title: taoziliyouchong/dsh-prompt-shelf
description: Keeps frequently used prompts in the DSH composer, with insert, replace, variables and a trash.

title: taoziliyouchong/dsh-reload-buttons
description: Two buttons in the top-left of the DSH header — reload the UI and restart the app.

title: taxueseek/dsh-files
description: File upload with color-coded attachment cards (session-isolated storage, sha256 dedup, TTL sweep) plus a content-sniffing read_document tool for PDF/DOCX/XLSX/TXT.

title: tcgbp/dock-flash
description: The dock-base Workbench adapter for the DSH Quick Control panel. The panel core ships separately as `dsh-flash`; this package is what mounts it into dock-base — sidebar/floating panel, activity-bar ⚡, editor view and the dock-flash:openQuickControl command. Requires dock-base; a broken install fails loudly instead of silently doing nothing.

title: tcgbp/dsh-flash
description: The Quick Control panel core for DSH Web: a standalone floating shortcut panel whose switches other plugins register through the quickControl service, with the skin system and zh/en i18n. The dock-base Workbench integration ships separately as the dock-flash adapter.

title: TecFancy/dsh-mobile
description: Mobile adapter for the DSH web shell: overlay sidebar/details drawers, responsive composer and settings below 768px, zero desktop regression.

title: TelethaMithril/dsh-hot-restart-row
description: Adds a "Hot restart" row under "Sign out" in the DSH account menu; it reconciles the profile plugin tree in place and reloads the page, without restarting the DSH process or dropping the current conversation.

title: Teyvat0/dsh-sidebar-compact
description: Adds sidebar collapse, a 248px compact mode, and panel-list folding to the DeepSeek Harness sidebar.

title: thanhvinh0265-art/dsh-locale-vi
description: Vietnamese (tiếng Việt) language pack for the DeepSeek Harness Web UI: hand-translated dictionaries for 61 namespaces (3,477 strings) that take effect when Vietnamese is picked in Settings → Language, plus a /vi-sync command that translates strings added by newer plugin versions through the harness translator service.

title: The-latest-one/dsh-branch-workspace-folders
description: Heap-allocated stack-safe fork tree with two-track indentation, title marquee, and physical cascade purge.

title: Theembers/dsh-quick-tasks
description: Sidebar panel for background local services: start, stop, restart, remove and inspect each task (status, port, PID, uptime, live log). Tasks are described in the plugin config, so any local service can be managed, and removing a task also drops it from that config. In the default attached mode the managed services are stopped when DSH quits, and a chat entry opens a new session with prefilled notes so an agent can add a service.

title: Theembers/dsh-workspace-icons
description: Adds per-workspace icons and a default session icon to the DeepSeek Harness sidebar. The workspace icon is picked inside the existing rename-workspace dialog; sessions without an IM channel get a default icon drawn with the same title pseudo-element the IM plugin uses, so the two stay aligned, while IM sessions keep their channel logo. Session rows are indented one level under their workspace with a vertical guide line. Icons come from 73 built-in Lucide glyphs, uploaded SVGs, or linked Iconify collections browsed from the official catalog, and follow the theme colors instead of a custom palette.

title: TheGoodMorty/chat-pace
description: Configurable chat auto-scroll — paced section-by-section reading with size-proportional pauses, smooth follow, step and hold modes, hotkeys, and per-session open positions.

title: TheTao-xt/dsh-composer-shot
description: WeChat-style screenshot button in the DSH composer on Windows: freeze the screen, drag a region, and the crop lands in the current draft as an attachment; an eye switch hides the DSH window during the capture and restores it right after.

title: ThinkofRain1213/dsh-smooth-cursor-patched
description: Comet-mode animated caret for the DSH Web composer: a glowing trail glides to the text position, with configurable accent color, thickness, trail, and a 500 ms idle blink. Extends the surface to ask-question card inputs, and fixes the caret vanishing on an empty composer or first focus, forward drag-selection not following the pointer, soft line breaks measuring against the previous line, and the caret painting outside the composer when long input scrolls. Maintained fork of Lacquervii/smooth-cursor.

title: thomasvvugt/dsh-wide-stats-footer
description: Un-clamps the composer stats footer: long turn and token stats lines span the full composer width instead of truncating with an ellipsis.

title: Thunderunruly/agent-office
description: A fixed-pixel office tower for DeepSeek Harness: every workspace is a floor and every session an office inside it. Lit windows mean work in progress, and clicking a floor or a person takes you straight to that session.

title: Thunderunruly/session-kanban
description: Session board in the left sidebar: every chat session's current work, todos and progress, with a searchable overview heatmap and one-click navigation back to the session.

title: thynon/dsh-at-plugins
description: Adds an installed-plugin group to the @ menu, split into System and User, groups session mentions by folder, and gives section headers sticky positioning, row counts, and fold controls.

title: Thyxqz/dsh-plugin-quick-invoke
description: Adds an installed-plugin picker beside the composer: drag a plugin name into the prompt at the drop point, open a draggable plugin rail in the right sidebar by double-clicking the entry, and choose which plugins (and remarks) appear in Settings.

title: tianlaoban/DSH-Chinese-Talk
description: Switches every session's thinking and answers to Chinese — terse, a little wry, plain-spoken — while keeping proper nouns in English, and adds an "answer only what was asked" interaction rule. One global system-prompt section (order 10): no UI, no binaries, no network calls. Inactive under the minimal preset, which replaces the whole prompt with its own persona.

title: tianxiaz/dsh-recent-sessions
description: A Workspaces-native Recent sessions section for the DSH left sidebar: favorites, running, waiting-for-you and unread sessions at a glance, with a one-click ☆ on every session row, one-line collapse and in-section search. It takes over the sidebar shell (the shipped sidebar package is disabled) and renders the official workspace/session browser inside it; its recent-sessions panel id conflicts with huangxp12/whybebabo, so do not install them together.

title: TianYa-DAO/dsh-wallpaper-engine#plugin
description: Wallpaper Engine local library, background layer, native Scene panel, and desktop-mode controls for the DSH desktop shell.

title: TiChuXiXi/dsh-file-extras
description: Enhances the DSH Web GUI file tree with inline sizes and modification dates, plus a right-click menu for download, upload, and copy-path actions.

title: Timebro9999/dsh-session-deck
description: Codex-style sidebar: a pinned band for projects and conversations, collapsible 置顶/项目/组件 sections, a bell activity view of recently used conversations, and per-project emoji icons.

title: timxiang-948/dsh-composer-model-controls
description: Model and reasoning-effort controls in the DSH composer tool row, with a Pi-Harness-inspired effort slider whose track and composer border tint with the level, plus Shift+Tab cycling.

title: tingfeng347/dsh-vscode-workbench
description: VS Code-style local workbench for DSH with a file explorer, Monaco editor, full-text search and a Git panel.

title: tinyfinddong/dsh-close-all-tabs
description: Right-Sidebar tab menu enhancement for DeepSeek Harness: adds a 'Close other tabs' item that closes every content tab of the session except the one whose menu is open and the docked guide.

title: tipoLi5890/dsh-file-mention
description: Session-scoped @file/@folder mentions in the composer with Git-aware indexing, drag-drop and paste managed uploads, and validated path markers.

title: TixAn9/DSHdesktop-restart-bottom
description: Restart button for DSH Desktop placed directly above the sidebar account button.

title: tkliuxing/dsh-presets-hidden
description: Browser-side preset visibility and ordering controls for the new-session page.

title: Tleon-H/dsh-next-prompt
description: After each reply, shows a gray next-prompt suggestion in the empty composer that Tab or → accepts; in an empty composer, ↑ / ↓ browse the messages you sent in the session. Settings can be changed on the Plugins page; nothing is sent automatically.

title: TLEWA/dsh-better-choice
description: Adds two enhancements to DSH ask_user_question choice cards: right-clicking an option expands a per-option note that is merged into the submitted custom answer, and a footer field asks a side question answered by a fork subagent from the session context, read-only, with no write-back. Keeps left-click, skip, paging and the countdown working as before, and only claims generic choice cards, not plan review or approval cards. Supports DSH 0.2.x from 0.2.0-rc.1 (verified on 0.2.2-rc.1) and Node.js 20+. Derived from buaaflyaway/dsh-question-note (MIT) and inspired by MichengAI/dsh-btw (Apache-2.0); do not install it together with dsh-question-note — both take over the same ask_user_question card.

title: TLEWA/dsh-sidebar-organizer
description: Adds custom ordering and tucking away to seven strips of buttons and cards in DSH (the left sidebar, sidebar footer, conversation tabs, composer dock, session header icon strip, right sidebar and settings navigation), plus per-area drag switches and JSON layout import/export. Tucked rows land in the built-in More menu of that region and can be dragged back out.

title: TLEWA/dsh-sidebar-row-menu
description: Right-click menus for DSH sidebar rows: on DSH 0.2.2+ both rows use the host menus — workspace rows follow the session grouping (new session, copy path and reveal, pinned open-with apps, an open-with submenu, bulk delete) and session rows extend the menu that opens at the pointer with pinned open-with apps, an open-with submenu and permanent deletion of archived sessions; entries stay in the right-click menu by default and can be opted one by one into the shared "…" menu. On 0.2.1 the workspace menu is drawn by the plugin. Adapted from miao-ge/dsh-sidebar-context-menu and 0imzero/dsh-workspace-menu; do not install it alongside either - all of them attach right-click menus to the same sidebar rows.

title: tm5452/dsh-workspace-explorer
description: Windows disk browsing, file operations and persistent preview in DeepSeek Harness Desktop.

title: tntfireage/dsh-systeminfo
description: Adds a live system dashboard with per-core CPU, memory, GPU, processes, disk usage and a STOP action for ending processes, plus per-process energy on macOS, exposed as a browser page, a GUI panel and a `systemInfo` service other plugins can inject. macOS is the main platform and Linux is best-effort. The dashboard page and its read-only JSON (process list with users, disks, logged-in users) are served with no login check; publicDashboard: false only refuses non-loopback peers. STOP accepts loopback requests only and sends SIGTERM, then SIGKILL after a grace period, to any process your account may signal except pid 1, the DSH host and its parent.

title: tommy00748-tech/dsh-adhd-noise
description: ADHD-friendly focus soundscape docked under the DSH composer: five procedurally synthesised noise colours (white, pink, brown, rain, fan), a live-waveform orb, a 15-90 minute fade-out timer and a liquid-glass popover. No audio assets and no network requests.

title: tomowang/dsh-tui
description: Full-screen terminal client for DeepSeek Harness built on pi-tui: session replay/resume, streaming responses, collapsible tool cards, in-terminal approvals and questions, model/preset/permission/plan/goal management, shell mode, and a trajectory ledger.

title: tonebean/dsh-inline-visualizer
description: Inline visualizer for DSH: the model loads a design contract first, then renders an SVG or a sandboxed HTML card in place inside the conversation, with light/dark tokens and a source/download toggle.

title: tonglingming-hue/dsh-novel-studio
description: Novel writing workspace view with live word counts, chapter cards, frosted-glass panels, and selection-to-AI polish, continuation, and story-direction prompts.

title: tonyischen/ds_ask_graph
description: Interactive topic graph for DSH session history: groups questions into topics, drills into per-topic Q&A timelines, supports semantic regrouping, and exports HTML, SVG, and Bluepin vaults.

title: TonyKingWJX/dsh-thinking-bar
description: Replaces the composer's model and reasoning-effort selector with a two-level menu and six slider skins.

title: Totoro-qaq/dsh-jot
description: Adds a human-editable notes workspace with folders, full-text search, rich text, checklists, resizable tables, attachments, exports, and opt-in agent collaboration.

title: toujianjian/dsh-do
description: One plugin for DeepSeek Harness with durable autonomous loops, sidebar GitHub discovery, AI-assisted installation, and workspace shortcuts.

title: Toximiner/dsh-tokmeter
description: Live decode speed (tok/s) pill in the composer status bar that tracks the currently streaming response.

title: TPSCE/dsh-side-assistant
description: A right-sidebar assistant that knows the main session's finished turns, follows the main agent's running steps and background jobs, and answers in the panel; its model, context budget and answer style are configurable.

title: tr1v3r/dsh-quote-followup
description: Quote selected conversation text into the Web composer as native reference chips for focused follow-up turns.

title: Tracest/dsh-session-inbox
description: Compact top tools, untitled inbox and lower Working/Settled shelves; native menus, search highlighting, keyboard navigation, metadata backups and an original-layout switch. Chinese UI. On DSH 0.2.1-rc.5: macOS Desktop verified; Windows Desktop checked for cold starts, compact/original layouts at 1280x820 and 1471x1200, search, project filtering and native session menus. Linux and arbitrary third-party plugin combinations remain unverified.

title: tsonglew/dsh-media-preview
description: Audio/video FileViewer for dsh-better-sidebar: native inline playback for mp4/webm/mkv/mov and mp3/flac/wav, served by a Range-capable streaming media route.

title: tsonglew/dsh-workspace-search
description: VS Code-style workspace keyword search tab for dsh-better-sidebar: matches file names and content, grouped by file with line numbers, opens in the sidebar editor.

title: TSRYWHY/deepseek-time-price
description: Floating DeepSeek API time-of-day pricing window with Chinese legal-holiday awareness, account balance and estimated project spend; includes a green/orange 24-hour timeline and collapsible model, billing-rule and holiday sections.

title: Tsutsutsuu/dsh-quote-selection
description: Select text in the chat transcript, right-click, and quote it into the composer. The quote travels as an atomic chip and renders as a collapsible card, while the model receives the full block with message role, turn, block index and character range.

title: ttmouse/dsh-model-picker
description: Model picker for the DSH web composer that replaces the model seat: a search-first popup whose left column indexes the suppliers and scrolls the grouped list, with a favorites group pinned at the top, image icons separating native from bridged vision input, and a reasoning-effort panel opened from the right zone of the trigger.

title: ttmouse/dsh-recent
description: Adds a 最近 (Recent) section below the workspace list in the DSH web sidebar that flattens the newest sessions of every workspace into one timeline, reusing the session rows and hover cards the shell already renders, paging in earlier sessions as you scroll, and folding the workspace list itself to the five folders with the newest history. Requires DSH ^0.2.0-rc.1.

title: tumi-huakai/dsh-plugin-meow-speech
description: Display-layer text replacement for DSH chat messages: rewrite how any configured text appears on screen without touching the real conversation, with per-rule whole-word matching and code-block protection.

title: tuogusa/dsh-word-complete
description: Word auto-completion in the Web composer: prefix-matched suggestions sorted by closeness, arrow-key selection and Enter to confirm.

title: tuoLuoSuan/dsh-peak
description: A chip at the left end of the composer tool row showing whether DeepSeek bills at peak or off-peak right now. Clicking it opens a card with the current state and rate, the next switch with a countdown, and why this instant is in that state: a weekend, a named statutory holiday, a 调休 make-up workday, or simply outside the peak windows. Times are resolved in Beijing time with an explicit UTC offset, so the verdict does not depend on the machine clock; a hard-coded 2026 Chinese holiday table carries the 33 holiday days and the six 调休 workdays, and a year beyond the table says so instead of guessing.

title: TussalZeus18028/dsh-open-folder
description: Adds an "Open folder" item to the session-row ⋯ menu in the DSH workspace sidebar, opening the session's workspace folder with the host OS file manager.

title: TWFU-wcy/dsh-scroll-boost
description: Skips offscreen chat and trajectory rows so long sessions scroll smoothly; measured row heights keep the scrollbar steady, visible content unchanged.

title: tyouter/dsh-notes
description: A page for writing notes inside DeepSeek Harness. · Minimal writing — one page that typesets as you type. · AI completion — a suggestion arrives when you pause, and TAB takes it. · Immersive writing — full screen, with only the page on it. · History — every note listed, searched and edited in place, and copied out as standard Markdown. · AI board — a data assistant that answers from your notes and pins the charts it builds.

title: tyvtjhj/system-resource-monitor#dsh-hardware-monitor
description: Local hardware monitor for DSH: a sidebar dashboard, a composer-dock CPU/memory/GPU widget, and a hardware_monitor_status tool backed by a local Python service installed separately from the repository root with install-dsh.ps1 (Windows, Python 3.10); installing only the DSH plugin leaves the panel and tool offline.

title: TZHR-invest/dsh-plugins#dsh-mobile-ui
description: Mobile UI for the Web GUI on narrow screens: full-width responsive layout, overlay session drawer, 44px touch targets, safe-area support, and reading enhancements with zero desktop impact.

title: TZYCeng/dsh-model-visibility
description: Manage which models appear in the composer model menu. A settings page lists every provider's models with a per-model switch, provider-level show/hide, collapsible groups and filters by kind; switched-off models leave the menu while the model in use in the current session stays. The list can be searched by name or ID and filtered by capability (multimodal, reasoning) and by minimum context window (128K / 256K / 512K / 1M). Rows show the model kind, and chat models also show reasoning support with the adapter's effort levels, their context window and input modalities. Labels merge manual overrides, the settings document, the adapter, the relay's GET /models response, a built-in pi-ai / models.dev catalog, name inference and vendor corrections in that priority order, with the source named on hover and dashed borders marking inferred values. Any model can be edited by hand (kind, context window, modalities, effort levels); those edits are stored outside the profile and can be written back into the model provider's settings. A hard re-fetch drops every cache and asks the adapter and all relays again. A switch, on by default, lets relay routes whose models declare text-only input accept images in memory, without editing configuration files. The hidden list is stored in the profile patch and mirrored to $DSH_HOME.

title: uckkk/dsh-valley-meter
description: Peak-Valley Meter (峰谷电表) — a tiny DeepSeek usage companion: a minimal two-part balance chip above the composer (currency symbol + number, nothing else), official balance refreshed every 5s; click the symbol to open the official top-up page in a new tab; hovering the chip fades in a circular backdrop under the symbol, its left arc flush with the chip's own left edge, and expands a 24h peak/valley timeline (orange=peak, blue=valley, glowing marker at the current local time) so off-peak hours are obvious; independent today-spend metering; a settings panel with 10 muted color presets plus custom valley/peak colors, detailed/minimal styles and readout toggles; all-Chinese UI.

title: Uid-762/dsh-ai-workbench
description: Turns one plain-language request into a live workbench window: a sidebar panel asks a few clarifying questions, the model writes a single-file HTML artifact, and the plugin mounts it in a resizable floating window or a standalone browser tab. Declared window actions are recorded as info-level project journal entries (without their payloads), and workbenches can be imported, exported, or installed from a market index.

title: uigdwunm/dsh-conversation-jump
description: A rail of four circular buttons in the DSH Web conversation that step to the previous or next user message, or to the top or bottom, paging older history in automatically.

title: uigdwunm/dsh-process-fold
description: Folds each DSH Web turn's thinking, tool calls and context into bordered process boxes cut at every piece of model text; a collapsed box shows its latest two items, the stacked lines above its border open that one box, the border itself folds it back, and user dialogue, interactive questions and model text stay outside.

title: uio-o/dsh-plugin-operation-log
description: A right-sidebar session panel that lists every Skill, MCP tool call and file read or write by turn and step, with per-failure error detail.

title: UncleK/dsh-think-translate
description: Translate DSH reasoning, tasks, answers and review reasons into 9 languages. Ollama, custom OpenAI/Anthropic APIs or Google/Bing; ordered fallback, local model memory controls, originals preserved.

title: UndeadSheep/dsh-file-preview#dsh-file-preview
description: Floating workspace file-preview window for the Web client: lazy file tree, CodeMirror preview and in-window edit with save, Markdown and image preview, Quick Open search, and opening paths clicked in the conversation.

title: unhurriedly/dsh-sheji-library
description: Adds a sidebar panel that browses the 设记 Design Memory component library by asset type, with live previews, design tokens, and copyable HTML, CSS, and JavaScript. Component pages ship with the plugin; fonts and images load from the public library site.

title: UniMars/dsh-whale-widget-dock
description: Docks the dsh-whale-widget desktop pet flush against the right sidebar edge, following sidebar width changes and collapse/expand, with a toggle in the widget menu.

title: UnknowCao/dsh-dock
description: Windows desktop launcher for DeepSeek Harness: a one-click whale icon plus a sidebar More menu with Settings / Restart-Refresh / graceful Full Exit, and a scrollable multi-DSH picker on the cold-start card.

title: uoiszero/dsh-photo-picker#dsh-photo-picker
description: A DSH workbench for picking photos from local folders on macOS and Windows: local dedupe, filtering and grouping, AI grid triage and scoring with an image-capable model you supply (the plugin bundles no model, credentials or quota), then human review, calibration and export.

title: user-Mrz/dsh-system-prompt-studio
description: Per-conversation system prompt studio for DeepSeek Harness. Append text, shadow-replace one named first-party prompt section, or replace the whole system prompt; changes apply on the next model request without a restart. Overrides persist per session and are inherited by forked conversations along the parent chain, with a Pin action to freeze the inherited result locally. The panel lists the real assembled sections and guards unsaved edits.

title: Utmotc/dsh-balance-card
description: Shows the API balance of the provider behind the current model as a dsh Web sidebar card, with per-package progress bars, currency/credit-aware units, a settings tab, and subscription and credit quota monitoring.

title: vaisramana/dsh-bookmark
description: Select text or tables in conversations to bookmark, highlight, and annotate in the right sidebar, with a collapsible all-sessions bookmark page.

title: vamyane/dsh-brain-viewer
description: Brain-shaped relationship graph viewer for DeepSeek Harness with a Markdown knowledge-base pipeline that imports documents and builds the graph. The viewer ships demo data and needs no Python; rebuilding the graph from your own notes needs Node.js 20+ and Python 3.8+ and runs from the command line.

title: VanlxyG/dsh-hover-sidebar
description: Hover to reveal and leave to hide the left sidebar on Windows desktop and Web, with manual pinning, configurable delays and reduced-motion support.

title: var-lin/dsh-plugin-layout-organizer
description: Drag-and-drop reordering, official/third-party dividers and a stash panel for the buttons DSH renders in the sidebar, the sidebar footer, the conversation tabs, the composer dock and Settings. Only display position changes; the plugin registry is untouched.

title: vc1235-ui/dsh-ai-journal
description: Daily and weekly AI journals generated from your local DSH session logs, grouped by goal with deliverables and unfinished todos.

title: Veagau/dsh-amadeus-workbench
description: Adds an Amadeus-inspired launch panel with a clock and navigation shortcuts.

title: Veduis/dsh-workspace-tints
description: Gives each Workspace a stable tint from a warm-to-cool ramp, sets its name as a section heading above indented Sessions, and turns a finished unread chat's row green.

title: vibeinging/dsh-turn-navigator
description: Turn navigation for the DSH Web UI.

title: victormshan/dsh-web-relay
description: Three-party collaboration protocol for dsh: Step List state machine, five-tier review chain (Gemini/web/Claude Code/dialog/manual), alternatives adjudication, cross-restart resume with heartbeat, and capability persistence.

title: ViewWay/dsh-prompt-optimizer#bundle
description: Prompt optimizer for the DSH composer. One click runs rewrite then self-review rounds over the draft with per-round diff preview, and a rejected result rides into the next round as a prior attempt. Five fixed re-run directions (more concise / more detailed / more technical / restructure / stronger acceptance); a 164-role library ships in the package, roles recommended by draft or picked explicitly; matched installed skills fold into the meta-prompt under exact-name constraints; results save to a prompt library (browse, insert, re-optimize, two-step delete); mechanical acceptance criteria carry an executable check-command template; output language follows the agent UI language.

title: Vinzelles/dsh-clearview
description: Adds a Reading tab to the DSH web client that shows process steps and live reasoning in source order, collapses successful turns to the final answer, and keeps the original tabs, composer, and tooling intact.

title: vioeveann/dsh-avatar-frame
description: Shows a character avatar and an editable ID beside every assistant reply, and reads the reply aloud with the system voice or a local TTS service you point it at; includes presets, a playback bar with pause and sentence skipping, tone and speed controls, and one-click launching of that service.

title: VioletScar-Hui/dsh-chat-history
description: CLI-style chat history recall for the DSH input box: press ArrowUp/ArrowDown to recall previously sent messages.

title: vlln/dsh-navbar
description: Conversation node navigation bar for quick jumps between user messages.

title: vlln/dsh-pancha
description: Disk review canvas: agent-written semantics, human decisions, previewed cleanup with undo.

title: vlln/dsh-task-status
description: Background task status bar: progress plus live output tail on the chat page.

title: VNHUYY/dsh-sidebar-autohide
description: Adds Notion-style auto-hide to the left and right DSH sidebars: hover the matching window edge to expand, move away to collapse, and click the sidebar button to pin it open.

title: Void-LifeStream/dsh-gemini-kitten-widget
description: A Gemini kitten widget for the DSH Web UI: live Google Gemini API free-tier quota per model, a model switcher, color-coded warnings, drag-to-snap, and click-to-change lines.

title: vollegrewar/dsh-tool-highlight
description: Layered syntax highlighting for bash/pwsh command and read code output in the DSH web GUI (VS Code Dark+ palette: keywords/strings/numbers/functions/comments each get a color); colors only what it recognizes, keeps tables/logs plain; pure frontend, zero token overhead.

title: Volta-ln/dsh-quick-ask
description: ChatGPT-style side chat for the DSH Web GUI: ask small questions about the current topic in a floating side panel, answered by an independent lightweight session over the official /api RPC — the main conversation is never touched. Streaming text, collapsible reasoning, tool chips, stop button, agent-preset selector, and an automatic context snapshot from the visible main chat.

title: vvvspec/better-reasoning-slider
description: Official-style composer model trigger with a floating reasoning-effort slider popup.

title: w-j-y-wjy/dsh-glass-weather
description: Glass weather pill in the session header with 23 weather states, each with its own tint, SVG icon and canvas particle layer, per-field visibility switches, and a get_weather tool backed by keyless Open-Meteo data.

title: w4xxx/dsh-xia-plugins#packages/client-gameassist-knowledge
description: Knowledge-base browser panel: tree browsing plus drag-to-cite (path-only or full content) into the composer.

title: waknow/dsh-web-icon-indicator
description: Browser tab favicon mirrors the DSH session state (idle / running / asking / done), recolored and animated from one base SVG entirely in the browser, with colors and effects configurable from the Settings page.

title: wanderer-yk/dsh-xueqiu
description: Xueqiu (Snowball) market panel docked above the composer: A-share/HK/US quotes and indices, watchlist, candlestick K-line with volume, MAs and crosshair tooltip, hot list, search, 7x24 news, plus a draggable mini index badge — no login needed.

title: Wang-Chuming/dsh-obsidian-file-opener
description: Plain click on an Obsidian vault file in the DSH conversation opens it in the right app: notes in the Obsidian app, configured types (for example .tex) in VS Code with their project folder as the workspace; Cmd/Ctrl-click keeps the in-app preview. The open_vault_file tool follows the same routing, and every open is confined to the configured vaultRoot.

title: wang6077/dsh-ide-vscode
description: Workspace file tree and code editor in the DSH right sidebar: browse the workspace of the session it belongs to, create, rename and delete files and folders (to a trash folder by default), edit in place with line numbers and syntax highlighting (Ctrl+S saves, Ctrl+D duplicates the current line), preview images and play audio or video, list and unpack archives or pack a folder into a .zip through the system tar, search by file name or jump by a pasted path, and draw file rows with the icons Windows itself uses (SHGetFileInfo, Windows only).

title: wang678678/dsh-local-plugins#dsh-kb-picker
description: Adds a knowledge-base picker and a native-attachment paperclip to the DSH composer.

title: wang678678/dsh-local-plugins#dsh-workspace-flow
description: Replaces the add-workspace folder dialog with a path input, drive shortcuts, and the native folder picker.

title: wangjianghu/dsh-composer-lists
description: Ordered and unordered list editing in the DSH composer: automatic numbering and renumbering, marker-aware caret moves, level promotion, and an undoable AI prompt-polish button.

title: wangsrGit119/dsh-nanny-calendar
description: Sidebar calendar board for tracking a nanny or caregiver: onboarding and offboarding dates, leave days and salary payouts, with per-month and all-time totals and automatic payday markers on a 30-day cycle.

title: wangtheme-coder/dsh-greeting
description: Adds a time-aware greeting line under the DSH home hero headline: seven local-time slots with tsundere whale-girl lines, phrase overrides through ~/.dsh/greeting.json, and Ctrl+R / F5 bound back to a real page reload.

title: wangtheme-coder/dsh-stellar-effort
description: Adds a reasoning-effort rail above the DSH composer: drag or use the keyboard to preview and submit the levels the current model exposes (Off through Max), while a procedurally rendered micro-universe contracts and collapses into a black hole as effort rises. Levels go through the DSH model-selection interface, so the rail shows the level DSH confirms, and the plugin writes only to $DSH_HOME/stellar-effort/.

title: wangxiaocuo/dsh-composer-prefill
description: Predicts the next message you would send once an assistant turn finishes and shows it as a one-line suggestion above the composer; Tab or a click fills the draft without sending. The prediction follows the session model unless a provider and model are pinned, and the Settings page has an on/off switch.

title: wanruxi/dsh-selection-followup
description: Select text in a conversation and park it as a quote card above the composer; the input box keeps only your question, and the quoted text rides along with the message you send. Package name: dsh-quote-tray.

title: wanted09527/dsh-progress-caption
description: A one-line caption above the composer that tells you what the AI is doing right now: the step number, the action (e.g. running npm test), and whether it is still going, done, or failed with a short plain-language reason. Inferred locally from tool calls and the thinking text; no model calls, no network requests, no writes to DSH data.

title: warmwine/dsh-ui-font
description: Font engine for the Web GUI: system font enumeration, global and per-component font-size tuning with a Spy++-style picker, settings page.

title: waterha/dsh-pintop
description: Provides an always-on-top window feature for the DSH window, preventing it from being hidden unexpectedly, Windows only; requires PowerShell 7 (pwsh.exe) on PATH.

title: watershow666/dsh-sidebar-icon-row
description: Turns the DeepSeek Harness sidebar panel entries and footer entries into one row of icon-only squares with hover names, adds four icon-size presets, per-entry show/hide switches and up/down ordering, and puts a Settings shortcut in the footer row.

title: WatXtract-Luca/dsh-auto-open-sidebar
description: Automatically opens the right sidebar for blank top-level chats on wide screens, skipping saved layouts containing tabs and leaving non-blank chats unchanged.

title: Waverly-W/dsh-scratchpad
description: Quick temporary conversation and workspace manager for DeepSeek Harness Web GUI.

title: wdxtub/dsh-wdx-relief
description: Composer-side helpers for the DSH Web UI: next-message prediction shown as grey ghost text that Tab fills in, a one-line per-turn recap above the input (placeable below instead) that never enters the model context, a right-sidebar panel for follow-ups from past sessions, recap history and side questions with their own model picker, and config-driven reply length, style and actionable framing.

title: wefio/dsh-cache-miss
description: Yellow one-line notice for a prompt cache miss after the cache was rebuilt; shows re-billed uncached input tokens, cached hit tokens, and TTFT.

title: weiaisuyan/dsh-sidebar-entry-manager
description: Hide or show individual DeepSeek Harness sidebar entries from a settings page without disabling the plugin; includes in-plugin update.

title: weiaisuyan/dsh-split-view
description: Multi-column tabbed workspace for the DSH main area: up to four sessions side by side, each with its own tab strip, composer and host view switcher. Cannot be enabled together with luckybilly's dsh-split-view; installs as the package dsh-multipane.

title: weibaohui/dsh-dashboard
description: Usage dashboard: offline-scans session logs to chart daily/weekly/monthly tokens, estimated costs, model/tool/skill/command leaderboards, output speed, working hours and quality metrics; gridstack+ECharts cards are drag-and-drop composable, with custom formulas and AI arrangement (prompt round-trip import).

title: weibaohui/dsh-settings-ui
description: Customizes the native settings window: preset or custom window sizes, fullscreen, background transparency, and theme, solid-color, or image backgrounds, with a floating ball for quick access; saved in the local browser.

title: weibaohui/dsh-sidebar-tidy
description: Sidebar tidy: when plugins pile up, the rows under 'New session' get crowded with panel and plugin entries. This plugin folds them all — global panel rows, plugin-injected entry rows (own and third-party alike), and bottom entries — into a single menu button whose secondary menu triggers each entry exactly as before; keep any entry permanently visible with a name whitelist, and the button turns into an icon when the sidebar collapses to a narrow rail.

title: weien666/dsh-conversation-density-map
description: Adds a non-uniform conversation density map(chat history markers) to the right of the DSH chat area: one tick per turn, with tick length and spacing reflecting message size, clickable to jump to a turn and expanding on hover when crowded.

title: weimingyu9312/DSHSwitch
description: Adds customizable switch shortcut buttons to the left of the DSH Web GUI chat input for one-click slash-command insertion.

title: weixiaolv/dsh-sidebar-cards
description: A sidebar tool for DeepSeek Harness: switch between the card list and the native list, group workspaces and plugins into categories you create, and browse the project file tree in place.

title: weiYe-exployer/dsh-model-picker-2level
description: Two-level model picker for the DeepSeek Harness composer: browse providers, then models, search across all providers or within one provider, select supported reasoning-effort levels, and navigate with arrow keys, Enter and Esc.

title: WekyJay/Dsh-Microsoft-ToDo
description: Microsoft To Do panel: browse lists, add, edit, complete and reopen tasks, and open notes, due date, reminder, recurrence, steps and attachments. Lists can be collected into local groups, and a batch of tasks can be picked into a My Day shortlist. Signs in with the Microsoft device-code flow; the token cache belongs to the upstream microsoft-todo-mcp server, pinned to 0.2.0 and started with npx (so Node.js and npm access are needed) with only an allow-listed environment, while groups and My Day live locally. Today, Overdue, My Day and new due dates and reminders follow the device time zone (override with DSH_TODO_TZONE). Chinese and English UI.

title: WelY1/dsh-topbar
description: Per-session status chips in the GNOME top bar for DeepSeek Harness — gray for running, green for done, yellow for waiting — configurable from the sidebar, with a self-installed GNOME extension.

title: Wenaixi/dsh-prompt-history
description: Claude Code-style prompt history, double-Esc picker, selection quote/copy & right-click paste.

title: wenhaolin-svg/dsh-background
description: Replace the DSH solid background with a local image, with a draggable editor for fit, blur, veil and interface opacity.

title: weshopai/weshop-dsh-plugin
description: Infinite-canvas e-commerce visual workspace for product photography, virtual try-on, background edits, and video, synced live with the Harness conversation.

title: wf-ping/dsh-message-injector
description: Presets message-injection content combos and auto-injects them into every message.

title: Wfssll/dsh-three-pane
description: Adds an independently toggled native file explorer beside the conversation, with local and SSH file operations, fast remote @ completion, and native previews in the right sidebar.

title: wfz2006/dsh-status-bar#dsh-status-bar
description: Floating glass status bar for DSH on Windows 11 x64: an always-on-top capsule that mirrors session progress, the current step and pending approvals from a local DSH web profile, with peek and detail views; approval cards stay read-only until DSH returns its own decision receipt, and connecting to the official Desktop app is experimental and unverified.

title: WhatCannotBeSaid/dsh-blackhole-radio-lab
description: Opens a full-screen 3-D black-hole stage from a sidebar card, where 24,514 real internet radio stations orbit inside an accretion disc; drag to orbit, hold to cross a wormhole into a star cluster, click a star to play, with search, 13 genre filters, favourites and ICY now-playing titles.

title: WhatCannotBeSaid/dsh-im-workspace-buttons
description: Adds one 28x28 icon button per dsh-im channel that holds an account to the official Workspaces header row. Pressing one puts the sidebar into that channel's view, drawing only its conversations and hiding every other row; pressing it again drops back to the official list. Buttons appear only for channels with a connected account.

title: WhatCannotBeSaid/dsh-session-eva-status
description: Colors DSH sidebar Session rows by their official status, in an Evangelion-flavored palette: a blue left rail for a row awaiting interaction, red for the session open in the main view, purple for finished-but-unviewed, and a static rainbow title for pinned rows. Every colour is mode-scoped — dark keeps the vivid stop, light takes a darker variant solved to clear 4.5:1 against the light wall — and the split reads DSH's own dark marker. Reads official Client services only: it owns no state, never polls, and ships no host-side half.

title: whiteguo233/dsh-openbiliclaw
description: Consumer panel for OpenBiliClaw inside DSH: a right-hand drawer with recommendations, saved lists, Socratic dialogue, profile and settings, plus 22 Agent Bridge tools so the agent can read recommendations, answer probes and save items. Requires a running OpenBiliClaw backend with Agent Bridge v2 (default 127.0.0.1:8420).

title: WhitePlusMS/dsh-input-plus
description: Search and insert workspace file and directory paths with `@`, plus a `/h` menu for reusing prompts from the current session.

title: whiteS18/dsh-mcp-servers-panel
description: MCP server management panel in Settings: add, edit, enable/disable and delete servers across user and workspace scopes with form or JSON editing, and auto-register discovered MCP tools as native conversation tools.

title: whiteS18/dsh-terminal-button
description: Embedded terminal for DeepSeek Harness: opens an in-app terminal panel in the right sidebar (DockKit) or bottom composer dock, with PSReadLine geometry protection and full theme sync.

title: whybebabo/dsh-better-workspace
description: Topic grouping layered over the native workspace list: emoji folder groups, filtering and search, batch archive, and safe permanent deletion.

title: whybebabo/dsh-code-nav
description: Code preview for dsh-better-sidebar with per-language syntax highlighting, symbol outline, in-file search, and selection-to-conversation.

title: william-jin-cmu/dsh-global-launcher
description: A macOS global hotkey that opens a small prompt bar from any app and sends what you type, with an optional screenshot or window text, to a new or the last session.

title: wilsonchengassistant/dsh-media-web-preview
description: Plays video and audio files in the right Sidebar preview pane, streamed over an authenticated HTTP Range route so a remote browser can play and seek a large file without launching a native player on the Host.

title: wilsonchengassistant/dsh-mobile-sidebar
description: Below 1024px the sidebar leaves the shell frame entirely and is opened as an overlay drawer from a header button, so the conversation gets the full viewport width; wider layouts are untouched.

title: wilsonchengassistant/dsh-quick-workspace
description: Replaces the host-side folder chooser in the Add workspace flow with a name dialog, so a remote browser can create and open a workspace instead of an OS dialog appearing on the Host screen.

title: wilsonchengassistant/dsh-zh-hant
description: Adds a Traditional Chinese (zh-Hant) language to the web GUI, registered through the locale service with one dictionary per namespace and selectable in Settings, General, Language.

title: winditer/dsh-intertidal
description: Adds a full-screen sea overlay that appears on a schedule (3 minutes every 120 minutes by default) and fades out on its own. The phase, sky colours and moon come from the solar position computed on the host from a city table, so the light matches the real time and place. The water is either drawn procedurally on a canvas from a perspective noise field (random patches that grow toward the viewer, with sun glitter, near-field whitecaps and daytime gulls; at night a moon) or taken from images and videos in a folder you choose, or from web links fetched once into a local cache and graded to the current light. Includes quiet hours, deferring while you type, skip-today, a draggable corner-window form and an optional synthesised surf sound. No telemetry; the only network requests are the links you paste.

title: winditer/dsh-paste-spill
description: Folds each 4-50 KB paste in the DSH composer into its own chip (expand or delete it individually), and turns a paste of 50 KB or more into a real file attachment. Declares DSH >=0.1.7-rc.2 <0.3.0-0, so it stays visible on the 0.2 release line.

title: winditer/dsh-prompt-optimizer
description: Polishes the draft in the composer into a clearer, better-structured prompt from the ✨ button or Alt+O; streams the result live over SSE with reasoning shown first, and follows the session's default model with zero configuration or any OpenAI-compatible endpoint.

title: winditer/dsh-recent-tasks
description: An always-last, collapsible Recent tasks workspace group in the DSH sidebar: a sidebar entry and the Mod+Alt+N / Mod+Shift+N shortcut start a chat in a dedicated folder, so it lands in that group instead of 未分组. The group is a genuine workspace record rather than a plugin-drawn look-alike, so collapse, rename, search and drag order behave normally, and its folder, group name, pin-last and auto-repair are live settings.

title: winditer/dsh-temp-chat
description: Floating translucent DeepSeek whale elf on the DSH page that opens a draggable, minimizable temporary chat window using the session model or a custom OpenAI-compatible endpoint, with real-time streaming.

title: Windpixy/dsh-artifact-toolkit
description: Right-click menus on artifact cards and file links: copy the full or short path, show the file in its folder, or open it in its default app.

title: Windpixy/dsh-floating-window
description: A frosted-glass status card that floats on the Windows desktop and shows what DSH is doing — running tasks with elapsed time and current activity, pending approvals, today's token usage and the countdown to the off-peak window — and collapses into a 14×120 bar that stays out of the way.

title: windrover/dsh-minimal-UI-panels
description: Four right-Sidebar panels for the dsh web client: artifacts, long-term memory, terminal and notes. They pair two per tab with a draggable split, so two panes show all four at once. The host half ships nine memory_* tools, artifacts_list, the /memory command, and the /api/artifacts/* and /api/terminal-notes/* routes. The terminal runs one bash command per line, with a default 120-second deadline and a stop button. Requires dsh 0.1.5 or newer, and 0.2.

title: windrover/dsh-prompt-optimizer
description: A prompt optimizer in the composer input tool row: pick a category and a template, then ✨ rewrites the draft in place with one-click undo. Pick from the Basic, Context and Image categories; you can cancel a run, and it shows elapsed time and token usage. Ships 15 templates covering task-instruction rewriting, step planning, safety-research framing, system-prompt role cards, and text-to-image / image-to-image prompts; context templates read the recent turns of the session for coreference resolution. Calls go through the host model service, and a settings section exposes the model and the budgets. Output guards check that user-written constraints survive, warning rather than auto-retrying. Adapted for dsh 0.1.7 and 0.2.

title: WindyPro-rourou/dsh-code-studio
description: File-change monitor and code editor for the DSH Web UI. Agent edits appear beside your conversation as real-time line-by-line diffs, with a syntax-highlighted editor, one-click revert, change history, workspace switcher, and per-session isolation.

title: Wine-Red/dsh-codex-timeline
description: Left-edge user-Turn navigation rail with reading-position highlighting, hover previews of per-turn metrics and model-answer excerpts, keyboard and click-to-jump controls, and local conversation search.

title: Winter-And-You-Gone/dsh-deep-verbs
description: Rotates the model status line through a 53-phrase English/Chinese deep-theme pool: a random pick at turn start, event-driven switching on new thinking segments or tool calls (3s throttle), and a click on the status line toggles the language.

title: Winter-And-You-Gone/dsh-turn-fold
description: A better fold bar: automatically folds tool calls and Think segments into step fold bars, and collapses each finished turn into a single turn header with live metrics (duration, TTFT, token, tok/s, cache hit) — only the final summary stays visible; customizable leading icons with animated poker cards built in (suit-cycling card animation while running, a deck when collapsed, a fan when expanded), a settings row for the official fold mode, compatible with both new and old DSH versions. Zero intrusion into DSH source.

title: Witherwithwinter/DeepSeek-Balance-Whale-Widget-Bowl
description: A fixed-corner DeepSeek balance whale widget for the DSH web GUI: three switchable skins (default / bowl-on-head / bowl-in-hand), balance with today usage, per-turn cost popups, peak/off-peak price conversion, press sound effects and random talk lines. Modified from MeteorNOX/DeepSeek-Balance-Whale-Widget.

title: Witherwithwinter/DSH-Codinput
description: Replaces the chat composer with an editor-style input panel on CodeMirror 6: line numbers, edit + markdown-preview split, a floating window mode and a full-height sidebar tab — one input surface at a time. Drafts ride the official input machine; the official voice-input button is rendered when the host provides one, and the stats row and context meter read the same data as the official dock.

title: wjf1/dsh-prompt-enhance
description: Sparkle button immediately left of the model selector that rewrites the composer draft into an executable prompt in place, modelled on WorkBuddy: the host calls the conversation LLM with a prompt-engineering system prompt, multi-level undo keeps up to 8 previous drafts, and a token-level diff card shows added and removed spans, the number of changed spots and the net character delta. Runs on the session model, is disabled while the draft is empty, and keeps the browser-session cookie fence in front of the LLM call.

title: wjingshan/dsh-dock-launcher#dsh-dock-bridge
description: Publishes the running dsh Web server's PID, port and tokenized URL to a runtime file for the DeepSeek Harness Switch Dock app, and removes it on shutdown.

title: wjingshan/dsh-sidebar-focus
description: Orders and folds the DSH left sidebar by what is actually running — a workspace floats to the top when one of its sessions starts and keeps that place when the session finishes, only the N most recently active workspaces stay expanded, and six switches plus one count control each rule.

title: wjinxuan/dsh-perch
description: A Dynamic-Island-style status panel that lives in the macOS notch and lists running turns, background jobs and subagents, with a completion banner and a spoken reminder.

title: WJNCT55555/dsh-web-preview-float
description: Google AI Studio-style floating preview for the Web UI: a draggable/resizable iframe preview with aspect-ratio and resolution presets, plus a VS Code-style code window with direct editing, confirmed writes, and session-log recording.

title: WJZ-P/dsh-attachments
description: Adds file and folder drag-and-drop attachments to the Web UI, with composer cards, persistent history, and workspace-backed paths.

title: wlj521/dsh-ui-tweaks
description: Live-tune the DSH Web conversation UI from Settings: message font size, Claude Desktop-style markdown tables, dialog width, an optional timeline rail, and a GitBar with branch management, per-file diff, and commit & push.

title: wlllyj/dsh-prompt-forge
description: Adds one Prompt button beside the composer: clicking it rewrites the draft with an editable prompt-engineering doctrine and returns the result as pickable rows instead of overwriting the draft, and the same panel edits the plugin's own settings in place.

title: WLV-ZEDD/dsh-btw
description: Interactive Side-Assistant Dock to ask quick side questions via /btw with real-time thinking status and history pagination without interrupting the active agent loop.

title: wmengxiang/dsh-prompt-optimizer
description: Adds an icon button to the composer that optimizes the current draft prompt through the active model.

title: wmingzhou7-cell/DSH-English-learning
description: Rotating word and phrase flashcards under the composer, plus a right-sidebar page with an English topic brief, topic-matched vocabulary and a word book.

title: WMXS-A/dsh-utility-plugins#dsh-skill-cheatsheet
description: Composer button that opens a panel listing every skill available to the current session with Chinese titles, purposes and usage examples, and lets you catalogue newly installed skills in one click (saved locally).

title: wodongx123/dsh-desktop-tray
description: Adds a system tray icon to DSH Desktop, with settings to hide the main window to the tray on minimize or close and self-healing after app updates.

title: Woeful001/dsh-refresh
description: Adds a refresh button to the sidebar footer that reloads the plugin list and the page so newly installed plugins take effect without restarting the desktop app.

title: WolfGenerals/ncm-player
description: Floating NetEase Cloud Music player for DSH Web: draggable collapsible window with mini mode, playlist discovery with search and hot lists, synced lyrics with translations, persistent playback queue, QR-code or Cookie login, colors following the DSH skin theme.

title: WongYuYe/dsh-composer-recall
description: Arrow-key input history for DSH 0.1.2-alpha.1: press ↑ in an empty composer to recall this session's prompts, ↓ to go forward, Esc to restore the draft.

title: WongYuYe/dsh-diff-card
description: Per-turn file-change card for DSH Desktop: +N −M badges, aligned diffs, and Mac/Windows file open (system app, Finder/Explorer, VS Code).

title: wood007924/dsh-approval-enter
description: Keyboard confirmation for approval cards: the card takes focus when it appears, so Enter allows once and Esc rejects, and those two keys are forwarded through the card handler when focus has moved elsewhere. It never auto-approves and never steals focus from a text field.

title: woody-dx/dsh-pdf-bookmarks
description: PDF outline navigation and local reading bookmarks in the existing right-sidebar file preview; supports adding, renaming, deleting and revisiting page positions, with version and integrity guards. Verified on macOS Apple Silicon with dsh Desktop 0.2.1-rc.2 and 0.2.1-rc.3.

title: wowswows/dsh-req-workbench
description: Lets the conversation AI maintain a plain-language functional requirements checklist in a dedicated session view. A non-official rebuild of Songran241/dsh-req-workbench that keeps the upstream package name; do not install it alongside the upstream original.

title: wqx-txdsyl/dsh-ds-attach
description: **DeepSeek Chat (chat.deepseek.com) same-style attachments**: paperclip upload button, 240×64 DS-style file cards with official colored doc icons (PDF/DOCX/XLSX/PPT/IMG extracted from the DS frontend bundle), drag-and-drop, text extraction (PDF/DOCX/XLSX/TXT) injected into the message, and real attachment cards rendered in the transcript (custom user renderer) with the model reading full content.

title: wqx11235/dsh-github-profile
description: Read-only GitHub profile page inside DSH — repo cards with language and stars, plus a one-year contribution heatmap.

title: wqx11235/dsh-sidebar-fold-37
description: DSH sidebar fold: collapse plugin panel rows into one More row that expands inline on hover or click; right-click opens a settings page to choose which panels stay outside.

title: WSL043/dsh-reasoning-slider
description: Adds a model-aware reasoning effort slider with native and animated modes, light and dark palettes, and shared or per-model colors.

title: WsTe47/dsh-step-clock
description: Shows the running agent step above the web composer as a Chinese sentence: its step number, the tools it is running, and how long it has been going. A finished step keeps its duration on screen until the next one starts, so a slow step can be identified after the fact.

title: wsxwj123/dsh-plugins#dsh-composer-tools
description: Composer input toolkit: arrow-key session history (first/last-line gated, IME and command-menu safe), an instructions viewer/editor for global and project AGENTS.md/CLAUDE.md, and a prompt library of 780 Chinese prompts (Cherry Studio agents-zh corpus, AGPL-3.0) inserted into the composer in one click. Ships on npm as `dsh-composer-tools`.

title: wsxwj123/dsh-plugins#dsh-turn-scrubber
description: Compact right-edge turn rail with hover summaries and click-to-jump navigation. Ships on npm as `dsh-turn-scrubber`.

title: wszhoho/dsh-file-attachment
description: Drag-and-drop / paste / upload files and images; on non-multimodal models images are auto-described by a configured VLM.

title: wt0812/dsh-vocab-study
description: Offline vocabulary panel: a capsule beside the composer opens a word card, and a dockable tabbed panel tracks today, progress, the mistake book and settings.

title: WU55UY/dsh-pomodoro-box
description: Adds a collectible blind-box layer to a composer-dock pomodoro timer: each finished focus session opens one of 15 items across four rarity tiers, tracked in a 5x3 gallery.

title: wuaisaber/dsh-think-zh-plus
description: Keeps DSH reasoning in Simplified Chinese and auto-expands every Think row in the Web UI.

title: wucl12/dsh-side-branch
description: Read-only side branch in the right sidebar: quote text to ask follow-ups without polluting the model context of the main session; every follow-up rebuilds the branch from the latest settled turns of the main session, and writes are refused at the tool-execution layer so the prompt prefix stays cacheable.

title: WuHututu/dsh-side-chat
description: Opens a temporary side conversation in the right Sidebar that reuses the host conversation UI, so answers render with the same markdown, tool steps, timing and token usage as the main thread. Selecting part of an answer opens that conversation side chat with the passage quoted: the quote waits as a pill inside the composer, rides along with the next message, and joins the side chat context. The side chat runs on its own memory-only session: the parent snapshot is reference context only, and nothing is written to the session log.

title: wukiQAQ/dsh-enter-using
description: Codex-style keyboard answers for the pending command-approval panel — 1 allows once, 2 rejects, Enter confirms the highlighted choice, arrow keys move it, and Esc rejects, with the buttons still usable by mouse.

title: wukong7788/dsh-plugins#dsh-printer
description: Adds a Print action next to Copy that opens a preview and prints the assistant message.

title: wungjyan/dsh-offwork-countdown
description: A pill in the corner of every DSH page that walks a shift with you: it asks you to clock in when the shift starts, counts down quietly afterwards, tints the card with your reminder colour as the end approaches, then fills it, breathes and shakes when it is time to clock out, and stays on screen outside a shift naming when you are next on.

title: wuqiwenpk/dsh-custom-bg
description: Bottom-left floating panel that uploads and switches your own background images, with scrim and blur sliders and three bundled wallpapers.

title: wuuuuu123-32/dsh-open-artifacts
description: Adds an action to the session menu and the session title bar that opens the artifacts folder of that conversation: it reads the session log, works out which directories the conversation wrote files to, and opens them in Explorer.

title: wuwaka/dsh-clipboard-menu
description: Adds a right-click menu to DeepSeek Harness inside desktop shells that ship no context menu: cut, copy, paste and select all in the composer, copy and copy-as-plain-text on selected text elsewhere, and a search entry that opens the default browser with a configurable engine.

title: WuweiRE/dsh-composer-suggest
description: Ghost-text suggestions in the composer: the message you are most likely to send next after a reply, and a continuation of your draft when you press Tab, including images attached to the composer. Tab accepts, Alt+Down cycles candidates, and the Settings row shows which model route answered. Adapted from Stijnus/dsh-composer-predictions, so do not enable both at once (they share the composer overlay and the Tab key); each suggestion is an extra model call on the Session's model unless you pin another.

title: WWFZS/dsh-plugin-startup-animation
description: Full-screen boot animation covering the loading page until the app UI is ready. The same library doubles as an appearance theme behind the interface, and desktop pets float over it on their own. Ships multiple built-in videos, wallpapers, voices and pets; upload your own files to customize.

title: wwjzzy/dsh-weread
description: WeChat Reading (WeRead) right-sidebar bookshelf and chapter reader: QR or Cookie login, store search, resume reading, and weread_shelf / weread_search / weread_book / weread_chapter agent tools.

title: wwumit/dsh-phone#client
description: iPhone-style agent phone: dual-panel calls & SMS, RCS group chat with trust gates, cross-device agent messaging via the registry inbox bridge, L0–L4 trust badges and evidence audit. Experimental: trust summaries are not a security guarantee, and SMS/signalling is relayed through the operator's inbox (visible to them); E2E encryption is planned.

title: www02310/dsh-go
description: Launch splash screen for DSH — a row of white marquee dots lights up, then the DeepSeek Harness wordmark is written stroke by stroke before the main window takes over. Installs as a runtime-injected overlay plugin; the repository also ships an optional native build.

title: wwwangzilin/dsh-role-cards
description: Replaces the new-session hero with a combined picker: role cards for the agent presets and a workspace card, collapsed into capsule buttons that expand into two scrollable rows.

title: wx-98/DSH-folder
description: Folder explorer for the DeepSeek Harness right sidebar: open any local folder, browse a tree with file-type icons, rename/create/delete/copy files and folders, and add files to the chat as @ references.

title: wx-yss/dsh-message-rail
description: Codex-style left-side message navigation rail for the Web UI: one tick per user message, hover previews, and click-to-jump across the whole history.

title: wydddddcool/dsh-hover-approve
description: Anchors an approve/answer bubble to each DSH Web sidebar session row — one-click handling of authorization, questions, plan reviews and blocked goals without opening the conversation.

title: wyzh0117/dsh-notebook
description: Sidebar notebook with titled notes and inline images (videos rejected); click a title to copy its body to the clipboard, reference a note in the composer with @, and optionally open the notebook for every new session.

title: wzciczw/dsh-explainer
description: Zero-friction quick ask for DSH: select text in chat, Markdown/code, rendered HTML reports, or the better-sidebar editor. The default answer starts automatically (English prose is translated, a term is explained, a question is answered); typing cancels it. Answers stream from a one-shot completion on the main window's model, inherit a read-only conversation snapshot, read the selected file as context (up to 20,000 characters by default), and never write to the main session. One-line install; host routes, client slots, document renderers and the iframe selection bridge are separable extension points.

title: Wzh0718/dsh-minimal-transcript
description: Minimal DSH Web transcript toggle: hide thinking, tool-call, and turn-process rows from the session header while preserving assistant answer text.

title: wzn16/dsh-task-capsule
description: Session-header task capsule with color-coded run states, click-to-jump and a multi-task dropdown, plus task notification cards (done / error / waiting-for-confirmation) with synthesized sound and optional system notifications.

title: wzsx150/dsh-session-speed-pill
description: Adds a decode-speed reading to each reply action row, right of the usage control: open it for the turn time breakdown, first-token latency, decode output, prefill, speed ranges and total usage. A setting can keep every message action row visible.

title: wzz3034026545/dsh-rule-manager
description: Manage DSH rules from the web settings panel — edit global/project AGENTS.md, or auto-split pasted rules into layered AGENTS.md and skills via LLM.

title: x2802490130-prog/dsh-client-ui-writing
description: Client-side writing panel for the Web UI: project volumes and stats, corpus library, full-text search, evolution version-chain diffs, and an SVG thread graph, shown only in writing-preset sessions.

title: xchannel1987/dsh-sdd-progress-xc
description: SDD task progress (todos) and progress ledger (sdd/progress.md) as a right-sidebar tab bound to the current session, rendered with the official MarkdownText, auto-refresh every 5s.

title: Xchcy/dsh-codex-kit#chat-only
description: Adds a chat-only action to the sidebar footer that opens a blank session in a dedicated ~/.dsh/chats workspace, so a conversation can start without choosing a project.

title: Xchcy/dsh-codex-kit#projects-browser
description: Replaces the sidebar workspace list with a Codex-style browser: sticky Pinned / Projects / Recent sections, status marks for working, awaiting approval, interrupted, and completed sessions, right-click sorting plus workspace rename and delete, and per-session pin and archive menus.

title: Xchcy/DSH-Reflex
description: Right-click menu for links and file references in DSH messages: open with the default app or a chosen app, reveal in the file manager, copy the path, name or text content, or save a copy.

title: XcodeFish/dsh-file-link-menu
description: Adds a right-click menu on file references in chat output, listing registered applications with icons for open-with, revealing files in the file manager, and copying absolute or relative paths resolved against the session workspace, while code blocks, plain text and external links keep the native menu.

title: XDeemoH/PULSE
description: Running panel for dsh for skill management and visualizing skill calls: live skill and tool calls, the skill-catalog token budget against a line that follows the model's context window, a skill loadout window that enables and disables skills in bulk with dry run and undo, goals and ideas, and saved conversation excerpts. Applying a loadout moves skill folders between ~/.agents/skills and ~/.agents/skills-parked, which other apps share (dry run first, undo available); automatic translation, goal inference and idea collection call your default model only after you opt in on first open.

title: XenoPhonLau/dsh-activity-bar
description: VS Code style 44px icon rails for the side panels DSH collapses: the left rail keeps the sidebar navigation and the bottom action rows, the right rail lists the sidebarRightTabs ledger so third-party tabs appear on their own, and the right panel is drag-resizable between 300px and 60% of the window. Two switches under Settings → Activity Bar, saved in this browser.

title: XHR666/dsh-mpkg-wallpaper
description: Load Wallpaper Engine .mpkg files as the DSH web background: embedded video, time-of-day switching, unified frosted blur, local wallpaper library & rotation.

title: xi-zhao/OpenQuantum#openquantum-web-branding
description: Applies OpenQuantum branding, browser metadata, and PWA assets to the native DeepSeek Harness web UI.

title: xiaaoyun/dsh-vibe-desk
description: A vibe desk for the Web UI: palette presets, wallpapers with 4K daily images, a monospace look, generated ambient tracks, and NetEase Cloud Music search with a free-tracks chart.

title: xiaheng1/dsh-turn-nav
description: Turn histogram navigation rail for DeepSeek Harness Web with mixed, DeepSeek, and Codex visual variants.

title: xiamubumu/dsh-composer-launcher
description: A launcher panel for DSH: manages the capability composer, the plugin inventory and the MCP bridge, and walks you through installing the browser tab-bridge extension.

title: XIANGDEEN/dsh-sidebar-video-player
description: A right-Sidebar video player with a folder playlist (first-frame thumbnails, duration badges, sort by name/duration/modified/size, fullscreen, and a context menu for rename/copy/delete/refresh when the folder is opened with write access), live playback telemetry (buffered range, decoded FPS, dropped frames) and a read-only MP4/MOV reader for codec profile/level, exact frame count, per-track bitrate and rotation. Registers no agent tool; file writes use the browser File System Access API only after a write-permission folder choice.

title: xianrui69/dsh-quick-phrases
description: Adds a draggable, position-persisted chip bar of configurable quick phrases to DeepSeek Harness, plus a /-triggered phrase menu with per-phrase pin, slash-menu, bar-visibility, and click-to-send toggles.

title: xiao-xiao-bai-ya/dsh-cn-menu-kit
description: Chinese titles, Chinese search, hover detail cards and drag-to-reorder for DSH skills and commands in the slash menu and plus panel.

title: xiaobaga281/dsh-effort-mosaic
description: Replaces the reasoning-effort row in the DSH model menu with a pixel-mosaic particle track: the stretch next to the knob is a still, dense mosaic wall, and squares increasingly leave the grid and drift apart toward the left. Knob shape, size and fill, accent color, the highest-effort burst style and the out-of-track particle effect are all configurable in the plugin settings.

title: Xiaofei-fei/dsh-prompt-history
description: Terminal-style composer for the DSH web GUI: shell prompt history (↑/↓, prefix search, Ctrl+R), Codex-style completion and next-prompt prediction (Tab or → to accept), selection toolbar (copy / quote / ask in side chat), right-click paste, draggable chat TOC, and a parallel side-chat thread in the right sidebar.

title: xiaokaizhou/dsh-media-preview
description: Renders local audio/video paths as inline, playable previews in DSH chat: replaces paths with <audio>/<video> players backed by same-origin /api/media-preview/* route, with explicit error statuses.

title: xiaoluoli45/dsh-code-explainer
description: Adds a Chinese end-of-line comment to every line of code shown in a DSH tool card - grey for the call being made, blue arrows for code in the output - written instantly by a local rule set and, for lines the rules cannot judge, by the current session model; a header toggle returns the block to plain code, and credentials are masked before anything is sent or cached.

title: XiaoLuoMin/dsh-resource-monitor
description: Windows resource monitor for the DeepSeek Harness (dsh) sidebar: samples CPU, memory and clock speed once a minute, keeps a 30-day history and draws separate 24h / 7d charts for CPU and memory (with 85% / 90% alert lines) plus a frequency chart that marks load-time throttling. Reports sustained CPU >= 85% (10 min), memory >= 90% (10 min) and frequency <= 70% of maximum clock under load (5 min).

title: xiaomujiang/dsh-user-question-nav
description: ChatGPT-style question nav rail with up/down arrow buttons — per-question tick marks on the chat edge, hover-triggered drawer listing every user question with real-time search filter, one-click smooth-scroll jump, and active-question highlight synced to scroll position.

title: XiaoOu2024/dsh-novel-generator
description: Novel generator: builds a world snapshot along a story timeline and, from the latest snapshot and the most recent chapters, deduces the next chapter. Requires DSH >=0.2.1-rc.2.

title: XiaoPb/dsh-mobile-layout
description: Phone-portrait layout shell for the DSH Web UI: the sidebar becomes an off-canvas drawer opened by swiping from the left, a persistent 56px action bar sits under the composer, and the settings panel plus the model and permission pickers are reflowed for touch. Ships native, merged and floating layout presets, all scoped to html\[data-dshm-mode="mobile"], so desktop, tablet and landscape keep the stock layout.

title: XiaoSHang05/dsh-sidebar-fold
description: Puts one collapsible row above the sidebar panel icons. Click it to hide the icons, click again to show them. The choice is remembered in the browser. Because folding is done in CSS, icons from plugins you install later are folded too. It does not depend on any other plugin.

title: xiaoshihou514/dsh-tui
description: Clean and simple TUI.

title: xiaosurongjia/dsh-improved-inline-edit
description: A mid-run steer input for DeepSeek Harness Web: while the agent works, an input bar appears above the composer to inject modification requests into the next decision via agent.steer(), without stopping the conversation. Drafts persist per session, unread injected messages can be recalled from the bubble, and an optional guiding prefix is supported.

title: xiaotuchu/dsh-file-tree
description: Adds a resizable workspace file tree beside the native preview, with directory expansion, filtering of loaded files, and refresh.

title: xiaoxiaolelang-ai/dsh-next-steps
description: Per-turn next-step suggestions under each reply: a 2x2 grid of up to four clickable actions, projected from that turn's own tool result instead of a shared per-session store.

title: xiaoxiaolelang-ai/dsh-rail
description: Narrow 40px icon rail for the DSH sidebar: panel icons move into a single column so the session list gets the full width, session titles gain a three-level hierarchy, and the DeepSeek account balance sits just above the sidebar footer with today and cumulative spend accounted from balance deltas, plus value-based colours. Follows the DSH 0.2.2-rc.2 sidebar structure (the two-column grid now lives on the nested scrollArea), so icons and the workspace list stay side by side.

title: xiaoxin3309/dsh-mini
description: Windows only (needs the Edge WebView2 Runtime): pop the current session into an always-on-top WebView2 mini window with a self-drawn title bar, free resizing and a jump back to the main window; adds full-screen and region screenshots that paste straight into the composer, a "ask about selection" pill for text selected in any application, global hotkeys and a settings section.

title: xiaoyangcheng84-svg/dsh-skin-manager
description: Skin manager for the DSH web GUI: discovers installed skins and switches the active one from a dedicated Settings page, mutually exclusive, hot-reloaded without restart.

title: xiaoyaoguhuaxian/dsh-highlight-plugin
description: Select any sentence in a DSH chat session and mark it with a colored highlight (yellow, green or blue). Marks are drawn on an independent overlay so framework re-renders cannot wipe them, are anchored by quote context, stored per session and persist across restarts until deleted individually.

title: xiaoyi-xx/dsh-peak-status
description: Header chip for the DSH web GUI that shows whether the current Beijing time is inside DeepSeek's API peak window, with a live clock and countdown to the next transition.

title: xiaoyuer3921/dsh-showreel
description: Turns the latest completed DSH session turn into a shareable vertical recap video: editable five-scene storyboard, host-side privacy redaction, optional AI polish and TTS narration, MP4/WebM export with PNG cover.

title: xiex16070-jpg/dsh-prompt-enhance
