description: Adds an enhancement chip to the composer input action row, left of the model selector: it rewrites the draft in place using the model already selected in the session, in five styles, with one-click undo and an /enhance slash command.

title: xiezouqu12/agent-trees
description: Live multi-way tree of the current session's agents in the DeepSeek Harness conversation view and right sidebar, with status, plan progress, tokens, cost (requires dsh-cost-meter), and runtime on every card.

title: XiLuovo/dsh-session-timeline
description: Session timeline down the left of the conversation: every user message at a glance, current-message tracking, hover preview of the message and its reply, click to jump, collapsible.

title: XinAnzzZ/dsh-session-manager
description: Nested session folders for the DSH sidebar: create folders per workspace, nest them and drag to reorder, move sessions by drag or context menu, click a folder activity count to open the matching sessions, and tag sessions with a header tag filter. Undo, rename, archive, search and keyboard navigation work on the tree.

title: xinchen262/dsh-whale-balance-pet
description: A floating whale-girl pet for DeepSeek Harness that shows the live account balance and per-minute token spend.

title: xindady/dsh-prompt-enhancer
description: Adds a prompt enhancement button to the composer toolbar that rewrites the draft through a model call, keeps @file references verbatim, and offers one-click undo.

title: DSH Canvas
description: An AI-native multimodal canvas for DSH: preview images, video, audio, 3D models, PDFs, documents, and code; connect ideas and collaborate with agents in a persistent local workspace.

title: xing-shuyin/dsh-ui-tools
description: Developer tools panel for the DSH web UI: file browser with preview, edit, and path-only file mentions; multi-tab terminals with quick commands; Git panel with commit, push, pull, and branch switching; and background job management. UI ported from pi-web-ui.

title: Xingkong42/dsh-open-workspace
description: Adds Open workspace entries to the sidebar session-row menu and the session header actions slot, opening the session workspace folder in the system file manager.

title: Xingkong42/dsh-zh-labels
description: Re-applies Chinese UI labels to the DSH client modules on every start, so translations survive upgrades.

title: xingxing2013/dsh-prompt-history
description: Prompt history in the composer: Up and Down recall prompts sent earlier in this browser (newest first), Down walks back and restores the draft you had before the first Up, and the badge in the composer corner opens a numbered list to pick one directly. Only prompts you actually send are recorded — never fragments left by deleting text or cancelling a composition — history is shared across sessions and deduplicated, its badge size is adjustable in Settings → General, and Ctrl/Cmd+Shift+Backspace clears it.

title: xingxingbk-git/dsh-deepseek-chat
description: Adds a switch between DeepSeek web chat and the Harness workspace in DSH Desktop.

title: xingyeai23/dsh-comfyui-studio
description: ComfyUI studio in a DSH sidebar panel: connects to a local or LAN ComfyUI server, picks saved image workflows, cleans and rewrites prompts, edits LoRAs and nodes, generates images, and previews results with copyable seeds.

title: xingzhen199186/dsh-entry-drawer
description: Turns the first row of the DSH sidebar entry list into a switch that folds every other entry away, giving the session history more room.

title: xinjiguaike/dsh-session-location
description: Adds the owning workspace and current Git branch under each session row in the flat session list.

title: xinming-chenniang/dsh-button
description: Editable prompt shortcuts beside the DSH composer: save the prompts and phrases you retype as buttons, then send the preset text or insert it into the draft, and reorder, move, or resize them. Text-only: runs no host commands and never overwrites an existing draft; a button can also read the previous message, the draft, or the selection when clicked, and ask you to fill in {{name}} slots before it runs.

title: xinming-chenniang/dsh-open-at-last-input
description: Lands the chat viewport on your most recent own message when you open a finished session, instead of the bottom of the conversation; running sessions still follow the bottom. Client-only: it reads the viewport and never touches files, credentials, subprocesses, or the network.

title: XinpengWei/dsh-wechat-bg
description: Scan a QR code with WeChat, upload a photo from the phone, and use it as the DSH Web UI background.

title: xinspark/dsh-better-session-topbar
description: Better Session Topbar: replaces the session topbar title with a workspace and session breadcrumb, switching workspaces, sessions and subagents from topbar dropdowns; adding a workspace hands off to the host's own directory picker, which is the OS folder dialog on desktop.

title: xintingcui/dsh-sidebar-panels-fold
description: Collapses the sidebar global-panel rows to a few visible entries and adds a picker for choosing which ones stay, so a long panel list stops squeezing the workspace and session area; rows are hidden only, never unregistered.

title: Xinyuan-Gao/xy-dsh#xy-dsh-lamp
description: Always-on-top lamp board for macOS: one lamp per agent, one row per session, collapsing to one lamp per running task; a lamp turns blue and blinks while an approval or a question is waiting on you, and the root agent finishing raises a system notification.

title: Xinyuan-Gao/xy-dsh#xy-dsh-question-nav
description: Keeps the question you are currently on pinned above the composer, with a dropdown of every earlier question that scrolls the conversation back to that turn; questions folded into process groups are expanded first, and Escape, scrolling or clicking outside collapses the panel.

title: xinyuzi/copper-oil-plugin
description: Copper-to-oil ratio dashboard for the Shanghai Composite: lag-weighted forecast band and drill-down charts.

title: xiong356/dsh-draft-optimizer
description: Adds a ✦ button below the DSH composer — and on the new-conversation screen — that rewrites the current draft into a more complete prompt with a single call to the configured default model, keeping the original intent and language, and replaces the draft in place without sending it.

title: xishuai-zero/dsh-entry-organizer
description: Drag-reorders the dsh sidebar panel entries and the conversation view tabs, and moves an entry between the sidebar and the tab strip as a real tab; order and moves are saved locally and survive restarts.

title: XIUDENBENNY/dsh-claude-quote
description: Claude Code Desktop-style selection quoting: select text in a conversation to reply to that passage from a popover, or fork the session into a side chat in the right sidebar with the selection quoted. Quotes sit above the composer as removable cards, are sent as plain Markdown blockquotes in the same format as Claude Code Desktop, and render as clamped quote blocks in sent messages.

title: xixingyingmie/dsh-gpt-niang-widget
description: A GPT/ChatGPT-persona desktop pet pinned to the bottom-right corner of the DSH web GUI — shows balance, today's usage, peak/off-peak pricing and per-turn cost, with editable bubbles (text, balance, usage, pricing, images, random lines and weighted choices), per-line styles and fonts, a floating quick editor, sound effects, custom character art/animation/audio, and snapping/flipping. 54 GPT-flavored lines across five groups. Its routes, bundle id and data files are namespaced so it can run alongside the whale and Xiaoke widgets. A derivative of MeteorNOX/DeepSeek-Balance-Whale-Widget (MIT).

title: xiyuepcl/dsh-approval-translator
description: DSH审批汉化 — approval dialogs translated to Chinese before they render: DeepSeek-powered, host-side, nothing for React to revert.

title: xkjxziochu/dsh-input-optimizer
description: Rewrites the draft in the DSH composer into a clearer, more executable prompt through the harness's own LLM routes, showing an original/optimized comparison before you adopt it.

title: xlennart/dsh-goal-mode-enhance
description: Visual goal lifecycle for the DSH web UI: a composer dock to create, multiline-edit, pause, resume, complete and clear session goals with live round progress, plus a phase-dot composer entry and a settings-page goal overview.

title: xlennart/dsh-side-chat
description: Native side-by-side chat beside the main conversation: an independent DSH session with native UI, on-demand parent-context retrieval, selection quoting, and a keep-or-delete lifecycle.

title: Xliecc/dsh-session-theme
description: Shows every session theme in the DSH Web left sidebar immediately on page load by warming the session projection cache at startup; no need to click into a conversation first.

title: XM-Zou/dsh-local-music-player
description: Local-first music player and playlist manager for the DSH Web UI.

title: xmlans/dsh-xmlans
description: Desktop pet for DSH: 兰酱, an angel-winged maid in a transparent always-on-top window who reacts to session states (thinking, working, waiting, done, error), shows task progress and DeepSeek balance, and responds to drags, head pats, pokes and wing touches.

title: xmmtr/dsh-better-right-click
description: Better Right-Click: right-click menu on file references in the DSH transcript. Copies the absolute path, reveals the file selected in Explorer by reusing and focusing an existing window, and lists every app registered for that file type so you can open it with the one you want. Menu labels follow the DSH display language (Chinese and English). Windows only (Explorer reveal and the registered-apps list use PowerShell).

title: XMoon/dsh-pi-tui
description: Third-party TUI mode for DeepSeek Harness (dsh --profile pi-tui), built on a vendored pi-tui fork: covers the main session loop plus approvals, commands, session switching and full-text search, as well as presets, skills, model/settings menus and slash commands.

title: xmwengxing/dsh-client-ui-sidebar-perfmon
description: Host performance monitor in the right Sidebar: CPU, memory and swap gauges, a GPU clock and VRAM bar, CPU / GPU / motherboard / drive temperatures, and a process table sortable by CPU, memory or name.

title: xmwengxing/dsh-sidebar-enhancement
description: Enhanced right-sidebar files panel: rename, create, upload, download (a directory is zipped on the fly), copy the full path and delete from the tree; an editable document renderer for 128 text extensions with Ctrl/Cmd+S save and conflict detection; plus an independent bottom terminal panel with tabs and a quick-command library persisted under the DSH home.

title: xscanzm/dsh-hr-workbench
description: Runs a complete HR workbench inside DSH — a 3D office, recruiting pipeline (resume, interview, written test, score), employee roster, files, attendance, performance, training and analytics — with the site’s AI assistant answering through the model DSH already runs.

title: xswt442-cmd/dsh-xswt-tauriapp#dsh-desktop-app
description: Installer entry for the dsh-xswt-tauriapp desktop shell, a Tauri desktop shell for DeepSeek Harness: on the first dsh start after installation it downloads this platform's installer from the release, checks it against the release SHA256SUMS before writing it, and opens it with the system installer. It installs nothing itself and adds no UI to dsh.

title: xsxElricor/dsh-dynamic-island
description: Desktop dynamic island for DeepSeek Harness showing live agent status, approvals and questions, workspace switching, and usage stats.

title: xt765/dsh-message-edit
description: Inline user message editor: adds a pencil edit button next to Copy below sent user bubbles, switches the bubble in-place into a rounded editor card, and resends via session branch fork or in-session follow-up.

title: xt765/dsh-selection-quote
description: Cursor and GitHub PR Review style selection toolbar: quote selected text to chat (Cmd+L), write inline comments (Shift+Cmd+L), and batch-insert from a composer dock.

title: xuanfenglajiao/dsh-effort-menu
description: Replaces the composer model menu with a recent-models list, a searchable all-providers flyout and a draggable reasoning-effort slider; a Manage models row at the bottom of the flyout opens the Models settings directly. It takes over the composer model slot, so install only one model-menu plugin.

title: xuanfu-web/dsh-metaphysics
description: Chinese metaphysics (xuanxue) divination panel and agent tool with nineteen systems: eight chart systems (BaZi, Zi Wei Dou Shu, LiuYao, MeiHua, Da Liu Ren, Qi Men Dun Jia, compatibility charts, Tarot) plus eleven quick references (almanac, solar–lunar conversion, date selection, bone-weight fortune, Xiao Liu Ren, horoscope, numerology, life-curve, feng shui, name analysis, an MBTI-style 16-type questionnaire), with ask-driven, report-style interpretation. BaZi adds exact dayun handover dates, annual suiyun hints, "passing-through" (通关), three-book classical cross-reference, four-mausoleum (杂气) month pattern selection and daily "human element" (人元司权); Zi Wei adds 34 patterns, eleven switchable school variants (including an opt-in full 61-star minor-star table that ships the placement verses alongside the chart), chained flying transformations and three-way-four-corner composite flights; LiuYao adds yongshen strength, whole-hexagram per-line strength, hidden-spirit release conditions and response-time clues (应期), while LiuYao and MeiHua quote the received Zhouyi text in full (64 hexagram statements, 384 line statements plus 用九/用六, cross-checked across three editions with variant readings in brackets); feng shui covers eight-mansion and Xuan Kong flying stars; name analysis ships a 1,062-character library with five-grid (五格) numerology and phonetics checks; tarot ships a card-by-card library for all 78 cards (Rider-Waite-Smith base: English name, card-image description, core meaning and astrological correspondence, cross-checked against three published sources — court cards deliberately carry no zodiac because two published mappings conflict, and the chart says so). A classical-source library now backs the readings: 464 indexed citations from 66 classical works, with 584 verifiable quotations including all 120 Qiongtong Baojian pattern extracts; every quote is checked as a literal substring against a 341-page offline source snapshot, variant readings are kept side by side rather than harmonised, modern editorial notes are kept separate from the classical text, and the quotations with their plain-language glosses live only in a standalone citation index page instead of the browser chunks. Every result can carry a reproducible shadow-chart ID (same normalized inputs → same ID; version bumps auto-diff chart fields) plus optional step-by-step deduction traces (rule, inputs, result and source per layer). The browser client ships as a small first-screen entry plus per-tab engine chunks loaded on demand (first-screen gzip ≈ 90KB), while the offline page stays a single file. The DSH panel and the offline page share the same grouped first screen (ask / read a person / pick a date) with recent-used entries and narrow-width folding; charts open with a plain-language conclusion, one-click copy of an ask-ready prompt and saved birth charts, and an unknown birth hour falls back to a three-pillar chart instead of silently assuming midnight. All computed locally; networking is off by default. The npm package also ships an offline single-file page (命理排盘.html): double-click to open, every tab included, no server and no network needed.

title: xuanke66/dsh-thinking-slider
description: Reasoning-effort slider that replaces the composer model seat: one rail over the levels the current model declares (off/low/high/max on DeepSeek), with a 241-frame portrait that evolves frame by frame as you drag and a per-model choice that survives restarts. Uninstall restores the shipped picker.

title: xuanyuanchumo/dsh-codegraph-visualizer
description: Interactive code-graph visualization inside DSH: a sidebar entry (a tab inside dsh-better-sidebar when that plugin is installed) draws the graph produced by dsh-codegraph (its .codegraph/codegraph.db or the codegraph CLI) or by dsh-tool-lens, with call-chain tracing, cycle detection, dependency and impact analysis, directory/file/function clustering, four layouts, and PNG/SVG/JSON export. Requires dsh-codegraph or dsh-tool-lens as the data source; without one the graph is empty.

title: xuexiaolei1997/dsh-plugin-stock-x
description: Financial quantitative workbench and stock ticker: floating ball and drawer panel, real-time A/HK/US/global market quotes, multi-period K-lines and 5-day intraday charts, depth order book, capital flow, sector heat map, and AI investment research.

title: xueyufu/dsh-sidebar-groups
description: A sidebar plugin wall with local automatic grouping, drag-and-drop organization, search, and configurable compact footer components. Replaces the built-in sidebar.

title: xufu5438-netizen/dsh-boot-video
description: Full-screen video boot splash — play an mp4 at startup, skip with a click, import your own clip, and non-playable codecs are transcoded to H.264 automatically.

title: xuguangyao/dsh-prompt-deck
description: Turn your recurring one-liners into capsules above the composer. They reorder themselves by how often you use them, and ask you to fill in {{placeholder}} values before the snippet lands in the draft. Clicking appends rather than replaces, so a half-written draft survives. A drawer adds search, grouping and editing, and everything lives in a Host-side JSON file you can edit by hand.

title: xwh5/dsh-diff-review
description: Session change-review for DeepSeek Harness: tracks write/edit tool calls and renders VS Code-style side-by-side diffs via diff2html, auto-following the theme, with subagent aggregation and one-click revert.

title: XWIDE/dsh-draft-keeper
description: Keeps the images you pasted or attached in the composer, per session: they are mirrored locally in the browser and handed back through the official draft channel when you return to the conversation or the composer remounts, and dropped as soon as the message is sent or you remove them.

title: XWIDE/dsh-picflow
description: Pasted screenshots become numbered references: each Ctrl+V image is stored in the attachment library under a stable number, listed in a composer-dock thumbnail panel with an image source in the @ menu, and inserted as a reference chip at the caret — automatically after paste when the auto-insert switch is on.

title: XWIDE/dsh-xwide-annotation
description: Select text in a conversation to attach a numbered highlight with a colour stored per note, keep every mark in an outline panel that jumps back to its quote, and let a corner self-check badge report style, selector and saved-key problems without opening dev tools.

title: xx529/dsh-capability-settings
description: Adds a capability panel to the DSH web GUI: browse, install (upload, zip, host path or URL), enable, edit and export skills, and add or edit Claude Code-compatible MCP servers, at global and per-project scope — with project copies, per-project shadow stubs, live mount status and a zero-side-effect connection probe. A session view toggles capabilities for the current conversation only, and a TypeSafe Jev tab scores skills and MCP servers for the session from the input draft. Requires the dsh web shell 0.2.0-rc.2 or later. Forked from chengdb/dsh-plugin-capability-panel; it shares a patch id with that plugin and with pure-craft/dsh-capability-panel, so do not install them together.

title: xx529/dsh-shell-cmd
description: /cmd <command> in the composer runs that shell command in the session working directory, sends the command and its output to the model as a user message, and renders the input as a terminal card with exit status, expandable output and copy buttons; a bare /cmd opens an interactive terminal whose transcript is sent to the model with Ctrl+Enter. Runs with its own terminal permissions (danger-full-access) by default; set useSessionPolicy: true to use the session sandbox.

title: xx529/dsh-task-gantt
description: Agent-team task Gantt chart for the DSH sidebar - one swimlane per teammate, real session-log time on the x-axis, and every shared task drawn with its title and summary. Requires dsh-better-sidebar 0.4.0 or later (the tab has nowhere to register without it).

title: xx529/dsh-terminal-panel
description: Read-only terminal view tab in the conversation header: aggregates bash output, background jobs and persistent terminal sessions from the current session, subagents and Agent Team teammates into one filterable panel, with type and session-scope filters, command/output search, auto-collapse, follow-scroll and a maximize dialog; foreground bash shows final output only. Requires DeepSeek Harness 0.2.1-rc.2 or later (0.2.x).

title: Xxihagalife/dsh-lock-screen
description: A password lock screen for DeepSeek Harness so passers-by cannot see a running session while you step away.

title: XXP-AI-SPACE/dsh-snip
description: Snipaste-style screenshot for DeepSeek Harness: press F1 (a real Windows global hotkey) to freeze and dim the whole screen, drag a region, then draw red boxes and click-to-type text annotations with wheel-resizable font; the annotated PNG drops into the composer at native resolution. Esc exits. Windows 10/11.

title: Xxsttb/dsh-input-optimizer
description: Adds a four-pointed-star button left of the composer's model selector that rewrites the unsent draft in place — grammar, wording, punctuation and execution order — preserving code, commands, paths, identifiers, numbers and URLs byte-for-byte, answering nothing and never overwriting text typed while it runs. A pencil under every user message reopens that message for editing without touching the draft; because the Harness session log is append-only, an edit forks the conversation before that message rather than rewriting it. A circular restart icon under every reply asks that one question again in a fresh conversation that carries none of the earlier turns. Both are refused while a turn is still answering, and disabled when the reply used a tool that can leave a trace or when the files the message named have since changed. A right-sidebar memory tree draws the conversation as turns, showing what was actually asked and answered, every answer to one question on its own line labelled original, edited or memory-free, newest first, with arrows that re-read an answer in place; right-clicking jumps to a branch or removes it from the plugin's own history.

title: Xxsttb/dsh-sillytavern-presets
description: Imports SillyTavern AI presets as switchable, editable prompt layers: preserves the raw JSON, edits prompt order and sampler parameters, previews the injected System Prompt, exports back to SillyTavern-compatible JSON, and archives or permanently deletes presets with confirmation. Applies temperature and maximum output tokens to Harness requests; other sampler fields are preserved and exported but not applied.

title: xxxSnack/dsh-market-dock
description: A stock market panel for DeepSeek Harness, forked from dsh-xueqiu: A-share/HK/US quotes, K-line and intraday charts, hot lists, search and 7x24 news, plus local holdings with live-computed P&L, host-side price alerts, and a hide switch that unmounts the panel and stops market polling while alerts still fire. Replaces dsh-xueqiu; do not install both.

title: XXXXXQ-0206/dsh-prompt-for-me
description: Adds a composer button that optimizes the current prompt or designs the next one from the current session and project context.

title: xxxyz/DeepSeekHarness-MCP-Manager
description: MCP server manager for DeepSeek Harness: add, edit, enable/disable, restart and delete MCP servers from Settings → MCP 管理, with JSON export/import, four mcp_manager_* model tools and an HTTP API; install via npx, npm or cross-platform scripts.

title: xyAxzy/dsh-conversation-map
description: A live conversation map for DeepSeek Harness web: real-time session tree with subagent lineage, running state, and one-click navigation.

title: XYZ0901/dsh-composer-markdown
description: Markdown preview of the composer draft, rendered above the input or in a right-sidebar tab, with a formatting toolbar that writes bold, italic, lists, tables and code fences back into the draft.

title: xyzYaeMiko/dsh-deepsleep-progress
description: Shows an elapsed/budget progress bar with a moving head picture under blocking tool calls in the DSH Web conversation flow, and adds a graphical settings page for its style and tool list.

title: xyzYaeMiko/dsh-session-groups
description: Edge-style tab groups for the DSH sidebar on Web and Desktop, with nested groups up to three levels, workspace tree, single-list view, recursive sorting, RGB colors, collapsed status summaries, subagent expansion with status, and an approval-gated agent tool for organizing groups.

title: Y1X1n/dsh-prompt-optimizer
description: Adds an optimize button beside the composer that analyzes and rewrites the prompt draft with SSE streaming, conversation-context awareness (template vs intent-polish strategies), an edit-continuity memory chain, undo, and model routing with fallback and a connectivity test.

title: yangdinghui/dsh-sidebar-groups
description: Groups the sidebar's panel rows: two stay pinned, the rest fold under a collapsible Tools row, and rows can be dragged between the two groups.

title: yangdongzhen590/dsh-knj-menu
description: Third-party menu manager for the DSH Web UI: collects new menu entries added by other plugins into one place, with fold/collapse and pinned menu items.

title: yangdongzhen590/dsh-knj-prompts
description: Prompt scene picker for DSH: choose a scene from a dropdown and it opens a new session with the prompt already filled in (with {variable} placeholders), so you only tweak and send.

title: yanglingrise/dsh-erii-boot-splash
description: Erii (Sakura) themed boot splash animation — falling sakura petals, a mint monster mascot with a blossom on its head, and a soft pink progress bar; fades out after ~3 seconds without blocking input.

title: Yangluo-2021/dsh-restart-button
description: Adds a persistent restart button to the top-right corner of the DeepSeek Harness desktop client. It gracefully shuts down and relaunches the Electron shell and host, and asks for confirmation only when a task is running. Windows + DSH Desktop only.

title: YangShen-SWE/dsh-plugin-chat-zoom
description: Zoom only DSH chat messages and input (80%–200%) using Ctrl shortcuts or settings, with local memory and no sidebar scaling.

title: yangshen830-eng/dsh-editor
description: VS Code-style code editor: sidebar file tree over the workspace, Monaco editing, file read/write, Git status and diff, search, and Markdown preview.

title: yangzhenyu0817/dsh-session-color
description: Right-click any session row in the DeepSeek Harness sidebar to color-tag it with a default red, ten palette colors or a custom picker, persisted locally.

title: yangzhenyu0817/dsh-settings-drag
description: Moves and resizes the DeepSeek Harness settings panel; its position and size are remembered per browser.

title: yannicksong0106/dsh-550c-boot
description: Full-screen 550C boot intro for DSH: a 4-second simple cut and a 16-second rewrite sequence, skippable by click or Esc, with four phosphor palettes. The host half injects the opening frame while the document is still parsing, so the built-in loading card never shows; the desktop caption strip turns transparent, so those window buttons float on the animation.

title: YannZhou/dsh-about
description: About section for the DeepSeek Harness settings: version info, npm latest/next update check with one-click install and auto-restart, and GitHub release history.

title: yanweiyi11/dsh-pause-continue
description: Codex-style pause and continue for DeepSeek Harness: stop a running answer at any moment, then pick it up from the break point. Interaction modelled on Codex and Cursor.

title: yanzhaohui1999/dsh-3d-viewer
description: Opens STEP/STP/STL/GLB/GLTF models in a sidebar 3D viewer: STEP is tessellated in the browser with OpenCASCADE WASM; the toolbar offers fit/front/top/side/iso orthographic views and a PNG screenshot; inputs are capped at 64 MiB and .gltf files that reference external buffers or textures are rejected.

title: yaoshuo530/dsh-prompt-enhancer
description: Prompt enhancement for the composer: an "✨ Enhance" button rewrites your draft prompt into a clearer, more structured version with first-principles thinking, grounded in session context, memory and recent conversation; asks clarifying questions in a card when key info is missing, then previews the result before applying it to the input.

title: Yaoxxxxxxx/dsh-plugins#dsh-focus-composer
description: Returns the caret to the session composer on Ctrl+I; the key is rebindable in Settings and works from any region of the desktop window.

title: YaoZhang0224/dsh-formula-editor
description: Image-to-LaTeX formula editor: point it at any OpenAI-compatible vision model and a dropped or pasted screenshot is read into LaTeX, a MathLive field edits the formula in place with a 272-symbol palette, and the result copies into Word as a native equation or exports to .docx. Needs baseURL, model and an API key set in its settings before it works: there is no default endpoint, so the screenshot and the key only go where you point them.

title: YaphetHayate/codeRDD#dsh-rdd-goal-tree
description: Read-only goal-tree status strip above the composer: planners see the full node tree, workers see their claimed node, and worker reports call back to the planner session.

title: YardonYan/dsh-plugin-netease-lyrics
description: Windows-only stealth lyrics readout: reads the desktop Netease Cloud Music client through Windows SMTC (song, artist, play state), fetches its LRC and translation from the public Netease API, and renders the currently sung line directly beside the DSH activity line ("深度求索中，用时 X s") with font, size and color cloned from that line via computed style, so it reads as one longer sentence. The stopwatch-based progress freezes on pause and resets on track change; lyrics hide entirely when no activity line exists; an anchorText config retargets non-Chinese hosts; 1.0.5+ fails over between two Netease search endpoints when rate-limited. Needs the Netease "SMTC" toggle enabled.

title: ybniaobu/dsh-3d-viewer
description: Preview 3D models and textures from the session workspace in DSH's right sidebar. Supported formats include FBX, OBJ, glTF, GLB, DAE, and STL models, plus PNG, JPEG, TGA, EXR, and HDR textures.

title: YearnCy/dsh-question-tree
description: Tree-style questioning for DSH. Hover the "Question tree" tab above and a small card pops up with the whole tree — identical to the sidebar, but it frees that column and is quicker to consult (click "List / Graph" in the card to switch views). Select text in a conversation, click "Ask in tree", and a node appears in a tree you can reach three ways — hover the "Question tree" tab for a floating card that leaves the conversation in place, open the same tree as a full conversation view, or pin it in the right sidebar. Each node holds the quoted passage plus your own questions; clicking another node makes it the current parent so later selections nest under it (Alt+click opens a root node, Ctrl+click appends another passage to the same node). Double-click jumps back to the quoted text and pages older history in automatically when the passage is not loaded yet. Hover a truncated node to read the full quote, switch between a list and a horizontal branch graph (the graph scrolls sideways with the wheel as depth grows), mark nodes understood with a red/green dot — or let "mark understood once answered" do it when the reply lands. Nodes live in localStorage; nothing is injected into the prompt.

title: yefengliu1/dsh-agent-grid
description: Replaces the DSH sidebar with a fixed 2×4 board of eight standing agent seats; each seat shows its own status, latest tool call, reasoning and result, and a settings switch restores the stock sidebar at any time.

title: YEYEYEYESHIFU/dsh-result-only-view
description: Results-only conversation toggle for the Web GUI: hides thinking and tool-call process rows, keeps one live status line while the agent works, restores working animations under prefers-reduced-motion, zh-CN/en localized. Works in the stock composer and inside dsh-split-screen panes; verified on DSH 0.1.1 and 0.1.5.

title: YEYEYEYESHIFU/dsh-split-screen
description: Split-screen workspace for the DeepSeek Harness web GUI - chat with several agents side by side in panes that look and behave exactly like the stock conversation: drag-to-split, live sessions with queued messages and in-pane ask_user/approval cards, per-pane view tabs (Chat/Trajectory/plugin views), a compact TUI composer mode (Alt+T) and pane-focus shortcuts. Requires DSH 0.1.5+.

title: yezitotempeace/dsh-auto-think
description: Expands the assistant reasoning block while it streams and folds it back when done, animated in both directions; the sidebar switch only controls whether that happens automatically.

title: yezitotempeace/dsh-job-progress
description: Draggable floating card that follows background jobs: a progress bar and percentage parsed from wget/curl/apt/pip output, elapsed time, ETA when present, and the latest output line.

title: yfwu2020/dsh-full-view
description: Keeps the current chat in a movable, resizable floating window when the right file or browser panel enters full view, with a compact input bar, a whale restore button and a return to the original split layout.

title: yfwu2020/dsh-recent-sessions
description: Opens the recent sessions in a sheet that floats over the sidebar workspace list, from one row above Settings: rows sorted by last activity with their run state, a draggable height, and a list that settles onto whole rows after stopping. The sheet paints no surface of its own, so it reads as part of the sidebar.

title: yfwu2020/dsh-selection-explain
description: Select text in the DSH web UI to stream a translation and an explanation of what it means in that specific context, read against the conversation it came from; the panel keeps a replayable history and can be promoted into a full session.

title: yfwu2020/dsh-think-flow
description: Chain-of-thought panel for the DSH Web right sidebar: folds the live reasoning stream of each session into turn → step groups carrying the reasoning text and the tool calls made in that step. Only the newest turn is expanded by default and earlier turns collapse to one line; steps are grouped into activity phases by a local rule, the step waiting on a tool is marked, tool failures show their reason, full reasoning text is fetched per step on demand, an all-turn directory searches turn titles, user text and turn numbers locally, and a whole turn can be summarised into a Chinese title with one model call.

title: Ygritteee/dsh-ygritte-boot
description: Full-screen ice-and-fire boot intro for DSH: a frost-to-ember boot sequence with typed bilingual logs and a hairline progress line, then Ygritte's five-step identity authorization. Esc skips, Enter or click fast-forwards, and a settings page switches it off/quick/full or replays it; the host half paints the opening frame while the document parses, so the built-in loading card never shows.

title: yhPrime/dsh-sidebar-guide-scroll
description: Make the right sidebar Start page scroll when its tool cards overflow.

title: yhPrime/dsh-sidebar-left-split
description: Turn the seam between the sidebar panel list and the workspace list into a divider you can drag, snapping one row at a time, with the panel list scrolling when squeezed.

title: yhPrime/dsh-theme-picker
description: Manage native themes and installed theme plugins from a right-sidebar panel and a Settings page, with only one theme active at a time. Listing and toggling installed theme plugins requires dshmarket; the right-sidebar tab requires dsh-better-sidebar (otherwise the panel appears only in Settings).

title: Yhx888/dsh-quote-context
description: Chat quotes for DSH: select text in any message to quote or comment; the quote waits in a Chat quotes chip on the composer (never inside the draft), expands on hover into selected text and your comment, and folds into the message only when you send.

title: yi-yezhiqiu/dsh-prompt-market
description: Prompt market beside the composer: browse and search three built-in online prompt sources, bookmark or write your own, and insert into the input box.

title: yicun0316/dsh-claude-slider
description: Replaces the reasoning-effort dropdown with a draggable snapping slider, and draws 13 canvas effects across five style families (thrust, fluid, fantasy, tech, texture) with three tiers that unlock as the effort level rises. Custom mode combines 10 particle forms with 8 flow trajectories; 9 accent presets and a hex picker recolor every effect, and optional key sounds cover two voice clips, a synthesized duck squeak, a mechanical click and a local audio file.

title: Yifeng123589/dsh-design-kit
description: DSH design-delivery plugin with 10 tools for UI lint, design tokens, three-candidate shortlists, JND parameter probes, and PPTX deck check/export/render. Deck tools need ppt-master, Python with python-pptx and DSH's LibreOffice Kit; design_capture needs a real browser.

title: yingqi-studio/dsh-panel-compact
description: Fold the sidebar plugin-panel list to three entries, drag them to reorder, and keep every other panel one click away in a More menu — order and pins persist in localStorage.

title: yingqi-studio/md2chat-dsh-share
description: Adds a Share to chat action under each reply: converts the answer to WeChat or WeCom text, ordered segments or a long image, editable-table email HTML, or a downloadable Word document.

title: YinniCoding/momolulu
description: Floating photo companion for the DSH Web UI with a 15/25/45/60-minute focus timer, water and stretch reminders, Open-Meteo weather, and a session radar listing running, ended, input-waiting and permission-requesting conversations for one-click navigation.

title: YinqiSY/dsh-session-folders
description: Groups sidebar conversations into collapsible folders that reorder by drag, decorating the shipped session list instead of replacing it.

title: Yinxe/deepseek-harness-plugins#archive/file-change-viewer
description: Takes over the edit/write rows in the chat stream with the official native row shell and collapse behavior; expanding shows per-file code cards with file-type icon, add/delete stats, per-block collapse, highlight/plus-minus toggle, syntax-highlighted unified diff with real file line numbers, and a configurable context margin. Also ships a patch tool (beta, off by default) that applies multi-spot multi-file patches atomically via the *** Begin Patch envelope. Frozen archive: keep the pinned version, as the author no longer adapts it to newer DSH releases.

title: YiRan0/dsh-mobile-glass
description: Mobile adaptation for the DSH Web UI on narrow screens: reveal drawer with the chat layer on top, drag gestures, bottom-sheet settings panel, composer and header fixes, zero desktop impact.

title: yishan/dsh-typing-practice
description: English, Chinese and Cantonese typing practice with Pinyin and Jyutping hints, timed or passage modes, local conversation excerpts and local records.

title: yishengjun8/dsh-workspace-studio
description: Three-pane workspace layout with file-tree browsing, file editing, a non-linear conversation mindmap view, and mobile mode support.

title: YizhouLouisLu/dsh-math-copy
description: Copying rendered math from the chat puts the formula's LaTeX source on the clipboard instead of KaTeX's visual glyph text.

title: YizhouLouisLu/dsh-select-ask
description: Select text in the chat to quote it into the composer as an annotation, or to ask about it in a throwaway side panel that leaves no record.

title: yjh248619/dsh-select-assist-plus
description: Windows selection overlay for DSH that explains, summarizes or translates the selected text in any app; answers render in a native always-on-top panel with LaTeX formula support, multiple panels can stay open, and each can be folded or minimized to the taskbar.

title: ylw-ux/dsh-pins-fixtool
description: Pins passages selected in a conversation into a per-conversation right-sidebar panel, marks them in the transcript, jumps back to the source passage on click, and quotes a pinned passage into the composer from the selection toolbar or by typing @; the panel tags, searches, filters and exports the pins as a Markdown outline.

title: Yocaihua8/dsh-prompt-improver
description: Improves conversation drafts with optional conversation, memory and project context, side-by-side previews, a dedicated model and one-step restore; never sends messages automatically.

title: Yokira404/dsh-thinking-highlight
description: Counts keywords inside thinking rows and highlights them once a row is expanded, with a count chip per keyword on the title line that doubles as an on/off switch for that word, per-keyword tint, text colour and text size (10-22px, the same range the host body-text setting uses), typeface, bold / italic / underline and whole-word matching, plus a dedicated settings section.

title: YokosWY/dsh-calibration-tier
description: Adds a tier bar to the DSH composer with three thinking tiers (normal, strict, max), an exclusive loop mode whose three levels run 3, 5 or 8 self-review rounds, and a counter-review toggle that stacks on either; the model reads the current tier through the clarify_tier and forge_level tools.

title: YONAN1269/dsh-sidebar-suite
description: Adds two switchable sidebar layouts (tabs and overlay) plus a no-override official default, an always-expanded session list, disposable temporary sessions and a third-party tab API to DeepSeek Harness, with default-layout and feedback controls in the plugin detail page.

title: yongfanbeta/dsh-pomodoro
description: Classic 25/5/15 pomodoro timer for DSH that ties each run to the current session task or a manual project name, with a stats panel, a 365-day heatmap, a draggable floating timer and a corner pill, local JSON storage, and CSV export.

title: YooRarely/dsh-open-explorer
description: Adds buttons to open the current DSH workspace root in the host file manager.

title: youqisibun/dsh-claude-effort-slider
description: A six-stop reasoning-effort slider for DeepSeek Harness, with a pixel-texture Ultracode mode that sweeps in from right to left and adapts to light and dark themes.

title: youyaemmm-pixel/dsh-custom-lists
description: Groups the composer model picker into customizable official, plugin and relay sources, with hierarchical navigation, an Our Free Model four-category view, and a dedicated settings page. The Our Free Model view needs dsh-our-free-model installed.

title: YQing0123/dsh-artifact-center
description: Artifact center: search, preview and open files produced by DSH conversations.

title: ysqp6-lang/dsh-attachment-panel
description: Delivery panel in the DSH sidebar: indexes every image and file sent to the harness (content-addressed attachments plus @-mentioned local paths), rebuilds Taildrop send history per target device from tailscale file cp calls in the session logs, lists incoming files (the Tailscale inbox plus unmarked files in ~/Downloads), and sends new files to a device from the panel with online status and upload progress.

title: ysyyhhh/dsh-pet
description: Native desktop pet for DSH that follows agent activity, supports Codex pet packages, and imports approved pets directly from Petdex without its CLI.

title: Yu-tao-Li/dsh-read-image-view
description: Display read_image results in DSH Web and Desktop: complete previews, grouped multi-image galleries, transparency checkerboards, keyboard and touch zoom, and session-authorized loading. Verified with DSH Desktop 0.11.1 / Harness 0.2.0-rc.2.

title: yu-wenchao/dsh-free-models-hub
description: A drawer panel for the DSH web UI with a paginated list of free LLMs; one-click or batch writes each as a custom model provider into Settings, plus a local multi-key rotation proxy.

title: yuanbaoerer/dsh-decision-split
description: Decision split view for DSH web UI: a decision summary card in the main window plus the full plan in an independently scrollable side panel, so you can review the whole plan while writing decisions and send them back to the agent with one click.

title: YuanJiangDev123/dsh-job-monitor
description: A dedicated background-job dashboard for the DSH Web UI: merges jobs from every session, shows producer-reported or parsed progress with an honest estimate fallback, groups by status, purpose, session or kind, streams live output, and keeps a local history ledger.

title: yuanyiHY/deepseek-media-gallery
description: Sidebar button that opens a semi-transparent popup for browsing, previewing, downloading and deleting generated images and videos, with a settings page for the media, record and download directories.

title: yuanyiHY/dsh-rail-equalizer
description: System-audio visualizer for the turn navigator rail: the rail reacts in real time to whatever the default playback device is rendering, with four motion modes (spectrum, pulse, sway, travelling wave), a 16-band logarithmic spectrum from a 2048-point FFT on the host, and live sensitivity, strength, bass-punch and wave-speed controls. Audio is captured host-side through WASAPI loopback, so there is no permission prompt, no microphone and no screen capture. The browser half adds one attribute, one stylesheet, some CSS variables and a sidebar control row, and never patches the official component; switching it off removes the attribute, the stylesheet and the variables, returning the rail to its default styling. Windows only.

title: yuanzephyr920-oss/dsh-idle-crt
description: CRT idle screensaver for DSH pages: when no session is running and the page has seen no mouse or keyboard input for ten minutes (configurable), a retro CRT plate covers the window with scanlines and a looping inversion sweep. An in-window click or key press dismisses it, the wheel only locks scrolling, and the whole frame drifts slightly after the cursor; rendering is fully GPU-composited frame by frame. An adaptation of justawebsite/dsh-splash-crt (MIT), turned from a boot splash into an idle screensaver.

title: yuanzhenqi/dsh-mobile-ui
description: Phone-first drawer shell for DSH Web. Collapses the session list into a tap-to-open drawer, keeps header plugin actions, and turns Settings into a full-width sheet.

title: Yue-Lyu123/dsh-as-macOS
description: Turns the DSH Web UI into a macOS-style desktop with the chat parked behind it: Sonoma wallpaper, menu bar, magnifying Dock, F4 Launchpad, ⌘Space Spotlight, Control Centre, clock/calendar widgets, F3 Mission Control and a desktop orb that floats the native conversation back up. Finder, Terminal (a /bin/bash session) and Settings ship with the plugin; the Browser, Code, Office and Notes windows are unlocked by separate companion plugins (dsh-ego-browser, dsh-code-workbench, dsh-univer-office, dsh-obsidian-notes) and show a placeholder until installed, and the Browser window also launches a headless Chromium (found under /usr/bin, or set DSH_MACOS_CHROME). The agent can drive the desktop through /api/macos-desktop/* routes and window.__macos.

title: Yuer6327/NoLetMe
description: Real-time 'We need…' and 'Let me…' reasoning-trajectory keyword stats for the DeepSeek Harness web chat.

title: Yujm888/dsh-turn-rail
description: Codex-style auto-hiding right-edge turn rail: edge-peek show/hide, per-turn tooltip, in-rail search, and a scrolling 30-turn window for long sessions.

title: Yuki-cutesnow/dsh-session-groups
description: Adds a display-only session group section to the DeepSeek Harness sidebar: user-defined multi-level nested groups, drag sessions into groups, and a panel height you can adjust. Host workspace membership and session ownership are not modified.

title: YukimuraSol/dsh-ui-block
description: Renders a ui-blocks file named by a ::dsh-ui <name> \[res=WxH]:: line in a sandboxed canvas, and turns an element token into a composer chip that serializes back to the token verbatim.

title: YukoZ1227/dsh-ui-design-toggle
description: Requires the ui-ux-pro-max design skill to be installed; this plugin only gates it. Adds a switch to the DSH sidebar footer that enables or disables the ui-ux-pro-max design skill at runtime; the choice is stored in the profile settings.

title: yuloop/dsh-web-split
description: Split-screen panel for the Web UI: draggable panes, each rendering one Session's real conversation, with unread dots and a layout saved per browser.

title: yuluo554/dsh-prompt-polisher
description: Composer prompt polisher: a button in the input tool row rewrites the current draft through the session model (workflow engine, enabled automatically) or an OpenAI-compatible standalone API with host-side key storage, backfills the rewritten text with a replace/give-up dialog when the draft changed mid-run, and ships concise/structured style presets, custom templates with a {draft} placeholder, one-click restore from the status dock and reference-chip protection.

title: Yume-Hatsuyuki/dsh-preset-studio
description: Create and edit your own Agent presets with a form in Settings, covering id, name, description, order, and the plugin composition.

title: yumiao-dev/dsh-chat-thinking-editor
description: Adds an edit action to finalized assistant replies in DeepSeek Harness, letting you rewrite the reply text or reasoning chain; the edit is saved as a surface replacement.

title: yumm007/dsh-reveal-files
description: Turns each produced-file chip into a per-file menu: open the file, copy its path, reveal it in the native file browser, or open a terminal cd-ed into its directory.

title: yuna78/dsh-agent-tree
description: A tiny always-on floating tree of the DSH workspaces, conversations and subagents that are running, waiting on you or on a schedule — live running state, who is waiting for your call, per-row model, scheduled-run countdowns, other local dsh instances with their ports, and local claude/codex CLI processes with their codex subagent threads.

title: yuna78/dsh-maoxuan-pet
description: A floating whale-girl pet in the DSH web GUI: every hour it takes one article from a bundled 33-essay corpus of Mao Zedong's selected works and puts a cited line with its source link, one of six business angles (customer, project, organisation, cash flow, decision, self-discipline) and a one-line nudge for a founder into a bubble capped at 200 characters. Ships the maoxuan-pet preset and a maoxuan-vademecum skill over the same corpus, four poses, quiet hours and a daily cap.

title: yuna78/dsh-plugin-dock
description: Collects every DSH plugin sidebar entry into one collapsible floating dock at the corner of the Web GUI, with a switch that hides the original icon column and a deep-linked list of installed plugins.

title: yuna78/dsh-quick-resume
description: A row of quick-phrase buttons in the DSH composer: one click sends "please continue" or any saved phrase, so a stalled agent keeps working without touching your draft.

title: YunLiZeMeng/dsh-window-control
description: Tired of going fullscreen by hand every time you open Harness? This plugin fills the screen for you - auto-maximize (keeps the window buttons) or true fullscreen on launch, then maximize / restore / minimize / always-on-top anytime. It quits only after a native confirmation dialog - Esc, double Esc, or Ctrl+Q; in fullscreen, Esc leaves fullscreen first. The window channel installs itself, so no script or Python is needed; the first install takes effect after two DSH restarts.

title: yunxiao11xie/dsh-compact-header
description: Compacts the conversation header, moves the View tab row into the title row on wide windows, shows a local clock with session totals, and hides the duplicate composer statistics pills.

title: yunxiao11xie/dsh-context-meter
description: Moves the context-occupancy ring out of the lonely dock row below the composer card into the composer tool row, beside the quick-prompt trigger. The same ring and percentage from the contextPressure projection, always visible while generating, with a click-open panel showing the system prompt / tools / conversation breakdown and ~used/window tokens.

title: yunxiao11xie/dsh-prompt-chips
description: Adds a lightning-button menu in the composer tool row that inserts saved prompts at the caret; the four defaults can be edited and stay in the browser.

title: yunxiao11xie/dsh-sidebar-compact
description: Sidebar compaction: the global panel rows (plugins, market, tasks, context, memory, More) and the footer actions (e.g. paper reading and remote control) pack two per line in the wide sidebar, so the workspace session list regains the height. The collapsed icon rail keeps its shipped vertical layout. Pure CSS, no network or model calls.

title: yunxiyang/dsh-wide-conversation
description: Sets the DSH web client conversation column to a percentage of its own width (40-100, default 100 = full width) instead of the built-in 680-920px reading measure, edited from a collapsible card under Settings > Plugins.

title: Yur0918/dsh-sidepanel
description: A Codex-style right side panel for the DSH Web UI — session artifacts browser (live file tree, scan include, preview, reveal) plus a side chat that forks the current session with a model picker, human-pacing scheduled runs and smart send-to-bottom scrolling.

title: Yur0918/dsh-soul
description: SoulFusion-style personalization: 9 response styles, custom instructions, persona cards, per-session switching, long-term memory with audit trails.

title: yushui6666/dsh-learning-mode
description: Learning Mode toggle in the input toolbar: injects a teaching prompt into the current session so the assistant introduces a topic, teaches it, tests it, and corrects mistakes, rendering graded quizzes through GenUI. Requires the GenUI plugin (@changfenhuang/dsh-genui); without it the teaching text still works but quizzes, sliders and charts degrade to plain text.

title: yusufameri/dsh-t3-model-picker
description: A port of the T3 Code model picker into the composer: a provider rail, search results grouped under provider headings, favorites kept in the browser, unavailable-provider badges, and Cmd/Ctrl+1..9 jump shortcuts for the first nine rows of the visible list.

title: yusufameri/dsh-t3-new-session-screen
description: A T3 Code-style New Session screen for the composer: a "What should we build in <project>?" headline whose project name opens a workspace menu, a reasoning-effort picker in the composer tool row, and a git branch strip under the card that searches local and remote refs and switches with git checkout.

title: yusufameri/dsh-t3-session-ui
description: Session-context surfaces ported from T3 Code: a session-row hover card showing machine, git branch, model, agent preset, approval policy and token usage, a status pill covering pending approval, awaiting input, working, error and subagent work, a provider and model chip, a per-session header strip, a lineage breadcrumb, row-menu actions that copy the context or run DSH compaction, and a preference row in DSH Settings for choosing which facts appear. Nothing is added to the composer.

title: yutao8/dsh-custom-style
description: Adds a Custom CSS section to Settings for adjusting dialog dimensions, font sizes, full-window wallpapers, and inspecting stable selectors.

title: yutianliang/dsh-assistant-bubble
description: Adds a configurable bubble behind assistant replies, with an optional liquid-glass material and matching chrome for process, tool-call and reasoning rows.

title: Yuuhann1999/dsh-bloub-mood
description: Animated mood icon: swaps the favicon, sidebar wordmark and hero headline for bloub expression animations that follow session state (working / awaiting input / done / idle), with 8 shapes, 12 colors and custom wordmark texts configurable in Settings.

title: yuxiangwhn/dsh-chat-wallpaper
description: Image wallpaper behind the DSH chat UI: the composer card, the user's own bubbles and the new-chat button become frosted glass, the blur deepens by 5px once the composer has text or the conversation already has messages, and a settings-style window frosts the whole backdrop while it stays sharp itself.

title: yuyun-git/dsh-meow-constellation
description: Renders the seven-layer SQLite store of meow-memory as a live 3D star map, with draggable nodes, layer rings and a click-through detail panel. Requires the meow-memory plugin and Node 22.5+.

title: yzhclcl/dsh-plan-build-mode

title: bushizhanghan/dsh-routing-forensics
description: Forensic analysis of past model-routing decisions. Replays each session, classifies every turn's task complexity from its request shape (deterministic, no LLM), and reports two kinds of waste: an expensive model on cheap work (the difference is measurable), and a cheap model on expensive work that failed on its own merits — where every retry re-sends the whole context, so the downgrade cost more than the upgrade. Distinguishes provider-capacity retries (RATE_LIMIT/TIMEOUT/TRANSPORT) from model failures so it does not cry wolf. Derives routing rules from the evidence, priced against a built-in per-million table.

title: bushizhanghan/dsh-workspace-switch-cost
description: Quantify what switching projects costs. Measures each workspace's cold-start overhead (AGENTS.md + skill catalog + tool schemas + runtime context), its steady state, and how many turns it takes to reach it — then compares workspaces and attributes the difference. Attribution requires at least three workspaces and says so instead of inventing a correlation from two points; a factor with no spread across workspaces is reported as a property of the profile, not of the project. Recommends which workspaces to keep warm, which to archive, by entry cost times visit frequency. Deterministic.

Spend is metered by the plugin itself from session usage events using official DeepSeek unit prices (peak/off-peak, weekends and holidays treated as off-peak), with local-day aggregation and currency conversion. Also adds a cost_today tool and a /cost command.

title: liumiaozhi/dsh-token-gauge
description: Sidebar token gauge for DeepSeek Harness: live output-speed dial, current-session and today token totals, estimated spend from DeepSeek list prices with half price off-peak, and a 70-100% cache-hit dial, with single- and dual-gauge layouts and four skins.

title: liuyun2025/dsh-token-rmb
description: Appends the current turn's estimated token cost in CNY to the assistant action row, right after the usage/time indicator. Prices come from a built-in DeepSeek peak/off-peak CNY table (Beijing time, Monday-Friday 9:00-12:00 and 14:00-18:00) and can be overridden from the profile's cordis.patch.yml; a model without a configured price shows a dash instead of a made-up amount. Follows the shipped Performance & usage - Compact setting and hides together with the usage pill. Token cost only, per turn only.

title: liuzhihao-min/dsh-answer-timing
description: Per-answer timing breakdown: splits each reply into model, tool and other time, with first-token, decode and per-tool totals, and keeps a local JSONL ledger. Needs Node 24 or newer in the DSH runtime.

title: liuzx012/dsh-speakhumantalk
description: Removes AI phrasing so replies and documents sound human: an always-on de-slop style section injected into every session (on by default, switch it off with deslop_mode), four deslop_* tools (0-100 slop scan, deterministic rewrite, intensity switch, voice profile) and four skills (rewriting, conversation, technical docs, Chinese reports), copied into the DSH skills folder at startup. The effect is measurable: a typical AI-flavoured Chinese paragraph scores 49 before deslop_rewrite and 6 after.

title: lizilong1993/dsh-offpeak
description: Pauses peak-hour requests that target official or listed models and lets everything else run, with editable peak windows, a per-model interception list and per-session free-run in the badge panel.

title: ljr282341583/dsh-convo-cost
description: Real-time cost tracking for the current DSH conversation: a composer-dock line showing the running token usage and DeepSeek official price estimate (base and peak/valley pricing).

title: lksa09871234/dsh-tokeneconomizer
description: DSH port of TokenEconomizer with cross-session project knowledge, opt-in tool pruning, failure-loop redirection, and token usage records.

title: lkshjd/dsh-balance
description: Real-time DeepSeek account balance readout in the session header: host /api/balance route resolves the API key through the credentials seam (never sent to the browser), 60-second auto-poll plus manual refresh.

title: LL-cmyk-so/dsh-balance-widget
description: A balance and cost widget for the DSH web GUI: a sidebar footer card shows the account balance, a remaining-ratio bar and today costs; clicking opens a four-tier cost breakdown (last prompt / this session / today-this-project / today-all) with term explanations and a one-click top-up link. Zero external dependencies, works on Node 24.

title: lninghaha/dsh-hub-oauth-gateway
description: DSH Web Usage Center with local SQLite history, HUD and dashboard, Hub account/quota snapshots, custom pricing and fee ledger, and CSV/JSON export, plus coding-plan OAuth and an optional loopback OpenAI/Anthropic gateway.

title: LobotomyCorporation/dsh-token-bar
description: A per-turn token usage strip in each reply's icon row: a grey/yellow/green segmented bar plus a legend giving that turn's uncached-input, cache-read and output split and each one's share.

title: Looriann/dsh-cost-ledger
description: Cost ledger tab for DSH: per-turn token accounting converted to CNY, stacked daily charts styled after the DeepSeek console, and a built-in Alibaba Bailian price book covering 142 models (Qwen, DeepSeek, Kimi, GLM, MiniMax). Models no catalogue covers stay explicitly unpriced instead of being counted as zero, and a manual price fills them in with one click.

title: loshanvren/dsh-codex-reset-tracker
description: Reports Codex reset probabilities and schedules in the DSH composer, with opt-in system notifications for completed resets and a read-only status and history tool.

title: LoveDoLove/dsh-token-saver
description: DeepSeek Harness plugin that trims tool output (head/tail plus grep folding), adds optional prompt shaping (Caveman and Ponytail), instant local responses, RTK command-output compaction, context-pressure handling, optional LLM-summary compaction, stable prompt-cache layout, a Web settings UI, and persisted savings telemetry.

title: Lovenndme/dsh-command-context
description: Adds a /context slash command to DeepSeek Harness: shows how much of the session context window is used, how much is free, and a per-category breakdown (system prompt, memory files, skills, messages, tool results). Read-only, local, no model calls.

title: Lovenndme/dsh-profile-stats
description: A personal usage profile page in the DSH sidebar, folded from this machine's own session logs through ctx.sessionQuery. Five headline numbers (tokens with a small trend and the change against the previous period, spend, longest task, the active-day streak with your best, today's cache hit rate), a 12-month activity grid in daily / weekly / running-total views, a model-family chart by day, week or month as stacked columns or a share pie (version and tier stay apart, and vendor-specific ids collapse correctly), a token-stats ring chart of where the tokens went (system prompt, tool definitions, user messages, injected context, skills, tool calls, reasoning, answers), tokens and spend per project with the subagent share, and a per-provider split with each route's own hit rate and spend. A range switch in the header (today, this week, this month, all time or custom dates) drives the token and spend numbers, the token stats, the projects and the providers, and the selected range exports as CSV or JSON. Spend is priced at bundled list prices (peak and off-peak hours for DeepSeek direct); each provider can be set to list price, a discount, a monthly plan or not counted, stored only on this machine. The only outbound request is a six-hourly read of this package's own version from npm for the in-panel update button - no telemetry, no credentials, nothing uploaded.

title: Lstalu/dsh-quota-meter-plus
description: Enhanced derivative of ai-shushu/dsh-quota-meter; cannot be installed alongside it (both serve /quota). Per-session spend and quota meter for DSH: bills real token usage against an editable model price table (including peak/off-peak pricing), shows a live progress bar and, in the session header, a balance capsule (the balance needs a DeepSeek API key), and blocks new model calls when a session budget runs out. Subagent and helper-call spending rolls up into the parent session ledger.

title: mxw0808/dsh-cookie-guard
description: Windows-only guard against the desktop shell locking itself out: it counts the dsh-auth-* launch cookies the shell has accumulated, reports how much of the 16 KiB request-header budget they consume, and once the count passes 40 it backs up the whole Cookies database and lets DSH rebuild it, so every cookie in that profile is cleared. Install is one command: on load the plugin registers its own weekly scheduled task pointing at the scripts inside the package, and uninstalling it removes that task — nothing to copy into your home directory and no schtasks line to run by hand. The check itself runs while the app is closed (it waits up to 3 hours for the shell to exit). It does not raise the header budget or keep a floating panel; scripts/ can also be run standalone without the app installed.

title: MythGreenLand/dsh-local-delegate

Configured from the Web GUI; requires a reachable endpoint.

description: DeepSeek Harness's own fast mode: the same model on the same reasoning effort, fewer output tokens, all prompt-side. Only the output-discipline switch is on by default (late mode, active from step 4); every other switch is off and can be enabled on its own; turn on the tool-output trim switch when tool output is long. Measured on one machine, not a leaderboard: 30 task pairs with long output at the trim switch 0.756x wall clock and 21% fewer output tokens; 24 pairs on 6 real pallets/click PRs 0.805x and 23% fewer. On official SWE-bench Lite instance definitions with a self-built harness it does not show a gain (8 instances, three independent runs pooled to 72 pairs: 0.933x wall, 0.903x tokens, wall still crosses 1; single runs of the same configuration differ by 30%), and stacking switches on top of the trim switch is worse than the trim switch alone. Numbers and repro in the repo.

Adds semantic inline markup (`==confirmed==`, `!!risk!!`, `++key word++`, with bare 4xx/5xx codes highlighted automatically) and line-start check/warn/tip callouts; a fast/thinking chip in the composer that switches the model reasoning effort through ctx.modelDirectories; and sidebar contrast, where the selected session gets a tinted row with an accent bar and workspace folder icons are colored.

title: 18518182595-cell/dsh-arknights-splash
description: Arknights-style procedural opening film and silent looping chat backdrop for the DeepSeek Harness Web UI: Canvas-drawn visuals, synthesized WebAudio sound, click-anywhere skip, cross-dissolve into the interface, live-adjustable opacity; zero dependencies and no media files. By default the film (about 12 seconds, with sound) plays on every page load; a setting turns it off.

title: 4444Hao/dsh-codefall
description: Adds a Matrix-inspired digital-rain startup animation for DeepSeek Harness, a rectangular light portal that opens to both sides, optional replay when the desktop window reopens, and a green UI theme with adjustable hue.

title: 456erddgr/dsh-boo550wt-animation
description: Plays a full-screen video while DeepSeek Harness starts and reveals the UI only after it ends. Esc skips it.

title: 595708049/dsh-warm-charcoal-theme
description: Applies a Warm Beige light palette and a Dark Charcoal dark palette to the DeepSeek Harness interface.

title: AAAjzx111/dsh-theme-jing-chiyang
description: Honor of Kings inspired theme for DeepSeek Harness. Each launch starts with an about 5 second mirror-break opening: the key art appears as a glass pane, cracks outward from the impact point, bursts into 56 shards with gold edges, depth and spin, hangs still, then rotates back together before a golden flash reveals the picture, the sun halo and the light beams. The key art is also inlined as the window backdrop and the texture of both main panels over an ink night sky with a molten sun, frosted mirror shards and drifting embers; the mirror emblem at the bottom left switches motion between full, calm and off, and colours come from overridden design tokens so panels, bubbles, menus and code blocks follow the theme.

title: AaronKate/dsh-codex-appearance
description: Adds an appearance settings page to DeepSeek Harness: five eye-comfort light themes, each with its own accent and link colours, plus controls for the accent and background colours, UI and code fonts and sizes, font styles, content width, contrast and reduced motion.

title: AB-png123/dshplugin
description: Imports wallpapers newly downloaded by the Hao Wallpaper app into the DSH wallpaper engine on startup, incrementally and idempotently. Requires the Hao Wallpaper app, Python 3.8+ and the dsh-plugin-wallpaper-engine plugin (elysia395/dsh-wallpaper-engine) installed first. Supports macOS and Windows.

title: AbiTssE6/dsh-theme-zzz#dsh-theme-zzz
description: Zenless Zone Zero inspired dark theme for the Harness Web UI, with a pointer-following hollow background.

title: abuluoshuai/DSH-color-style
description: Ten Markdown-reader colour schemes for DeepSeek Harness that repaint the window background and the rendered Markdown typography, with a dedicated settings page to switch between them.

title: acdsh4869/dsh-aqua-theme
description: Aqua glassmorphism theme for the DSH Web UI, adapted to DSH v0.2.x and desktop v0.22.3+: the header, sidebar, composer, stats line and trajectory view become frosted glass panes over a live WebGL fluid board or an image/video wallpaper, with mica and compatibility layouts, adjustable blur, frost, hue and brightness, marine decorations (particle whale, fish, mesh, cursor glow), a one-click reset-to-defaults button, and a master switch whose off state restores the stock UI exactly; adapted from WYH66666666's original (0.1.x) and du-u-uck's 0.1.1-rc.2 port.

title: ahian-lee/dsh-bliss-glass
description: Theme that pairs Windows XP-era scenery wallpapers with a modern frosted-glass interface: a fixed background layer behind the DeepSeek Harness web UI, panel styling applied through theme tokens, a wallpaper picker with custom image import, and a light/dark toggle. Works on desktop and mobile web surfaces.

title: AIcivilization/dsh-her
description: A desktop companion for DSH: she lives on your real desktop, in the wallpaper or in dsh's own page, talks by voice, speaks first and remembers you. Several characters, each with her own look and scene rules.

title: AIR-pixel/air-pixel-liquid-glass
description: A configurable Liquid Glass theme for DeepSeek Harness with translucent surfaces, wallpaper, desktop transparency, window blur, custom cursors, click ripples, and per-side conversation contrast controls.

title: AKS1st/dsh-cyber-particle
description: Particle-network background overlay for the DSH Web shell: full-screen, click-through, zero runtime dependencies.

title: AKS1st/ikun-theme-skin

title: alexfengrui/dsh-client-ui-skin-real-madrid
description: Real Madrid dual-mode skin: Bernabeu night stadium for dark, white-kit pinstripes with crest and 1902 layers for light. Unofficial fan work.

title: Aliww2468/dsh-client-ui-aqua-patched
description: Aqua glassmorphism theme for the DeepSeek Harness web UI, forked from upstream and repaired to load on DSH 0.1.2-rc.1: mica and compatibility modes with adjustable blur and frost, fluid or wallpaper backdrop, background brightness, and a master switch that restores the stock UI.

title: AlyceStocking/dsh-cgss-idol-theme
description: CGSS idol theme with multi-character Web colors and card artwork, immersive reading, and an optional Windows desktop companion.

description: Material 3 Expressive theme layered over the built-in light/dark/system preferences, mapping every host alias token to colour roles generated from the official M3 colour library, plus expressive shape, motion, M3 menu surfaces and touch-browser ergonomics.

description: Nine single-ink print palettes — sage linen, kraft paper, lead type, cyanotype, risograph, CRT tube, phosphor screen, punch card, floppy disk. Each palette carries its own paper grain, type pairing, corner shape, section rule and a whale mark redrawn in its ink, plus a letterpress pass (paper tooth, sheet mottle, ink bite) that can be switched off. Every palette ships separate light and dark tokens.

title: Angel2518975237/deepseek-harness-hello-kitty-suite
description: Hello Kitty-styled task-completion and question alerts for DSH Web, bundled with an optional light/dark pink Skin Center v2 theme and local install scripts.

title: ArimaKana-Akane/dsh-wallpaper-position

title: ash-qw/dsh-theme-prts
description: An unofficial Arknights P.R.T.S.-inspired interface theme for DSH Web with appearance presets, accessibility controls, and conversation navigation.

title: AssassinVIX/fairy-zzz-plugin
description: H.D.D skin for the DSH Web UI: a voiced full-screen boot animation, an animated eye core (idle / thinking / done) you can drag or hide, a brand swap on the new-chat hero, a time-of-day greeting, a usage bubble with balance, today spend and the peak/off-peak countdown, the Fairy-mode agent preset, and optional local GPT-SoVITS voice.

title: AvalonskyAfar/MahoutsukaiNoYoru-DSH-Skin#skin

The repo ships no assets of its own; the 380 files / 263 MiB it drives (136 sprites, 208 UI parts, 13 backgrounds, 23 audio) must be recovered from your own copy of the original game, and the screen stays largely empty until then. The 23 audio files are a header strip away from working OGG; the 357 images use proprietary .mzp/.cbg formats, so the per-file mapping guide offers two routes and one of them expects you to supply your own decoder.

title: Avan0203/dsh-skin

title: Ayelsh/dsh-glass-theme

title: B-TQ/dsh-wallpaper
description: Full-screen dynamic wallpaper from local videos and images, with live effect controls, wallpaper switching and Wallpaper Engine workshop import; settings persist automatically.

title: BarneyZhaoooo/dsh-theme-native#plugin
description: A token-based DeepSeek Harness theme plugin with ten presets, custom colors, and system font pickers.

Published to npm as "open-sea-skin-dsh"; it keeps the upstream bundle id, so uninstall d-dev0101/open-sea-skin first — the two cannot be installed side by side.

title: BeiZi6/dsh-theme-plugin
description: Theme studio for the DSH Web GUI: five built-in presets plus fully customizable light/dark palettes (accent, background, foreground, UI and code fonts, translucent sidebar, contrast), hot-swapped instantly and persisted in localStorage.

title: berhbro/dsh-cyrene-theme

Unofficial non-commercial fan project; Cyrene and related art are (c) miHoYo / HoYoverse, not affiliated or endorsed.

It also hides the sidebar brand row and the New session button.
