title: 66rapper/dsh-model-auto-enricher
description: Model channel auto-enricher for DeepSeek Harness: eliminates manually configuring contextWindow, maxTokens, \[text, image] multimodal input, and {low, high, max} reasoning effort tiers model by model after adding a provider channel, with live auto-enrichment on save, a Settings UI page, and timestamped backups.

title: 836157055/dsh-teleagent-pool
description: Registers two LLM account pools as model providers: TeleAgent (China Telecom TeleAI; paste a token once) with a daily 09:00 UTC+8 full-pool check-in — currently check-in, balances and model listing only, since its chat is blocked by the client signing key — and AutoClaw (Zhipu desktop, Windows), whose tokens are decrypted from the local DPAPI-protected credential store and whose chat streams through the desktop bridge. Both pools report credit balances and model catalogs; quota-triggered failover across local desktop instances is automatic, while switching the AutoClaw account is an opt-in setting (off by default). Panels ship in settings and the left sidebar.

title: a1141171521/dsh-multi-agent-gateway
description: Adds six AI coding platforms to DSH — OpenCode, Qoder, Qoder CN, TRAE, WorkBuddy and WorkBuddy International — each as its own group in the native model picker, and manages their accounts from one settings page, with daily check-in where the platform has one, credit balance lookups, and retry on another account of the same platform when one is rate-limited. Models carry their credit multiplier where the platform declares one. OpenCode's anonymous free tier works with no credential, and TRAE stays hidden by default until it is enabled in the settings.

title: a2580vb/dsh-llm-opencode-go
description: OpenCode Go in the DeepSeek Harness model list, providing subscription quota display, model discovery, session affinity, and more.

title: a331266223/dsh-multi-model-discussion
description: Multi-model deliberation pipeline for DeepSeek Harness: independent proposals, blind peer review, program-executed evidence verification, immutable revision and independent acceptance on a fresh context.

title: A42Null/dsh-opencode-zen-plugin
description: OpenCode Console (Zen) models for DeepSeek Harness: paste a Console API key under Settings → Plugins and the Console's chat models become selectable, with the catalog synced automatically, each model routed to the endpoint the official docs assign, and free *-free models hidden by default because they only run inside the OpenCode client.

title: a981008/dsh-switch
description: Mirrors cc-switch providers and models into DeepSeek Harness the moment they are saved, and shows each provider's plan windows, account balance, or custom usage script in the composer and the settings card.

title: aa2246740/dsh-antigravity-oauth
description: Unofficial Gemini Cloud Code Assist OAuth integration with isolated account storage; carries account-ban risk.

title: aa2246740/dsh-model-fusion
description: Adds a model route where a Lead plans and reviews while a Sidekick performs code changes.

title: aa2246740/dsh-oauth-login
description: Adds subscription OAuth and provider Plan API-key logins through Pi adapters, using a DSH-owned credential store.

title: aaabrli/dsh-thu-automad
description: Tsinghua MadModel provider for DSH: renews the campus token automatically, switches between campus direct access and WebVPN, and serves model requests through a loopback transport with per-model queuing.

title: AdonisSheldon/dsh-openai-oauth
description: Connect a ChatGPT account to Codex models in DeepSeek Harness through browser PKCE or device-code OAuth, with automatic token refresh and Web or headless login.

title: aerince/dsh-models-dev-reasoning
description: Adds models.dev reasoning levels to unconfigured third-party DeepSeek Harness models.

title: AhYi8/dsh-key-managment
description: Per-provider API key pool for DeepSeek Harness with manual switching, background reachability probing and plan-usage adapters for DeepSeek, Kimi, MiniMax, Zhipu, OpenRouter and other providers.

title: ai-yukin/dsh-0-tools
description: One-click free-model setup for DSH web, built for coding beginners: one-click installer for Windows (install.bat) and macOS/Linux (install.sh, v1.7.0+); four permanently free channels — Zhipu GLM (text + image), SiliconFlow (Qwen3-8B plus 15+ sub-9B models), iFlytek Spark Lite and the OpenRouter free pool, which routes through openrouter/auto and picks from a pool that changes over time; bottom-left setup hint hides once any free model is connected; real-time DeepSeek peak/off-peak pricing reminder; bundled beginner help center.

title: aichixiaojuzi/dsh-model-quick-switch
description: Provider-first model picker for the composer. Every provider is listed in the left rail and its models in the right pane. Providers, models within a provider, and pins reorder by drag or Alt+Arrow; providers take a local display alias; one provider can be the panel default; a model's reasoning levels expand inline; search matches model names, provider names and aliases. Switching goes through the shipped model directory service, so the /model popup and this panel always agree.

title: AIcivilization/dsh-model
description: Connects 36 model sources (free and pay-as-you-go APIs, Codex and Kimi subscriptions, local Ollama and LM Studio) to dsh and gives other tools one authenticated OpenAI-compatible address and key. The free pool model free/auto combines free API quotas such as ModelScope, Zhipu Flash, Gemini and Cloudflare Workers AI, moves to the next provider when one is used up, and by default only uses quotas that do not charge. Models appear in dsh grouped by source; Cherry Studio, Cline and scripts can use the same address (HTTPS is set up automatically next to dsh-vps). Daily check-in for 10 services (Trae, Qoder, WorkBuddy, Doubao, MiniMax Code, WPS Lingxi, DuMate, AStudio, Huawei CodeArts, OfficeAce) with several accounts each, pasted credentials for checking in on a server, and custom check-in services described as JSON. Installed from the plugin market it sets itself up, and the engine ships as an npm package, so no GitHub access is needed.

title: AidenOrz/dsh-workbuddy-connect
description: Drop-in successor to the now-deleted corrinehu/dsh-workbuddy-connect, keeping its package name, config row id and provider ids so an existing install upgrades in place. Also fixes the 400/11128 channel check by neutralising the DSH identity sentences and scrubbing the product name from system messages, and reads the real Windows client and bundled CLI versions instead of a compiled constant, unlike the functy and community forks. Verified 2026-10-21 on Windows, WorkBuddy 5.8.3, DSH 0.2.1-rc.2.

title: AITabby/dockyard-dsh
description: Native account-pool and provider plugin for DeepSeek Harness on macOS and Windows: official browser OAuth and provider-native transports for Codex, Antigravity, Grok, Claude, Cursor, WorkBuddy, Command Code, Hermes and OpenRouter Free, with per-account model catalogs, plan and quota windows, quota warnings, and manual, sticky-session, round-robin, failover or most-allowance-left account selection.

title: Akiyuki1130/dsh-ark-coding-provider
description: Unofficial Volcengine Ark Coding Plan LLM provider: registers an `ark-coding` route with 12 models (capacity facts measured per model), multi-account with automatic rotation, a bundled pinned arkcli for the official model catalog and live plan quota, plus a settings wizard and a sidebar usage card.

title: AkutagawaKoyori/dsh-zcode-start
description: Uses Z.ai / ZCode Start Plan quota inside DeepSeek Harness as a GLM model provider (GLM-5.3-Flash, GLM-5.3) with tool calling and reasoning levels; the settings page shows quota bars, gifted-plan claiming, refresh opportunities and a redacted request log. Requires the ZCode desktop app installed and signed in at least once (the plugin reads its local credential store) and an account with an active Z.ai / Start Plan entitlement.

title: AlaIchhe/dsh-qwenwork-connect
description: QwenWork (千问办公) model provider for dsh: signs in through the desktop device flow and then calls the official OpenAI-compatible gateway, so tool calls, image input and usage pass through; adds the tiers of the plan as a qwenwork provider, keeps the credential in a local file that a refresh rewrites in place, and shows the remaining credits of the account.

title: Alice-Marx/dsh-model-router
description: Routes DeepSeek Harness work across configured model APIs and supported vendor CLIs with dependency-aware packages and cost previews.

title: almost-nowhere/dsh-antigravity
description: Google Antigravity model provider based on LiZhenNet/dsh-antigravity, with a multi-account pool added. Do not install it in the same profile as LiZhenNet/dsh-antigravity: both register the same bundle id (dsh-antigravity) and the same npm package name.

title: alvinhuang0509-design/dsh-connect-teleagent
description: TeleAgent (China Telecom TeleAI "Stellar" agent) model provider for DeepSeek Harness with the working v1 gateway signing: two-round HMAC-SHA256 keyed by the login JWT signature segment, which fixes the 40104 rejections the older local-v1 signing produced. Signs in through a dedicated browser window over the DevTools protocol — the plugin intercepts the login callback the same way the official desktop app does, so nothing has to be copied by hand — and also accepts a pasted token. Ships points balance, daily check-in, an in-composer account chip, and a configurable context window (100K by default, 16K–2M, since the gateway declares no catalogue and the official client ships one shared 100K preset for all three tiers). Cannot be installed alongside anye-99/dsh-codearts-auth: both register the same teleagent provider, and this plugin reuses its credentials and derives its SSE/tool-call parsing from it. It also registers the same teleagent provider as anbulang/dsh-connect-teleagent, so install only one of the two.

title: AlyceStocking/dsh-harness-switch
description: Adds Kimi models to native DSH sessions with per-model selection of the embedded Kimi core or DSH native execution.

title: amlyczz/dsh-agy-link
description: Google Antigravity (agy CLI) models for DSH — streaming chat with Gemini/Claude/GPT-OSS subscriptions, native tool cards, thinking turns, and in-GUI Google OAuth login.

title: anbulang/dsh-connect-teleagent
description: Connect DeepSeek Harness to the TeleAgent (China Telecom TeleAI desktop app) models through the app's own local kernel after signing in there, keeping DSH's streaming, multi-turn, images, tool calls, reasoning and points balance. macOS and Windows only, with TeleAgent 2.7.1+ installed and signed in. It reads the app's saved login token and points cookies (macOS Keychain / Windows DPAPI), starts the app's own kernel binary as a local child process, and needs the gateway apiKey the desktop app ships with, supplied through TELEAGENT_API_KEY or a local.secrets.json in the plugin folder. Daily points claiming is on by default; adding or switching accounts backs up and rewrites the app's login files. It uses the same package name and mount id as the listed alvinhuang0509-design/dsh-connect-teleagent, so install only one. The author's disclaimer asks you to follow TeleAgent's terms of use.

title: Ansonfishing/dsh-model-manager
description: Control panel for local LLM inference servers in the DSH web view: service registry with health checks and stop controls, named parameter profiles for llama.cpp, SGLang and vLLM with pre-save KV/VRAM validation, GPU detection, and tok/s benchmarks.

title: antonio-mastropaolo/dsh-anthropic-membership
description: Sign in to DeepSeek Harness with a Claude Pro/Max membership (no API key), downscale Anthropic request images to a 2000px long edge, slim /compact summarizer payloads, and show 5-hour/weekly plan usage plus DSH message counts.

title: anye-99/dsh-codearts-auth
description: Signs in to Huawei Cloud CodeArts and registers CodeBuddy, WorkBuddy, LobsterAI, Qoder (global and China), TRAE, Cline, Loomy, Raccoon Work, MiniMax Code, TeleAgent, ZCode, Step Code and Antigravity as LLM providers, with per-provider account pools; several of them also show quota balance and daily check-in in the same panel.

title: apcamargo/dsh-claude-subscription
description: Use Claude models in DeepSeek Harness through Claude subscription accounts.

title: apolenkov/dsh-provider-proxy
description: Routes outbound model traffic per provider host or per model ID through chosen proxies, loopback or direct, configured from a Plugins settings page.

title: ArcaneOrion/dsh-model-channel-manager
description: Model channel manager: several provider/model candidates share one virtual route (roundrobin/<group>) with failover, retry, timeout and cooldown; a settings tab edits providers and groups, runs per-model speed tests and real single-model request tests, and a seven-day health panel aggregates latency, failures and upstream token usage (input, output, cache and reasoning).

title: architect-xyz/liquid-dsh-plugin
description: Adds the Liquid Inference auction exchange as a model route, with liquid.auto and its ranking variants, and four tools that read offers, markets, routers and job receipts. Requires a Liquid Inference API key (LIQUID_API_KEY, spend scope).

title: arnen7000/dsh-workbuddy-model
description: Adds the models available in a signed-in WorkBuddy desktop app to DeepSeek Harness as a model provider, with the CN and international apps as separate groups. It is a rebuilt derivative of the npm package dsh-workbuddy-connect@0.7.9 (originally corrinehu/dsh-workbuddy-connect); it registers the same workbuddy / workbuddy-ai provider ids, so it cannot be installed alongside other WorkBuddy bridges.

title: Asheblog/dsh-ollama-cloud
description: Ollama Cloud provider for DeepSeek Harness: adds the chat route on install, publishes each model's own thinking levels for the composer effort control, keeps the model list current from the endpoint (/api/tags and /api/show, cached for offline boots), reads the account allowance from /api/balance into the Models page and a sidebar row that hides itself when the endpoint reports none, and offers Ollama's web search and fetch as selectable DSH web providers.

title: AshenSeeker/dsh-subagent-switch
description: Picks each subagent model from the local catalog by task category, unless the caller already named one. Free and quota tiers are ranked together by per-model capability tags; a pricier model is used only when no cheap model is tagged as good at that kind of work. Only providers whose remaining balance is readable, or that are account-backed, enter the candidate pool; the rest stay listed but are not routed. A panel adds per-model manual priority above the automatic order plus allow/revoke controls.

title: Atlantis-LA/dsh-laci-engine
description: Local model scheduler for DSH on Windows 10/11 with DSH Desktop 0.2.x: a bundled console for engine/model import, VRAM estimation, load/close, and an OpenAI-compatible gateway.

title: atlasmarkz/dsh-effort-pilot
description: Per-step thinking-effort pilot for DeepSeek Harness: simple tool rounds stay cheap, failures and heavy work lift one declared step, and agents can change their own depth through a set_effort tool without switching models.

title: Ayelsh/reasoning-setup
description: Edit reasoning effort levels and thinking formats for models that declare none.

title: Ayowait/dsh-official-reasoning-effort
description: Official-style model + reasoning-effort control for the composer. Reuses the official picker and always offers Off/Low/High/Max — exactly like the official DeepSeek control — even when a gateway model declares no reasoning effort, with a small hint at the panel bottom when upstream does not natively support it.

title: Ayowait/dsh-reasoning-effort-new
description: Fork of dsh-reasoning-effort with a two-level model picker in the composer: a provider list, a model pane that slides out beside it, search, and compact rows, alongside the reasoning-effort slider and its max-level effects.

title: Ayowait/dsh-send-photos
description: Declares image input on relay routes whose endpoint omits modality metadata, so models that can see photos stop being rejected as text-only. This also overrides routes that are explicitly declared text-only.

title: backtomyfuture/dsh-litellm-panel
description: DeepSeek Harness sidebar for LiteLLM models, MCP servers, skills, and spend.

title: bainianlaoyao/dsh-codex-harness
description: Codex-shaped coding tools and agent presets for GPT models on DeepSeek Harness: exec_command, write_stdin, apply_patch and view_image, plus OpenAI Chat Completions and Responses API routes, bridged to DSH-native plan, ask, approval and compaction. Long-running commands become DSH background jobs with bounded head/tail output readable through job_output, and each subagent type can be pinned to its own preset, provider, model and reasoning effort.

title: bainianlaoyao/dsh-llm-api-pool
description: Pools several OpenCode Go API keys and hot-switches each request to the least-used one, with official usage and balance lookup plus a graphical settings page.

title: BaoBao1996121/dsh-chatgpt-subscription
description: Adds native Codex OAuth sign-in, main-Agent default model selection, and direct or local-proxy settings for DSH Desktop 0.2.0-rc.2 on Windows.

title: Bazley13/dsh-multi-model-orchestrator
description: Multi-model orchestrator: the main brain decomposes complex tasks and dispatches subtasks to GLM / Kimi / Qwen sub-agents by each model's strengths, with per-model token usage.

title: beibing173/dsh-codex-gpt
description: OpenAI OAuth login for ChatGPT Codex that adds ChatGPT as a selectable LLM provider (streaming, Off/Low/High/Max reasoning effort, image input) and a codex tool for per-session DeepSeek escalation, with optional light-task delegation to DeepSeek and subscription usage and reset-credit management.

title: beijingwahw/dsh-proactive
description: Proactive multi-model scheduling plugin: multi-source signal intake with dedup and urgency ranking, a four-way execute/defer/dismiss/ask-user decision engine, DAG plan generation with parallel model execution, quality reflection with automatic retry and model switch, long-term memory for task patterns and lessons, and strategy evolution via genetic algorithms with sandboxed evaluation and canary rollout.

title: betsunninda9-lgtm/dsh-model-groups
description: Hierarchical model selection and collapsible multi-key configuration in the DSH 0.2.2-rc.1 web UI (native app menus unchanged); host patches are explicitly enabled, updated or restored from settings with verified backups and require an engine restart. Ordinary uninstall does not restore patches.

title: bill277048-hash/DSH-model-router
description: Rule-based multi-provider model routing for DeepSeek Harness with pre-first-token failover, cooldown circuit-breaking, usage accounting, and a status API.

title: bitxeno/dsh-magpie-connect
description: Magpie gateway provider for DSH: syncs gateway models into the picker with visibility control, image input and thinking levels.

title: boe1900/owndsh#owndsh-plugin
description: Early-stage plugin connecting DeepSeek Harness to a separately deployed, self-hosted OwnDsh server for team identity, model access control, quotas, and usage auditing.

title: Boomerangz/dsh-openrouter-live
description: OpenRouter provider that reads the live /models list, so new models appear without a harness release: models sorted by name with input/output prices, per-model reasoning levels, image input, reasoning_details replay, Anthropic prompt caching, and actual spend per session including subagents from OpenRouter usage.cost, shown under the Web UI composer and by /cost.

title: BruceLanLan/dsh-tier-router
description: Two-tier model routing: a strong tier plans, advises and reviews while a cheap tier implements, with plan-mode-aware auto routing, a high-impact escalation guard, failure auto-escalation, and subagent tiering.

title: bushizhanghan/dsh-workbuddy-harness
description: Brings WorkBuddy free/paid models (domestic + international) into DSH without the desktop app, published as @bushizhanghan/dsh-workmate. This package is a maintained fork of Faide-cyber/dsh-workbuddy (whose upstream entry is already listed in this catalogue); do NOT co-install both, as they register the same provider id "workbuddy-ai" and will collide. v1.2.7 relocates over-long system prompts past the domestic gateway channel-risk classifier, rewrites the DSH brand string, and adds a debug dump; supports dsh 0.2.0-rc.2 through 0.2.1 (incl. prereleases).

title: callqh/dsh-codex-oauth
description: Adds a Codex sign-in page to DSH settings, driving the built-in llm-pi-ai OAuth flow for browser or device-code login and showing masked account status without a separate provider or credential store.

title: calmzealA/dsh-decide
description: Connects DSH to decision models (TypeSafe Jev, TokenRhythm NeoHorse-Jev, OpenAI Decisions, and local System One endpoints) with decide, gate, rerank, and judge tools plus a settings page. Needs an API key for at least one provider (kept in the DSH credential store); the text you ask it to judge is sent to the selected provider unless it is local. The command guard is off by default.

title: CarlCN2003/dsh-model-fallback
description: Primary and multi-level backup model failover router for DSH, with cross-provider reasoning-effort clamping, exponential cooldown, per-turn recovery, and a settings panel.

title: CARVIN94/dsh-router
description: An AI routing gateway that runs as a DSH plugin. Adds a Routing System sidebar panel for suppliers, account pool, fallback combos and API keys, and serves an OpenAI-compatible endpoint at http://localhost:3080/v1.

title: CARVIN94/dsh-router-codebuddy
description: CodeBuddy supplier plugin for dsh-router. Handles one account at a time with polling OAuth login and token refresh, leaving account selection, cooldown and check-in to dsh-router core.

title: CARVIN94/dsh-router-qoder
description: Qoder supplier plugin for dsh-router, covering both the CN and international regions. Uses a personal access token for authentication, signs requests to the Qoder cosy gateway and converts upstream SSE to OpenAI SSE; the model list reports the upstream display name alongside the key, while account selection and cooldown stay in dsh-router core.

title: CARVIN94/dsh-router-traework
description: TRAE SOLO supplier plugin for dsh-router, ported from traework2api. Provides the traework supplier, a free SOLO chat channel, and reports single-account status to dsh-router core.

title: catfish1277-png/dsh-magpie-bridge
description: Automatically discovers the local Magpie gateway to sync chat models, enables Codex and Gemini image generation, and configures image sources for eligible workbenches.

title: cc1104666/dsh-plugins#dsh-grok-online
description: Runs a local OpenAI-compatible relay that forwards DSH chat requests to grok.online, exposing its two chat models in the model picker without an API key.

title: cc1104666/dsh-plugins#dsh-grok3ai
description: Talks to the two public Hugging Face Spaces (MiniMax-VL-01 and Llama-2-7B-Chat) that grok3ai.org only embeds in an iframe, presenting them as OpenAI-compatible models.

title: cc1104666/dsh-plugins#dsh-ima
description: Signs in to ima.qq.com (Tencent IMA) with a WeChat QR code and runs a localhost OpenAI-compatible relay in front of its SSE chat endpoint, so the four models behind it appear in the picker.

title: cc1104666/dsh-plugins#dsh-lightvela
description: Signs in to LightVela by WeChat QR code, reads the model gateway key from your own instance and writes the gateway into llm-pi-ai so its models appear in the picker.

title: ccccwwwxx/dsh-bifenggang
description: Time-based model routing: a settings panel defines weekday peak and off-peak windows and the provider/model each one uses, the choices are read from the harness registry (API keys and subscription logins alike), and a global switch decides whether that policy sets the model and reasoning effort of every request. The switch is independent per session, each session row carries a light showing its own state, and the settings panel names the model in force right now and why. A day no window matches — every weekend and holiday — uses the primary model of the first plan; the advanced thinking model is a separate axis, used only when a session itself asks for max reasoning.

title: Cci-65/deepseek-harness-plugin
description: Adds configurable reasoning levels for third-party models and a model-strength picker in the composer.

title: ccl4-56-23-5/DSH-Plugins#api-switcher
description: Manage API providers and enabled models, with provider-grouped model switching and keyword search in the native model menu.

title: ccsert/dsh-subagent-hub#subagent-hub
description: Named subagent presets bound to model-route allowlists, where an out-of-list child model is refused before a delegation starts and each child conversation shows the model its last request actually used.

title: ChaYeWuu/dsh-hyperworkbuddy
description: Bring the WorkBuddy accounts signed in on this machine into DSH, managing CN and international accounts separately. Supports automatic failover between accounts, one-click refresh of model catalogs and credits, the CN daily check-in, and a togglable OpenAI-compatible endpoint.

title: chen1pengvincent/dsh-model-sync-plugin
description: Discovers the model providers actually configured in DSH, surfaces unread catalog changes from eight official platforms, and applies only the selection you confirm, with a version check and a pre-write backup.

title: chen704290901chen/dsh-newapi-video
description: Call a new-api (one-api style) relay station's video model from the conversation with @-referenced image/video materials, supporting Seedance 2.0 and Happyhorse text-to-video and image-to-video across four relay protocols.

title: chengshenyangtai/dsh-workbuddy-trae-qoder-connect
description: One DSH plugin that aggregates the models of WorkBuddy (personal multi-account, enterprise and the WorkBuddy AI international edition), Qoder CN and Trae CN into a single model picker with a shared conversation history, live credit multipliers, per-model reasoning effort, the largest context window the international edition declares, and daily check-in where the channel offers one.

title: chengzhi-c/dsh-wtq-pool
description: Brings the WorkBuddy, Trae and Qoder desktop logins on this machine into DeepSeek Harness as OpenAI-compatible local endpoints, with an account pool, automatic account switching when WorkBuddy is rate limited, and a settings panel.

title: ChimeSky/dsh-effort-keeper
description: Remembers the reasoning effort you explicitly chose for each provider and model and restores it when you switch back, without replacing DSH's own model picker.

title: chimneyQ/dsh-model-rotator
description: Ranks the models a DeepSeek Harness install already discovered by measured connectivity and speed, and switches to the next candidate inside the same turn when the one in use fails without producing any output. Ships a settings page with a grouped model list, per-model and per-channel switches, and a quota-aware cooldown that rests an exhausted model until the next day.

title: Chip-G0202/dsh-model-radar
description: Runs a four-task, 150-point model intelligence benchmark inside DeepSeek Harness (Qin 60, Pompeii 45, Pelican 22.5, Candy 22.5): each selected model × reasoning-effort pair executes every task in its own isolated subagent session, Qin and Pelican are graded by the selected judge model against rubrics, Pompeii and Candy programmatically, and batches keep scores, artifacts and cost. Adds a 0–1000 real-world performance score per model × effort computed from local session logs across seven dimensions (output speed, first-token latency, reasoning speed, tool cadence, tool latency, tool success rate, cache hit), with baseline deltas and controlled speed runs, plus a sidebar page with ranking, performance, history and settings views. Each batch spends real tokens of the candidate and judge models, and candidate subagents get file and bash tools inside an isolated run directory.

title: Chrono-rigger/dsh-model-rotation
description: Ordered model rotation for the DSH model picker: a rate-limited or repeatedly timing-out member hands over to the next one, members that only timed out are retested once, and the DSH platform model is the sticky last resort. Ships a settings page with editable chains and a short-429 in-place retry switch.

title: Chruix/dsh-team-model
description: Assigns a model and reasoning effort to each Agent Teams teammate, from the chat toolbar or a settings page.

title: cjc-github/dsh-model-provider-picker
description: Turns the composer's model menu into a two-level list (provider first, then that provider's models), shows the current model together with its provider name, asks for a reasoning effort after a model is picked, and adds settings switches that hide whole providers or single models from the picker.

title: ckanner/dsh-plugin-chatgpt
description: Signs in to a ChatGPT account over OAuth and serves that plan's models as a DeepSeek Harness provider route, calling api.openai.com/v1/responses with the account's plan scope rather than the Codex backend.

title: ckilwork/dsh-plugin-llama-manager
description: Manages local llama.cpp servers and GGUF launch profiles on Windows and exposes the profiles in the DSH model picker.

title: Clukay-Fun/dsh-gpt-link
description: Signs in to ChatGPT by driving DSH's bundled pi-ai Codex OAuth flow from a settings page, revokes the session at OpenAI on sign-out, shows the signed-in account's five-hour and weekly quota, and limits the Codex route to seven GPT models with low, medium, high and xhigh reasoning (default low).

title: colin4k/DSH-webtokens-desktop
description: A Desktop 0.2.2-rc.1 adaptation of DSH WebTokens that registers a signed-in Chrome DeepSeek web session as the deepseek-web model in DeepSeek Harness, with tool-call transport, reply validation, a Chrome bridge extension, plus install and rollback scripts. It cannot be installed with the one-line plugin add shown on this page: it needs its own installer (node scripts/install-desktop.mjs, which backs up the whole profile first). Prompts, project content and tool results are sent to the DeepSeek website through your Chrome session; the author has tested it on macOS only.

title: comet9699/dsh-agy
description: Connect a locally installed agy CLI to DeepSeek Harness 0.2.2-rc.1, with separate thinking levels, quota display, and Harness-owned tools. Community fork of dannndouglas/dsh-antigravity-acp, beta, verified on Windows x64 only. Needs the agy CLI signed in with your own Google account; installing makes new chats default to Agy models (messages go through agy to Google), switches web search to the agy provider and replaces the built-in compaction. Do not enable it alongside other forks that register the agy-local-acp provider.

title: CREAIT-nl/dsh-plugins#gen-limit
description: Per provider/model generation concurrency, with a settings card: a cap on how many sessions may stream at once, enforced at the stream and again at subagent spawn, where a fan-out past the cap waits in a FIFO queue instead of failing.

title: CREAIT-nl/dsh-plugins#think-level
description: A thinking level stored per provider and model, so reasoning effort outlives the session it was set in and also reaches subagents, which dsh never asks. The in-session picker still wins, and a model with no row keeps its provider default.

title: ct-jyjntc/dsh-model-modality
description: Declare whether a configured third-party model accepts image (multimodal) input; writes the modality into the owning provider settings and verifies it through runtime model resolution.

title: cthulhu-tww/dsh-solmirror
description: Connects the Solmirror open platform to DeepSeek Harness as MCP tools covering image and video generation, a model catalog, cost estimates, reference uploads, result queries and media URLs. Generation jobs submit as native dsh background tasks that notify on completion and run in parallel within one message, with in-chat video playback and an image wall. A settings page takes the platform API key, server URL, per-group model visibility and a test-connection check; the key is stored in the local dsh credential store. Reference uploads (image, video, audio) return reusable ids kept one day unused or three days after last use — 50 MB per file, video up to 30 s, audio up to 60 s. Usage bills platform points at in-site prices, with quotes before a run and automatic refunds on failure. Files passed to upload_reference (jpg/png/webp/gif, mp4/mov/webm, mp3/wav, up to 50 MB) leave your machine: images and videos go straight to Volcengine ImageX/VOD storage with temporary credentials issued by Solmirror, audio through the Solmirror server; its HTTP routes (/plugins/solmirror/...) have no DSH access check.

title: ctianye/dsh_gearbox
description: Reasoning-effort gear presets for third-party models: 16 vendor/model presets with per-mode custom wire values, written into dsh-llm-pi-ai with pre-write validation and per-rule rejection; per-model switching between OpenAI Chat Completions, OpenAI Responses and Anthropic Messages with automatic route regrouping; plus a composer Optimize button and a settings section that rewrite the input text with a model you pick.

title: cuboteam/dsh-plugin-dit
description: DIT.ai provider bundle for DeepSeek Harness: installs 29 OpenAI Chat Completions models and 10 Anthropic Messages models from one DIT_API_KEY, with protocol-specific thinking configuration.

title: cv-superding/dsh-deepseek-web-login
description: Adds a deepseek-web provider that uses chat.deepseek.com web models in DSH, with browser login capture, PoW request signing, SSE streaming, and prompting-based tool calls.

title: cybtachyon/dsh-plugin-local-infer
description: A DeepSeek Harness plugin that manages local inference engines.

title: CynthiaYX/dsh-plan-act-models
description: A mode dropdown in the composer that switches models through the host's own session.selectModel — Plan, Act and any number of user-defined modes, each with its own provider, model, reasoning effort and optional instruction that joins the system prompt while that mode is active — plus a soft switch into Plan mode and a forced switch to Act when a plan is approved, with per-workspace overrides for Plan and Act.

title: CypherNaught-0x/DSH-Subagent-Model-Router
description: Automatically and intelligently routes each delegated task to the best configured model using aliases, capability tags, and usage guidance—keeping routine work fast and affordable while sending complex work to stronger specialists. Configure your model team in the Web UI or guided setup, run specialists in parallel with reliable result joining, and see the chosen model at a glance in subagent views and inline in Better Sidebar's Tasks tree.

title: dakouchiya/dsh-auto-router
description: Routes model and reasoning effort per turn: a cheap classifier reads each request and picks one of five tiers, a supervisor model re-routes on tool errors and checkpoints, and upgrading to the stronger model waits for confirmation.

title: Dalizi2026/dsh-factory-provider
description: Factory (Droid) subscription quota as native DSH model providers, with three protocol routes, your own API key through a loopback gateway, and a settings page for connection status, quota, per-model token statistics and key switching.

title: darkings/dsh-agy-provider
description: DSH model provider for the locally authenticated AGY CLI: Gemini/Claude model discovery, independent reasoning effort, DSH-owned tools, bounded context and tool-result handling, and Windows-safe streaming. Report problems in GitHub Issues: https://github.com/darkings/dsh-agy-provider/issues.

title: dat-lequoc/dsh-kiro
description: Kiro model provider with Builder ID, Identity Center, Google, GitHub and credential-import sign-in, automatic token and profile refresh, account usage, live model discovery, selectable reasoning efforts, streaming tool calls, provider stop-reason and context-overflow handling, and token accounting that uses Kiro's exact counters when it sends them and otherwise scales the context-usage percentage it does send by the model's advertised window.

title: DavidRm1911/dsh-llm-subscription
description: Adds Claude, Gemini, and a local Ollama model to DSH's native model picker, using your existing Claude Code / Antigravity CLI logins instead of a metered API key, with a working reasoning-effort selector for Claude.

title: dawnliming/dsh-chinese-mode
description: Global Chinese mode: a compact pill switch beside the composer that injects a language requirement into any preset's system prompt (complete personas excepted); reply, thinking and tool output each toggle between Chinese and English, and anchored presets are supported.

title: DeepseekDays/dsh-ofm-model-manager
description: Per-model enable/disable and renaming for every provider in DeepSeek Harness: a panel at the bottom of Settings - Models with a search box, status chips with counts, a provider filter, collapsible provider groups with group-level switches, and batch actions scoped to the current view. Disabled models leave the model picker and custom names replace the built-in ones. Preferences persist in the profile and apply immediately, without reloading the page or restarting DSH.

title: DeepseekDays/dsh-provider-toggle
description: Adds a one-click switch to every provider row in Settings - Models: turn a provider off and it leaves the model picker, turn it back on and it returns. It works by wrapping the model catalog call, so it affects the catalog and the picker only, never routing, keys or provider config; existing sessions that already use such a model keep working.

title: delltig/dsh-multi-model-collab
description: Runs one task through several configured models at once — in parallel or as a primary/secondary review — and returns each model's answer plus an aggregated digest.

title: Delthin/dsh-plugins#fast
description: Switch sessions between Standard and Fast tiers via the model selector or `/fast` command, attaching the `priority` tier to eligible Responses requests and forwarding them to the target endpoint when Fast is enabled. Interactive sessions can toggle tiers on the fly while team roles lock in their tier at launch; once Fast is active alongside required configuration and upstream support, requests are routed with `priority`, with actual speed and billing governed by your provider. It needs provider, source and target URLs filled in; it then runs a loopback proxy that sends matching requests, with their authorization header, to the target URL.

title: dev-bravelo/dsh-hf-spaces
description: Adds the models of your own GPU Hugging Face Space to the model selector, starts the Space when you send a message, shows its start progress, and pauses it when idle or at a time limit. Requires a Hugging Face account with a GPU Space serving an OpenAI-compatible API, a Hugging Face token stored in the DSH vault as HF_TOKEN, and a paid plan for GPU hardware; Hugging Face bills the GPU time.

title: dev-cmde/dsh-routerai-prices
description: Lists RouterAI prompt, completion and cache-read prices per million tokens for the models configured in this profile, highlighting the active one. Requires a model provider whose config key is `routerai`; without it the table shows no data.

title: DeZhou123/dsh-model-orchestrator
description: Two-level model routing: pick the best model group first, then the best channel within that model; a failure switches channel before switching model. Preference mode pins one model across its channels, a status bar under the composer shows the live model, channel health and the day's token usage, and a speed/intelligence report can be imported as the routing prior. Exposes a model_orchestrator tool and a /route command.

title: DHLlib/online_model_discovery
description: Adds live model discovery and per-model reasoning-effort editing for third-party pi-ai providers. Its HTTP routes have no DSH access check, so a web page open in your browser could call them.

title: dingminhua/dsh-connect-qoder
description: Connects Qoder (Lingma CN / international) models to DSH through their PATs, with a per-region multi-account pool, daily check-in, automatic failover, and read-only credit visibility.

title: dingminhua/dsh-connect-trae
description: Connects locally signed-in Trae CN models to DSH, supports DSH-executed tool calls, account switching, and Work/general credit visibility.

title: dingminhua/dsh-connect-workbuddy
description: Connects locally signed-in WorkBuddy models, CN and international alike, to DSH, reading each model's credit multiplier from the upstream catalog on every refresh, with per-model image input toggles, account switching backed by an auto-failing-over pool, manual daily check-in, and read-only credit overviews shown as compact pills on the card and in the composer.

title: dingminhua/dsh-subagent-default-model#plugin
description: Configurable default model for subagent delegations via settings.yaml, with single-model and multi-model round-robin or random strategies.

title: doombeaker/dsh-bizyair
description: AIGC creation inside DeepSeek Harness: generate images, video, audio and 3D with open and closed-source models — parameter schemas, cost estimates, approval gates and a task panel.

title: DragonHorizon-xtihc/dsh-connect-opencode-free
description: Connect OpenCode Zen free-tier models to DeepSeek Harness through the local OpenCode client. Real-time model discovery, per-model toggle in settings, one-click provider write. No API key required.

title: DragonHorizon-xtihc/dsh-connect-trae-models
description: Aggregates all local Trae accounts into one auto-failover model provider, with manual and automated daily check-in, credits and expiry monitoring, and a model selection settings card.

title: DragonHorizon-xtihc/dsh-connect-workbuddy-models
description: Aggregates every WorkBuddy account already signed in on this machine into one model pool, with manual and scheduled check-in, credits and expiry monitoring, per-model credit multipliers, and account switching with remaining credits right below the composer.

title: dreanzy/dsh-plg#dsh-model-pack
description: Per-workspace model packs: bind a named provider, model and reasoning effort plus the four subagent tier routes to a directory. Applies to new sessions in that directory; a session that has not run a turn yet also follows a pack switch, while sessions that already ran a turn are never changed.

title: drscrewdriver/dsh-llm-openai-completions
description: OpenAI-completions-compatible adapter for custom gateways (vLLM / LM Studio / self-hosted proxies): always role:"system", thinking driven by the model config, Qwen-style response split, and vision-model image input (single / multiple).

title: drscrewdriver/dsh-thinking-levels
description: Per-round thinking-level (reasoning_effort) control for DeepSeek Harness: pick Auto and it schedules low/high/max from the recent tool-call history, or fix a wire level (off/on/minimal/low/medium/high/xhigh/max) manually, with custom wire mapping, a model-aware capability guard, and context-window presets (64K–1M); its per-model capability card pairs with a separate plugin, [dsh-llm-openai-completions](https://github.com/drscrewdriver/dsh-llm-openai-completions) (installable from dsh-market), so custom OpenAI-compatible gateways (vLLM / LM Studio / self-hosted) can try reasoning — the card writes llm-pi-ai capabilities, the adapter drives the wire (compat.thinkingFormat), and this plugin auto-maintains the takeover list.

title: dsh-plugin-lab/dsh-workbuddy-bridge
description: Brings WorkBuddy desktop-app models into DeepSeek Harness: the China and international builds each appear as their own group in the model picker, with the reasoning tiers the upstream declares, per-reply credit cost and remaining balance, per-account model visibility, and image input where supported.

title: du-yuxuan/OneKey-Models
description: One-click TokenDance gateway access for DeepSeek Harness: OAuth sign-in stores the API key, a live model catalog with per-model visibility, and agent tools for chat, image generation, video generation and typed decisions.

title: dungcsnd1133/dsh-tlpro-models
description: Declares two model routes in the llm-pi-ai settings section — a TLPro gateway and Z.ai's GLM-5.3 endpoint — with per-model context windows, output caps and reasoning-effort ladders, so the stock model picker can select and tune them. Requires your own TLPRO_API_KEY and a Z.ai coding-plan ZAI_API_KEY; the patch replaces the whole llm-pi-ai row config.

title: Duskriver/dsh-opencode-go
description: OpenCode Go provider with live gateway model discovery, online models.dev capability metadata, session routing, and Web settings with subscription usage.

title: dylan121322/llm-adaptive
description: Adaptive model routing: per-request complexity classification with automatic provider routing.

title: DZQJOKER/dsh-plugin-local-model
description: Local model plugin for DeepSeek Harness: manage GGUF models in settings, auto-launch llama.cpp on first message, and auto-unload after 5 minutes of idle time to free VRAM.

title: ebluffy/dsh-model-router
description: English-only fork of dsh-model-router. Routes each agent step across a configurable model pool and adjusts reasoning effort based on task complexity, tool failures, and cost.

title: Ebony-Vinyl/dsh-our-free-model
description: Adds free model lanes to DeepSeek Harness — DeepSeek V4.1 Flash, Kimi K3 and others — with no login, sign-up or API key, plus a local OpenAI-compatible gateway, fallback routing and a usage dashboard.

title: edge-sky/dsh-oauth-adapter
description: Provides an OAuth account page for DSH Web, currently supporting OpenAI Codex, GitHub Copilot, Anthropic, Kimi For Coding, OpenRouter, and xAI.

title: eghrhegpe/dsh-connect-agnes-token-plan
description: One-tap connect Agnes language, image and video models into DSH (off by default), with image recognition and thinking level filled in automatically. After signing in to the Agnes console (re-login uses AGNES_PASSWORD), you can see the quota windows (5-hour requests, weekly requests, daily images, video), account-wide cumulative usage, and a usage pill beside the input box. AgnesCode desktop models can be connected too (Windows only), re-reading the desktop app login when the token expires, with rate-limit hits backing off on their own.

title: eghrhegpe/dsh-connect-modelscope-token-plan
description: One-tap connect ModelScope language and image-generation models into DSH (off by default), with image recognition and context window filled in automatically. You can also see the free Magicube balance, jump to a model's info page, and record local call counts, trends and rate-limit events, with a usage pill beside the input box showing the balance and today's local count. All of it needs only an API key, with no account sign-in.

title: eghrhegpe/dsh-connect-qoder
description: Registers Qoder CN and international language models into DSH, fetching each model's rate automatically as it shifts with off-peak hours. It also provides a daily check-in, a usage pill and a credit lookup. Needs the Qoder login state on this machine, or one browser login.

title: eghrhegpe/dsh-connect-sensenova-token-plan
description: One-tap connect SenseNova Token Plan language and image models into DSH (off by default), with image recognition and thinking level filled in automatically. On a rate limit it backs off and retries on its own instead of misreading it as an exhausted quota. After signing in to the SenseNova console you can see the usage pill, credit pools and per-model consumption. Xiaohuanxiong can also be signed in by QR code, bringing in its models and their consumption multipliers, and taking over DSH web search.

title: elegant01/dsh-codearts
description: Connects Huawei Cloud CodeArts to DeepSeek Harness with built-in OAuth2 sign-in (PKCE + DPoP) or a pasted token, after which CodeArts models are available in the DSH conversation window. Reads per-account credit balance, expiring credits and daily check-in from the CodeArts credit API, counts requests and tokens locally, and shows a per-account credits popover under the chat input box; the credits line and the upstream queue hint can each be turned off in settings.

title: elfgzp/dsh-llm-minimax
description: Adds MiniMax open-platform models to the DSH model picker: paste the API key in Settings and MiniMax models become selectable, with the M Plan quota windows shown beside the composer.

title: elfgzp/dsh-unified-model
description: Writes one model and reasoning effort into every session at once from a control beside the composer model picker, since the shipped picker only changes the session you are in. Sessions that already match are skipped, subagent sessions follow their parent instead of being written, and the same selection can be pinned as the default for new sessions.

title: EliteOtaku/dsh-opendesign-go
description: OpenDesign Go provider: 12 subscription models over Chat Completions, the real 5-hour and 7-day quota read from the local OpenDesign app, per-model parameters and switches, and multi-account failover.

title: elizax/dsh-http-proxy
description: Wraps globalThis.fetch to route DeepSeek Harness model-API requests through an HTTP/SOCKS proxy by target domain, leaving all other requests on the direct connection, without modifying Harness source.

title: EmotionG/dsh-llm-config
description: Requires DSH >= 0.2.0-rc.2 < 0.3.0. Declare any number of LLM providers, each with its own endpoint, credential and per-model parameters (reasoning-effort vocabulary, image input, retry policy), across the OpenAI Chat, OpenAI Responses, Anthropic Messages and Google Gemini wire formats, configured from a settings page.

title: ethanweave/dsh-connect-workbuddy
description: Runs a local OpenAI-compatible gateway so DSH can use the model quota of a logged-in Tencent CodeBuddy (WorkBuddy) account: one-shot installer with SHA256 verification, logon scheduled task with duplicate-launch guard, manage.ps1 for status/start/stop/restart/logs/update/uninstall, and an agent skill that drives setup and troubleshooting.

title: Eve-146T/DSH-CODEX-SUBSCRIPTION-POOL
description: Use your ChatGPT/Codex subscriptions in DSH, with image generation and web search support.

title: Faide-cyber/dsh-workbuddy
description: Bring WorkBuddy's free and paid models (domestic and international) into DSH — no WorkBuddy desktop app required.

title: FelixJiashengFu/dsh-haoba-mode
description: A gold switch beside the composer that raises every model request to the strongest reasoning effort the current model declares and to its default max output tokens, and adds a system-prompt section asking for exhaustive, self-checked work.

title: ffyuuu/dsh-llm-longcat
description: LongCat-2.0 LLM adapter: 1M context, binary thinking mode, tool calling, and streaming over the OpenAI-compatible endpoint.

title: fieldnote-ops/keyringseam
description: macOS Keychain credential provider that replaces the local-file provider and uses a signed, notarized universal helper.

description: Anthropic provider using the native Messages API for language models in DSH. Requires Firefox2100/dsh-ai-providers#runtime to be installed and enabled.

title: Firefox2100/dsh-ai-providers#cohere
description: Cohere provider for language models, embeddings, and reranking through Cohere's native APIs in DSH. Requires Firefox2100/dsh-ai-providers#runtime to be installed and enabled.

title: Firefox2100/dsh-ai-providers#dashscope
description: Alibaba Cloud DashScope provider for Qwen language models, embeddings, reranking, speech, and image generation through native APIs in DSH. Requires Firefox2100/dsh-ai-providers#runtime to be installed and enabled.

title: Firefox2100/dsh-ai-providers#jina
description: Jina provider for embeddings and reranking in DSH. Requires Firefox2100/dsh-ai-providers#runtime to be installed and enabled.

title: Firefox2100/dsh-ai-providers#localai
description: LocalAI provider for language models, embeddings, reranking, speech, and image generation with LocalAI-specific controls in DSH. Requires Firefox2100/dsh-ai-providers#runtime to be installed and enabled.

title: Firefox2100/dsh-ai-providers#ollama
description: Ollama provider for language models and embeddings, with model discovery, loading, and unloading in DSH. Requires Firefox2100/dsh-ai-providers#runtime to be installed and enabled.

title: Firefox2100/dsh-ai-providers#openai
description: OpenAI provider for language models, embeddings, text-to-speech, speech-to-text, and image generation in DSH. Requires Firefox2100/dsh-ai-providers#runtime to be installed and enabled.

title: Firefox2100/dsh-ai-providers#runtime
description: AI provider runtime and configuration UI for shared credentials and embedding, reranking, speech, and image generation services in DSH.

title: Firefox2100/dsh-ai-providers#typesafe
description: TypeSafe AI Jev decision provider for typed probabilistic choices and scores in DSH. Requires Firefox2100/dsh-ai-providers#runtime to be installed and enabled.

title: FishBottle7/opencode2dsh
description: Exposes OpenCode Zen free models to DeepSeek Harness, with no API key.

title: FitBBC/dsh-plugin-tokenmarket
description: Adds Token Market as an OpenAI-compatible model provider with DeepSeek V4 Pro, Kimi K3, and GLM-5.3.

title: Fleey/deepseek-harness-acp
description: Registers external ACP (Agent Client Protocol) agents such as Codex, Claude Code and Gemini CLI as DSH model providers: maps each agent's thought_level options to the reasoning-effort selector, forwards images when the agent advertises promptCapabilities.image, and routes permission requests to DSH's approval dialog; ships an ACP Agents settings page that imports Zed agent_servers JSON and discovers models.

title: Fleey/deepseek-harness-trae
description: Connects Trae enterprise models to DeepSeek Harness from a personal access token alone, calling llm_raw_chat directly with no trae2api or traecli process; fetches the model catalog from upstream on startup and shows remaining quota for personal packs and enterprise seats.

title: fortran2005/dsh-baipiao-shigege
description: Tiers free-channel models into three 1M fallback chains plus a custom chain; orders them by measured throughput, drops models below throughput or error-rate thresholds, and rotates accounts. Requires an OpenAI-compatible gateway (default :8326).

title: franksong2702/dsh-codex-connect
description: Connect ChatGPT OAuth and OpenAI Codex models to DeepSeek Harness, with opt-in search and image tools.

title: frederico-kluser/dsh-orquestrator
description: Pick the model your subagents run on — with a reasoning-effort ceiling and an output-token cap — enforced in code on every child DSH starts, whichever tool starts it.

title: fu827707013/dsh-codebuddy-cli
description: Reuses the CodeBuddy CLI sign-in to bring its models into DeepSeek Harness, with a settings card showing account, token expiry, and remaining credit.

title: Fushena/dsh-ark-agent-plan
description: Unofficial Volcengine Ark Agent Plan provider: registers an `ark-agent-plan` route with a model catalog fetched from the gateway, per-model thinking-effort control, server-side harness tools, and a quota badge with a panel showing remaining plan capacity.

title: Fushena/dsh-qwen-token-plan-full
description: Unofficial Qwen Token Plan provider: registers a `qwen-token-plan-full` route with a model catalog fetched from the gateway, Responses and Chat Completions protocols, server-side built-in tools, image and video generation tools, and per-entitlement budget tracking that disables a benefit once its quota is exhausted.

title: FuSheng-cs/Trae2api-dsh
description: Use TRAE account model quota in dsh, with multi-account management, daily check-in, rotation, usage statistics, reasoning levels and model visibility. Requires Python 3.10+; the first run downloads Python dependencies.

title: Fuxfantx/dsh-qwen-mode
description: Qwen mode for DSH: manages local GenieX and Alibaba Cloud QwenCloud providers, normalizes thinking and sampling, detects model capabilities, and shows per-turn latency and decode speed. Its bundle patch replaces the permission plugin's preset table with reply-only, read-only, workspace-write and danger-full-access (the last two as in stock), so any custom presets are overridden.

title: GaoHu1997/dsh-model-think-level
description: Thinking levels, image input and image generation for third-party models in the official Models page; multiple keys per provider routed by model, automatic failover between keys on failure, per-route custom request headers, and balance display.

title: GaoHu1997/dsh-webdav
description: Syncs DSH model providers and models across computers through any WebDAV server: the backup is sealed with a passphrase before it leaves this machine, so a new machine opens with the same model list.

title: Garybot126/dsh-subagent-models
description: Set the provider, model and reasoning effort delegated subagents run with, from one chip beside the composer: a per-conversation override and a profile-wide default share the same two controls, and the chip always shows the effective route. Applied when each in-process child is created (agent/created + agent.model.select()); no settings page, no preset edits, no model-facing tool parameters.

title: Gaudi-XIX/dsh-agy-cli
description: Windows-only model provider for Google Antigravity CLI, continuing Darkings/dsh-agy-provider (install as dsh-agy-cli; do not install alongside the original). It reads the Antigravity token from the Windows Credential Manager and sends it only to the Google Cloud Code endpoints, lets DSH own the harness tool policy, streams the tail without rollback, and tracks the real quota windows.

title: Gaudi-XIX/dsh-zcode-cli
description: Runs the locally installed ZCode CLI as a `zcode` model route in DSH: all traffic is signed by the official binary, the plugin never sends its own request, forges client requests or sends credentials off the machine (the plan token is decrypted in memory only to hand back to the official CLI), no API key is needed, and both a paid one-shot and a free app-server channel are supported. Since v0.3.0 it ships an HTTP MCP bridge so tool calls run through the DSH approval surface. Backed by a contract document and a node --test gate.

title: gdyshi/dsh-connect-scnet-plus
description: Connects the models of the SCNet (超算互联网) Computing Service desktop client to DSH, adding a per-model switches tab on the plugin page and adapting the transcript to whichever pi-ai generation the profile resolves. Reuses the API key the SCNet client cached under ~/.sclaw (or SCNET_API_KEY, or a key set in the plugin config) and sends chats to api.scnet.cn through a loopback proxy; it depends on SCNet's unofficial client interface, which may change, and use is subject to SCNet's terms.

title: GeekRicardo/claude-in-dsh
description: Hand a DSH web session to the locally installed Claude Code CLI: a per-session engine selector (DSH | Claude Code), Claude models and reasoning effort in the model seat, Claude permission modes in place of the access-mode selector, and permission requests, AskUserQuestion and ExitPlanMode routed to the native DSH approval, question and plan-review cards. The stream is written as native DSH session events, so the built-in transcript, tool cards and nested subagents render it; Claude slash commands merge into the command palette; the CLI is held by a detached broker, so plugin updates and DSH restarts do not interrupt a running turn.

title: gengwg/dsh-agent-router
description: Routes subagent delegations once at spawn time by keyword rules over the delegation label and prompt: the first matching rule sets the child's provider/model/reasoningEffort, explicit caller routes are kept unless a rule opts in, and unmatched delegations pass through unchanged.

title: gentle-knight/dsh-cannbot-connect
description: Connects CANNBOT gateway models to DSH by reusing the sign-in CANNWork already establishes for opencode: the JWT and virtual key are read from disk on every request, so no separate OAuth flow or extra key is needed, and the account's visible models are registered in the model picker.

title: GnaneshKunal/dsh-openrouter-plus
description: Per-Session OpenRouter routing: a loopback relay writes `service_tier`, `provider.sort` and the `:floor` variant into each request from one of nine presets picked on the composer chip, with a pinned base URL per preset for route-level defaults.

title: GodD6366/dsh-sub2api
description: Connect a sub2api gateway to DeepSeek Harness: OpenAI-compatible multi-provider routes (OpenAI / Claude / Grok / Gemini) behind one base URL, with per-key model discovery, usage lookup, and global vision/image tools.

title: good-saltfish/dsh-auto-rerun
description: Automatically retries model failures (drops, timeouts, rate limits, 5xx) in-turn. Retry count, delays, backoff, fallback and more are configurable. Rate-limit backoff is capped and jittered, server retry hints are honored, and optional retry-until-success keeps going within a time ceiling. Every option is editable from the plugin config or the sidebar panel: retry count, initial and max delay, backoff factor and jitter, rate-limit delay window, retry-until-success ceiling, fallback trigger and switch cap, dead-route blacklist TTL, log file. When a route keeps failing it can switch to a pinned, allowlist-filtered, or catalog-picked alternate model route, with a 30-minute dead-route blacklist (auth failure, subscription expired, billing) and a stale-assembly guard that keeps retried requests on the switched route. Ships a right-sidebar panel with live retry state, route labels and incident counters, Chinese and English locale, and memory-only logging by default.

title: GooDAnDReaDY/dsh-clinebot
description: ClineBot and ClinePass integration for DeepSeek Harness: dedicated settings page, live quota dashboard, in-UI key saving, curated and custom model selection, and a /cline command.

title: GooDAnDReaDY/dsh-key-rotation
description: Keeps a pool of API keys per provider with auto-created clone routes, switches to the next key on quota or rate-limit errors, probes cooled keys for recovery, and exposes the pools, cooldown and switch codes in a Settings section.

title: Leonlee114514/dsh-local-trim
description: One-step local model onboarding plus a light harness for DSH. On load it probes loopback and private-network inference endpoints (llama.cpp, Ollama, vLLM, LM Studio), reads each model's context window and output budget from the backend, and registers the provider through settings, so a local model becomes selectable without hand-writing config. It then trims only that provider: masks the tool list through tools.restrict, drops named system-prompt sections and memory contexts, swaps the injected instruction block for a short one while preserving its first 80 and last 96 characters, and truncates tool-schema descriptions without touching structure or required fields. Cloud providers are returned as the same assembly object, untouched. The injected block is re-read from disk on every assembly, so editing the file takes effect on the next request with no reload. The panel in the plugin detail page is a live operations view: it shows whether the takeover is active and by which hook, how many characters the last assembly was trimmed from and to, and which providers are online (probed concurrently, with a real one-shot completion reporting latency and reply text per provider). If a local backend is not running, the panel offers a one-click launch: it probes the port first (never starting a duplicate), then starts the matching server (ollama serve, or a custom command you supply) detached and polls until the endpoint answers, clamping the wait to 3-600 seconds, reaping the child it just spawned if it never answers, and naming the paths it searched when it cannot find the binary. A stop button kills backends this plugin started (SIGTERM, then SIGKILL) and refuses to touch a server somebody else launched. When a model has just been downloaded and no backend exists yet, the panel can also scan the machine for .gguf files with hard caps (300 models, 20000 directory entries, Downloads only one level deep), start llama-server on the chosen one (skipping the .mmproj. vision projection and reusing a server that already answers), register the provider under the model id the backend reports, and run one real completion to prove it works. Before spawning anything it does a fit check that counts only the part of the file the GPU cannot hold: hostBytes = fileSize - VRAM, compared against max(total RAM - 2GB, free RAM). A file far larger than RAM is refused outright; a heavy host-side remainder is refused unless you confirm; the same remainder under mmap is only a warning, because the weights land in reclaimable page cache. A load-mode selector (auto / mmap / none / mlock / mmap+mlock) maps to llama.cpp --load-mode, and the default is whatever the engine picks. From 0.4.2 everything above is derived from the platform instead of assumed: home and data directories come from os.homedir() and the OS conventions (LOCALAPPDATA on Windows, ~/Library/Application Support on macOS, XDG_DATA_HOME elsewhere); backend binaries are looked up in the official install locations of each OS and can be pinned with OLLAMA_BIN, LLAMA_SERVER_BIN, VLLM_BIN or LMSTUDIO_BIN; model discovery walks DSH_LOCAL_MODELS_DIR, ~/models, ~/llama.cpp/models, ~/.cache/llama.cpp and the LM Studio data directory, with the WorkBuddy layout demoted to one candidate among them. VRAM is asked from nvidia-smi, then rocm-smi, then sysctl hw.memsize on Apple Silicon (flagged unified, so the same bytes are not charged twice), and any flip to a unified-memory budget is handled explicitly. Before building a command line the plugin runs llama-server --help once and keeps only the flags that build actually has, so older engines get --n-gpu-layers 99 and no KV quantization while newer ones get auto plus q8_0; anything it cannot probe is passed through rather than dropped. LM Studio is started with lms server start --port N rather than being lumped in with the engines that need a model argument, and vLLM gets its own --model example instead of llama.cpp syntax. Windows, macOS and Linux are all exercised in CI, including a windows-latest and a macos-latest job, because a cross-platform claim that has only ever run on one OS is not a claim. Two of those suites exist specifically to catch this machine's blind spots: one replays the whole suite with process.platform rewritten to each OS, and one deletes every advantage this development box has — no nvidia-smi, no rocm-smi, no sysctl, an empty PATH, a home directory with no models — and requires graceful degradation rather than a crash. That last one caught a real class of bug: several assertions hardcoded 'lms.exe', which cannot pass where the executable has no suffix. Measured on the reference machine: a 16.9GB 27.2B MoE with 14.5GB of VRAM holds a 285-691MB working set and sustains 76 tok/s after a 1000-2000 token warm-up, so file size alone is not a fit signal. From 0.4.3 the scanned models are shown as a table rather than a dropdown (one row per gguf, with its size and any fit warning), so you can see what is on disk before choosing. From 0.4.4 the delete button on the provider table removes the provider entry, not the weights file on disk. That distinction matters: what people actually want to clear out is the dead entry - one pointing at a port that never answered, one registered twice for the same port, one whose model file was deleted long ago - not a 15.8GB gguf. Deleting a config is undone by importing again; deleting a gguf is not. The removal goes through settings.mutate with an unset op on \['providers', id], because update merges layers: writing null there leaves a null provider key that the loader reads as a broken config rather than an absent entry, and only mutate/unset is implemented as Reflect.deleteProperty. The result is read back afterwards, because unset on a key that comes from a lower layer (the profile cordis.patch.yml or a home patch) does not delete it - it restores the inherited value, so the call succeeds while the entry stays. When the entry is still there the panel says so and points at the file to edit instead of reporting success, and a DSH whose settings service predates mutate() is told plainly rather than silently ignored. Deleting takes two clicks and clearing the confirmation is as easy as clicking another row; on success the online and baseURL caches are cleared and the tool surface is recomputed, since the provider list changed. The gguf itself is never touched by this plugin - the scanned-model table is display and selection only.VRAM reporting is driver-dependent. From 0.4.5 model discovery also reads Ollama's own storage: its blobs are named sha256-… with no extension, so extension matching could never list them. Weights are now accepted by extension OR by GGUF magic header (only dot-free files of at least 8MB, capped at 600 header reads per scan; obviously-not-weights extensions like .json/.md/.safetensors/.part are never opened). Ollama models are resolved from their manifests: the model layer is picked by mediaType application/vnd.ollama.image.model (never adapter/mmproj layers), the human-readable name is restored from the manifest path (…/qwen3/8b becomes qwen3:8b, …/latest stays bare), tags sharing one blob merge into a single row, and the metadata kv supplies name, quantization and context length. Adopting an Ollama model does not start a duplicate llama-server over the same weights: it confirms ollama serve answers on 11434 (launching it if not) and registers the provider under the tag the endpoint itself reports — the blob's sha256 name would never match anything, since 11434 lists qwen3:14b, not sha256-a8cc…. Two real-machine-only traps fixed on the way: existsSync('<file>/') returns true on Windows, so manifest-vs-directory branching now goes by parseable content instead of trailing-slash semantics; and the quantization label table had been copied from a stale ggml enum generation, labelling ggml_type 15 as Q5_K_S while ollama show reports Q4_K_M. Same-blob dedup is by (dev,ino), keeping whichever entry has a name. Verified on the reference machine: the scan goes from 1 row to 4 — qwen3:14b (8.64G) and qwen3:8b (4.87G) now appear with Q4_K_M badges — in 4ms; npm run verify exits 0 (launcher 57, portable 35, panel-host green including the linux/darwin simulated-platform runs); the new panel-host suite builds a real miniature Ollama store in tmpdir and points OLLAMA_MODELS at it, so results no longer depend on whether the test machine happens to have Ollama installed. From 0.4.6 the panel shows each model its real name instead of its file name, because some download tooling stores every weight under one generic file name, leaving the real name only inside the GGUF header. The scan now reads each file GGUF KV section - not a fixed-size head buffer, because tokenizer.ggml.tokens (hundreds of thousands of strings on a large MoE model) and the chat template push general.file_type past any window; and GGUF string arrays are interleaved (u64 length plus payload per element), so treating them as a length table walks the cursor off the rails and produces astronomically large reads. Reading and skipping are accounted separately: key names and types are always read, string values over 256KB and string arrays are only walked past without copying, non-string arrays over 64 elements are skipped outright, and a cursor past the file size stops the read, because an out-of-range position means the cursor is wrong rather than that a limit should be raised. The displayed name goes Ollama tag, then general.basename plus size_label, then general.name, then the file name, with the full string kept for the hover text since it usually carries internal build numbers; mmproj files are now identified by general.type as well as by name. A short read (truncated file) no longer feeds half a value into the parser. On the reference machine, reading one file header parses 44 keys in about 16ms, and a whole scan takes about 31ms. From 0.4.7 the smoke test no longer fails the first time and passes the second. The old code gave both request attempts one shared AbortController and one shared 30-second timer, so the total budget covered both rounds: a cold load of a large model burned it in round one, the abort left the signal permanently aborted, and the second round (the Ollama-style reasoning_effort: none retry) could not even be sent - which is exactly why the first click returned This operation was aborted and the second succeeded. Now each attempt gets its own controller and timer, a timeout retries once automatically (retryOnTimeout, on by default) because a first-request timeout almost always means the weights are still being read from disk, and non-timeout errors (refused connection, HTTP error) are not retried at all. Timeouts report themselves: the message says the wait exceeded smokeTimeout, whether a retry already happened, and points at the new smokeTimeout setting (seconds, default 60, clamped to 5-600) - port responding is not the same as tokens coming out, so it is a separate knob from launchTimeout. Unrelated: an example naming one specific model was dropped from the panel copy, since not every machine has that model downloaded, and the explanation now describes the mechanism instead. From 0.4.8 adopting a plain .gguf no longer registers an unrelated Ollama model. The port field used to follow the last click rather than the file: selecting an Ollama entry moved it to 11434, selecting a plain .gguf did not move it back, so a 11434 left over from an earlier click stayed. The server accepted it as given, probed the port, found Ollama answering and borrowed it (the skipped-launch log line about the port already answering is this path), and then the model id - derived from the file name - could not be matched against Ollama's /v1/models, where the fallback was to grab the first entry in the list. Embedding models tend to sort first, so the adopt registered a model the user never selected. Now the port follows the file: a plain .gguf landing on another engine's port (ollama 11434, vLLM 8000, LM Studio 1234) is moved to 8090 and the panel says so. Only ports belonging to a known engine are overridden - a hand-typed 9999 aimed at your own llama-server is left alone. The model-id fallback no longer guesses either: it takes the only entry when there is exactly one (a single-model backend may legitimately report a different id than the file name) and otherwise reports an error listing the ids it did see, rather than registering a wrong provider. From 0.4.9 the panel can no longer vanish. It used to be possible for the whole section to disappear from the plugin detail page while the host stayed up, the HTTP bridge kept answering, and no crash log appeared. The cause was a scope error: a helper was declared inside one component and referenced from another, which is valid JavaScript and passes a syntax check, so it only threw at render time - when the user pressed the scan button and React ran the state updater. The host wraps every slot entry in an error boundary whose fallback is an empty anchor, so the throw was contained silently: the panel was not uninstalled or crashed, it was replaced by an empty div. The helpers now live in the module scope both components share. The client half also gained its own test - a minimal React stand-in loads the real panel module, really calls the components, really runs the state updater at render time, and presses the scan button, so this class of error can no longer reach a release.
