title: Phoeky/dsh-sensenova-pool
description: Brings SenseNova (日日新) models into dsh with a per-key rotation pool: paste any number of API keys and requests rotate across them, a 429 rate-limit immediately retries on the next key with per-key exponential-backoff cooldown, local RPM pre-throttling avoids the limit instead of reacting to it, and an exhausted pool answers 503 with Retry-After so a 429 never reaches the caller. Ships a built-in model catalogue that works offline and refreshes from /v1/models, plus a settings card with masked keys, per-key probing and removal.

title: pigman18/dsh-openai-gateway
description: Exposes every model of every provider configured in DeepSeek Harness through one OpenAI-compatible endpoint on a fixed loopback port, with a sidebar page for the base URL, key, port and model ids.

title: Plocr/dsh-commandcode
description: Command Code for DSH connects Go / GOAT / Pro / Max subscriptions through llm-pi-ai provider profiles, with model sync previews, favorites and hidden models, per-model reasoning presets, explicit request diagnostics, usage alerts, configuration import/export and web search.

title: prgrmrwy/dsh-auto-model-routing
description: Use Jev to adjust main-chat reasoning effort without switching its model, independently select and apply fresh sub-agent capability and effort, and inspect decisions with per-reply allocation feedback.

title: prgrmrwy/dsh-magpie-connector
description: Connect a self-hosted Magpie gateway with one provider route per upstream owner, so the stock model picker shows Magpie (Claude), Magpie (Codex) and other groups, plus automatic multi-line failover, read-only usage cards, per-model default effort, a per-session fast switch for priority-tier models, and optional Cloudflare Access.

title: Pummelchen/TinyTitan#dsh-tinytitan
description: Keeps a local TinyTitan model server reachable from the harness: refreshes the llm-pi-ai route from the installed models and mounts a compaction backend that does not think.

title: puppy-bai/dsh-quota-takeover
description: Quota takeover for DeepSeek Harness on top of Our Free Model: compiles your platform order and pinned model tiers into one ordered fallback chain, skipping platforms that lack the model, sit in cooldown or are out of quota, writes the result back as Our Free Model combos, and after a quota or rate-limit failure re-plans and injects a follow-up continue message into the interrupted session so the turn resumes on the next platform; the chain ends with your configured aggregate fallback model or the official DeepSeek quota.

title: pure-cow-horse/dsh-model-pool
description: Merges your configured, runtime-registered and locally cached models into one panel, probes and minimal-request tests them, pulls each channel's upstream /v1/models catalog, and chains the keepers into named schemes. A virtual ModelPool provider fails over at request time with per-model cooldowns, exponential backoff, image-request avoidance for text-only models, and a 10-minute memory for rejected reasoning levels. Adds a token ledger by day and model with CSV export, and 21 regression probes. Not a fork of dsh-llm-fallbacks.

title: pyh-pan/dsh-openai-oauth
description: Use ChatGPT subscriptions in DeepSeek Harness Desktop via official Sign in with ChatGPT, with dynamic Agent registration and native model and reasoning selection.

title: QGG4588/dsh-model-failover
description: Model failover for DeepSeek Harness: pick one or more providers and the pool becomes every model inside them; when a request fails (rate limit, quota, timeout, server or transport error) the next untried model in the pool retries automatically, and the original error surfaces once the pool is exhausted. Configure from a seat beside the composer model picker or the model_failover tool, with no restart needed.

title: QI-seven33/dsh-jev-mode
description: Optional JEV decision mode with deterministic project reads, bounded semantic selection, native authorization checks and desktop credential settings.

title: qikairo7/dsh-gemini-pool
description: Multi-account Google Gemini provider: picks the account with the most remaining quota, fails over on 429 with exponential cooldown, probes disabled accounts in the background, and ships a Chinese/English settings page.

title: qinvnb/dsh-cursor-integration
description: Cursor SDK integration with multi-account scheduling, usage tracking, scoped proxies and conversation checkpoints.

title: qinyongliang/dsh-one-gateway
description: OpenAI-compatible gateway for every connected model: groups with failover, aliases, session stickiness, usage charts, API keys and a LAN listener (open to the whole network until you create an API key).

title: qipengxiang/dsh-cc-switch-bridge
description: Bridges the third-party providers saved in a local cc-switch app into DeepSeek Harness: Anthropic-format tool groups become adapter routes, Codex groups are handed to the built-in pi-ai adapter, and a settings page picks which groups to import and in which order.

title: qiubai-di/dsh-chatgpt-subscription
description: Connect ChatGPT subscription models to DSH via OAuth, preserving local tool-call identity across conversation replay.

title: qjf44/dsh-plugin-thinking-api
description: One-click OpenAI-compatible API (CodeBuddy/vLLM/proxies) with thinking mode, avoiding developer-role content_filter rejection.

title: changmodel
description: Model switching, model capability configuration, fixed compaction models, subagent routing, and input history enhancement.

title: r600a-code/dsh-swarm-router
description: Sub-agent matrix swarm that routes heterogeneous tasks to the most suitable model from an OpenRouter-like gateway plus cfgpu.com/llm/square, dispatches each via in-process subagents or direct LLM calls, and tracks per-model token consumption with a feedback-driven ranking.

title: randomix777/dsh-opencode-zen
description: Bring OpenCode Zen free models to DSH: 8 live-discovered providers with zero config, no API key; includes persistent quota tracker with rate-limit detection and reset countdown.

title: randomix777/dsh-plugin-subs
description: OAuth sign-in for 9 subscription LLM providers (Claude, Codex, Grok, Antigravity, OpenRouter, Agnes AI, Qwen, Spark, ERNIE) with zero-config login and usage dashboards.

title: Rczlin/dsh-better-reasoning
description: Gives pi-ai routed models a reasoning-effort ladder without manual settings: falls back declared to models.dev to a 7-tier default, and replaces the composer model chip with a Codex-style vertical picker.

title: realchendahuang/dsh-provider-studio
description: Manage llm-pi-ai providers, API keys and models from one Settings page: add or edit providers, test a model, discover models from an endpoint, and start from 218 provider templates.

title: REALOIYO/dsh-qwenwork-connector
description: Unofficial QwenWork (千问办公) model provider for DSH, adapted from dsh-magpie-connect and magpie (MIT): device-code sign-in and request signing live inside the plugin, so no desktop client or forwarding process is needed. Requires an active QwenWork plan and DSH 0.2.x.

title: recyvan/dsh-model-proxy
description: Routes DeepSeek Harness model API requests through a system, custom or SOCKS proxy; requests outside the configured domains stay direct.

title: Relethe/dsh-thinking-effort-autoswitcher
description: Replaces the composer model picker with a model + thinking-effort picker: arrow keys left/right cycle the effort level and arrow keys up/down switch model; an Auto level scores each turn by how far the conversation has drifted from the main objective and by repeated failures (one extra small judge call per turn), picks the effort from that score, and labels every finished turn with the effort it sent.

title: dsh-zed-provider
description: Use Zed AI hosted models in DSH.

title: ringoage/dsh-subagent-model-picker
description: A GUI subagent-model selector beside the main model seat: pick a model and reasoning effort per session, applied to every in-process subagent.

title: robbywang25/dsh-llm-mlx
description: Use local MLX-LM or MLX-VLM models in DeepSeek Harness through a loopback OpenAI-compatible provider, with optional DSH-owned server startup.

title: roclee2692/dsh-model-groups
description: Grouped provider and manufacturer model selector for DeepSeek Harness, preserving provider/model routes and reasoning levels.

title: Root-7-KHX/habit-hint
description: A local small-model habit hint plugin for DeepSeek Harness that reads recent turns, extracts the user habits, key points and hints, and injects them into the conversation system prompt. It needs a Python virtualenv with torch/transformers/peft plus a user-supplied Qwen3-0.6B base model and LoRA adapter, none of which are bundled; its default scope only runs in sessions that companion-memory has enabled, and with the shipped placeholder paths it silently injects nothing.

title: Sakana07X/dsh-plugin-team-subagent-control
description: Adds per-member model and reasoning-effort routing to DeepSeek Desktop Agent Teams, plus leader-initiated release of a teammate subagent run instance.

title: sanmumu-325/dsh-qwenwork-models
description: Exposes the chat models of a locally signed-in QwenWork desktop app as a Harness provider, with a multi-account pool, session affinity and failover, pre-expiry credential renewal, a health watchdog, per-model enable/context-window/input-type settings, and account status with credit balance. Unofficial local integration that reuses your own signed-in client credential; your own account only. Windows only: needs the QwenWork desktop app signed in, and keeps its account pool in a DPAPI-protected file under %LOCALAPPDATA%. The author warns that reusing the client credential may conflict with the vendor's terms.

title: sanser9/dsh-opencode-connect
description: Brings the free models of a locally installed OpenCode CLI into DSH: starts or reuses a local opencode serve, discovers the live catalog and refreshes it every five minutes, and bridges the session event stream to OpenAI-compatible SSE through a loopback-only shim that validates Host and Origin.

title: Saretheya/dsh-lantern
description: Expose every model already configured in your local DeepSeek Harness to the LAN over OpenAI- and Anthropic-compatible endpoints, with API keys, per-key rate limits, a circuit breaker, model filters and usage reports.

title: Scorp1o117/dsh-reasoning-options
description: Add missing reasoning-effort declarations to custom pi-ai models through DSH settings, enabling the native effort picker and handling models added later.

title: Seller-1990/dsh-model-smart-config
description: Recognizes a model ID in the DeepSeek Harness model catalog and fills that row's context window, input modalities and reasoning levels as editable suggestions, from a bundled offline rule table covering 33 vendors.

title: seonzzy/dsh-zen-adapter
description: Registers OpenCode Zen free models as a native provider: the catalog is discovered live from opencode.ai intersected with models.dev pricing, and a detail page can re-fetch it or test which models answer. Declares no dependencies, so the host's pi-ai stays the only one.

title: sequoiayunus-hue/dsh-subagent-model-config
description: Settings-UI editor that assigns per-teammate model and reasoning-effort rules for DSH native agent teams, resolved at spawn time by wrapping SubagentRuntime.startContinuable. No official files are modified.

title: seriousz158/dsh-codex-use#dsh-codex-appserver
description: Adds OpenAI Codex (ChatGPT) as a selectable DSH provider via the local Codex App Server.

title: serra006/dsh-connect-opencode
description: Expose every free model from a local opencode serve catalog — all providers, including your own custom ones — to DeepSeek Harness's model picker, with OpenCode's native tools denied so execution stays in DSH.

title: SeverusZh/dsh-plugin-subagent-director
description: Per-subagent LLM provider/model selection with role templates.

title: sharewiner/dsh-model-management
description: Manages the default DSH model, provider and model visibility, and optional OpenAI Responses web search.

title: Sheep1x/dsh-aimy
description: Manages a relay station's many groups and rates for DSH, switching the station's billing group in place and refreshing the model list and rate on stations that expose /v1/token/group; stations without it fall back to read-only and keep serving models.

title: shenkonghui/dsh-llm-acp
description: LLM provider adapter that routes model calls through any ACP (Agent Client Protocol) server — Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI, Devin and more — with a registry browser, per-server settings UI, lazy authentication, and dynamic model discovery.

title: Shuai-S/dsh-sub2api-sync#sub2api-sync
description: Syncs the groups, keys and models of one sub2api instance into dsh-llm-pi-ai provider routes, with panel-driven login (password / OAuth) and one provider route per relay key.

title: shuang-ying/dsh-ThirdApi-ThinkingMode
description: Reads each third-party endpoint's own model listing and keeps llm-pi-ai's per-model reasoningEfforts in sync, so the composer offers the thinking levels a model actually has.

title: shuind/dsh-codex-harness
description: Compact Codex coding mode for DSH: light prompt guardrails against GPT over-explaining, with an editable prompt and native Codex-style tools.

title: sirnple/dsh-provider-hub#plugin
description: Provider and account hub for DeepSeek Harness: several API-key accounts per provider with one-click switching and failover when a call dies on quota or credential errors, a per-account usage and quota panel in the conversation header, and built-in Grok Build device-code OAuth.

title: SISCHOI/daruma#dsh-daruma
description: Keeps long DSH sessions alive when a model channel starts failing: daruma takes over after the in-box retry gives up, trips a self-healing circuit breaker on repeated 429/5xx or a terminal error, and moves the next request to another channel in your chain. Works on DSH 0.1.x and 0.2.x hosts, including 0.2.1-rc.2 with verified failover and backup-management RPC. The backup can be picked in Settings or from a panel beside the composer — both stay in sync — with a durable JSONL audit log for every switch. Channel switches are recorded in that audit log instead of as in-conversation notice rows, because a plugin session event of a type the host does not know makes it refuse to load the whole session.

title: SkylerFee/dsh-llm-opencode-go-live
description: An OpenCode Go model source for DSH: it reads the opencode-go catalog from Models.dev and serves it on a separate opencode-go-live route, leaving the built-in opencode-go route in place. The catalog snapshot is cached under the DSH home and a failed refresh keeps the last successful one; its own Models settings card edits the route key and can render OpenCode Go subscription usage.

title: Smartloe/dsh-catpaw
description: Registers 12 CatPaw (妙手) models as a DeepSeek Harness provider, with per-model reasoning effort, harness-executed tool calls, and QR-code login. The bundled catpaw-cli is a macOS arm64 binary (other platforms must supply their own copy), and calls use the signed-in CatPaw account quota.

title: SnailMann/dsh-quick-model-selector
description: Search-first model selector with favorites, recent models, collapsible provider groups and keyboard navigation.

title: SnowAmberX/dsh-role-router
description: Routes agent requests to configurable default, planner, and subagent models, automatically using the planner role in plan mode, with per-role reasoning effort and Web UI configuration.

title: solstice621/dsh-sap-ai-core
description: SAP AI Core provider with shared OAuth, five Qwen model choices, thinking budgets, streaming, and tool calls; validated on cn40.

title: songoao25/dsh-chatgpt-subscription
description: Bind your ChatGPT account via official OAuth and chat with ChatGPT models inside DSH, using your Plus/Pro subscription quota.

title: songrui111/dsh-fine-tune
description: Local LoRA and QLoRA fine-tuning in a panel: import JSONL, see a VRAM estimate before training starts, evaluate, and export an adapter. One-click Python venv setup, but you must supply your own Python 3.10+ and an NVIDIA GPU (6 GB or more). Verified end to end on Windows 11 with an RTX 3060 6 GB; the installer refuses non-Windows hosts, so Linux, macOS and other GPUs are unsupported for now.

title: songzhiyin/dsh-local-model
description: Registers a local LLM provider that routes model calls to an OpenAI-compatible endpoint or the Ollama native API, with a connection-test card in the Models settings page and no account sign-in.

title: SoulZhou/dsh-context-windows
description: Adds a Settings section to adjust the advertised context window of each connected WorkBuddy and Trae model, writing the override into the connector's context budgets.

title: spdw666/dsh-credit-hub
description: Native multi-platform accounts and model routing with staggered check-ins, event notifications, and quota forecasts. Its background worker needs a standalone Node >=22.23.3 with node:sqlite (enforced by engines.node); Qwen Office coding additionally needs Python with cryptography and wasmtime.

title: SpookySandwich/dsh-plugin-rollout-scout
description: Detects which conversation model an account is being served: launches concurrent throwaway probe conversations, scores each streaming chain-of-thought by how its paragraphs open, and cancels probes that read as the older model within seconds. Includes an offline self-check that replays 13 hand-labelled chains-of-thought through the same classifier.

title: stallenlu/dsh-freellmapi
description: Registers FreeLLMAPI as a dsh model provider, with the router itself bundled in the plugin. It launches the vendored server with the host binary and exposes the freellmapi route; the sidebar panel starts and stops that process, lists the router catalogue, probes which claimed models actually answer, and ranks them by the stability, speed and intelligence scores the router computes for itself. Provider keys, routing strategy and usage remain in the router console, which the panel links to.

title: star-Cosmo/dsh-model-tidy
description: Tidy the model list of DeepSeek Harness: hide any model from the selector, rename models and channels while keeping the provider billing rate, and arrange both with arrows. Search, per-provider batch toggles, back to top, one-click restore. Display only — no provider configuration is rewritten.

title: starefinger/dsh-llm-qwen-local
description: LLM adapter plugin for locally deployed Qwen models behind a vLLM OpenAI-compatible endpoint, with per-model multimodal switch, fully configurable reasoning efforts, and a web settings page for editing the deployment from the frontend.

title: starry-sky-blip/dsh-tri-model
description: Multi-model layered pipeline for DeepSeek Harness: a strong model plans, a fast one drafts, a third reviews, and a failed review is reworked automatically — endpoints, protocols, models and gates all configured from the DSH settings panel.

title: STLI69/coding-plan
description: Volcengine Ark Coding Plan provider route for DeepSeek Harness with all 15 Coding Plan models and per-model reasoning-effort control, generated from a single source and drift-checked weekly.

title: stoneface10/dsh-codex-connect-plus
description: Adds ChatGPT/Codex OAuth-backed Codex models and gpt-image-2 generation/editing to DSH without requiring an OpenAI Platform API key.

title: Stormycry-cryp/dsh-AuthInOne
description: Adds account login, API and custom Provider setup, model switching, image fallback for text-only models, and token/cost attribution to DeepSeek Harness 47f.

title: subeichen1/dsh-auto-effort
description: Per-turn reasoning-effort routing that keeps the current provider/model: judges each user message (retry or correction, explicit intent, length, code blocks, errors, task scope) and sets reasoningEffort to a level the model actually declares, so Magpie and other OpenAI-compatible models work too. Ships a composer chip with an auto/manual switch and per-session decision history.

title: summerscar/dsh-plugins#dsh-connect-agentscope-platform
description: AgentScope Platform inside DeepSeek Harness: manage several platform accounts (switch the billing account by hand, pick one by remaining Credits, probe and flag unhealthy ones), an optional OpenAI-compatible model provider whose catalog you can fetch, add to and edit row by row, an available-Credits and redeemable-contribution readout under the composer, and a settings panel for the daily check-in, the balance, contribution grants, usage detail and the price list. Switching accounts affects new requests only and never interrupts a session already in flight.

title: suntianc/dsh-antigravity-auth
description: Adds an unofficial Antigravity OAuth-backed LLM route, web search, image generation and editing, video understanding, quota status, and DSH Web settings controls.

title: suntianc/dsh-codex-auth
description: Reuses the Codex CLI ChatGPT login as an `openai-codex` LLM route and adds GPT Auth controls to DSH Web settings.

title: sunyifeisb-art/dsh-llm-chatgpt-web
description: Answers model calls by driving your own logged-in chatgpt.com session in a local Chrome, so inference spends the ChatGPT web quota rather than Codex quota, and adds a JSON tool-call protocol so the web model can run DSH tools.

title: superboy911/dsh-model-router
description: Deterministic keyword routing, allowlisted model switching, and an isolated image_gen channel for DeepSeek Harness.

title: superfish058/dsh-llm-proxy
description: Per-model proxy routing for LLM requests: selected models go through a proxy (Clash etc.) while the rest stay direct, with automatic retry on transport errors, 429 and 5xx, configured live from the settings page.

title: SYXliuliuliu/dsh-apply-model-all
description: Apply the current session's model to every other session in one click, from a control beside the composer's model picker.

title: szluyu99/dsh-oneapi
description: Configuration panel for an existing `oneapi` route of the pi-ai provider adapter (declare that route in the llm-pi-ai settings first, with api: openai-completions): edit display name, Base URL, API key and default model, test connectivity per model and sync the model list from the gateway, with six agent tools and an optional left-sidebar panel. Written for a Baidu-internal gateway: the Base URL placeholder and token link point there, so set your own OneAPI-compatible gateway.

title: tafcear/kimi-tide#dsh-kimi-tide
description: Per-step model router: named presets with ordered image/keyword-group rules route each agent step across every mounted provider and model, adding collaboration flows for image transcription, an image guard, a multi-plan quota panel, and per-step decision observability.

title: taikaikaikai-pixel/dsh-tap
description: Unofficial upstream bundle for DeepSeek Harness. CodeBuddy gateway with a runtime-synced model catalogue, per-model reasoning efforts, web search/fetch, image generation and a streaming credential bridge, plus TraeWork CN and Qoder CN subscription channels via local translation gateways and a key-type OpenAI-compatible provider registry, all managed from an accordion settings card.

title: tako-dev/dsh-tako
description: Adds Tako chat models to the official llm-pi-ai provider list from Tako's public catalog, with live refresh, context windows from size tags, and browser one-click sign-in writing a cr_ key into DSH credentials.

title: tang-bugu/dsh-connect-qwenwork
description: Registers a QwenWork (千问办公) model provider that reuses the desktop client's local sign-in, runs a loopback OpenAI-compatible bridge on 127.0.0.1, and translates DSH model requests into the ACP-style control-envelope conversation protocol the upstream actually speaks.

title: tangyixiao/dsh-workbuddy-connect-community
description: Community-maintained WorkBuddy and WorkBuddy AI model provider using local desktop sign-in, with model discovery and credit display. Version 0.1.20 supports per-model context-window selection and DSH 0.2.1-rc.2, rc.3, rc.5 and 0.2.2-rc.1; its CN compatibility layer differs from the functy23 fork. Derived from corrinehu/dsh-workbuddy-connect (MIT), it registers the same workbuddy / workbuddy-ai provider ids, so it cannot be enabled together with the original or other WorkBuddy bridges. Version 0.1.12 requires authenticated Host owner access for status and control routes.

title: tangyixiao/dsh-zcode-plan-bridge
description: Requires the ZCode CLI installed and signed in. Relays the ZCode CLI agent into DeepSeek Harness as a model provider. A resident app-server session streams each turn, and the model catalogue is read from the CLI at runtime, so context windows, image support and provider routes follow the installed CLI and account. Stable 0.6.2 supports DSH 0.2.2-rc.1 and 0.2.2-rc.3, improves CLI discovery and includes optional Retry. Tool permission requests are denied by default; unknown approval or permission methods are always denied, and full-auto requires an explicit opt-in. DSH approval UI does not mediate this separately spawned app-server process, and the policy is not an OS sandbox. Derived from kyle123740/dsh-zcode-cli-proxy (AGPL-3.0); it registers the same `zcode-cli` provider id, so it cannot be installed alongside the original.

title: tasuma-qwq/baifanyu-ofm-bridge
description: Connects DSH Web and qq-bridge to OFM, defaulting to the DeepSeek public pool while preserving reasoning effort and manual model selection; loads the official OFM dependency when absent and reports account-rotation receipts.

title: taxah92/dsh-nanogpt
description: NanoGPT PRO subscription models for DeepSeek Harness: a curated model picker with ×1/×2 rate badges, reasoning levels and the remaining weekly quota, without spending the subscription allowance.

title: tearslee/dsh-workbuddy2api
description: Supervises a local workbuddy2api gateway process and exposes its models as an LLM provider, reading context windows and reasoning efforts from the gateway's own model endpoint.

title: Tests4gptplay/dsh-codex-native
description: Use your ChatGPT account to bring Codex models into DSH: choose models and thinking effort, chat with images, use tools and skills, approve local tasks, answer interactive questions, continue and compact long conversations, check quota and Token history, and maintain a supported Windows screenshot helper.

title: thebtf/dsh-cliproxyapi-provider
description: Connects one CLIProxyAPI gateway to DeepSeek Harness, speaks OpenAI Responses, Chat Completions, Anthropic Messages or Google Generative AI natively, and imports the gateway model catalog into a settings page where each model can be selected.

title: TheStreamCode/dsh-muse-code
description: Adds Meta's Muse Code subscription as a DSH model provider: the bundle declares the shipped Meta route under Settings > Models, syncs the account chat catalog (Muse Wonder included) into the model picker, and adds a Sign in card plus the /muse-login command that run DSH's built-in Meta device-code flow, keep the minted key renewed, and show a red or green credential dot. Needs an active Muse Code subscription and no Meta CLI.

title: thibautrey/multivibe#dsh-multivibe
description: Connect DSH to a MultiVibe gateway and inspect available models and connection status.

title: TikaFlow/dsh-model-fix
description: Provides a better model experience, including but not limited to: filling model parameters in multiple ways, improving model compatibility, remembering reasoning efforts, subagents following the parent's model and reasoning effort in real time, and AI self-adjusting reasoning effort.

title: TINGOD2006/dsh-um-proxy-ondemand
description: Manages the lifecycle of the local UM GenAI proxy (127.0.0.1:8788) that DSH's um-genai provider talks to: wakes it on demand for llm/stream calls, stops it after an idle period, and reports health plus a read-only status endpoint. Also ships a DSH settings page for port, always-on mode, idle minutes, interpreter and paths, plus the UM account and proxy API key, and a button that writes the providers.um-genai entry into the profile patch and fills in its model list, since a fresh profile has no provider and the model picker would otherwise stay empty. A renewal watchdog logs in to the campus gateway on a hidden Windows desktop when the upstream token expires. The proxy itself is um_opencode_setup.py, a single-file tool distributed by the University of Macau; a copy is vendored in vendor/ so a fresh install works out of the box, while a copy in ~/.um-opencode/ takes precedence when present. The plugin still does not produce tokens: those come from logging in to the campus gateway. Requires Windows (process discovery and idle shutdown use netstat/taskkill; renewal uses PowerShell and a hidden desktop), Python 3.10+ and a University of Macau account.

title: TinyBOOOOM/dsh-cliproxyapi-pro
description: Connects CLIProxyAPI (CPA) to DeepSeek Harness (DSH) with multiple accounts, model filtering, native protocols, quota lookup and image / video generation; once configured, the selected models appear in the model picker automatically.

title: tkaiz0406/dsh-subagent-route-pin
description: Registers a wrapper provider that gives delegated subagents their own LLM route — one-off spawns through provider.start, Agent Teams members through a hook on startActivation — while the main agent keeps its model. Ships a Settings section for picking that route, a per-expert override file, a capability flag reporting which seams the hook caught, and a readiness record written at mount.

title: TLEWA/dsh-opencode-go-router
description: Keeps prompt caches warm for OpenCode Go DeepSeek conversations by predicting each request's cache hit before it is sent, rotating the x-opencode-session routing id when that request would be cold and recent requests are slow, and pooling idle warm ids for reuse by new conversations.

title: tonylee2022/dsh-xai-oauth
description: Sign in to an xAI Grok subscription with device-code OAuth, refresh the access token, and use it as the xai route credential without an API key.

title: TonyWu2333/dsh-mercury-diffusion
description: Plays Inception Mercury's diffusion (denoising) stream live in the dsh Web UI answer bubble: for routes that support it, the request is re-sent with `diffusing: true` and the real frames are replayed from noise to final text, while only the converged answer reaches the session log. Support is detected per provider/model with a probe that is rejected before any token is generated, a floating per-model toggle turns it on, and attachments, auxiliary calls or unsupported routes fall back to the original adapter. Replaces the assistant-message renderer for all models while enabled.

title: troytse/dsh-plugin-subagent-roles
description: File-defined subagent roles for DeepSeek Harness: roles live in project and global .dsh/roles files, a delegating agent sees one catalog line per role, and each role's tool policy decides which tools its child can see.

title: twoweeks1995/dsh-subagent-setup
description: Named model routes for subagent delegations, configured from a settings page: each alias binds a subagent provider, model and optional reasoning effort, token cap, agent preset, tags, plus a "when to use" line the model reads to pick it, so a delegation names only the alias. Adds five tools (delegate, list routes, edit config, wait, release), shows the route a child actually ran on in its session header, lets each UI element be switched off, and keeps all configuration in one local JSON file instead of YAML.

title: uio-o/dsh-model-control
