description: Sidebar unread / waiting / status hub for DSH Web: a bell jumps to the next unread session, a shortcut walks sessions waiting for input, and ⌘⇧, / ⌘⇧. step back and forward through the conversations you have visited; one overlay lists unread and pending sessions side by side; a six-metric readout at the sidebar foot makes every icon a button that jumps to the next session of that kind; a host-side ledger keeps the account across restarts, so an unread session keeps its green row dot after a restart, and a startup dialog offers to re-send a continue message to sessions whose turn was cut off.

title: Da0Mine/dsh-talk-map
description: A visual map for your sessions: every conversation is a card on an infinite whiteboard — workspaces become frames that fold their overflow into a drawer, card positions are never rearranged, lines between cards carry context (drag one to fork with an injected digest), and each card shows a status lamp for running, waiting, unread or interrupted.

title: dcd887/dsh-record-search
description: Full-text search over every DeepSeek Harness session, with a sidebar panel and a record_search tool.

title: DDDMUC/dsh-delete-turn
description: Per-message delete for DSH: remove a user message, one reply step, or a whole assistant reply from the derived model context through the official surface-replace contract, and hide it from the visible transcript without rewriting the append-only log.

title: deciia/dsh-message-pins
description: Bookmark a whole assistant reply with the star on its action row, or bookmark any selected sentence with the icon beside the selection; pins are saved as Markdown to a local folder or an Obsidian vault, and the existing right sidebar lists, tags, searches, exports and jumps back to them.

title: deepsleepAquarium/dsh-whale-post#bus
description: File-backed post office between DeepSeek Harness sessions: every letter is sealed with an HMAC and a body digest, recipients are resolved through a roster interface, and delivery is offline-first, so an undeliverable letter waits in the mailbox instead of being lost.

title: DelayNooMore/dsh-plugin-session-trash
description: Session trash for DSH: move sessions to a recoverable trash, restore or purge them in settings.

title: delock/dsh-whats-up
description: What's up - a zero-maintenance status board for your sessions. Scans every conversation on the host, extracts a goal + one-line status per session (multi-provider LLM, fingerprint-cached), surfaces half-done, unanswered and recent work in a sidebar panel, and jumps you back into any session with one click.

title: DenAbr/dsh-compact-selected-model
description: /compact and auto-compaction summarize with the model selected in the session, not the model that finished the last turn.

title: deqingLv/dsh-slash-new
description: Adds a /new slash command that opens a blank session in the current workspace (reusing an existing blank one when there is one) and carries the old session's permission preset and agent preset into it, so starting fresh never changes what the agent may do.

title: device1999/dsh-session-archive-delete
description: Adds backup-then-delete and delete-only actions to the DSH session menu: a safe session-delete tool that copies the session directory, its projection cache and a metadata snapshot to a local archive folder and checks them file by file before deleting a session to free disk space; subagent sessions it spawned are handled in the same run, and each backup folder keeps a RESTORE.txt with recovery steps.

title: devzer0o0/dsh-prompt-optimizer
description: Rewrites the message you type into the DSH composer into a precise prompt before the model ever sees it, with one cheap side call on the session's own route. The rewritten text is what gets logged and sent, so the transcript always shows exactly what the model received; hover the whale to compare before and after. Slash commands, very short or very long messages and image-only messages are left alone, and any failure sends your text untouched. The composer whale is the switch: dark silhouette when off, gold when on.

title: DieJob/dsh-session-folders
description: Creates summary-named per-session folders in a workspace on each session's first message, lets a new session inherit an existing session folder, and can be toggled per workspace.

title: Diluka/dsh-afk
description: AFK controls for ask_user_question: profile-wide or per-session settings, configurable automatic replies or blocking new calls, and session-log question history with read tracking; does not approve permissions or plans. Supports DSH 0.2.1-rc.2 and 0.2.1-rc.3 only.

title: Domaki-co/dsh-message-forward
description: Cross-session message forwarding between DSH sessions: extract one model reply, a user message, or a multi-selected batch of messages and images from one session and deliver it into another, with silent send, draft fill, or send-and-jump delivery, plus prompt templates.

title: domitor-syh/dsh-rollback
description: TRAE-style conversation rollback — per-turn checkpoints (10-turn sliding window) roll back touched files and truncate model context in place, keeping the same session id. Human-initiated only: a /rollback command or a per-turn Web button (works on interrupted turns too), with a preview listing each affected file and its action — restore, recover, delete, or skip.

title: dongasai/dsh_compact_queue
description: Registers /compact_queue, a compaction command that does not drop the request when the session is busy: it compacts immediately when idle, otherwise queues the request in that session and runs it at the session's next idle window, with a 2-second fallback tick beside the agent status event so the trigger is not missed, a 30-minute wait cap, and /compact_queue cancel to withdraw a queued request or abort a running one. Each session keeps its own queue state from a single command registration, completion and failure arrive as a collapsed notice that does not wake the model, and every ManualCompactionError code except busy is terminal so a failure is not retried. Host half only; the core /compact command is left untouched.

title: dongasai/running-sessions-float
description: Collects the sessions that need you into one dock at the bottom of the web GUI sidebar: running sessions, sessions waiting on an approval, plan review or answer, and finished runs whose result has not been opened yet. Rows are sorted by last update and clicking one switches the main view to that session; it reuses the shipped useSessions and useSessionStatus hooks rather than adding a data source, polls nothing, stores nothing and modifies no session. The header dot pulses while anything is running or waiting and settles to a static dot when every row is only a finished-but-unread reminder; with no such sessions the dock collapses to one quiet line, and a collapsed 56px sidebar shows a 36px badge with the count instead of the list. It registers in the sidebar footer slot, so it is part of the layout and does not overlay the conversation list, leaving the existing footer entries below it.

title: donghangxunlang-cmd/dsh-attention-health
description: Content-degradation detection (thinking loops, output repetition) for DeepSeek Harness, with a continue-vs-handoff cost verdict and zero-model handoff documents.

title: dongsheng123132/task-passport
description: Carry durable task state across DeepSeek Harness, WorkBuddy, Claude Code and Codex with machine-readable checkpoints and optimistic locking.

title: Donkey-Kurt/fullstack-pair
description: Give one session a mutable set of extra workspace directories, with cross-directory search and a header badge.

title: dororo42/dsh-ungrouped-sweeper
description: Sweeps the dsh web conversation list: a standalone page lists every stored session by workspace with official titles, batch-archives the ungrouped test ones through the workspace registry (stopping running work first), restores them anytime, and physically purges archived sessions as an explicit second stage. Ships a client half that adds a sidebar launcher button.

title: dotdance/dsh-title-prefix
description: Prefixes every session title with the name of its workspace or project, so a flat session list shows which project each conversation belongs to; titles you renamed yourself are left unchanged.

title: dpskk2/dsh-chatsync
description: Two-way sync of DSH sessions, workspace mappings, settings and patches between machines through your own private GitHub repo (API keys stay machine-local).

title: dream12347/dsh-session-manager
description: DSH session manager: delete with trash/restore/purge, restore archived sessions, recent-activity stats, continue/pause, open log folder, unread markers, fork into a new chat, workspace grouping and sorting, context compaction threshold.

title: DrinkerqvB/dsh-markdown-copy
description: Copies a text selection anywhere in the DSH conversation as Markdown source on Ctrl+C, restoring headings, lists, GFM tables, fenced code blocks and TeX math.

title: drscrewdriver/dsh-context-compression-improved
description: Same-origin in mechanism with the two loudest lines in context compression. The code-skeleton gate follows the skeletonization approach of Headroom (Apache-2.0), whose published headline is 20% fewer tokens for coding agents and 60–95% fewer tokens for JSON, same answers. The estimator channel follows TokenPilot (arXiv:2606.17016), which reports up to 60% lower cost for long-session agents. Both figures are theirs, quoted as-is; this plugin ships no benchmark of its own and claims no reduction of its own. What it adds for DeepSeek Harness: choose a compression profile, set the Auto Compact trigger level and toggle code-skeleton compression from one settings section, with exact DeepSeek V4 tokenizer measurement, same-revision count verification, and fail-open behaviour that keeps the original tool results on unsupported models. Within a turn it supports skeletonized information compression with a low original-text retrieval rate; at the tail of a turn it supports a turn-tail intent summary implemented purely by content substitution; context content stays safe, and the whole process runs inside the official JSONL compression.

title: drscrewdriver/dsh-date-wrapper
description: Compresses DSH time-context from ~280 chars to 46 chars by injecting a compact date line into the runtime-context snapshot; zero runtime dependencies.

title: drscrewdriver/dsh-manage-session
description: Session Manager for DSH (formerly Session Steward): one console over active and archived sessions — grouped by workspace, domain and title filters, favorites, and batch archive / unarchive / purge archived files (destructive steps ask twice) — plus a four-gate health checkup (log integrity, projection cache, lossless JSON, cold read) that ends in a reversible, backup-first prescription. Search and indexing live in dsh-search-index; this plugin builds no index and never rewrites session logs.

title: drscrewdriver/dsh-reference-session-collector
description: Read-only session-log projector (drsc) for DSH: scans ~/.dsh/sessions/**, decodes zstd/tiled-frame logs with a vendored leaf decoder and rewrites per-session projections into its own SQLite (node:sqlite, segments / replaces + FTS5), exposed through a single fenced HTTP route — surface ledger, recall/compression pair accounting and Chinese-capable full-text search. Token counts share the exact DeepSeek-V4 tokenizer and formula as CCI verify, falling back to a labelled chars/4 basis when assets are absent. Never writes session files; all output lands in its own data directory. Serves three consumer plugins: context-compression-improved (surface marking + recall reconciliation), session-steward (search-corpus switch), prime-memory (historical anchor backfill). Hosts 0.1.0-rc.2 .. 0.2.1-rc.2 (17-tag exact engines.dsh enum). npm: dsh-reference-session-collector.

title: drscrewdriver/dsh-search-index
description: Sidebar session search that builds its own index instead of reusing DSH's full-text one: title to content toggle in one entry, results grouped per session with the strongest snippet and user/reply/tool tags, plus watermark-based incremental sync, archive-driven pruning of archived sessions, and a shadow rebuild that never blocks the live index.

title: drscrewdriver/dsh-session-guard
description: Peak-hour auto session gate: weekend mode + global peak auto-pause + session-level freeze/resume + backend auto-retry, auto-resume on off-peak.

title: dsboylw/LazyNoobsCockloft#dsh-session-notes
description: Session notes 0.3.1: multiple numbered notes per session (1 2 3… by creation order), session-level color and pin (one click in the popover title row), a copy picker (click any note to copy), per-session delete-all, compatible with DSH Desktop 0.8.2.

title: duanyunlun/dsh-conversation-link
description: Peer communication between conversations in one DeepSeek Harness process: list the conversations the workspace shows, link one under a nickname, message it without waiting for its turn to end, read its progress without waking it, and declare rules for your own tool calls.

title: Dubai1210/dsh-session-delete
description: Deletes a DSH session from the session menu, and lists the workspace files that session touched so you choose which ones to remove with it. Deletion is permanent (no undo), and files written through shell commands are not tracked.

title: duroey/dsh-study-tree
description: A learning chat tree for branching chat: fork selected text with inherited context, continue each native session, and return to your reading position.

title: dylan121322/dsh-session-unarchive
description: Restore archived sessions to their original workspace from the Web GUI sidebar.

title: DylanYeung0929/dsh-session-bridge
description: Read, message and live-follow local DeepSeek Harness sessions from inside an agent: four tools (session_list, session_read, session_send, session_chat) plus a matching Python CLI, over the desktop app local RPC; transcripts also read offline. Requires Python 3.10+; offline transcript reads also need the zstd CLI.

title: dzwalker/dsh-session-keepwarm
description: Keeps the most recently used sessions resident in the browser so switching back reuses the already loaded history instead of re-reading it; the number of resident sessions is configurable and the plugin can be switched off.

title: Earnest02522/dsh-archive-manager
description: Archived-conversation manager for DeepSeek Harness: view archived conversations grouped by workspace, restore them, and reveal their transcript folders.

title: EarthPretender/dsh-session-delete
description: Adds a red "Delete session" row beneath Archive in the sidebar session menu and permanently deletes that one session - its stored logs and its workspace account entry, written through the workspace registry itself. A second click confirms and the row leaves the list immediately; sessions opened this run are disposed from memory first so nothing resurrects them, and a session running work shows one extra warning whose click stops the task before deleting.

title: Eason-22/dsh-autorestart
description: DeepSeek Harness plugin: restart without losing work. It waits until every conversation is idle, restarts the host, and picks the interrupted work back up instead of dying with it; where a supervisor already manages the host it asks that supervisor, and it never starts a second host next to a running one. It also fixes a common one: stale login cookies pile up on every launch until the request header overflows and the host will not start; the plugin clears them before each restart. Every restart is preceded by a snapshot of the configuration and the installed plugins - 2 are kept by default, up to 10 are allowed, and old or incomplete ones are pruned. That snapshot is never applied automatically: the plugin does not watch the host and does not restore anything on its own; it is only there for you to look at, or to roll back by hand. When the work is done it counts down and powers the machine off, so nobody has to stay up at night. It works on the Windows desktop client, and on a hosted dsh web instance - verified on WSL with systemd; Windows-hosted web, WSL without systemd, and native Linux are untested.

title: Edge-Echo/dsh-driftwatch
description: Behavior-drift reports for DSH sessions: compares two session logs and reports tool-sequence alignment, tool mix, reasoning volume, timing, retries and file targets, with an optional CI threshold gate. Zero dependencies.

title: Ediblewildfungi/dsh-archived-session-delete
description: Adds a confirmed Delete session action to the sidebar menu of archived Sessions; the Host permanently removes their local JSONL logs (including hidden subagent descendants), workspace accounting and archive/pin entries, then refreshes open Web clients.

title: EIGHTfs/dsh-session-conductor
description: Session management for DSH: archive/restore, batch & conditional delete, AI auto-rename, interrupted-session auto-resume, workspace grouping, undo last message, repair damaged session logs (seq-gap/EIO/dual-format), value analysis and full-text search — plus plan/closing template injection (system prompt + context).

title: EIGHTfs/dsh-session-migrate
description: Cross-version session migration for DSH: sweeps legacy session stores (v0 plaintext, .zstd and .zip exports), re-pins the header cwd to the target workspace and drops sessions in so the persistence layer upgrades them on open; settings sidebar with env/import/list/convert tabs plus a CLI (check / fix / import).

title: Elefseus/dsh-default-workspace
description: Moves the default workspace off the system drive (DSH opens every new Session in <Documents>/deepseek-harness/default-workspace and never relocates it) while keeping stored sessions usable: rewrites the workspace record without a restart, offers the same three actions as a GUI panel, moves stored session logs together with their header cwd, and re-frames logs whose first frame is not exactly one header line. Requires the desktop host (workspaceRegistry and sessionPersistence).

title: elegant01/dsh-scalpel
description: Compare two or three answers in one session and drop chosen turns from every later model request.

title: elfgzp/dsh-session-bridge
description: Gives an agent tools to open foreground sessions, prompt them in queue or steer mode, read the transcript back, cancel a turn, and get the authenticated URL of the local web app.

title: elk-9527/dsh-auto-archive
description: Automatically archives idle DSH conversations after a configurable number of days and clears the projection cache of archived sessions, without deleting transcripts or attachments.

title: EmptyVessel-000/dsh-file-history
description: Per-turn checkpoints of the whole workspace: every turn ends with a snapshot, the files it changed are listed under that turn in the chat, and any turn can be restored — files, the conversation, or both. Capture is a whole-tree scan rather than a hook on write/edit tools, so edits made by shell commands, external editors or git leave a record too. Restoring the conversation forks it from that turn instead of cutting the original, and a restore can itself be undone. History sits in a shadow git repository under DSH_HOME and never touches your project .git. Requires Git >= 2.20 and Node.js >= 20.

title: Enosensu/dsh-fork-relink
description: Fork companion for DSH: on any official fork, copies every direct subagent child of the source session onto the forked conversation (recursively, whole subtrees) through the official agent API, leaving each copy as a cold session the official resume path can wake — so the new conversation keeps its subagent panel and can keep messaging those children, while the originals stay with the old branch.

title: erlingmijiang/dsh-lorebooklike-prompt-tool
description: SillyTavern-style prompt rules for DSH: layered system-prompt anchors, constant/keyword entries, reproducible probability gates and regex rewriting.

title: EvilIrving/dsh-context-proxy
description: Thin on-demand context retrieval: context_query / context_slice / context_grep tools that read already-persisted history back with replay-safe citations.

title: Fadegentle/dsh-session-booth
description: Persistent multi-session split view in the DSH main window — open one or more sessions side by side in resizable panes with grid, shelf and column layouts, drag-to-reorder panes, and a sidebar entry to reopen the booth.

title: falling-ts/dsh-force-compact
description: Forces context compression when running low-context llama.cpp models such as Qwen3.8-27B, improving model efficiency and usage smoothness, together with well-refined compaction prompts.

title: FallnStrelitzia/dsh-chat-settings
description: Per-conversation system prompt, turn-based context folding, sampling overrides and a low-token pure chat mode for DeepSeek Harness.

title: fallow5/dsh-pin-sessions
description: Pin and unpin sessions to the top of the Web sidebar with a dedicated pinned panel, archive section, and native three-dot menu integration.

title: Fan-sx/dsh-session-focus
description: Marks a Session as focus or parked in one click from its sidebar row, its hover card, or the conversation header, and keeps a count visible at the foot of the sidebar and next to workspace folder names when those groups are collapsed. A panel lists every marked Session alongside the states the sidebar already tracks (waiting for a reply, running, finished-unread), and the sidebar foot opens whichever one needs a reply first.

title: Feahter/dsh-plugins#archive-rsi
description: Session archive with tags, notes and per-session metrics, plus a Plan-Do-Check-Act loop over the archived sessions that produces prompt and AGENTS.md rules and re-measures them on later sessions. Runs locally without calling a model.

title: feiertu/dsh-input-rewriter
description: Type normally; about two seconds after you pause, it rewrites your draft into a clearer, first-person version more likely to get a good answer, leaving pasted code, links and long text untouched, marking missing details as placeholders instead of guessing, and keeping multi-part questions numbered.

title: feigo313/dsh-structured
description: Persona mode + structured output for DSH: identity header, three cards and signature rendered by the plugin while the model only submits a persona JSON envelope; per-session structured toggle, default-on persona.

title: fengxiforcy/dsh-surrogate-guard
description: Neutralizes lone UTF-16 surrogates in tool output before they reach the session log, preventing permanent 400 INVALID_REQUEST errors.

title: FenrirCait/dsh-session-leftover-purge
description: Purges billion-context snapshots left behind after a session is deleted in DeepSeek Harness, and can also clean up cost-meter ledger rows (off by default).

title: Fioraen/My-code-warehouse#dsh-withdraw
description: Right-click a sent message to edit or withdraw it. The running answer is stopped first, then that message and everything after it are replaced in the conversation: withdrawing leaves a short withdrawn marker and stops there, while editing asks the model again with the new text.

title: flandre2233/dsh-recovery-resume
description: Resumes turns interrupted by a DSH host restart: hooks agent activation (once a session is live), reads the crash-repair turn/end, and sends a continuation that requires verifying real-world state first rather than assuming a side effect succeeded or failed. Permanent failures (AUTH, QUOTA, context overflow) are skipped, with a cross-restart budget, adaptive backoff and a minimal-context payload.

title: flow2dream/dsh-msg-rewind
description: Conversation rewind for dsh web: /undo rolls back one turn, /rewind cuts to a past message, and hovering a user bubble offers a visual undo.

title: flowfire/dsh-plugin-agent-groups
description: Organizes multiple live DSH sessions into a collaboration group and relays each round's final output on a shared timeline.

title: flyeasy/dsh-session-overview
description: One recency-sorted list of recent sessions across all workspaces, with color-coded workspace badges, a collapsible sidebar section, and the built-in session row actions on right-click.

title: fomalhaut1998/dsh-session-find
description: Ctrl+F find-in-session for the conversation, powered by the session store rather than the DOM - labels every hit by source (you / assistant / reasoning / tool call / tool result / system), groups results by turn, merges identical snippets, offers prose-vs-everything scope, regex / case / whole-word options, highlights all matches, and copies or exports the result set as Markdown.

title: fredalxin/dsh-solo-thinking
description: Visual branch brainstorming that creates an isolated Session for each direction, automates parent, sibling, checkpoint, and return Handoffs, and provides a full tree tab with an optional Better Sidebar view.

title: Frog755/dsh-client-auto-retry
description: Auto-resumes interrupted DSH turns: sends a queued 「继续」 after turn/end with error, interrupted or max-tokens reasons, with a grace period, cooldown, exponential backoff, a consecutive-attempts cap, boot-time scanning, a settings card and a per-session stop/restore button in the composer toolbar; it never switches models or providers.

title: FrozMN/dsh-session-adopt
description: Adopts DSH sessions created outside the running window (IDE/ACP clients, other processes) into their matching Workspace, and imports local sessions from other agent harnesses (pi) as native, resumable DSH sessions with sidebar sync/import actions and idempotent re-import.

title: fujingzhai/youxia-dsh-plugins#dsh-session-labels
description: Finder-style session labels: a hover button next to archive and pin, plus the native context menu, assign coloured labels; titles can take the first label's colour or a label symbol; view options gain a filter by label applied before grouping. Labels are stored by the Host and shared across workspaces. Needs DSH 0.2.2-rc.1 or newer and Node.js 24.9+ (node:sqlite); the interface is available in Chinese and English only.

title: Full626/dsh-session-trash-90d
description: Lists every session stored in the local DSH profile with its title, workspace, last-modified time and size, then moves the selected ones to a 90-day trash you can restore or purge; deletion detaches the live session first, so the sidebar updates without restarting the app.

title: FunnyDiodio/dsh-session-delete
description: Adds a Delete Session row to every sidebar session '...' menu (the official harness has archive/pin/rename/fork only, no durable delete). One-click Force delete ejects the session from the host live catalog, stops its background work, then removes the durable log, projection cache and registry bookkeeping - no ghost rows on any connected desktop web UI. Workspace files the session created are kept; conversation logs are permanently deleted. Third-party cloud mirrors (e.g. phone apps via Agents Anywhere) hold their own copies. Bilingual zh/en UI, trust-fenced local route. Requires DSH >=0.2.1-rc.1.

title: GallenShao/dsh-faster-compress
description: Prepares context summaries in the background and applies them at safe step boundaries, with native compaction fallback and a per-conversation history of summaries, application status, timings, and token usage.

title: Gaudi-XIX/dsbot-session-create
description: Adds four tools to a Session. create_session opens a new Session in a named workspace or in any existing folder and delivers one prompt into it; session_message adds one more message to a Session that is still running — the host is asked to splice it into that turn at once, instead of queueing it until the turn ends; a Session that has gone idle is refused, pointing back to create_session; read_session_transcript reads back what a Session said and whether its current turn has finished; list_dispatched_sessions lists what this plugin dispatched and each one's state right now. Host-half plugin, no UI — it calls the host's own session primitives rather than reimplementing them. Restart DSH after installing.

title: gbn0219/dsh-ask-from-text
description: Select text in a completed assistant answer to ask in a separate floating branch with colored marks, a stage, and a branch tree.

title: Genesi599/dsh-plugins#branch
description: Four slash commands for session branches: list the branch tree, fork at a completed turn, pin a session together with its whole family, and merge a child branch back into its parent.

title: GengDaPeng/dsh-agent-message
description: Cross-session agent messaging for DeepSeek Harness with session discovery, offline delivery, delivery receipts, and sender-session navigation.

title: glk1220/dsh-session-git
description: Merges the work done in a forked session back into the session it came from: /merge turns the branch's session log into a digest without a model call (each turn's prompt and reply, files changed, commands run, choices you made, to-dos and the final answer) and delivers it with your next message, or at once with --wake; merging the same branch again brings only the turns added since. Also adds /branches, a right-sidebar branch map with merge state, a reminder above the composer for branches with unmerged turns, and session_branches / session_branch_merge tools for the agent.

title: GnaneshKunal/dsh-session-coldstore
description: Tiered cold storage for DSH sessions: idle sessions move out of the live root into an on-disk cold tier instead of being deleted, an FTS5 index over that tier keeps them searchable, and a restore path moves a session back into the live root. Dry-run by default: nothing moves until you turn it off in Settings.

title: GoetheDady/dsh-no-project-sessions
description: Adds a work-without-a-project option to the project picker, creates a dated working directory from the first message, and groups these sessions under a native Recent section.

title: GoGoZeppeli-towa/dsh-dsml-leak-guard
description: Drops text blocks that carry nothing but leaked DSML tool-call tags, then rewrites the resulting empty turn into a retryable error so the host's built-in retry re-issues the request; prose that merely contains tags passes through untouched.

title: good-saltfish/dsh-multi-session
description: Multi-session overview: list every session grouped by workspace with live status, and pin up to three side by side to read their conversation text. Each card says whether a session finished since you last looked, is waiting on your answer, or has stalled mid-turn, and which files it changed. Send a message or interrupt any session without switching away, with a receipt showing whether it was queued, delivered or being processed. Search across all sessions, forward a turn to another, and switch a session's model from its card.

title: GooDAnDReaDY/dsh-session-control
description: Session management for the DSH sidebar: pin conversations, search their contents, read archived transcripts and hide noise.

title: Gorkaseto/dsh-delete-sessions
description: Adds a "Delete session" option to the sidebar session menu that permanently removes the session from disk.

title: GreenLv/dsh-session-insights
description: See how you have been using AI: `/session-insights` reviews your DSH sessions over time, shows what worked, which problems kept coming back, and what results were actually produced, then creates a retrospective report on your machine.

title: guicaiyue/dsh-context-domains
description: Puts a domain bar under the session header — a domain groups skills and tools and toggles as one block, so one click loads or unloads every member. Hovering a chip lists its members (skills, then tools) in a height-capped panel that scrolls. The right end of the bar is a compaction-threshold counter (− 5 +, 100k tokens per step) that rewrites the live compaction engine policies, so the compaction trigger line changes on the next turn without restarting dsh; a degraded fallback turns the number amber and is reported in the snapshot. Settings maintains domains and members with search, skill/tool tabs, all/selected/unselected filters and a copyable AI grouping prompt. Tool removal uses tools.restrict plus a guard; hiding a skill re-registers it with modelInvocable false, so it leaves the model catalog while /name still works. Sessions of another preset are left untouched.

title: gulagala001/dsh-btw
description: Ask side questions using the current conversation context, with independent streaming and cancellation.

title: gulagala001/dsh-undo-plugin
description: Rewind conversation turns and checkpointed file changes while restoring tasks and evidence at the same history boundary.

title: guo120629-dotcom/dsh-send-timestamp
description: Adds a Timestamp toggle to the composer; while it is on, each message you submit is followed by a hidden context message carrying the current local time, so the model knows when you sent it. The switch is remembered per conversation.

title: guokecloud/dsh-session-janitor
description: Lists DSH session records and archive caches on a sidebar page, moves deletions into a restorable recycle bin, and refuses sessions written within the last 10 minutes.

title: GuYou9799/dsh-turn-sieve
description: Prune low-value exchanges or single messages from a session: select them inline in the chat, drop them from the model-visible surface and the transcript, undo in one step.

title: hagen666/dsh-topic-graph
description: Splits a session into turns and incrementally clusters them into named topics and stages, with per-topic token / tool / time stats, a workflow view, a turn timeline, a relation graph and per-turn AI analysis.

title: Hai-Story/dsh-conversation-tools
description: Star conversation exchanges and edit any sent user message in the native composer while keeping previous conversation versions. Supports DSH 0.2.2-rc.1.

title: hajimimaodie8/DSH-Session-Sync
description: Bidirectionally synchronize sessions, workspaces, settings and plugins between the DSH web instance and the DSH Desktop instance.

title: Han-Yao94/dsh-session-toolkit
description: Consolidated toolkit for session identity, global & workspace prompts with referenced files, session auto-resume, UAC-free web restart, and peer-session messaging.

title: HanYu-me/dsh-prompt-booster
description: Prompt booster for the composer. Left-click the composer button and the draft is lightly polished and replaced in place (undoable, no popup). Right-click opens a menu with 8 built-in modes plus your own, where each mode's template can be edited or new modes added (saved on the host), and the model used for the rewrite is picked from the live dsh model list. Other modes show a before/after preview. Based on rongxingda/dsh-prompt-enhance (Apache-2.0); do not install both — both add a composer button and share Ctrl+Alt+E, so disable one of them if the upstream is present.

title: HanYu-me/dsh-talk-pages
description: Conversation map for the DeepSeek Harness web GUI: one page per workspace, conversation cards placed freely, links between cards, named and colored boxes that group conversations, high/medium/low priority marks, a picker for which conversations (archived ones included) are on the map, and a file-based API so another conversation can rearrange the map.

title: haoranwang0921/dsh-session-cleaner
description: Manage conversation records from the DSH web GUI settings page: delete a whole session (archive plus physical log removal) or a single message (deleting a user message cascades to its assistant replies and tool results). Running and current sessions are protected.

title: HarryHeYu/dsh-sessionflow
description: Continues work across coding agents inside DeepSeek Harness: six sessionflow_* tools query a local session index built by sessionFlow to find past work, show where the current project left off, and hand the goal, files and open items to the next agent. Requires the separate sessionFlow core, installed from its GitHub repo. Everything stays local — no cloud, no telemetry.

title: Harzva/dsh-restart-autoresume
description: Adds confirmed DSH restart actions and durable automatic continuation for eligible top-level sessions through an existing compatible dsh-restart Host provider.

title: Harzva/dsh-supervisor
description: Per-session supervision with role assignments and handoff workflows; off until enabled with /supervise. Requires @harzva/dsh-role-registry 0.1.0-alpha.1 (not on npm) installed first from its GitHub tag archive.

title: hasan-aghayev/dsh-session-resilience
description: Adds DSH restart and stop controls with token-aware reconnect and policy-based recovery for interrupted web sessions.

title: hbgdjb/dsh-session-shield
description: Guards session logs from malformed model tool calls (empty id/name, non-string arguments) so a bad call can never make a session unloadable.

title: HCQM/dsh-session-merge
description: Merges, appends, and repairs DSH session logs: eleven modes for copying events between sessions, computing compaction cut points, clearing a broken parent link, and validating the result against DSH's own loader.

title: heartmove/dsh-session-bridge
description: Session bridge for DeepSeek Harness: drive other real DSH sessions straight from your prompt — create top-level sessions in any workspace, message or steer any session, wait for replies and stream them segment-by-segment (chain-of-thought included), resume offline sessions, find sessions across workspaces, run a background watchdog that monitors and schedules a main task (nudge when stalled, correct drift, cancel when stuck), and archive sessions with one command.

title: heartmove/dsh-side-chat
description: Select part of a conversation and ask about it in a right-side side chat; bring AI replies back to the main chat directly or as a summary.

title: Heeweelee/dsh-session-plugin
description: Recall previously sent messages in the input box with Up/Down, and archive a workspace session from its right-click menu.

title: heiheiha798/dsh-plugin-subagent-delete
description: Ownership-checked tools and HTTP routes to list, release and permanently delete subagent sessions, with automatic web UI refresh after deletion.

title: hellodigua/dsh-share
description: Share your conversations with one click.

title: hellokidder/dsh-hotkey
description: Keyboard navigation for the DSH Web GUI: hold Control for 1-9 conversation numbers in the sidebar, Control+Tab to cycle, Control+J to jump to any conversation from a panel that also lists collapsed and not-yet-rendered ones, double-tap Option for clickable hints, and Option+Enter to focus the composer.

title: helo060228/dsh-chat-search
description: Cross-session and in-chat keyword search with context highlighting, keyboard navigation, and instant message jumping.

title: Hercules-debug/dsh-fork-map
description: Per-workspace Fork library: a bookmark on each finished assistant turn stores that turn boundary as a full compressed snapshot that survives deletion of the source session; a "Fork 库" conversation tab lists a workspace's forks as a tree (a fork saved from a launched session nests under its parent) with name, turn count, last question and answer, note and source link, and "从这里启动新会话" seeds a new session from any fork, repeatable. Each fork then names itself from its own context: the snapshot is replayed to the model with a naming request appended, and that exchange is never written into the snapshot or a session.

title: HERO476/dsh-conversation-recycle-bin
description: Delete a DSH conversation from its sidebar menu or the conversation header, optionally cascading into that conversation's associated memory nodes when you tick the box (the confirmation dialog shows the hit count before you commit); deletes land in a plugin recycle bin with restore, every action is appended to an audit log, and batch deletes are rate-limited with per-conversation rollback.

title: hhuapen/dsh-per-session-folder
description: Creates an isolated folder for each new default-workspace session and renames it to match the session title.

title: HildebrandYu/dsh-session-chains
description: Groups the sessions that hand off to each other into one chain in the DSH sidebar — automatic chain detection from the handoff prompt, per-chain numbering, in-place rename, search, drag and multi-select to re-chain, pinning a chain to the top, archiving chains out of the sidebar into a panel-only archive, a per-session context/steps readout, and configurable handoff thresholds that can trigger an automatic handoff (write the next prompt, open a new session, paste it, switch over).

title: Hjdd14/dsh-toolong-warning
description: Counts completed compactions per session in a floating window and warns only after repeated compactions plus extra token spend or high context occupancy, with all three thresholds adjustable in Settings.

title: hkkz9522/dsh-session-manager
description: DeepSeek Harness session and workspace manager —— Workspaces: archive and visibility. Sessions: move, migrate presets, delete, favorite, review later, prioritize, tag, and annotate. Batch operations.

title: hoist-wen/dsh-trajectory-tool-insight
description: Adds an Insight tab next to the conversation and trajectory tabs in DSH: calls a model to interpret tool calls turn by turn, and supports a custom prompt.

title: homily707/dsh-session-header
description: Injects an x-session-id HTTP header carrying the harness session id onto every LLM provider request, plus whitelisted gateway fetches during tool execution.

title: hongdougao111/dsh-archive-trash
description: Deletes any DSH session from its sidebar row, in bulk, or through a settings panel — into a recoverable trash, with ghost entries pruned automatically.

title: hongdougao111/dsh-power-switch
description: Adds a power button to the session header with two actions, each requiring a second click to confirm. Restart terminates the Electron main process itself (taskkill /F without /T), so no crash dialog appears: the host then exits gracefully on its own once the IPC channel drops, and a detached helper relaunches the same executable after the single-instance lock is released, confirming the new instance by a real window handle. Shut down does the same without relaunching. Leftover GPU and renderer processes from the previous run are reaped best-effort. Windows desktop app.

title: hoshF/dsh-md-export
description: Export the current session to clean Markdown from a button in the session header, through the native save dialog, with a CLI and an HTTP route over the same renderer; reads session logs directly (formats v0, v3 and v4) and declares no @deepseek-ai peer dependencies.

title: hotheat/dsh-recent-sessions
description: Adds a collapsible Recent list to the bottom of the DSH Web sidebar: sessions from every workspace sorted by last activity, filtering empty, archived and subagent sessions, with the host status dots and ten more rows per click.

title: hoyyang/dsh-concise
description: One-click Concise output style for DeepSeek Harness: results first, no filler, same work depth. Every final reply opens with a plain-language digest card (select text to copy); file paths inside the card are highlighted and click-to-open with the OS default app, and a deliverables zone lists the files the turn actually produced from real tool outputs. Scoped per session, works in headless/CLI too, with /concise command, style.md overrides and a local API.

title: hoyyang/dsh-manage-sessions
description: Native-feeling session manager: bulk archive/restore/hard-delete, two-stage force-stop with auto-resume, and instant copy-workspace-path.

title: hoyyang/dsh-smart-compact
description: Context window auto-management for DeepSeek Harness: when the window fills up it rolls over to a fresh one with zero summarization model calls, archiving the old window verbatim for line-by-line recall; handoff anchors carry task orientation, working notes survive compaction, and a stale-notes gate warns instead of vouching for outdated notes. The trigger follows the provider budget equation (window - max_tokens) and the real routed model even after a mid-session switch. One-click composer button plus /smart-compact, three-band automatic rollover, mandatory anchor sanitization; works out of the box.

title: HrxSpace/dsh-session-sweeper
description: Scan, view, and safely clean local AI terminal session histories (Claude Code, Codex CLI, WorkBuddy, DSH) from a settings card — quarantine-first with SHA-256 manifests, one-click restore, audit log, and phrase-confirmed hard delete.

title: ht719/dsh-session-categories
description: Adds per-Workspace category trees to the Web sidebar, with nested categories, drag-and-drop session assignment, category-scoped session creation, and category deletion that archives contained sessions.

title: huajikano/dsh-gatekeeper
description: Inspects the model's streamed reply before it is committed and either discards it or holds it for review when it reads as a refusal, so that text does not stay in the session context. Detection combines built-in phrase rules (an opening refusal, a capability denial, policy wording, first-person intent, refusals quoted in reasoning) with a plain-text word list and optional regular expressions. Interception can sit at the llm/stream waterfall, at the HTTP fetch layer before encryption (not TLS decryption, and it cannot tell which session a call belongs to), at both, or in a preview mode that shows a transient preview while the original chunks stay in memory until the whole reply has been checked. The same plugin also guards tool calls on tools/pre-execute: a command that deletes a drive, filesystem or user-profile root, formats or repartitions a volume, empties the Recycle Bin, fetches and executes a remote script, or writes to a raw device is denied, and a recursive delete outside build directories is recorded by default. Each tier can be set to deny, ask, record, or off, and the disk guard has its own switch. Both halves are heuristics: they can miss phrasings, the disk guard sees the arguments of a call rather than what a running script does, and they fail open.

title: huajuan2024/dsh-session-manager
description: Session manager panel under Settings → Plugins: list all sessions with title, cwd, agent preset, updated time, turns and steps, expand a row to view message history, delete non-running sessions, and export a session as JSON or Markdown via a browser Blob URL.

title: huang13113/dsh-web-share
description: Read-only export of a chat.deepseek.com conversation into a new DSH session: builds a hand-off pack with the selected rounds kept verbatim and earlier rounds collapsed to one line each, then pre-fills the composer without sending it. Windows only as published (package.json os=win32); requires Edge or Chrome and a one-time chat.deepseek.com login.

title: huangxp12/dsh-recent-sessions
description: Lists recent sessions across every workspace in one panel, with time grouping, two sort orders, content search, reveal-in-file-manager, and local notes that offer to insert themselves into the draft.

title: Hugo16/dsh-session-rotate-on-compact
description: Rotate the outbound LLM session ID after each successful DSH compaction without creating a new DSH session.

title: huguangyu666/dsh-plugin-session-import
description: Import claude-code / codex / reasonix / zcode chat history into dsh sessions: workspace binding, tool calls preserved, oversized-session protection, zcode compaction restore.

title: HuiHuitie-zhu/dsh-incognito
description: Incognito sessions: a standalone ephemeral sub-agent with its own preset (no parent context) and full toolset, draggable floating window, burned to zero traces on close.

title: Hungry-M/dsh-deepseek-import
description: Imports chats captured from chat.deepseek.com by the repo's companion Edge extension (loaded unpacked in Edge) into DeepSeek Harness as new sessions; thinking is saved as a sidecar thinking.md, and trimmed, branched or very long chats also get the full transcript.md.

title: hunyu-feng/dsh-context-handoff
description: Live context-pressure meter in the composer dock. When usage nears the limit it asks the current model for a handoff brief, starts that brief in a fresh session and switches you there, so long work can continue without hitting the window.

title: hwangjunjie/dsh-session-move
description: Move a session to another folder, permanently delete it, or AI-rename it from the Web UI — by dragging a session row onto a folder title or from the session menu. Moving rewrites the session header cwd, relocates the persisted log and updates workspace accounting so history travels with it; deleting stops running agents and removes the log, projection-cache row and workspace accounting. The same three operations ship as agent tools: workbench_session_move, workbench_session_delete and workbench_session_rename_ai.

title: hyzyn/dsh-plugin-kit#search
description: Full-text global search for the DSH Web GUI: a sidebar search box that searches history sessions (via the sessionQuery index, with a per-session scan fallback) and settings panels, highlights matches, and jumps to the matching session or settings card.

title: hzh5021/dsh-qq-voice
description: Mounts a per-channel speaking-rules file into the QQ preset's system prompt only, so that channel answers in one or two lines while every other channel stays untouched. Does nothing until home points at a folder with the rules file (default QQ线口径.md); meant for the QQ preset, not the global plugin list.

title: i1j/context-assembler-DSH
description: Context Assembler plugin for DeepSeek Harness: topic-block context assembly, water-pressure topic splitting, tool trace/rewrite, reality recall injection and handoff planning.

title: iamwuzhanglin/dsh-session-recycler
description: Delete a conversation record from the DeepSeek Harness Web UI, with a trash bin to restore or purge it. Both this and zhezhi33/dsh-session-recycler install under the package name dsh-session-recycler, so install only one of them.

title: icanfinish11/dsh-context-mode
description: DeepSeek Harness adapter for Context Mode: in-process ctx_* tools for sandboxed code execution and an FTS5 knowledge base, plus context-window routing guidance.

title: Icstick/dsh-context-maid
description: Context curation for DeepSeek Harness: content-aware tool-output slimming, dead-log sweep, pinned user requirements and in-flight work, archive-then-compact with an audit trail.

title: idealclover/dsh-session-title-studio
description: Configurable session titles with custom prompts, refresh policies, local topic-drift detection, and single-session or historical title regeneration.

title: idoall/dsh-session-colors
description: Give any Session a colour mark, shown as a chip in the sidebar and picked from the conversation header; marks are stored on the Host, so a colour chosen on one device is visible on every other one.

title: ijry/DeepSeek-Harness-Desktop-Ultra#dsh-plugin-canvas
description: Infinite canvas for sessions, with regions bound to workspaces and agent presets, pinned session cards, sticky notes and alignment guides.

title: IKEASven69/dsh-takeover
description: Session takeover: read-only pull local sessions from nine external agents (Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, ZCode, Pi, WorkBuddy, Cursor, Grok, Gemini CLI) into distilled six-section handoff cards — one click on the Relay chip takes over. /handoff checks the current session into the handoff: 1 open-protocol inbox (~/.handoff, consume-once with machine-signature tamper detection); any agent picks up on start and continues. Memory files ride with cards; cross-machine relay is one env var away.

title: imcaibaicai/dsh-auto-continue-inturn
description: When a turn is truncated by max-tokens, keeps the model writing inside the same turn instead of ending it with the warning bar and waiting for a manual continue; after a per-turn limit it hands over to cross-turn auto-continue plugins.

title: imcaibaicai/dsh-conversation-log
description: Mirrors every session to a standalone readable Markdown file plus a JSONL twin whose name carries date, time and topic, keeps a searchable index beside them, and adds a settings-page search and a model recall tool.

title: imcaibaicai/dsh-message-revert
description: A revert button on every sent message: on confirm it returns that message's text and attachments to the composer, rolls the session back to before that step and restores workspace files to their captured before-content.

title: imcaibaicai/dsh-session-ref-unlimit
description: Lifts the built-in cap of three @ referenced sessions per message by rewriting the reference resolver's config after it is instantiated, defaulting to 8 with an aggregate context budget guard; no app.asar changes.

title: imlishiyuan/keep-reminder
description: Injects the contents of a .keep-reminder file from the session working directory as a system-reminder, with three modes: once per session, first step of every turn, or every request.

title: imrascal/dsh-archive
description: DeepSeek Harness plugin that manages archived sessions and the trash from the settings panel.

title: imshz6669/dsh-split-chat
description: Opens any session as a second full chat tab in the right sidebar, with its own transcript and composer, while the main conversation stays put; a split right pane allows up to three concurrent conversations.

title: imtwa/dsh-recall-sessions
description: A lightweight plugin that decompresses and reads past sessions, so a new session can read what an earlier conversation contained, in milliseconds per read. `/recall` lists the sessions of the current project with title, last activity, turn count and first prompt; `/recall <number>` reads back the turns of that session; `/recall all` covers every project; the model can also be asked in natural language to query with the `recall_sessions` tool.

title: Imzl-zl/dsh-redo
description: Adds Regenerate and Edit and resend to each message you already sent: Regenerate re-answers the same text in one click without going through the composer; Edit and resend retracts that message and everything after it in place — out of the transcript and out of the model context, in the same session with no new branch — then puts its text and images back into the composer, so the edited send rewrites the conversation from that point. Messages carrying files rather than images stay disabled.

title: ingk888766-cloud/dsh-manage-deletion
description: Delete sessions, optionally with the files each session wrote; deletions go to a trash that lists them by time and restores one or many; a session with a running turn is refused and nothing outside that session folder is touched.

title: ishuowang/dsh-rolehub-bridge
description: Discover and verify portable RoleHub roles, pin each exact bundle, then launch its prompt and bundled skills in an isolated, continuable DSH Session with Host-approved tool bindings and optional Agent Team Room attachment.

title: ishuowang/dsh-sideband
description: Hand off focused context without waiting for or interrupting the active Agent: freeze a bounded Session snapshot, summarize it asynchronously with an isolated no-tool LLM, and deliver a provenance-bearing capsule to another Session or an authorized Room—quiet by default for Sessions, with explicit wakeup available.

title: iStarryDust/dsh-edit-regen
description: Edit and regenerate: adds an edit action to user message bubbles, regenerating from that message with images and files carried over and the original model inherited.

title: itchenshi/dsh-gui-last-session
description: Reopens the conversation you were last in after restarting DeepSeek Harness, by keeping a pointer file under the DSH home directory instead of patching engine files.

title: iu3o3/dsh-archived-sessions
description: Manage and delete archived DSH conversations: a Settings page lists every archived session with per-row and bulk delete, and the sidebar session menu gains a Delete row next to Unarchive. Deletion is real — the session log, its projection cache and both indexes are cleaned up, not just an unarchive.

title: jackxiao17/dsh-session-cleaner
description: Adds Delete to the DSH sidebar session menu, moving the session — and its whole descendant tree when it has subagents — into a recycle bin that relocates the directory on disk (an atomic rename, never a copy), plus a sidebar bin panel with title and full-text search, workspace filter, sorting, per-session chat-log viewer, restore and permanent delete. Deleting also clears the workspace slot, the pin, the archive flag and the projection-cache row, so a restore puts the session back at its original sidebar position; permanent deletion also clears the schedules bound to it and removes the emptied project directory. Verified on DeepSeek Harness 0.2.1-rc.2, with a whole-profile residue scan coming back clean.

title: JanEickholt/dsh-asc
description: Model-driven context compaction for DeepSeek Harness. The agent decides when and what to compress, commits durable session-log replacements, and ships reversible tool-result compression with byte-exact hash retrieval.

title: jarvisluk/dsh-projectless-session
description: Adds a Session without workspace entry to the DSH Workspace picker, creates isolated date-organized directories, and keeps started sessions resumable under Ungrouped.

title: Jason-skd/dsh-session-fork
description: Git-style conversation branching that mirrors how real programmers collaborate: a secretary root branch dispatches tasks to child branches with their own contexts, merging back only compressed summaries via squash or rebase; ships /branch commands, a branch tab, branch-to-branch messaging, and a governance baseline pairing each session branch with a git worktree.

title: Jason25417/dsh-session-auto-rename
description: Adds an Auto-rename row to each Session sidebar menu: the model reads the Session log, weights recent user messages higher (exponential decay, 3-day time constant), and writes a title of at most 10 CJK characters into the Session title. Also opens that Session menu on right-click, and exposes the same operation as the session_auto_rename agent tool. Requires DSH 0.2.1-rc.5 or newer.

title: JasonQQ/dsh-btw-plugin
description: Codex-style /btw command: answer side questions in a conversation-seeded subagent (fork provider), rendered in the UI without entering the main session history.

title: jasonrale/dsh-archive-manager
description: Archived-session manager for DSH Web UI: reopen an archived session and keep chatting, unarchive it back in place, or hard-delete a session — grouped panel with message search and native view sync.

title: Jaylor-Wang/dsh-tool-result-trimmer
description: Eager, tail-heavy, line-aware tool result trimmer plugin: hooks into post-execution pipeline to trim oversized command outputs with smart semantic reducers and ANSI stripping.

title: Jaylor-Wang/dsh-tool-session-delete
description: Adds a Delete session action to the sidebar context menu behind a confirmation modal reporting log size and live activity, cleanly unlinking log files, projection checkpoints, and host memory registrations.

title: JayYuen666/dsh-session-rescue
description: Automatic recovery when a turn ends badly: resume after a transient failure, continue after output truncation, re-run after an unfinished todo list, plus a request-level 429 backstop and a client dock with edit-resend, manual retry and stop-and-re-ask.

title: jermaine123123/agent-context-editor#deepseek-harness
description: Agent Context Editor is a cross-agent plugin for manually excluding, editing, and selectively compressing AI conversation context. It also supports searching, filtering, selecting, hiding, restoring, and undoing conversation changes while preserving the original Session.

title: Jesse-njx/dsh-crosstalk
description: Cross-session messaging for DSH: any session on the machine can list and message any other, Claude Code-style, via a local heartbeat registry and inbox.

title: JessenReinhart/dsh-plugin-btw
description: Adds /btw and /side slash commands that answer ephemeral side questions in an isolated forked sub-session without polluting the main conversation context.

title: JessenReinhart/dsh-snapcompact
description: Bitmap-frame context compression plugin for DeepSeek Harness: renders discarded conversation history into pixel-font PNG frames for vision-capable models.

title: JessenReinhart/dsh-time-context
description: Injects the exact current local time and the timestamp, day relation and recency gap of the previous user message into every prompt, and adds a /time command that prints the injected block.

title: Jessicaisleep/dsh-dsml-guard
description: Strips DSML markers that leak into assistant prose and resumes a turn only when a "continue" genuinely helps — a no-output marker leak, local or upstream network blips, a single-reply output token cap (max-tokens), and empty or stream errors — with message-level classification for codes upstream miscategorises and a default cap of 3 consecutive failures that any normal reply resets; quota, rate-limit, auth and context-window errors, and user aborts, never resume. Requires DSH 0.2.1-rc.2 or newer, below 0.3.0, and Node 20 or newer.

title: Jessicaisleep/dsh-wm-toolkit
description: Session and message surgery in one plugin: recall or edit prompts and replies (reasoning included), regenerate from the original prompt, delete any turn at the model-context level, and archive, delete, move or migrate sessions across workspaces. Targets DSH 0.1.5 and 0.2.x, verified on 0.2.1-rc.3. A combined fork of three MIT plugins (dsh-message-recall from Jipcon/DSH-plugins, dsh-session-manager from hkkz9522, dsh-delete-turn from DDDMUC) with added reply editing, regeneration and workspace migration. Do not enable it together with those plugins or other session movers or message deleters.

title: jiahaozhang516-svg/caopazi-compact
description: Compacts a session at 70% context and appends mechanically extracted anchors — first user message, hard requirements, paths, commands, error codes and unresolved items — to the summary; it reuses DSH built-in compaction-basic and adds a /compact-status command.

title: jiahaozhang516-svg/caopazi-marks
description: Bookmark a passage or a whole message in a conversation and jump back to it with one click.

title: jiangyuxue666/dsh-conversation-tree
description: Workspace-wide conversation tree for DeepSeek Harness: every conversation and branch on one canvas with its source turn, own token usage and notes; compare two branches, bring a summary back, export a Markdown outline, archive (undoable through DSH's native archive), and delete a whole subtree (macOS and Windows only; deletion runs immediately and is permanent).

title: jianyuepei/dsh-session-mindmap
description: Turns a DSH session into a self-contained interactive HTML mind map of its topics, conclusions, decisions, todos and open questions, and reports what changed since the previous run.

title: jingleboat/dsh-session-cleaner-host
description: Deletes a whole conversation from the sidebar session menu, and opens a right-click menu on a chat text selection with Copy, Quote (insert a Markdown quote block into the composer) and Ask: Ask sends the selection plus your question to one reused continuable subagent (label `ask`, found again through the subagent catalog after a restart) and streams the answer into the right sidebar.

title: JinYihang1011/dsh-plugins#dsh-session-ops
description: Adds three actions to the sidebar session row menu: open the workspace location, move the session to another workspace, and delete the session to the Recycle Bin.

title: Jisiyong-A/dsh-plugin-background-compaction
description: Precomputes the compaction summary in the background and commits the held result when pressure compaction fires, removing the foreground model round-trip. Registers itself as the session compaction engine, pins the span it summarised so the payload fingerprint still matches at commit time, prunes tool results before committing, and falls back to the stock foreground path on payload drift or context overflow.

title: jkzing/dsh-session-profiler
description: Adds an analysis tab to each session that draws it as a timeline: swim-lane tracks by category, a flame graph, and per-category and per-tool timing statistics for model calls, tool calls and background processes. Running sessions refresh live, and extra lanes can be defined with regex rules in the plugin config.

title: JMILI/dsh-seesion-copy-enhance
description: Copy a user message together with its images and files, then paste it into any session: the text lands in the composer and each attachment is rebuilt through the official createDrafts/addAttachments path, so it uploads and sends like a normal draft.

title: JoblessJoe/smart-compaction
description: Lets the model trigger compaction itself at a safe point via a compact_now tool (works mid-turn), plus a context_status tool reporting real token usage against the session's actual context window.

title: JochenYang/dsh-rewind-plugin
description: Recall a message you already sent: the session log stays append-only and nothing is deleted, while the recalled turns leave the model context and the transcript, the text returns to the composer, and the files those turns changed wait in a quarantine you can review and clear from its own settings page.

title: jockerbear/dsh-workspace-migrate
description: Workspace-scoped DSH migration: package a project's conversations, files and attachments, restore them on another machine into a chosen root with historical absolute paths rewritten, and re-sync only what changed afterwards.

title: Joe-0202/dsh-archive-manager
description: Two-tab archive panel (archived / active) where every row offers archive or unarchive next to permanent delete; each row shows its bound workspace folder as a clickable path, and queued archive-entry cleanup keeps a deleted session from resurfacing in the active list.

title: john-walks-slow/dsh-message-datetime
description: One-line clock context for DeepSeek Harness: a Current time timestamp reading (weekday, date, time, UTC offset, IANA timezone) opens every conversation turn and a Turn ended reading closes it, so the model always knows the time, date and idle gap across turns without asking.

title: john-walks-slow/dsh-session-prefix
description: Auto-classify DeepSeek Harness sessions via Jev decision models or Agent tools, displayed as title emoji prefixes (wip 🚧, blocked ⏸️, review 👀, done ✅, plan 💡, bug 🐛). Features seamless lifecycle recovery, optional Jev inference (needs a Jev API key), model tool maintenance, and a visual settings panel.

title: JohnshyCY/dsh-session-active-top
description: Floats conversations that are currently running to the top of their workspace session list, and keeps them there after they finish.

title: joyboy-yy/dsh-archive-purge
description: Force-hides archived sessions from the DSH sidebar whatever the view filter is set to, and adds a panel that restores them or deletes them permanently - session log directory, archive and pin records, and projection cache.

title: JRJRJPRO/dsh-chat-tree
description: Draws every branch of a conversation as a clickable tree beside the chat, with favorites, custom icons and colors, branch merge and split, rewind-aware layout, and Claude Code branches that keep their memory.

title: jujiujiang222-cell/dsh-archive-sessions
description: Archived-session manager: an "Archived Sessions" settings page that lists archived sessions and lets you restore or permanently delete each one (two-step confirmation).

title: juliiiiiiiu/session-stickies-manage-your-attention
description: Session-specific sticky cards with optional, explicitly authorized agent follow-ups. Targets the DSH desktop/web profile (protocol 0.2.2-rc.1); installed from GitHub.

title: JungleYXu/dsh-dossier
description: Volumes and handoffs for DeepSeek Harness: group sessions per project and hand state to a fresh session through a generated handoff document instead of replaying context.

title: Justin-Mai/dsh-role-prompts
description: Adds job-role prompts to the DSH composer: type - at the start of the input to pick a role, which becomes a reference chip in the draft and is then injected as a system prompt section on every turn of that conversation, so the instruction keeps applying without showing up in the transcript. Roles are added and edited on a Settings page and stored in ~/.dsh/dsh-role-prompts.md.

title: jwang513/dsh-stuck-monitor
description: Passive recorder that replays the main agent and every subagent on one timeline, flags repeated calls, loops, recurring errors and truncated output, and writes an AI cause-and-effect review on demand.

title: Kadima-code/dsh-session-mirror
description: Per-conversation backup for DSH: incremental session mirroring, fuzzy restore (preview then confirm), and rule-based cleanup with a 7-day recycle bin.

title: kagurazakayashi/dsh-delete-session
description: Adds a Delete session item to the sidebar session-row menu; the confirmation mode is configurable (click again, confirm in a dialog, or delete immediately) and a session that is running a task is refused.

title: kaieye/dsh-AIR
description: Web composer enhancement: recalls sent prompts across sessions with ArrowUp/ArrowDown, searches them with Ctrl+R, restores rich drafts, and opens a docked /btw or /side conversation.

title: kanchengw/dsh-assembly.resume
description: Import local Codex CLI/Desktop, Claude Code CLI, and Claude Desktop conversations into DSH with project grouping, semantic history, and tool activity; bind an existing or replacement workspace and continue with the DSH Agent.

title: kanmanJO/dsh-cross-session-ref
description: Cross-session reference cards: drag a Q&A card out of any session into another one and it stays there; when you ask a question in the target session, the dragged cards' question, the answer it got at the time and its attachments are injected into the prompt as earlier conversation context, so the model can quote them directly.

title: kennethfan/dsh-session-fold
description: Folds older oversized tool results into spill files and replaces them with short, deterministic stubs at step boundaries, with no LLM call: the stub keeps the first 200 and last 80 characters plus the sequence number, tool name, line/char/size counts and the original file path, and each fold is a real surface replacement accompanied by compaction/prune shadow pricing so token counts stay honest. Triggers on context pressure at 25% of the model window (falling back to 32768 tokens when the window cannot be resolved) or on five accumulated candidates; the last three turns, error results and rich content are never folded. The original is recovered from the session log rather than the spill file, so /folds, /unfold <seq> and /unfold all keep working after spill cleanup; session_fold_recall lets the model fetch a folded result by sequence number or by keyword, and session_fold_diagnose reports the effective settings. /spill-prune removes orphaned spill directories, preview only unless --apply. A Settings page exposes 12 of the 13 options as draft-then-save fields; they are volatile, so saved changes apply without restarting the plugin.

title: kevenliu3/dhs-plugins#dsh-session-monitor
description: Sidebar badge and panel that aggregate per-session pending, running, and completed states across workspaces, with one click to open a session.

title: KhalilJar/Remu-desktop-shortcuts
description: Keyboard shortcuts for DSH Desktop: return to the conversation, focus the composer, switch pages, open DevTools, and an Alt+Tab style session switcher that previews sessions while Alt is held and switches on release (DSH NEXT on Windows).

title: kialajin-l/DSH_Plus#dsh-codex-import
description: Import Codex and Claude Code session history into DeepSeek Harness: merges same-project sessions into existing workspaces by cwd, offers handoff summaries or full transcripts, and keeps a rollback ledger.

title: kialajin-l/DSH_Plus#dsh-session-move
description: Moves DSH sessions between workspaces with validation of live/subagent/offline states and automatic backups of every move under ~/.dsh/session-move-backups/.

title: kialajin-l/DSH_Plus#dsh-session-tools
description: Session utilities: Markdown export and dependency-free batch ZIP export, a timeline overlay for jumping between turns, safe session duplication that rewrites internal identity fields, and sidebar right-click menu extension points.

title: kiligzzz/dsh-session-archive
description: Sidebar panel for archived sessions in DeepSeek Harness: group by workspace, search by title, preview user questions, one-click restore, or delete with confirmation.

title: kiligzzz/dsh-session-nav
description: Piano-key style in-conversation navigation bar: one key per user message, hover preview tooltip, click-to-jump across full history. Official dual-face dsh plugin, no dsh source changes.

title: kinggod899/dsh-reply-forge-v3
description: Edits assistant replies and thinking chains in DSH sessions so the model sees the edited text, live via message projection or on disk.

title: kira905/dsh-butler-archive
description: DSH web plugin that browses, previews, restores and deletes archived sessions that were moved out of the sessions directory.

title: kira905/dsh-session-title-live
description: Live session-title provider for dsh that regenerates the title after every user message, summarizing the most recent messages within a byte budget.

title: kirkchinese/CiteCiter#citeciter
description: Select text in a committed DSH response to open an independent, persistent, read-only multi-turn Topic bound to source-session evidence and project files while the source Agent keeps running.

title: kirkchinese/claude2dsh
description: Import Claude Code sessions, skills and plugin assets into DSH as native resumable sessions, and export or sync DSH sessions back to Claude Code JSONL.

title: KissBlank/dsh-session-manager
description: Purge DSH sessions for good and manage them from one console: per-session deletion, a filterable bulk console, and housekeeping sweeps.

title: kittimzhe/dsh-session-eval
description: Retrospective agent-session evaluation — grades the sessions that already happened: deterministic grade cards, regression diffs, /eval-history trends, and /eval --report straight from exported artifacts; no benchmark runs, no LLM judges.

title: kittimzhe/dsh-session-export
description: Evidence-grade reports beyond a plain export: /transcript writes styled HTML/Markdown/JSON with Mermaid lineage, editor diffs and a turn timeline; /stats prints a cost-aware card; /archive packs the raw JSONL with a metadata manifest, while /transcript --manifest and /bundle add the SHA-256 evidence manifest — full history, any backend.

title: kittimzhe/dsh-session-recall
description: Deterministic cross-session transcript retrieval: the `recall` tool full-text searches past session logs with cwd-scoped authorization, a CJK substring fallback and a degraded raw-scan; every hit carries the sessionId plus the newest exported-report path, closing the loop with the export and eval plugins.

title: kkkkk-tubu/dsh-deep-purge
description: Actually delete DSH sessions instead of archiving them (Windows only). Clears all six on-disk locations (transcript, title cache, billion-context SQLite index with VACUUM, workspace registry, cost-meter ledger, bridge logs) with a dry run, a backup, byte-for-byte rollback, and an automatic quit-delete-relaunch flow.

title: kkwalking/dsh-stall-guard
description: Watches the turn endings of the models you select and asks a second model whether the turn was actually finished: if the assistant stopped after text with no tool call, a three-way verdict of continue, finished or uncertain is recorded and shown in a sidebar panel. In suggest mode it only reports; in auto-continue mode it calls agent.followup() once the turn is idle to send a continuation message, up to a per-turn limit. Single-step turns are always rechecked, watched models can be picked exactly or matched by case-insensitive regex, and the resume text is configurable.

title: kumiiwaka/dsh-intercom
description: An intercom between already-open DSH windows. No teams, no new sessions, just peer-to-peer messages with a hop limit.

title: KunKun24/dsh-fold-delete
description: Collapse older messages in long conversations and permanently delete sessions you no longer need.

title: Kyf-eng/dsh-threads
description: Claude-style projects and threads: a project's main conversation opens threads (real sessions you can open and talk to) for self-contained tasks, runs up to 3 at once by default, optionally each in its own git worktree, and gets each thread's report back.

title: kyle123740/dsh-message-recall
description: Adds hover Recall / Delete / Delete-onward actions to every message row: removes content from the model context and the transcript together via durable append-only tombstones, with an empty-content guard so old deletions can never break strict providers. Tested on the DSH 2.0 desktop.

title: L7X6899/dsh-Session-Turncate
description: Idle-time context truncation for a single DeepSeek Harness session. After a configurable number of idle hours the older conversation is dropped without a summary, so one long-lived session cannot leak one task into the next; it ships a per-session toggle, a tab next to the chat, and a /truncate command that IM bridges can drive.

title: lacemou/dsh-session-ref
description: Cross-session reference (mention) plugin — paste @[label](dsh-session:…) into any session, including one in another workspace, and the host injects the referenced session snapshot for the model to read; includes a one-click copy-reference button.

title: lamost423/dsh-maze
description: Execution maze for DSH sessions: the agent's real path — main advance, failed or dead-end detours, backtracks, request retries and subagent branches — drawn on one wall-clock timeline, with three tracks under each lane sharing that axis (tool-call density, token pulse, context pressure) and a deterministic analysis panel below it (tool result matrix, failure-recovery chains, duration distribution); watch it grow live in a session tab, or upload up to 5 session logs for a same-axis compare.

title: lanscer/dsh-workspace-drag
description: Drag a conversation onto any workspace group in the sidebar to relocate it between DSH workspaces, updating its cwd, disk location and registry ownership.

title: Leawind/dsh-rice-on-a-stick
description: Rice on a Stick: Expose control over DeepSeek Harness (dsh) through MCP (Streamable HTTP) and dsh's native tools, with a configurable list of allowed models. Long-tail host endpoints can be invoked via a generic, audited bridge. By default, it listens only on 127.0.0.1, with an optional access token.

title: Leeminjing/dsh-messages-sanitizer
description: Auto-repairs the messages array after a tool-dispatch crash (orphaned tool_calls / tool messages), preventing 400 INVALID_REQUEST session lock-ups.

title: leoan698-tom/dsh-sessivra
description: Sessivra: drag sessions into resizable split views, insert native @ references into drafts, exchange linked replies and review delegated work before queued follow-ups. npm package dsh-plugin-sessivra.

title: leogottadothebest/dsh-plugin-archived-conversations
description: Manage archived conversations in the Settings UI: unarchive them back to the sidebar, or permanently delete them with confirmation.

title: leoriczhao/dsh-session-butler
