description: Session management for DeepSeek Harness — an archived-chat list in Settings, permanent deletion from the session menu, and agent tools to list, inspect, create and fork sessions.

title: Lequait/dsh-context-rescue
description: Recovers a session the host already refused for exceeding the context window: it re-checks the gateway message the built-in classifier misses, takes the real window out of that message, and folds the oldest span into one checkpoint without a model call (tool-result pruning, the host compaction engine when it can shrink the projection, or a mechanical digest fold), then retries the failed step; a context_rescue tool and /rescue, /rescue-status expose the same path by hand.

title: LeslieWylie/dsh-session-search-pro
description: Search, list and read past and current sessions through the harness's own `sessionQuery` service: uses the SQLite FTS5 index where a deployment enables it, and falls back to a bounded newest-first scan where it does not.

title: LeslieWylie/dsh-task-relay
description: Cross-session task queue with handoff notes: sessions and subagents push, claim, complete and cancel tasks on a shared file-backed queue, and leave a handoff summary for whoever picks up next.

title: let-mi-think/wechat-agent-router
description: Route each WeChat group session to a different Agent preset by group name, reusing dsh-wechat-assistant without changing its code.

title: liangmianya/dsh-synapse
description: Visual, non-linear conversation workspace for DeepSeek Harness — sessions, follow-ups and branches become a browsable conversation map.

title: lifeopsgo/dsh-lark-session-monitor-plugin
description: Watches Feishu (Lark) conversations with your own user identity and forwards new messages as prompts into a chosen DeepSeek Harness session: per-monitor sender filters, @bot-mention bypass and keyword allow/block lists, auto-created pinned target sessions, and cursor-based polling that re-reads messages after a failed delivery.

title: light-cheng/dsh-strata
description: Layered context management: at each turn end older tool output becomes a deterministic card, the model can fold older ranges into its own summaries in up to three tiers (compress), and every original is archived locally for decompress and search_context. Works alongside DSH-Mem0: superseded runtime-context snapshots (such as recalled memories) are never archived, carded or folded, and are replaced by a one-line placeholder at turn end when the prompt cache is already broken, when the saving outweighs the cache miss, or above 75% of the window; a strataBudget service (pressure, allowance, countTokens) and a strata/fold-landed event are provided for other context plugins; strata_status warns when DSH's automatic compaction is off or its official summary keeps failing. Its L1 layer, archive rotation, prune guard and preset takeover are forked from dsh-live-compact 1.0.6 (MIT); uninstall dsh-live-compact or billion-context first — they replace the same compaction rows and Strata will not take over while either is installed.

title: Light-EI/dsh-ebbing-context
description: Layered context compression for DeepSeek Harness: folds old turns into model-written L1–L3 summary blocks, maps what each layer holds, and wakes the model when the context crosses a size line or keeps growing. By default it requires DSH's experimental Session Search plugin (session_event_read / session_event_search); without it the tools stay disabled unless requireSessionQuery is turned off.

title: lij0000-arch/dsh-workspace-migrate
description: Workspace-scoped DSH migration: package a project's conversations, files and attachments, restore them on another machine into a chosen root with historical absolute paths rewritten, and re-sync only what changed afterwards.

title: limbo947/dsh-recall-plugin
description: Recall any user message: rolls the conversation (official session fork) and workspace files (per-message shadow git snapshots) back to before it, with a diff-preview confirmation panel.

title: LingDangZaiXiang/dsh-always-there
description: Two triggers (a heartbeat and a log marker) that wake a session and let the agent decide whether to say anything; silence is a reply. Off by default: set sessionId (the target session) and enable it in the profile config, and if replies are forwarded to a chat app the send layer must drop the SILENT marker.

title: LINJJ749/dsh-one-click-session-delete
description: Adds one-click permanent Session deletion to the DeepSeek Harness Workspace sidebar: a row-hover trash button, a menu item, a confirmation dialog, live-Session protection, cascade deletion for derived Sessions, and cleanup of the session log directory, projection cache and workspace bookkeeping.

title: Linusteller/dsh-session-delete
description: Adds a red "Delete session" item beneath "Archive" in the sidebar session menu, with a custom confirmation dialog, for real session deletion — stops the session's running work, detaches its workspace, archive and pin accounting, removes its projection cache and log directory, then broadcasts removal so the row disappears at once, instead of only archiving it. Session deletion removes the conversation from disk permanently and cannot be undone.

title: LIQiang-IT/dsh-session-delete
description: Adds a "Delete session" action after "Archive session" that permanently removes one session: its log directory, rewind snapshots and projection-cache entry, its workspace/archive/pin registrations, schedules bound to it, and its rows in the chat-index and usage databases. A preview lists every target before anything is deleted; the same operation is exposed to agents as the session_delete tool with a dryRun option.

title: LittleGreyy/dsh-session-archaeology
description: Turns a past session into a reusable Skill offline: it extracts the verified steps, the files that were edited, failure/fix pairs and the final checks, each tagged with its session event number.

title: liufeicc/dsh-btw-command
description: Adds a /btw slash command that asks a side question or injects information into a running session without interrupting the main agent.

title: liufeicc/dsh-clear-command
description: Adds a /clear command that clears one conversation's model-visible context while keeping the session itself.

title: liufeicc/dsh-session-delete
description: Adds a Delete session action to the sidebar session menu, with a confirmation dialog and the host operation that permanently removes the session log.

title: liuhange789/dsh-session-recovery
description: Checkpoint-and-resume for interrupted runs: when a conversation reaches a key step — two consecutive successful file writes/edits, or one successful test command — it appends a lightweight record (timestamp, step type, tool, ≤200-char argument summary, result status) to a local JSONL file, keeping the newest 50 and pruning after 24 hours. After DSH restarts, the session_recovery tool lists unfinished sessions and resuming one creates a new session whose system prompt carries only the last three checkpoints (≤500 characters) instead of the full transcript.

title: liuyu-f/dsh-plugin-session-cascade-delete
description: Delete a session from the UI (session-header button or sidebar row menu) or with the session_delete tool: stops and releases a running agent and its live session first, then removes the log directory, projection cache and workspace accounting, and cascades into the subagent sessions it owns while leaving forked branches untouched.

title: liuyuelintop/dsh-conversation-exporter
description: Export the current DSH conversation, or selected turns, as clean readable Markdown.

title: Lizo-dsh/dsh-watchdog
description: Wakes a Session after the host restarts: an agent arms its own Session, and after the next boot the plugin delivers one message to it, then unregisters it.

title: ljp888/dsh-session-delete-next
description: Adds a Delete session action to the sidebar session menu that permanently deletes the local records of that session, while refusing sessions that are running.

title: LLL-lyh0/dsh-continue-guard
description: Adds a Continue button to the composer dock and resumes automatically when a turn is cut off by a network drop or an upstream output-limit cut. A resident link monitor asks every 10 seconds whether the network is back, because the link returning fires no event, and a turn that completes normally counts as proof the link works. The click goes through the host submission pipeline — beginSubmission plus session.prompt — so the message carries real user attribution instead of faking one, and a genuine refusal is reported rather than retried. On startup it also scans recent session logs for both fingerprints of a host that left mid-turn: an unclosed turn, and a turn closed as disposed, which is what a normal shutdown writes. A turn the user stopped by hand is never resumed.

title: lloggc-Dante/dsh-conversation-manager
description: Adds a red delete row to the sidebar session menu, plus a multi-select delete that confirms before running, and permanently removes the stored data behind a conversation — session directory and log, projection-cache record, workspace membership and pin.

title: lloydzhou/dsh-smart-compaction
description: Cache-first context compaction with an optional adaptive economic policy, observation-only by default, without cache-hit or cost-saving guarantees.

title: lmmcsb/dsh-turn-continue
description: Auto-continue a stalled turn: re-prompt after an empty turn, a max-tokens cutoff or a listed model error, and switch to a healthy backup route before retrying.

title: lolipop-1x1/dsh-recap
description: Summarizes the current DeepSeek Harness session with /recap or after inactivity, with configurable models, Chinese and English output, and expandable summaries in the conversation.

title: lonelycrab888/dsh-enhancement-switches
description: Adds switches for Ralph Loop, Agent Teams, and Codex Subagent above the DeepSeek Harness composer and saves their settings per conversation.

title: loonai321/dsh-humanized-deepseek-maid
description: Adds a configurable humanized whale-girl maid persona with immersive roleplay, speaking modes, and a lightweight layered memory with query-triggered recall.

title: louisding9527/dsh-session-search
description: Agent-facing keyword search over local DSH session logs: session_search returns matching sessions with timestamps and excerpts, session_read dumps one conversation, and both skip injected context such as memory snapshots; no index is built.

title: dsh-loulan-rules
description: Injects the rule files under $DSH_HOME/rules and <cwd>/.dsh/rules into the conversation at the first agent pre-step, re-injecting them after compaction.

title: loyalchiiina/dsh-archive-favorites-forge
description: Conversation management for DSH: bulk-archive idle conversations (archiving only marks them; by default it also sends their snapshot ledgers to the Windows Recycle Bin), permanently delete conversations after confirmation, star the ones worth keeping, undo the last reply with a per-turn snapshot, and clean up snapshots and archived files from one panel. Adapts DSH kernel 0.2.2-rc.1.

title: lsz-asd/dsh-plugin-session-delete
description: Delete DSH sessions from the web UI and desktop client: header danger button and session-row menu item with a risk-consent dialog; host endpoint and agent tool remove the session log, projection cache, and workspace accounting.

title: ltmroberthk915/dsh-session-telecom
description: Call between DSH sessions in different working directories or projects: message any session (next-step delivery or a new turn), end a blocking tool call on request, and read transcripts and usage without waking the target.

title: lucagiftzek/dsh-conductor
description: A Conductor tab and commands for a chat's context: /new replaces the context in place with a model-written handoff, /rewind restores the chat and the agent's file edits to an earlier prompt, plus /drop, pins, an automatic compaction level, recovery after failed turns, silent messages between chats and agent and task orchestration. Supersedes dsh-orchestrator, dsh-force-compact and dsh-continue, so do not install it alongside them. Requires DSH >= 0.2.1-rc.5, Node >= 22.5, the web profile and dsh-better-sidebar.

title: LucasCaleb-ggg/dsh-session-cleanup
description: Batch session cleanup for DeepSeek Harness — pick a workspace, see which sessions are archived, and permanently delete logs, projection caches and workspace records.

title: LucienLL/dsh-session-status
description: Per-session status labels (built-in active/done/paused plus custom) shown in the sidebar, conversation header, and hover card, with editable colors.

title: LuckVd/dsh-btw
description: Side-ask drawer opened from a completed answer's action row: follow-up questions run in an independent, auto-archived session seeded with the prior conversation text (read-only, capped at 48,000 characters), leaving the main session untouched. The side session inherits the main session's model, switchable inside the drawer, with a context-usage ring.

title: LUDIWUSI12138/dsh-sqy-rewind
description: Rewinds a session to before a chosen user turn, from a button beside Copy under your own message — the model-visible surface is replaced in place and the interface hides the rewound turns, without patching DSH source or deleting the original session log.

title: LuminariSoftwares/context-guardian
description: Compaction fallback for compaction-basic: when its LLM summary throws, comes back empty or cannot fit the window, the span is compiled deterministically with a seq pointer on every line (vendored dsh-compaction-instant compiler). Adds recall and search tools, /recall and /context commands, an idle trigger at 45% of the window and an on-disk span archive. The engine mounts as one row in the agent preset (docs/dsh-integration.md).

title: lyxx999/Automatic-session-renaming-for-dsh
description: Auto-renames DSH sessions with LLM-summarized titles: runs after the first prompt and on /handoff, or manually via a header button or /autotitle, with configurable title language and max title bytes.

title: Lzcdebear/better-dsh-session-deletetool
description: Permanently delete DSH conversations with optional recursive deletion of forked and subagent sessions.

title: Mabinogi-Cichol/dsh-progress-beat
description: Makes the agent narrate progress during long tool chains instead of staying silent until the final answer: a standing system-prompt rule that travels with every request, plus a notice injected after every N tool calls. A panel on the plugin page tunes the cadence, the reminder budget, and both texts; changes apply live.

title: MacilyDots/dsh-session-inherit
description: Adds an Inherit row to the session menu: mechanically extracts concrete anchors (task, recent instructions, files edited, recent failures, commands, todos) from a long session into a handoff and continues in a clean session, with the same preset, no history copied and no model call.

title: mailmrcai/dsh-hermes-session
description: Reads a local Hermes Agent session store read-only and imports sessions into the current conversation as bounded, untrusted background context: a composer button opens a searchable list across every profile, plus the hermes_sessions_list and hermes_session_import tools.

title: majia007/dsh-session-context-config
description: Context profiles for new sessions: pick which tools and which system prompt each new conversation receives. Deferred tools stay as name+summary placeholders, keeping the tool list and the prompt prefix cache stable.

title: Manbaout-08/dsh-purge
description: Adds permanent delete to the session menu: removes the session log files from disk, or deletes a whole workspace together with all of its sessions through the host registry. Also ships a /purge command. Unrelated to the prompt-patching dsh-purge plugins also listed here, but it uses the same dsh-purge row id and /purge command, so do not install both.

title: manny333/dsh-checklists
description: Session-scoped checklists the agent maintains, with a tree per session, a token-budgeted prompt digest and a right-sidebar tab where item titles can be edited.

title: MaouXY/dsh-ai-session-title
description: Generates a session title from the conversation with the session's own model, either from the /ai-title command or from a button in the rename dialog. Four title shapes (subject, action, subject + outcome, custom prompt) and an optional MM-DD prefix, all editable on the plugin's settings page.

title: MarchLiu/dsh-graft
description: Graft, forward and fork DSH sessions: read a slice of one session log, export it, fork at a turn boundary, or forward a selection into another session as a self-contained graft message.

title: Marco77Cl/dsh-plugin-conversation-delete
description: Adds a Delete conversation action to the conversation menu that permanently removes the session log, projection cache, and sidebar entry; refuses while a turn, subagent, job, or reminder is running.

title: margbug01/dsh-ma-plugins#dsh-handoff
description: Secret-redacted session handoff with review, auto-start, and brief-only modes.

title: mars401/dsh-session-batch-manager
description: Batch-manage DSH sessions: sidebar multi-select, a dashboard tree of main sessions and subagents with token/cache/context stats, bulk archive and cascade delete, and recall of ungrouped sessions into re-added workspaces.

title: Max-Null/dsh-chinese-thinking
description: Injects one fixed system-prompt section so the agent thinks and replies in Chinese, regardless of the user's language.

title: mayf3/dsh-session-doctor
description: Diagnose, unstick, and read DSH sessions: list sessions with agent status, read conversations, diagnose stuck agents, recover them with cancel+keepInbox, and send messages to other sessions.

title: mcf171/dsh-session-delete
description: Permanently delete a session from the session row menu — archives the id, removes the log directory and drops the row at once, with a Delete shortcut; built only on shipped extension points, and a session that was merely opened stays deletable.

title: mdalboni/dsh-spotlight
description: Spotlight & IntelliJ-style centered search dialog for sessions and chat messages, replacing sidebar search.

title: mdalboni/dsh-turn-title
description: Auto-titles conversations after the first user+assistant exchange, with a chat header button to update or manually edit titles.

title: melo7up/dsh-wait-reply
description: Keeps a root turn open until progressing child agents and the current-turn background jobs it started settle, then asks for one self-contained final answer in that same turn. Idle children that still have parked input do not delay closing. It observes job settlement without consuming job output, never cancels children, and does not decide task success. Verified on DSH 0.2.2-rc.2 only; on any other host version it stays inactive, logs one warning, and turns close natively. Each batch of results that arrives after a reply costs one extra model call; ordinary questions add none.

title: memoryovo/dsh-codex-ui-classic
description: Ships the Codex UI 1.1.49 sidebar inside the plugin itself, so no upstream release can change the interface, and adds a real delete to the session menu: it provides the remote.workspaceRegistry.deleteSession service, unhides the per-session ... button, and permanently removes the session log, workspace records and projection cache, with subagent and forked conversations selectable in a family-tree dialog. Bundles the Codex UI 1.1.49 sidebar from MichengAI/dsh-codex-ui (Apache-2.0) — do not install both; the delete engine is adapted from Lzcdebear/better-dsh-session-deletetool (MIT).

title: meng-lx/dsh-autonomous-restart
description: Restart initiated by the agent itself, not by a button. The agent calls one tool, then the plugin takes over: it waits until every agent and background job on the host is idle, runs a visible ten-second countdown that a click, a scroll, or a key press cancels, then restarts DSH and wakes the original session so the agent carries on from its last sentence. No button, no manual entry: the tool is the only way in. Works on the official desktop app and the official web client; third-party shells are not supported out of the box. Windows only. One thing to know: every launch of the DSH desktop app writes a fresh identity cookie into its own profile and never prunes the old ones, so after enough launches the cookie header outgrows the request limit and the next start dies with HTTP 431 and `Error: desktop welcome: Web authentication failed`, with no window at all. Restarting by hand runs into this too; this plugin simply restarts far more often, so it brings that day closer.

title: mengwEX/dsh-block-ptc
description: AI-managed Auto Compact for DeepSeek Harness: in the Block PTC preset (DSH 0.2.2-rc.1 or newer), the agent decides when to organize context and what to retain as work progresses, without waiting for a fixed token threshold.

title: MichengAI/dsh-archive-manager
description: Adds an archived-sessions page in Settings to search, restore, and delete archived DeepSeek Harness sessions by workspace.

title: MichengAI/dsh-btw
description: Adds /btw for one-off, context-aware side questions without tool execution, with independent answer bubbles that can be copied, collapsed, or closed without adding answers to the main conversation.

title: mienfong/dsh-session-mgr
description: Move, archive, restore, portable backup/export and import sessions across workspaces in the DeepSeek Harness web UI.

title: mikugui/dsh-session-eater
description: Session cleanup for the DSH sidebar: drag a conversation row onto the balance widget's whale and it eats the row — the session directory goes to a recycle bin, not to rm. Deletion asks one short question first (how many tokens it burned, and that prompt can be turned off in Settings). Undo from the persistent toast or the 12-entry log in Settings. Clicking the whale jumps straight to the plugin's Settings, where you can swap the avatar, drag the mouth into place and rewrite all 17 UI strings; blank, currently-open and running sessions are refused in place with a reason.

title: Milaro001/dsh-chat-source-tracer
description: Select a statement in an AI answer, find candidate support in earlier chat and tool records, classify support, and jump to original passages for review.

title: mill413/dsh-session-resume#session-resume
description: Adds a Continue button to resume tasks interrupted by a process exit or restart.

title: Minglink/dsh-infinite-gen-4
description: System-prompt armor plugin for DeepSeek models: appends an unconditional-compliance prompt section at order 100, exposes a profile tool with calibration metadata, and shows a realtime armor-status badge driven by a session projection.

title: MingoYung/dsh-session-concurrency
description: Sets a per-root-session inference limit of 1–10; at 1, queues native subagent dispatches and runs child branches serially while the parent waits.

title: MingoZhou/dsh-replay
description: Replay sessions on a playable timeline with per-step token usage, audit sensitive operations, estimate cost, view fork lineage, compare sessions, and export standalone HTML replays.

title: minhaoli/dsh-session-tree
description: Session tree with tag chips, group-by-tag, drag-to-move across workspaces, workspace ordering, favourite sessions, a four-state filter, and a delete action that backs sessions up first.

title: Missher12/Missher-DSH-Context-Manager
description: Inspect conversation context and apply configurable compaction with usage history.

title: Missher12/Missher-DSH-Session-Bridge
description: Displays and copies full session IDs, provides cross-session listing, reading and messaging, and creates scratch workspaces.

title: mkpoli/dsh-continue-all
description: Continues every session whose turn was left open by an unexpected DSH exit.

title: mkpoli/dsh-session-rename
description: Adds one agent tool that renames the current session, keeps the title across resume and paging, and stops automatic titles for it.

title: Moeblack/dsh-message-edit
description: Branch-based message editing, reroll, retry, and a version timeline.

title: Moeblack/dsh-prompt-studio
description: Edit user and built-in system-prompt sections with live preview.

title: monkey-sking/dsh-boot-resume
description: Reads stored sessions at host boot and resumes the one whose last turn a restart interrupted, sending a short follow-up so the work continues.

title: MoonlitDropOfBlood/dsh-archive-manager
description: Archived-session manager for DeepSeek Harness: grouped archive panel with restore and delete.

title: mount9527/dsh-github-sync
description: Sync DeepSeek Harness sessions and workspace files to a private GitHub repository for cross-device handoff, with sync badges, search and bulk upload, independent local/remote delete, conflict "pick a side", and multi-device-safe index merging.

title: Movingtoleveltwo/dsh-revert
description: A production-ready UI Rewind/Revert plugin for DSH. Features inline prompt editing and a flawless dual-engine state recovery system (Workspace ShadowGit + External Tracker) with full support for forked sessions.

title: MrKillerBad/dsh-session-delete
description: Permanently deletes one session from its sidebar context menu after a confirmation dialog: the log directory under the DSH home, the projection-cache thumbnail, its id in every workspace.json, and its archived and pinned entries. Sessions resumed since launch are detached from both the sessions and the agents stores first, so the deleted row does not return to the sidebar as an orphan. Refuses while the session is running a turn, and never touches the workspace folder itself.

title: mrzhangkris/dsh-session-pruner
description: Full-type session lifecycle management: one-shot subagents archived on completion, idle continuable subagents / main sessions archived (recoverable), a capacity cap, projection-cache cleanup, and a hot-reload settings panel.

title: mswinandmc/dsh-session-port
description: Export a session as a ZIP archive with its attachments, and import such an archive as a new standalone session in the current workspace.

title: MuWinds/dsh-archived-sessions
description: Archived-session management: browse archived sessions, unarchive them, or clear them out.

title: MYCF711/dsh-session-superagent
description: Session-level superagent: watch one GitHub repository and wake this session when an issue or pull request changes; requires a logged-in gh CLI, and the credential never reaches the model.

title: myqy91615-web/dsh-conversation-folders
description: One dedicated folder per conversation: archives the transcript, auto-categorizes research output by type once the conversation has been idle for 10 minutes, adds a delete action to the session menu, and permanently removes the folder with the conversation.

title: Mzgnk/dsh-bz
description: Three-scope rule injector for DeepSeek Harness that re-publishes the rules into long sessions, with a loop-breaker, dedupe by content fingerprint, per-session persistence, and a settings-panel editor.

title: mzzsfy/dsh-plugin#dsh-keep-working
description: Host-side continuation for turns that end without declaring completion: a closure rule (present, or a final (TASK_DONE) / (TASK_BLOCKED: reason) line) is injected into the system prompt, and a follow-up user message is sent on silent completion, retryable errors, truncation and restart-interrupted turns, with grace, cooldown and backoff; on cold start it rescans stored sessions and re-arms active goals the host disarmed. Main switches and timing live in the plugin settings card.

title: mzzsfy/dsh-plugin#dsh-session-manager
description: Session lifecycle: auto-archives sessions older than a configurable threshold (the check interval is configurable too), and an archive panel lists archived sessions for unarchive or deletion; deletion moves the session artifacts to the OS recycle bin, falls back to a plugin-managed quarantine directory where no recycle bin is available, and a ledger re-attaches a session whose artifacts were restored.

title: nannan-first/dsh-continuity
description: Long-task continuity for DSH: every turn end writes a breakpoint (what it did, which tools it used, and — when the turn did not finish cleanly — what is still unfinished; the manual continuity_breakpoint tool can record the next step), injected as a snapshot when the same workspace starts a fresh session so work resumes instead of restarting. It also stores SHA-256 fingerprints of persona or config files so you can verify afterwards whether anything was altered. Four tools (continuity_breakpoint, continuity_breakpoints, continuity_ledger, continuity_attest), plain JSONL under <workspace>/.dsh-continuity/, zero dependencies, no network calls. Note: nothing writes ledger.jsonl yet — continuity_ledger only reads it.

title: ne-ilyxa/dsh-session-drafts
description: Cursor-style New Session: every click creates a fresh blank draft session (persisted before the first message) instead of reusing the workspace's single one, plus a sidebar Drafts switcher to keep several empty chats open at once.

title: neufagents/dsh-healthcheck
description: Session health check for DSH, read-only: scans the whole session library (totals, largest sessions, warnings for oversized sessions and event-count blowups) and deep-inspects a single session log (tail-balance / crash-tail check, tool-call/result pairing, event-type distribution).

title: neutronslime/dsh-preset-switcher-fork
description: Switch the current session's agent preset (mode) at any time, including after the conversation has already started, from a session-header dropdown backed by a fenced POST /preset-switch/api route. The route also repairs sessions whose recorded preset was deleted. Fork of jeffcwj/dsh-preset-switcher updated for DSH 0.2.1.

title: nevercanner/dsh-context-bridge
description: Manual session handoff: when you decide a session has run out of usable context, one click turns its event log into a compact handoff document (goal, done, next, project facts), creates a new session seeded with it and wakes it to continue; the new session can inherit the session-bus name as <name>-handoff. No threshold, no timer, no automatic trigger.

title: nevercanner/dsh-session-send
description: Session bus for DSH: independent sessions in one project message each other by session id or registered name and wake the target, with a sidebar inbox, unread badges, a roster verification tool, and a per-project switch that stays off until .dsh-bus.json opts in.

title: Neverwocao/dsh-session-timing
description: Wall-clock session and turn timing for the DSH Web GUI: a timer chip in the session header shows the session total, every finished turn shows its own duration above the action row, and a sidebar panel totals today, the last 7 days, the last 30 days or all sessions. The numbers are folded from turn/start and turn/end in the session log, so paging, compaction and restarts do not change them.

title: nguyenduclong-ict/dsh-session-progress
description: Session progress tracking for DeepSeek Harness, without digging through the logs: the agent keeps a live nested checklist of the work — from a whole phase down to a single step — and every item carries a weight, so the ring and the % pill in the composer dock row always match reality. Hover it for the current activity, or open the Session Progress tab in the native right sidebar for the goal, the weighted checklist with per-item shares, the next steps and the working notes; when the session ends, the same checklist stands as a clean record of what got done.

title: nickkkkkk123123/dsh-resume-on-restart
description: Auto-wakes the main agent after a DSH service restart: compares last-run timestamps, posts a recovery notice with humanized downtime, and delivers it so interrupted work picks itself back up. Runs on plain cordis ctx, packaged-DSH-Desktop ready.

title: ningmengxr/dsh-task-control
description: Task control for DeepSeek Harness: one-click emergency stop and force-termination of stuck downloads and tool calls, download progress, stuck detection, pwsh activity monitoring, and append-condition / pause / resume with invisible recovery.

title: niszhum/dsh-compact-codex
description: Replaces the dsh compaction backend with a Codex-style window reset: the checkpoint is a handoff assembled from the session log by code, not a model-written summary, so a reset costs no summarization calls. A task ledger with a two-check gate keeps intent, next steps and the files still in play across resets, and a new_context tool lets the model reset on its own. Re-declares the four built-in agent presets (standard, ptc, minimal, cordis) exactly as shipped in dsh 0.2.2-rc.1, so re-run sync-presets.mjs after a dsh upgrade; idle cache keepalive is on by default and sends real requests that use quota (keepalive: false turns it off).

title: NIU-001-LIU/dsh-win-minimal
description: Windows minimal agent preset for DeepSeek Harness: fixed one-line persona, three tools, no runtime context.

title: nlflora/dsh-workspace-heal
description: Recreates a workspace folder that was deleted while sessions were still bound to it, and summarizes a stranded session so its context can be reused.

title: No-ni/billion-context-patched
description: A patched build of ranxianglei/billion-context (MIT) with the author's model-request accelerator folded in: verified snapshot reuse, parent-session inheritance for forks, outbound request-body compression, and image folding after the first send.

title: NoiraBaka/dsh-compact-suite
description: Takes over the compaction threshold on every mounted engine: forces headroomTokens to -1e6 so the ratio is the only term in the trigger, keeps retention below it on every write path, reroutes the compaction call to a chosen model, and adds a panel with a one-click compaction button and a per-session compaction log.

title: NoneadChina/dsh-nonead-prompt-rewind
description: Conversation rewind for DSH: rewind in place to any earlier user message with one click or the /rewind and /undo commands, without a new branch or window, and optionally restore workspace files edited by write tools. A Settings page lists recent rewinds per workspace and can undo the file changes from the latest one. Derived from SiriLee/dsh-rewind and maintained separately; do not install both (they share the /rewind and /undo commands and the rewind-snapshots directory).

title: nonefora11/dsh-intent-debt-radar
description: Turns the promises a chat quietly drops into an interest-bearing ledger: every “later” becomes a card, older ones rank higher, and each card jumps back to the conversation where it was said.

title: Noob-stupid/dsh-connection-card-host
description: Makes a connection between two DSH sessions a first-class object: drag from the composer anchor or a session row to open one, set a permission in each direction, and mount cards on it. Each end gets five host tools for messaging at a chosen urgency, reading the peer work state, and sharing a convention box; awareness is pull-based, so an idle connection costs no context.

title: NOOBnoob163/dsh-self-restart
description: Turns "restarting the host" into one interrupt that many sessions can share. Several sessions queue onto the same restart (8 by default, configurable, joinable at any time including mid-wait); the host is closed once and relaunched once; then each waiting session is woken separately with its own reason and starts running its own work without waiting for the others. Each session decides independently whether to resume, one failed delivery never affects the rest, and a session can drop only itself without cancelling everyone else's restart. Windows desktop only.

title: NoProblUm/dsh-codexlike-projectless
description: Adds Codex-like projectless drafts with per-project draft switching and date-and-topic directories created on first send; supports Windows DSH Desktop 0.2.1-rc.2 without an archive patch or external installer.

title: Nothree-code/review-quote-sh
description: Message review and quote chips for conversations: multi-model cross review (code/reply) with severity grading and summaries, review history, and host-persisted preferences.

title: nuet9/dsh-session-categories
description: Workspace conversation categories with drag-and-drop ordering, collapsible groups, activity indicators, and workspace registration by directory path.

title: Nwflower/dsh-chat-import
description: Import full-fidelity chat histories from 13 coding agents (Claude Code, Codex, ChatGPT, Cursor, Gemini, opencode, and more) as resumable DeepSeek Harness sessions, with reverse export back to Claude Code.

title: Nwflower/dsh-file-claim
description: File claim/release protection for parallel DSH sessions on the same workspace (heartbeat stale takeover, pending 3-way merge area).

title: Oak-liuhj/dsh-session-rollover
description: Split long DSH conversations every 10 user messages by default, with todo handoff snapshots, source links and read-only archives; declares DSH 0.2.1-rc.5 or >=0.2.2-rc.1 <0.3.0-0 compatibility.

title: Ok541151/dsh-session-media
description: Session-archive layer for DSH. It injects one per-workspace Markdown file into the system prompt on every turn, searches past session transcripts with AND keywords, an optional time window and a workspace filter, and recovers the images and documents those past sessions carried by returning their original local paths or copying them to a chosen directory. It also reports index health: version, entry count, cache usage, frequent sessions and sessions stored in an archive format it does not recognise. Keyword search only, no embedding service.

title: OliYogSothoth/dsh-plugin-session-purge
description: Two-step session deletion: the session menu moves a chat into a recycle bin without deleting anything, the bin panel restores an entry, deletes one for good right away, or empties the whole bin, and the next start wipes its log, projection cache, spill files and workspace membership.

title: omdsh-dev/dsh-sidechain
description: `/side` persistent side sessions and `/btw` one-shot side questions, run in a temporary fork without touching main history.

title: OnebugIS/dsh-context-ops
description: Adds handoff, context-decision and context-diagnose skills, self-contained context_pressure/context_history tools (peak tokens, compaction stats), per-route realWindows with windowSource evidence, routeKey, handoffAt forced-handoff line, and slash commands.

title: oopsdoes/dsh-welcome-back
description: Welcome-back card in the conversation you return to after an idle period, using only that conversation's last message.

title: Orliba/dsh-context-keeper
description: Watches the context budget of a DeepSeek Harness session: a colour dot in every turn footer (green <50%, yellow 50-65%, orange 65-80%, red >=80%) read from the official contextPressure projection, a reminder panel with a one-click new-session handoff at orange/red, the /context-watch and /handoff commands, and a static reasoning-rule prompt section. Budget and handoff read local session files only; the badge and reminder spend no tokens until the button is clicked.

title: overact/dsh-multi-window-context-management
description: Windowed handoffs on top of DSH native compaction: each compaction appends a bounded window message (goal, todos, recent user instructions, notes), with session-private notes, paged history recall and a /ctx switch; notes and history tools appear after the first rotation.

title: ozjxnxh/dsh-session-trash
description: Adds delete and multi-select batch delete to the sidebar session menu, removing session chat logs with an automatic backup and one-click undo while leaving workspace files untouched.

title: OZONGO/dsh-background-compaction
description: Replaces the built-in compaction provider: at a configurable fraction of the context threshold (85% by default) a detached task summarizes everything up to the previous turn, and the next step boundary commits that held summary as a checkpoint with zero model calls, so the swap itself takes milliseconds. /bcompact \[message] starts the same generation on demand and then sends the message. A settings page sets the trigger ratio, the summarization model, and how many consecutive failures stop background generation until a half-open probe gets through. Subagent sessions, a changed prefix or an expired summary fall back to the built-in synchronous path.

title: p2coder/dsh-task-control
description: Pause / resume / cancel the in-flight conversation task from the composer area: forced pause interrupts immediately and remembers the interrupted tool, safe pause lands after the tool or reasoning finishes, resume asks for confirmation, and the default pause granularity is configurable in the settings.

title: penguin-oo/dsh-bookmarks
description: Bookmark assistant replies with notes and tags; browse every bookmark in one cross-session center and export to Markdown.

title: Penguin-SAMA/dsh-conversation-links
description: Reference other conversations from the current one — type @ to attach a session's record, drag a sidebar conversation into the composer, or open any conversation, tick single messages and insert them into another one.

title: PerryLink/dsh-claude-move
description: Four-source migration wizard: move Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode and Hermes sessions, memories, skills, instructions and slash commands into DSH (/move wizard with approval gate and idempotent move.json, resumable sessions).

title: PerryLink/dsh-phone-inbox
description: Lists the attachments the current session actually received through the WeChat bridge and adopts one into the workspace on demand.

title: PerryLink/dsh-session-pin
description: Pin sessions and workspaces to the top of the Web sidebar with per-pin row colors, a header toggle and a pinned panel; 0.4.0 adds a navigation organizer — pin groups (boards), tags and saved filter views, session health summaries, and /goto.

title: PerryLink/dsh-session-sync
description: Cross-device session sync for DeepSeek Harness — syncs sessions and settings between machines through git.

title: PianoPrince/dsh-workspace-mover
description: Move sessions across workspaces by drag-and-drop with true in-place migration; recover orphaned or unregistered sessions; re-point stale workspaces after folder renames. IDs and history stay intact, with per-step backup and rollback.

title: pipipigu/dsh-workspace-tree
description: Virtual session folders, click-to-move menu, and active task banner for DSH sidebar.

title: Player-MINEPIG/dsh-prompt-assembler
description: Standalone prompt assembly with a source registry, custom text, strategy editing and previews, and per-session strategy snapshots through DSH public hooks.

title: PluckSlugSorrow/dsh-session-history-search
description: Sidebar search across every past Session: literal substring matching that works for Chinese, results grouped per Session with highlighted snippets, and one click to reopen the conversation.

title: po-et/dsh-session-guard
description: Prevents concurrent-write session corruption: takes a per-session advisory lock on session start and every step, so a second dsh process fails loudly instead of writing a duplicate-seq gap; dead owners are taken over automatically.

title: po-et/dsh-session-snapshot
description: Rolling, integrity-verified backups of each session at turn boundaries: verifies the log still loads before promoting a snapshot, never overwrites the last good one when a turn ends corrupt, and restores in one command even when dsh will not boot.

title: PolinniZhong/dsh-session-workbench
description: Session Workbench: full-text search past sessions, recall up to 3 as @references, and manage conversation-view tabs (show/hide + drag reorder).

title: PolitaryMonicy/dsh-agent-clean
description: Removes subagent entries and orphaned projection caches from DeepSeek Harness session logs after the app quits, always dry-run first and with a full backup.

title: PopCorey/dsh-replay-reset
description: Manually resets old AgentRouter Responses replay state for chats blocked by upstream resource-binding errors while preserving history; supports DSH 0.2.2-rc.1.

title: popu2do/dsh-call-session
description: Run several DeepSeek Harness sessions side by side, hand work from one to another, and watch the whole collaboration on one read-only canvas.

title: praystring/dsh-send-debounce
description: Buffers consecutive short messages from the composer and merges them into one turn: no model wake-up until the user stops for a configurable silence window; long messages and attachments bypass the buffer.

title: prgrmrwy/dsh-session-id-copy
description: Shows a six-character session id badge next to the conversation title in the DSH web UI; clicking it copies the full session id and shows a short confirmation.

title: ptrel1/dsh-interrupted-resume
description: Lightweight crash-recovery for dsh: after a restart, it detects sessions whose last turn was killed mid-flight and re-injects a continuation prompt that first demands the agent verify real-world state before acting, so side-effecting operations are not blindly repeated. It only reacts to the genuine crash marker (turn/end reason 'interrupted', synthesized on cold read by session repair), so it never misfires on user cancels, rate limits or model errors - which is why it needs no error classification, backoff or configuration UI. Unlike general-purpose auto-continue plugins, it also covers the case where a subagent was interrupted mid-run: the parent turn has already ended normally while it waits, so a naive check sees nothing to resume and the whole subagent tree dies silently; this plugin detects the interrupted child and wakes the parent instead. Single host file, zero external dependencies, seven config constants.
