description: Loop guard for DeepSeek Harness: detects and stops repeated output mid-stream, prunes and compacts context, then automatically resumes the task without a restart.

title: Tests4gptplay/dsh-compaction-selector
description: Browse and search provider models to choose an independent summary model for DSH Standard mode, or let Auto follow the conversation route; save extra automatic pressure-compaction passes, while manual compaction attempts one useful pass. Includes Chinese/English theme-aware settings; start a new Standard-mode conversation after installation to apply the configuration.

title: TetraSsky/dsh-hold
description: Holds a drafted message until the main agent is idle, no subagent is running and no background job is live, then sends it. Each hold takes an optional send time and a choice to queue, wait or steer, and lives on the host with its attachments so a restart does not lose it.

title: TGYD-helige/dsh-plugins#dsh-storage
description: Mirror dsh session events to MySQL, PostgreSQL, SQLite, or SQL Server while retaining local session files.

title: Theflippy978/dsh-auto-rename
description: Names a session from its first prompt, and streams AI title suggestions into the rename dialog.

title: thirteenkai/dsh-resend-editor
description: Edit a sent message in place and resend it as a forked chat, keeping the original: change the text, remove, reorder or add images and files, with session image limits checked before sending (the first message opens a new chat in the same workspace). Also @-references pending images by file name, drag-reorders composer attachments, copies messages together with their images, and adds copy, download and drag-to-composer for images in the conversation.

title: Thunderunruly/workspace-settings
description: Per-workspace session defaults for DeepSeek Harness: save the Agent preset, permission preset, model, reasoning effort, Chat work-details level and collapse timing per workspace; new or reused blank sessions in that workspace start from them.

title: TianYa-DAO/dsh-pinned-sessions
description: Keeps running, finished-but-unopened and currently open sessions pinned above the workspace groups in the DSH Web sidebar, and lets any session or workspace be pinned there from its own "..." menu.

title: TiFu799/dsh-wake-up
description: Resumes a dormant DSH session on demand: when a session is not currently live, it is resumed from disk with the provider/model route it last used, so external integrations (chat bridges, schedulers, webhooks, other plugins) can deliver into it instead of failing with "that session is not alive". Exposes an HTTP endpoint, a wake_session tool and a ctx.wakeUp service. Resuming only reads history back into memory and spends no model request by itself.

title: TiJun-Prime/dsh-turn-delete
description: Delete one finished turn from a DSH conversation without deleting the session — the trash button next to the last assistant reply removes the question, that reply and the tool records of the turn from the conversation surface and from the model context, while the session id, title, later turns and the append-only log stay; the removal is written as a persistent tombstone, so it survives a reload.

title: timefarer/dsh-chat-search
description: Global and in-session search for DeepSeek Harness: search chat history across all sessions or just the current one, and retrieve both paragraph text and file names — find it even when you only remember the file name. Filter by date range and each session recent turns; results expand as session → question → paragraph, and a jump lands on the match with the words highlighted. Defaults to the last 14 days and the latest 30 turns per session; leave either empty to search everything.

title: tingfeng-droid/dsh-compaction-vcc
description: Replaces LLM summarization with deterministic text compilation, so compaction makes no model calls and keeps original tokens; elided content stays retrievable through seq pointers. Based on TsFreddie/dsh-compaction-instant.

title: tinyblckc0000al/dsh-deepworker
description: A DSH conversation workspace: turn actions, provenance quotes, local notes and summaries, in-conversation find, focus lock, and per-workspace command buttons.

title: TLEWA/dsh-fastload
description: Shrinks the first history page of long DSH sessions to at most 100 messages, targeting the latest two turns, and fills the viewport in the background with the built-in load-earlier control when the trimmed transcript is shorter than the window.

title: TLEWA/dsh-if
description: Adds an /if slash command to DSH: the first line is a condition and the remaining lines are an instruction. A fork subagent that inherits the session tools, system prompt and message history judges the condition and answers YES or NO, and only on YES is the instruction sent to the main agent as an ordinary user message, while a NO sends nothing. The condition, judge prompt and verdict never enter the main transcript. While the agent is busy the command queues with ordinary messages, editable, removable and steerable from the queue panel, and a setting switches to the 0.2.x background mode. The judge runs read-only, and falls back to a one-shot model call over a plain transcript when the host has no context-inheriting fork provider. Supports DSH 0.2.1-rc.5 and later (verified on 0.2.1-rc.5 and 0.2.2-rc.1) and Node.js 20.3 or later.

title: tmeeli/dsh-auto-goal-resume
description: Automatically resumes active goal sessions after DSH restart; long-running tasks continue without a manual nudge.

title: tmpdot/dsh-checkpoint-diff
description: Browses checkpoints produced by dsh-checkpoint-rewind as a timeline of time nodes and shows per-file line diffs between any two of them, with trace replay from session logs (no snapshot producer needed) and preview-first workspace rollback with single-shot undo, via /diff and /rollback commands, a JSON HTTP API, and a GUI panel.

title: TOBYCAI/dsh-sessions-manager
description: Archive, restore, permanently delete, and move DeepSeek Harness sessions across workspaces from one unified settings panel.

title: tom143tc/dsh-session-card
description: Draggable session cards on a board inside the session canvas, with grid, matrix and freeform layouts, a per-card composer, and native floating windows.

title: tony92921/dsh-compact-manager
description: Take over context compaction on both the manual and the automatic path, each runnable by a compaction model (falling back to a second model, or used directly) or by a mechanical fold that builds the summary card locally with no model call; the fold goes through the same official compaction transaction, so the replaced events stay in the append-only session log under their sequence numbers. It adapts code from dsh-compact-saviour and takes the mechanical fold from dsh-ledger-compact (both MIT) — install it instead of dsh-compact-saviour, not alongside it.

title: tonyzdev/dsh-session-messaging
description: Cross-session messaging across one or all workspaces: session_list finds top-level sessions by recency or title, session_send_message steers or queues attributed messages (cold-resuming stored sessions when needed), session_create opens titled top-level sessions with an initial task, and a client renderer displays relayed messages as user-side chat bubbles naming the sender session.

title: Totoro-qaq/dsh-plugin-bridge
description: Moves an existing DSH session to another agent preset through a previewable five-section handoff, preserving the source session and either pausing the target for confirmation or continuing immediately.

title: tower666/dsh-checkpoints
description: Per-turn git checkpoints of a workspace: revert one turn’s changes (or go back to the end of an earlier turn), previewed file by file, and forget that part of the conversation from the model context.

title: trammels51/dsh-pause-button
description: Pause or resume the running task from a 28 px button beside the DSH composer: safe pause lets the current step finish, holds the next agent/pre-step boundary, and resumes the same turn without a continuation message; force pause cancels immediately, and the default granularity is configurable in Settings.

title: Tsechiyuan/dsh-session-manager
description: Session manager and session settings for the DSH sidebar: sessions grouped by workspace with archive filters, title search, batch archive and a read-only transcript preview; global and per-workspace name, occupation and instructions injected into the system prompt; optional recent-only and hide-workspace filters for the sidebar.

title: tsingshitao-nuke/dsh-set-workspace
description: Adds a Windows Explorer right-click action to open a folder as a DSH workspace, launching DSH if needed.

title: tuogusa/dsh-session-nav
description: A floating button beside the chat that opens a searchable list of all questions in the session for quick jumps, with smooth hover-open/close behavior.

title: tuogusa/dsh-session-tags
description: Attach tags to sessions and search sessions by tag in the Web settings panel.

title: txlznbzsdj-collab/dsh-session-delete
description: Adds a "Delete" item to the sidebar session menu with a confirmation dialog, then hard-deletes the session.

title: tz-Wang510/dsh-safe-session-delete
description: Recoverable session deletion for DeepSeek Harness: session-row and Settings entry points move logs to a 30-day trash, then clean projection caches and subagent logs.

title: Ultroncn/dsh-archived-chats
description: Workspace-based archive management with scoped content search, conversation previews, tags and notes, ZIP backups, lineage graphs, confirmed permanent deletion and retries, and official Host updates.

title: Uruz123321/dsh-plugin-classes
description: Plugin classes for DeepSeek Harness: installing a plugin is global, so every session sees every tool. This plugin splits installed plugins into mutually invisible classes and registers each composition as an ordinary @deepseek-ai/dsh-agent-preset, so a session mounts only the plugins of the classes it belongs to; classes are toggled from a chip next to the model selector. Deleting a class only hides it (its preset stays registered), so sessions already bound to it still open.

title: uugvkbvkdjbsdbvwxxl/dsh-archived-chats
description: Browse archived DSH sessions grouped by workspace in Settings, filter and search them, restore one in a click, or delete a session log from disk for good.

title: uwu9039/dsh-unarchive
description: Lists archived sessions, previews their content, restores them to the original workspace, and adds an optional archive confirmation.

title: v93013520/dsh-abba-secret-chat
description: One-off two-person password chat in the DeepSeek Harness right sidebar: end-to-end encrypted (the server sees ciphertext only), with images and screenshots, fully cleared on end.

title: vagur1689/dsh-conversation-find
description: In-conversation keyword search for the current session: pages the history back to its first window before matching, then highlights every hit and scrolls to the one you pick.

title: vaniawang/dsh-side-conversation
description: Opens a native side conversation forked from the active conversation, with live parent context, Inline & Spill chain recall, relay to the main conversation, and usage stats.

title: Vast-Unhurried/dsh-toolkit#dsh-session-delete
description: Adds a delete-session action that permanently removes session logs, workspace entries and archives.

title: Venshell/dsh-session-dm
description: Cross-session messaging: sends text into another session in the same workspace, and creates new top-level sessions.

title: VergilYe/dsh-auto-continue
description: Keeps a turn from closing on an unfinished reply: a stream guard turns silent truncation into an in-step retry, and a completion protocol asks the model to declare how each turn ended.

title: VermilionPasvikin/dsh-pack-and-go
description: Pack DSH conversations and workspaces into one .dshpack file and restore them on another machine or platform, with cross-platform path repair.

title: Very12345/dsh-archive-delete
description: Archived-session management with single and batch deletion, native workspace registry cleanup, and deferred file cleanup while the host holds session resources.

title: victorwwchan/FastCompact#dsh-fast-compact
description: Deterministic, zero-LLM compaction engine for DeepSeek Harness: the checkpoint is compiled locally from the session log with no summarizing round-trip, and dropped tool traffic becomes seq reference lines the model can restore with recall, which helps on small context windows. Ships as two packages: install dsh-fast-compact and dsh-fast-compact-preset, add both to the profile's bundles, pick the Fast Compact (standard) preset and start a new session. Needs dsh >=0.1.5-rc.2 <0.3.0.

title: vinson1101/dsh-task-dispatch
description: Dispatch a task to a real DSH session by workspace path or session id; results land in a persistent task ledger that can be queried without triggering the model. It serves HTTP on 127.0.0.1:7391 and requires a bearer token it generates on first run (kept in ~/.dsh/relay/token), rejects non-loopback Host and foreign Origin, and stores task results as JSON files under ~/.dsh/relay/tasks; an optional notifyUrl receives each finished result.

title: Voellin/dsh-deephub-share#dsh-deephub-share
description: Turns a dsh session into a redacted idea and delivers it end-to-end encrypted to friends on DeepHub; received ideas land as new sessions.

title: walksls/dsh-degeneration-kit#auto-checkpoint
description: Auto-compaction that writes a handoff note first: as a session approaches a token threshold it asks the model to save a project checkpoint into the workspace, then optionally starts a fresh session seeded with a continue instruction and parks the old one. The note must be written within the current compaction cycle and its conclusions section must actually change, so a stale or merely touched file cannot slip through.

title: WangLemna/dsh-recycle-bin
description: Delete DSH sessions into a restorable recycle bin — subagent sessions follow their parent as one tree, batch archive, restore and purge are supported, and only purge destroys bytes.

title: wangxiaocuo/dsh-session-trash
description: Session trash for DeepSeek Harness: move cold sessions out of the sidebar into a recoverable trash, restore them within the retention window (30 days by default), or delete their logs permanently. A trashed subagent tree moves and restores as a whole, a shared DSH toast offers undo, and the settings page supports search, sorting, multi-select batch restore and emptying the whole trash.

title: waning-sun/dsh-session-wake
description: Wakes a DSH conversation on demand and hands work to it: pick one or more sessions to auto-wake when DSH starts, give each session its own provider, model and reasoning effort, and let the agent call another conversation with the session_task tool — it wakes that session, delivers the content, waits for it to finish and brings the answer back. Also ships list_sessions and wake_session tools plus a settings page titled 会话唤醒; no QQ or bridge dependency. The three tools are available to every agent and can reach any session in the profile; the auto-wake list is empty by default, a session's boot prompt is delivered at every DSH start, and session_task waits up to 300 seconds by default.

title: weibaohui/dsh-continue
description: Auto-resume for interrupted agent sessions: an ordered rule table routes by failure type (rate limit, quota, auth, context overflow, crashed orphan) to automatic backoff retry, model switch, resume after context compaction, or a stop-loss notification, with a visual rule editor and a full activity log.

title: weibaohui/dsh-favorites
description: Session favorites: bookmark any conversation into a browser-style favorites panel — one-click star from session rows, folders for organization, notes, custom display names, resume session, fork into a new session, basic session stats, plus a fork-relationship graph showing how conversations derive from one another.

title: weibaohui/dsh-smart-title
description: Smart session titles for DSH: after each conversation turn an independent auxiliary LLM call summarizes the full user+assistant transcript into a title that follows the session's real topic instead of echoing the first message; the first message is titled instantly, failed built-in titles auto-retry on later turns, manual renames are never overwritten, and subagent/fork sessions are skipped.

title: weiVc/dsh-session-tidy
description: Deletes a whole DSH session or one completed turn from the session log: confirmation dialog, live-agent teardown, path and identity checks, pre-rewrite backup, and later turns renumbered.

title: wenhao4126/dsh-session-delete
description: Session management for DSH: archive or delete one session, archive/delete all sessions in a workspace, and restore archived sessions from the settings page — archiving backs up workspace metadata and restoring recreates deleted workspace registrations automatically.

title: WenhongPan/dsh-projects
description: Project and session organization with multi-folder groups, attention summaries, grouped chat search, native folder picking, pinning, favorites, ordering, and an archive center.

title: wfz2006/dsh-agent-bridge
description: Browse local AI agent projects in one DeepSeek Harness panel: filter and pin projects, pick memories, skills, and recent sessions, then continue in the original directory with an editable DSH handoff draft or export it as Markdown.

title: whiteS18/dsh-handoff-button
description: Adds a handoff button to every assistant message that writes an LLM-summarized handoff document of the current conversation into the workspace handoff/ directory.

title: whybebabo/dsh-recent-sessions
description: Flat list of recent sessions across every workspace, with last-question previews, time buckets, full-text search, and notes that resurface when you reopen a conversation. Fork of huangxp12/dsh-recent-sessions with a native-style UI rewrite; both register the same recent-sessions panel id, so do not install both.

title: whyihaveyou/dsh-suite#plugin-session-export
description: Export the append-only session log as human-readable Markdown or HTML, grouped by trajectory source.

title: wiiwings1988/dsh-agent-bridge
description: Lists Claude Code and Codex sessions in the DSH Workspace browser, where they can be opened, continued, pinned, renamed and archived, with terminal, file and git tabs.

title: wilsonchengassistant/dsh-session-clean-delete
description: Adds a permanent Delete session action to the sidebar session menu, behind a confirmation dialog that reports the log size, running turns, subagents, background jobs and reminders bound to the session; the id is then released from the live, archive and workspace registries, so the row stays gone on refresh instead of folding back in.

title: WindFromKadath/dsh-plugin-workspace-archive
description: Archives the sessions of a workspace when its folder is deleted or moved away, or when its registration is removed, and restores them when it returns: unarchives only the sessions it archived itself, re-attaches every member its ledger recorded (including sessions you archived manually, whose archived state is left unchanged), and adopts ungrouped sessions whose working directory is that workspace path.

title: Wine-Red/dsh-prompt-stash
description: Local, per-session LIFO prompt stash for temporarily setting aside unfinished composer text and safely restoring it later.

title: Wisdoverse/dsh-inline-media-viewer-plugin
description: Renders image, video, and audio paths and URLs from DSH conversations inline, with workspace-confined local reads and an optional ComfyUI proxy.

title: WiseXin/dsh-session-intent-title
description: Zero-UI-overhead DeepSeek Harness plugin that automatically classifies conversation intents and names sessions with clean emoji prefixes (optimize, fix, feature, explore, etc.).

title: wjj-8283/dsh-temp-workspace
description: Temporary workspace for DSH web — one click creates a throwaway workspace whose conversations are deleted at the next restart (immediately or after a delay, optionally behind a confirm dialog). Pin a temp workspace to keep it: its files move into the folder you pick, its title becomes that folder's name, its conversations migrate, and a real host-level restart re-indexes them.

title: wojiao42/dsh-space-optimizer
description: Per-task disk-space ledger in the sidebar with opt-in reclamation of unowned junk; session logs are never trimmed.

title: wpc0323/deepseek-web-import
description: Imports chat.deepseek.com web conversations into DeepSeek Harness as resumable sessions, from a settings-page UI.

title: WSL043/dsh-chat-manager
description: Manages archived DSH chats with conversation search, restore, and confirmed safe permanent deletion.

title: WSNMM3/dsh-session-keeper
description: A session manager for the DeepSeek Harness sidebar: per-workspace category trees with drag-and-drop ordering, pinned sessions hoisted above the categories (or kept inside them, switchable from the view options), an archive partition, and a delete bin where removed sessions keep their logs and can be restored or purged in batches. The host half owns the category and recycle data, the web half renders it; both ship as one plugin. Maintained fork of ht719/dsh-session-categories ported to current DSH, with pinning, archive partition and delete bin added; it cannot be installed together with the original.

title: wsxwj123/dsh-plugins#dsh-session-manager
description: Delete sessions with a 5-second undo and a recycle bin, plus an archive view to browse and unarchive, for the DSH Web GUI. Ships on npm as `@wsxwj123/dsh-session-manager`.

title: wu1yi2fan/dsh-qqbot-suite
description: Adds group gating, chat history and tool allow/deny lists to the official QQ bot plugin.

title: wusoudiaowei/dsh-conversation-trash
description: Recycle bin for conversations - delete a session from the sidebar into a trash folder, undo within 8 seconds, restore or delete forever later.

title: wuuuuu123-32/dsh-session-delete
description: Adds delete and batch delete to the session list menu; sessions go to the Windows Recycle Bin instead of being erased, and the files a session produced are listed first so you decide whether to remove them together.

title: wuxiangru915/dsh-session-manager
description: Session manager for the DSH Web UI: browse all and archived sessions, restore/unarchive, delete with two-step confirmation, and preview conversation content from the Settings panel.

title: wwwangzilin/dsh-auto-sync
description: Automatic, versioned backup of your DeepSeek Harness home — sessions, memories, settings and the profile plugin tree — to a private git remote you own, with commits and pushes on a schedule and every failure surfaced in the DSH log.

title: wwwyxsuper/dsh-session-purge
description: Adds a permanent-delete row to the sidebar menu of archived sessions, removing the session log, its projection cache and its workspace registration.

title: wx-yss/dsh-composer-enter
description: Makes Enter insert a newline in the DSH 0.1.5 Web composer while Cmd/Ctrl+Enter keeps submitting messages.

title: wyewyewye/dsh-session-title-regen
description: Regenerates a session's title from its last 10 user prompts using the model the session itself last used, with an editable preview before the new title is written back.

title: wzn16/dsh-auto-archive
description: Auto-archives sessions idle beyond a configurable threshold, with safety guards (never touches live or running sessions), plus a full archived-session management UI: list, unarchive, safe delete and content preview.

title: xchannel1987/dsh-session-xc
description: Session management enhancement plugin for DeepSeek Harness - workspace session count display, archived sessions panel with restore/delete, drag-and-drop session move across workspaces.

title: xCube007/dsh-message-rewind
description: Adds edit and delete to your own message bubbles: editing truncates the following turns and resends the new text, deleting removes the message and those turns, and either can optionally roll back the recorded file changes of the removed turns (refusing when a file has changed since). The sidebar keeps a single conversation.

title: xfgil/dsh-session-clock
description: Per-session clock injection with durable idle-gap tracking: tells the agent how long it has been since this particular conversation last spoke, which the host's time context (last message only) cannot.

title: XialerMoies/dsh-prompt-easymanager
description: Applies personal prompts and system-prompt edits at the global level or on a single session, so each session can work with its own prompt setup without touching the others.

title: xiamubumu/dsh-context-reclaim
description: Context governance for DSH: folds oversized tool results, collapses the tool surface and keeps the prompt cache warm, so long sessions stop getting more expensive.

title: xianshu-virtuous/dsh-whale-companion
description: Automatically starts a fresh Web session near the context limit with the last complete turn, and adds an editable additive whale-maid persona with on-demand reload.

title: xiaolin233-ctrl/dsh-session-transfer
description: Adds a "Move to another workspace…" row to every conversation menu: copies the full event log into the target workspace under a new session id (header, title and model preset preserved, delivery markers retargeted), reads the copy back to verify it, attaches it, then archives the original unless you keep it.

title: XiaoMa-PM/dsh-cross-session-agent-pre
description: Cross-workspace DSH messaging and sender navigation, with bounded same-workspace context and opt-in local Claude Code messaging.

title: xiaoshenming/dsh-session-surgeon
description: Repair DeepSeek Harness sessions that refuse to load, with a sidebar Session surgeon overlay and dry-run repair.

title: xiguazhiPrince/dsh-session-map
description: Session map: a fork-tree canvas over DSH sessions, and a Settings page that clones a Git repository into a new workspace. The canvas is reachable from a session-header toggle and two right-side tabs, and from a conversation tab that is off by default; it starts on the current session's own tree, growing downward, with wheel pan, Ctrl/⌘-wheel zoom, a subagent-session filter and a per-session overview of turns, steps, model time, tool time, output tokens and running state. The clone page takes a repository address and a remembered parent directory with a native folder picker, offers a per-clone shallow switch (off by default), runs git clone on the host, and registers the cloned directory as a workspace.

title: xin505/dsh-task-shelf
description: Organizes task materials and supports session handoffs across workspaces.

title: xine2009cn/dsh-branch-inbox-guard
description: Removes the queued prompts a DSH fork child inherits from its parent, so the first turn in a new branch runs the prompt typed there instead of the parent's next one.

title: xing666173/dsh-vision-hub#bridge-preview
description: Inline preview for \[图片: path] image bridge markers: after the marker renders, the image shows in chat automatically, keeping long instructions out of the conversation.

title: xingyingyuzhui/dsh-session-actions
description: Session row menu extras for DeepSeek Harness: pin sessions, copy session id, export structured Markdown, and permanently delete sessions.

title: xinming-chenniang/dsh-closeout
description: Before closing a coding session or the DSH app itself, checks what would be lost — uncommitted work, unpushed commits, scratch files, missing handoff notes, pending restarts, broken profile bundles — and prints a three-level verdict; when a handoff is needed it writes the seven-section handoff file into the workspace ledger. Read-only by default.

title: xinming-chenniang/dsh-kb-sync
description: Pulls your chat.deepseek.com conversations into a local knowledge base — one Markdown file per conversation, a JSONL transcript and a catalog — and searches them from a control page inside DSH. Daily increments plus a full-history backfill from the official export, an integrity check, and an optional model step that runs through the host llm service and writes only after its JSON passes validation. Reads the web userToken from the DSH credential store and calls chat.deepseek.com only; no install scripts, no runtime dependencies.

title: xlcg10086/dsh-compact-threshold
description: Composer control for the automatic context-compaction threshold. A 20%-80% slider rewrites the running BasicCompactionEngine config per step, shows current usage, context window and the effective trigger line, and compacts immediately when the threshold drops below current usage and the agent is idle.

title: xlxs123/dsh-session-multiselect
description: A searchable, workspace-grouped multi-select panel over DSH conversations for batch delete, archive and pin, with Shift-range and Ctrl-add selection.

title: xohmai/dsh-session-delete
description: Real session deletion with trash and restore, archived cleanup, and batch delete from settings.

title: xqh-jason/dsh-sidebar-delete
description: Delete sessions for real from the dsh sidebar (local logs and projection cache included, subagent and fork children cascade) and manage workspaces and ungrouped sessions, with an optional daily cleanup of ungrouped sessions.

title: xrn1997/dsh-session-delete
description: Adds a trash for DSH sessions: nothing expires automatically. Delete or batch delete moves sessions there, where you can read, restore, or permanently delete them.

title: xuedipiaofei/dsh-session-title-stamp
description: Keeps DSH session titles in DATE | CATEGORY | NAME with turn-aware auto-retitle, title-language control, a settings page, and hover duration/cost/token stats.

title: xuenann/dsh-workspace-purge
description: Deletes a whole workspace together with its conversations in one pass - session logs, projection caches and workspace registrations - and optionally sends the workspace folder to the Windows Recycle Bin (on other platforms deletions are permanent).

title: XvBenny/dsh-chat-search
description: Full-text search over DSH conversation history: decompresses the persisted per-session session.v4.jsonl.zstd logs, matches user/assistant message text, and opens a hit at the matching message (archived sessions are unarchived first). Also binds Ctrl+F.

title: XWIDE/dsh-xwide-handoff
description: Generates a structured handoff card so a near-full conversation continues in a fresh zero-context session: /handoff writes the card with self-incrementing titles, pins it to the top of the sidebar and prepares the new session once the context nears its threshold.

title: XXXXXQ-0206/dsh-session-delete
description: Fork of harness-session-delete that adds Delete to the native session action menu and a recycle-bin page with search, sort, workspace grouping, message preview, batch restore, and per-workspace permanent purge; active sessions are protected.

title: xypang33-sketch/dsh-save-chat
description: Save whole turns — the question plus the full answer — as plain Markdown inside the session workspace, promote the good ones into a cross-project personal knowledge base, and let the model search it on demand. No database and no runtime dependencies.

title: Xzl21/dsh-session-files
description: Per-session file tree: every file a conversation touched, laid out left-to-right by turn and split into deliverable, process, input and temp lanes; click a card to preview, reclassify or annotate. Temp files move into a recoverable trash with batch or single-file restore, batch emptying and an optional retention window. Ships a session_files tool so the agent can tidy up itself.

title: y2zyyr/smart-session-title
description: Replacement session-title provider that compresses oversized or code-heavy first prompts before calling the model (in the tested DSH version the built-in provider rejects inputs above 4096 bytes without a model call) and waits for a real task instead of titling a greeting. Titles use the session’s own provider and model by default and manual titles are protected; title rules cover a character cap, an optional date affix, style, language and exclusion words, plus a per-session lock. Also re-titles stored sessions in bulk, with a progress overlay that keeps running after Settings is closed.

title: yamingmou/dsh-retrace
description: Recall, edit-and-resend and regenerate, plus in-conversation versioning: a timeline of every rewind, artifact rollback (git-first, snapshot fallback), a fork map of explored paths, session lineage, and a real-time watchdog that snapshots the log at the first sign of concurrent writes. Edits auto-stop the running agent (official cancel/whenIdle) so rewinds never corrupt the durable log or break /compact.

title: yang208691-source/dsh-nutstore-backup
description: Backs up DeepSeek Harness sessions, plugin config and workspace memory to Nutstore (Jianguoyun) over WebDAV, with incremental upload, connection test and one-click restore on a new machine.

title: yangdongzhen590/dsh-knj-session-management
description: Session management for DSH: archive, restore and delete persisted sessions, cap how many sessions each workspace keeps, and review disk usage in a size governance panel.

title: yangyizhu8/dsh-session-handoff
description: Session handoff for DeepSeek Harness: the session menu creates a successor session that rebuilds the old session's memory, tasks and rules through an eight-section takeover packet, with light context via on-demand transcript readback.

title: yangyizhu8/dsh-unread-mark
description: Session-row unread mark for DeepSeek Harness: the session menu gains Mark unread and Unmark, pinning a red dot before the session title that survives reload and opening until cleared, both entries disabled while the built-in green finished-unopened dot is present.

title: yangyongzhen/dsh-session-export
description: Export sessions to Markdown/JSON for review, replay, and per-session cost summaries.

title: Yantingmo/dsh-lang-zh
description: Injects a fixed system-prompt section so the agent always replies in Simplified Chinese — including the short narration between tool calls — unless you explicitly ask for another language. Applies to every session and preset without overriding the persona.

title: yanzoro926/dsh-btw
description: One-off btw side questions that inherit the current DSH session, with selectable context ranges and an optional compressed summary you review before sending it into the main session.

title: YB313/dsh-branch-tree
description: Turns a session into a folder in the left sidebar: fork it into an independent branch — full copy, a compressed digest of its memory, or only the opening request — and browse the branches as a tree.

title: ycm50/dsh-compat-val
description: One settings card that gives every DSH agent mode its own compaction threshold: it registers <mode>-compact-<ratio> preset copies with compaction-basic.thresholdRatio rewritten, re-registers when the value or the selection changes, and can adopt one copy as the default mode (standard > cordis > minimal > ptc).

title: ycm50/dsh-delete
description: Session and image management for DSH: a sidebar panel deletes selected sessions together with their on-disk files after DSH has archived them, with multi-select, sub-agent / team-member / whole-family cascade and per-session size; a right-sidebar tab counts a session images and offloads or deletes the selected ones, optionally removing source files and attachment objects from disk.

title: YDT-china/dsh-web-search-session
description: Routes DSH web search through the current session's model and a self-hosted retrieval backend.

title: yeastcloud/dsh-anchor
description: Session instruction anchor for DeepSeek Harness: the first step of a new session injects a freely composed instruction block as a plugin-sourced message, and it is re-anchored after a summarizing compaction, every N turns, or when metered context pressure crosses a threshold. An /anchor command re-anchors on demand without a model call; a settings page manages the paged preset library, injection order, re-anchor source and character limits.

title: YeqingTang/dsh-session-flow
description: Cross-session archive: overview workbench, folded timeline, subagent lineage, full-text search, rule+LLM summaries, ZIP export, live tracking. Native session-page embeds: turn rail, docked right panel (live mode, pinned to original session on switch), rename (official-synced), conclusion digest, health monitoring + persistent header chip (idle / active / tool-wait / stalled). dsh v0.1.2+: fuses with the official TurnNavigatorRail — vector-icon info chips (duration, tool calls, errors, thinking) plus lazy tool distribution inside the official preview card, right-click opens the workbench; the classic piano-key strip is on by default and delegates unloaded-turn jumps to the official auto-load engine; the official rail can be hidden entirely. Settings dialog section with 10 tunable behavior params.

title: YEYEYEYESHIFU/dsh-session-hotkeys
description: Session hotkeys for the DSH Web GUI: switch sessions like browser tabs (positional Alt+1-9, pinned slots, previous/next, new/archive/rename), keyboard model switching via Alt+M, alternate send, Esc focus hand-off, and Alt+W to close or restore a dsh-split-screen workspace — all rebindable with Windows/macOS presets. Verified on DSH 0.1.1 and 0.1.5.

title: yezitotempeace/dsh-big-compact
description: Chunked compaction for oversized sessions: takes over only when the live context exceeds 85% of the model window (or the request exceeds 4 MB), summarizes the history in 1.5 MB chunks and merges them; smaller sessions keep the built-in compaction.

title: yhPrime/dsh-session-delete
description: Add a "Delete session…" item to the sidebar session row menu that moves the session log and projection cache to the OS recycle bin after confirmation, then removes it from the workspace list. Windows only: on macOS and Linux it returns an error and changes nothing; a session loaded in the current run leaves the sidebar only after a DSH restart.

title: yhy854/zhong-wen-thinks
description: A Chinese-thinking plugin built for Chinese users: registers a system prompt section at order -900 so the agent reasons in Simplified Chinese.

title: yiliang114/dsh-session-deck
description: Adds Activity and Favorites views to the DSH sidebar for running, waiting, unread, recent, and natively pinned sessions across workspaces, while preserving the native workspace tree. Targets DSH 0.2.1-rc.2 only.

title: yillkid/dsh-share-room
description: Invites people into one conversation through single-use links with no account: up to 20 guests discuss together and ask the AI, the shared fork runs read-only, and the owner can remove guests or end the share at any time.

title: yindf/taskfold
description: Wraps work in named tasks and, once a task closes, folds its whole span of messages into one summary at the next step boundary; the original content can be restored on demand.

title: yingjian666/dsh-zh-thinking
description: Injects one system-prompt section so the agent's chain-of-thought, planning and tool-invocation reasoning stay in Simplified Chinese. Zero external dependencies - clone and link-install from any local directory, no npm build or publish required.

title: yingqi-studio/dsh-material-library
description: Material library for dsh: collect a folder, file or note from a conversation, keep it in real folders with tags, browse it Finder-style, reopen the source chat's output in one click. Ships a materials_archive tool plus auto-filing rules: file a task's deliverable once, and every later scheduled run files the new documents by itself.

title: ymck-x/dsh-session-continuity
description: Injects a small continuity pointer at the start of a new session, naming the previous session and any handoff file, and reuses DSH's own compaction summary when there is no handoff file.

title: yoinchen23-oss/dsh-message-branch
description: Edit plain-text user prompts inline and resend them in a new DSH conversation branch.

title: you-qilin/dsh-task-instructions
description: DeepSeek Harness plugin: a Task Instructions button beside the input box pins reusable task requirements to a session, and the instruction survives context compression.

title: youqu68/dsh-delete-chat
description: Archive, unarchive, and delete sessions from a settings page.

title: yoyococo1234/dsh-drag-graft
description: Codex-style drag-to-reference for DeepSeek Harness: drag a conversation row from the sidebar onto the chat area and it becomes a native session-reference chip in the composer draft, so you can keep typing around it before sending. Drag a workspace (folder) row instead and the draft gets that folder's path, so a whole directory can be handed to the model. The target session is matched by session id rather than by title, so duplicate or blank titles cannot insert the wrong conversation. The reference cap comes from the host (3 by default) and is read at runtime instead of being hard-coded, so a host-side raise is followed without changing the plugin. If the chip cannot be inserted, the plugin falls back to sending a reference-only message instead of failing silently.

title: yoza10635/dsh-argp
description: Guarded context compaction for DeepSeek Harness (dsh): the LLM proposes, deterministic guards dispose — eager per-atom shrink (extract/summary/false under verbatim guards) + lazy reference-graph eviction (0-LLM) + byte-exact recall from an append-only log.

title: yuan-source-666/dsh-ptc-discipline
description: PTC agent preset whose tools.guard refuses tool calls until the session holds an active goal and an in-progress todo.

title: yue7ye/dsh-Context-Drawer
description: When a live session's context passes a threshold, append older messages to a per-conversation folder on disk, then release the oldest finished turns from the model-visible context; the chat transcript and the session log stay untouched.

title: yuezengwu/dsh-explain
description: Local-first learning mode: cross-session learning threads with per-source explanations.

title: yuna78/dsh-plugin-multi-chat-windows
description: Side-by-side native chat windows for DSH Web GUI — open several conversations beside the main chat, tile them with one click, minimize into a live status dock, or pop them out into their own browser window.

title: yunfong/dsh-session-md-export
description: Export the current session as a readable Markdown file with dialogue only: user messages, assistant text, and ask_user_question answers, from a session-header button or the /md command.

title: YunongDai2005/dsh-theone
description: Talk about everything in one chat (the main chat): each message is routed automatically to the topic it belongs to, each topic runs in its own background session with its own context, and existing DSH chat history is organized into topics.

title: Yutai233/dsh-daily-report
description: Turns DSH sessions into a one-page daily brief: what you did, tokens spent, where you got stuck and what comes next. A morning card above the welcome-page whale, data pulled from other session plugins, and Windows reminders when you sit too long.

title: yxv1203-collab/dsh-conversation-archive
description: Manage archived DSH sessions on Windows with search, batch restore and deletion, AI-assisted file retention, and verified local or network-directory backups.

title: yyfdfsyyf-source/dsh-context-fold
description: Folds oversized tool results into on-disk spill files with deterministic head and tail markers, indexes compaction summaries in a searchable ledger, and extracts cross-session memories with per-project scoping. Any folded content is restored byte-for-byte on demand through one tool call.

title: Yyhy110421/dsh-broadcast
description: Sends one instruction to a chosen group of existing DSH sessions at once, with attachments, optional answer collection and up to eight temporary subagents.

title: YYJ-python/dsh-focus-board
description: Cross-session task ledger for DeepSeek Harness: one item per request with a step chain, an accordion strip above the composer, unfinished items injected into every step, staleness review with artifact fingerprints, clickable choices that learn repeated decisions, a grant ledger whose four-mode control sits inside every authorization-blocked card, blind-work backfill checklists, and a scheduler that re-judges an item only when a new assistant answer mentions it.

title: yyjsdsg/dsh-summary
description: Write each session's summary as a Markdown file in its workspace, with a page to browse, regenerate and delete them.

title: zaizaizhao/dsh-branchmark#dsh-branchmark
description: While vibe coding, save an answer you may need later, use Side Chat for a question that suddenly comes up, or open a related conversation for deeper work without losing focus on the current task.

title: zangxx66/dsh-prompt-setting#dsh-prompt-setting
description: DeepSeek Harness Default System Prompt Management Plugin: Browse, search, and override the final system prompt assembled into each session round within the Web GUI "Settings".

title: ZCasual/dsh-context-diet
description: Elides stale, oversized plain-text tool results from the model-visible session surface once the prompt cache goes cold, replacing each with a stub that keeps the tail lines and any error lines, and reports per-request and cumulative savings in the composer footer.

title: DSH 工作区前端重建
description: Rebuilds the sidebar into a workspace / group / session tree: drag sessions between groups, per-session context-usage ring, scheduled-task clock, cost tag, resize handles, 20%/40% context alerts and the balance in the workspace header. Client-only bundle, no host changes.

title: zchuxi/dsh-restart-task
description: Recovers broken DSH turns: widens the product's own retry budget and renders the wait as a live countdown inside the same step, keeps a truncated output alive inside the same turn, and can open an opt-in continuation round when a turn has already ended; while the composer is empty it hands the send button to that continuation.

title: Zci514/dsh-nightwatch
description: Keep this session working until a wall-clock deadline: one button in the composer picks 22:30, +90m, or tomorrow 07:00, and after every finished turn the plugin posts one continuation message so the session keeps working; nothing is posted once the deadline passes. Stops early on a round cap (400), three consecutive failed turns, or four consecutive rounds that called no tool; a manual stop button is always there. The last part of the watch switches to wrap-up wording, sized to at most half the remaining time so a short watch is not entirely wrap-up. Armings persist to $DSH_HOME/nightwatch.json via an atomic write and are re-adopted after a restart. No slash command is registered by default (enableCommand turns one on); the continuation message carries source.kind cordis-host-runner, not user.

title: zdjmrq/dsh-compact-control
description: Adjusts the context-window percentage at which DSH triggers its native automatic compaction: a slider on the plugin page in the plugins manager sets it from 1% to 100% (default 80%, arrow keys adjust by 1%), and the retained-history budget shrinks with lower thresholds so early compaction is not defeated; the compaction run itself stays with the native engine.

title: zenghang25/dsh-session-delete
description: Adds a one-click delete-session row to the DSH sidebar session menu: moves the session log and its per-conversation .dsh-sessions artifact directory to the Windows Recycle Bin, with no confirmation dialog.

title: zengxiaolou/dsh-session-rail
description: Progress tab for the DSH right sidebar: the turn status of the session and the progress long-running tasks reported, in one tab beside the conversation.

title: ZeroKingHao/dsh-cleaner#plugin
description: Session deletion for DeepSeek Harness: a sidebar menu item, a workspace-grouped batch cleanup panel and a session_delete tool (dry-run by default). Deletes session logs, projection cache, workspace-registry references and derived search indexes, and cascades to all subagent sessions.

title: zf-666888/dsh-session-id-for-desktop
description: Adds Copy session ID and permanent deletion of a Conversation's log, projection cache and workspace references to the session row's ⋯ menu, behind a two-step confirm.

title: zhangyahao/dsh-longtask-guard
description: Externalizes oversized assistant and tool messages in long sessions into project files while keeping a recent window, and archives reasoning from empty turns as a visible message so long tasks do not stall on context size.

title: zhangyy0423/dsh-veripipe
description: Keeps a per-turn receipt that later turns do not clear (final todo counts, goal id and phase, end reason, and a fail-closed pass/fail/inconclusive plan verdict), plus a read-only tool to read recent receipts. Stores counts and ids only.

title: Zhao0335/dsh-conversation-retry
description: Edits a message you already sent and re-runs from that point by forking the session, and retries a completed turn, in the DeepSeek Harness Web UI.

title: zhaolianghz/dsh-turnscope
description: Per-turn file changes, per-file diffs and deterministic safety verdicts for DSH sessions, plus a preview-first rewind that refuses when the worktree has drifted since the preview.

title: zhaoqianguo/dsh-session-trash
description: Adds a recoverable trash bin for DeepSeek Harness sessions: right-click delete, restore, permanent purge, configurable retention with automatic expiry, batch restore and purge, capacity stats for bin / archived / active sessions, archive takeover that can unarchive or move archived sessions into the bin, and 10 agent tools. Entries are deleted permanently after 30 days by default, and the agent tools can purge entries or empty the bin.

title: zhengjy01/dsh-period-report
description: Free-interval session reports with AI-narrated daily/weekly digests over any date range, plus every-N-days scheduled reminders with system notifications (macOS / Linux).

title: zhengkaixing/dsh-conversation-queue
description: Caps how many DeepSeek Harness conversations run at once, so extra conversations wait in a FIFO queue instead of piling up model requests. On Windows a bottom status strip shows physical memory, commit memory and disk usage; on other platforms only the queue and physical memory are reported. A plugins-page card changes the limit.

title: zhenyu-24/dsh-workspace-manager
description: Workspace manager in the sidebar: a workspace-to-session tree table with name and path search, column sorting, unarchived-session counts, batch archive, session and workspace rename, workspace removal that keeps files and logs, and extra source folders per workspace passed to the agent as context without granting file access; the same operations are exposed as a workspace_manager tool.

title: zhezhi33/dsh-session-recycler
description: Two-stage session deletion for DSH on Windows: move a conversation to the recycle bin and restore it to its original sidebar slot; deletion confirmed in two steps to prevent deleting files by mistake, clearing the whole subagent tree, sidebar ledger, projection cache, log lines and exclusive attachments along the way. It also scans the files a conversation actually wrote, adds a file query that pastes the path information into the conversation so an agent can judge which files are safe to delete, highlights them in Explorer, and copies the paths grouped by type. Both this and iamwuzhanglin/dsh-session-recycler install under the package name dsh-session-recycler, so install only one of them.

title: zhou1736948757-cpu/dsh-auto-continue
description: Automatically sends a "continue" prompt when a reply is cut off at the output token limit, resuming long answers without manual input; aimed at self-hosted Ollama deployments with small output caps.

title: zhukeu2-lang/dsh-takeover
description: Adds a "Handoff session" item to the session context menu: pick an older session, choose how the new one should read it, and a fresh session is created with the handoff instruction pre-filled in its composer while the old session stays untouched. Three read modes — the AI decides what to read, a six-part summary written into a .md file, or just the last 20 turns. The second tab turns those .md files into a cleanup list grouped by workspace, deletable once the receiving session has run 3 turns or the handoff is 7 days old. All file, record and turn-count operations run in the host process; the browser half only renders and requests. Requires Windows and the DSH desktop app (it uses Electron shell.openPath and explorer.exe/cmd.exe).

title: zhuto666/dsh-compact-agents
description: Model-callable compact_agents tool that force-compacts context in every live session (main session, ordinary sub-agents and AgentTeams members alike), queues busy targets and compacts them when the turn ends, reports the shadowed node count and estimated tokens per target, and ships a browser form for the trigger ratio, retained ratio, controlled-phase output budget, auto-continue budget and an end-of-turn pre-compaction ratio that compacts near the trigger line once a turn ends, so a reply no longer opens with a wait for the summarizer.

title: ZilongYang/dsh-session-mng
description: One Settings page for every DeepSeek Harness session: browse active and archived sessions by workspace, generate a title from the whole conversation for live or archived sessions, archive or restore, move a cold session to another workspace, and permanently delete an archived session (with its subagent descendants after confirmation).

title: ZilongYang/dsh-session-titler
description: Adds a manual, confirm-first title generator: a header button and a session-row menu entry ask a model to summarize the whole conversation, show the proposal in an editable dialog, and rename the session only after you confirm — without registering a title provider or changing automatic titling.

title: Ziminli/dsh-session-search
description: Search stored DSH conversation text across all or selected workspaces and sessions, with exact, regular-expression, typo-tolerant or word-internal subsequence matching.

title: ZiYuan258/dsh-prompt-enhance
description: Maintained fork of dsh-prompt-enhance, brought up to DSH 0.1.7 — the plugin would not even load on current hosts (InputState.imageIds became attachmentIds, so the composer button crashed the input box; settings.get() was removed; /enhance read a session id the agent no longer exposes). Rewrites default to reasoningEffort off, which measured 252 output tokens for a draft where the model default spent 2897, and a Settings page for all 17 fields is bundled. Verified on a real 0.1.7-rc.2 host: activation, a live HTTP enhancement request, /enhance in the GUI, and the Settings page reading and persisting configuration. 204 tests.

title: zljr/dsh-share
description: Share the current session over the LAN as a read-only, token-guarded HTML snapshot with session stats and Markdown rendering.

title: zlqd123/dsh-timed-send
description: Timed send for the chat composer: pick a moment and the host delivers the message then. Inside an existing conversation tasks join that conversation; from the new-session screen each task gets its own pre-created session.

title: zmengle/dsh-plugin-artifacts
description: Workspace artifact manager that sorts files into artifact, process, memory and material roles, with extra workspace roots, 12 file types, a year/month/day timeline, preview, rename, trash, zip archive and optional COS sync.

title: Zn-Dk/dsh-session-explorer
description: Message-level full-text search across DSH sessions via an FTS5 trigram index (user / assistant / steering / tool with per-kind filters), deduplicated results across fork/continued sessions, read-only context preview with auto-scroll to the focused message, one-click jump to the real session, and incremental/full index rebuild with health check; zh/en i18n follows the Host locale service.

title: Zn-Dk/dsh-session-repair
description: Diagnose and safely repair corrupted DSH session history: raw zstd/JSONL validation, tool-call ID repair, single-slot pre-repair backup, restore, and an audit trail.

title: zongyanbai/dsh-context-continuum
description: Replaces rolling narrative summaries with an append-only session index, so early facts survive compaction verbatim and shadowed text stays retrievable by anchor.

title: zrrrrrrr77/dsh-breather
description: Take a breath mid-task: the current step finishes, then it holds. Resume sends no new request and spends no tokens; the timer freezes. Current session only.

title: ZRui-C/dsh-minimal-first-turn
description: Minimal-compatible first turn for Web root sessions: starts with persistent bash and str_replace_editor, removes automatic workspace and skill context, then restores the selected preset after the first tool call or reply; includes a persistent composer toggle.

title: zsenpro/DSH-Quickly-clear
description: Adds a delete row to the menu of an archived conversation only, and after a confirmation removes the session log directory, its projection cache, the archive and pin marks and the workspace booking together.

title: zsenpro/DSH-Transpose-Plugin
description: Moves a conversation into another workspace: long-press its sidebar row, drop it on the target workspace, and the session log with its full history is relocated and re-pointed. A plain drag still does the sidebar's own reorder inside one workspace.

title: zsjs110110-cpu/dsh-cross-session-approval
description: Cross-session task delegation for DeepSeek Harness: spawn durable top-level sessions and send them tasks, read or steer them by base62 session alias, and approve their sandbox escalation requests through an approval bridge that refuses destructive deletes.

title: ZSQBFan/dsh-chat-sessions
description: Create a chat with its own workspace in one click, so everyday questions and small tasks can start without manually choosing a project directory.

title: zxsimple/dsh-revive
description: Session replay view for DSH conversations: replays a session turn by turn at reading pace for prompts and answers while reasoning and tool output stream past, and every prompt is followed by a one-second pause. It can also re-run the original prompts in a new session, and record the replay — screen recording the conversation itself — to a WebM video through a 1280x720 canvas, with no OS screen-recording permission.

title: zyd232/dsh-compaction-policy
description: Stops DeepSeek Harness from compacting (summarizing) your conversation far too early. Without it, compaction fires around half-full on smaller context windows; with it, compaction waits until the window is as full as you want (80% by default), settable per provider/model. It only changes when compaction happens — what a summary keeps is still DSH’s decision.

title: zyf2492313716-cloud/dsh-session-hub#plugin
description: Cross-agent session browser for DeepSeek Harness: mounts /session-hub/api/* and a Settings > General status row to read and search OpenCode SQLite, Claude Code JSONL, Antigravity, Qoder CN and DSH zstd logs, plus explicit continue-in-DSH and export. Its /session-hub/api routes are mounted without DSH's access check, and on startup it registers the workspaces found in those other agents' histories into DSH.

title: ZyxQl-Ala/dsh-rollover
description: Context rollover: auto-saves a handoff before the context window fills and re-injects it once in the next session segment. Two tools and a settings panel.

title: ZZJQ678/dsh-global-context
description: Adds a Global Prompt tab to the conversation view: text you write there is prepended to the top of every session system prompt, and saving takes effect on the next message without a restart.

title: ZZZZZZZ-ZZZZZ/dsh-attachment-library
description: Read-only attachment library: lists every image and file attachment stored on this machine, its size, and which conversations (including those in the session trash) still use it, with Show in Finder and Open in Preview.

title: ZZZZZZZ-ZZZZZ/dsh-session-trash
description: Session trash: move conversations to a trash instead of deleting them, restore them, or delete them permanently after a second confirmation; a session opened in this run is hidden and moved at the next start.

title: 00080000/dsh-project-memory
description: Project memory for dsh with native task-system integration: session todos and file reads auto-condense into cross-session task records (task↔file links), so workflows are switchable and resumable without re-contextualizing. Read-time memory (no upfront scan): extracts code symbols, summarizes docs, and cross-links docs↔symbols; optional TS semantic enhancement (auto on when TS installed). Experience notes auto-dedup. Every recall includes a traceable citation. Pure JS, single dep, works out of the box, silent operation, zero overhead.

title: 0Junze0/dsh-mem0
description: Long-term memory on top of mem0 and a local Chroma store: user profile and recalled facts injected through the system prompt, capture at session end, a nightly pass that dedupes, merges paraphrases and resolves contradictions, a persistent topic graph written as Markdown cards, periodic export to a git repository, and a full-page memory UI with search, bulk merge, snapshots and undo. Needs a manual Python venv setup plus LLM and embedding API keys before use.

title: 0x7A7A6572/dsh-forge-studio#plugin-memory
description: Cross-session memory for DeepSeek Harness: agents save, search and update user preferences, facts and project decisions; important entries are injected into later sessions, and a Settings section lists, edits, archives or deletes them.

title: 1014029855/dsh-codevault
description: Reading archive for dsh: after reading open-source code, capture quick notes or write full deep notes that group into one card per repo / file / symbol, stored as an append-only log of Markdown notes you can open in Obsidian; query your history, browse recent reads, or search your own Obsidian vault and link related notes to a reading record. Nine tools, a /codevault command, and a code-reading skill.

title: 1015677515/dsh-prompt-ErrorNotes-desk
description: Captures the agent's own self-reported mistakes into a categorised lesson library that is re-injected into the system prompt every turn (each captured draft is confirmed or edited by the user before it is recorded), and adds two conversation-header panels for editing the cross-conversation global prompt and a per-session prompt.

title: 1129742588/dsh-memory-tiers#core
description: Six-layer local memory for dsh: captures turns, stages them through an L2 buffer into DL3 summaries via a staging model, injects a stable memory block each turn and replaces chat history with placeholders. Ships five memory tools and a config page.

title: 1148462398-hub/dsh-elysia-memory
description: Elysia's memory plugin for dsh. One shared, human-editable MEMORY.md across every session: two-disk mirror, history snapshots, cross-process write lock; entries tier between the main file and a searchable archive by hit frequency; retrieval is keyword co-occurrence plus BM25. Nine sections (persona, requirements, corrections, lessons, methods, requests, sessions, method library, ingested docs) plus a dedicated self-identity section for a character's own self-cognition, injected above the persona. Ships an opt-in memory pack (packs/elysia: 61,903-char identity + 2,482-char persona, distilled from 1,696 officially-confirmed voice lines and checked against a 112,175-line game-dialogue corpus) that is off by default, backs up before writing, only touches identity/persona, and can be uninstalled. Also a skills library and a sticker library (you import your own images; none are bundled) that sends a fitting sticker at the right moment. On by default: a text bubble with her avatar after each reply, which costs one extra small model request unless the agent already announced (voice.bubble: false turns it off). Opt-in voice playback needs a local GPT-SoVITS engine (about 27 GB, installed separately, NVIDIA GPU required; the plugin downloads about 200 MB of weights) and is Windows-only; the automatic second-drive mirror is Windows-only too (elsewhere set mirrorPath, otherwise there is no mirror).

title: 1292858901/dsh-persona-gateway
description: Turns DSH into a local OpenAI- and Anthropic-compatible gateway endpoint that puts one persona and long-term memory in front of every client pointed at it; requires your own DeepSeek API key — the DSH login credential is rejected upstream.

title: 1326007879-sys/companion-memory
description: Local long-term memory core for DeepSeek Harness with plain-text notes, a bounded index, five tools, optional host-model consolidation and auditable evidence. It appends every user and assistant message under 32,000 characters to ~/.companion/cold/<date>.jsonl in plain text, with no built-in cleanup, and adds a short index of its notes to every system prompt; the optional model-based consolidation is off by default and, once on, sends those messages to the session's model.

title: 135642-163/dsh-knowledge-base
description: Local-first knowledge base for DeepSeek Harness: imports Word/PPT/Excel/PDF (text or scanned), EPUB and MOBI/AZW3, builds Markdown parts with page anchors, OCR quality/confidence and column-aware PDF reading order; adds an LLM-maintained wiki layer (schema.md rules, auto index.md, append-only log.md, typed notes with sources and backlinks), adds source-trust labels (high/medium/low) with trust-aware ranking and low-trust warnings, and supports ranked search, cross-KB query, precise reading/editing, and md/jsonl/zip export. MOBI/AZW3 need Calibre; legacy .doc/.ppt need Word/PowerPoint (Windows) or LibreOffice (Linux); scanned-PDF OCR downloads models on first use.

title: 13576751971/dsh-memory-band
description: Local three-band memory for DeepSeek Harness: a 24h protection band, query recall and scene replay, injected into sessions without embedding or model calls.

title: 1420079678-ctrl/agent-body#dsh-cortex
description: The memory organ of Agent-Body: after 2 minutes of silence it enters light sleep and after 5 minutes deep sleep, where deterministic rules distil real experience into memory cards (pitfalls, playbooks, hotspots, unresolved issues, facts). Incoming commands recall related cards by keyword and inject them into context; cards unused for long decay on a half-life and are archived rather than deleted. It also de-noises body-wide homeostasis warnings: repeats inside a window are counted instead of re-printed, and a warning that keeps recurring without ever healing converges into a known steady-state offset and goes quiet. Consolidation and recall make no model calls.

title: 1720198650/dsh-cognition-engine
description: Lets the AI remember what you said across sessions, and know which facts are still current.

title: 18477514055/dsh-ledger-memory
description: Project-level memory built around a ledger whose structure the AI designs per project; the plugin only handles detection, injection, write-back, archiving and git. Memories are split by meaning: the active ledger holds current state, the turn journal is append-only, and decisions, the goal tree and lessons are one-card-per-file (with a multi-dimension index over the card folders); the fundamental principles file can be changed only by the user. There is a single compaction mode: before compacting, the AI sorts the work into three buckets - what must stay in context and is re-injected verbatim, what is written to the project's _stash/ for later lookup, and what is dropped. When a conversation is opened in a container workspace holding several projects, it can be locked to one sub-project (the lock lives in the plugin's own home and survives restarts; it leaves no marker in your project). Also an activity log with five levels, where L4 stores the user's own words verbatim (never injected, queryable on demand). Before each compaction a verbatim capsule (user quotes, raw errors, changed files) is written to disk, and both the capsule and its source material survive a restart; a handoff document lets a new conversation resume the previous one. 21 tools, 12 subcommands, 39 settings (one of them switches whether the settings panel or each project's manifest wins). Runs locally, no runtime dependencies.

title: 2132774831/dsh-memory-plugin
description: Fully local long-term memory for dsh: cross-conversation and cross-project, stored as a single JSON file on your machine with no network calls, no model calls and no API key. Ships memory_save, memory_search, memory_list, memory_forget and memory_review tools, keyword-and-tag recall injected before each turn with adjustable ranking weights, Markdown import (including Kun and Hermes Agent formats) and export (native and Hermes Agent formats), and a settings page to browse and edit memories.

title: 2930136787xy-tech/dsh-memory-nebula-bridge

title: 382quaii/dsh-Layers-Hippocampus

description: Local Obsidian vault as the agent knowledge store, with read-only DSH tools that route status, preference, correction, memory, project, search, and suggest to the matching page.

title: 863683348/dsh-memory-setup
description: Local, auditable personal memory for DeepSeek Harness: preferences, project conventions, workflows and error lessons persisted as a changelogged JSON file in the workspace, with onboarding, auto project-convention extraction and evidence-backed lessons.

title: 863683348/dsh-plugin-focus
description: Focus board for DeepSeek Harness agents: durable, model-maintained notes in the session workspace that pin the objective, constraints, and decisions across compaction and sessions, with automatic context injection, archive on clear, and an optional web panel.

title: 988hj7tczd-oss/harness-desktop#plugins/harness-memory
description: Cross-session memory for DeepSeek Harness via the official storage domain: memories persist through ctx.storage (storageDomain table) and are injected into the system prompt through a registered section (memory:recall), with memory_save / memory_forget tools so the agent reads and writes its own memory (maxMemories configurable).

title: a1141171521/dsh-plugin-memfuse
description: Long-term memory for DSH stored as plain Markdown. Real user/assistant exchanges are captured into daily session files without a model call; an LLM pass then distils them into memories that are injected into the system prompt each turn. Retrieval is local (CJK bigram + BM25) in three levels — index, summary, full text — so the model only pays for the detail it asks for. Memories carry priorities; P0 and user-written entries are never changed automatically, and forgetting marks an entry stale instead of deleting it, so the whole chain stays auditable in status.md. Six tools cover recall, write, status, extract, feedback and the skill library; when a cluster of memories is ready to become a skill, a card appears at the end of the turn, writes the SKILL.md on click, and installs it only after you approve. Learning is on by default and follows the conversation model; turning the master switch off stops the LLM entirely while capture keeps working. Failures are surfaced in the prompt and in status.md instead of being swallowed. Pure JavaScript, no third-party runtime dependencies beyond the harness packages.

title: a574676848/dsh-compaction-sticky-window
description: Replaces the summarizing context compactor with a handoff note the model writes itself and a fresh window that keeps only the system prompt, the note, and the current turn.

title: adithyanraj03/dsh-memory-recall
description: Persistent memory for dsh in the style of Hermes Agent: a memory tool that keeps a user profile and the model's own notes, delivered to every chat as a logged context message — at the start, after a change and after compaction — and a session_search tool that reads earlier chats only after the user approves, with a Memory panel to see and edit what is kept.

title: adoresever/graph-memory
description: Traceable, searchable cross-session memory for DeepSeek Harness — conversation knowledge as typed graph nodes (TASK/SKILL/EVENT) and typed edges.

title: ai-fu-cn/dsh-plugin-memos-code-retrospect

title: Aik358/dsh-auto-memory

Local Markdown storage, model-agnostic, zero deps; lexical 0GB floor with optional semantic tiers.

title: AirPineApplea/feiyu-memory
description: Cross-session persona and diary for DeepSeek Harness: each turn can leave a first-person diary entry with a short retrieval index, and the next conversation injects the persona, a hand-note file you write yourself, and a dated batch of past entries retrieved by searching the diary text itself; anything older is found through feiyu_recall using that index.

title: aki66938/dsh-natural-dialogue

title: AllenWES365/dsh-local-memory

title: AndyYang12345/dsh-butler-memory

title: AntonyLang/dsh-memory-observer
description: Distills long sessions into background observations and reflections, injects them as a system-prompt section, and renders compaction summaries from prepared memory; includes a Settings page and source-backed recall.

title: aoyamabf-max/dsh-obsidian-memory

title: aqsk-BLG/dsh-memory

title: BangBang-03/dsh-memory

Settings → Memory holds the archive, list and timeline views, a health check (duplicate clusters, stale entries, broken links), the supersede version chain with rollback, and a read-only scan that imports existing WorkBuddy / Qoder memory files.

title: dearbld/dsh-living-memory

title: djasdh/interest-memory
description: Cross-session long-term memory backed by a local Go service (~50MB RAM, SQLite-vec + verify-augmented claims): zero-lag recall injection on every user message, session-end transcript ingest, and memory_search / memory_logs / memory_ingest tools. Install with `dsh plugin --profile web add @djasdh/interest-memory-dsh-bridge`. Protocol bridge only: the Go service is not installed by `dsh plugin add` — install and start it per the repository README first; until it runs, the tools silently return nothing.

title: dogbotowo-oss/dsh-long-memory
description: Long-conversation memory for DeepSeek Harness (DSH): keeps settled decisions, user corrections and exact numbers, with their conditions and sources, available across compaction and restarts in 100-1000+ turn sessions; one small budgeted evidence block per model step, with enabled skill rules re-applied in the same block.

title: domitor-syh/dsh-knowbase
description: Local-first knowledge base for DeepSeek Harness: each base is a folder of UTF-8 text, text PDFs and OCR-read images; the plugin retrieves from the session's selected bases before every turn with Chinese n-gram and BM25, answers carry citations that open in a right-sidebar reader, and the agent gets five kb_* tools (list, search, read, stats, propose text) plus /kb commands for create, use, files, search and rescan.

title: Domush/dsh-plugin-context-mode
description: Native DSH support for context-mode (mksglu/context-mode), intercepting large tool outputs with SQLite FTS5 indexing, BM25+RRF search, and session continuity. On by default: tool outputs over 4 KB are replaced with a short preview while the full text is indexed into ~/.context-mode/context.db, and a section is added to the system prompt. Its ctx_execute and ctx_batch tools run shell, Node, Python, PowerShell or cmd commands with DSH's own permissions and environment (not sandboxed), and ctx_index reads any local file path or fetches any http(s) URL it is given.

title: drscrewdriver/dsh-prime-memory
description: Layered memory for DSH whose agent-facing surface is 10 tools: high-privilege writes (memory_add, memory_delete, memory_import), rumination controls (memory_ruminate, _cancel, _status), and a memory graph (memory_search_graph, memory_expand_graph_node), built over an L0-L3 distillation pipeline that recalls and injects relevant memories before each model step.

title: DSH-Raising-Plan/dsh-context-budget
description: Trim tools for long chats: trim_context / estimate_context_tokens keep the system persona and the last message, drop the oldest user/assistant pairs to fit a turn or token budget, and report before/after estimates; the conversation is not trimmed unless something calls the tools.

title: DSH-Raising-Plan/dsh-mnemosyne
description: Evolving memory infrastructure for DSH — evidence, time, context, and correction for long-term continuity — backed by a local Python 3.11+ memory service (fastapi/uvicorn/pydantic, started automatically as a python3 subprocess).

title: duhuashan/dsh-annals
description: Memory that outlives the session, kept as plain daily log files: one markdown file per day plus a generated index the agent greps instead of re-reading. Registers the annals skill, injects the write-it-down rules into the system prompt, and exposes three tools — annals_init builds the log directory, the index generator and a separate Git repository in one call; annals_query full-text searches past entries and returns them with file and line anchors; annals_links resolves which entry cites which. Reminds the agent once per turn when it changed files but wrote no log that day, and once more when the log was updated but the index was not. Adds a settings page for the six switches.

title: dunxuan/dsh-mimo-context
description: Port of MiMo Code's infinite-context memory: as the window fills it asks the model in the background (the current provider route unless writerProvider/writerModel is set) to write a structured checkpoint and a project MEMORY.md, then, ahead of DSH's native compaction, replaces the visible window with a rebuilt dump of tasks, checkpoint, recent user messages, memory and notes, falling back to a MiMo-style compaction. Memory files live under $DSH_HOME/mimo-context (per session, per project, plus a read-only global one); it adds mimo_* memory, history, checkpoint and rebuild tools and /mimo-* commands, with dream/distill off by default. Needs DSH 0.2.2-rc.1 or a later 0.2.x.

title: dxxCaO/dsh-self-improvement
description: Cross-session memory as plain Markdown per workspace: weighted injection, bi-temporal invalidation, TTL review with stale markers, credential redaction, error and session retrospectives, SOP skills, and approval-gated self-improvement proposals.

title: dyrcjqlgcj/dsh-hindsight-local
description: Runs Hindsight long-term memory on your own machine: after a one-time uvx --from hindsight-embed@latest hindsight-embed profile create server setup (~450 MB of Python dependencies) and with your own LLM key, the plugin manages the local memory server itself (health probe, start, stop, logs), registers ten hindsight_local_* tools for status, page search, page read, recall, remember and reflect, injects a knowledge-page index once per session, writes each finished turn back into the bank, and extracts facts with your own LLM key. Do not enable it alongside the official @vectorize-io/hindsight-coding-agents plugin: both read the same bank and would inject duplicate context. At session end it writes a handoff snapshot that the next session injects as previous progress. The data directory is configurable (dataDir) and scripts/relocate.mjs moves an existing install to another drive, creating directory junctions where the server hard-codes its paths.

title: Echo-Smith/dsh-hy-memory
