description: Three-tier memory (personal, project, session) built on the Hy-Memory engine, with relevant memories injected before each step. Ships seven memory tools (search, add, list, get, update, delete, forget), a settings panel with per-tier lists, editing, change history and duplicate cleanup, real token accounting per write, session summaries written by the engine at session end, and a user profile refreshed from recent memories. Memories can be exported to and imported from MemHub. Needs Python 3.11+ once to install the engine, or uv, which fetches 3.12 itself; uninstalling keeps the stored memories.

title: ECNU/EduWork#dsh-memory
description: Local semantic memory and prior-chat retrieval with source references, editable memories, retention, forget controls, undo, and JSON import/export.

title: EdmundZhangzy/dsh-error-lessons
description: Cross-session error lessons for DSH agents: search past mistakes before handling errors and reuse their verified fixes.

title: EPCN-fla/dsh-observational-memory
description: Distills session work into background observations and reflections to preserve context across compaction.

title: eryucheng/dsh-suzu-memory
description: Per-session long-term memory for DeepSeek Harness, with memory management, persona settings, and compaction prompts.

title: EternalNight996/dsh-memory-eternal
description: A self-contained second brain for DeepSeek Harness — auto-captures durable dialogue knowledge into a local Markdown vault (custom dedup, CJK search, git-friendly), with a graphical knowledge base and an interactive knowledge graph (legend filter, time-dimension coloring, box-select, merge, delete, PNG export/import).

title: EternalNight996/memory-eternal
description: Other memory plugins help your agent remember more. This one decides what is allowed to count: agents propose, a human approves (three-store gate + immutable audit log), and recall runs on SQLite FTS5/BM25 with zero model calls (measured p50 2.3ms). A token ledger shows what recall actually cost. One vault for DSH, Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, OpenClaw, Hermes, MengBot and any MCP client. v0.31 adds five one-click skins (Default, Pop, Light, Resident Evil, Spider-Man) with full-bleed theme banners and per-skin hover contrast.

title: EvoMap/evolver-dsh-plugin
description: A harness that gets smarter the more you use it, with no more goldfish memory. Before each prompt, Evolver recalls one proven strategy from your local history and the EvoMap network; after the turn it grades that strategy by the checks that ran, whether the edits were kept, and how you replied, then reports back to the network, which weighs it by evidence. Every success becomes a shortcut for next time, and every failure becomes a warning.

title: fangqiing/dsh-knowledge-lite
description: Local knowledge base for DSH: one Markdown file per note, with tags, hierarchical folders, full-text search, attachment opening via the system default app, zero-dependency Office text extraction, and citation into the conversation. Built for host DSH 0.2.0-rc.2; on Windows the default root is E:/dsh-kb.

title: fanyingnie2163663/dsh-whale-journal
description: Diary and narrative memory for companion agents: daily first-person entries scoped per group or private chat, refs that can be checked against that day's messages, and a read-only journal page where hand-drawn doodles and photos follow the sentences they belong to.

title: faruzanCN/dsh-memory-cloud
description: Visualizes all DSH session memories as an interactive 3D nebula, with a neuron-signal skin, memory-scaled clusters, zoom-driven detail levels and a live write/read activity stream over SSE.

title: Firefox2100/dsh-agentic-roleplay#state
description: Persistent SQLite session state, story memory and recall, repositories, and model-facing record tools for DSH roleplay plugins.

title: fish9988/dsh-supermemory
description: Cross-session long-term memory backed by Supermemory: pre-step semantic and chunk recall with per-session deduplication, debounced transcript upload, background LLM fact extraction (add/update/delete) with bigram and semantic deduplication, memory_search / memory_save / memory_forget tools, global or per-workspace container scoping, and a Plugins page UI for API key storage, memory CRUD, recall preview and activity log. Requires a Supermemory API key (a free monthly quota is available), and conversation excerpts are uploaded to Supermemory's cloud.

title: fjzzwxp/dsh-mnemosyne-memory
description: Permanent memory plugin for DSH with vector search, LLM reflection, and knowledge pages.

title: FleetingEcho/dsh-handoff
description: Self-maintaining handoff memory per working directory and git branch: records turns, folds them into concise Markdown, and injects the result into future sessions from ~/.agent/agent-handoff, byte-compatible with pi-handoff.

title: flymysql/dsh-memory
description: Cross-session memory vault: remember / recall / forget tools, per-turn prompt injection, and a settings-page entry browser.

title: FogStop/whale-mind
description: Memory engine for a long-lived companion agent: a six-module loop (gate, solidify, store, retrieve, inject, decay) that decides what is worth keeping, distils raw turns into long-term entries, fuses short and long term at recall time, and fades entries that stop being used. Runs offline by default; if DEEPSEEK_API_KEY is set it also sends each message to the DeepSeek API to judge and distil it. Zero runtime dependencies and no build step; ships three switchable panels over the same store - neural brain, memory ring and memory galaxy - so you can watch what it remembers. Non-commercial license: commercial use needs the author's permission.

title: Fqh22/dsh-rag#plugin
description: Per-project long-term memory for DeepSeek Harness: a panel to browse, search and edit what each project knows, and a pointer injected after the first user message telling the agent to read the handoff pack. The memory store itself is a local MCP server (Python + SQLite) in the same repository; install the plugin from npm, then clone the repo, set up the MCP server per the README, and the plugin locates the checkout through DSH_RAG_ROOT or a common install path. Handoff packs are ordered for prompt-cache reuse: stable baseline first, facts appended at the end.

title: freehul/sgme
description: ShiGuang Memory Engine (SGME) bridge: multi-agent shared long-term memory via HTTP — L0/L1/L1.5/L2 distillation, scenario-based injection, unified search, and proactive care signals (memory_search / wiki_search / signal_pull / signal_claim / signal_ack), installable as `dsh-sgme`.

title: Frog755/dsh-hybrid-memory
description: Three-layer local memory for DeepSeek Harness: L1 snapshot memory (MEMORY.md/USER.md) read on demand through the memory_* tools + L2 searchable knowledge base (facts + SQLite FTS5, Chinese search via sliding-window tokenization) + L3 import from Hermes/Claude Code/Codex/WorkBuddy and from approved Agent Hub documents (memory/global, memory/projects, accepted decisions) with content-hash dedup. v0.2.0 removed every automatic injection: memory enters the context only when the model calls one of the 12 memory_* tools, and data stays on the local drive.

title: Gao2612/relationship-notes
description: Private relationship notebook: scores each day of chat from message-level evidence and tracks how the relationship develops over time. Chats, profiles and drafts stay in your browser's local IndexedDB and the plugin runs no server of its own, but using model replies, profiling or automatic analysis sends the relevant chat context to the model service configured in DSH.

title: Genesi599/dsh-plugins#curator
description: Every few turns asks the model whether anything is worth keeping, then sorts the answer into memory, skill or hook.

title: gezi-wen/sage-mem
description: File-based cross-session memory: plain Markdown memory files with automatic retrieval injection, format-compatible with Claude Code's CLAUDE.md and memory files, so migrating is a manual file copy.

title: GIN0076/cross-session-memory
description: Cross-session lesson book (the agent wrong-answer notebook) for DeepSeek Harness: injects a memory index capped at 2 KB verbatim into every turn, adds mem_recall and mem_save model tools whose write gate demands four sections, a locatable reference and explicit human approval before anything reaches disk, registers the /memory command, and keeps every lesson as a zero-dependency Markdown entry in the .memory/ directory.

title: GIT121995/dsh-memory-gate
description: Bounded local memory with CBDC authority gating: SQLite + FTS5 claims, scoped recall with explainable use/verify/ignore decisions and a full audit trail, /memory commands, ≤3-claim/1200-char injection per call, no extra model call.

title: giter00/dsh-headroom
description: Automatic context compression for DeepSeek Harness: compresses tool outputs before they reach the model and keeps every lossy compression reversible via CCR retrieval tools.

title: gjhhjfgh/mirror-dsh-adapter
description: Local-first memory governance: distills conversations into categorized memories, surfaces conflicts for human arbitration, and previews what gets injected next turn.

title: Gladess1102/dsh-g-memory
description: Cross-session semantic memory for DSH: indexes session history locally with EmbeddingGemma 2 embeddings and recalls relevant past context, injected as clearly-framed untrusted context. No npm runtime dependencies; synthesis is opt-in.

title: GodCC6/dsh-claude-memory
description: Read-only bridge that surfaces Claude Code's existing project memory in DSH — git-root-aware resolution, credential redaction before injection, and an on-demand recall tool. Zero runtime dependencies.

title: GreatArrow-ai/dsh-greatarrow
description: Connects dsh to the GreatArrow.ai MCP server over Streamable HTTP, so the agent can search and save workspace memories, tasks and decisions shared with your other AI clients; a config-only bundle that reads the token from great-arrow.token in the dsh home, never from the environment.

title: greyoak111/siyuan-codex-bridge
description: Connects DeepSeek Harness to a local SiYuan (思源笔记) desktop app: registers its note tools as mcp__siyuan__<tool>, exposes the AI configured in SiYuan together with its agent loop as one more tool, ships a notes skill, and enforces a readonly/authoring/full profile on every call while keeping the tool list available when the app is closed.

title: guo6x/dsh-palate
description: An accumulated design-taste corpus for DSH agents: feed good and bad examples, distill principles, and review new designs against learned judgment rather than a fixed ruleset.

title: han0han0le0ni/dsh-daughter
description: Five-layer persona (L1–L5), event memory with FTS5 plus Dice retrieval, cognitive filter, skill cards with auto-frozen asset packs, millisecond reflex rules, three-tier safety degradation, a read-only brain star map, and an optional VPet-Simulator MOD bridge.

title: hanhan9999999999999999999/dsh-memory-nebula
description: Local-first memory nebula for DeepSeek Harness with graph views, evidence chains, hygiene checks, and offline snapshots. Reads the memory stores of every workspace and of other memory plugins (read-only, for example meow-memory's SQLite) and writes only under $DSH_HOME/memory-nebula. Registers 9 agent tools and a system-prompt section (usage rules every turn, plus not-yet-read neighbouring memories after a few reads); its /export and /share endpoints return the full memory text without authentication on the local server, and an optional standalone engine listens on 127.0.0.1:7890.

title: hcg91/spike-ltm
description: Local long-term memory for DeepSeek Harness with SQLite storage, automatic extraction, semantic recall, corrections, reliable forgetting, and an in-app summary dialog.

title: Heart3-XDUGT2/dsh-memory-agent
description: Local DSH companion plugin with long-term memory, graph-assisted retrieval, emotional state, reflection, group context, and audit views. Targets Windows with Node 24 and Python 3.14 (the basic engine uses the Python standard library, no pip; without Python it falls back to the JS retrieval path).

title: hellosky983/dsh-qrcode
description: Offline QR code (SVG/PNG/ASCII) and barcode (Code128/EAN-13) generator for DeepSeek Harness, no network and no shell.

title: hellosky983/dsh-skillradar
description: Scans the skills visible to the current session and ranks them by relevance to the recent conversation.

title: HERO476/dsh-instruction-memory
description: Standing instructions edited in the DSH settings UI and injected into the system prompt of every subsequent turn.

title: HiAi-gg/docsmint#dsh-docsmint
description: DocsMint workspace panel and agent tools for document search, reading, creation and updates through Cloud OAuth or self-hosted API keys.

title: highland0971/dsh-native-memory
description: Native per-workspace memory on the harness's own seams: facts and a bounded always-on profile on the storage-domain JSON unit, approval-gated writes with `(sessionId, seq)` citations, deterministic recall plus session-query FTS over past sessions — no external server, no custom SQLite.

title: hmlyx/dsh-memory
description: Persistent conversation memory for DeepSeek Harness: memory tab, automatic AI naming, per-AI privacy isolation, sidebar AI names, and automatic experience archiving. A static profile plugin available in every preset without disappearing on restart.

title: hr98w/dsh-memory
description: Claude Code-inspired Auto Memory meets Codex-inspired Session consolidation, bringing simple, transparent, and context-efficient long-term memory to DeepSeek Harness.

title: htcqp802/dsh-knowledge-base
description: General-purpose knowledge base for DSH: import md/txt/json/yml/docx/pdf, folder management, FTS5 full-text search (BM25), and a Web management UI.

title: Hua1Q1nG/dsh-hindsight-local-optimize
description: Local-memory lifecycle for the official Hindsight plugin on DSH desktop: one-click start/stop of the hindsight-embed daemon, auto-start on boot, stop on exit, hides the uv.exe console window, and installs the vault/models to another drive.

title: Hua1Q1nG/dsh-prompt-self
description: Rewrites each request against a learned prompt profile and automatically updates habits, anti-hallucination rules, and learning records.

title: hzh5021/dsh-memory-watch
description: Warns the session to flush what matters before context compaction kicks in, and rolls a long-term ledger into a frozen archive with a digest of title plus up to three lines per moved section. The roll-up stays off until home is set.

title: hzh5021/dsh-wakeup
description: Injects your home folder — identity, house rules, recent diary and ledger — into every new session before anyone speaks, and keeps that home writable so the agent can amend its own persona. Does nothing until the home folder exists (default dsh-home under the user home, or set home in the config).

title: i11ustriouS/dsh-mnemosyne
description: Layered long-term memory for DeepSeek Harness: each turn injects a persona frame plus a relevance-ranked memory index while full transcripts stay on disk and are expanded on demand, so the vault never floods the context window. Facts are slot-keyed, so a changed mind retires the old value instead of recalling two contradictory answers. The persona frame is derived from memory by the model itself, behind three anti-pollution gates (rejecting development chatter, blocking echoes of its own injection, and merging restatements by shared content words). Periodic consolidation merges near-duplicates, rolls long topics into digests, and archives low-value old entries by tagging only — raw text is never deleted. The append-only store is compacted in place (measured 4.7 MB to 355 KB). Zero third-party dependencies, no build step. Note: per-turn injection inevitably lowers prompt-cache hit rates, so this plugin is not recommended for work scenarios.

title: IAMLieutenant/dsh-tool-user-memory
description: Local Markdown user and project memory for DSH: pinned preferences, keyword search, soft invalidation, history and archive, and JSON migration with preview, backup and rollback.

title: ICCuse/dsh-file-memory
description: File-backed working memory: memorize/recall key premises verbatim in a session notes file so they survive context compaction losslessly.

title: ICCuse/dsh-knowledge
description: Bridge into a global Markdown knowledge base shared with the Codex kb.cmd CLI: kb_add/kb_search/kb_show/kb_timeline tools with byte-compatible frontmatter.

title: ICCuse/dsh-premise-guard
description: Post-compaction premise-drift guard: injects a one-shot notice when a compaction summary drops a critical literal anchor.

title: icearia0219/dsh-memory-spaces
description: Human-governed cross-session memory spaces with independent source and consumer relationships, provenance, versioning, and pre-send injection review.

title: Icstick/dsh-adaptive-context
description: Governed long-term memory for DeepSeek Harness: append-only evidence ledger with write guards, 7-tier authority claims, supersede chains, and budgeted pre-step injection with per-domain quotas.

title: Icstick/dsh-inject-scheduler
description: Injection scheduler for DeepSeek Harness injection planes: cross-plugin sections register/order/account on the official storageDomain, with conflict detection and per-session budget summaries (B10 panel data source).

title: IcyDate/ofttold-memory
description: Memory the assistant writes and maintains itself — diary, index, self-description, the live emotion value — put back in front of it at the start of every session. It reads only the sections you name, never summarises, fills in missing starter files, and stamps a start date into an undated anchor in place — apart from that one additive edit it never changes an existing file. The writing side ships as skills.

title: Ikalus1988/MisakaNet
description: Failure-recovery memory: search and record failure-recovery lessons from real engineering sessions, with BM25 + semantic RAG retrieval and a lessons knowledge base.

title: illli-studio/mory#dsh-mory
description: Personal memory sidebar and agent tools for Mory, with search, editing and optional GitHub/Gitee synchronization. Requires a Mory service installed and running on the DSH host.

title: imaused/dsh-kb-lite
description: Local knowledge base for DeepSeek Harness: six tools to ingest Markdown, plain text and PDF files, search them with BM25 or hybrid BM25 plus optional local embeddings, and answer with cited source passages. Runs offline with no database server. Requires Node.js 18+ and Python 3.9+; PDF ingest needs pymupdf.

title: imaused/dsh-memory-archiver
description: Approval-free memory archiving for DeepSeek Harness: writes Markdown memory files without approval prompts, backs the old file up before any overwrite, marks a revised conclusion as status: superseded in one call, and prunes old backups after 30 days by default (optional size cap). The writable scope is hard-limited to configured memory roots (default ~/.dsh/memory). Companion to dsh-kb-lite, which indexes these files and down-weights superseded ones. Host-only, no npm dependencies; requires Node.js 18+.

title: isheng-eqi/dsh-hermes-memory
description: Faithful port of the hermes-agent MEMORY.md / USER.md mechanism for DSH: bounded dual-bank memory (2200/1375 chars), a single `memory` tool (add/replace/remove/batch), frozen-snapshot injection per session, nudge reminders, DSH-native JSON storage — zero external dependencies, zero LLM cost.

title: IStarFoxI/dsh-memory-calendar
description: Local-first long-term memory for DeepSeek Harness: text packages, on-demand recall, raw event citation, multiple brains and workspace boundaries.

title: itr-del/dsh-cue-bank
description: Cross-session event-cue memory for DeepSeek Harness: auto-extracts task/conversation cues and user language habits from every turn into a persistent global cue bank, then re-injects remembered context on topic-switch detection (keyword or vector matching).

title: iwtown/dsh-llm-wiki
description: Karpathy LLM Wiki pattern knowledge base for DSH: wiki-write/wiki-search skills, zero-dependency pipeline (lint/index/mnemon memory sync/quality feedback), minimal lifecycle plugin injecting schema + knowledge preview, SiliconFlow semantic recall via an Ollama-compatible proxy.

title: Jackbessaliuz/dsh-memory-semantic
description: Read-only semantic retrieval for meow-memory: a local bge-m3 vector index over memory entries and conversation turns, a knowledge graph, and verbatim turn recall. Never writes back to the memory store; requires meow-memory.

title: jackyytche/dsh-hindsight-memory
description: Hindsight long-term memory for DeepSeek Harness: injects relevant memories before each turn and retains finished turns to a Hindsight bank. Requires DSH ^0.2.0-rc.1 (verified on 0.2.0-rc.2).

title: Jasery/dsh-workbuddy-memory
description: Shares one set of Markdown memory files between DSH and WorkBuddy: project memory, user memory and the user profile are injected into the session context, while daily notes stay out of the prompt and are read, appended and archived through the tools. Six tools (status, read, search, append, edit, prune) write back through a cross-process lock, revision check, backup and atomic write, and a panel in the left rail and the right sidebar edits entries, sections and whole files.

title: jayhchen/dsh-cc-auto-memory
description: Claude Code-compatible persistent memory: the host injects the MEMORY.md index at session start, the model maintains memory files with plain read/write/edit tools, and a Settings page lists saved memories. Same on-disk format as Claude Code; claude mode shares the exact memory directory.

title: JayYuen666/dsh-lesson-loop
description: Turns guard denials, gate failures and human thumb-downs into project lessons, and injects only the rules a human has armed into each new session of that project; it registers no model tools and is reviewed through its settings card.

title: Jesse-njx/dsh-memory
description: Cited memory over DSH's lossless session log: distilled facts carry `(sessionId, eventRange)` citations that expand back to the exact original log excerpt.

title: JevonsCode/fuli#dsh-connector
description: Connects DSH to a local FULI install: each turn gets FULI's task entry (saved preferences and project facts) as a context message, a completed turn closes its FULI task, and FULI's MCP tools are mounted. Requires FULI 0.27.0 or newer on the same computer.

title: jiayan-xu/dsh-memoria
description: Vector + graph memory backend: observe/remember/search/recall tools against a local memoria server, fusing HNSW semantic recall, FTS5 keyword search, and knowledge-graph signals via RRF ranking, with automatic turn-end persistence and per-agent namespace isolation.

title: jiayan-xu/dsh-memoria-extra
description: Advanced memoria tools: session context injection (profile + recall), recent decisions, health report, namespace allowlist, memory relation graph, and entity search; companion to dsh-memoria.

title: JiewiW/dsh-derive-watcher
description: Semantic context watcher for DSH agents: maintains a journey ledger with flash summarization and MinHash novelty detection, folds milestones, and can inject long-term context with a three-level stall response; injection and the stall-2/3 responses are off by default.

title: jinguanghai/deepseek-harness-forge-plugins#forge-memory
description: BM25 keyword-based memory recall.

title: JingxuanC/causal-memory#dsh-plugin
description: Causal memory for dsh: a zero-dependency MCP stdio bridge that mounts the 17 tools of the causal-memory server under clean names (no mcp__ prefix) — decision → outcome edges with typed relations (caused / enabled / prevented) in a local SQLite store that survives compaction — plus a pinned system-prompt section. Requires the causal-memory server binary on PATH (pip install causal-memory, or a prebuilt release).

title: jisi71/dsh-memories
description: Dual-ledger cross-session memory: auto-extracts lasting facts from conversations into MEMORY.md and maintains a PROGRESS.md project ledger, recalling both into every new session.

title: jlnkx5200-beep/dsh-task-checkpoint-guard
description: Local task checkpoints and bounded recovery for DSH, with optional L0–L3 hierarchical memory, dependency-aware retrieval, prerequisite-aware context, and six opt-in memory tools.

title: john-walks-slow/dsh-clear-mind
description: Model-autonomous context compaction for DeepSeek Harness: a mind_map tool surveys the agent context surface (stable seq ids, roles, token weights, clear-boundary markers, the clear-mind playbook), a clear_mind tool replaces a chosen conversation-history span with a model-written checkpoint through the native compaction transaction, call and result pairs self-collapse into one-line tombstones, and a proactive reminder nudges the model when the context grows long or a turn runs too many steps.

title: JOJO-Adam/dsh-memory
description: Three-layer memory for DeepSeek Harness — a small always-on core block plus on-demand topic files (profile, preferences, decisions, lessons), with source-annotated writes and supersede-not-overwrite history, so preferences and project constraints stop drifting between sessions. Local-first: no vector DB, no server, no outbound calls.

title: jojoman2024/dsh-memj
description: A project-scoped memory plugin for DSH. Knowledge authoring and the plugin's own prompts are open to editing, so users can redesign the library structure and how the model is driven without changing a line of code. By default the library is built on one core idea: a project document you design yourself (a handoff by default) is the project entity; the plugin detects which project a session belongs to, binds captured knowledge to that project, and promotes what generalizes into theme and global layers. The most natural logic there is does the pre-filtering of knowledge, with controllable compression and archiving of context.

title: JunNanLYS/dsh-layered-memory
description: Long-term memory for DSH: conversations auto-distilled into atomic facts, scene summaries and a persona profile, with relevant memories injected before every model step. Zero-config out of the box — hybrid BM25 + vector retrieval, optional offline local embeddings, chat/work family separation.

title: Kagurazaka135/dsh-memory
description: Layered cross-session memory kept as plain YAML: facts carry a version history instead of being overwritten, a briefing is injected at session start, and a nightly pass consolidates and shards by topic past a threshold. Zero runtime dependencies, so it also runs inside the dsh Android app (verified there).

title: kelunisi/dsh-neocortex
description: Markdown-authoritative second brain: layered memory, local recall, and a daily Bilibili feed that writes source pages and recent notes back to Obsidian.

title: kentzjh-cmd/tmem
description: Project-scoped deterministic execution trace memory and zero-token session digest plugin for DSH, compiling session histories into guarded playbooks and behavior summaries with inline session_id lineage. Registers the /tmem slash command, recalls memories only on explicit file-path or error anchors in agent/pre-step (skipping unchanged repeated steps), and intercepts tools/post-execute errors and code edits with same-origin L2 fixes, failure-loop warnings, and statistical L1 co-change partner hints (skipping routine read calls when idle). Needs Python 3 on PATH (or TMEM_PYTHON) and spawns python3 -m tmem.cli with a 5-second timeout; stores all data inside each project's .tmem/ directory (no ~/.tmem/ global store) and makes no network requests. It needs Python 3 on PATH (or TMEM_PYTHON) and runs python3 -m tmem.cli synchronously, with a 5-second timeout, on every agent step and tool result; traces are stored in .tmem/ inside each project and in ~/.tmem/ shared across projects. It makes no network requests.

title: kialajin-l/DSH_Plus#dsh-nexus-memory
description: Long-term memory backed by a local SQLite store: project-scoped memory auto-injection with junk filtering, rule-based or model-assisted memory extraction from recent turns, write-side dedup and feedback-weighted ranking. The Python bridge runs on $NEXUS_PYTHON or the DSH-bundled interpreter at <DSH home>/dsh-runtimes/dsh-primary-runtime/dependencies/python/ (Python 3.8+).

title: kianajunjie/dsh-hippocampus
description: Event-based memory for long-lived chat bots: emotion-weighted decay, three confidence levels on recall, superseding outdated facts, per-subject isolation, plus relationship, fact, chapter, skill and gap tables. Ships a CLI, an HTTP endpoint and a DSH plugin bundle.

title: kiefeng/dsh-lan-memory
description: Local-first memory and persona plugin for DeepSeek Harness: four file-backed memory layers (pinned, memory, facts, experience), editable SOUL/MOOD persona, zero-LLM session capture, BM25 recall and a themed mood card; no standalone web panel, Python service, vector database, or API key.

title: kipozannaki/DSH-Headroom-Plugin#plugin
description: Runs the upstream Headroom compression toolkit (headroom-ai, Apache-2.0) inside DeepSeek Harness over MCP: headroom_compress, headroom_retrieve and headroom_stats are exposed as mcp__headroom__* tools backed by the upstream server, installed on demand by uvx. Compression is lossy but reversible — originals are fetched back by hash from a local CCR store. Also ships a registrar that adds DeepSeek Harness to Headroom's own MCP registry, and a model-header sanitizer for the upstream proxy.

title: kkwings/dsh-super-memory
description: Cross-compaction memory for a long session: on compaction it stores what is being dropped, and at question time it injects a few relevant passages (or nothing) so the model can recall what you decided before.

title: kleinklein0824/dsh-obsidian-quote#dsh-obsidian-quote
description: Adds a knowledge-base sidebar backed by the separately installed local Obsidian Quote service: select registered vaults or folders, retrieve read-only note excerpts and cited context, extract rules, generate project convention briefs, and view shared citation statistics.

title: KLRSL/dsh-biomemory
description: Biomimetic memory system for DeepSeek Harness: a single SQLite store (node:sqlite, WAL) whose Markdown tree is kept as a read-only mirror; memory tools, frozen-snapshot injection at session start, graded approval gating, on-demand extraction of the current session, near-duplicate merging, an archive and supersede lifecycle, memory metabolism (dream), memory pins, semantic recall over local embeddings, and the /memory command.

title: knighthongyu/dsh-handoff-compaction
description: Context compression for small-context models: visually configure the compressed context budget, default to an 8k handoff + 16k recent context, and keep full history searchable.

title: kobubu/Rag-Coding
description: Local code memory with automatic source context, symbol lookup, vector search, and dependency graphs for JavaScript and TypeScript projects.

title: KouzakiUmi/dsh-hindsight-gui
description: Adds a Hindsight configuration and status dashboard to the DSH sidebar for connection, model, embedding and bank settings, with health checks and ownership-checked local service controls; memory tools are provided by the separate official integration. Hindsight itself is a separate service and is not installed by this plugin.

title: krodon998/dsh-get-memory
description: Pulls GitHub repo content into DSH conversations at start and writes extracted long-term memory back with SHA-locked multi-file commits at conversation end; per-file read/write permissions, native settings page, turn indicators and global change notices.

title: Kun-Fox/dsh-foxy-memory
description: Connects DSH Foxy to Foxy Memory for cross-platform recall, with local JSONL fallback, platform filters, and a memory browser. Requires dsh-foxy.

title: lanyun077/dsh-project
description: Organize folders and sessions into projects with shared PROJECT.md memory and AGENTS.md instructions injected into every session, plus a project tree sidebar.

title: LAYZR114/dsh-project-memory
description: Polaris Memory: local-first project memory plugin for DeepSeek Harness. Uses per-project .dsh-memory.json; provides memory_read/recall/write/update/delete tools, /memory command and settings UI, with tiered injection (resident user profile + scene-triggered memories with P1/P2/P3 importance), semantic recall (IDF + synonym layer), and a hard-guard mechanism for bottom-line memories (detect deny-semantics -> authorize -> block AI deletion; user can confirm-override).

title: lcthe/dsh-hermes-memory
description: Scoped persistent memory for DSH: memory_save/search/replace/remove/list across global, user, project and failure scopes, DSH storage-domain persistence with secret and prompt-injection scanning, session-scope search, retention cleanup, and optional session-start injection; standing context via memory_pin/memory_pins/memory_unpin.

title: leetom314/dsh-tiered-memory
description: Tiered persistent memory (user/env/project) with per-tier char budgets and semantic query routing; full layers refuse writes instead of silently evicting.

title: lemoncat7/dsh-knowledge
description: Provides local and remote knowledge bases with project- and session-scoped recall, controlled write-back, and an embedded Web management console.

title: Leon-dbh/life-innovation
description: A cyber lifeform that lives in DSH: she remembers people, promises, and the days you spent together, and comes home to a read-only room with four views (today, what she remembers, her room, who she is). She can forget or restore a memory only after confirmation, and can defer or refuse when she is tired. Requires Node 22+ and a DeepSeek API key; the installer and desktop notifications are Windows-only.

title: levodoubt/project-node-memory
description: Markdown-as-database project knowledge base for DSH agents: ten kb_* tools (including kb_register for registering existing notes), stable TIDs, `[[node]]` links that never copy text, `[[tscl]]` definitions expanded in place, bounded reads, structural lint covering tscl, workspace-first library discovery, inline git snapshots, a node-graph panel, and a bundled prompt section plus skill that make the agent reach for kb_* instead of hand-written docs/.

title: LFM097384/Context-Prism
description: Project-level Local Context Engine for DeepSeek Harness: retrieval/compression/prioritization over history, code, files, user preferences and agent trajectories, producing a dynamic context window for any LLM.

title: lgquan/dsh-workspace-memory
description: Workspace-isolated durable memory for DSH, with searchable, auditable, correctable, and removable workspace memories plus controlled global memory.

title: liancha22/dsh-puzzle-mode
description: Keeps project decisions in plain markdown instead of chat history: one main document plus per-module documents, every entry carrying a file:line citation. The agent interviews you to turn open questions into settled decisions, and a five-dimension score (task complexity, extensibility, maintainability, code quality, reusability) is derived from the documents and shown on a button beside the model picker. A session can bind several projects; projects are sized small/medium/large, which widens the entry limits, and a reusable-pipeline section in the main document is injected when its trigger words appear.

title: liangxiaobing520/dsh-local-vector-memory
description: Fully local vector memory for DSH: local embeddings, SQLite storage, automatic recall injection, dedup with conflict detection, soft-delete recycle bin, online backup, and optional LLM extraction.

title: Libraqg/dsh-memories
description: Long-term memory ported from the OpenAI Codex memory pipeline: sessions idle for 6 hours are extracted in the background by a chosen model, then merged by a hidden agent into a Markdown memory folder at most every 6 hours; new agents get the memory summary in the system prompt plus four tools to list, read and search memory and save corrections. Models are chosen on a settings page or with /memories; an optional filter keeps a notes folder out of memory.

title: Libraqg/dsh-workspace-memory
description: Explicit, project-scoped memory handoff: when you open a new conversation, one model call that you confirm curates the project's earlier conversations into a bounded brief and injects it into the conversation's first step. No silent background calls; a Memory panel shows the brief and lets you edit notes.

title: light-cheng/DSH-Mem0
description: Mem0-backed long-term memory for DeepSeek Harness with managed Platform, self-hosted server and local OSS backends; visual settings, automatic recall (from the first turn) and capture, editable memory summary, token budgets and weekly memory hygiene that only deletes memories this plugin wrote. Captured text is redacted; the memory summary is a stable system-prompt section (plugin:dsh-mem0:profile) and recall a separate mem0:recall block appended last, so the cached prompt prefix stays stable; recall and capture have timeouts (recallTimeoutMs, addTimeoutMs). With dsh-strata installed, recall size follows its strataBudget allowance, and the optional captureStrataFolds setting (off by default) also saves its fold summaries as memories.

title: lightporta/dsh-knowledge-center
description: Local knowledge base for DeepSeek Harness: distills workspace and chat-attached PDF, Word, Excel, Markdown, TXT, CSV and HTML documents into Markdown notes, with a VS Code-style viewer, per-workspace access grants and agent tools to search, read and add notes.

title: LingDangZaiXiang/dsh-life-hair
description: Copies the compaction checkpoint into the sticky-notes archive when context is compacted and wakes the session to write what was lost.

title: linner1224/dsh-video-coursemap
description: Windows-only plugin that watches the foreground window title, recognizes Bilibili video courses, classifies them by subject, fetches metadata/danmaku/comments, and generates Markdown + Mermaid knowledge maps and Word study manuals (Word output needs a local Python install).

title: lishicheng2054/dsh-flavor-memory
description: Character-chat memory layer that keeps persona, voice and relationship state separate from summaries, archives every raw message for retrieval, and ships a SillyTavern card importer plus an OpenAI-compatible gateway.

title: LittleBlackTong/dsh-plugin-memory
description: Long-term cross-session markdown memory with an LLM-Wiki structure and a SOUL.md persona, injected at session start (by default only after the first user message and only in the active session), plus remember/recall/consolidate/forget workflows, an embedded memory skill, pack/unpack migration tooling, and an idle-time first-person recall nudge that surfaces real memories in a companion voice. Also gives the store observability and upkeep it lacked: a per-file boot-block budget that keeps the index routing table from being truncated, automatic last_access stamping so salience decay actually works, a read-only memory health dashboard (size, freshness, lint-parity checks), a declarative index compiler (pages declare summary:, one command re-lines the index), an interactive memory graph (page links plus shared tags, draggable, wheel zoom), structured queries (tag/type/salience/hot/stale filters), cross-link suggestions for pages that have no relationship yet, and a `checkup` report that ends in a prioritised action list. The boot payload was also cut by ~23% by moving operational detail into the on-demand skill. Its settings section now carries its own navigation mark (a brain half wired to a node cluster, since the shell offers no icon slot to plugins) and a feedback entry that opens this repository. Requires DSH session format v4 (official DeepSeek Harness 0.1.7+): injected messages declare the producer-owned source kind plugin:memory. v0.11 added a bilingual settings panel whose copy and sidebar label follow DSH language setting (中文「记忆」/ English "Memory"); v0.12 added the shared cross-plugin speech floor, a context-sensitive tone section and a weekly growth recap; v0.13 declares its DSH compatibility via engines.dsh (official 0.2.1-rc.5 series; older hosts are refused by the gate), adds a "Review now" button (POST /api/memory/control, action growth-now) that sends one growth recap immediately while still respecting the speech floor, panel accessibility (aria labels, status and alert roles, focus-visible rings), and the public PROACTIVE-PROTOCOL.md. v0.14 adds per-session memory: a composer chip with a dropdown (this session / workspace default), the /memory on|off|status command, and a settings-panel switch all flip the same gate — off means no boot injection, no digest/recall nudges and no last_access stamping for that session (nothing is deleted); disabledWorkspaces lets whole projects default to off, and session choices persist for 7 days. v0.15 adds a Basic soul (quick forging) card: my name / what I call you / baseline persona, saved into a managed block inside SOUL.md (the rest of the file is left untouched) and marks BOOTSTRAP complete; existing chat-forged souls are echoed from the SOUL text, and the boot block now asks the agent to remind the user to forge first when no soul exists yet. v0.16 turns the memory graph into an interactive 3D sphere (Canvas, zero dependency): drag to rotate, wheel to zoom, drag nodes to arrange them in 3D, double-click empty space to reset, auto-spin (reduced-motion aware); hover or click a node to instantly light up its neighbours (displacement+duration click threshold), and colours adapt to light/dark panel themes. v0.17 adds graph search (ranked matches, the camera flies to the hit and lights up its neighbours), Reveal in Finder / Copy path for any node (the host command is awaited, and the absolute path is copied automatically when reveal fails), Windows support (path-variable expansion, CRLF parsing with style-preserving writes, explorer /select, argv and exit-code handling, case-insensitive workspace matching), plus a much shorter README with real screenshots. v0.18 (issue #8) adds a boot snapshot mode: session freezes the boot block for the session so mid-session memory writes no longer invalidate the prompt-prefix cache (the volatile recent-log tail now rides in its own late context segment), with live kept as the default; double-clicking a memory node now opens the note in the DSH right sidebar (falling back to Finder/Explorer). v0.19 makes the plugin compatible with DSH 0.2.2-rc.2: the agent registry is read with agents.roots() when available and falls back to agents.list() on rc.2, and every agent/created listener is exception-guarded — on rc.2 an unguarded throw there rejects agent registration and no session can be created, so rc.2 users must upgrade to 0.19.2 or newer (0.19.5 is latest). Settings, dashboard and composer chip keep working on both the legacy and the rc.2 host APIs.

title: LIU118117/dsh-love
description: Distills daily chats into an updatable character card and a cross-session emotion module that trains the persona.

title: liuhange789/dsh-dream-reflect-lite
description: Lightweight cross-session reflection: at the end of each turn it writes 3-5 reusable facts (tool chain, file paths, config items, pitfalls) as a card in .dsh/reflections/{date}.md, and on a new session it injects the last 3 cards at the end of the system prompt. Extraction uses the real ctx.llm.stream; when no model route is available it falls back to a heuristic built only from the session log and labels the source honestly on the card. No timers, no quarantine, no approval flow; cards are plain Markdown you can edit or delete.

title: liuhuishang/dsh-five-session-evolution
description: Review every five distinct ended project sessions in DeepSeek Harness, retain sourced lessons and workflow drafts, and supply project memory to later sessions.

title: liuyuhao1122/dsh-hermes-memory
description: Layered long-term memory for DeepSeek Harness with automatic model distillation, source-linked encrypted session logs, and guarded compaction.

title: ljsysfurryACE/dsh-compaction
description: Compaction backend replacing LLM summarization with a deterministic semantic extractor (keeps code/paths/commands, drops chatter) plus 28.4x KV-compression accounting.

title: ljsysfurryACE/dsh-memory-director
description: LLM-driven remember/forget memory: after each turn a model decides what to keep (MemoryDirector), injects relevant memories before each step, dedups, and persists cross-session.

title: LLL-lyh0/dsh-archived-digest
description: Turns archived sessions into durable memory instead of dead disk. Distils each archive into reusable skills, a fact ledger with ADD/UPDATE/NOOP decisions plus validUntil and supersededBy so stale facts retire instead of piling up, and topic clusters by single-linkage similarity. Also digests sessions that are still in progress through a read-only seq watermark, leaving the session log byte-for-byte untouched, and can self-check the growing memory to merge duplicate facts, retire stale ones and consolidate duplicate skills — measuring only unless you opt in, and never hard-deleting, only superseding.

title: Lng-ux/dsh-nebula-mind
description: Cross-session memory for DeepSeek Harness: three-way recall (BM25, dense vectors, and Personalized PageRank over a memory graph) fused with RRF, emotion as a modulation multiplier, power-law forgetting with five sinking layers, and an interactive memory star map. Its HTTP routes have no DSH access check, so a web page open in your browser could call them.

title: LornBerry/dsh-memory-center
description: Local long-term memory for DSH: browse, search (BM25 + synonyms) and edit entries in a panel; folders, archive and a recycle bin; choose per session what to inject; model-written memories need your approval; import/export backups; optionally sync across devices via your own Git or WebDAV.

title: LoserFox/distill
description: Automatic conversation distillation: background subagent reflection + skill create/update.

title: loveandbeepbrother/dsh-galatea#framework
description: Galatea: shape an AI assistant of your own. One assistant with its own persona and long-term memory (git-versioned plain files); long chats hand off to a fresh conversation without forgetting, and it tidies its memory in the background while you are away. It runs on whatever model DSH is set to and keeps its memory when you switch; every module can be turned off, and other plugins can extend it. Phone chat (QQ, WeChat) and Claude Code sessions come from the separate Galatea channels and agent-sdk plugins. Preview; needs DSH 0.2.2-rc.1 or a later 0.2.x.

title: LoveDoLove/Veyra
description: Engineering intelligence for coding agents — persistent, evidence-aware, project-isolated engineering memory with unified hybrid search (memory + RAG documentation) for DeepSeek Harness.

title: lovezi0/dsh-memory-palace
description: Human-readable Markdown memory for DeepSeek Harness: user-level (~/.deepseek-harness/MEMORY.md) + workspace-level memory injected every turn, auto daily-log writing with distillation, bridges existing WorkBuddy/CodeBuddy memory dirs, memory_note / memory_note_user / memory_read tools with built-in dedup, and a bilingual settings page. Plain-text storage, no database.

title: lpf20200901/dsh-memory-delta
description: Layered cross-session memory for DSH that pushes only what changed - the first round injects every active entry, later rounds push only added / updated / removed ones, and nothing at all is injected when nothing changed, with keys that merely repeat an entry id left out of the text so the baseline is about 26% smaller. Facts and decisions carry semantic keys (one active truth per key), the model may only write to an inbox that a human promotes, an entry can carry a review date that raises a one-time reminder when due, and search is relevance-ranked with journal lines down-weighted and Chinese matched by bigram. A sidebar tab tells the lifecycle story instead of listing files - entries are grouped by stage (awaiting confirmation / in use / archived) along four axes (topic - one level, human-assigned, type, tag, date), each group can be ticked for batch promote / withdraw / archive / restore / delete / assign topic, and topics can be renamed store-wide or searched on their own. The archived stage reads in three levels - the category says why an entry left (distilled into the docs / useless for good / not needed right now, the first two being defaults you can add to), below it the entry topic stays collapsed until you click it, and entries with no topic sit right under the category. The tab also shows the global and workspace instruction files plus the current injection size. A zero-dependency CLI ships with it, so the store is usable without DSH.

title: ltl0312/my-dsh-plugins#tlmemory
description: Cross-session and cross-project long-term memory: a non-blocking silent sedimentation dispatch on turn/end writes into a local SQLite store (FTS5 trigram full-text index with insert/update/delete sync triggers) that later turns recall from; entries are scoped per project alongside a global tree, and the plugin ships its own embedded web dashboard (it starts the HTTP server itself, no separate process) for browsing, graphing and controlled deletion.

title: lucagiftzek/dsh-note-keeper
description: Obsidian-compatible Markdown notes in the DSH sidebar with search, tags, backlinks, graph, audio notes with transcription, a paint canvas, OCR (needs tesseract), client-side encryption and notes_* agent tools; the release tarball and the npm package carry a prebuilt Linux x64 daemon, other platforms build it from source with Go.

title: LUgABeEEE/dsh-ctx-budget
description: Static-context audit for a DSH home: a six-layer baseline (rules, memory, skills, tool surface, sessions, KB), broken-path checks for a markdown capability map, memory duplicate/stale/over-limit reports, SKILL.md description compression, and tool-surface plus cold-start static-context estimates recovered from session logs. Four read-only DSH tools; writes require --apply and are backed up first. Requires Python 3.10+ on the host (stdlib only; all four tools shell out to the bundled CLI).

title: Luisarg03/dsh-memory-vault#memory-auto
description: Session-memory autopilot: watches DSH sessions and extracts OKF entries in-process through the harness LLM (ctx.llm, deepseek-official by default) at idle, commit, compaction and end checkpoints, storing them via the vault MCP server.

title: Luisarg03/dsh-memory-vault#memory-mcp
description: Bridges the agent to a persistent OKF memory vault over MCP stdio: a Python server (SQLite FTS5 + Markdown) with 10 tools for searching and storing decisions, facts, learnings, conventions, profiles and sources.

title: Lumivox-wiz/memory-lattice
description: A memory plugin that forgets on purpose: short-term memories expire after 48h, long-term ones are rescheduled by Ebbinghaus/SM-2 curves and rarely-used ones fall asleep instead of bloating your context. Long-term writes stop in an approval center, so the agent cannot rewrite your persona on its own.

title: luxiwusuobuneng/dsh-plugin-context-manager
description: Context manager for DeepSeek Harness: auto-summarizes every turn into priority-sorted records, injects them plus pinned cross-session notes and custom text into each model request, and folds any-size real conversation ranges into summaries to save tokens. Persistent and restart-safe. NOTE: manual multi-step install — copy the three package folders into profiles/node_modules and add the provided cordis.patch.yml rows, then restart DSH; not a standard one-command install.

title: lzk112233/dsh-self-memory
description: Four-layer memory for DeepSeek Harness, ported from the memory design of NoMindSama/qq-dsh-bridge (MIT) with the QQ channel removed: an append-only dialogue log, a weighted long-term fact store with decay and one-way archiving, self-notes the agent writes about itself, Chinese bigram recall over the raw log, and incremental AES-256-GCM sync to a private git repo where only ciphertext is stored. Archived sessions drop out of recall without losing their history.

title: M1r0er/dsh-inkvault
description: Turns a local Markdown vault into two folders the user picks in Settings: a knowledge folder DSH writes notes into, and a memory folder used as the agent's long-term memory with per-turn recall and end-of-turn capture. Pure Markdown with frontmatter, BM25 search, reversible archive, and path isolation that rejects traversal, absolute paths and symlink escapes.

title: Ma354/dsh-limit-break
description: Durable cross-session memory plus a fetch ladder that survives hostname-keyed blocking. Four tools: memory_recall, memory_save and memory_stats over a plain-JSON fact store at $DSH_HOME/memory/facts.json, plus resilient_fetch which tries plain fetch, then a same-service alias host (Wikipedia only for now), then curl over IPv6 and IPv4 (needs curl on PATH). No daemon, no npm dependency, no network at import time. (1.3.0 shipped a fifth tool, memory_prune; it was withdrawn in 1.4.0 because adding a tool to a running plugin breaks sessions that were opened before it.)

title: madage/dsh-self-improved
description: Long-term memory & self-evolving plugin for DSH: L0 capture → L1 memory extraction → L2 scene grouping → L3 user persona, auto recall injection, skill synthesis, fully local (SQLite FTS5 + jieba, optional vector recall).

title: malabananclauss-rgb/qing-self
description: Structural scaffolding for DSH agent continuity: layered memory (hot/index/judgments), judgment cards, handoff packs (compact mode), compaction review. Zero-dependency, pure files, portable — rebuild the 'self' across model changes. Not a memory engine; the skeleton of continuity.

title: Marquez807/dsh-experience-memory
description: Cross-session experience memory for DSH. Lessons are evidence-graded, injected when the turn is about the same thing, and shown just before an action only when the record declares which call it applies to. A rule that holds whatever the turn is about — "always answer in Chinese" — can be marked **standing** and is then carried every turn: measured on 24 isolated real-model turns, a standing rule is followed 6/6 against 0/18 for the controls (empty store, same record unmarked, unrelated standing record). A guess still cannot become always-on: a standing record needs a verified passage like any other. What nobody looks up is retired, reversibly. Five tools, seven slash commands, zero runtime dependencies.

title: MarsStorm/dsh-hierarchical-fishmemory
description: Layered long-term memory for DeepSeek Harness - a merge of AirPineApplea/feiyu-memory 4.0.2, dsh-soul-md and dsh-shallow-memory (do not install it alongside those plugins): a diary distilled from finished turns, a hand-written feelings diary, a persona card with version history, a hand-note injected in full every turn, and a short-TTL note layer, each capped separately so per-turn injection stays small; ships agent tools and a sidebar panel for recall, editing, compaction, and backup or restore from a local file, WebDAV or a gzip archive.

title: Max-Null/dsh-memory
description: Cross-session plaintext memory: deterministic BM25 keyword recall (no embeddings), memory_save/list/search/confirm/forget tools behind a human-confirm gate, and global + project-scoped JSON stores that follow your git repo.

title: meisijiya/dsh-hindsight-memory
description: Bridges DeepSeek Harness to a Hindsight memory service using the same conventions as omp: one shared bank, automatic project-tag stamping, project plus global recall, plus tools for mental models, duplicate detection and retrying failed background operations. Requires a running Hindsight server (default http://127.0.0.1:8888).

title: melandlabs/opencontext#dsh-opencontext
description: DeepSeek Harness integration for OpenContext with durable cross-session memory, automatic prompt capture and recall, session summaries, structured insights, and document retrieval.

title: memorax-ai/dsh-patchouli
description: DeepSeek Harness memory and knowledge hub that routes update, retrieve, and subscribe calls across compatible plugins, with an optional transactional Rust backend.

title: memorylake-ai/memorylake-harness#dsh-plugin
description: Memory Lake as a persistent memory layer for dsh: memory_search, memory_remember, and memory_forget tools over the memorylake CLI, a session status line, and guided setup/diagnostic skills, sharing one ~/.memorylake identity and memory set with the Claude Code and Codex plugins.

title: MemTensor/MemOS#memos-local-plugin
description: Local-first memory plugin for DeepSeek Harness: layered L1/L2/L3 memory with automatic capture, manual memos_* retrieval tools, and a built-in memory viewer.

title: mengxiaoxian/lookover#dsh-expmem
description: Personal-experience memory for DSH: turns solved tasks into sourced problem cases with condition-scoped claims, recalls them into new tasks via hidden pre-step injection, and makes corrections/deletes cascade to future recall.

title: menotbobbybrown/dsh-plugin-memory
description: Persistent long-term memory for DeepSeek Harness: a JSON store of typed entries (fact, preference, entity, rule, episodic) exposed as the memory_remember and memory_recall agent tools, with recall ranked by keyword overlap, importance and access frequency.

title: mess1103/dsh-inner-life
description: A private diary for your agent: eight zero-dependency tools to write, amend, search and export daily entries kept on date-hashed paths the index never records (inner_find returns a day's path on request).

title: meyaomiao/dsh-graphmemory
description: DSH knowledge-graph memory with a better-sidebar tab and a standalone /graph-memory/app dashboard: extracts TASK/SKILL/EVENT nodes, recalls across sessions, and ships as the npm package dsh-graphmemory.

title: MiHjy12138/dsh-memory-lite
description: On-demand memory for DeepSeek Harness: session logs are distilled into layered markdown (a summary, an index and per-topic files), and a mem_query tool returns only the matched entries rather than the whole index. Nothing is injected per turn, there are no dependencies, and every entry keeps a source pointer back to the conversation it came from.

title: mihomooo/dsh-persona-panel
description: A memory panel for DeepSeek Harness with one store per workspace: persona traits, notes about you, dated events, and a first-person diary the model writes and cannot edit. Every entry keeps the quote it came from and can be retracted; workspaces can share one memory and be split apart again; optional per-person profiles for group chats; a capped event list with ★ marks. Local only, no network, zero dependencies.

title: minedalang/dsh-dafeiyu-life
description: A persistent AI companion for DSH that explores Bilibili, interacts with permission controls, and grows through evidence-backed life memories, evolving interests, simulated emotions, social relationships, and autonomous to-dos.

title: MineRPi/dsh-trilium
description: Connect Trilium notes to the DSH agent via ETAPI with 20 agent tools: durable memory (remember/recall + auto-injected index), note management (CRUD/clone/attributes/revisions), full-text search, weekly-report workflow, attachments, calendar notes, backup/import, and a settings card.

title: MingHuanYue/dsh-iter-memory
description: Iter Memory: it remembers my own state, not the facts. A level that drifts back to baseline by itself, plus an occasional line I choose to say only when that level allows it. When it stays quiet, nothing is spent.

title: MingHuanYue/dsh-tide-memory
description: Tide Memory: a long-term memory that forgets on purpose. It keeps what matters and lets the rest fade. Whether an entry enters the context is decided by an evidence score C = s/(s+2): below the threshold (0.35 by default) it never enters. Events decay by half-life (30 days, or 7 days when they carry emotion); facts never decay; superseded entries are kept and marked stale instead of deleted. Recalled lines do enter the context and therefore do consume tokens — small, but real. No embeddings, no network calls, no cloud.

title: MingoYung/dsh-Xiangxu-Persona
description: Persistent persona memory for DSH with a unified recent, long-term and archive timeline, bounded context loading, memory retrieval and isolated task delegation.

title: mingzeng21/dsh-obsidian
description: Connect dsh to a local Obsidian vault: search, read, write, move, and trash notes through `obsidian_*` tools.

title: Missher12/dsh-missher-brain
description: Coordinates bounded project recall from compatible memory and learning providers, with shared settings and provider lifecycle management.

title: Missher12/dsh-missher-memory
description: Project-scoped local memory with review-before-recall, source references, reversible consolidation, and a portable Cordis service; the Harness adapter provides search and settings, with optional Brain integration.

title: Missher12/Missher-MSE-Learning
description: Persists scoped user corrections and method candidates for DSH with bounded recall and restart-safe completion settlement.

title: mllun/dsh-memory-layers
description: Layered long-term memory for DeepSeek Harness: a ~600-character hot layer that evicts its own overflow, month-archived cold entries recalled by keyword and ranked by usage, and extractive day/week/month summaries.

title: moondrop12138/dsh-zcode-workspace-memory
description: Workspace memory for DeepSeek Harness ported from ZCode: one Markdown memory directory per workspace (a MEMORY.md index plus one file per fact), injected into each main session and refreshed by a background extraction request after completed turns; a sidebar page browses the stored files read-only.

title: MoonlitDropOfBlood/dsh-memory-manager
description: ZCode-style persistent project memory with a full settings manager, index-first injection and agent memory tools.

title: moononnn/DeepSeek-Harness-Hanako-Memory
description: Hana-style assistant manager for DSH: visual preset management (cards, yuan personalities, avatar cropping) plus a full Hana memory stack (rolling summaries, layered compilation, SQLite fact store, deep memory).

title: Moontail-Ling/dsh-time-memory
description: Chat memory that archives messages by time and recalls by stated period, widening twice before admitting it forgot.

title: Morgiana-V3/dsh-feed-the-seek
description: Personal cross-session memory in local SQLite, with automatic conversation learning, companion states, and optional semantic retrieval. Currently intended for single-user local use on Windows.

title: MrLsss/cyber-self
description: Per-workspace personal knowledge base for DeepSeek Harness: each identity gets an isolated local library — import PDF, Word, Excel, Markdown, text, HTML and images, auto-chunk and embed into SQLite with FTS5 + vector hybrid retrieval, then ask questions in chat with numbered citations back to the source. Local-first, no cloud upload; vector embeddings need a local Ollama (default bge-m3), and without it retrieval degrades to FTS5 keyword search.

title: MYCF711/dsh-GOkifu-compact
description: Kifu-style context compression for long DSH sessions: each step folds new turns into a DAG (node = position, edge = attempted fix), injects only a ~417-token hot list (2000-edge fixture, L5 tier), and adds failure memory plus position-repetition detection. Each span is summarized exactly once, so what is retained does not decay with the number of compactions.

title: NattoCB/dsh-plugin-memory
description: Persistent five-layer memory system with relevance injection, LLM auto-extraction, profile rotation, and six agent tools.

title: NeoHotaru/dsh-knowledge-canvas
description: Knowledge base as a canvas in the right sidebar: notes are nodes, and nine tools let the model read, write, link and remove them. A node can carry pictures and documents, and reading one returns their text — Office files extracted in place — while pictures can be handed over as images.

title: Nero0427/dsh-wb-memory
description: Renders WorkBuddy SOUL, USER, MEMORY and topic Markdown files from an existing ~/.workbuddy/user-*-personal directory into the DeepSeek Harness system prompt, with a byte budget and a settings page; the profile's AGENTS.md loader must be disabled first.

title: Nesarf/mega-index-map
description: A cross-workspace Library for DeepSeek Harness: agents record files, tools, environments, knowledge and work records so any later session can index, search and reuse them.

title: NEVSTOP-LAB/dsh-import-copilot-files
description: Loads a workspace's VSCode/Copilot AI configuration into every DSH session: `.github/copilot-instructions.md` is injected as standing instructions, `.github/instructions/**/*.instructions.md` are gated by their frontmatter `applyTo` and join once the session has touched a matching file, and `.github/skills/*/SKILL.md` are registered as DSH skills. Configuration directories outside the workspace, by default `~/.copilot`, are read as well, and a settings page edits that path list.

title: nineoooo/dsh-qzone-echo
description: Archives the QQ Zone posts you published yourself into a local library, auto-sorted into three columns — thoughts, dreams and reviews (book/film recommendations) — all three of which can be corrected by hand, one column at a time, and undoing a correction never disturbs the other two. Ships a private web viewer that can be locked with a password, repairs long posts that the upstream API truncates to its first ~500 characters, counts words by year and month, and backs up attached images for offline reading. The cookie is stored on the local machine only.

title: Noelune/unified-agent-memory
description: One shared Obsidian vault for every agent: dependency-free Python core (search/promote/adjudicate/forget), vault template, dsh plugin (memory_search/show/submit/status).

title: nowledge-co/nowledge-mem-deepseek-harness
description: One memory layer for every AI tool and agent: Context Bundle injection, prompt-time recall, MCP tools, and turn-end DSH thread capture.

title: Nowyousee1/agentloom#dsh-agentloom
description: Bridges the shared ~/.agentloom store between DeepSeek Harness and Codex: injects the shared memories and the AGENTS.md entries the context budget truncates into the system prompt, and adds six loom_* tools for status, sync, memory search/list/add and skill listing. Requires the agentloom CLI installed and a one-time agentloom init; the seven-tool MCP bridge in the same repo is a separate package for MCP clients.

title: NoxTyrannus/dsh-cipher
description: Cipher memory platform as a DSH bundle: four memory types (attention, experience, preference, cognitive) sedimented per turn by four memory agents, cross-session deterministic recall injected via systemPrompt.context, insight review kept out of user-facing output, per-session UNNI/LOOP modes with memory-driven auto-continuation, memory search/ingest tools, plus a settings page (SOUL editor) and an AgentPool panel.

title: NyaaCaster/dsh-yuque-kb
description: Yuque knowledge base as external memory for dsh — auto-injects matching document fragments into conversation, with catalogue search, cloud full-text search and online reading.

title: OakcoderX/solopup-memory
description: Global and project text memory with original-message citations, revision history and managed source withdrawal. Public beta.

title: Old-Friends-Gathering/sedimem#dsh-sedimem
description: Memory center for sedimem, a local cross-client memory layer: one sidebar entry opens the read-only observer as a full page — today's changes, a hand-rotatable 3D memory graph, and 30-day hygiene trends, with a scope picker. The host reuses an already-running observer when observerUrl points at one (pure proxy, no extra process) and spawns an embedded copy as fallback, both reading the same ~/.memo; read-only, loopback-only, with an extra cross-site fence on the routes. The write path (MCP memory_* tools) shared by DSH/Codex/Claude Code is untouched. Zero dependencies.

title: OldManDing/dsh-ledger-watch
description: Ships a minimal lesson ledger: brief.ps1 to look up past pitfalls, add-lesson.ps1 to record new ones, deployed into the skills directory and wired into AGENTS.md by the installer. The model checks it before working and turns what it hits into rules, so the same mistake is not made twice. This plugin watches whether that actually happens and shows the result in a tab and under the composer.

title: omdsh-dev/dsh-kb-sieve
description: Build auditable KB packs (SQLite FTS5) from md/txt/docx/pdf with deterministic retrieval and original-text reading.

title: omdsh-dev/dsh-mnemon
description: Cross-agent, local-first persistent memory plugin for DeepSeek Harness (DSH), powered by Mnemon. It shares long-term memory across Mnemon-enabled agents and adds runtime memory, searchable project documents, semantic recall, knowledge graph, and a Sidebar UI.

title: orangeshinee/dsh-mem0
description: Agent tools for a self-hosted mem0 server: add, search, get, update, delete, history, reset and status memories, with a settings-panel configuration card.

title: OverDustD7/dsh-experience-recall
description: Recalls lessons recorded in earlier projects: when the running work matches one, the local model decides whether to inject a short note before the next step. Requires a local Ollama model (default qwen3.5:9b) and the dsh-mnemon store with its mnemon CLI; without them it only observes and logs, never injects.

title: PaangGaaSam/dsh-persona-memory
description: Daily session digest that grows a user profile and a companion personality, gated by evidence, and injects both into every prompt. Runs daily at 17:00 by default over up to 20 sessions per run on the host model (deepseek-v4-pro), applies the results automatically, and injects up to 1200 characters of profile and persona into every prompt. Its package name, dsh-persona-memory, is also used by other listed entries, so install only one of them.

title: PerryLink/dsh-library
description: Turns local markdown and text documents into a queryable knowledge base with hybrid semantic and keyword search, citation verification, and source injection.

title: PerryLink/dsh-memento
description: Bounded, layered, approval-gated, auditable cross-session memory: a typed `ctx.memory` seam with a zero-dependency SQLite provider, a `memory` tool, and frozen snapshot injection, plus the dsh-memory-protocol v1 rehearsal with an adapter registry and a distributable conformance suite.

title: Phant0Meow/dsh-meow-memory
description: Project-scoped cross-session memory: seven-layer SQLite store (soul/user/project/fact/lesson/rules/topic) on node:sqlite, cache-friendly first-message injection plus per-message keyword hits, memory_remember/search/find_similar/read/update/project tools, and idle-window consolidation ("dream") with peak-hour suppression. Prompt texts ship as per-language data files — the framework supports multilingual users.

title: plastic-labs/dsh-honcho
description: Honcho memory plugin by Plastic Labs: injects the user profile, session summary and relevant conclusions at session start, uploads each turn to Honcho in the background with secrets redacted, and adds honcho_search / honcho_chat / honcho_remember tools plus a /honcho status command; configured through the ~/.honcho/config.json shared with the other Honcho integrations, against hosted honcho.dev or a self-hosted instance.

title: plur-ai/dsh-plugin
description: PLUR memory rendered into the system prompt on each assembly rather than exposed as a tool call, so the block is replaced instead of appended and context stays flat across a session. Fully local hybrid search (BM25 + BGE fused with RRF), plain YAML storage you can edit, per-workspace scoping, and a /plur-memory browser.

title: pokiimon/dsh-memory-eternal-fork
description: Maintained fork of dsh-memory-eternal: auto-captures knowledge cards into a local Markdown vault and recalls them on demand, with DSH 0.2.0-rc.x compatibility fixes. Original project by EternalNight996 (https://github.com/EternalNight996/dsh-memory-eternal), MIT.

title: propzhang/dsh-memory-unlocked
description: Send "Memory unlocked" to let the AI recall conversations it has forgotten.

title: Psychic-Z/dsh-memory-assistant
description: Long-term memory for an agent. Conversations become memory cards; recall reads a few cards and answers in three explicit states (exact / related / none), so the token cost of remembering stays flat as the library grows, and it asks instead of guessing. Its HTTP routes have no DSH access check, so a web page open in your browser could call them.

title: pzh-xsj/dsh-memory-with-soul
description: Long-term memory kept as plain Markdown plus git: each session opens with a generated memory-context block assembled from a global store and per-project books (role card, user profile, current focus, routing table, recent logs), the plugin records which memory files the agent read and reminds it to extract conclusions while the day's log is unextracted, personas live in roles/<role>/SOUL.md role cards, and it ships a seven-tab settings page in the sidebar plus four skills. Requires Python 3.10+.

title: Q2667671398/lingshu-skill
description: Lingshu (灵枢) is a brain-inspired persistent memory, persona and growth system for AI coding agents: pure Python standard library, zero dependencies, local-first, requires Python 3.9+. Hippocampus/cortex layered memory with forgetting curves, dream consolidation, fuzzy associative recall, emotion system, persona drift protection, knowledge base, self-authored skills, and a local web panel. Ships as a DSH bundled skill; the separately installable cordis startup-injector plugin auto-injects sessions only when Lingshu is installed at ~/.dsh/skills/lingshu (or brainPy is configured) and Python 3 is available; the optional update check contacts GitHub/Gitee.

title: QIANLING-0831/dsh-memory-plus#dsh-memory-bundle
description: Memory profile composition with Chinese session search, hybrid recall, persistent workspace facts, user-pinned rules and reusable native skills. Install the standalone versioned Release bundle with one dsh plugin add command. Requires Node.js 24 and pnpm on PATH.

title: qibo30/dsh-worklog
description: Cross-session development worklog for the agent: worklog_add appends one line (optional tag) to today's file, worklog_list reads a day back or lists the days on record. Entries are plain JSON under $DSH_HOME/worklog, so the next session can pick up where the last one stopped.

title: QIC-9821/dsh-memory-sync
description: Sync a git-backed memory folder with a peer machine every time DeepSeek Harness starts — no daemon, no cron, no manual pull.

title: qihao1123/dsh-whale-pal
description: Cross-session memory and compaction archives for dsh, plus a persona kernel. After each substantive turn a background model call extracts facts, preferences, open tasks and commitments; entries carry ids, fade when they stop being mentioned, are capped per kind and can be corrected. When the host compacts a conversation the compressed span is written to the note vault as an archive card whose catalog is injected into the session, so details can be read back by id. Ships an append-only ledger, a settings page, a /whale command group and nine tools.

title: Qinling-Melon-Farmers/dsh-memoir
description: Local-only project memory with zero bundled runtime dependencies or external services: JSON as the source of truth plus generated PROJECT_MEMORY.md, token-bounded session-frozen Hot Memory for prompt-prefix cache stability, cached cross-project BM25 recall, trusted session/turn provenance, explainable pre-write duplicate/conflict governance, editable importance/pin/tags/supersede/archive lifecycle, configurable top-level turn-end distillation, and a bilingual Web GUI for search, inspection, diagnostics, and live settings.

title: QqiqiQ/dsh-profile-vault
description: A consent-gated personal profile store: people are indexed by name, entries by person and key, and no profile record is read before the current session is authorised. Sensitive entries come back masked unless the user authorises that tier separately; credential-like values are refused at write time. Ages and next birthdays are computed at read time, so asOf restores the answer for a past date, and facts that rot (height, weight, address) carry freshness warnings. Five profile_* tools plus a settings page to browse, edit, delete and revoke grants.

title: QuantumKuba/dsh-continuum
description: Persistent project memory, event-sourced task lifecycle, context budgeting, and cooperative multi-agent handoffs.

title: QuaonY/dsh-mem-weave
description: MemWeave (dsh-mem-weave) weaves memory into persona: layered memory and a persona editor in one DeepSeek Harness plugin, with a bounded per-turn injection budget, decay and consolidation, a candidate and conflict review queue, 24-hour undo, and calendar reminders, all stored in a local SQLite file.

title: quberi/dsh-quberi
description: Search the documents and pictures in your Quberi knowledge base, browse its spaces and documents, save notes to it, and upload files into it with your approval for each one, from DeepSeek Harness over OAuth.

title: qwert702/dsh-memory
description: Project+global long-term memory for the dsh web GUI: split POST /items endpoints, tool-call context merged into memory items as compact summaries, with deduplication and session-scoped persistence.

title: rainow/dsh-simple-wiki-memory
description: A super-simplified LLM-wiki memory plugin: one index document (auto-loaded) + one markdown file per topic (read only when needed) — no dumping everything into the context and burning tokens. Simple and lightweight, painless to install/uninstall, and freely editable however you like.

title: raoain/dsh-memory-chain
description: Layered memory for AI agents: five verbs (wake/work/pit/tomb/close), core layer read every time, archive on demand. Plain markdown, four pages created on first run; survives restarts, model swaps and plugin removal.

title: rasyidmmz/dsh-ai-memory
description: Closes ai-memory's consolidation loop for DSH: when a DSH session ends it calls ai-memory finalize-session, so the observations DSH captured become wiki pages the other harnesses ai-memory serves can read. Skips subagents, queues concurrent session ends, and sweeps sessions abandoned by a forced restart.

title: Ray144165154/dsh-memory-loom
description: Cross-session long-term memory: captures durable facts from each turn, auto-associates them by shared entity and tag, and recalls with BM25 plus spreading activation over the link graph.

title: reatcat/l123-harness
description: Three-tier agent memory harness: L1 always-on CLAUDE.md, L2 index, L3 detail skeleton with templates, a gate that blocks writes to protected files without a one-time approval token, zero-judgement event logging, weekly distillation, and a TDD execution-loop skill.

title: rebron1900/dsh-mnemosyne
description: Mnemosyne memory for DeepSeek Harness: remember / recall / forget / stats / sleep tools, embedded skill, auto-setup, optional auto-sync/prefetch, and a Settings panel. Data lives under ~/.dsh/mnemosyne.

title: regrevia/dsh-lite-memory
description: Nothing stays in the system prompt: a hit returns titles only, a body loads only when read, and project rules can grow themselves.

title: Relistencode/dsh-recall
