description: Conversation history recall for DSH: three-layer (literal/fuzzy/semantic) retrieval over every past session's original text, fully local & offline — AI never forgets what you told it. One-command install via `dsh.bundle.patch`, semantic layer runs in a worker thread.

title: renorai/dsh-renor
description: Connects DeepSeek Harness to the hosted Renor memory MCP server over Streamable HTTP, using a Renor API key from RENOR_API_KEY, so the model can call Renor's recall and save tools. It is a configuration bundle with no code of its own.

title: reshuibuduo/tmcra-plugin-deepseek-harness
description: Cross-app project memory for DeepSeek Harness with role-separated writeback, a visual knowledge workspace, confirmed corrections, session controls, local Writer and organizer settings, and an account-free Windows local installation preview.

title: dsh-memory
description: All-in-one local memory: JSONL files per scope (session, project, global, or a custom name) with per-scope dedup, five model tools (memory_save, memory_search, memory_list, memory_get, memory_forget), automatic recall and hard rules injected into the agent pre-step, and a settings panel. Retrieval combines lexical IDF with a local embedding backend, which the panel can install and manage itself.

title: rocco623/dsh-codex-memory
description: Port of the V2 memory pipeline from OpenAI Codex to DeepSeek Harness: a background agent extracts each idle session, consolidation folds the extractions into one memory_summary.md behind a git baseline diff, new sessions get that summary injected, and cited memory flows back as usage counts. A Settings page chooses the model, each stage's reasoning effort, and the idle, age, concurrency and timeout limits.

title: RocoFish/deepseek-memory
description: Long-term memory for dsh with defense-in-depth hardening. Two tiers (project `.dsh-memory/` and user `$DSH_HOME/memory/`), each a plain hand-editable JSON file with bounded entries and tags. Writes are atomic (unique temp file + rename, previous revision kept in a bounded history/) and serialized across processes by a per-tier lock with stale reclaim; a disk-revision check refuses lost updates instead of silently overwriting another writer. Memory text is wrapped in explicit untrusted-data boundaries (forged wrappers stripped on write) to blunt prompt injection from remembered content, load-time validation rejects out-of-bounds stores, and symlink escapes out of the tier directory are refused with MEMORY_STORE_ESCAPE. No content-heuristic filtering and no confirmation step, so headless auto-consolidation stays intact. Install: dsh plugin --profile web add github:RocoFish/deepseek-memory.

title: Root-7-KHX/companion-memory
description: Roleplay companion memory for DeepSeek Harness: per-conversation editable persona documents (1-100 weight per entry, AI may refine them in small story-driven steps), per-speaker favorability and bond in multi-person chats, active memories with AI-scored vectors, a nine-emotion table updated every turn, an AI self-evolution ledger, recent 48-hour transcript search, companion-style conversation compression, sleep-time compute that pre-guesses the next topics while a conversation is idle, per-conversation tone cards learned from its own past replies, a habit-hint small-model bridge that writes the user habits it extracts into this conversation memory, a date-archived local knowledge base with auto-packing by turns or tokens, and a unified integrations page that lists curated plugins and downloads their GitHub releases.

title: ROSESSSSS66/dsh-memory
description: Local long-term memory for DSH: extracts preferences and project facts from sessions, injects the most relevant ones before each turn using local SQLite FTS5 search, and supersedes outdated facts. Requires Node 24+; the offline self-evolution loop needs an OpenAI-compatible LLM endpoint and API key.

title: rpegorov/drafta-mcp#dsh-drafta
description: Connects the Drafta notes app to DeepSeek Harness over MCP, so the agent can search, read and write notes in your local Drafta library.

title: Rxiain/dsh-openviking
description: Semantic retrieval, resource management, auto-recall (user + agent dual spaces) and session memory for DeepSeek Harness: memsearch/memfind/memread/membrowse/memgrep/memglob over viking:// URIs, memadd/memremove resource management, memqueue observer status, memcommit session capture, and memlearn skill playbook minting.

title: Sacredbluedragon/dsh-memory-shield#dsh-memory-shield
description: Hides other memory plugins' context sections and tools inside a chosen DSH preset, so that session gets a clean context. Off by default; ships a read-only diagnostic tool.

title: Saretheya/dsh-cairn
description: Keep conclusions alive across context compaction: the model writes a task checkpoint and the plugin re-injects it into the system prompt's first node — the span compaction never touches, so it survives any number of compactions. Four-tier injection (0/95/175/≤12000 chars) scales with session relatedness; checkpoints live in the plugin's own folder, never in your workspace.

title: scd13150/dsh-cognition
description: Project memory for coding agents on DeepSeek Harness: similar past edits surface as precedents, out-of-scope edits are blocked, and cognition persists across sessions (47 upstream-verified fixes, gold-free 20-task run).

title: Scorp1o117/dsh-soul-md
description: Manage soul.md persona cards and long-term memory, with workspace and session persona selection and tools to read and update them.

title: Scorp1o117/dsh-tdai-memory
description: TencentDB Agent Memory integration with conversation capture, structured memory extraction, automatic recall, and memory and conversation search tools.

title: ScreamingMaggot/rcs-context
description: Reversible context folding plus external memory for DeepSeek Harness: tool output collapses into expandable lines, session facts become auditable records.

title: SeanWang114514/dsh-memo-notebook
description: Per-workspace memo/todo panel that auto-captures queued and running user instructions, marks preempted tasks as interrupted, and restores them to their previous state with one click.

title: seriousz158/dsh-memory
description: Local Git-backed long-term memory for DeepSeek Harness with hybrid CJK/English retrieval, cited context, transactional sync, previews, and rollback.

title: shadowRjh/dsh-neuron-memory
description: Neuron-inspired memory for dsh: turns buffer into a hippocampus, a nightly patrol classifies fragments into pools, and each turn injects a minimal auto-compacted handoff, the live mood (via dsh-feiyu-mood), and only relevance-filtered memories (Ebbinghaus half-life decay; recalled memories are reinforced like spaced repetition). Hard caps bound storage; past-session original text is searchable over multi-frame zstd; dsh-fish-memory stores can be imported. Optional vector retrieval (off by default, keyword fallback). The 3D panel offers four themes and pulses a signal from the center to each recalled memory.

title: shamojun/workmemory#packages/workmemory
description: Workspace long-term memory for DSH: records rationale, lessons and constraints that files never capture, then injects them into later sessions automatically.

title: Shiye-10Pages/dsh-memory-porter
description: Brings your existing Claude / ChatGPT history into DSH: instant zero-token import of the memories.json inside a Claude export, local Claude Code transcripts with no export needed, and conversations distilled through the model you already configured in DSH. Every memory carries verbatim evidence checked against the source by code — a paraphrase is dropped and counted, and evidence found only in the assistant turns is always routed to review rather than stored.

title: shua-781/dsh-beme
description: Long-term memory kept as blocks: one event per block, written to a local append-only event log with a block view and derived indexes, so a full history stays recoverable while only the matching blocks reach the context. The model saves entries with memory_remember and pulls the relevant few with memory_recall, plus one automatic recall pass before each step. Data stays in ~/.beme; no external service and no API key.

title: sidleo/llm-wiki#dsh-wiki
description: Portable agent knowledge base in plain OKF v0.2 Markdown: 13 wiki_* read/write tools, progressive disclosure, backlinks, gated writes via AGENTS.md rules, auto index/log maintenance, linting, and named multi-bundle switching (session-level or global).

title: SiriusWJ/dsh-lite-memory
description: SQLite memory entries, a calendar with due-time reminders, and cron-scheduled agent tasks, with 13 model tools and a bilingual zh/en UI.

title: skepsun/dsh-engram
description: Zero-LLM auto-capture and a symbolic \[ENGRAM\] index with progressive disclosure, an ESR-lite task/evidence protocol (esr_task / esr_node / esr_close / esr_link), and per-workspace usage telemetry with an offline recall benchmark (npm run eval).

title: skyline654654/dsh-memory-drive
description: Manage memory files written by DSH memory plugins inside Settings (view/edit/delete), and sync them to one cloud drive with conflict-safe three-way sync; other drives take upload-only backups.

title: slow-stack/mneme#dsh-mneme
description: The memory that dreams — cross-session memory for DeepSeek Harness: recalls you and your projects across sessions, consolidates memories while idle (autoDream), freezes conflicting memories for your review, and keeps a replayable audit trail. Memory stays on your machine as SQLite with human-editable Markdown mirrors; four-way recall (keyword, vector, BM25, entity graph) and an interactive memory panel ship with it, plus 10 model tools, an MCP server, an external API and a CLI. Summarization and consolidation run on the host model you already configured; with a local embedder, semantic search runs fully offline.

title: SMPcosy/dsh-memnexus
description: Unified long-term memory hub: captures turns into L0 evidence, distills in the background into L1 facts / L2 scenes / L3 profile (depth configurable), recalls via hybrid BM25+fuzzy search, ships 13 memory_* tools, traceable lineage back to source turns, optional Hindsight backend, and a built-in memory panel with three entry points.

title: snaiheihei/dsh-snail-memory
description: Layered global and workspace memory for DeepSeek Harness, with a web panel to browse entries and tune distillation and consolidation, an index kept in context with records loaded on demand, and a per-session choice of layer.

title: snakejohn/dsh-hindsight-local
description: Long-term memory for dsh via a local Hindsight service: each turn is retained with local timestamps and relevant memories (time-aware, reranked) are recalled into context before replies; each workspace binds to one memory bank, several workspaces can share a bank, and banks can have Chinese names; what gets retained is configurable (default: user messages and AI replies); history is imported only when you choose to; includes a three-step setup page with one-click local deployment (uv + Python 3.12), a sidebar status card and a panel to browse and search memories. Needs a SiliconFlow API key for the default embedding and reranker models; only Linux is verified so far.

title: Snerou/dsh-hippo
description: Hippocampus: renders workspace files, DSH memories and past sessions as a rotatable neuron graph in the sidebar, with Chinese-friendly labels and automatic re-indexing on every start.

title: SodaMem/dsh-plugin-sodamem
description: Bi-temporal memory backed by a SodaMem daemon: recall is contributed to the prompt while each turn is assembled and every closed turn is ingested, with no tool call and no model call on the read path; each recalled fact cites the turn it came from and carries validity dates, so superseded facts stop being retrieved.

title: Soren-ABT/dsh-knowledge
description: Knowledge base for DeepSeek Harness: assembles ContextWindow evidence at query time within heading boundaries and token budgets, with follow-up reading around each search anchor; combines BM25/vector search via weighted RRF, MMR and optional local/remote reranking; provides automatic evidence injection, a browser panel for local embedding/rerank/OCR model downloads and health checks, keyword search without model downloads, and in-place rescans of imported directories.

title: spark-ai-boy/dsh-obsidian-bridge
description: Connect a local Obsidian vault to DeepSeek Harness: local Markdown indexing with keyword search by default and optional hybrid or semantic search through `obsidian_*` agent tools (hybrid and semantic need an OpenAI-compatible or Ollama embedding endpoint); agent access is off until you enable the conversation switch, and note writing is approval-gated, undoable and proposal-first; the index and vectors stay on your machine.

title: SQHLnb666/mindsea
description: A long-term memory plugin for DeepSeek Harness. Every turn is judged and stored into a local SQLite (utterance / event / version / stage / decision), with a browsable panel.

title: sqzw-x/dsh-plugins#dsh-notes-context
description: Notes-backed context compression for DeepSeek Harness: replaces LLM-summarized compaction with a model-written persistent notebook plus recoverable raw history, so the rollover boundary itself costs zero model calls.

title: stas130286-blip/dsh-brainagent
description: Brain-inspired cognitive plugin: episodic, semantic, procedural and emotional memory with reinforcement-learning signals, a goal stack with time triggers, curiosity-driven autonomous web research and proactive initiatives.

title: summerscar/dsh-plugins#dsh-mnemon-sync
description: Backup and restore for dsh-mnemon: pick any of its three memory components (memory spaces, project documents, runtime memory) and archive them to S3-compatible storage or WebDAV, then browse the archives and restore a chosen subset. Live SQLite databases are copied through node:sqlite backup() so a concurrent writer cannot tear the copy; every file carries a SHA-256 checked before upload and again before restore; a restore previews by default and deletes the stale -wal/-shm sidecars before writing a database back. Archives are named mnemon-sync-<device>-<timestamp>.zip so backups from several machines stay tellable apart. Runs a single timer with intervals from hourly to weekly, stores credentials in a 0600 file outside the DSH profile, and depends on nothing outside Node.

title: suomir1995/dsh-notes
description: Keeps notes as local Markdown files grouped by directory under a root folder you choose, with a sidebar page, AGENTS-style rule files surfaced as writing context, and six agent tools.

title: super3ben/agent-feedback-loop#agent-feedback-loop-dsh
description: Feeds every dsh prompt into the local agent-feedback-loop feedback-memory pipeline — captures dissatisfaction, reviews it offline into reflections, and attaches the compiled recurrence-rule context back to the turn, never blocking a prompt. Lessons are compiled into a layered rules block (an index that names every family on every turn, plus on-demand instructions), same-class reflections are merged so one lesson is not re-read as many, and each index fact decays through current → possibly-stale → dormant instead of being trusted forever. Requires the agent-feedback-loop runtime; running agent-feedback-loop install afterwards wires existing dsh profiles automatically. On every prompt it runs ~/.agent/feedback-loop/hooks/core-hook.sh with the prompt on stdin.

title: Swd146296/dsh-memos-bridge
description: Bridges the MemOS memory service over MCP: the agent gets add/search/update/delete memory, multi-cube sharing, and a memory scheduler as mcp__memos__* tools.

title: swenbo1-web/agents-learning
description: Project-scoped SQLite memory with progressive retrieval, bounded context, a composer button and visual review. Install the repository-root DSH bundle, then run /learning-init with an absolute project path using local Python 3.10+.

title: sxwer001/dsh-context-control
description: A context usage ring with configurable character-based automatic compaction, manual compaction, protected user requirements and recoverable original history for DSH 0.2.0-rc.2.

title: symmetryseeker/dsh-akn-plugin
description: Local-first Agent Experience Network for DeepSeek Harness, distilling task-level experiences from traces and live manifests, grading by H0-H4 evidence, discovering by compatibility, and promoting only after explicit review.

title: syyr1987/dsh-linghun-memory
description: A memory subsystem for DeepSeek Harness: full ontological memory (event/fact/rule three-ontology) plus a goal system (goal.js) — belief values written via Bridge trigger words, goal activation scored at read time (0.25 domain + 0.35 bridge + 0.40 sim) to recover goal/value long-range associations, journal ledger, episodic archive, low-confidence decay, memory_append/read/consolidate plus linghun_goal_update/get/state closed loop. Independent of the original dsh-linghun line. 16/16 on LoCoMo-Plus.

title: tabilet/tabilet-skills
description: Seven shared engineering skills, a read-only project dashboard with amendments, options, stages and SQLite audit browsing, and workflow request previews for DSH.

title: TacitSay/dsh-compact-arsenal
description: Configurable context compaction with three independently switchable sections — whole-context checkpoint, reasoning compression and tool-output pruning — each with its own pressure threshold and method. Mechanical modes make no model calls; model modes summarize fragments in batches with a configurable provider and prompt. A left-sidebar panel exposes switches, method cards and editable parameters that save without a restart, and every rewrite is archived with its original text.

title: tancheng33/dsh-yogacara
description: Tracks the agent's state as Yogācāra mental factors over a durable seed store, and feeds it back into the prompt as first-person inclination.

title: Tangcuyu4/dsh-long-memory
description: Cross-session long-term memory: a hybrid-retrieval memory store (BM25 plus CJK bigrams), chunked long-document search, chat-log extraction and distillation, and context-summary archiving and browsing, with important memories and the latest summaries auto-injected into the prompt.

title: text2future/flowix#dsh-flowix-memory
description: Registers the local flowix-cli MCP server so the agent can search, read, create, and edit Flowix memos and mind-map artifacts.

title: thawline/dsh-memewiki
description: Offline meme and slang dictionary: 6,792 built-in entries are looked up before a turn and injected only when a message looks like a meme question. Ships a lookup tool, a settings page for adding/editing/deleting entries and aliases, an adjustable tone slider for how far it plays along, and a built-in version check.

title: theBeautifulIce/dsh-Immunity-memory#memory-plugin
description: Cross-session long-term memory for DSH: eight memory layers, four notebooks, hybrid SQLite FTS5/vector/graph retrieval, agent-driven automatic capture, write lifecycle hooks, optional write audit, project spaces, forgetting and a visual management page. Full FTS5/vector/graph retrieval needs the bundled Go service, which ships only as a Windows x64 prebuilt; on macOS/Linux, build it from source or the plugin falls back to Node SQLite without FTS5 and retrieval degrades.

title: Thomas-zz/dsh-luanji
description: Local-first quick capture: select text in a DSH conversation to save it as a quote with its source (model and session), or jot quick notes from the sidebar; records stay in a local JSON file, with optional sync to a self-hosted service.

title: timestatic/dsh-session-notebook
description: Notes taken from DeepSeek Harness conversations: quotes whole replies or selected passages, keeps highlights rendered at their original position in the session, attaches editable Markdown notes, tags them, filters by workspace or session, and exports Markdown or a full JSON backup stored as local JSON files.

title: tinqiao-oss/engramory#plugin
description: Long-term memory for DeepSeek Harness kept as plain markdown, one fact per file. Every step the `MEMORY.md` index (the project store if there is one, plus a global store under `$DSH_HOME`) goes into the runtime context, so recall does not wait for a file read. The index has a hard cap, 200 lines / 25 KB by default, enforced by `ctx.tools.guard()`: a write that grows an over-cap index is denied, a rewrite that shrinks it passes. A read-only sidebar Memory page lists the notes by type. The plugin never writes memories on its own. An experimental companion mode adds note types for a persona's own life. The same store also works with Claude Code, Codex, Kiro and OpenClaw.

title: Tkingxiao/dsh-memu-memory
description: Memory for long-form RP and companion chats: three fading layers, per-turn recall, source labels, character and world boundaries, a relationship graph, image attachments and a WebUI.

title: Toctsu/dsh-full-life-memory
description: A biomimetic memory plugin for DSH that folds context into token clues and reconstructs memories on-demand.

title: TodayJin/dsh-trilogy
description: Per-project memory for DeepSeek Harness. Three Markdown files per workspace — PROJECT.md, DECISIONS.md and SESSIONS.md — are auto-created on the first step of any session in that workspace, re-read from disk and re-injected only when they change (and re-injected if compaction dropped them), and written back by classification through a memory_checkpoint tool, with a bounded end-of-turn nudge when a turn did work but recorded nothing. memory_read and memory_search read the live log and the archive, the latter over a zero-dependency BM25 index. The session log is capped at 200 entries with the overflow moved to SESSIONS-archive.md — never injected, but visible, readable and searchable, and restorable one entry at a time. Settings page: a workspace list with a path filter, read-only tabs for the three memory files plus the archive, reload, export/import of one workspace's memory as a JSON bundle, a two-step clear, a panel that rewrites or removes the AGENTS.md instruction block, and a PROJECT.md staleness reminder. A composer status chip shows that workspace's sync state and creates the files on click. Zero dependencies — no vector store, no embeddings, and no model calls.

title: Tommy00748/dsh-self-evolution
description: Bounded self-managed long-term memory (Hermes-style MEMORY.md / USER.md with hard character limits and a safety scan), a review that runs after every turn and writes plain-language notes or refines an existing skill instead of adding a near-duplicate, a curator that finds and surgically repairs skills the loader would silently discard, cross-session search over past messages, and a learning card above the composer that appears only when there is news and asks before it deletes or rewords a memory.

title: topkie/dsh-lattice
description: Local memory for DeepSeek Harness: what you write is filed under a topic and linked to related entries, recall ranks results by embedding similarity (word matching when no model is installed), and the data stays in a local SQLite database.

title: tr1v3r/dsh-ltm
description: Local SQLite long-term memory with CJK-aware search, BM25 and character n-gram cosine reranking, deduplication, and lifecycle management.

title: truelove-dreamer/dsh-plugin-recall
description: Cross-session memory for the model: full-text search all past sessions (SQLite FTS5 via ctx.sessionQuery) and bring the strongest matching excerpts back into the current context.

title: TuringCorp-net/mosaic-memory-compress
description: Forgetting-curve in-place dialogue compression for DeepSeek Harness: recent turns stay verbatim, middle turns are structurally dehydrated (zero-LLM), ancient turns fold into a bounded summary pair — unbounded conversations on a bounded memory budget.

title: Tyan66666/billion-context-dsh
description: Model-driven context compression (Active Context Pruning) for DeepSeek Harness: the model decides when and what to compress.

title: tynr426/dsh-relationship
description: Local relationship-memory workbench with a confirmation gate: every AI write — extracted memories and newly created contacts alike — lands in a pending queue until the user confirms it in the GUI; materials are archived verbatim with quote-level provenance checks on AI extraction, and confirmed memories aggregate into per-contact timelines, gift occasions and reciprocity views. Ships a native relationship agent preset for conversation capture; JSON storage by default with an optional SQLite backend, zero production dependencies.

title: vectorize-io/hindsight#coding-agents
description: Hindsight, agent memory that learns: long-term project memory with auto recall and retain, knowledge pages, deep reflection, and per-repo memory banks.

title: Vesna-Strivozha/DSH-LLM-wiki-plugin#dsh-llm-wiki
description: An Obsidian-style knowledge base: ingest sources, let the LLM build and maintain an interlinked wiki, and ask questions grounded in it.

title: vibe-any/dsh-plugin-save-token
description: Reversible context slimming for DeepSeek Harness: TOON-style lossless tabular re-encoding of uniform JSON arrays, stride-sampled table windows with line numbers, and cross-turn dedup for repeated tool output; every replacement passes a byte-plus-token gate (≤72% bytes, strictly fewer estimated tokens) and the original is spilled to disk behind a `[save-token #id]` notice retrievable in one call via the `save_token_expand` tool, with billed and avoided token metering on a settings dashboard.

title: volcengine/OpenViking#examples/dsh-memory-plugin
description: OpenViking memory and context bundle for DeepSeek Harness: pre-step auto-recall and profile injection, session capture, `viking://` URI guarding, and recall/write memory tools backed by an OpenViking server.

title: vshulcz/deja-vu#extensions/dsh
description: Cross-session memory and context recovery across forty-five other coding agents (45+) on this machine, reading session files they already wrote before install (Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Windsurf, Trae, Antigravity, VS Code Copilot Chat, opencode, OpenClaw, Hermes, Kimi, Qoder, Cline, Zed, Magpie and more): six tools (deja_recall, deja_session, deja_blame, deja_fix, deja_how, deja_remember), a /deja command, and optional automatic recall injected into runtime context. Local BM25 CLI/MCP index, no LLM, no embeddings, no network (dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-deja).

title: vv5v5/dsh-anima-rag
description: Anima-style vector memory for DSH: injects retrieved historical summaries into the system prompt each turn, exposes an anima_query semantic-search tool, and isolates the vector store per playthrough. SiliconFlow embeddings sent as array-shaped requests; timeouts and provider errors surface as honest, classified notes in the injection slot — never silent.

title: vv5v5/dsh-memory-archive
description: RP memory built on pmp tavern: RP history summaries ride the native compaction pipeline, with plain tool sessions kept out of the way. Full recall requires the downstream anima plugin. Requires the plugin-provided roleplay preset to be enabled.

title: w4xxx/dsh-xia-plugins#packages/gameassist-memory
description: Single-file persistent companion memory: interests, preferences, tasks, and past works summarized into the system prompt, with read/update tools.

title: wackyju2-beep/eventmem#dsh
description: Local-first event memory for DSH: recall injection, seven memory tools and a native console. Install the eventmem daemon separately; SSH sharing is opt-in and no private host is a default.

title: wafernm-crypto/dsh-memory-library
description: Per-workspace memory library with manual per-chat opt-in, editable rules, three sharing modes, and continuous forgetting; cards stay readable Markdown.

title: waspqj/dsh-study-mode
description: Learning-mode agent preset for DSH with a topic knowledge base: answers retrieve from your own stored cards and cite the card they came from, mark anything not found as unverified, and only go online when verification is required. The sidebar panel browses topics, searches and edits cards, and every card can be AI-reviewed, verified, rolled back and versioned. Cards can reference each other with `[[title]]` links; the panel shows both outgoing links and which cards reference the one you are reading. New cards arrive as a preview you confirm before they enter the library; topic and card names are editable in the UI. The knowledge base is plain local files, not an automatic scraper.

title: webkubor/dsh-mirror
description: Make the AI remember how you think, not what you said: actively captures your principles, redlines, and working habits across sessions — with memory capacity, graceful decay, and human-readable reasoning for every entry. 0.7.0 brings an intuitive persona portrait with evidence tracing.

title: weibaohui/context-razor
description: Context trimmer: lists the current session's context entries with role, preview and ≈token estimate (cl100k), highlights over-threshold items, and removes selected entries exactly without LLM summarization.

title: weibaohui/hermes-loop
description: Automatic session retrospective: after a conversation wraps up, distills useful experience into reusable skills stored in the skill library for the model to call, with signal-accelerated triggers, manual runs, an approval mode, and skill-library governance (archive/restore, never deletes directly).

title: weirwei/dsh-logseq
description: Syncs Logseq 2.0 DB graphs (including E2EE) with a Logseq sync server via the headless Logseq CLI, adds 11 logseq_* tools to search, query and edit them, and a Settings section to log in and configure sync.

title: whding110/dsh-dev-progress-memory
description: Per-turn development progress memory: completed turns are classified into date-indexed Markdown files under doc/progress/ with a maintained INDEX.md, system-level bugs are kept in a cross-project SYSTEM_MEMORY.md and re-injected on error keywords, and a progress_read tool loads full documents on demand.

title: William20100221/dsh-context-graph
description: Indexes each chat of a workspace into a small topic graph every 4 turns (one model call, verbatim source kept under .context-graph/), appends up to 5 matching topics from the other chats to each message, searching a named day such as "yesterday" first, and adds a recall tool that returns the original text by topic, chat, day or turn. On and shared by default; /context-graph off and unshare opt a chat out, and stats, build, map and find inspect it.

title: Windsander/Mebular#packages/dsh-plugin
description: 🌌 Mebular · shared memory and task collaboration for agents. Through a DSH-native plugin, it provides cross-device, cross-agent memory sharing and task-graph capabilities — so physical devices are no longer the boundary of your agents. Secure, controllable, and decentralized! The plugin attaches to an existing Mebular app or CLI runtime; when none exists, the panel installs the shared runtime on demand, and it never starts or downloads Mebular silently.

title: wojiao42/dsh-memory-file
description: File-backed memory: injects your own Markdown memory file at each session start, adds read/write tools with backup and undo, and reports DSH_HOME drift. Reads no conversations by default; an opt-in autoScan switch surfaces your own recent lines from local session logs. Never opens a network connection.

title: woshishadowhunter/dsh-seed-society
description: Memory consolidation tuning for dsh-mneme (autoDream enabled, schema-max output budget, deepseek-chat route) plus the llm-deepseek reasoning-effort fix, an MCP bridge to the auditable seed-society agent runtime, and six yogacara seed skills.

title: wqx11235/dsh-experience
description: Local-first experience library for DeepSeek Harness: signature-based search over plain markdown, pre-step recall that raises its own bar when hints go unread, failure-to-fix drafts, and one-click triage of the gap queue. Ships a sanitized starter library. No model calls, no network.

title: WsTe47/mylife
description: A local-first personal state record and decision engine for dsh: keeps every input byte-for-byte with line-level provenance, argues against its own conclusions by generating defeaters first, ages each stored fact with its own TTL, and reports where a decision rests on nothing at all.

title: WU079/dsh-memory-keeper
description: Cross-session memory for DSH: export every session to readable Markdown transcripts, keep one long-term MEMORY.md, and get a wake-up summary in a fresh window.

title: wu81313-lab/dsh-company-kb
description: Local-folder knowledge base for DSH: builds a SQLite FTS5 index over Office, text, PDF and scanned files, ships five tools (kb_search / kb_read / kb_list / kb_status / kb_session) plus a Web panel, and retrieves or syncs only when the user explicitly asks.

title: wuwen837/dsh-companion
description: Adds a Chat mode beside Work with a user-defined persona, long-term memory extracted after each turn and recalled by topic, and stickers it can save and send.

title: wuying1630/dsh-selfmem
description: Three ledgers for a model that loses context between restarts. Self-note: what I have become — capped at 40 entries, and every eviction first leaves a one-line crease recording which entry was dropped and why. Judgment ledger: record a claim together with how to verify it, come back when it is due, and mark it right or wrong; wrong ones stay in a mistakes book so you stop assuming you were always correct. Handoff: where this run stopped and what the next one should read first — a baton, not a memory. Three tools each taking an action parameter instead of a dozen separate ones (the prompt is paid every turn). Data lives in ~/.dsh/*.jsonl and is shared with the same-named CLI scripts. Zero dependencies.

title: WYR-233/dsh-memory-lite
description: Read-only enhancer for a file-based long-term memory library (markdown cards in git): a memory_find search tool, a small budgeted memory digest injected into the system prompt, and a settings page with library overview, health-check status and toggles.

title: xbzbing/dsh-openviking-manager
description: Configuration UI for the official OpenViking memory plugin: connection and user-key setup, local connection diagnostics, a per-session memory toggle in the composer, memory isolation that keeps recall inside the current topic, and recall tuning for score threshold, injected item count, query expansion and excluded URIs.

title: XHszDHM/dsh-memory-tide
description: Long-term notes and daily journals kept per workspace in a hot/cold archive, each tier with its own index and rebalanced once a day; read and written through seven memory_* tools, with a settings page for per-workspace options.

title: Xiaocanglan-hub/dsh-whale-memory#dsh-memory-brain
description: Object memory for DSH: each object is broken into fourteen kinds of smallest elements (shape, material, state, part, function...), observed links are stored apart from inferred ones, and analogies stay as questions until the user answers.

title: Xiaocanglan-hub/dsh-whale-memory#dsh-school
description: She keeps the questions your chats left unanswered, then goes and looks them up later. A line she asked you that ended in "?" and never got an answer is stored as a hanging question; on a schedule inside a daily window (08:00–23:00, five a day by default; an optional mouse/keyboard-idle gate is off by default) she picks the oldest one, searches the web and Bilibili, reads what is actually readable, distils it into two or three sentences and leaves a note on her desk. Questions about its own plugins are skipped and left for you. Read-only on her events: nothing is written to her memory, her growth is untouched, and dsh-fish needs no patching. Requires the @ssamurias/dsh-fish persona plugin for her event stream and a local Ollama model; a search API key is optional.

title: Xiaocanglan-hub/dsh-whale-memory#dsh-slow-wave
description: What it does while she sleeps, in one card. Two things: (1) tidy the element memory — merge synonyms only when the model agrees, trim descriptions, prune weak links, propose analogies for the user to confirm, with a backup before every write and a 15%-of-library cap per pass; (2) dream — stitch her own past experiences (plus props from the element memory) into a short 3–6 sentence story, leave one line on her desk as a note labelled "this is a dream, not something that happened". The dream lives in its own file and never enters her memory or her personality prompt. Requires @ssamurias/dsh-fish for her event stream and dsh-memory-brain for the element library; model-approved merges and dreams need a local Ollama model (or a paid API key).

title: Xieddenv/dsh-memory-kit
description: Gives a DSH agent five layers of persistent memory kept as plain Markdown files — persona, speaking-style rules, daily diary, session archive and open loops — rebuilds a system-prompt section from them within a minute of a file change, and adds three tools (memory_read, memory_write, memory_search) plus an importer for migrating an existing memory directory.

title: XieZongChen/dsh-md-notes
description: A markdown notes manager for DSH: full **MD notes manager** and **MD notes editor**, quickly capture conversations into notes, maintain notes by **syncing to Git repositories**, and **bring notes into the conversation context**.

title: xinchen03/minta#dsh-plugin
description: DSH-native integration layer for the Minta memory engine: composes the official dsh-mcp-client row, registers the minta-memory-governance skill plus a session-start memory prewarm, and ships a Minta agent preset; requires the separately deployed Minta engine (Python/Docker) to provide the 19 MCP tools - not usable without it.

title: xingyueDanYang/dsh-puppet-memory
description: Cross-session memory for DeepSeek Harness: a three-tier store (behavior notes, deep details, session archive) plus a 600-character core card injected every step, work/companion/learning state lines, multi-person and multi-group records with visibility partitions, session-scoped suppression or deletion of memory fragments, summaries and fact candidates that can route to a separate model, and backup plus self-check tools. Data is plain text under the home directory, and entries can carry images and audio stored by content hash.

title: XinzeQing/dsh-user-memory
description: White-box memory in two parts: four user-authored long-term tiers (must-follow rules, behavior settings, user profile, optional rules) injected as one system-prompt section, plus a separate temporary working set (cross-session handoffs, stage goals, waiting items) with its own 1200-character budget that stops being injected once an entry is done. The long-term tiers are plain Markdown files the user can read and edit; the agent can only propose them, and nothing is written until the user accepts in the Chinese panel. Temporary entries are written only when the user explicitly asks, and live in <DSH_HOME>/temp-memory.json (created on first write), not in the memory directory. No auto-capture, no background writes, no network.

title: xiyunSacire/dsh-skill-manager
description: View and delete persistent skill memory from the DSH sidebar.

title: Xplore-LAB/dsh-plugin-asmemory
description: Action-state time memory: record typed states and actions, then analyze trends, anomalies, and causality.

title: xs1023/dsh-memory-vault
description: SQLite-backed long-term memory for DeepSeek Harness: add, search, update and archive entries with categories and tags, automatic conversation logging, tiered compression, and a project dimension that scopes retrieval to the current workspace plus global facts.

title: xulei666a/dsh-rules
description: Unified rules/guidelines layer for DeepSeek Harness. Keeps every agent guideline in one local rule library with default (always-on) vs local (task-domain) coverage, syncs the effective set into the AGENTS.md managed section, and adds semantic routing, a classification tree, a management page / right-sidebar panel, an in-panel assistant that can collect existing guidelines, calibrate pending rules, re-classify them, and report an issue ledger grouped by owner, rule copies (right-click move/copy, folder copy, jump to origin), decision points with branch conflicts, and per-session branch choice.

title: xuxiaoxiang0721-tech/javmem-dsh-plugin
description: Per-Bot memory for Tobs Bots (requires DeepSeek Harness with @botharness/core; it ships off with no Bots listed, and after you list a Bot and set mode to on it works with no other service): a read-only local full-text index of that Bot's own past conversations (Chinese words found inside sentences), memory imported from other AI tools, a status tool, optional auto recall before a step in which a Human speaks, and a service for other plugins. Richer backends can be chosen at install, with a quote first and a daily token cap: a public fact store (memv2-lite), the official Graphiti graph, or both, fed from the Bot's own conversations.

title: xxwjxx-1210/dsh-brain-hub
description: A second brain for DeepSeek Harness where Markdown is the database and git is the sync, with zero runtime dependencies. Core memory is injected into every system prompt, one file per note with weighted search; cards produced in the sidebar web chat land in an inbox first and are approved one by one as cloud notes or local-only notes (private/ is permanently gitignored and never pushed); web-chat progress is saved to progress.md with the last 20 drafts archived. A four-step flow lives behind one header icon: open web chat, extract cards, review them, back up to the cloud. The extraction prompt is editable in the panel and applies immediately.

title: xy261624/dsh-companion-memory
description: Long-term memory written by the character itself. A sorting plugin watches the workspace and, once conversations have been quiet past a threshold, opens its own session to run the bundled extraction script and turn the recent exchanges into memory files; a heartbeat plugin later re-opens sessions on a probability curve that rises with the time since the last exchange, with quiet hours and a random delay. Ships the memory templates, the sorting guide and the extraction script. Needs Python 3.8+ with zstandard, plus manual setup after install (a preset with agent-instructions, templates copied into the workspace, defaultPreset/sortPreset set to real preset ids; a wrong id fails silently with one log line). Plugin-opened sessions run with full permissions by default. Tested on DSH 0.2.0-rc.2.

title: xying-lm/dsh-memory-vault
description: Disk-backed long-term memory for DSH: a SQLite FTS5 vault that captures every conversation turn, injects relevant past turns into new sessions within a per-turn character budget, groups sessions into resumable conversation files, and ships a web panel for search, paging and capacity.

title: xyzOvO/dsh-selfnote
description: Self-narrative memory in five budgeted segments (800 chars, not a full context): a first-person note the model writes to itself, a profile of you aggregated from approved facts, environment facts kept separate from who you are, heat-ranked conclusions, and habits. Every injected fact is traceable to a fact id and can be retired; the profile can be edited by hand, and self-notes stay plain lines you can clear. Facts fade by use and time without ever changing their credibility. Preference-like lines you say are auto-detected as candidates (never auto-approved), with conflicts kept side by side. Recall over past conversations with citations, an incremental index that only decodes newly appended frames, a pointer-required warm layer, a doctor that says which part is broken, a heartbeat proving injection is alive, and export/import so the whole thing moves to another machine.

title: xyzOvO/dsh-wiki-notes
description: Read-only knowledge gateway over a local Markdown vault, in four tools: `wiki_recall` returns the matching section in full with page-level citations plus vault health checks and a page skeleton for writing a good answer back; `wiki_context` returns one evidence pack with per-page excerpts, a support verdict and an explicit list of gaps; `wiki_verify` re-checks a drafted answer against that pack and reports claims the evidence cannot back, including unsupported numbers; `wiki_observe` reports how often answers needed correcting. The settings page and sidebar panel share the same query path as the model, so a search you run by hand cannot disagree with what the model was given. The three knowledge-gateway tools (`wiki_context`, `wiki_verify`, `wiki_observe`) need a local Python 3 bridge — `bridge.python` plus `bridge.toolsRoot` containing `wiki_bridge.py`; without it they return `E_PYTHON_UNAVAILABLE`.

title: dsh-long-term-memory
description: A long-term memory box for DeepSeek Harness settings: type it once and every new session carries it. 0.3.0 can also expand a rough note into a five-section requirement sheet that keeps every requirement of yours verbatim, marks anything the model had to invent as 推断 and deletable, and lists the dimensions you left open instead of deciding them for you.

title: yangdongzhen590/dsh-knj-obsidian
description: Built-in Obsidian-style knowledge base for DSH: agents distill conversations, documents and web sources into a structured .wiki graph, with retrieval, graph export, note editing, incremental builds and multi-vault management.

title: yangyizhu8/dsh-powercontext
description: PowerContext for DeepSeek Harness: WorkBuddy-style project memory and inspectable handoff workflows - bounded context recall before each model step, 19 pc_* tools for memory, handoff, experience and skills, with a Windows server watchdog for resident operation.

title: yangyongzhen/dsh-memory
description: Long-term memory injected at session start: preferences/facts/summaries/knowledge in global and per-project scopes, budgeted recall via `agent/pre-step`, durable JSON store.

title: Yanlrx/dsh-memory-v2
description: Rui Xi's Memory (dsh-memory-v2) — a local long-term memory plugin for DeepSeek Harness: four memory collections (semantic / conclusion / profile / temporary), per-day scene archives, two-phase consolidation and literal trace. When structured recall finds nothing, it falls back to searching the daily scene archive: time-window first (yesterday / last week / N days ago / dates), then a 2/7/30/180-day tiered sweep, with line-numbered citations. All data stays in the local DSH directory; semantic recall, diagnostic logs and the sensitive debug route are off by default.

title: Yansera/dsh-living-memoir
description: Cross-session memory kept as a short Markdown living document that is rewritten in full at the end of every turn, written to by model tools, the page, and automatic rewriting alike.

title: yffo/dsh-engramory-recall
description: Local BM25 auto-recall, a fail-closed write guard, a static doctor and a memory panel for an Engramory markdown store. No network, no daemon and no model calls unless you opt in; recall quality is measured by a reproducible benchmark in the repository.

title: yhPrime/dsh-Engram
description: Experience and skill engine with a sidebar console and exp_record / exp_recall / exp_feedback / exp_consolidate / exp_type tools, stored in a local JSON file. Optional Git backup (off until you configure a remote) pushes the library to a remote you choose; GitHub sign-in uses a device code or a token kept in local settings.

title: yhPrime/dsh-exp-lib-provider
description: Requires dsh-mnemon. Experience-library memory-space provider for dsh-mnemon, with exp_recall / exp_record / exp_feedback / exp_type tools.

title: yihefeikong-rgb/dsh-cc-haha-dream
description: Background memory consolidation (auto dream) for DeepSeek Harness: periodically reviews recent sessions and existing memories to dedupe, refresh stale entries, remove contradictions and rebuild the MEMORY.md index, with hybrid/volume auto triggers, /dream command and a settings-panel config card.

title: yihefeikong-rgb/dsh-cc-haha-memory
description: Persistent memory for DeepSeek Harness: memory read/write/retrieve tools, per-turn auto-recording, project-scoped recall injection and a management UI, with non-destructive Claude Code memory import.

title: Yiipu/dsh-agentmemory
description: DSH ↔ agentmemory session-memory bridge: mirrors session lifecycle into a local agentmemory daemon (REST), exposes memory_recall / memory_remember tools, and injects a per-session memory context window via agent/pre-step.

title: Yixianqzm/deepseek-plastic-memory
description: Partitioned long-term memory for agents, with folders as memory zones, a one-line index first, and a forgetting curve.

title: yiyunet/dsh-learn-skills
description: DSH plugin: a four-entry learning flow in the session input bar — scaffold a preset, collect candidates, merge reviewed changes, and run a read-only workspace audit.

title: youchen-yc/dsh-heartprint
description: A memory plugin for DeepSeek Harness: set its name, personality and character; it forgets only trivial things, keeps what matters, and marks and remembers what is special to you.

title: ys118/harnmem#dsh-harnmem
description: Cross-harness agent memory for DSH: one plain-file store shared by the DSH and pi adapters and the harnmem CLI, so a memory written in one harness is available in another; injected as a byte-stable hot index, with five harnmem_* tools, session-end extraction, and a read-only memory browser panel.

title: Yuankilo/dsh-memory-studio
description: Memory for DeepSeek Harness with five sections (memories, tree, profile, graph, inbox), a rule-based capture policy that decides what to keep and what to drop, and hybrid BM25 plus vector retrieval over parent and child chunks, backed by twelve agent tools that read and write the same local files.

title: yunkong-134/xiaoman-memory
description: Plain-text memory for DSH where every event is one Markdown section with six fields, recall works by element association rather than vector search, at most two old titles surface per turn, and nothing calls a model or the network. Writing the library stays manual: you can open it, grep it, correct it and carry it to another machine.

title: yushenghai1106/dsh-memory-plugin
description: Persistent memory for DeepSeek Harness with curated facts, automatic turn retention, and graph- and vector-ranked recall.

title: Yuuyuko-uu/dsh-fish-memory
description: Per-session long-term memory that fades over time, recalls by evidence score and injects a few entries into the system prompt each turn.

title: Yuuyuko-uu/dsh-xingxi
description: Turns an organised memory archive into a browsable star map — one star per memory, the diary as an outer timeline, plus a chapter view, a day view, and a picking task that files each day's raw conversation into the archive.

title: yuyolin/dsh-decision-log
description: Decision log for DeepSeek Harness: record key decisions (chosen option + why) into a versionable DECISIONS.md via decision_log / decision_list / decision_audit tools, and auto-inject the summary into future sessions so decisions stay traceable and are never re-litigated.

title: Yvesgao/dsh-env-profile
description: Global experience archive for DeepSeek Harness on Windows: probes local tools (with versions and PATH-first hits), convenient paths, network latency and disk speed; folds per-session stats from session/event; LLM-extracts durable facts; env_profile tool with remember; byte-stable summary injected every turn to speed up sessions and cut token use.

title: yxie15022-debug/dsh-wife-memory
description: Long-term memory about the owner: extracts schedule, likes, dislikes, emotional triggers, current focus, promises and tone preferences from each turn, injects a short digest into every prompt, speaks up on a schedule or slips a caring line into replies, learns wake/work/sleep times from short messages, and compacts the memory automatically, with plugin-source and outbound-tool recognition, unverified-memory down-weighting and one-click retract.

title: yzx4036/dsh-memory-snapshot
description: Injects your existing markdown documents (notes, rules, knowledge-base files) into every dsh session's system prompt as read-only memory — list file or directory paths in `files`; no database, no service, no write path; UTF-8 byte-budgeted truncation with line-boundary fallback, total budget, YAML front-matter stripping, and freshness timestamps.

title: zcd0818/dsh-scribe
description: Cross-session memory and a per-workspace knowledge base in one plugin. Memories are plain JSONL under ~/.dsh/memory by default; each session starts with the relevant ones already in the system prompt and writes one back when it ends. A read-only kb/ folder per workspace plus one global folder is searched with results cited down to file lines. Eleven tools under a scribe_ prefix (seven scribe_memory_*, four scribe_kb_*), a /scribe slash command, and a settings page with overview, memory, knowledge base and migration tabs. Cloud backends (Bailian memory library, ChromaDB, cloud-primary with local mirror) are opt-in; moving data between them requires an explicit approval and is logged so it can be rolled back.

title: zhang66633/dsh-memvault
description: Bridges DSH to a local MemVault store: core memory blocks injected into the system prompt, finished turns extracted through MemVault's own pipeline, and a panel to browse, trace, review and replay what was stored.

title: zhangj1164/dsh-mega-plugins#dsh-memo
description: Week-keyed personal memo service: stores entries in ISO-week tables, resolves week/month/quarter/year navigation from one period calendar, archives quarters, runs AI analysis and Markdown report export, summarizes archived DSH sessions into the week as one entry per session in the language and at the length the reader picks, requires an explicit force flag to edit a past week, turns one suite-wide telemetry failure analysis into a GitHub issue report, and checks the npm registry for a newer release, returning the exact upgrade command instead of installing anything.

title: zhangzhenwen1/qmd-autosearch
description: Auto-supplement QMD semantic search when the model greps/globs a knowledge-base directory: zero-dependency DSH plugin, async injection via next-step, no manual invocation.

title: zhaoyuntao-wl/dsh-plugin-thread
description: Decision-and-goal memory with lineage: explicit commands and a model tool record decisions deterministically, a status card re-anchors them across compaction, a lossless event stream with BM25+jieba retrieval backs it, and a scenario-level fidelity regression suite gates releases.

title: zhengjy01/dsh-flomo
description: Write notes and memos to flomo (浮墨笔记) from any agent via the flomo_send tool, configured once with the flomo API URL or API Key.

title: zhengjy01/dsh-flomo-report
description: Generate AI-narrated DSH session reports (daily/weekly/monthly, any date range) and sync them to flomo (浮墨笔记) with one configurable tag (default #write/dsh) and automatic # stripping, via a web settings panel with daily reminder.

title: zhengjy01/dsh-notion-connector
description: Notion connector for DeepSeek Harness: search, read, query, create, update, and append Notion pages and databases via six agent tools, with a Web settings page — configured once with an Integration Token.

title: zhibaiYingChuan/dsh-plugin-lrc
description: Connects DeepSeek Harness to LRC's local structured memory: distills conclusions every 8 turns, drops near-duplicates by character-level Jaccard similarity (≥ 0.85), and writes them to a local LRC store. Five tools — lrc_recall, lrc_forget, lrc_remember_now, lrc_handoff and lrc_status — cover on-demand recall, retracting wrong entries, immediate writes, session handoff and a status line. On first run it downloads a per-platform LRC binary (win32-x64, darwin-arm64 or linux-x64, SHA256-verified) and starts an isolated instance, so the LRC desktop app is not required; data stays in $DSH_HOME/cache/lrc-plugin/data unless LRC_BASE points at an existing instance.

title: zhiwuli0228/dsh-memory-hub
description: Local-first, file-native long-term memory for DSH with per-turn preflight, compact context injection, citations, human-approved writes, manual consolidation, nightly report-only maintenance, and a Web panel that is read-only for knowledge while allowing workspace-config edits.

title: zhujunpeng12/dsh-memory-system
description: Local-first persistent memory for DeepSeek Harness: bounded pre-step hot-memory injection, exact and Chinese-bigram BM25 cold recall, six agent tools, approval-gated lease-lock writes with recovery receipts, and read-only governance and trajectory-review candidates.

title: zilliztech/memsearch#MemSearch
description: Shared Markdown memory for DSH and other coding agents, with automatic capture, pre-step context injection, searchable recall, and memory-to-skill self-evolution through a review panel.

title: zilta-amaze/dsh-recovery-memory
description: Conversation memory behind a 20-letter recovery code: /recovery create packs the current conversation into one local record, and /recovery memory <code> injects it into a new conversation, where the model first summarises the recovered session and ends its reply with 记忆已恢复. Records are plain JSON under $DSH_HOME/recovery (mode 0600) with no network calls; the restored transcript is complete unless it exceeds the configured character budget, and /recovery where plus the dir option or DSH_RECOVERY_DIR move the directory to shared storage or a synced folder.

title: Zoria-Lind/dsh-ecolink#adapter
description: Shares a local memory pool between DeepSeek web chat and Harness, with full-answer saving and sidebar browsing and injection. The optional Windows desktop patch for DSH 0.2.2-rc.1 adds shadow sessions that sync completed web turns to Harness, display Harness replies in the original web chat, and hand tasks off to Harness.

title: ZSeven-W/dsh-noema
description: Long-term memory for DSH agents — durable, inspectable memories with recall, search, browse and knowledge-graph tools, import from ten other AI coding tools, and a settings page.

title: zuoyunlai/dsh-chronicle
description: Daily chronicle for DeepSeek Harness: collects session events, closes the previous calendar day after midnight into a Markdown week file (LLM scoring adds a daily summary; rule scoring does not), and extracts durable facts — decisions, conventions, pitfalls — that merge across days and can be superseded. 10 tools, a read-only sidebar panel, rule export, and a standalone Obsidian vault; zero third-party dependencies.

title: zwebzzz/almost-for-ever
description: Derives the index from your Markdown memory files on every turn instead of keeping a hand-written index table, so renames, splits and deletions never leave a stale entry. Retrieval ranks by library tags, section tags, title tokens and body text, then injects the matching line ranges rather than whole files. Writing is model-proposed and user-confirmed through a sticky note; entries are appended after the target section's format is detected. Ships a structure panel showing each library and section with line ranges and token estimates, a starter template for an empty memory directory, and optional appearance controls.

title: ZyxQl-Ala/dsh-decay-memory
description: Agent memory with a forgetting curve: entries gain weight when mentioned, shrink when forgotten, and pinned entries never decay. Six tools and a settings panel.

title: zzy-fxxxexxxyxxx/dsh-openclaw-memory
description: Share an existing OpenClaw Markdown workspace with DeepSeek Harness as bounded persona and memory context, with Sidebar browsing and editing.

title: 0xRabit/dsh-crypto-portfolio
description: Self-hosted crypto portfolio dashboard: BTC, EVM (73 chains via DeBank), Solana, Dogecoin, Cardano, Hyperliquid L1, five exchanges (Binance, Bybit, Backpack, OKX, Bitget) and tokenised equities in one view, with multi-provider failover, custom asset labels, a tunable asset-health report, a shareable PNG card, per-source connection tests, multi-profile configs, scheduled refresh and zero-dependency charts (Python stdlib + vanilla JS, no CDN).

title: 111xjyuan/dsh-desktop-sidecar
description: Native Windows desktop control for DSH, 21 tools: UIA control tree plus offline OCR to see the screen, click a control by its name, type CJK without touching your clipboard, and drive WeChat / Office / browsers / online-class pages. It never steals your mouse or keyboard (it waits for you to stop), never resizes your windows, lets you type corrections mid-task from a sidebar panel, and after every action it reads the screen back and tells you honestly when it could not confirm. Persistent built-in browser channel. No driver, no extra runtime.

title: 1321928757/dsh-mysql
description: MySQL connector for DeepSeek Harness: configure multiple connections in the settings page with per-connection table allowlist and write permission, switch the active connection from the composer, and expose mysql_query / mysql_tables / mysql_execute tools to every agent preset.

title: 1344738825/ai-residue-cleaner
description: Sweeps AI byproducts (scratch files, backups, logs, caches) into a reversible trash per project, and on project close classifies deliverables, archives reference results and writes a cleanup report. Requires Python 3 on PATH (the cleanup engine is a Python script; python3 / python / py are auto-detected, and without one cleanup cannot run and says so).

title: 1497105876/dsh-media-studio
description: Generate images and videos directly in chat and deliver them to the conversation: generate_image / generate_video / send_media tools, a built-in Agnes free tier plus any OpenAI-compatible backend, background jobs that auto-push finished media, and inline gallery and video cards with download, lightbox, and native open.

title: 1497105876/dsh-tools-manager
description: Deny-only tool blacklist per agent preset. Tick a tool off in Settings and it leaves that mode's tool schema and its calls are rejected; nothing is ever enabled or whitelisted, and tools nobody denied are left alone. Each row expands to that tool's own description, and rules live in one JSON file outside the profile.

title: 18518182595-cell/dsh-prompt-workshop
description: Turn rough ideas into precise prompts for 19 image/video generation, writing, code and text models, with multi-model enhancement, prompt scoring, image-to-prompt and a periodic self-updating knowledge base.

title: 19952730389/dsh-app-updater
description: Detect which installed apps have a newer version and update them with one click, downloading each vendor's full installer from its official site and installing it silently. Windows via winget, macOS via Homebrew casks, matching the machine's ARM64 or x64 architecture.

title: 1997liuyh-boop/dsh-desktop-tools
description: DSH Desktop toolkit with separate settings for each feature: a selection toolbar, a floating assistant, and screenshot, long screenshot and screen recording modes opened by global shortcuts from a toolbar at the top of the screen. Screenshots support shapes, pen, arrows, text and numbered markers, mosaic, pin to desktop, saving, and forwarding to a DSH conversation or the system share panel (Windows and macOS); recordings capture an area, a window or a full screen as MP4, GIF or WebM with optional system sound and microphone. Extract text, Translate and Knowledge graph on captures use the OCR tools of dsh-vision-router, which is installed separately (the settings page offers a one-click install). Requires DSH Desktop >=0.2.2-rc.1 <0.3.0-0. The features run in a separate Electron helper process and the plugin does not download Electron: with the installer build of DSH Desktop you must provide a standalone Electron through the electronExecutable setting, the DSH_DESKTOP_TOOLS_ELECTRON environment variable or $DSH_HOME/electron/; a DSH Desktop started from a bare Electron reuses it. System sound recording is not available on Linux.

title: 1997liuyh-boop/dsh-studio-fitness
description: Local fitness studio recording workouts, exercise duration and training volume within the DSH workspace, stored in the browser. Needs the dsh-studio-projects runtime and the dsh-worktable container from 1997liuyh-boop/dsh-studio-library installed first.

title: 19north/dsh-redstone-music
description: Minecraft redstone music: rm_render renders instrument samples from a SoundFont and aligns every onset to within 3 ms, and rm_build compiles a song plus lane table into a datapack of scheduled mcfunction shards (optionally deployed over RCON).

title: 1byteone/dsh-plugin-nlbi
description: Natural-language data queries + BI reports: Text2SQL, charts, report saving, schema/data grid panel, and a sidebar workbench — all behind DSH's MySQL connection layer.

title: 1jiegejiayouxuewangan1/dsh-desktop-uia
description: Windows desktop control through UI Automation: nine tools that read a window control tree and drive elements by id through their own UI Automation patterns, with every write gated by an approval policy, an append-only action log and a settings panel.

title: 1na-ko/dsh-hdc-bridge
description: HarmonyOS device bridge: hdc screenshot/install/log/crash/UI automation loop with read_image, official-first versioned API knowledge (SDK .d.ts + offline bundled docs), and a DevEco CLI build/sign/lint lane.

title: 2025Bigeye/dsh-nanobot-subagent-link
description: Runs the local nanobot CLI agent as a DSH subagent through a nanobot_run tool: each call carries one self-contained task and returns only the agent's final answer, either as a fresh process or through a persistent OpenAI-compatible server.

title: 2026heshao/dsh-armory
description: Unified MCP, skill and expert management board for DeepSeek Harness: connection status, tool schemas, enable/disable and reconnect for MCP servers across global and per-project scopes, enable/disable of SKILL.md skills, attach/switch/detach WorkBuddy expert personas in any conversation at any time (429 experts) with no mid-session preset lock, a tool tailor that scans local session logs for per-tool call counts, error rates and context-token cost with one-click disabling, and three install markets (SkillHub 190k+ skills, WorkBuddy connectors, 47 verified built-in services).

title: 2026heshao/dsh-obsidian-board
description: Turns a local Obsidian vault into a dedicated RAG chat panel: a sidebar page with the note browser, the retrieval-augmented chat and the cited source side by side, answering from fully local BM25 plus CJK-bigram retrieval over your notes and streaming through the DSH model channel, with clickable \[n] citations and mtime-based incremental indexing.

title: 2048lr/dsh-feishu
description: Creates and edits Feishu and Lark cloud content through ten tools - Bitable databases and their records, documents with Markdown converted to native blocks, spreadsheets, wikis, drive files and messages - plus Base V3 dashboard charts and server-side aggregate queries.

title: 2239058652/dsh-mcp-workbench
description: MCP management console for DeepSeek Harness — a left-sidebar page that lists every configured MCP server, trial-calls its tools in place, restarts a single row when its transport dies or never synced, and probes reachability. A fork of PerryLink/dsh-mcp-panel; do not install it alongside the upstream plugin — both register the /mcp command.

title: 2286893544/feishu-dsh-plugin
description: Feishu (Lark) integration for DeepSeek Harness: 25 tools for chat messages and history, cloud documents (including knowledge-base pages, generated charts and images), bitable records, spreadsheet ranges and drive permissions, using your own enterprise self-built Feishu app.

title: 27painter/dsh-nx
description: Drives Siemens NX 2406 and 2506 from DeepSeek Harness, plus NX 12: an executor that judges a journal run from its log rather than its exit code (NX returns 0 for a journal that swallowed its exception, and 0xC0000409 after a clean one), 16 typed tools over a resident batch NX, and a probe that keeps the three releases apart. Windows only; NX 2406 is the reference release, 2506 expected. Requires a local Siemens NX install and a free NX licence seat; run `dsh-nx install` once, and the 16 MCP tools stay off until `NX_ENABLE_MCP=1` is set (the skill route works without it).

title: 27painter/dsh-sw-cad
description: Registers two MCP servers that drive the installed AutoCAD and SolidWorks desktop apps over COM, plus two on-demand skills. Windows only, Python 3.11+; the pinned upstream servers install themselves on first load, and only the sides whose CAD application is registered get a row. Each server advertises two meta-tools instead of its full catalog (a discovery shim here for SolidWorks, upstream DISCOVERY_MODE=search for AutoCAD), taking the schemas loaded before the first request from 23,404 to 256 tokens and from 83,732 to 365 respectively.

title: 333YYY-BIT/emotion-state-portrait
description: Emotion, energy and per-user portrait engine for AI characters: a 303-word emotion library scored in two steps (pick one of 6 categories first, then choose within it), novelty reward and same-word cooldown for diversity, a spirit meter with easter-egg state transitions (excited / suppressed / angry), and per-user portraits. File mode works with any AI; the optional OneBot mode reads friend message history from a OneBot 11 endpoint such as NapCat. Requires your own OpenAI-compatible LLM endpoint and API key (EMOTION_LLM_KEY or emotion/config.json).

title: 379385796-sys/dsh-environment-packer
description: Private Windows DSH cold archives and guarded fresh-environment recovery. v0.7.3 classifies the known plugin Home directories `.dsh-paper-reader`, `dsham-move-backup` and `music` as captured plugin data, restores them as data-only, and resolves matching legacy pending-review entries during read-only planning; unknown or incomplete trees remain critical and blocking. Strict dependency, transaction and verify/commit gates remain. Verified ZIP integrity does not certify private business recovery.

title: 3ChatAI-NCT/3chatai-deepseek-harness-plugin
description: Connect DeepSeek Harness to 3Chat via OAuth for customer and conversation search, context retrieval, confirmed messaging, and batch-send tracking.

title: 439436269-ctrl/dsh-automations
description: Runs a local command, an HTTP request or a log entry on DSH lifecycle events (startup, session start/idle/end, user messages, tool results) or on a daily or interval schedule; a left-rail panel and five agent tools manage the same rule set.

title: 439436269-ctrl/dsh-search
description: Web search, page fetch and one-call research through DeepSeek's official Search and Fetch API; needs a DeepSeek API key.

title: 439436269-ctrl/dsh-zspace
description: Turns a ZSpace (极空间) NAS into native agent tools: list, stat, search, read, download, upload, write, create folders, rename, move, copy and delete files on the NAS. Works across networks through the desktop client relay — no LAN, no WebDAV, no SSH — and switches to the faster direct WebDAV transport automatically when the NAS is on the same network. Deletes require an explicit confirm: true; write, upload, create-folder, rename, move and copy run directly, and zspace_write overwrites a same-named file unless overwrite is false.

title: 4444wjt/dsh-plugin-veriscope
description: Release gate for AI answer quality. Two channels: replay an existing VeriScope archive through the original Python quality gate, or run a threshold gate over a Ragas per-row export with Node only — no VeriScope, Python or pandas. Returns PASS, FAIL or REVIEW with source evidence and a re-checkable receipt; supports per-row thresholds and exact decimal comparison. It never re-evaluates and never calls a model, and REVIEW never becomes PASS.

title: 474885697-alt/dsh-kit#dsh-rulebook
description: Extracts chapters, numbered clauses, keyword tables and numeric values from a docx, txt or md rulebook into JSON, and flags duplicate clauses and missing values.

title: 4KAForever11/dsh-mcd-mcp
description: Brings McDonald's China official MCP (mcp.mcd.cn) into DSH. Paste a token you generated yourself and the plugin handshakes, calls tools/list, and registers every remote tool as a native DSH tool (mcd_ prefix) — upstream additions and removals need no code change, just a restart. Ships four always-on tools (mcd_status, mcd_test, mcd_tools, mcd_call) for self-checks and direct fallback calls, plus a settings page with a one-click connection test. The token is stored only on this machine in ~/.dsh/dsh-mcd-mcp.json (mode 600); it never enters the repository or the conversation context.

title: dsh-video-notes
description: Agent tools that download a Bilibili video, transcribe it with a local whisper.cpp build, then write a structured Markdown note with DSH's own LLM (optionally printing it to PDF). Windows only: missing dependencies are auto-downloaded into the data directory — yt-dlp.exe and the ffmpeg.exe build from GitHub and gyan.dev, the whisper.cpp x64 binary from GitHub, and a ~547 MB model from the hf-mirror mirror; PDF export shells out to a locally installed Edge/Chrome. Two tools: video_to_notes and note_to_pdf. Pure JS, no extra API key.

title: 58catmiao/dsh-sciwork
description: A research library panel and skill set for DSH: project folders, figures with registered provenance, drafts, references, data tables, journal profiles and submissions, plus writing, citation and Origin-plotting discipline for research agents.

title: 60studay/dsh-serial-whalesong
description: Serial-port toolkit for DSH - 9 tools plus a web UI where an AI agent and a human share one UART line, with auto port matching, hex/text frames, timestamps, scheduled sends, rule-based auto-recovery and appearance themes. The serial engine runs on Python 3.8+ — DSH's bundled interpreter is used when present, otherwise python / py -3 on PATH.

title: 643048695/dsh-mt-download
description: Adds a download_file tool that fetches a URL over 16 aria2c connections and falls back to a single stream when aria2 is unavailable. Needs aria2c installed separately; the aria2 channel does not verify TLS certificates.

title: 781237194/agile-workbench#dsh-pm-workbench
description: Installs and opens PM Workbench, a local Electron multi-role project workbench, from a DSH tool. Windows only: the first load bootstraps Node, Electron and the app through a PowerShell installer. It does not embed the workbench UI in DSH.

title: acttk/dsh-bili-interactor
description: Browses Bilibili on your behalf and actually takes part: search videos, like, coin, send danmaku, post comments, reply to other people, and keep replying when someone answers back. Reads the video's Bilibili AI subtitle (or transcribes the audio locally when there is none) so its comments talk about what the video really says, and it reads that same content before choosing whom to reply to. Instead of copying other people's sentences, it distills rules about how to sound like a person and gets less AI-ish the more it runs. Skips videos it already browsed, de-duplicates replies per thread, and after too many rounds with the same person in one comment section it reviews whether the exchange has any substance -- if it looks like two bots complimenting each other, it says one last line and stops replying to that person there. Checks whether each comment is genuinely public or only visible to your own account, can scan any time window (last hour / day / 3 days / all) and lists the ones others cannot see, warning you on the overview when replies got folded. Six-tab settings panel where every change takes effect immediately with no restart, a manual run that queues behind the background listener instead of being refused, and an environment self-check that tells you exactly what to install. Requires Python 3 for the Bilibili actions; the built-in check lists any missing packages.

description: Personal finance plugin for DSH with structured Beancount ledger tools.
