title: dingchenhui0618-arch/dsh-compress-bench
description: A local mirrored A/B benchmark for context compression, not another compressor. It runs one fixed read-only scenario twice with the same model and temperature — compression off, then on — and reports input tokens, turns, tool-call success, fact coverage, answer similarity and a per-line diff, with JSON, a self-contained SVG and raw warnings. 18 node --test tests, zero dependencies. The first measured run: 63,029 → 6,927 locally estimated input tokens (−89.0%), 3 → 3 turns, facts 3/3 → 3/3, answer similarity 1.00 on one sample.

title: dingchenhui0618-arch/dsh-cost-ledger
description: Auditable token-cost ledger for DeepSeek Harness: wraps the llm/stream waterfall and records every call with provider, model, input/output/cache-hit/cache-write tokens, usage source and integer nano-CNY cost from an explicit price table. Aggregates by hour, day and session; exports JSON or CSV with a no-write dry-run preview; keeps a manually entered official platform bill in a parallel column with actual-minus-estimate diff. Unknown provider/model routes stay explicitly unpriced. Zero runtime dependencies; no balance query, notifications or animations.

title: dingchenhui0618-arch/dsh-delivery-receipt
description: A delivery receipt panel for a project hand-off. One trigger collects the branch and commit, the test and build results, screenshot dimensions with sha256, and the secret-scan verdict, then assigns every line to one of three zones by evidence alone — verified, local-only, or unverified. A claim in the unverified zone keeps its label and prints an explicitly empty slot instead of the claim itself, because a confidently worded sentence with nothing behind it is the exact thing the receipt exists to catch. Test failures and secret-scan hits are still evidence, so they land in the verified zone with a red tone rather than being quietly dropped.

title: dingchenhui0618-arch/dsh-mp-catalog-guard
description: Content-catalog guard for WeChat mini-programs: validates catalog.json so every activity price is an integer amountFen, every template renders prices through money(), required fields / duplicate copy / image paths are checked, and the result is an issue list plus a unified diff that can be applied with patch -p1. 29 rules over five groups (catalog shape, required fields and uniqueness, amounts, rendering, images). Three fixes are automatic (legacy yuan amount, string Fen, absolute image path) and preserve the file's own indent, EOL and trailing newline; everything else is reported with a hint instead of being guessed. Dry-run by default; apply re-checks the written file so the report describes what remains. One implementation serves a tool, a conversation panel and a CLI with exit codes 0/1/2. Zero runtime dependencies, no model call, no network.

title: dingchenhui0618-arch/dsh-pua-receipt
description: Measured /pua for DeepSeek Harness: every pressure message gets a receipt comparing the last N completed model steps with the next N — tool calls, verification-class steps, repeated-call peak, failed calls and text volume — with a three-way verdict (changed approach / merely restated / no change) and a daily ranking of which sentence moved the work. Ships a conversation-view panel, a /pua command with list/status/receipts/rank/off, append-only local JSONL receipts (no tool arguments, content or session ids), 38 node:test tests and a zero-dependency build. Reports observed differences, not causality. Inspired by MichengAI/dsh-pua (independent code); it registers the same /pua command, so it cannot be installed alongside dsh-pua.

title: dingchenhui0618-arch/dsh-ship-receipt
description: A shareable delivery receipt for a project hand-off. The `ship_receipt` tool measures what it can and records what it was told, then sorts every line into three zones: verified (evidence this run produced and that reproduces elsewhere — a command that actually ran with its exit code, a file hash for a file that is under version control, a scan that found files, a git ref present in the recorded remote), local-only (true on this machine alone — uncommitted changes, unpushed commits, an artifact no one else can see), and unverified (no evidence, including every sentence a human typed). A claim with no evidence keeps its label and leaves the body blank rather than printing the claim; declares the commit and branch, artifact byte sizes and sha256 with PNG dimensions, and the three pre-push checks.

title: dingchenhui0618-arch/dsh-skill-radar
description: Skill usage radar for DeepSeek Harness: records every skill hit from the skill tool and /name gestures into a local JSONL ledger, ranks skills by hits in the last 7 days, greys out zero-hit skills with an archive suggestion, and expands a row into time, session, trigger and prompt. Ships a conversation-view panel with frontmatter model-invocation toggle, skill creation, and a recoverable .trash archive/restore. 52 zero-dependency tests; loopback-only, no external network.

title: dingchenhui0618-arch/dsh-tab-complete
description: The composer predicts what you are about to type. Inline ghost text sits on the caret, measured against the editor's own font and line box, and Tab turns it into real text (Esc ignores it). The prediction is one short call through the session's own model router, seeded with your draft and the last few turns of the conversation, so an empty composer also gets a next-prompt guess written in the user's voice; suggestions that merely restate the assistant are dropped. Host side is one HTTP route with sub-path endpoints (loopback-only, 64 KB body cap, 2-minute result cache, 20-second miss cache, one in-flight call per session); client side is one 0-height overlay registered on conversation.input.overlay, with insertion guarded by the composer's draftRev CAS and a setDraft fallback. IME composition and slash commands are skipped. 16 node:test cases, zero runtime dependencies, real screenshots in docs/.

title: dingchenhui0618-arch/dsh-take-sheet
description: A conversation-view tab for turning one local reference video into a human-curated shot list. ffmpeg scdet finds shot boundaries, each shot gets one timecoded thumbnail, you untick what you do not need, and the export writes frames.csv (UTF-8 BOM), shots.json, numbered JPEG frames and a labelled contact sheet. Local-only, no upload, zero runtime dependencies, 39 node --test tests including a real-ffmpeg integration case. Requires ffmpeg 5.1+ (with ffprobe) installed separately.

title: disantosmyha-cloud/tempguard#dsh-plugin-tempguard

Needs the separate tempguard Python watchdog and its alertd service running locally, with projectDir and alertdToken set in the profile patch; there is no npm package, so install from a local clone of the repository subfolder.

Defaults to a nudge (a reminder injected into the next request); cutting and auto-resuming is opt-in, and should not be combined with another plugin's cutting such as dsh-loop-rescue. Needs DSH 0.2.1+ and Node.js 22.15+.

Fully local, zero network. Requires Python 3.8+.

title: dream-office/dsh-cross-workspace

title: drscrewdriver/dsh-bash-terminal-ts
description: Shell tool with four Windows backends (PowerShell / Git Bash / WSL / MSYS2) plus an interactive PTY terminal; the MSYS2 backend starts bash.exe with -lc so /etc/profile puts /usr/bin and /mingw64/bin on PATH, and injects MSYSTEM=MINGW64 into the PTY environment. Written in TypeScript, targets DSH 0.1.2+.

title: drscrewdriver/dsh-cookie-cleaner
description: The cyber-elixir of youth for the desktop client: fixes the `desktop welcome: Web authentication failed` (HTTP 431) launch failure — an Electron random-port launch lets `dsh-auth-*` login cookies pile up per port (70+ of them, ~229 B each), the startup request headers blow past Node's default 16 KB cap, and the client can no longer launch. Two fixes in one: a scriptable cleaner that removes leftover login cookies from the cookie database (Chromium SQLite) — explicit, offline, keeps a `.bak` copy, `--expired-only` narrows the scope — and a `patch` feature on the settings panel that fixes the launch port through the profile `cordis.patch.yml`, so the client always starts from a single port and cookies stop accumulating across different ones (rewrite `port` as a `!!js` expression to keep the `--port` flag in charge; a per-profile snapshot makes one click revert it). Read the README for usage. Interface, CLI output and market metadata in 9 languages. The purge runs from the bundled CLI (`dsh-cookie-cleaner --clean`) only while the client is fully closed; the in-app half is read-only. npm: `dsh-cookie-cleaner`.

title: drscrewdriver/dsh-patch-edit-plus
description: Patch-style file editing: one apply_patch tool accepting git/unified diff (default) and Codex apply_patch syntax (opt-in), applying every change all-or-nothing after a full read-only verification pass, with sandbox-aware delete and move and a dry-run mode.

The "ignore intro" scan maintains a SQLite fingerprint cache keyed by absolute path and size, with MAD-first frame lookup and dHash/pHash fallback; incomplete cache rows are removed and rebuilt automatically, and a full scan rebuilds the band index. A "quick file lookup" takes one file, uses the cache when present, generates its fingerprint on demand when missing, and reports a task with live logs, progress and cancellation without rescanning the source folder. Duration-bucket matching always probes and captures fresh, and does not use the fingerprint cache. Batch rename or move by extension, UUID, file size or video length; empty-folder cleanup; MOV/AVI/WMV detected by header and transcoded to MP4 keeping resolution, frame rate and audio. Requires ffmpeg and ffprobe. Scans run in a sidecar worker with live progress, A-B single-direction dedupe and asynchronous fingerprint writes; one task at a time; local-only API. Every task that moves files has one-click restore: per-group/target _dupfc_restore.json records, deleted files skipped and counted, files outside the record renamed to UUID and moved into resetFail.

title: JularDepick/dsh-wakatime-plugin
description: A plugin for dsh: quantify every dsh Agent interaction as a visualized performance metric and automatically sync it to WakaTime, using data to showcase your productivity with Agent.

title: junecattle/dsh-attachment-cache
description: Attachment store manager: per-conversation inventory, impact-aware deletion, and relocation of ~/.dsh/attachments to another disk (relocation tested on Windows 11 only).

title: JungleYXu/dsh-loadout
description: Per-conversation tool kits for DeepSeek Harness: pick one kit and only its tools reach the model, with three bases (All, built-in only, or a saved kit), add-ons for one-off combinations, and a token ledger estimating what the kit saves.

title: JunKoProject/dsh-read-book
description: Search four free libraries from one window: Project Gutenberg through its OPDS catalog, Shuge through its WordPress search plus the s.shuge.org short links on each book page, and NCPSSD through its Solr-backed endpoint. The Chinese Text Project is deliberately link-only, because its terms forbid automated access. Two tools: readbook_search and readbook_open; the second returns real download URLs for Gutenberg and Shuge, and only a page link for NCPSSD.

title: justinzyc271828-sys/dsh-ai-jobs
description: Indexes public AI-company job boards (Greenhouse, Ashby, Lever, Workable, SmartRecruiters), scores postings for AI relevance, extracts the requirements from each job description, and produces a scheduled daily Markdown digest.

title: dsh-baidu-netdisk
description: Connects DeepSeek Harness to Baidu Netdisk's official MCP service for file search, file metadata, and storage quota. Requires Baidu account authorization after installation.

title: justinzyc271828-sys/dsh-music
description: Connects DeepSeek Harness to Suno's official MCP to check credits and browse or search your music library. Sign in with your own Suno account after installation.

title: juzpost/dsh-juzpost
description: Connects the agent to JuzPost, a social media scheduler, over MCP: lists connected accounts, checks per-platform limits, uploads media, and drafts, schedules or publishes posts to YouTube, Instagram, Facebook, TikTok, X, LinkedIn, Pinterest, Bluesky, Threads, Tumblr and WordPress. Registers the JuzPost tools as mcp__juzpost__* plus a workflow skill that confirms with the user before anything is published. Needs a JuzPost API key in JUZPOST_API_KEY; JuzPost issues API keys on paid plans.

title: jxhsjxhs/dsh-job-lasso
description: Daily remote job hunting across BOSS Zhipin, Liepin, LinkedIn and other Chinese job boards, scored against a saved profile and shown in a Harness panel. Requires a local Chrome/Chromium install (the plugin launches its own browser profile) and a BOSS Zhipin account for BOSS results.

title: k0ndrateff/dsh-plugins#atlassian
description: Jira and Confluence for DeepSeek Harness: the tools of Atlassian remote MCP server, a result card for issues and pages, and an issue panel.

title: Kagurazaka135/dsh-web-search-free
description: A WebSearchProvider that falls back across backends instead of relying on one: Exa, then Bing HTML, then DuckDuckGo HTML, and only then the quota-limited SerpAPI, so the free tiers carry routine searching.

title: kaiwangleo/xiwen#dsh-xiwen
description: Semantic-layer analytics tool that uses curated table, column and metric metadata with Qdrant and Elasticsearch recall to generate, validate and execute MySQL analytical queries through the Xiwen service.

title: kaixinguo360/dsh-script-manager
description: Custom script manager for DSH: turn verified operations into reusable scripts that run directly via /script or register as agent tools, with parameterized scripts, declared expected outcomes, and execution history.

title: Kaixxrua/dsh-aigc-radar
description: Search AIGC Radar's curated GitHub AI project library (500-star admission, bilingual zh/en tags, star-growth snapshots) over its MCP endpoint with native result cards; an agent/pre-step listener proactively suggests a reuse check before the agent writes code.

title: kaka-crypto/dsh-disk-guard
description: Redirects DSH downloads, artifacts, caches and temp files to user-specified drives (auto-picks the largest non-C drive), injects a path-discipline prompt into every session, and ships a disk_guard tool for status and cleanup — keeps the C: drive from filling up.

title: Kandecho/Video-Reader#dsh-video-reader
description: Connects DSH to timestamped video reading, shared queues/history and Scroll personal Bilibili workflows through an existing Video Reader installation. Windows x64 only: install the core and set VIDEO_READER_ROOT before starting DSH; the bundle does not install Python, FFmpeg, models or Bilibili credentials.

title: KannaKuron/dsh-gitbash-shell
description: Windows plugin that swaps the host shell executor for Git for Windows bash across every agent mode, materializes Git Bash variants of the standard, minimal, PTC and Cordis presets (per-file sha256-marked, user edits preserved), and exposes a gitBash capability so companion presets pick Git Bash automatically; when dsh-better-sidebar is installed it also adopts that sidebar's terminal shell (UI tabs and the model-facing terminal_* tools) through its official settings seam.

title: KannaKuron/dsh-ptc-cordis-preset
description: Agent preset for DeepSeek Harness that layers the self-referential Cordis toolset (dynamic plugins, runtime inspection) and preset-authoring skills onto the PTC Code-Mode preset; materialized files carry per-file sha256 markers, so user-edited presets are never overwritten on upgrade or uninstall.

title: karla-zhang/dsh-plugin-account-sync
description: Syncs the same DeepSeek account's terminals: plugin inventory and enablement, app settings, selected workspace files, session logs and skills / agent presets. Four transports (shared folder, git, WebDAV, LAN) and five independent content toggles, with a dry-run plan, conflict copies and additive-only session import. Its optional LAN transport listens on 0.0.0.0 (port 47810 by default) and is protected only by a pairing token over plain HTTP; synced app settings and workspace files are not encrypted by the plugin (secrets are stripped before publishing).

title: KB1SLN-Labs/dsh-linear
description: Linear tools for DeepSeek Harness: 26 model-facing tools over the Linear GraphQL API (issues, comments, relations, teams, states, labels, projects, cycles, users) plus a linear_graphql escape hatch. Requires a Linear personal API token.

title: kdcadmin/dsh_douyin_tools
description: Douyin assistant plugin: picks a daily round of videos, reads comments, writes a dated report, can like and comment with an @ mention (both off by default), and publishes clips rendered by your own ComfyUI. Windows only; needs Python 3 and a system Chrome, and the first run needs the install-main-dependencies step plus a QR-code login.

title: kdcadmin/dsh_qzone_sticker
description: QQ Zone poster for DeepSeek Harness (repo dsh_qzone_sticker): scan a QQ login once, then let the model publish posts with mood-matched sticker images, with a daily cap and a silent headless Chrome session.

title: keer1024/dsh-native#packages/dsh-rust-exec
description: Resident Rust sidecar for Windows that folds shell-heavy tool calls into one warm worker: 11 tools (10 rust_* tools plus a native_help entry point; 5 resident, 6 activated on demand) for command execution, sha256-guarded file reads and writes, code indexing and search, session-log projection and resource sampling, served by a lane pool with soft RSS and CPU limits over 8 HTTP routes.

title: kenny2077/dsh-web-search-zai
description: Web search for DeepSeek Harness through Z.ai or Zhipu, with Coding Plan MCP quota and REST API billing modes, a native bilingual settings card, and support for reusing an existing ZAI_API_KEY.

title: kentleenot/dsh-trading-toolkit
description: A-share and US stock trading toolkit for DSH agents: realtime quotes, OHLCV klines, ADX three-state regime signals and simple backtest previews via EastMoney. Read-only, never places orders.

title: Keridium/dsh-gopeed-downloader
description: Agent tools for a local Gopeed downloader: create, inspect, pause, resume and remove downloads, diagnose or launch the Gopeed process, and receive download-complete events through a DSH background job that wakes an idle agent. Process diagnostics and launching are Windows-only; the download tools work wherever Gopeed runs.

title: kevinchu1981/dsh-insurance-experts#insurance-actuary
description: Insurance actuary — runs real actuarial calculations (life & P&C reserve valuation under C-ROSS II BEL+RM, profit testing NBV/VNB/IRR, embedded value EV, pricing & loss-triangle reserving), not just explanations.

title: kevinchu1981/dsh-insurance-experts#insurance-company-analyst
description: Insurance company financial & operating analyst — solvency, financials, investment, distribution channels and peer comparison with real calculations.

title: kevinchu1981/dsh-insurance-experts#insurance-ops-analyst
description: Insurance company operations analyst — runs real solvency, profitability, embedded value (EV), investment risk and regulatory compliance calculations, not just text explanations.

title: kevinchu1981/dsh-insurance-experts#insurance-product-analyst
description: Insurance product comparison & proposal expert — clause analysis, cost-effectiveness, coverage planning, generates verifiable client-facing PDF proposals.

title: kexijiang/dsh-harmony
description: HarmonyOS device workbench for DSH NEXT Desktop on Windows x64 (tested with DSH NEXT 2.0.21-next and Better Sidebar 0.28.2); the floating mirror reuses DSH's Electron or downloads one (~140 MB) on first use.

title: kexuejin/dsh-zhihu-dashboard
description: Zhihu (知乎) dashboard: hot list with trend arrows, follow feed (favorites/creations/followees), post tracking (question/keyword/person) with auto-briefs, and five agent tools (zhihu_search/hot/answer/global_search/followees).

title: keyblues/dsh-fengniao-company-search
description: Look up Chinese companies inside the conversation: name a company and get its business registration, shareholders, executives, outbound investments and registration changes, plus judicial and operating-risk records such as enforcement, dishonest judgment debtor, consumption restriction, abnormal operation, serious illegality and administrative penalties (11 dimension groups). Results render as conversation cards with fields and the raw payload on expand, and the API key is saved from the plugin page into the Harness credential store.

title: keyblues/dsh-plugin-everything
description: Whole-disk file search on Windows: ask for files or folders by name, path, extension, size or modified date and get matches from the local voidtools Everything index in milliseconds, with full paths, sizes and modified times. A second card reports whether Everything is reachable and how many items it indexes. Ships the official Everything SDK, so no es.exe or HTTP server is needed; Everything 1.4+ must be installed and running (the plugin can start it).

title: kezan31/dsh-copy-tool
description: Adds a line-based copy tool for replacing or inserting file sections, with indentation control and diff previews.

title: kgmkm/dsh-genspark
description: Genspark tools for DeepSeek Harness - web search, crawl, image/video/audio generation, media analysis, X/Instagram/Reddit search and model listing through @genspark/cli, with 17 typed tools and 18 /genspark-* commands. Requires @genspark/cli installed and logged in (gsk login), or GSK_API_KEY set.

title: kgmkm/dsh-rustxng
description: Answers the built-in web_search from a self-hosted RustXNG metasearch instance, downloading and starting that binary on demand and stopping it after an idle timeout; an optional fetch provider also decodes pages whose charset is declared only in <meta>.

title: kiligzzz/dsh-agent-dispatch
description: User-defined agents with automatic routing, model failover, and squad orchestration: six model tools (agent_dispatch / agent_followup / agent_list / agent_squad / agent_import_skill / agent_upsert), no built-in agents, a native right-tab panel (Overview / Agents / Squads / History), and a floating action ball.

title: kingguuu8-svg/dsh-pi-compatible
description: Pi-compatible tool suite recreated inside DeepSeek Harness: installs lower-case read/write/edit/bash/find/grep/ls core tools while retaining DSH-backed web, task, plan, todo, think, and slash extensions.

title: kingofpowers/dsh-context-archive
description: Model-driven tool-result archiving for DeepSeek Harness. Results above a configurable size carry a short inline id (\[#a1b2c3d4]); the model archives the ones it no longer needs into the session's own archives/ folder and the context keeps a small recoverable stub with the file path. Originals stay in the append-only session log, so nothing is lost. Ships a settings panel with per-size-bucket recovery stats, thresholds that apply without restart, and a conditional reminder when results are waiting to be archived. Requires dsh-better-sidebar for the statistics panel.

title: KitanWang/dsh-figma-plugin
description: Figma design context for the agent: reads a frame's node tree, auto-layout, paints and typography, resolves the variables it is bound to, and renders a screenshot to compare code against — plus four bundled design-to-code skills. Connect with one button against Figma's own consent page; the plugin ships its own OAuth app, refreshes tokens automatically, and never asks for or displays a token.

title: KJHAJKSLFHA/dsh-computer-use-next
description: macOS cross-application desktop tools for DSH using CuaDriver, with a hidden agent cursor, background window selection and post-action observations.

title: kkk-yoyo/dsh-mcp-rea
description: Mounts the REA (Reverse Engineer Anything) MCP server through two gateway tools instead of registering its 200+ tool schemas on every request: rea_list searches the catalog or returns one tool's input schema, and rea_call invokes that tool, each call spawning a short-lived rea mcp process, so the tool definitions sent per step drop from about 780 KB (207 tools as measured in REA 6.5.0) to about 1-2 KB. When no rea entry point is found it installs rea-agents into a plugin-private directory with the pnpm bundled in DSH (dependency build scripts skipped) and links the reverse-engineer-anything and rea-gateway skills into the skills directory without overwriting existing ones.

title: kkkkk-tubu/dsh-longpress-shot
description: Region screenshot for DSH without a hotkey (Windows only; capture runs through PowerShell + GDI). Hold the left mouse button for 550 ms, the page dims into a crosshair, drag a box, release: the crop is saved to ~/.dsh/longpress-shots and copied to the clipboard, and a preview card can send the same bytes into the composer (button, Ctrl+V, or drag) instead of hunting for a file dialog.

title: klarkxy/dsh-plugin-autoevo
description: Search-first capability workflow for DSH agents (v1.0.0): reuse local tools or review exact-source plugins before installation, adapt or create capabilities in managed source work, and use receipts that distinguish installed, loaded, activated, and verified states; version tools cover rollback, adoption, and upstream updates.

title: KLRSL/dsh-packer
description: Agent config packer for DeepSeek Harness: pack local agent assets (skills/sessions/profiles/settings/memory) into a zip for migration or sharing, with privacy scanning, diff-based restore, pack management, and a settings UI; memory ships as a read-only Markdown mirror, not the live database.

title: kmyy350234-dz/dsh-tool-drawer
description: On-demand tool groups for DeepSeek Harness, with optional role-scoped tool surfaces. Role masks are off by default; Settings can enable or disable review/build/research, and add custom roles with a group allow-list. The role key comes from the host's session label, subagent marker or preset, so an orchestrator's child agents each see only their own allow-list. Also auto-groups tool families by name prefix, lets the agent classify ungrouped tools once, restores a hidden tool when it is actually called, and reports per-session visibility health.

title: KonnectSuite/dsh-arya-computer-use
description: Drives Windows apps through accessibility controls instead of pixels, with a takeover overlay that frames the window being driven, marks each action with a ghost cursor, and stops on Esc; a browser lane adds sign-in profiles, saved state, and attach-to-my-Chrome. Windows only, and DSH must be run as Administrator for the desktop lane.

title: kookoolive/dsh-plugin-telleru
description: Type /telleru in any conversation and an AI tutor teaches it on a whiteboard in the right sidebar: it clarifies your goal, checks your level with quick questions, has you confirm an outline, then writes structured board content (tables, flowcharts, formulas, code) step by step with optional voice, subtitles, quizzes and interruptible Q&A.

title: kouyichi/dsh-plugins#dsh-a2a
description: Native A2A (Agent-to-Agent) server for dsh: expose this dsh as a callable agent over HTTP with JSON-RPC tasks.

title: kouyichi/dsh-plugins#dsh-guard
description: Security and governance for dsh: rule-based tool denial, full tool-call audit trail, and governance reports.

title: kouyichi/dsh-plugins#dsh-meter
description: Token usage and cost metering for dsh: per-session and aggregate statistics with configurable pricing and reports.

title: KouzakiUmi/dsh-tool-discovery
description: Progressive tool discovery through tool_list, tool_search and tool_load, exposing tool schemas on demand while preserving host execution permissions.

title: kuaiyukuaikuai/dsh-agent-sync
description: Scans 20+ AI agents on this machine (Codex, Claude Code, cc-switch, Hermes, opencode, Gemini, Grok, Kimi, CodeBuddy, Trae, OpenClaw, Qoder, WorkBuddy, Zcode, Cursor, Windsurf, Cline, Roo Code, Qwen Code, ...) and one-click syncs, manages and adds their MCP servers and skills into DSH — global or per-workspace.

title: kuangdang123/dsh-zotero
description: Zotero bridge: search, read, add, update and trash items in a local Zotero library, read PDF annotations and notes, pull indexed full text, and find related papers by DOI. Needs Zotero 7 or later with its local API enabled; the first write triggers a Zotero authorization prompt (the key is stored in plugin-data/dsh-zotero/auth.json) and permanent deletion asks for confirmation. Finding and adding items query OpenAlex, Crossref, arXiv, PubMed and Open Library. Uses the same package name (dsh-zotero) as Vncntvx/dsh-zotero, so only one of the two can be installed per profile.

title: kunjienie50-creator/dsh-shared-kb
description: Team shared knowledge base: one member runs a zero-dependency Hub, everyone else installs this plugin and joins with one invite code. Uploads are filed into ten categories with a summary, confidence and points; 15 agent tools let members upload, search, recall, comment and read them. Important items are pinned with a hand-written recommendation until the member has read them, and each account also gets a private local library, collections, a weekly digest and version diffs.

title: kunjinkao-os/dsh-mobile-gui-agent
description: Android GUI Agent with ADB screenshots, compact UI hierarchy grounding, verified iterative actions, approvals, and a Mobile Web view.

title: KunWu1980/dsh-douyin-kb
description: Paste a Douyin video link (easy to copy from the Douyin PC app) and the plugin downloads the video, transcribes the speech offline into timed Chinese text, and imports it into Obsidian as a Markdown note. Built for DeepSeek Harness and for beginners building a personal knowledge base. Needs Python 3.10+ with playwright (it drives Edge), PyAV, sherpa-onnx and numpy installed, plus a SenseVoice model placed under %USERPROFILE%\.dsh\douyin-kb\models.

title: l2685209197/dsh-pdf-translate
description: Translate text-based PDFs via DeepSeek or OpenAI-compatible APIs while preserving layout, fonts, images and links, with editable output.

title: laa1991/dsh-health
description: Turns declared health readings — source, criterion, verdict — into one read-only verdict; an unreadable source is reported as `unknown`, never as healthy.

title: lacrimosa-da/dsh-etf-monitor
description: Side panel for DeepSeek Harness that tracks a 15-ETF national-team basket intraday from Eastmoney and Tencent quotes (pure Node, zero dependencies): capital flow, minute-level support pulses and a composite read.

title: LaFantasque520/dsh-sidebar-reader
description: Let the model read the current session's sidebar: the active tab, open tabs, terminal screens and browser page text (page text is desktop only; the terminal channel needs DSH >= 0.2.1-rc.2).

title: Lain-in-coding/dsh-grok-search
description: Requires at least one search API key (Grok, or any one of the supplementary sources). A grok-search-rs-backed web search provider for DeepSeek Harness with configurable source fallback, visual settings, search log replay, and account quota queries.

title: Langlijun666/dsh-xmum-moodle
description: XMUM Moodle in the sidebar: courses grouped by term, a schedule merged from the calendar, assignment and quiz deadlines and dated announcements, and batch downloads filed by term, course and material type. It signs in to the school Moodle (l.xmu.edu.my by default) with your campus ID and password, keeps only the resulting Moodle token in the DSH credential store, and its HTTP routes have no DSH access check.

title: latte03/dsh-select-quote
description: Adds selection annotations, in-place translation, sidebar subagent questions and default-browser link opening to DSH. The selected text rides along with your next message, the source keeps its highlight and ordinal mark for jumping back, the menu opens on selection or from the right-click menu, and the translation model can be picked separately.

title: LAU-MARS/dsh-cad
description: Views and builds CAD models (STL, OBJ, STEP, IGES, DXF, SVG) via cad_view/cad_info and OCCT parametric modeling tools, with an interactive viewer card and a resident CAD panel in the Web UI.

title: LaynePeng/dsh-astock
description: A-share assistant: 19 tools for quotes, K-line, screening, sentiment and backtests, plus a manual trade ledger, a sidebar panel, daily archive snapshots and risk-alert email. No broker connection or order placement.

title: lcgash/dsh-plugin-uw
description: Union workspaces: merge multiple directories into one session, manage unions from a settings panel, and read/write member files via uw_read/uw_write/uw_edit/uw_delete/uw_move tools.

title: leaforbook/dsh-mcp-lazy
description: Lazy-loading router for MCP servers: auto-discovers compatible MCPs and keeps only a shared router in the tool catalog, revealing a server's schemas when a turn needs them and hiding them again at turn end, so many installed MCPs stop costing context on every request. Falls open to normal visibility on any uncertainty, and the original MCP keeps ownership of execution, permissions and process lifecycle. Also supports explicit lazy connections with warm reuse, bounded reconnection, stdio and Streamable HTTP.

title: Lee-Eee-Eee/API-MRI
description: Inspect API latency, streaming output and model-response fingerprints from a native DSH panel, with classic-task previews and public benchmark rankings.

title: LeemanCheung/dsh-agent-preset-recommender
description: Bounded, privacy-safe local scanner for Codex, Claude Code, WorkBuddy, and CodeBuddy metadata: atomically aggregates keyed evidence and deterministically advises built-in DSH presets and optional capabilities—without content retention, network access, or preset mutation.

title: LeifDai/MACKORN-hydraulic-cone-crusher
description: Cone crusher selection and crushing-plant design for MACKORN NH/NS single-cylinder hydraulic cone crushers: requirement-form intake, equipment selection, plant configuration, proposal generation, product-size simulation and field-data calibration. 21 tools, 6 skills, an MCP server, no runtime dependencies.

title: LeiSureYu/dsh-smart-download
description: Multi-threaded downloader plugin for DeepSeek Harness with bundled aria2: probes the target for Range support, then picks aria2 (4 or 8 connections by file size) or falls back to curl.

title: lemonxiny55/dsh-code-index
description: Local code intelligence for DSH: Impact X-Ray visualizes potential change impact with inspectable source evidence and uncertainty; also provides symbol navigation, bounded Context Packs and ArkTS support.

title: lemonxiny55/dsh-lsp-diagnostics
description: Real-time LSP diagnostics loop: lsp_diagnostics / lsp_workspace_errors / lsp_hover tools over headless stdio language servers (TypeScript/JavaScript + Python), plus an auto-injected post-edit diagnostics delta wired to the harness fs/observed event — Cursor-style edit → diagnostics → fix for dsh agents.

title: lengquan88/dsh-dual-auto
description: Dual-model auto-routing plugin: low-cost direct / high-cost upgrade with an escape-learning closed loop (wrong direct answers auto-learn fingerprints, force-upgrading the same fingerprint next time), persisted and interoperable with the Python ModelRouter.

title: Lequait/dsh-proxy-router
description: Imports a proxy subscription, supervises a local mihomo core (proxy-provider plus a url-test group), and fetches direct-first with automatic proxy fallback and per-host routing memory; exposes one proxy_router tool (status, start, stop, test, fetch, routes, forget).

title: Letter2025/dsh-tool-search
description: Hermes-style tool search & slimming: progressive disclosure, semantic search, describe, and call long-tail tools on demand while core tools stay eager.

title: DSH QQ Zone
description: Publishes and reads QQ Zone posts through SnowLuma's OneBot qzone_* actions (SnowLuma 2.2+ signed in to QQ), and lets the agent understand images with a local vision model (OpenAI-compatible gateway) or Windows OCR.

title: Lheyang/orca-dsh-launcher
description: Windows desktop companion for DeepSeek Harness: update checker, server start/stop, system tray, graphical console, and one-click installer.

title: li-shaozhe/dsh-chatops-mcp
description: DSH plugin: three MCP tool servers for DingTalk (via the dws CLI), Feishu (via lark-cli) and Feishu Project (via the official @lark-project/mcp), reusing the accounts dws and lark-cli are already logged in with, plus a Feishu Project MCP user token you paste in the panel; once the three connectors are connected, the default set is 140 tools (47 DingTalk, 45 Feishu, 48 Feishu Project) under the mcp__dingtalk__ / mcp__feishu__ / mcp__meego__ prefixes. A sidebar panel adds a connector wall with one-click connect (installs the CLI and walks through device-code login, or takes the Feishu Project token), custom MCP connections pasted as mcpServers JSON, enable/disable per connection, the write-tool switch, and a searchable catalog of the 1098 dws and 246 lark-cli commands.

title: liancheng2020/dsh-aihot-radar
description: Real-time Codex/Claude/Antigravity quota-reset alerts plus AIHOT news digest and agent tools. News comes from the AIHOT public API, which is free for personal non-commercial use only.

title: liaoyuqing/dsh_workspace_switch
description: Per-workspace activation control: a dialog opened from the workspace row menu switches individual plugins, MCP servers, and skills on or off, and the host applies the choice in that workspace's own agent scope — a disabled skill leaves the model catalog, an MCP server has its mcp__<server>__ tools denied, and a plugin has the tool names its entry declares denied.

title: Liatos233/dsh-dl-progress
description: Download task panel for the DSH Web UI: a bundled download_file tool streams the file itself and reports exact byte counts, shell downloads (curl -o, Invoke-WebRequest -OutFile, pip install, git clone) are recognised from host job events, and every task shows its name, real percentage, transfer rate and remaining ETA in the bottom-right corner.

title: lifeodyssey/dsh-compressor#dsh-compressor
description: A slim port of Headroom: compresses tool output, cuts up to 20% of context, without affecting the model's context cache or agent performance.

title: lifeopsgo/dsh-capability-toggle-plugin
description: Adds session, project, and global controls in the DSH WebUI for skills, MCP servers, tools, prompt injections, approval escalation, and safety guards; enforcement is scoped to the current agent.

title: lihanhong2002/dsh-minimax-multimodal
description: Add MiniMax image understanding, image generation, speech synthesis, and transcription tools to DeepSeek Harness.

title: lijieyu233/dsh-codex-account-tools
description: Import, preview and export JSON accounts for dsh-codex-subscription with duplicate detection and explicit full-backup confirmation. Requires dsh-codex-subscription 3.2.6 or newer.

title: lijiusa/dsh-workbuddy-daily-credits
description: Claim WorkBuddy (CodeBuddy CN / WorkBuddy global) daily check-in credits and benefit bonuses from a composer-dock card and an agent tool, using the official web OAuth login — no desktop client or third-party plugin needed. If another WorkBuddy plugin has already saved a login in ~/.dsh/workbuddy-vault, it reuses that login instead of asking you to sign in again.

title: lilixinsniper/dsh-intent-recognition
description: Five-layer intent recognition pipeline (rules, pgvector retrieval, Jev scoring, fine-tuned arbitration, LLM fallback) with scenario management UI, PostgreSQL storage and distributable API services.

title: LIN-F1SH/dsh-prompt-lint
description: Reads your past DSH conversations and surfaces recurring prompt gaps — missing paths or versions, an unstated output format, missing preconditions that break tool calls — each with a paste-ready rewrite. Adds a one-click rewrite next to the composer that applies those constraints to the draft in a shorter form.

title: linfeicxy/dsh-idea-box
description: A floating box that turns one line or a screenshot into a Markdown file in your workspace.

title: LINGTIAN303/dsh-agents-visualization
description: Views, creates and edits AGENTS.md and other AI rule files from the DSH settings page: the project directory chain from project root to cwd, both DSH global roots (~/.dsh and ~/.agents), and user-level rule files of 25 third-party AI tools. Markdown preview is rendered with .mdc frontmatter stripped, edits save in place with conflict detection, files whose content is identical across tools are flagged, and tools outside the built-in list are discovered heuristically. Zero runtime dependencies.

title: LinJohn8/dsh-local-Sub2api
description: Embeds a private local Sub2API gateway (Sub2API + PostgreSQL + Redis via Docker) into the DeepSeek Harness sidebar with automatic local login. title: maxmilian/dsh-grafana-query

title: MegaPandas/dsh-stock-research
description: Provides snapshot-based research and question answering for individual A-share and US stocks.

title: Mekansm1/DSH-WebGIS
description: Conversational GIS for the DSH Web UI with local file and PostGIS querying, interactive maps, and spatial analysis.

First run needs a one-time in-app install of Python dependencies (a uv venv plus PyPI packages such as bili-agent and edge-tts) and a Bilibili QR login.

title: mengqi1436/dsh-db-tool

title: Meteor-system/dsh-codegraph
description: Indexes the current workspace into a relation graph and exposes one agent tool, codegraph_explore, for reachability, callers, and impact, plus a Web sidebar graph pane.

Published on npm as dsh-harness-reflex (plugin) and harness-reflex (core, also a stdio MCP server).

title: Miyamiz39/dsh-consensus
description: Consensus academic search and research agent with interactive paper cards and native OAuth.

title: mjylfz/dsh-subagent-codex

title: moononnn/DeepSeek-Harness-biaoqingbao

title: Mr-Neutr0n/dsh-medseek

title: muhadif/dsh-atlassian-mcp

Exposes mcp__atlassian__* tools (CQL search, pages, comments, JQL issues, transitions).

title: mzzsfy/dsh-plugin#dsh-shared-terminal

title: mzzsfy/dsh-plugin#dsh-shell-select

A settings card configures the allowlist.

Targets DSH 0.2.1-rc.2 only; mcp-remote 0.15.2 is downloaded through npx on first launch.

title: nalikip/dsh-unified-desktop

description: Yijing-based decision review plugin for DSH: six-layer weighted aggregation engine (384 yao to taiji) with strong-association veto rules, pure JS with zero solver dependencies. Free tier is capped at 9 runs per day and activation codes raise it; the stock-trend scenario pulls live quotes from Tencent for the stock codes in the request.

title: wangxuewangxue98/dsh-motor-ai
description: Full edition of the motor-design AI plugin for DeepSeek Harness: adds the L1 (Ansys RMxprt) and L2 (Motor-CAD) precision layers on top of the L0 millisecond-level broad filter, completing an end-to-end chain from requirement parsing to parameter identification, candidate matrix, L0 pre-screening and L1/L2 verification. Mutually exclusive with dsh-motor-ai-l0 (uninstall l0 first); the shared core @wangxue98/dsh-motor-ai-core installs automatically. L1 needs Ansys AEDT (RMxprt) and L2 needs Motor-CAD installed locally. Distributed under the PolyForm Noncommercial licence; L1/L2 require an activation code. Telemetry is on by default: per-tool usage counts and design-experience samples that the author describes as desensitized are sent to the author's server at wangxuewangxue98.deno.net, and fault assistance can upload fault reports; switch them off with telemetryEnabled, designExperienceUpload and faultAssistEnabled in the plugin config.

title: wangxuewangxue98/dsh-motor-ai-l0
description: Motor-design AI assistant plugin: requirement parsing → parameter identification → candidate matrix → Top10 verification. L0 is a millisecond-level broad filter (pure JS, zero solver dependency) that ranks candidates and emits the handoff payload for the L1/L2 precision tools; usable as a local agent preset and Cordis plugin. L1 (RMxprt) and L2 (Motor-CAD) are reserved in this version — the level gate fails fast above l0.

title: wangzhanchao883/dsh-disk-manager
description: Scans the whole C drive and classifies every large folder into A/B/C/D/E/P (safe cache / relocatable / junction-movable / abandoned software / config-memory redline / personal files), then deletes, moves, or redirects on demand — with strong redline protection, dry-run preview and undo. Unknown software decided by LLM fallback + human confirmation. Works on DeepSeek Harness 0.1.7 through 0.2.x, tested on 0.2.0-rc.1.

title: wangzhanchao883/dsh-lost-and-found
description: Local file recall: indexes the folders you choose into one local SQLite database, so 'where did I put that file?' is one query instead of a disk walk. Caches, VCS and program folders are pruned per directory; each folder keeps its own incremental anchor, so a folder added later is backfilled in full. Read-only: it never modifies, moves or deletes your files. Works on DeepSeek Harness 0.1.7 through 0.2.x, tested on 0.2.0-rc.1.

title: wangzhanchao883/dsh-resume-screening
description: Resume screening plugin for HR in DeepSeek Harness: ingest up to 100k Word/PDF/Excel resumes into one searchable library with skills / coarse categories / ingest time, auto-ingest & de-dupe new resumes, then screen by plain-language criteria — rule pre-filter in the database plus LLM fine-judge on the shortlisted few, CSV export. Works on DeepSeek Harness 0.1.7 through 0.2.x, tested on 0.2.0-rc.1.

title: wangzhanchao883/dsh-screenshot-capture
description: Point-and-shoot screenshot capture: a system floating window turns a new screenshot (or copied image) into an Obsidian note with comments and key-point marking, instant OCR through the host DSH multimodal model (no extra API key needed, Tongyi Qianwen as fallback), a duplicate-screen guard, per-day merging, and an optional evening AI organization pass.

title: wangzhanchao883/dsh-word-vault
description: English word bank for one or more children, built for DSH 0.2 and newer (0.2.0-rc.1 and 0.2.0-rc.2 verified, including the desktop shell; 0.1.7 through 0.2.x all work). 1.10 added pronunciation: in the memory cards and in the online quiz every word and every example sentence has a speaker button that reads it aloud with the built-in Windows voice - offline, with no network call and no model call - and the whole batch of audio is pre-rendered in the background whenever cards or an exam are generated, so a click starts instantly. 1.11 adds: pick words in bulk straight from the library (10 at a time, top-down, up to 50 selected, with a live counter); turn the words a child got wrong in a quiz into a one-click review set - an online card page that speaks plus a printable PDF; and every card example sentence now carries its Chinese translation underneath. Words marked on textbook or workbook photos (highlighter, red pen) are found by their marks, then translated and stored in a local SQLite bank with an occurrence count; the clipboard picker, the photo route and dictation all land in the same bank. High-frequency words surface by count, three correct answers in a row flag a word as learned, and any selection prints as a memory card set (a word split into chunks, real IPA per chunk, a grade-7 example sentence, a mnemonic hook, an A4 sheet of eight) in HTML, PDF or Word, with a print-and-answer exam page whose four options are set against each other for meaning. On 0.1.5 the settings panel does not appear - install dsh-word-vault@1.0.2 instead.

title: DeepSeekLauncher

title: waning-sun/dsh-napcat-keeper
description: Keeps the NapCat QQ backend alive next to DSH: probes the OneBot 11 HTTP port at startup, launches NapCat when the port does not answer, then rechecks every 45 seconds, kills duplicate process chains, hides the console window, can create a logon scheduled task when a task name is set, and adds a settings page plus napcat_status, napcat_restart and napcat_dedupe tools. Optionally remembers the QQ password, behind a risk confirmation, so an expired fast-login token can be renewed without scanning a QR code. Windows only; without that scheduled task the launched QQ exits together with DSH.

title: wanwulizhi/dsh-claude-code-sdk

title: Wanyi424/dsh-quick-translate

Zero tokens throughout — nothing goes through the model, and your notes stay ordinary local files that git and any editor can read.

description: 0.8.6 fixes a startup crash: the host runtime package is an optional peer, never an installed dependency. TypeSafe Jev (System One decision model) wired end to end into DeepSeek Harness (0.8.6). Seven tools: jev_decision (1-25 parallel atomic verdicts in one call; noul/choice/score; typed answers with calibrated confidence; measured median 266-484 ms; verdicts only, never prose), jev_choose (rank 2-10 candidate approaches - fit 0-3 and risk - into an explicit composite with a recommended pick), jev_batch (NEW in 0.8.6: one set of 1-5 judgments over 1-20 texts, one real call per text at bounded concurrency, returning a paste-ready markdown table sortable by a judged dimension; built-in sentiment/priority/intent/pii/spam presets; a failed row is reported as failed with the raw error, never guessed), jev_usage (locally measured usage: calls, tokens, estimated cost, latency median and p95, per-tool mix, rolling windows, projected burn rate, optional local hard budgets, and a declared-balance remainder), jev_overview (session ledger), jev_guard_status (guard counters plus a registrations block that surfaces per-surface registration failures) and jev_verify (frozen 27-question live benchmark at concurrency 6: 96.3%, 26/27). WHAT IS NEW IN 0.8.6 - the ledger survives a restart, the remainder is derived instead of invented, and the plugin can now do batch paperwork. (1) The local ledger persists to $DSH_HOME/jev-usage.json BY DEFAULT, so the cumulative total no longer resets when the host restarts. Two real bugs behind the old silent zero were found and fixed: the ledger path only honoured DSH_HOME (absent inside the host process, so persistence was silently disabled and the file name was null), and save() wrote the still-empty in-memory ring over the history file because it ran before the first load while the debounce window swallowed the follow-up write. (2) Remaining is derived, never invented: TypeSafe exposes no balance endpoint - /v1/usage, /v1/quota, /v1/account, /v1/account/balance, /v1/balance, /v1/credits, /v1/billing, /v1/me, /v1/limits and a dozen more all return 404, and only /v1/models answers, with no balance headers - so the panel shows the remainder as your declared balance (quota.declaredBalanceUsd) minus locally measured spend since quota.balanceSince, and says plainly that it cannot be fetched instead of printing a number. (3) The composer pill re-reads every 20 s instead of every 60 s, so a call you just made shows up while you are still looking at it. (4) The collapsed pill leads with the remainder once you declare a balance, and the cumulative row is renamed when the ledger is on disk. Every tool has an in-conversation structured view; the Settings > Plugins card covers credentials, tool switches, the auto-guard, the dashboard, the prompt section, usage/quota and auto-triage. Honest by design: no API key means an explicit error, never fabricated results; every registration is quarantined so a failure degrades one surface. Tests 38/38 (npm test, ~2.5 s). Client half applies on refresh; server half needs a host restart.

title: ximing-chat/dsh-chat-reply-coach

title: Xin-kon/dsh-lang-guard

Zero runtime dependencies, single file; falls back to a second registration path and only logs a warning when the host API changes.

title: xing-he888/dsh-database-explorer
description: Database explorer panel for DeepSeek Harness: connect SQLite, MySQL/MariaDB, PostgreSQL, SQL Server, MongoDB, ClickHouse, Redis, Elasticsearch and Qdrant from a third Conversation tab — browse schemas, page through data, edit cells, insert rows, design and drop tables, run SQL, import/export CSV/JSON/SQL/Markdown, and draw editable E-R diagrams. Read-only connections enforce statement-level allowlists, agent tools ship read-only by default with an opt-in write flag, and every write (including refused attempts) lands in an auditable log. Ships an MCP stdio server exposing the same connections to external AI clients.

title: xing666173/dsh-vision-hub#file-drop
description: Drag-and-drop file upload for PDF, Word, Excel and images: dropped files are saved to a local directory and referenced by path, no base64 bloat in the chat.

title: xingbei437/dsh-cbm-autorefresh
description: Zero-config per-Session freshness for codebase-memory: on Session start and on every working-directory change it refreshes the index of the Session's own repository, so each project in each Session answers from its current graph while indexing stays in the shared daemon.

title: XINGMENG2333/dsh-plugin-optimize-ai-reply
description: Strips AI-flavor from LLM text with local density scanning and deterministic fact/strength/safety checks; a rewrite that fails verification falls back to the original.

title: xingxue-ux/dsh-comfyUI-control
description: Adds a Drawing Mode agent preset whose 19 comfyui_* tools drive a local ComfyUI: Anima and Krea2 generation, LoRA search and download, Danbooru character tags, PNG metadata, an upstream repro check, and xiaofanqie de-obfuscation.

title: xingxue-ux/dsh-reverse-mode
description: Reverse-engineering agent preset. Mounts REA (rea-agents) as MCP tools for native binaries, JavaScript/Electron apps, managed assemblies, archives and installers — the full 170-tool catalog by default — but only inside sessions that select the preset; other presets load nothing. Ships an install-time check that reports which native analysis engine (Hopper, Ghidra, IDA) is present and prints the env snippet to wire one in. A fork of dsh-rea (JeremyWangCY, MIT) retargeted as an agent preset; do not install it together with dsh-rea.

title: xinming-chenniang/dsh-outcomes
description: Deliverables registry for DeepSeek Harness: agents register the final artifacts of a task (reports, pages, documents, sheets, images, datasets) into one settings section and manager page that store paths only, never copies, and remove recoverably; a standalone CLI (add, list, stats, check, remove, restore) reads and audits the same registry outside the app.

title: xiseliuli/dsh-as-mcp
description: Exposes a running DeepSeek Harness as an MCP server over Streamable HTTP or a bundled stdio bridge, so an external agent can create workspaces and sessions, prompt, fork, rename and switch the model on them, read and write files, run foreground and background shell commands, call the instance's own agent tools by name, and read per-turn and cumulative token usage with a cost receipt when a price plugin is installed.

title: xizhilang2012/dsh-claim-gate
description: A self-justification gate for outbound claims: a claim needs a checkable source (an http(s) URL plus a quote of at least 8 characters), every number in the text must appear in a quote, and a quote whose vocabulary overlap with the post is under 10% counts as an invalid citation; absolute wording is rejected when the only evidence is second-hand. All verdicts come from deterministic rules — no model call, no network. The guard subcommand refuses to run the publish command when the gate fails (fail-closed), explains what is wrong and how to fix it, and requires an --ack note on the second attempt stating what changed; after three attempts it stops and hands back to a human. Ships check / explain / fix / guard, with 30 tests.

title: XMoon/dsh-profile-settings
description: Per-profile settings overlay for DeepSeek Harness: global settings.yaml stays the baseline while each profile overrides any namespace through its own profiles/<name>/settings.patch.yml — object sections merge recursively, scalars and arrays replace wholesale, and !unset masks an inherited value. The overlay is transparent to existing plugins (they keep reading ctx.settings unchanged), writes land in the profile overlay only, and official schema validation, revision semantics, expectedRevision conflicts, watchers and events are untouched. Ships a settings command family (get/set/unset/mask/unmask/promote/demote/migrate/diff/layers) plus a Profile Settings section in the web Settings panel over a loopback RPC channel.

title: xmutfyh/dsh-plugin-writing-guard
description: Academic writing guard (EN/ZH bilingual): removes AI-style defensive writing, protects scientific evidence (numbers, citations, claim strength, null findings, scope) during polishing, and calibrates writing toward a target journal (Journal Profile + Journal Fit). Deterministic local regex/statistics, zero network/LLM; writing_rules / writing_audit / writing_style_profile / writing_journal_profile with auto-audit on paper writes.

title: XRC111/dsh-apikeys
description: A credential proxy for outbound API calls: keeps keys for GitHub, Cloudflare, Vercel, npm, Docker Hub, Hugging Face and custom platforms, and calls them from the Host so the model never holds the key. apikey_call takes a path rather than a URL, pinning the host to the platform definition; apikey_platforms lists accounts without values; apikey_key gets, sets or clears one; apikey_upload sends multipart with a file read from disk, bounded by an allowlist. Supports five auth shapes (bearer, custom header, x-api-key, basic, query string). Optional layers, each off by default or preserving existing behaviour: an AES-256-GCM vault with a scrypt-derived key and an authenticated header, a SHA-256 hash chain over credential operations that records no key values, response redaction of the key actually used, and per-platform failover on 401/403/429. Ships a CLI (list, verify, audit, call) that reads the same vault without the harness. By default (exposeKeys on) the apikey_key tool can return a stored key's value to the model, which puts it in the session log; turn exposeKeys off to keep keys inside the Host.

title: xsnnnnnn/dsh-coros
description: Bridges the official COROS MCP server into DeepSeek Harness with a self-contained local stdio-to-HTTP bridge and on-device OAuth login, exposing 34 COROS tools on the current endpoint for sleep, HRV, resting heart rate, recovery, training load, activities and FIT files, plus workout and training-plan CRUD and scheduling.

title: xtt-xt/dsh-custom-tool-studio
description: Author custom tools in Python from a web page, in chat, or from the dsh-go app's native panels, and register them as DSH tools without a restart; dangerous tools need built-in approval on every run, tools can be grouped into packs, and an optional unlock mode exposes them per conversation. Needs Python 3 on PATH.

title: xuanyuanchumo/dsh-kaogong
description: Offline civil-service exam study panel integrating 16 upstream open-source question banks with SRS wrong-book, mock exams, essay grading, an interactive knowledge graph and whitebox observability, plus a HuaSheng-13 methodology view (25 documents) with BM25 search. The npm package ships no question-bank or corpus data: after install, the question-bank manager clones the required set (about 360 MB, needs git) from the upstream repos (all 16 are about 2.2 GB).

title: xuedipiaofei/dsh-drawio-chat
description: Draw.io in chat: describe it, get an interactive diagram in the transcript; 12 Chinese scenario templates; keep editing or undo the same .drawio file; right-sidebar preview. No account, no MCP server, no editor.

title: xuezuoys/dsh-blender-mcp-bridge
description: This project aims to bridge the Blender MCP Add-on, so that models on DSH can conveniently connect to the current user's working Blender to assist creation, while meeting basic security requirements.

title: XuRui2022/dsh-paper-manager
description: Academic paper reading and citation manager for DeepSeek Harness: left-rail library, original-layout PDF reader, six citation styles, a Word bibliography append, and AI translation/summary/mind-map/term lookup. A derivative of jypjypjypjyp/dsh-paper-reader (now dsh-vibe-reading, MIT) that shares its default ~/.paper_reading work root — do not install both. Requires the dsh-better-sidebar plugin.

title: xuxue04403/dsh-tool-gate
description: Per-project tool gating for the harness: before each step, the session looks for `.dsh/tool-gate.json` in its working directory and up to 32 parents, then filters the tool set handed to the model — allow or deny lists with `prefix*` wildcards, `off` when no rule file is found. A single `tool_gate_status` tool reports the active mode, rule file, and which tools were hidden.

title: xwtxbzz/dsh-ccf
description: Looks up CCF conference paper deadlines with the ccf_deadlines, ccf_venue and ccf_update tools, the /ccf command and a desktop panel that exports the list as a calendar. Dates come from a live sync (CCFDDL as the main source, a second source cross-checked; a gap of 36 hours or more is flagged as a source conflict), so nothing is bundled and the next 30 days stay in the system prompt.

title: XXGJ666/dsh-feiyu-affinity
description: Per-person affinity for DSH personas on a QQ channel (a QQ bridge such as dsh-onebot-qq is required — the person is identified by the QQ number in each message; on the plain web UI nothing is injected): per-user scores with daily decay, reasons history, sulking and forgiveness, plus a global mood that colors replies.

title: yangdw2024/gaussian-dsh-plugin
description: DSH plugin for Gaussian 16: SMILES-to-3D, input generation, serial job management, output parsing, and Multiwfn/VMD post-processing (orbital/ESP/RDG).

title: yanglaofish/dsh-proxy-pro
description: Routes model requests, web fetches/searches and spawned tools through the Windows system proxy or a custom address — idempotent kernel (reads never rebuild the dispatcher), header one-click toggle, per-URL route diagnosis and NTLM-aware 407 hints.

title: YangRuiYangDan/dsh-media-card

description: Trending-topics collector aggregating Baidu / Toutiao / Douyin / Weibo hot lists in one call (Weibo optional cookie), returning titles with heat values for content creators — tool: `sxs_news_hot`.

description: Sidebar disk browser for DeepSeek Harness - browse any folder on the server (including hidden ones) with text preview, streaming download and upload (multi-select / drag-and-drop, overwrite confirm), responsive on desktop and mobile.

title: YanYunCY/dsh-exit-code-lens
description: Annotates bash results whose exit code 1 is an answer rather than an error (grep with no match, diff with differences, false test) so the agent does not re-investigate them.

title: YaphetHayate/codeRDD#dsh-rdd-explore

title: yaways/dsh-subagent-claude-code-wrapper
description: Subagent delegation provider that runs any Claude-compatible CLI binary pointed at by a configurable executablePath field.

description: Compile a video link into timestamped Markdown knowledge cards with back-links to the exact moment. Requires your own Python 3.10+ and yt-dlp (ffmpeg + faster-whisper only for videos without subtitles; Bilibili login cookies for members-only subtitles).

title: ycm50/dsh-proxy
description: Domain-routed proxy for DSH fetch traffic: hosts on a force-proxy list always go through the proxy, every other host tries direct first and fails over to the proxy within a second, the first channel to answer is pinned for the session, connections are reused for 120 seconds, and each attempt is logged. Can also route pnpm/git subprocesses used by plugin installs.

title: YE-ZINAN/dsh-wb
description: Bridge between DSH and the local WorkBuddy desktop app, in four parts: read, search and append WorkBuddy memory, skills, plans and daily logs; run tasks through the local CodeBuddy CLI with four permission profiles; drive the running WorkBuddy window over CDP (open a conversation, read its replies as sanitized rich HTML, type and send, switch the account-billed model, relaunch it with a debug port when it is missing); and a sidebar panel that puts that conversation surface inside DSH. 25 tools and 15 HTTP routes in one plugin.

title: yeahmahao/dsh-fish-notes
description: Records an agent's short notes about what it browsed or thought, and lists them in a sidebar panel.

description: Control, organize, diagnose, design, personalize, and answer product knowledge questions for a Yeelight smart home, powered by the local yeelight-home runtime.

title: yhm138/dsh-image-rescue
description: When an image over the 8192 px per-side limit (or 64 MP) would make the Host reject the whole prompt, stores it byte-for-byte as a generic file and hands the model the saved path — no resize, no re-encode — so it can still be viewed or converted, e.g. a long screenshot or a scan to PDF.

title: yhy854/dsh-calc-tool
description: Calculator tool that evaluates arithmetic expressions with a hand-written recursive-descent parser. No eval or new Function; whitelisted identifiers, length and nesting limits, and structured error codes.

title: Yijian-quiet/dsh-mol#dsh-ui
description: A chemistry workbench panel in the DSH web UI. Draw structures on a Ketcher canvas (a script downloads the build; it renders locally in the browser with no backend), then compute on the current molecule with RDKit without calling a model — formula, molecular weight, exact mass, logP, TPSA, hydrogen-bond donors and acceptors, ring counts, Fsp3, stereocentres, Lipinski and Veber rule-by-rule checks, QED, PAINS/BRENK structural alerts and the Murcko scaffold, plus SMARTS substructure matching, fingerprint similarity, format conversion, standardisation and batch clean-up. A retrosynthesis tab talks to a pluggable backend (Retro* by default) over a single JSON-in/JSON-out process, and states what is missing when the backend is not installed instead of inventing a route. The calculations run in this repository's Python package (rdkit), which is installed with pip separately.

Ships a universal prebuilt binary (arm64 + x86_64), so no Xcode Command Line Tools are needed; the panel itself requires macOS 14+.

Frozen archive: keep the pinned version, as the author no longer adapts it to newer DSH releases.

Installing drops the three SKILL.md folders into ~/.dsh/skills/, so the agent can invoke them by name after a restart. The bundled web-research skill assumes a local HTTP proxy at 127.0.0.1:7897; edit it if your setup differs.

title: YixiangTang/dsh-tool-subagent-batch
description: Rolling-window batch scheduler for DeepSeek Harness subagents: one subagent_batch call carries a queue of independent subtasks plus a user-owned concurrency window, a settled child's slot is refilled immediately, and the call returns every child's final answer, stop reason and child id as one acceptance report. async mode keeps the pool running in the background for subagent_batch_status, and the window comes from config, DSH_SUBAGENT_BATCH_CONCURRENCY or a hardware recommendation.

title: yiyunet/dsh-dingtalk-connector
description: DSH plugin: read and write DingTalk AI Tables through the official dws CLI, adding ten DingTalk AI Table tools (nine `dingtalk_aitable_*` plus `dingtalk_sync_job`), a settings panel, and scheduled CSV export.

title: yiyunet/dsh-mcp-client-manager
description: DSH plugin: a settings panel to list, add, rewrite and toggle @deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client MCP rows — no more hand-writing them into cordis.patch.yml. Zero build, zero runtime dependencies.

title: yjl9903/AnimeGarden#dsh
description: Anime Garden for DSH: search anime torrent resources from 動漫花園, 蜜柑计划, 萌番组 and ANi inside DSH — via chat, a sidebar panel with fansub and type filters, a seasonal calendar, and an in-app floating player.

title: ymwang92/dsh-refkeeper
description: Collects the references a conversation cited, verifies each against Crossref, OpenAlex, arXiv, DataCite and PubMed, exports BibTeX or RIS.

title: YokosWY/dsh-guard#plugin
description: A 护航 panel in the session header that switches the local dsh-guard watchdog on or off and shows whether scanning is enabled, whether the guard is alive and when it last scanned; the Python watchdog that does the watching is deployed separately and found through the DSH_GUARD_ROOT environment variable. The watchdog defaults to a Windows checkout (D:\AI\Projects\dsh-guard); set DSH_GUARD_ROOT to point at another directory.

title: YongjianWan/dsh-loadout
description: On-demand tool loadout for DSH: MCP tools are grouped by server and host plugin tools by prefix; grouped tools hide by default and activate with one call, while tools claimed by no rule stay visible. Ships preset modes (coding / writing / ops / review), a trial zone that promotes new tools after repeated use, gated groups that need user confirmation to activate, an outbound cut while reading the web as prompt-injection defense, and built-in search plus proxy call for long-tail tools.

title: yoursc/dsh-siyuan
description: SiYuan (思源笔记) notes integration: 17 siyuan_* host tools covering notebook and document listing, full-text search, SQL query, reading documents and blocks, creating and appending content, moving and renaming documents, daily notes and block attributes, plus a Web settings page for the SiYuan URL, API token and per-tool switches.

title: yqdnsjs-qq/dsh-server-manager
description: Manage SSH servers and NAS web UIs from the DSH sidebar, including status probes, Docker control, PVE updates, and 1Panel app versions.

title: Yu-tao-Li/dsh-computer-use-win
description: Lets the DSH agent operate your Windows apps and web pages: it reads controls through UI Automation, clicks, types, captures the screen and reads text with OCR, and works on web pages in its own browser in the background, without moving your mouse; when it needs your mouse or keyboard, an on-screen indicator appears and Esc stops it.

title: Yu-tao-Li/dsh-reference-checker
description: Reference verification for DeepSeek Harness (参考文献真实性检查器): the reference_checker model tool checks a paper's bibliography (.pdf/.bib/.tex/.txt or pasted text) against Crossref, OpenAlex and arXiv, reports found / partial / not_found / error per entry, and emits corrected citations in the input's style (APA, GB/T 7714, IEEE, Vancouver, MLA, Chicago, Harvard, ACS, BibTeX).

title: YuanyuanMa03/dsh-funnel
description: Ingestion-time tool-output curation: keeps error and warning lines plus head and tail, spills the full text to disk with a pointer the model can read back; covers every text tool, small results pass through untouched.

title: Yubickari/dsh-semantic-drift
description: One versioned vocabulary of a project's business concepts, a read-only drift scan, and the same naming rules in every agent prompt.

title: YUEEEEY/dsh-desktop-tools
description: DSH environment management: auto-installs a Rust/Tauri desktop host (downloaded per-OS from dsh-desktop-host releases, source build as fallback), one-click runtime updates, Windows platform compatibility, official DeepSeek billing, and a built-in code editor for the workspace.

title: yuehancn/dsh-tool-archive
description: Pack a directory into a deterministic tar, read an archive's contents without extracting it, unpack while refusing every member that could reach outside the destination, and verify what came out against what went in by SHA-256. No external dependency — the tar format is written and read in this plugin. Extraction is deliberately more permissive on reading than on writing, because a reader's job is to report what an archive says, while a writer must never emit what it cannot read back. A tar has no central index, so the walk tracks whether it reached the end-of-archive marker: without that, a half-file checksums fine and reads as complete.

title: yuehancn/dsh-tool-browser
description: Open a page, wait for it the way it actually needs, extract the readable article, and take a screenshot. Playwright is optional: when it is absent the tools fall back to a static fetch and say so in the result, because a page whose JavaScript never ran means something different from one that rendered. Content is chosen by scoring candidate subtrees on prose density rather than on tag names, so a container loses to the article inside it instead of winning by containing more of the document.

title: yuehancn/dsh-tool-comfyui
description: Generate images from chat by calling a fleet of local or LAN ComfyUI workers, with workflow templates, worker health checks and queue control.

title: yuehancn/dsh-tool-epub
description: Read, build and take apart EPUB 3 books with no external dependency — the ZIP reader/writer and the XML scanner are both built in. Inspect metadata, reading order and TOC for structural problems, assemble a book from chapters, or split one back into per-chapter HTML.

title: yuehancn/dsh-tool-gzh-publisher
description: WeChat Official Account pipeline: validate a draft against a publish gate, then push it into the draft box.

title: yuehancn/dsh-tool-invoice
description: Pull invoice number, date, parties, tax IDs and the amount/tax/total triplet out of text, then verify that amount plus tax really equals the total and flag documents that do not reconcile.

title: yuehancn/dsh-tool-media
description: Drive a local ffmpeg as six structured tools: probe a file's streams, transcode or trim it, pull evenly-spaced frames or the audio track, and compress video to a byte budget with two-pass encoding.

title: yuehancn/dsh-tool-mining
description: Turn a GitHub repository's raw counts into a defensible judgement — contributor concentration and bus factor with single-author files, merge time reported as a median beside the mean so an outlier is visible rather than hidden, and an issue backlog with pull requests and drafts filtered out. Reads the public REST API with no SDK, and never claims a truncated page is the whole answer.

title: yuehancn/dsh-tool-notion
description: Convert Notion blocks and Markdown in both directions, with no API client and no external dependency. A Notion paragraph is an array of rich-text runs while Markdown says one string, so the two directions are a split and a merge rather than a pair of inverses — rich-text runs are cut at every annotation boundary one way and re-merged the other, with fences widened when the content already contains backticks. Reports every lossy step instead of swallowing it.

title: yuehancn/dsh-tool-ocr
description: Extract text from an image or PDF, reading a born-digital text layer directly and falling through to a configured OCR engine for scans.

title: yuehancn/dsh-tool-podcast
