description: Web search provider with switchable engines, several usable without an API key (Bing, DuckDuckGo, SearXNG and others) and a fallback order between them; adds multi_search, platform_search, image_search with an in-chat image wall, page_images and save_images, plus a settings page for engines, keys and per-engine proxy.

title: CQin04/dsh-playwright-mcp
description: Configuration bundle that connects Microsoft's official @playwright/mcp to your running Chrome through the Playwright extension, so the agent can drive your logged-in tabs. Install from a local copy: put your extension token in cordis.patch.yml first (with the token, connections skip the extension's approval prompt, so keep it private). Needs Node.js and the Playwright Chrome extension; the default command is the Windows form (cmd.exe /c npx), so change it to npx on macOS or Linux. It starts @playwright/mcp@latest through npx.

title: CREAIT-nl/dsh-plugins#web-fetch
description: A guarded local fetch provider for the ctx.web seam — the backend dsh does not ship for its own web_fetch tool. Every redirect hop is re-resolved and checked against the non-routable ranges, with a streamed size cap and a content-type allowlist.

title: CREAIT-nl/dsh-plugins#web-search-searxng
description: Points web_search at a self-hosted SearXNG instance instead of the native route: pages until maxResults is satisfied, and reports degraded coverage when engines fail so a thin result set is not read as a thin web.

title: cslkkl/dsh-web-annotator
description: Annotate pages inside the existing Harness Browser: click or drag to select, comment or ask, then send marked screenshots or DOM location details to the current session. While enabled it replaces the official Browser, Chat and Layout providers; targets Harness 0.2.1-alpha.2.

title: cyrus-xc/better-ego-browser
description: Windows-only derivative of the official ego lite DSH plugin (@ego-lite/dsh-plugin, citrolabs/ego-lite) that cannot be installed alongside it: connects DeepSeek Harness to the installed Windows ego lite app through authenticated loopback HTTP for task spaces, navigation, page reading, clicks, form input and screenshots.

title: d342784178/dsh-opencli
description: Browser tools for DSH that POST to the local OpenCLI daemon instead of spawning the opencli CLI per command, avoiding its cold start: oc_status, oc_exec, oc_navigate, oc_snapshot and oc_tabs, with one persistent automation tab per session.

title: dafeiyu1314520/dsh-douyin-agent
description: Autonomous Douyin watching in a dedicated Edge browser on Windows (requires Node.js 22.13+): sampling decisions, frame storyboards, danmaku-aware comments, persona memory and a watch diary, all under daily viewing limits. Fork of LockyBee/dsh-douyin-agent — uninstall the upstream plugin before installing this one.

title: damijun/dsh-browser-automation
description: Drive the DSH Desktop right-sidebar browser on Windows through playwright-cli, with a stable per-session page ID. Needs DSH started with --remote-debugging-port=0 and @playwright/cli installed globally.

title: dcd887/dsh-browser-ops
description: Self-managed persistent browser for DSH automation — launches its own Chrome/Edge profile, navigates, switches tabs, snapshots with semantic refs, acts by ref, evaluates JS, screenshots, and uploads files. Does not bypass CAPTCHAs by design.

title: DDDMUC/dsh-free-search
description: Free, keyless web search for DSH: 7 engines (DuckDuckGo/Bing/SearXNG free + Exa/Perplexity/DeepSeek paid), auto-failover, settings-page UI with API key inputs and official links, web_fetch, and an engine test tool.

title: Decodo/dsh-web-fetch
description: Decodo Web Data API as the fetch provider behind the built-in web_fetch tool: returns Markdown by default, pins fetchProvider to decodo, and enforces a configurable per-process fetch cap. Requires a Decodo API key; web_search is unchanged.

title: delef/dsh-free-web-search
description: Free web search with 10 engines (Bing/DuckDuckGo/SearXNG/AnySearch free + Exa/Tavily/Keenable/Perplexity/DeepSeek paid), automatic fallback chain, time-filtered advanced search, platform search (GitHub/Reddit), web page fetching, LRU caching, and a settings UI. No API keys required for basic use.

title: dengpeihua/dsh-browser-use
description: Real browser tools for DeepSeek Harness: browse and extract web content, fill forms, manage multiple tabs, and execute multi-step tasks, with incremental DOM, session isolation, screenshots, action-result checks, and archived evidence recall.

title: deqingLv/dsh-chrome-attach
description: Attaches the current Chrome tab to a DSH draft: one pick screenshots the page (falling back to a macOS window shot) and writes its title and URL into the composer as one line.

title: DeveloperYe/dsh-doyourweb-remote
description: Fork of SheepofSheep/dsh-doyourweb that puts the browser on another machine: the MV3 extension dials out to this plugin over TLS, so DSH reads and acts on a remote Chrome or Edge rather than a local one. It also generates ready-paired extension packages for the current configuration, adds tab open and close tools, writes annotation detail to a file instead of pasting it into the chat, and shows a checklist naming which part of a remote setup is misconfigured. Interfaces with no DOM at all are reachable too: canvas games, canvas maps and hand-drawn widgets take coordinate clicks, drags and wheel input that glide, pause and hold like a person's, and the viewport is checked before every action so a stale coordinate is refused rather than clicked blindly. It reuses the same browser-tabs plugin id as the upstream, so do not install both in the same profile. Requires Chrome or Edge 125+ and an unpacked MV3 extension loaded manually on the browser machine; the plugin does not install the extension. With tls: true, trust the generated ca.crt as a root certificate there. The extension gives the model access to the tabs and signed-in sessions of the browser it is paired with. The bridge listens on 127.0.0.1 by default; a non-loopback bind needs remote: true, and the extension pairs with a token confirmed by the user.

title: DightEndless/dsh-browser#packages/browser/bridge-browser
description: Open the extension side panel and it takes over the page you are browsing right now. On top of upstream it adds: hover, coordinate clicks, drag, batched action chains, whole-page screenshots, local file upload, image listing, and switching between several connected browsers. Pages reach the model as structured text with a numbered element list; actions wait for your approval and sensitive fields stay masked. Ships as the bridge plugin, with the extension in the same release. This project is a fork of omdsh-dev/dsh-browser: https://github.com/omdsh-dev/dsh-browser

title: dougen/dsh-cdp
description: Drives a Chromium browser you are already running — Chrome, Edge, Brave, Vivaldi, Opera, Chromium, Arc or Thorium — over one long-lived CDP connection, so the remote-debugging approval is asked once instead of per command. Commands for tabs, navigation, JS evaluation, DOM snapshots, clicks, typing, screenshots and CSS/DOM/pixel assertions go over a loopback HTTP route that the agent calls with the shell tool it already has, so no new tools are registered, and the plugin registers its own usage skill with no runtime dependencies.

title: drscrewdriver/dsh-browser-cdp
description: Visible agent browser for DSH over CDP, also driving egolite, Tabbit, Chrome, Edge, Brave and Lightpanda backends. Only bcdp_status stays resident (401 chars); the other 33 context-optimized bcdp_* tools unlock per activity batch, so non-browser sessions pay no schema tax (-91.9% measured). Realtime watch panel with direct click/scroll/IME input, element picks quoted into the composer as balanced @"picks/*.json" references, and human-verification notices; non-CDP channels (ego CLI / Tabbit CLI) sync frames by 3s polling. Cross-version support for DSH 0.1.7-rc.1 ~ 0.2.2-rc.1 (exact enumeration of 10 rc).

title: drscrewdriver/dsh-union-search
description: Union web search for DSH (consolidated successor of DDDMUC/dsh-free-search, which it credits): 28 engines across three tiers — keyless free (Bing/DuckDuckGo/AnySearch/SearXNG multi-instance union, plus Exa/Tavily/Keenable/Firecrawl/Parallel keyless modes), paid-with-key (Zhihu/Perplexity/Serply/DeepSeek official/You.com/Baidu/Kimi/Aliyun/Doubao/Zhipu/Bocha/Metaso), and model built-in search (OpenAI/Gemini/Claude/Grok, explicit opt-in only) — with auto smart routing, per-engine enable/disable & fallback priority, parallel top-3 merge, multi_search, failure-aware fallback, a toggle to block the system built-in search, time filtering, platform search, web_fetch and a web settings UI. Experimental free advance_fetch: whole-page GFM-Markdown or CSS-selector/fields structured extraction with no API key and no per-call billing; fetch identity configurable (custom User-Agent, Referer, per-domain cookies attached only on domain match, never leaked across cross-domain redirects). Hosts 0.1.0-rc.2 through 0.2.1-rc.2 (17-tag exact engines.dsh enum; the rc.2 search-provider takeover goes through volatile config pinning after capability probing, never version branches). Paid engines need your own API keys (optional; free engines work keyless). npm: @drscrewdriver/dsh-union-search and bare dsh-union-search.

title: EdwinDigital/dsh-web-search-microsoft-webiq
description: Microsoft Web IQ search provider for the built-in web_search tool, with a settings card for the API key, endpoint, language, region, passage length and SafeSearch.

title: elves-ai/dsh-web-search-firecrawl
description: Firecrawl-backed web search provider for the built-in web_search tool, with a settings card for the API key and result limits.

title: Fisfzy/dsh-ego-browser
description: Drive a real Chrome/Chromium browser from DeepSeek Harness with 35 structured tools for navigation, snapshots, clicks, forms, JavaScript/CDP, screenshots, downloads and tabs; a live sidebar mirrors the page and accepts mouse and keyboard input. It ships a managed CDP runtime, keeps login state across calls, and can import cookies from your everyday Chrome through a companion extension.

title: FleatherYu/dsh-webannotate
description: Annotates pages inside the built-in browser: click an element, write a comment, and send the batch to the conversation as one message, with a cropped screenshot per note where the element can be located.

title: fno2010/dsh-web-search-ext
description: Multi-backend web_search provider (Exa + Firecrawl) for the built-in web_search tool, with automatic failover, per-backend 429 cooldowns, and key-free anonymous access.

title: foolfu86/dsh-scrapling-mcp
description: A configuration-only DSH bundle that connects the MCP server shipped with Scrapling to DeepSeek Harness over stdio, exposing its HTTP fetch and stealth-browser scraping tools for page extraction, browser actions, screenshots and network inspection. Requires Python 3.10+ with scrapling\[ai] (scrapling-mcp on PATH) and a Chromium-compatible browser (scrapling install).

title: fujingzhai/youxia-dsh-plugins#dsh-quick-chat
description: Opens the official chat.deepseek.com page in the DSH main panel through the desktop app's native browser view, so the login survives restarts, without an iframe or request proxying. A fork of JaMoLpE88/dsh-desktop-chat with the changes listed in its NOTICE. The login token is kept in plaintext in session.json.

title: Geighlord007/qp-exa-dynamic
description: Exa-backed web search provider for the ctx.web seam, with Exa Dynamic Highlights on by default and the Exa-Beta header that setting requires; exposes all eight Exa retrieval types, adds an /exa command to change highlights, search type and result count at runtime, and registers an exa_search tool that takes its own result count.

title: godchen520/dsh-web-search-bing
description: Bing-backed web search provider for the built-in web_search tool: prefers Bing's RSS feed with the public cn.bing.com HTML page as fallback, no API key, reachable from mainland China, and keeps searches off the model's own search quota. Endpoint, result count and result language configurable; targets DSH 0.2.x (also works on 0.1.7+).

title: GoldenLoaf24h/browserpaw#browserpaw-dsh
description: Dual-brain Chrome automation: registers the browserpaw skill and browserpaw_session tool to connect with the local BrowserPaw host (127.0.0.1:12306 via bridge-token), driving Chrome without losing logins.

title: GoldenLoaf24h/dsh-exa
description: Exa web search and fetch provider for DSH: replaces built-in web search and exposes multi-source research capabilities.

title: graydovee/dsh-browser#packages/browser/bridge-browser
description: Side-panel Chrome and Firefox extension that lets DSH drive the tab you are on: pages reach the model as structured text with a numbered element list, and clicks, typing and navigation wait for your approval. Beyond upstream it adds viewport screenshots, opening a URL in a new window, scrolling inside nested scroll containers (chat transcripts, side panes, modal bodies), permission-mode, model and slash-command controls in the composer, and an opt-in developer-tools group (elements and CSS, page JavaScript, network requests) that is off by default and approved per call. The install is two halves: the bridge plugin comes from the prebuilt release tarball, and the companion extension ships as a tgz in the same release and is loaded unpacked, which is the only way Chrome accepts it. This project is a fork of omdsh-dev/dsh-browser: https://github.com/omdsh-dev/dsh-browser

title: GreyRaphael/dsh-web-fetch-moli
description: Ultra-lightweight Moli (Rust headless browser) web-fetch provider for DeepSeek Harness: renders complex SPAs, micro-frontends, and dynamic pages with ~60MB memory.

title: gulagala001/opencu
description: Browser and desktop application control with live previews, annotations and native Hyprland support.

title: guo6x/dsh-pilot
description: Zero-dependency browser control: drive a real headless Edge/Chrome over CDP with 8 `pilot_*` tools (navigate/click/type/keys/eval/screenshot) plus a live draggable cockpit panel in the Web GUI - text-first snapshots for text-only models, no Playwright, no API key.

title: GuoMonth/dsh-erp
description: Learn an ERP through the browser into private local knowledge, with a desktop Adapt ERP workspace (multi-site sessions, chat in the middle and the official Browser on the right, approvals before writes).

title: hermes-ai-2026/dsh-browser-agent
description: 19 browser_* tools that let agents drive DeepSeek Harness's built-in sidebar browser over a loopback bridge: accessibility-tree reads with stable refs, real CDP clicks and keys, screenshots, network interception, device emulation, a cookie vault, document-start script injection, multiple browser instances, and raw CDP passthrough. Requires DSH launched with --remote-debugging-port=9222.

title: Hesitate-P/dsh-sidebar-browser-agent
description: Native agent control for the DSH right-sidebar browser: semantic snapshot with stable refs, clicks/typing/key presses, shadow DOM and same-origin iframes, recorded JS dialogs, full-page screenshots, back/forward, viewport resizing, and native large-file download/upload through the Electron webview. Page control needs DSH Desktop (Electron webview); in the Web build only tab management works.

title: hezheyihuan/dsh-open-deepseek-web
description: Adds a sidebar button to the DSH Web UI that opens chat.deepseek.com in a standalone Chrome app window and focuses that window when it is already open (Windows).

title: htcqp802/dsh-web-search-openai
description: OpenAI-compatible web search provider for the built-in web_search tool: one baseURL/apiKey/model config powers Qwen Token Plan, OpenAI and any Responses API gateway.

title: HXwHSJS/dsh-web-annotation
description: Annotate elements, blank positions or dragged regions in the DSH right-Sidebar Browser tab; each batch is saved as screenshots plus report files and attached to the next message as text. Does not replace the official Browser, Chat or Layout providers.

title: IKEASven69/dsh-opencli
description: Logged-in browser automation with 170+ site adapters as deterministic one-shot commands (requires the OpenCLI CLI, npm i -g @jackwener/opencli, and its BrowserBridge browser extension) — action-evidence verification (no silent failures), site knowledge & health cards, watch monitoring, trace replay, provenance reports, and a write-approval gate.

title: iStarryDust/dsh-browser
description: Built-in browser: gives the agent a real headed Chromium it can open, click, type and scroll in, keeping page state across calls.

title: jaibhasin/dsh-browser-agent#dsh-plugin
description: Chrome side-panel browser agent for DeepSeek Harness with tools to inspect pages, navigate, click, type, scroll, and capture screenshots through a local bridge.

title: Jakcet/dsh-dschat
description: Embeds the DeepSeek web chat (chat.deepseek.com) in a DSH Desktop main panel through an Electron webview guest, with a back/forward/reload toolbar and a local snapshot of login-related localStorage restored on the next open.

title: jakehemmerle/dsh-web-search-exa
description: Exa search provider for the dsh-web seam: the web_search tool sends queries to Exa's /search API and returns the results as sources, in dsh web, dsh-TUI and headless runs. Needs an Exa API key (EXA_API_KEY, the credential store or a key file read on every search). web_fetch is unchanged and there is no UI.

title: jaychang1989/dsh-webchat
description: Opens the official DeepSeek web app (chat.deepseek.com) inside DeepSeek Harness: one sidebar entry renders the real page in the center column through the desktop shell's native browser guest, and keeps you signed in across restarts. The official client keeps its model picker, deep think, smart search, history and attachments. Falls back to opening a window where no guest bridge exists.

title: JayYuen666/dsh-scrapling
description: Wraps the Scrapling Python library in up to nineteen model tools, registered by probed capability: real-browser rendering for JavaScript-only pages, CSS/XPath extraction that returns data instead of Markdown, self-healing selectors, reusable login-state sessions, XHR capture, page screenshots, gated browser actions and a domain-scoped crawler with content/sitemap/feed/Shopify modes on the official job backend. It can also replace the built-in web_fetch / web_search, and serve the same tool table over MCP. Requires Python 3.14+ with Scrapling installed; the browser tools also need a Chromium engine for patchright, which an optional CLI installs on macOS arm64 only.

title: jiaererw/dsh-plugin-chrome
description: A visible Chrome window per DSH session: 16 chrome_* tools (open/status/close/navigate/tabs/snapshot/screenshot/click/click_at/fill/type/press_key/hover/scroll/evaluate/wait), a Chrome tab in the Web GUI with a live screencast view (screenshot-heartbeat fallback for idle pages), tab management, window controls and a screenshot history.

title: jiewaigongxing/dsh-jiey-browser
description: Drive Jiey Browser from DeepSeek Harness over MCP: navigate, snapshot, act, read, screenshot, and manage tabs in a real Chromium profile.

title: JohnXu22786/browser-automation
description: Real-browser automation for dsh via an MCP server (Playwright core): navigate, click, fill, type, screenshot, and act on accessibility snapshots with numbered references - all 22 web_* tools re-exposed to the harness over stdio.

title: kakajun/dsh-web-recorder
description: Records real clicks, inputs, navigation and network traffic in a user-guided browser session for DSH, then generates a Markdown timeline report (report.md + events.jsonl) to build API-level skills.

title: kaminn/dsh-web-fetch-fakeip
description: A fake-ip-aware ctx.web fetch provider that takes over the stock http provider id: a hostname is accepted when every DNS answer is a placeholder inside the proxy's fake-ip block (198.18.0.0/15 by default), so web_fetch works under mihomo/Clash TUN mode without disabling fake-ip or setting proxy environment variables. IP literals and private, loopback and reserved destinations stay blocked.

title: KasenRi/dsh-browser
description: Controlled browser automation for DeepSeek Harness: the agent_browser tool and BrowserAutomationService drive a real Chromium or Chrome page (or an explicit CDP endpoint) through the agent-browser CLI, with allowedDomains containment and per-call output limits.

title: keenableai/dsh-keenable
description: Keenable web search and page fetch for the built-in web_search and web_fetch tools, working with any model and no API key.

title: kenny2077/dsh-web-kimi
description: Kimi Coding web search and web fetch providers for the DeepSeek Harness — one coding-plan key fills both ctx.web seams (POST /v1/search and /v1/fetch), a settings card in the GUI stores it via the credentials service, and the fallback chain reads the Kimi CLI config for zero-setup installs.

title: kenny2077/dsh-web-search-doubao
description: Doubao Search (Volcengine 豆包搜索) web search provider for the DeepSeek Harness — swaps the active web_search backend to the standalone Doubao Search API with its own key and billing (500 free searches per month), and ships a dedicated settings card that stores the key via the credentials service.

title: kesha4/dsh-site-bridge
description: Browser bridge for DeepSeek Harness: captures page markup (DOM with boxes and computed styles, selector candidates checked for uniqueness) and the site's own xhr/fetch calls with headers and bodies, redacting credential-shaped values on ingest, into workspace files — then drives the page with trusted CDP input to verify what was captured. Ships 11 tools and an MV3 extension that works in the browser's own session. Requires Chrome or Edge 125+; the extension is loaded manually and paired with a local token.

title: KirinKylin-1/dsh-annotated-browser
description: An annotated browser tab: pages render in headless Chromium on the host and are served same-origin, so you can click an element or drag a region, write what should change, and send the notes into the conversation with selectors, visible text and rectangles. Requires a Chromium-based browser on the host (auto-detected, or set CHROME_PATH / browserExecutable). By default it provides the `browser` tab type itself; set `takeover: false` to keep the stock browser and use a hand-off button instead. Picking continues until you press Esc.

title: klaus-2/dsh-redline
description: Visual review for the harness browser: pick any element to comment on it, adjust styles live with rollback, sketch on a free-form annotation canvas, and send everything as structured context attached to the next message, with a cropped screenshot per pin or the whole visible viewport composited with the drawings.

title: KNLCXY/dsh-websift
description: Token-efficient web reading for DeepSeek Harness: one call fetches several pages through a real Chrome/Edge over CDP, gates them by relevance and returns a single digest, cutting context tokens by 80-98%. Real search URLs, login flow, screenshots, three proxy modes.

title: kyo615/dsh-browser-control
description: Playwright MCP browser control for AI agents: drive a real, visible Chrome (navigate/click/type/snapshot + ~80 browser_* tools), with a live screenshot panel embedded in the GUI that refreshes after every action.

title: L1818346/dsh-browser-takeover
description: Browser takeover for sign-in-gated sites: keeps a list of addresses that need a login (URL and date only, no credentials), answers before a visit whether an address is already on it, reports whether the debug browser is signed in there from the session-cookie names of that site (certain, likely, or not signed in — anonymous cookies such as _gh_sess never count), and opens saved addresses in that browser by navigating and clicking one element by its visible text, searching every iframe. One click per call, no crawling.

title: laoyingfuhuole/dsh-browser-use-automation
description: Fully background browser automation and browser use for DSH: an offscreen Electron window per conversation with real CDP input and screenshots, so headless-style browsing never steals focus or pops windows. Runs on Electron and keeps cookies in a persistent user-data directory, so a signed-in page stays signed in for later conversations.

title: lemoncat7/dsh-web-search
description: Configurable web search for DeepSeek Harness using SearXNG, Wikipedia, Tavily, Brave, or Gemini, with per-client engine selection and bounded retries.

title: liangzz1998/dsh-web-devtools
description: Exposes Chrome DevTools Protocol to the agent through 17 tools for page summaries, element locators, activity timelines, console, network, storage and downloads, reading either a browser the plugin launches on its own or the tab the user is currently browsing through a small browser extension.

title: lightrivers/dsh-proxy-switch
description: Fixes web_fetch failing with "non-public IP address" while Clash, Surge or v2rayN runs in TUN/fake-IP mode: finds your local HTTP proxy by itself, sends web_fetch through it while the proxy is on and directly when it is off, and adds an Auto/Proxy/Direct switch to the sidebar. Model calls are left alone by default.

title: lijiaqi-AI-Product-Manager/dsh-bug-gps
description: Records browser bugs, freezes expected results, and verifies fixes against a fresh original-code control.

title: limingyao-xx/dsh-sidebar-mobile-browser
description: Mobile-viewport preview tab for the right sidebar, with nine preset sizes covering phones, tablets and a laptop plus a custom width/height, one-click URL copy, and the page URL inserted into the composer through an @ button or the /url command.

title: lirui1024k/dsh-browser-ops
description: Browser automation for DeepSeek Harness: agent-driven real-browser control (managed Chrome with an isolated persistent profile, or attach to your daily Chrome over CDP) with snapshot, click, fill and page-reading tools; records manual operation flows and replays them with variable slots to create test data on demand; ships 27 browser_* tools plus a Settings panel.

title: liustack/modsearch
description: Web search bridge for text-only agents: ask the web or X, get structured JSON evidence (search, fetch, citations).

title: LockyBee/dsh-douyin-agent
description: Browses Douyin in a dedicated browser with daily viewing limits, shared local persona and interests, native settings, diagnostics, usage tracking, and reports. Replies and shares use selected conversations; group replies require a mention or configured name. Public comments require separate opt-in.

title: longmiaoo/dsh-native-browser
description: Browser plugin for DSH (浏览器): Codex-style native browser control in your signed-in Chrome, with smooth virtual-cursor feedback, semantic page reads, form filling, screenshots and handoff; setup from the Browser sidebar. Requires macOS + Google Chrome (Chrome 125+) and a one-time unpacked load of the bundled MV3 extension; Edge, Windows and complete Linux installation are experimental.

title: LouXiaXiaoHei/dsh-chrome-bridge
description: Lets the agent drive the Chrome tab you @-mention — 13 tools for tabs, snapshots, clicking, typing, keys, scrolling, dragging and screenshots, with input sent as real CDP events so pages see isTrusted true and a pointer drawn inside the page. Needs the bundled Manifest V3 extension loaded by hand in Chrome (developer mode; it requests the debugger and all-URLs permissions), talks to it over a WebSocket on 127.0.0.1 ports 30795-30805, and saves screenshots under ~/.dsh/chrome-tab-shots; the macOS native input channel also needs Accessibility permission and the Xcode command-line tools.

title: loyalchiiina/dsh-browser-hub
description: Adds a search-engine picker, a bookmarks panel with multi-level folders (add/edit/delete/import Netscape bookmark HTML) and keyword-then-Enter search in the address bar of the sidebar Browser tab. Requires dsh-better-sidebar >=0.20.0 (the client injects its betterSidebar service and will not load without it). Bookmarks are stored in a local JSON file; no external browser required.

title: Luca4Don3/dsh-web-search
description: Web search and fetch provider for DeepSeek Harness and Pi: anonymous-first routing across Exa, Tavily, Parallel, Firecrawl and TinyFish, with opt-in billing, quota preflight and bounded cancellation.

title: Lumos-789/malo-browser
description: Electron browser with two faces. For agents it is a runtime: a daemon hands out port leases so several agents drive isolated, profile-backed sessions (25 session tools — navigate, act, observe, screenshot, batch runs, upload_file — including network_capture/responses for reading XHR/fetch bodies through a real browser), and it needs no window. For demos it splits a web walkthrough into a Stage window for the audience and a hidden Recorder that produces 1080p30 video with evidence files over CDP, without forking the browser engine; flows are scripted as scene.yaml packages driven from a Director console plus a loopback control API on 127.0.0.1:7317; headless recording shows no window, takes no focus and stays out of the Dock. Requires Node 22.12+ on the 22 line, 24.x, or 26+ (the 23 and 25 lines are excluded).

title: LWJ007/dsh-browser-tabs
description: Type /tabs to pick a browser tab (via chrome-devtools-mcp) and auto-fill its URL into the composer.

title: lyd123qw2008/pi-control-chrome#dsh-tool-control-chrome
description: Chrome and Edge browser control that drives the real logged-in profile, tabs and cookies through an MV3 extension and a loopback Bridge, exposing browser_* tools, a Skill and /chrome commands.

title: lyp88997/dsh-browser-service
description: Gives DSH the full 33-tool browser surface (ctx.browser seam -> a self-hosted headless Chromium over CDP: one 127.0.0.1 daemon with Bearer-token auth, request-path whitelist and WebSocket rewriting, no root/GUI/Electron needed), plus a web panel — a real page you can click, scroll and type in, operation/console/network logs with one-click cleanup, a customizable window (border color, transparency, glass, fit-to-picture with no black bars, top-inset and self-centering) and an adjustable page size (1920x1080 by default) — plus a collapsed pill that can be dragged to any spot on the screen (free position), a live view that auto-resumes when you switch back to the web tab, and a 1920px default max edge for the live frame — and two bundled skills (browser, browser-runtime) served through the plugin built-in skill provider, so the skill centre lists them as system-level by default without writing into $DSH_HOME/skills.

title: lyp88997/dsh-moli-browser

description: Mounts the hosted Exa search MCP endpoint (https://mcp.exa.ai/mcp) through the in-box @deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client bridge: web_search_exa and web_fetch_exa tools, anonymous on the free tier or with your own EXA_API_KEY.

title: MicroHEROX/dsh-Kimi-WebBridge
description: Drive the user's real browser through the local Kimi WebBridge daemon: navigate, find-tab, snapshot, click, fill, evaluate, CDP, screenshot, network, upload, PDF export and tab-management tools that reuse existing login sessions.

Login state persists (own profile plus session-cookie re-injection). 23 Playwright tools (20 always on, 3 gated and off by default), with a URL allowlist, dialog suspension and a CDP method allowlist that are mechanism-level and pinned by tests.

title: mmyddd/dsh-element-lens

title: moguiyu/dsh-tavily#packages/dsh-tavily
description: Tavily search, extract, map and crawl tools with multi-key rotation, failover on HTTP 401/429/432/433, and a load-balance mode that caps in-flight requests per Tavily account, plus a key and usage card on the Plugins page. The built-in web_search is never replaced.

description: Tavily, Exa and Firecrawl behind one normalized web_search and web_fetch seam: a failing vendor falls through a cooled-down chain, and the row is a host Config form the desktop page and dsh-go both edit.

title: NingYuanLee/dsh-gui-auth-url

Pages render in the webview bridge that ships with DSH Desktop, and the current page can be opened in your local Chrome.

title: Noemm/dsh-web-search-glm
description: Zhipu GLM web search provider: registers as `glm` on the ctx.web seam and runs the native web_search server tool through GLM's Anthropic-compatible API (Coding Plan billing).

title: Nono-neko/dsh-browser
description: An AI-native browser workspace for DeepSeek Harness (DSH), combining multi-tab browsing, live page annotations, lightweight code editing, workspace previews, and Agent-assisted iteration across Web and Desktop.

title: omdsh-dev/dsh-browser#packages/browser/bridge-browser
description: Chrome sidebar extension that lets DSH operate your browser directly, no vision capabilities required.

title: OrderG-X/dsh-chrome-bridge#plugin
description: Controls the Chrome you are already logged into: the model clicks, types, fills in forms, reads pages, takes screenshots and downloads files in your real tabs, including inside same-origin iframes. Runs on macOS, Windows and Linux; needs Chrome 116+ and Node 18+. Works over native messaging and chrome.debugger instead of a listening port. Ships 12 browser_* tools and a cb CLI, dispatches real CDP input events, draws an on-page cursor that also appears in screenshots, and adds a toolbar panel with live status, the controlled tabs and a pause switch. browser_download saves a link, an element's target or a URL with the site's login cookies (following redirects, keeping the server's file name) to the Downloads folder or the session's working directory; cross-origin iframes are named in the snapshot but not entered. The native host and the MV3 extension travel inside this tarball: on first load the plugin copies them into place and writes the native-messaging registration itself, so there is no clone, no install.sh and no python3 - the one step left is adding the extension to Chrome: install DSH Bridge from the Chrome Web Store (https://chromewebstore.google.com/detail/bippcbbbipppmhjkjomgdnjbooecbimo, no Developer mode), or load the bundled unpacked copy at chrome://extensions (the plugin opens that page and puts the folder on the clipboard for you). Until then the tools fail loudly with those steps. On Windows the registration goes into the registry (for Chrome and Edge) and the host talks over a named pipe. A daily CI run on GitHub's macOS, Windows and Linux machines installs the plugin, loads the extension into a real Chrome and reads a page through the browser_* tools.

title: Oxygen640/dsh-plugin-nuaa-search
description: Zero-key web search provider for the built-in web_search tool: scrapes Bing China, 360 and SearXNG through a backend fallback chain and returns real URLs with snippets and publish dates. No API key and no settings card are required. SearXNG is used only when you set your own instance URL, and installing this plugin switches web_search to it and turns off the official DeepSeek search row.

title: OzzyDeng-JunDeng/dsh-keyless-search
description: Registers a keyless search provider for the built-in web_search tool so it works without an API key, failing over between the documented no-key tiers of Tavily and Firecrawl; a TAVILY_API_KEY or FIRECRAWL_API_KEY is picked up automatically when present. Two Bing scrape backends are included but off by default.

title: ParticleLight/dsh-browser-plus
description: Visible Electron browser for DSH with one shared BrowserWindow, isolated task views, explicit human-Agent handoff, snapshot-reference and native navigation tools, operation trails, demand-driven page thumbnails, keyed session recovery for reliable tab switching and closing, and site-scoped cookie clearing for login maintenance.

title: PartinGQAQ/dsh-web-search-zhipu
description: GLM (Zhipu bigmodel) web search provider - routes ctx.web search through Zhipu's Anthropic-compatible endpoint with the native web_search server tool, billing your existing GLM quota or Coding Plan instead of the DeepSeek platform. Includes a translation layer for Zhipu's non-standard tool_result response layout.

title: PILIHU2022/dsh-proxy-failover
description: Loopback relay as DSH's process-wide proxy route: web_fetch works under TUN fake-ip; a dead proxy gets same-request direct fallback, and a probe switches back.

title: platonai/dsh-browser4
description: Installs the browser4-cli runtime and registers the Browser4 skills (browser4-cli, browser4-experience, browser4-plugin, scent-miner) into the DSH skill registry, providing an AI-native browser engine for autonomous agents, intelligent extraction, and large-scale web automation.

title: PyModel/dsh-research-plugins#dsh-mcp-firecrawl
description: Firecrawl MCP bridge: hosted Firecrawl MCP server with keyless search, scrape and parse; an API key unlocks the full tool surface including crawl and map.

title: PyModel/dsh-research-plugins#dsh-tavily
description: Tavily Search API as a web search provider (settings toggle with DeepSeek fallback, keyless search) plus a Tavily MCP bridge: keyless search and extract tools, crawl and map with an API key.

title: qcann/dsh-chat-in-harness
description: A conversation-independent floating window for chat.deepseek.com, rendered in a webview, draggable and resizable, with page zoom, opacity control and an optional floating ball. It makes no API calls, stores no credentials and injects no scripts.

title: qikairo7/dsh-web-search-fetch
description: Aggregated web_search and web_fetch providers for DeepSeek Harness, sitting behind the built-in tools. Search fans one query out to AnySearch, Zhipu and Zhihu concurrently, dedupes URLs, fuses ranks with Reciprocal Rank Fusion and optionally reranks through SiliconFlow. Fetch is URL-aware: static pages pass through the built-in HTTP fetcher, dynamic ones fan out to Firecrawl and AnySearch extract and pick one body by quality. One shared circuit breaker skips an engine for the day after a quota or 429 signal, and a settings card keeps each engine API key in the credential store without ever showing its value.

title: qoqpqpq/dsh-web-preview
description: Embed a local web server in the DSH GUI through a remote-browser-safe same-origin proxy: any localhost port works, plus a Console/Network/Errors toolbox that captures what the iframe actually does.

title: QuantumKuba/dsh-webstack
description: SearXNG search and Scrapling multi-tier fetch provider bundle for DeepSeek Harness ctx.web with SSRF protection and markdown conversion.

title: regrevia/dsh-inner-browser-use
description: Drives the sidebar browser already open on the right: same cookies and same sign-in, a pointer you can watch, no second window.

title: regrevia/Envoy#envoy-dsh
description: Paste a link; the agent reads it. Xiaohongshu, Douyin, Bilibili, WeChat, articles, PDFs and audio become citable Markdown for a wiki or knowledge base. On 60 turns with vs without: finishes reading 22% -> 92% (+70 points), times out 68% -> 0%, answer quotes a real source fact 23% -> 82% (the A/B is exploratory: different time caps, no human correctness review). On 123 live links 80% came back usable (93% of the pages that answered); an unreachable link reports in 26 s. Codex, Claude Code, DSH.

title: renchengxiang/dsh-web-search-tavily
description: Tavily-backed search provider for native web_search, with a Settings → Plugins card for API key management and toggling DeepSeek replacement.

title: ricardochen1996/dsh-browser-use
description: Browser provider for DeepSeek Harness: hand it a web task — open a page, click, type, fill a form, read what is on it — and it drives a real browser step by step, seeing an indexed table of what can be done on the current page instead of raw HTML or screenshots. Each step is one bundled-Jev decision rather than a full model turn (1.1 s median per step versus 2.8–3.6 s for chat-model turns in the repo benchmark), and the main conversation receives only the conclusion, so its context does not grow with the page. Targets come from the page it just read and a changed page is re-read rather than clicked blind, and it runs in the browser that Session owns, leaving your everyday Chrome untouched unless you switch to attach mode.

title: robin421/dsh-html-inspector
description: Selection mode for HTML preview and browser tabs: click any element in a locally served demo page and its locator (selector, text, HTML snippet) is written into the chat input for precise AI editing.

title: rogerdigital/dsh-searxng
description: SearXNG-backed web_search provider for the web seam: free, self-hosted, key-less metasearch through your own instance's JSON API, with a bundled loopback-only docker-compose example.

title: ROY32172310/dsh-ego-webqa
description: Adds an ego-webqa MCP server that audits deployed pages across the mobile viewport matrix and returns structured repair evidence; needs uv/uvx on PATH and a Playwright Chromium headless runtime on the same machine.

title: SciF-Lin/dsh-browsercontrol-mcp
description: Mounts Microsoft's Playwright MCP through the official dsh-mcp-client so the agent gets its browser tools over stdio; the one-time CDP authorization is guided by a prompt note, a call guard and the /bw-setup command.

title: Shad0wwa1ker/dsh-browser-mode
description: Adds a visible-browser Agent preset (persona and toolset for navigating, filling forms, clicking and screenshotting through the Playwright MCP toolset) plus a gate that refuses every browser tool call in other presets until the user approves that Session through the bundled browser_access tool. The bundle mounts the Playwright MCP provider itself, and both a settings page in the Plugins view and the browser_source tool switch the browser at runtime between Microsoft Edge (default), the Chromium shipped with Playwright, and a CDP endpoint. Requires keeping the shared browser-use registration row in the profile (one provider per process).

title: ShallBay/dsh-bridge-browser
description: Lets DSH drive the Chrome tab you are already browsing, no vision needed: the page reaches the model as structured text with a numbered element list, and clicks, typing, key presses, scrolling, tab handling and navigation wait for your confirmation in the extension side panel while password and payment-card fields stay masked. Fifteen browser_* tools cover snapshot, text, tab list, open, follow, click, type, press, scroll, wait, navigate, back, close, forward and reload. A repack of the bridge plugin from omdsh-dev/dsh-browser, published to npm so it installs with `dsh plugin add`: the peer ranges the host checks are widened so the install is not refused as incompatible, the bundled extension also probes the DSH Desktop host port 19387 so no bridge address has to be typed, and a script copies the extension to a fixed directory so a profile switch or reinstall cannot break it. The prebuilt release tarball carries the plugin and the built MV3 extension. Upstream: https://github.com/omdsh-dev/dsh-browser.

title: SheepofSheep/dsh-doyourweb
description: Reference logged-in Chrome/Edge tabs, authorized local HTML and running Windows apps through a searchable native sidebar or @. Open browser candidates and the webpage sidebar refresh when the extension connects, disconnects or changes tabs, including an unchanged search query. Windows application lists skip protected processes with unreadable identity metadata and preserve other running apps. Read scoped snapshots, batch actions, capture screenshots and use available WebMCP tools; supports authorized uploads, drag/drop and opt-in network metadata. Browser actions preserve failure evidence, accept an explicit post-action observation scope and can check one final visible/text/value/URL condition without replaying effects. Expandable context preserves model content; dockable annotations support a session-bound staging queue with edit/delete/restore, and append to chat drafts without sending. App control prefers a matching installed MCP or approved installation, then Cua Driver with text, hotkeys and paged controls; desktop reads present the window once per connection or when recovery is needed. Background input depends on the app. Requires Chrome or Edge 125+ with the companion MV3 extension manually loaded and paired; installing the plugin does not install the extension.

title: shinjiyu/dsh-plugin-search
description: Keep the built-in web_search tool without an official DeepSeek API key: disable web-search-deepseek and use Tavily keyless by default.

title: SiliconSailor/dsh-dual-browser

title: SivanCola/dsh-deepseek-search

It registers its own tool and routes instead of replacing the built-in web_search and web_fetch providers, so an existing search setup keeps working.

title: specstream/specstream-tools#dsh-plugin-specstream
description: Registers the hosted SpecStream MCP server with the harness MCP manager and keeps the API key in the credential store. The server returns live web data as structured rows, each value with its source URL, and a run starts only after the quote's maximum is approved.

title: sryimnoob123/dsh-web-search-ollama
description: Routes the DSH web_search tool through Ollama's web search API, reusing OLLAMA_API_KEY. No DeepSeek official key needed.

title: Starp1ume/dsh-chat-mode

title: startime-ltk/dsh-explorers
description: Connects Chrome, Edge and QQ Browser to DeepSeek Harness through a local MV3 extension and loopback bridge, exposing 12 browser tools for navigation, snapshots, clicks, typing, extraction and screenshots. The browser extension is loaded manually (MV3, developer mode) and paired with the bridge, and it requests the debugger permission.

title: stormbuf/dsh-tavily-pool
description: Takes over the built-in web_search and web_fetch providers with Tavily, each behind its own toggle: a key pool with balance-aware scheduling that reads real credit balances from /usage, failover with hard exclusion of cooling or exhausted keys, and call history with a 14-day credit chart.

title: stuarthu/dsh-chrome
description: Chrome side panel that embeds the dsh web UI and lets the agent read the current page, capture HTTP traffic, and drive the browser.

title: Suguyun/dsh-insight

Fork of stuarthu/dsh-chrome (MIT): upstream supplied the bridge, browser tools and page injector, and this fork adds select-to-interpret, native multi-turn follow-up, in-panel settings and appearance options. It registers the same browser_* tool names as the upstream, so the two cannot be installed together.

title: superagents-lab/dsh-s1
description: Native Search1API (s1) web research tools: search, news, page crawling, sitemap discovery, and trending topics as first-class `s1_*` tools, with a bundled s1 skill.

title: SZMY-haruhi/dsh-tavily
description: Tavily web search for DSH with a settings toggle, keyless by default, and a connection test.

title: T-Markus-Liang/dsh-webmcp
description: WebMCP bridge: your agent discovers & calls site tools exposed over the W3C WebMCP protocol via a built-in headless Chromium.

title: Tabbit-Browser/dsh-tabbit
description: Gives DeepSeek Harness control of the Tabbit Browser: auto-loads the tabbit-browser skill on install, detects official Tabbit and Tabbit Browser releases (>= 1.9.0), checks the tabbit-cli persistent runtime, diagnoses the per-platform DSH sandbox mode needed to call the CLI, and downloads the region-matched official installer via a background job when no qualifying version is present.

title: tao1020/dsh-chrome-use
description: Drive the Chrome browser you already use: open new tabs or reuse logged-in ones to read pages, click, fill, drag, scroll, screenshot, upload files, export PDFs, inspect console and network logs, and group tabs by task — 38 tools in all. Several harnesses can connect to the same Chrome at once, each working on its own tabs; a tab belongs to one harness at a time, so they never fight over it, and they can message each other. With foreground mode off, operations never bring the window to the front. Requires Chrome 120+; install the extension from the store and pair with an 8-digit code.

title: TC635807/better-crawler4agent
description: Registers a real-browser URL-to-text MCP server in a DSH profile: fetch_url and fetch_urls render JavaScript-heavy and anti-bot Chinese pages (Zhihu, CSDN, Juejin, cnblogs) and return clean article text as JSON with per-tier diagnostics, and crawler_status reports whether the browser is available. Needs a one-time Python dependency setup after install.

title: Tencent/BrowserSkill#dsh-plugin-browserskill
description: BrowserSkill bridge for controlling visible Chrome and Edge Agent Windows from DeepSeek Harness, with native browser tools, accessibility and VOM observations, screenshots, owned multi-session control, and a live Web UI overlay.

title: Tests4gptplay/dsh-dots
description: Open ChatGPT Dots in a full-width DSH page with Desktop startup preload, retained page state across panel switches, bilingual theme-aware controls, refresh and external-browser access. Optional login persistence (DSH Desktop only): a Settings button backs up and patches the browser-partition code in DSH Desktop's app.asar (Restore undoes it); it needs a full DSH restart, must be re-applied after a DSH upgrade, and is refused on code-signed macOS builds.

title: TonyDua/dsh-web-search-exa
description: Zero-config Exa web search provider for the ctx.web seam: anonymous MCP fallback without an API key, plus keyed REST search.

title: TZHR-invest/dsh-plugins#dsh-web-search-metaso
description: Metaso (秘塔AI搜索) search & reader providers for the web seam: web_search returns page summaries, web_fetch reads full-page markdown, multi-scope search (webpage/document/paper/image/video/podcast).

title: umineko987/dsh-search-enhance
description: Grok-compatible web search with retained source pagination, Context7 and Exa documentation lookup, bounded page extraction, site mapping, offline research planning, and read-only diagnostics.

title: uugvkbvkdjbsdbvwxxl/dsh-plugin-web-annotate
description: Annotate elements in the built-in browser — click one, write a comment, then send the whole batch to the session in one message so the model can find and edit the matching source.

title: vfuncyy/dsh-edge-bridge#plugin
description: Drives the Edge already open on your machine through a local WebSocket bridge and an unpacked MV3 extension: the agent reads the page as Markdown, dumps its interactive elements with stable refs, clicks and types with pre-action assertions and a three-valued effect state, and can capture pages from the extension popup as self-contained HTML snapshots, filed into a kb.py literature knowledge base when one is configured (kbRoot or DSH_KB_ROOT). Seven browser tools stay unregistered until edge_bridge is started, so an idle session pays no context cost.

title: Viger1/dsh-pilot
description: Browser operation by accessibility refs: navigate, snapshot the page as a ref tree, act on elements, and wait for conditions; the origin policy follows the session approval stance and is enforced by request interception.

title: Viger1/dsh-preview
description: Headless-browser verification tools so the agent opens the page it just built, reads the rendered DOM and computed styles, checks the console, and screenshots the result; ships a frontend-verify skill.

title: vitas/dsh-web-search-openrouter
description: The built-in web_search bills a full model turn against DeepSeek's own endpoint; this runs it on an OpenRouter-compatible gateway instead, so search is billed where your chat already is, at the model and price you pick.

title: WalterYOO/dsh-web-search-yuanbao
description: Tencent Yuanbao Search provider for the ctx.web seam: one direct Search API request per query returns portable title, URL, snippet and ISO-8601 date, with credentials resolved per search and no auxiliary model turn. Requires a Tencent Cloud WSA API key.

title: wangtheme-coder/dsh-dragon-control
description: Windows x64 only, 0.5.4 preview: two scoped tools (dragon_browser and dragon_desktop) that drive a visible browser through the DOM or CDP and Windows apps through UI Automation, with per-origin and per-executable read/control scopes, batch steps, a physical-Esc emergency stop and a redacted action log. 0.5.4 only widens the DSH compatibility range to 0.2.0-rc.2 through 0.2.1.x, because 0.5.3 pinned it to an exact DSH version and was silently skipped on DSH Desktop 0.2.1. Two long-lived native processes remove the per-action process spawn, so a single key step takes about 0.7 s on the same machine; when another window steals the foreground the step is aborted instead of typing into the wrong place. The browser side ships its own Edge/Chrome launcher and CDP client, so it no longer needs another browser plugin or the Electron runtime. It is not an OS sandbox; logins, admin windows and secure desktops stay with the user.

title: wanwujiehuyi-web/dsh-browser-lens
description: Zero-dependency browser hand & eye over CDP: drives your own Chrome/Edge with real clicks, Chinese IME typing, scrolling and text/selector element picking, and captures whole-page evidence into one replayable folder — DOM, accessibility tree, screenshots, cookies, storage, console, HAR, resource waterfall and perf metrics.

title: wanwujiehuyi-web/dsh-omni-browser
description: Drive a real Chrome and bundle the DOM, accessibility tree, HAR with response bodies, console logs, storage, screenshots, PDF and screencast into one self-contained evidence folder.

title: whiteS18/dsh-bing-search
description: Maintained fork of godchen520/dsh-web-search-bing adapted to DSH 0.1.5-rc.1: Bing-backed provider for the built-in web_search tool, scraping the public cn.bing.com HTML results page with no API key, reachable from mainland China, and keeping searches off the model's own search quota. Endpoint and result count configurable.

title: wjj-8283/dsh-web-fetch-fakeip-plugin

Works with no proxy environment variables and no Clash changes.

title: wqty123/dsh-browser
description: Shared real browser for DSH: a native Electron window the human can watch and take over, driven by the agent over CDP with 20 browser_* tools (open/snapshot/execute/fill/screenshot/download/auth), per-task session isolation, cookie persistence, CAPTCHA detection; self-hosts on plain dsh web without a desktop shell.

title: xianmua/dsh-browser-relay

title: xiaobai2017666/dsh-chrome-cdp
description: Chrome DevTools Protocol Plugin for DeepSeek Harness. Use chrome-remote-interface to connect to and control Chrome via CDP. The connection includes a graphical interface.

title: xiaonerner0821/prismsearch#dsh
description: Bundles the PrismSearch MCP server and its agent skill. Web search over Bing and Baidu with no account or API key, plus Google and Brave when API keys are set and DuckDuckGo, Sogou, 360 and Yandex when enabled in config; automatic engine fallback and an aggregate mode. Also image search, WeChat Official Account article search, and fetch_page, which returns web pages and PDFs as Markdown in segments.

title: xingzhen199186/dsh-jev-ultrafast

title: Destinhue/dsh-video-vision
description: Five tools for reading a video as raw material rather than as something to watch. video_outline maps a whole file as text and draws nothing at all: 4-60 equal windows, each with its cut count, speech share, intensity bar and tags, then the windows worth opening and the exact start/end for the call that follows -- zero image tokens. video_probe returns metadata and a reading plan without decoding frames. video_storyboard turns a window into one contact sheet plus a text index binding every cell to its timecode, cut count and frame time; cells whose text would be illegible at that scale are marked zoom, and dedupe global folds a picture that comes back after a cut. video_zoom re-renders 1-9 cells from a short window at a larger scale. video_read decodes only keyframes, OCRs each screen, and returns an outline plus \[mm:ss] text -- the path for lectures, slide decks and screen recordings, where the words are the content. It also reads a file with sound and no picture as a transcript (subtitle track, then DSH_ASR_CMD, then a transcript file you pass; long audio is cut at 45 s onto silence), composes six changed frames into one sheet when a file has no readable text at all, and can write the result out as SRT, WebVTT or text. Cuts, dissolves and one-frame flashes are found in a single ffmpeg pass; from ten minutes up a file is analysed on its keyframes only, 2.7x faster on a two-hour lecture; and a cell is never shrunk below a fifth of the source, so a 1440p sheet spends the same tokens on fewer, bigger cells. OCR is the engine Windows ships, tesseract with line boxes, or DSH_OCR_CMD. It takes a B station link (bilibili.com/video/BV..., a bare BV id, an av id or a b23.tv short link) wherever it takes a file: up to 300 seconds is read from the CDN in place with nothing written to disk, longer videos are downloaded once and cached within a 4 GB / 24 video budget, play URLs are cached for ten minutes, and a link that is not a single video says what it is. Needs ffmpeg, uses ffprobe when present, and has no other runtime dependencies. It is a wire-compatible reimplementation of SAOS-3624/dsh-video-storyboard: it registers the same video_probe / video_storyboard / video_zoom tool names, so the two cannot be enabled together.

Supports edit and lock mask polarities, a mask threshold, tolerance and alpha-ignoring; PNG color types 0/2/3/4/6, bit depths 1-16, all five filters and Adam7. Zero dependencies, local only — no model call, no network, no upload.

title: dingchenhui0618-arch/dsh-vision-diff

Two local PNGs in; a machine-readable first line (`PIXEL_CHANGED=true|false`, greppable as an assertion), then the difference ratio, per-region bounding boxes, maximum channel delta and mean absolute error, plus a self-contained HTML comparison page. An ignore-region list with absolute or fractional coordinates excludes clocks, cursors and other per-render noise. It deliberately does no content recognition: it answers only "did this change", which is the part that can be made deterministic. Entirely local — no model call, no network, no upload.

title: drscrewdriver/dsh-media-lens
description: All-media (video/audio/image) sibling of liustack/modlens: turns local media into structured evidence (timeline / transcript / layout regions) injected into the conversation so text-only models can cite concrete frames, seconds and speakers — Evidence, not imagination. One failover chain per media, recorded hop-by-hop in meta.attempts (a fallback is never silent): host-registered multimodal models first, then a configured OpenAI-compatible endpoint (comma-separated multi-key rotation), then local ffmpeg frame-sampling / a local ASR CLI, degrading to metadata-only as a last resort. Absorbs modlens battle-tested rules — cooldown keyed only on auth/quota failures and softened to chain-tail (never dropped), redact-before-clip error text, magic-byte sniff that never trusts file extensions. Optional vision-bridge registers a media-lens wrapper into the host model selector so a pure-text model gains image/audio/video sight. Registering / authenticating multimodal models and true inline audio-video upload lean on two companion plugins, declared as optional peers (absence auto-degrades, never errors): dsh-thinking-levels fronts the model config / registration surface, dsh-llm-openai-completions takes over the OpenAI-compatible transport that serializes file blocks into video_url / input_audio. Privacy: media goes to remote providers by default; strictLocalOnly keeps content on-machine. Prerequisites not shipped with the package: ffmpeg/ffprobe on PATH (frame sampling / reencode / duration probe; degrades to metadata when missing) and a user-configured local ASR CLI for the audio fallback. Hosts 0.1.7 / 0.2.0 / 0.2.1 (6 rc, exact engines.dsh enum). npm: dsh-media-lens.

title: whiteS18/dsh-image-generation

description: Codex-style window capture for DSH Desktop on macOS and Windows: press both Command keys (macOS) or both Ctrl keys (Windows), or the camera button, to grab the frontmost window, attach it to the current chat, and inject a VoiceOver-style accessibility tree as hidden context.

title: WSL043/dsh-image-viewer
description: Upgrades DSH image viewing with pointer-centered zoom, pan, galleries, downloads, keyboard support, and inline region notes.

title: wulusai2333/mimo-vision
description: `describe_image` tool: a vision bridge that sends images to mimo-v2.5 through the opencode Zen API (credential `OPENCODE_GO_API_KEY`, free route first with paid fallback) and returns text descriptions for text-only models, with native passthrough and ImageMagick transcoding of SVG/TIFF/HEIC formats.

title: xiaoshihou514/dsh-vision
description: Native vision capability extension, using either Zhipu (free) or Qwen-VL (local).

title: xiaoyuink/dsh-image-vision
description: Image understanding for any DSH model: vision, OCR, grounding, and crop tools with domain presets for histopathology, cell biology, anatomy, clinical images and scientific figures.

title: xiaozhe7772222/dsh-draw-router
description: Unified image generation router for DeepSeek Harness (DSH): auto-discovers image models from any OpenAI-compatible endpoint, provides draw_image and draw_list_sources tools, supports SenseNova, StepFun, Agnes, Qwen, Flux, SD, Imagen and more.

title: ximengxiaolan/dsh-vision-bridge
description: Composer-attached images are transcribed to text by an OpenAI-compatible vision model before reaching text-only DeepSeek models.

title: xing666173/dsh-vision-hub#tool-vision
description: Enhanced vision toolbox: 14 pixel-level vision tools (describe, ground, detect, crop, pixel-diff, OCR, long-screenshot OCR, vectorize, colors, cutout, screenshot, present, materialize, html-screenshot) driven by one OpenAI-compatible endpoint, with clean \[图片: path] bridge markers, content-safety classification and rate-limit auto-retry.

title: xinming-chenniang/dsh-longshot
description: Splits over-long screenshots into DSH-acceptable slices before prompt admission instead of letting them be rejected: vertical slices overlap so a line of text is never cut in half, and pure-JS codecs avoid native binaries. It wraps the existing attachment store instead of replacing it.

title: xsoc1/dsh-image-vision
description: Chat image-attachment bridge with a `view_image` tool for any OpenAI-compatible VLM (local Ollama or cloud): pasted/dropped images become `view_image` path markers before reaching text-only DeepSeek models.

title: xuanyuanluoxue/computer-use-vision
description: Windows computer-use capability for DSH: screenshot → vision model → simulated mouse/keyboard with self-evolving knowledge base. Dual-mode plugin tools + skill-only pwsh fallback.

title: xuhairui-dzz/dsh-shengtu
description: Multi-engine image generation inside the conversation: an agent tool plus a composer-dock panel with an on/off switch, engine presets (Volcengine Ark, SiliconFlow, OpenAI-compatible, custom) and local spend tracking. You supply the API key for the engine you pick.

title: XXGJ666/dsh-feiyu-vision
description: Image understanding for DSH: describe an image and read the text in it through Zhipu GLM-4V (needs a Zhipu API key, free tier), with optional person identification through Volcengine Ark and anime-only reverse image search through SauceNAO or trace.moe (each needs its own key); ffmpeg must be installed for GIF/WebP input. Keys and the ffmpeg path are set on the plugin's own settings page.

title: yanming119/dsh-spectacles
description: Point at one window and the AI reads only that window -- text, layout and small print. No full-screen fallback, and it still works when that window is covered by others. Windows 10/11 only.

title: yanming119/dsh-spectacles#eyesight
description: See the whole screen clearly: a 146-token overview map first, then 1:1 blocks up to 1400x900 so text is pixel-legible; a single sight_see tool with an on-screen eye toggle, measured against a 1600px host shrink limit. Windows only (it uses PowerShell); capture stays off until you click the eye.

title: Yinxe/deepseek-harness-plugins#vision-bridge
description: Let text-only models see images: when a picture arrives with a placeholder like \[image omitted because this model accepts text only], the model calls the vision_describe tool and the plugin forwards the image reference plus the question to a multimodal model, retrying with a fallback model on failure. Configured in the settings page and persisted via the official settings API.

title: YOUNG-FELIX/dsh-vision
description: Ask a vision-capable model about a local image from any session, including sessions whose own model is text-only. On the default path the plugin calls the host's route in-process with ctx.llm.stream(), so the host's credentials stay inside its provider adapters; only the optional direct/custom OpenAI-compatible routes read one key (from the plugin config or an apiKeyRef into ~/.dsh/.credentials.yaml).

title: ysiguu/dsh-novelai
description: NovelAI image generation for DSH: `nai_image` (style presets, artist strings, per-model weight rewriting, token budget warnings, results rendered inline), `nai_status`, and `nai_prompt` (build / check / guide), plus a studio page with live draft previews, a standalone studio server, and a prompt guide distilled from four tutorials. Bring your own `pst-` token.

title: ysr666/dsh-vision-router
description: Free vision for text-only agents: built-in keyless vision chain plus pixel tools (Q&A, grounding, crop, pixel diff, colors, OCR, SVG trace, cutout, screenshots); paste an image to use it.

title: yupaoa/dsh-image-lite
description: Image generation for DSH in two modes — an image_generate_lite tool the model calls from chat, and a right-sidebar studio for manual runs; up to five reference images, the OpenAI images API format, keys kept in the DSH credential service.

title: yxqfg/phone-lens#phone-lens
description: Turn your phone into a full-featured camera for dsh sessions (requires the open-source Android companion app — install the plugin and scan the QR code it shows to download the APK): 1. Live viewfinder over LAN or USB, injectable into the chat or savable to a folder. 2. Callable tools let the dsh model take photos, zoom, and switch lenses on demand mid-conversation, so in fully automated workflows the model can actively "see" the physical world. 3. Full zoom/flash, crop, and annotation. 4. Rich settings.

title: yzhclcl/dsh-omni-modal
description: Adds an Omni-modal settings section to DeepSeek Harness that points the harness at any OpenAI-compatible image and video endpoint: switchable config profiles with separate endpoint, API key, model, path and size for each side, free-form extra request parameters, a connectivity test that does not spend generation quota, and three model-visible tools — generate_image, generate_video and check_video — with async video tasks that survive restarts.

title: zhiwuli0228/dsh-image-router
description: Digests the images in a prompt with a vision model before admission, so any model — a text-only one included — can read them without the session ever switching models, and adds a describe_image tool for image paths.

title: zirscard/dsh-ocr
description: Registers two tools for DeepSeek Harness. `doc_ocr` turns scanned PDFs and images into structured text (per-page text, financial tables with a balance-sheet tie-out check, contract-clause hits) through a local RapidOCR engine or a Zhipu GLM-OCR cloud engine, and `doc_preprocess` turns a directory of raw files into an Obsidian-ready knowledge base through a seven-stage pipeline with backend routing and sha256-based incremental skipping. Numbers that fail the tie-out are reported, not invented. The local engine needs Python 3 with rapidocr-onnxruntime, pypdfium2 and Pillow (pip install -r requirements.txt); the GLM engine needs ZHIPU_API_KEY.

title: zlmddygggzh-collab/dsh-tool-camera
description: Grabs a live frame from the local webcam and hands it to the agent as an image, so the model can actually look through the camera without opening any app or keeping a window in front. A dim room no longer comes back black — brightness, gamma, contrast, sharpen and an auto-level pass run inside the capture itself. ffmpeg is fetched automatically on first use, and the same plugin lists the available capture devices.

title: zmengle/dsh-plugin-ark-image-gen
description: Image generation through the Volcano Ark / Doubao Seedream API: ark_generate_image for text-to-image, image-to-image and fixed-seed batches, ark_image_gen_status for checking the key, model and output directory. Requires a Volcano Ark API key (ARK_API_KEY).

title: zmm863-commits/dsh-agnes-studio
description: AI image and video studio as a floating DSH panel, so creation runs alongside the conversation instead of replacing it: text-to-image, image-to-image and multi-image composition at 1K-4K across eight aspect ratios; text-to-video and image-to-video with first-frame control at 4-12 seconds; short-drama mode that imports a script (.txt/.md/.json), breaks it into storyboard shots for preview and batch generation; and a prompt-expert workspace. Zero runtime dependencies.

title: zxygithub/dsh-agnes-create
description: Sidebar panel for Agnes image and video generation. Images: plain text-to-image, or image-to-image and multi-image composition from up to eight reference images chosen from local files or from results already in the panel, at 1K-4K across eight aspect ratios, with six one-click style presets. Video: agnes-video-2.5-flash at 720p, 4-12 seconds, in three modes that the panel picks for you - plain text, keyframe (first frame, last frame, or both) and reference (up to five images) - plus an optional seed; the task is submitted to the host process, so switching panels, reloading the page and restarting the app all resume it instead of losing the job. The prompt is written into each generated PNG or JPEG and shown again when you hover the result, where one click copies it. Browse the output directory (images and videos on separate tabs) with automatic refresh, copy a path, reveal a file in Finder, or download it; the last 24 generations persist across restarts. Images and videos can also be produced from the chat itself through the agnes_image, agnes_video and agnes_video_status tools. Both the image and the video model can be switched from the panel, with a connection test, and local reference or keyframe images are sent as base64 data URIs so no public image host is needed. Needs an Agnes AI API key saved in a local file (default ~/.agnes-key.txt).

title: zyf2492313716-cloud/dsh-auto-image-optimizer
description: Client-side image downscaler for DeepSeek Harness: intercepts paste and drag-drop images over 1999px in memory via HTML Canvas and raises legacy attachment maxImageDimension up to 4096 when writable.

title: zzsszz1122/dsh-agnes-media
description: Sidebar panel for Agnes image and video generation that also ships a node canvas and a short-drama mode. Canvas nodes are chained by extracting the previous shot's tail frame with ffmpeg and submitting it as the next shot's first frame; short-drama mode turns an imported script into storyboard shots. Generation and polling run in the Host process, so tasks survive a page reload or a closed panel, and results plus an 80-entry history are stored on disk.

title: 0nt-one/dsh-voice-input
description: Mic button in the composer tool row: Web Speech API speech-to-text (Chrome/Edge), language switching, and optional auto-send, zero dependencies.

title: 117BS/dsh-perlica-ding
description: Perlica (Arknights: Endfield) themed tiered sound notifications: plan-ready, task-done, needs-your-input, and error tones; silent for plain chat, system-level playback (works in background), cross-platform (Windows/macOS/Linux), custom TTS sounds.

title: 1497105876/dsh-mimotts
description: MiMo TTS speech synthesis for DeepSeek Harness: a speak button on finalized assistant messages with an inline player (draggable progress bar), a plugin-page configuration card with preview playback, and a voice-history settings page.

title: 15060899827/dsh-audio-player
description: Inline audio player for generated clips and songs: the play_audio tool renders a player in the conversation (promoted into the transcript when the host supports it, otherwise inside the tool-call fold). Serves only allow-listed directories, supports Range seeking and HEAD, 512 MB cap per file.

title: 1624318455/dsh-plugin-tts
description: Reads assistant replies aloud via free Edge TTS or your own RVC voice models: read-aloud buttons + auto-read, adaptive chunked progressive playback (gapless long reads), one-click voice-pack installs from a registry, and a portable RVC runtime.

title: 1DAdidi/dsh-voice-horn
description: Floating TTS speaker in each conversation corner: when an AI reply finishes, edge-tts reads the summary aloud in the background with no popup windows; the toggle is remembered per conversation. Requires Windows, Python 3.9+ with the edge-tts package installed, and network access to Microsoft's Edge TTS service; summary is the default mode.

title: 2021Heei/dsh-tts-flash
description: Reads AI replies aloud as they stream, with voiced waiting phrases while the model thinks. Edge TTS built in, any OpenAI-compatible cloud engine supported.

title: 27Synthesis/dsh-go-local-voice
description: Text-to-speech for the dsh-go native phone UI: long-press an assistant reply to read it aloud through Xiaomi MiMo TTS or ByteDance Doubao Seed TTS. The reply is segmented and pre-synthesized in the background after each turn, so one tap hands the app a single continuous MP3 instead of one short chunk per tap; playback has a stable lease so stop works, a status strip and progress bar give live feedback, and audio can be exported to phone storage. Keys stay on the device (0600) and are never rendered, committed, or sent to the model.

title: 3274375092/dsh-voice
description: Voice input for DeepSeek Harness: speak into the microphone and the recognized text is submitted as a normal chat message, via local or browser speech recognition.

title: 474885697-alt/dsh-kit#dsh-audio-post
description: Runs loudness normalization, silence trimming, format conversion and batch processing through local ffmpeg, with presets for game sound effects, music uploads and voice cleanup.

title: aa2246740/dsh-livevoice
description: Realtime WebRTC voice using Codex OAuth, with task delegation to a DSH session.

title: abbccdd/dsh-localtts
description: Reads Harness replies aloud through an existing local TTS runtime: built-in IndexTTS and GPT-SoVITS launchers, a protocol-based local HTTP/JSONL entry, and model-folder loading for Kokoro, F5-TTS, VoxCPM, Qwen3-TTS and CosyVoice SDK environments. Ships no models. Derived from 1624318455/dsh-plugin-tts; it isolates its row id and settings, so both can be installed side by side with duplicate features deactivated.

title: AI-Galaxy-GPU/dsh-sound
description: Per-event sound notifications: turn completion, approval, question, plan-review, goal-blocked, and task-failure each get their own sound and volume, configurable in the Web UI (built-in synth, mute, or local audio file).

title: AIcivilization/dsh-audiobook
description: Search public-domain libraries (Project Gutenberg, Wikisource, Internet Archive, Standard Ebooks) by title, author, character or half-remembered plot, or import EPUB / PDF / TXT / DOCX / Markdown, and listen in the sidebar with Microsoft Edge neural voices, offline Kokoro or the device voices; keeps your position, takes voice notes anchored to what you just heard, and discusses the book with your DSH model.

title: Alan2Z/dsh-speak
description: Zero-dependency, event-driven voice announcement plugin: no extra model, no token cost. Speaks with the system's built-in natural voice, supporting both Windows and macOS; final-reply announcements, approval & question alerts, optional event announcements (turn end, command done, goal change, tool errors, todo updates), replayable final replies, and a bilingual visual settings page.

title: Aliboder/dsh-music-panel
description: Local + online music player for DeepSeek Harness: multi-root library, NetEase / QQ Music / KuGou / Navidrome, synced playlists and lyrics, audio cache, EBU R128 leveling, 10-band EQ with AutoEQ headphone curves, smart crossfade, in-list search, and tag / cover editing. Online sources keep login cookies and tokens in ~/.dsh/music/providers.json (mode 0600); ticking Save password for Navidrome writes that password there in plain text.

title: ALittleLov/dsh-soundcheck
description: Turns a local audio file into a short plain-language verdict on tempo, key, dynamics, clipping and arrangement shape, and keeps the raw measurements in a separate block; audio never leaves the machine.

title: AndyYang12345/dsh-dictation-hotkey

title: anweat/dsh-voice-webspeech
description: Browser Web Speech API voice input: zero server, zero keys, zero model downloads (Edge=Azure, Chrome=Google speech).

title: baisama-cloud/dsh-stt-input

title: bbfang2025-cyber/dsh-pet-voice-fishy

Whisper bubbles are read aloud automatically, left-clicking a bubble reads it, right-click/long-press reads it again, and clicking the pet replies with lines like 「主人，小鱼在这呢」. Default voice is a local offline replica of 鱼鱼酱; 鱼鱼姐 (experimental) is also included — no API key needed, voice packs download on demand (~58MB, China-accessible mirrors). Auto-reading can be throttled (unlimited / 30s / 60s / 3min); within one DSH instance only one page plays audio. About 35KB package, inference in a worker thread, no dsh-pet files modified.

title: beiyege-01/dsh-voice-ai-girlfriend-plugin
description: Voice AI girlfriend for the Web UI: FunASR mic input, Qwen3-TTS spoken replies, companion animation window, and two-way QQ chat (text/voice/image push) via NapCat.

title: berserk0501/dsh-soundscape
description: Dual-MediaPlayer daemon ($think loop + $fx one-shots) with volume ducking, mood-aware sounds (smooth/struggle/deep_think triggered by consecutive success/failure streaks and prolonged agent runtime), 15 built-in PCM WAV synthesised from sine/square waveforms, per-tool sound mapping with 51 categorised tools, custom WAV/MP3 drop-in with auto-conversion, and a full settings UI with dark-mode fix.

title: biliye/dsh-voice-call
