title: CAOGGL/dsh-ding
description: Notifies you when a conversation finishes: plays a sound and shows a Windows notification when the agent goes idle (configurable sound file, volume, debounce/throttle).

title: cccc12138/dsh-read-aloud
description: Adds a speaker button immediately right of the Like button on every finalized assistant reply; click it to hear the reply through the browser speech engine, and hover it for a speed and voice panel. Text is sent to an unofficial Edge TTS endpoint.

title: cestbonn/dsh-bilibili-radio
description: Sidebar radio that plays Bilibili audio with search, playlists, scrolling lyrics (looked up on music.163.com, kugeci.com and lrclib.net), and chat-driven song picks. Runs a local audio proxy on 127.0.0.1:13210 and, when the system resolver fails, DNS lookups in the whole DSH host process fall back to public DoH servers (1.12.12.12, 223.5.5.5).

title: chaoge762/dsh-ears-prosody
description: Local offline prosody analysis for DeepSeek Harness: reports how something was said — speed, pitch, pauses, energy — alongside the transcript.

title: chaowei08/dsh-big-fish-speak
description: Makes the dsh-pet desktop pet read model replies aloud in its own configured voice. Newer dsh-pet gets the whole text in one request (up to its 500-char cap); older versions automatically fall back to 60-char chunks. Each piece is verified against the pet log to confirm it actually played.

title: chaowei08/dsh-live-speak
description: Reads assistant replies aloud while they stream: sentence-by-sentence speech with highlighted lines in a sidebar player, pause, mute and stop controls, and automatic quieting for code blocks. The speech engine is switchable: Edge TTS online by default, or the operating system local voices. Its HTTP routes do not verify the caller, so any program that can reach the local DSH port can call them.

title: Chrono-rigger/dsh-voice-enhance
description: Hold Alt (default; rebindable in the plugin page) to dictate and insert a cleaned-up transcript, plus a sparkle button that rewrites the composer draft into a clearer prompt. Dictation requires the Harness Voice Input plugin with its SenseVoice model enabled.

title: cilis/dsh-whale-tts
description: Provider-agnostic text-to-speech for DeepSeek Harness: synthesize speech to local audio files, manage preset, cloned and designed voices, configure providers in a bilingual settings card, and read assistant replies aloud with optional auto-read.

title: cloudoyx/any-audio
description: DSH has its own audio workstation too: real recordings, multiple TTS engines and genuine sound effects, with every generated sound landing as its own clip on one visible timeline that you can audition, balance and fine-tune track by track. Use it for scoring animation, producing audiobooks and radio drama, composing and mixing on your own, making ASMR, and whatever else you come up with. Its HTTP routes have no DSH access check, so a web page open in your browser could call them.

title: crease123/voice-call
description: Talk to your current DSH Agent without switching presets: automatic speech transcription and sending, streamed spoken replies, voice interruption, and a five-bar microphone meter. Choose DeepSeek or Doubao independently for ASR and TTS, configure your own credentials, and edit instructions applied only during calls. Includes an illustrated setup guide.

title: dingchenhui0618-arch/dsh-voice-memo
description: Dictation that ends up in the repository instead of the chat log: hold the button (or import a WAV), and the plugin archives voice-memos/<id>/ with audio.wav, a rendered waveform.png, memo.md (frontmatter, per-segment timestamps, ready-to-paste quote blocks) and meta.json. Audio is resampled to 16 kHz mono in the browser before it is sent. Transcription stays local — the harness speechToText service with silence-split windows, or a command worker such as faster-whisper — and when no engine is available the memo is still filed with an explicit status and reason rather than a fabricated transcript. Ships a conversation-view 口述 tab with click-to-seek playback and per-segment quote copy, three agent tools (voice_memo_save / voice_memo_list / voice_memo_read) and HTTP routes. Zero runtime dependencies, 52 node:test cases, real screenshots in docs/.

title: do-nothing/media-suite#media-qwen
description: Qwen media tools: multimodal video and audio understanding, text-to-speech with preset voices, and scene audio generation, through Alibaba Cloud DashScope.

title: duoduoqian708/dsh-voice-talk
description: Voice conversation mode for the DSH Web GUI: tap the mic to start a full-screen call, talk hands-free, and hear each reply read aloud as it streams. Bilingual (Chinese/English) UI, light and dark themes, adjustable speech rate, and switchable voices.

title: fangqian616/dsh-say
description: Speaks your agent's reports in a voice you choose, compressing long reports before speaking. Character voices need no training - a 3-10 second reference clip clones one, and community-trained models work too - and no 6.4 GB GPT-SoVITS install: the plugin installs its own runtime and voice. An existing GPT-SoVITS can be used instead, and it is the same voice model.

title: Feahter/dsh-plugins#realtime-voice
description: Continuous dictation for the composer using a local SenseVoice ONNX model on CPU: recognised text appears while you speak, a pause ends the sentence and writes it into the input box, and audio never leaves the machine.

title: february2015/dsh-dingo
description: Sound reminders with one-click jump for concurrent sessions: the current session gets crisp dang/dang-dang tones, other sessions a soft ding/ding-ding plus a top-right card that jumps straight to the replying conversation.

title: fenglin-ai/dsh-funasr-voice
description: Offline voice input for the DSH Web UI: mic to local FunASR (SenseVoiceSmall), one-click install, no cloud.

title: fishcg/dsh-airpod-control
description: Requires macOS and AirPods with head tracking. Answer DSH permission prompts and questions with AirPods head gestures — nod to allow or confirm, shake to reject or shift the selected option — and install the companion macOS menu-bar app from a card inside the session.

title: Fishsb/dsh-voice-prompt-enhancer
description: Rewrites a composer draft into a clearer, structured prompt (5 modes, model fallback chain, optional multi-round memory) and adds stop-on-silence, hotkey and filler-word cleanup to DSH voice input; transcription stays with the official speechToText, the plugin ships no engine.

title: flashyiyi/dsh-voice-announcer
description: Voice announcements when a conversation ends (session title, round, outcome) plus live sentence-by-sentence reading of replies, via built-in edge-tts with zero third-party dependencies.

title: flyinghouse-ma/dsha-tts-bridge
description: Host-side TTS bridge for dsh that synthesizes speech over the Edge TTS protocol and serves MP3 on a same-origin route, for containers with no audio device.

title: FuzzySoul/dsh-chatvoice
description: Free voice closed loop for the Web UI: browser SpeechRecognition mic input with live interim results plus read-aloud speaker buttons and auto-read for assistant replies, zero configuration and no API key.

title: FYZB2020/dsh-voice-doubao
description: Adds two Volcengine Doubao cloud speech recognizers to the DeepSeek Harness voice-input picker, optionally rewriting the transcript with an LLM.

title: glowwan/dsh-bluetooth-earbuds
description: Windows-wide Bluetooth earbud shortcuts for AI work: a left-earbud volume-down gesture starts or stops Windows voice typing (Win+H), and a right-earbud volume-up gesture sends Backspace. The DSH settings page offers manual key mapping, test actions, Backspace count, volume-gesture detection, and a 1.6-second cooldown so one triple-tap performs one action. The helper is compiled locally from included C# source. The plugin itself does not record or upload audio; Windows voice typing processes speech under its own privacy settings.

title: GooDAnDReaDY/dsh-tts
description: Speaks agent replies in the DeepSeek Harness web UI through a provider fallback chain (OpenAI, ElevenLabs, Google, Azure, Groq, Deepgram, OpenRouter, Edge, Piper, eSpeak), so a failing or rate-limited provider falls through to the next instead of going silent.

title: GooDAnDReaDY/dsh-voice
description: Voice input for the web UI: dictation chunked by pauses and voice messages, each with its own provider fallback chain (Deepgram, Groq, HuggingFace, local whisper.cpp, or an OpenAI-compatible endpoint).

title: hangdingding/breezetts-dsh
description: Breeze TTS for DeepSeek Harness: read replies aloud in full or as a short summary, one-click Breeze CLI login with automatic key import, voice search and design, smart companionship, and lunch/dinner reminders.

title: hangyesite/dsh-shortvideo-export
description: Download watermark-free Douyin and Xiaohongshu videos, transcribe them with local or cloud speech recognition, proofread the text against a term list, and export Markdown, DOCX, SRT, VTT and other formats from a settings panel or agent tools. Needs Python 3.10+ with pip packages (playwright, python-docx, numpy, and sherpa-onnx for the default local SenseVoice engine, which also downloads a ~228 MB model on first use), ffmpeg on PATH, and Chrome or Edge.

title: Hao0311/dsh-mimo-tts
description: Text-to-speech for DeepSeek Harness through Xiaomi MiMo TTS, needs a XIAOMI_API_KEY: a mimo_tts tool that writes audio to a local file, a read-aloud action on each finalized answer, auto-read, and a sidebar panel for built-in voices, voice design by description, or voice cloning from an mp3/wav sample. Same package name as lengmodkx/dsh-mimo-tts, so the two cannot be installed together.

title: haoku123/dsh-voice
description: Full-duplex voice mode for the Web UI: tap-to-toggle or hold-to-talk dictation (send key or `Ctrl`) with a live caption, host-side SenseVoice ASR via sherpa-onnx, sentence-by-sentence spoken replies, and speaking interrupts playback and the running turn (true barge-in). No API key.

title: honwee/dsh-plugin-mynah
description: Give the agent a talking face: seven tools that drive a self-hosted Mynah realtime digital human — speak (queued or interrupting), play a gesture clip, interrupt, list live sessions and channels, check health, add text to its knowledge base.

title: howie79794-sys/dsh-voice-polish
description: Composer mic button that transcribes speech locally with SenseVoice, then tidies the spoken transcript into clean text with your configured DeepSeek route before inserting it into the draft.

title: huguangyu666/dsh-plugin-notify
description: Notification outbox: agent proactively notifies via toast / Chinese TTS voice / sound effects (explosion, victory, alarm), 60s confirmation window voice-calls you back, volume boost, settings panel.

title: huliux/dsh-asr-plugin
description: Local meeting transcription for DeepSeek Harness on Apple Silicon macOS: dual-track recording, live transcript drafts with speaker labels, and @-referenced summaries into decisions and action items.

title: ictrektech/V-yovoice#tool-audio-transcription
description: Transcribe session audio through V-yovoice and display a waveform player and transcript. Needs a reachable V-yovoice service (its root URL is set in the plugin's configuration); audio files are sent to that service.

title: jerryqx/dsh-ximalaya
description: Listen to Ximalaya podcasts and audiobooks inside the DSH web UI: search albums, browse paginated tracks, and play through a now-playing bar (prev/play/next, seek, volume, rate). After QR login the "Mine" page lists your liked tracks (click to play), subscribed albums with latest-episode hints, and followed anchors with their public albums; the host relays audio streams with Range support and registers an `ximalaya_play` tool so the agent can search and play on request.

title: Jesse-njx/dsh-voice
description: Voice notes in, spoken answers out: dictate audio that becomes user messages (transcribe), have the agent read replies aloud (speak), local-first under ~/.dsh/voice.

title: joeseesun/qiaomu-audio-dsh
description: Read Markdown aloud, dictate and transcribe audio, and export narrated media from Harness.

title: Jstn-1g/dsh-live-voice
description: Consent-bound one-turn voice preview for DSH Web with a credential-free local synthetic demo, optional Qwen Audio, exact Session isolation, and explicit transcript-to-draft handoff without automatic submission.

title: junarch/voice_for_dsh#voice-for-dsh
description: Let DSH speak: every reply is rewritten into natural spoken language before being read aloud, with code, tables, and Markdown handled gracefully. Works out of the box with system TTS; Doubao (third-party API) adds dialects and expressive voices; the local Kokoro engine runs offline to keep content on your device. Supports both DSH desktop and dsh web. Optional session sounds tell you when the agent is working, finished, or waiting for your answer — with swappable built-in tones and support for your own audio.

title: jypjypjypjyp/dsh-music-studio
description: Music composition inside the conversation: the model writes a score against a bundled composing skill, and a play_score tool renders it as an inline card with a piano roll, Web Audio playback and WAV/JSON export.

title: KeinsteinNUS/dsh-speech-polish
description: Adds a terminology-aware correction pass to the built-in local speech-to-text: keeps DSH's own microphone and SenseVoice engine (audio never leaves the machine) and fixes homophones, domain terms and malformed numbers in the finished transcript.

title: kekydream/dsh-meeting-room
description: Meeting notes for dsh: one meeting per conversation, transcribed and speaker-separated on the machine itself, with points, assignments, handwritten notes, reviews and monthly scores in the same panel. Exports SRT/Markdown/Word and packs a meeting into a portable zip another dsh can import; confirmed assignments go to DingTalk/WeCom in one click, following your robot settings. Recognition models are swappable (a stronger local model can be imported from a file), and cloud recognition is off by default with no request made before consent. Word export needs Python and python-docx; the first run downloads a recognition model (28 or 77 MB).

title: KevinZhangNothing/dsh-nico
description: Hold right-Cmd and talk — local SenseVoice STT, a fixed DSH session with voice-triggered rotation, and streaming CosyVoice2 TTS with emotion voices and an optional Live2D overlay.

title: kinglhy2006/dsh-voice-bridge
description: Hands-free voice for DSH on Windows: local wake word, local Chinese speech-to-text inserted and sent into the composer, and spoken replies that can be interrupted and resumed. Requires a one-time run of the bundled install.ps1 (Python speech dependencies plus microphone pick) and a SenseVoice model already downloaded by the DSH voice input (or placed under models/sensevoice-onnx).

title: kkmingjun/dsh-kingspeak
description: Voice dictation scratchpad: realtime speech-to-text into timestamped, per-session blocks, with one-click insert into the conversation composer. Requires the official DSH voice-input bundle (@deepseek-ai/dsh-experimental-voice-input-bundle); the speech model downloads on first use.

title: Laplace-bit/dsh-pianist
description: Piano performance plugin: ask the agent to play a piece and it renders on a Canvas2D grand piano with real Salamander Grand samples, an immersive stage, and an interactive 88-key keyboard.

title: ldchaowin/dsh-plugin-notify-sound
description: Per-workspace completion ringtones plus attention sounds for approval, question, plan-review, goal-blocked, and task-failure events, with built-in synth, voice (TTS), and custom audio.

title: lengmodkx/dsh-mimo-tts
description: MiMo voice for DeepSeek Harness — reads each finished answer aloud, turns composer dictation into text, and offers nine built-in voices plus a cloned-voice slot.

title: lgquan/dsh-voco
description: Continuous voice conversations for DSH with hands-free listening, push-to-talk, speech recognition, TTS replies, and background Agent delegation.

title: LiDu-china/dsh-dafeiyu-emotion
description: Adds a fish-ear microphone to DSH that transcribes speech locally, estimates tone and emotion, and lets BigFish reply with an emotion-aware prompt.

title: lihua12345670-jpg/dsh-bili-audio
description: Plays the audio of a Bilibili video from a floating bar in the DSH Web UI, with a queue, seek and speed controls, and a host-side reverse proxy for the CDN Referer check.

title: litterbit/dsh-plugin-moss-tts
description: Reads Harness replies aloud with the MOSS-TTS-Nano-100M C++ CPU engine: fully offline with no API key, one-click engine download verified against the release sha256sums.txt, auto-read of settled replies plus a read button on every reply, and playback that starts while synthesis continues. The weights are installed once and shared with the companion CLI and web playground. Windows x64 only, because the engine ships for that platform only.

title: LIU118117/dsh-voice
description: Adds a voice to the agent: emotional speech synthesis (ChatTTS when available, falling back to edge-tts) and a singing mode, with mp3 output and local playback over ffplay. Requires Python 3.10+ with edge-tts installed (ChatTTS and its model cache are optional), ffmpeg/ffplay, and the pythonPath/ffmpegPath/ffplayPath values in cordis.patch.yml pointed at your own installs.

title: ljz970803/dsh-voice-wake
description: Local wake-word voice input for DSH. Say the wake word, wait for the chime, then speak; text is sent to a DSH session. Audio is processed locally by default and not stored. Requires the DSH speech input service (speechToText) to be available.

title: lol9706262-source/dsh-cover
description: One-line song cover: fetch a track or take a local file, split stems, derive a key shift, run RVC conversion through Applio, align the vocal, mix three variants and gate the master — nine stages across three tools, zero npm dependencies. Requires a local Applio install (Python, ffmpeg, yt-dlp), a voice model and a CUDA GPU.

title: loveandbeepbrother/dsh-tts-service
description: Text-to-speech service with Doubao TTS 2.0, Alibaba Bailian and OpenAI-compatible providers and a user-chosen voice; the agent speaks through tts_service_say, split into segments with an optional tone each, and other plugins can reuse ctx.ttsService.

title: loyalchiiina/dsh-voice-alert
description: Voice or sound cue when a turn finishes and a failure cue when a tool call or turn errors; user aborts stay silent and subagent sessions are skipped by default. Three modes: voice (Volcengine TTS with cloned or preset voices, fingerprint reuse so unchanged text is not re-synthesised), effects (20 built-in sounds assignable to done, fail and approval, with per-row preview and no API key; the approval slot has no automatic trigger, so it plays only manually) and off. Plays through winmm without touching system volume. Windows only. Adapts DSH kernel 0.2.2-rc.1.

title: lucagiftzek/dsh-voice
description: Read-aloud and dictation for the DSH web UI with 23 TTS and STT provider types configured side by side, per-language routing, in-text language markers, per-sentence language detection, word highlighting and a TTS Reader sidebar tab (the tab requires dsh-better-sidebar; everything else works without it).

title: ma1833577561/dsh-plugin-voice-autosend
description: Offline voice input for the composer: records with the microphone, transcribes locally with SenseVoice, and sends the message automatically. A derivative of the official voice-input plugin that adds auto-submit; first use downloads the SenseVoice model (about 242 MB) to ~/.dsh/speech-to-text/sensevoice, and it registers the same speech provider rows as the built-in Voice Input, so disable that one first.

title: Making-acid/dsh-synthv-studio
description: Connects a local Synthesizer V Studio 2 Pro to the agent through its own Lua script API, with five tools for discovery, a persistent bridge, voice composition, note editing and DAW (VST3/ARA + MIDI) integration. Windows 10/11 only; requires Synthesizer V Studio 2 Pro 2.1.2+ with a project open.

title: maoyuching/dsh-voice-chat
description: Doubao-style voice chat for DSH: press-and-hold mic in the composer converts speech to text and auto-sends, and AI replies are read aloud. Optional LLM condensing (long replies summarized into short spoken lines, following the current conversation model), TTS-friendly text cleaning, selectable Edge TTS voices, adjustable silence auto-stop, and settings embedded in DSH settings dialog.

title: MaRi23333/dsh-fish-tts
description: Reads assistant replies aloud via Fish Audio API only (bring your own key): per-message read-aloud, auto-read toggle, and a settings page for model, voice reference_id, encrypted API key, and proxy.

title: martindye/dsh-voice
description: Two-way voice for the DSH web app: dictate with the unified composer, hear replies with speaker buttons and auto-read, on any device. Needs DSH 0.1.7+, Node 22+, Python 3 with numpy and requests, a TTS model, and a microphone.

title: mhlywxl/dsh-coding-sound
description: Generative background music while the model streams, plus completion, approval and attention chimes: hear whether the agent is thinking, still working, or waiting for you without watching the screen.

title: most-silence/dsh-record
description: Adds a composer microphone button that records audio as MP3 (default), WAV, or WebM and attaches it to the current prompt as a conversation file attachment. The format is chosen on the plugin's own detail page under Settings > Plugins; recordings are passed to the host through the conversation draft-attachment channel and are not written to disk by the plugin.

title: naili0712/dsh-gsv-local
description: Local GPT-SoVITS voice for DeepSeek Harness: boots the engine with DSH and kills it on exit, speaks only the line marked for voice, and ships a default voice, so you only need to point runtimeDir at a local GPT-SoVITS install.

title: NewDaNew/dsh-voice-input
description: Voice input for the web UI: a mic button in the composer that transcribes speech into the draft via the Web Speech API, with an optional auto-send toggle.

title: NMDwhy66154/dsh-voice-realtime
description: Real-time speech-to-text inside the DeepSeek Harness composer: a live transcript while you speak, inserted at the caret when you stop, with a microphone picker. Local sherpa-onnx inference, so audio never leaves the machine.

title: Nothree-code/voco-input-sh
description: Voice input for the Web UI: a mic button that drives local VocoType offline speech recognition and auto-inserts recognized text into the composer (auto-deploy, dedupe, continuous dictation).

title: nsswkj/dsh-typewriter-blip
description: Turns a streaming assistant reply into short blips, one per character at a configurable minimum spacing, for the reply text only, and keeps sounding when the window is minimized, covered, or in a background tab. Two built-in voices, or a custom one shaped by waveform, or loaded from an audio file.

title: Nuoyi207/dsh-gptsovits-tts
description: Local GPT-SoVITS text-to-speech for DSH: reads replies aloud, switches voices from the right sidebar, and trains a new voice from a dropped audio sample. First run downloads an 11.4 GB engine and needs an NVIDIA CUDA GPU.

title: OMSociety/dsh-xiaoai-bridge
description: Plugin that turns a XiaoAI (Xiaomi) smart speaker into a voice assistant: hosts the local bridge process, listens for the wake word, runs speech recognition (ASR / STT) on what you say, keeps the conversation in the host session, and speaks the answer back through the speaker with text-to-speech (TTS) playback.

title: pandaman0759/dsh-tts-voice
description: End-of-turn voice summary: the model calls voice_say once before finishing a reply so the conclusion is spoken through Breeze TTS, with Chinese bracket audio tags (laughter, sighs, pauses) and optional performance instructions. Audio is synthesized host-side and played from browser memory without ever touching disk; the character limit is a writing target for the model, not a cut-off, so long lines still play in full. The API key stays in the credential store, and an optional daily Breeze check-in is included. Needs a Breeze API key and sends the spoken text to the Breeze service; its HTTP routes (including the settings route that stores the key) have no DSH access check.

title: pandaman0759/dsh-voice-input
description: Doubao streaming speech-to-text button in the DSH composer — one API key and your words land in the draft. Needs a Doubao (Volcengine) speech-recognition API key, kept in the DSH credential store; recorded audio is sent to Volcengine, and its HTTP routes have no DSH access check.

title: PandaPolo/dsh-voice-call
description: Agent-initiated voice calls: `offer_call` rings the human (接听/拒接/稍后再说); accepted calls synthesize and play locally via CrispASR + Qwen3-TTS (9 speakers, 2 Chinese dialects), rejected calls return the decision to the agent.

title: Pegasus02/dsh-siri
description: Talk to DeepSeek Harness through Siri and iPhone Shortcuts: a bearer-key POST /siri endpoint on your computer answers each spoken request for Siri to read aloud, with a settings page (key, port, workspace, model, Agent Preset, rate limit, allowed addresses), optional DS Bot routing, and a ready-made Shortcut.

title: PensiveFei/dsh-voice-scribe
description: Voice input for the DSH web UI: tap or hold Alt to dictate into the composer. Local SenseVoice ASR by default — offline, zero config, zero key; auto-fallback to browser Web Speech, optional OpenAI-compatible ASR chain, polish through DSH-configured models, settings UI.

title: PerryLink/dsh-talk
description: Voice I/O for DeepSeek Harness — speech-to-text and text-to-speech over the microphone and audio output.

title: PolinniZhong/dsh-omi-voice
description: In-chat read-aloud for DeepSeek Harness: tap to read, pause and resume AI replies with natural Doubao TTS voices (BYOK), reading only the final answer with code, tables and diagrams filtered; local engine, plugin keeps no API key.

title: ppy-web/dsh-plugin-xiaomi-mimo-tts
description: Adds Xiaomi MiMo, Doubao, Breeze and browser speech to DSH, with external provider and local model adapters, text filtering, streaming read-aloud, audio downloads, sound effects, desktop pets, QQ Bot and AI Passport integration.

title: QiNFPV/dsh-voice-dialog
description: Continuous voice conversation for DSH: auto sentence splitting, a 2-second confirm window before sending, and spoken replies you can interrupt by speaking. Speech is recognised by DSH's own speech service by default (a local Whisper bridge or an OpenAI-compatible endpoint can be set instead), the recognised text is corrected by a DSH model call, and replies are read aloud through Microsoft Edge's online text-to-speech service, so reply text is sent to Microsoft. A daily check of PyPI and Hugging Face for faster-whisper updates is on by default; settings and any API keys are stored in plain text in ~/.dsh/voice-tutor-config.json. Its /voice-tutor routes require an authenticated DSH session (admission is checked per request), API keys are never returned, and applying an update needs a one-time confirmation token.

title: qishuilalala/dsh-voice-mode#dsh-voice-mode
description: Full-duplex voice mode for the DeepSeek Harness Web UI: toggle (2s-pause auto-send) or hold-to-talk dictation into an editable draft with zipformer2 streaming ASR, optional wake word; sentence-by-sentence Edge TTS read-aloud with live captions, and speaking interrupts playback and the running turn (true barge-in). On-device ASR, no API key.

title: QT-Chen/dsh-mic-input
description: Microphone voice input for the composer: browser Web Speech API live transcription, dedupe/auto-continue, smart punctuation, language and auto-send settings.

title: radres/dsh-plugin-call-me
description: Rings your phone over CallKit: `call_me` and `text_me` tools, plus optional turn-end and approval calls whose spoken answer is transcribed back into the session.

title: red000000/dsh-bili-music-player
description: Bilibili music player for the DSH composer dock: import your Bilibili login cookie and a listening-profile JSON for profile-based recommendation with like/skip/dislike feedback and 192k playback; without a profile it falls back to genre-based online search and progressive playback.

title: regrevia/pocket-harness#pocket-harness
description: Pocket Harness: the phone side of DSH. Continue the same DSH session from your phone, with the same history, projects, goal, queue and pending questions, connected over your LAN, your own domain or a relay you run (no author-run server, no account). Needs the Android companion app (APK from the repo's releases) paired by QR code; an optional pixel-whale desktop pet can talk and listen, and neural voice and local speech recognition are optional extras. Formerly dsh-pet-voice.

title: Ren-xing/dsh-audio-tools
description: Audio tools for DSH: inspect audio/video files, transcode or extract the audio track from a video, trim and normalize, and transcribe speech with local whisper.cpp or an OpenAI-compatible API. Requires ffmpeg and ffprobe on PATH (not bundled); local transcription also needs a whisper-cli binary and a ggml model.

title: rirtue/dsh-breeze-speak
description: Reads each reply aloud through the BreezeBlue / Breeze TTS 2 API. Synthesis starts as soon as the reply first sentence is complete rather than after the whole reply, and the audio is streamed as raw PCM into Web Audio so it plays continuously while it arrives. Needs a BreezeBlue API key, entered on the settings page or via BREEZE_API_KEY; a key saved on the settings page is stored as plain text in ~/.dsh/breeze-speak.json. By default only the first sentence of each reply (up to 120 characters) is spoken, and that text is sent to api.breeze.blue. The default voice is just an example, so pick one available to your account on the settings page.

title: Root-7-KHX/ai-voice
description: A local AI voice studio for DeepSeek Harness with nine local TTS engines for voice design, voice cloning, emotional performance, a reference-audio library and audio export. It only registers /ai-voice/api routes; the UI lives in the companion-memory plugin's integrations page, and every engine needs its own Python virtualenv and downloaded model weights, which are not bundled.

title: rootryanlau-art/dsh-voice-transcribe
description: Transcribe local audio and video files offline with a composer panel, a CLI, and an agent skill, powered by SenseVoice int8.

title: SAOS-3624/dsh-watch-together
description: Watch a video together with a text-only agent: with ffmpeg and the bundled browser extension reporting your real playback position (not a timer), it hands over one segment at a time just before that segment ends. It ships no TTS engine — it emits timed speech events, and speaking them aloud needs your own voice/TTS setup.

title: scarf1985566475-cloud/dsh-voice
description: Local English-to-Chinese simultaneous interpretation: on-device Qwen3-ASR bilingual captions with automatic language detection, crash-safe meeting records with minutes, and Obsidian export.

title: Schumchanvi/dsh-voice-input-cn
description: China-ready voice input for the composer. Requires a local Python bridge (pip install dashscope websockets, run bridge/voice-bridge.py) — the plugin alone does not work. Browser mic streams 16 kHz PCM to the bridge, which runs Alibaba Cloud DashScope ASR (paraformer-realtime-v2); interim text fills the draft at the cursor, silence auto-stop, optional auto-send.

title: shimingming520/dsh-audiogen
description: AI audio generation for the DeepSeek Harness web GUI — multi-vendor TTS, music, sound effects and voice design with a sidebar panel, model comparison, resource library and Agent tools.

title: sorooy/dsh-read-aloud
description: Reads DeepSeek Harness replies aloud with MiniMax voices, with a per-message speaker button, optional auto-read and barge-in when you send a new message.

title: STARDUSTLC666/dsh-voice
description: Voice tools: free edge-tts neural speech synthesis, OpenAI-compatible ASR transcription, voice list, batch voice preview and health self-check.

title: SuCriss/dsh-voice-control
description: Voice control for the DSH web composer: push-to-talk speech-to-text into the input box (with optional auto-send), spoken playback of assistant replies via the Web Speech API, right-click settings popover, and a global Ctrl+M hotkey.

title: Sunshine334419520/dsh-minimax-voice
description: MiniMax voice studio for DeepSeek Harness: clone a voice from an audio sample, preview it from the audio returned by the clone request itself (no extra synthesis call, so the per-voice fee stays uncharged), synthesize text to local mp3 files, transcribe audio to text with asr-1.0, and manage the voice library, API key and these actions from a settings panel; four agent tools and a local HTTP API.

title: supersyh-sss/dsh-voice-assistant
description: Voice assistant for dsh web: say the wake phrase (e.g. "小鲸") to activate hands-free dictation — what you say is transcribed and typed into the chat box automatically. Supports spoken edit commands (send, clear, new line, stop reading) and reads assistant replies aloud in Chinese. Speech recognition runs locally in-browser via sherpa-onnx WASM, so it works offline without an API key.

title: tangzheng202202/dsh-voice-live
description: Real-time duplex voice over Volcengine streaming ASR/TTS: agent reply narration, barge-in, wake word, live captions, 30 Chinese voices and a reply-first acknowledgment; builds in the DSH monorepo.

title: TaoruiLiu19/dsh-gsv
description: Real-time local TTS for DeepSeek Harness: voice presets, auto-read, engine setup assistant, a read-aloud button, and a settings panel for the GSV-TTS-Lite engine.

title: 小星辰任意语音
description: Click the chibi mascot and it reads the assistant reply aloud through your local IndexTTS 2.5 install. One character = one reference clip; a missing portrait just shows a placeholder. Ships no voices or artwork — the library lives on the user's own machine. Requires a local IndexTTS 2.5 install.

title: toddpan/dsh-xiaozhi
description: Connects the Xiaozhi voice assistant to DSH Web over MCP: DSH is the tool provider, weaving 35 DSH Web endpoints into 16 voice-friendly tools for workspaces, sessions, chat, models, settings and files — outbound WebSocket to the Xiaozhi MCP access point by default (no public IP or port forwarding needed), several devices bound at once, plus a DSH settings page with live status.

title: triagmas/smart-dictation-dsh#smart-dictation-bundle
description: Local Russian dictation for the DSH composer with GigaAM v3, English technical terms, punctuation, and a personal glossary that learns only after confirmation. Audio and transcripts never leave the machine.

title: underworld-oddball/dsh-volume-knob
description: Speaker button left of the model selector in the composer tool row — one click scrolls to the start of your newest question, marks it with a blinking caret and reads from there through the newest agent reply (dsh-tts, browser voice as fallback); press-and-hold the icon and then click anywhere on the page to pick another reading start position; press-and-drag-up opens a vertical mixer for in-page media volume and system output volume.

title: Vansnc/dsh-feiyu-say
description: Synthesises speech through Alibaba Bailian's WebSocket TTS and returns a WAV file plus a preview URL, with an optional per-turn hint that nudges the model towards voice. Needs a Bailian API key and ffmpeg, and the text is sent to Alibaba Cloud; the plugin does not send messages itself — delivery is left to the session's own transport.

title: wangzhanchao883/dsh-hold-to-talk
description: One-handed, keyboard-free input for the composer: press and hold the mouse on the input box, speak, release — the text lands in the draft, and sliding up cancels without leaving a half sentence behind. No mic button to aim at and no shortcut to remember; the hand never has to leave the input area, which is the point when the other hand is busy. Recognition runs fully offline (SenseVoice via sherpa-onnx, no API key, audio never leaves the machine).

title: Watchcats211/dsh-podwave
description: Local-first podcast player and transcriber for DeepSeek Harness: plays audio files from your disk, transcribes with local ASR, shows bilingual subtitles and exports SRT or Markdown.

title: WayneYu430/dsh-voice-agent#voice-app
description: A conversational voice frontend Agent for dsh: speak naturally over ByteDance Duplex, delegate requests to background tasks, and hear their asynchronous results reported by voice.

title: WizisCool/dsh-ears
description: Voice input plugin for DeepSeek Harness (dsh): a microphone button in the composer turns speech into a draft transcript, with a choice of speech-recognition backends, optional polish through dsh own LLM routes, and a native settings page.

title: wuyou0423/dsh-space-ptt
description: Hold Space to record and release to transcribe and send, without focusing the composer first. Esc cancels and window blur auto-cancels. Requires the official voice-input bundle (`@deepseek-ai/dsh-experimental-voice-input-bundle`) enabled with its speech model downloaded; otherwise Space is left alone.

title: wwweljf/dsh-plugins#dsh-ding-sound
description: Turn-end notification sound for DSH: built-in internet meme voices (ni gan ma ai yo, ji ni tai mei, shen ying ge, etc.), Settings panel with preview/switch/random, custom audio folder support.

title: WYR-233/dsh-multi-tts
description: Per-reply read-aloud with a multi-provider settings page — MiniMax or any OpenAI-compatible /audio/speech endpoint, with voice, emotion, speed and model selection plus an auto-read toggle.

title: wzd-cpu/dsh-breeze-tts
description: BreezeBlue text-to-speech for DSH: three agent tools, a header toggle that reads assistant replies aloud (markdown and code blocks stripped), and local HTTP endpoints for audio playback, synthesis and long-poll delivery. Requires a BreezeBlue API key (BREEZE_API_KEY); synthesis is billed per character.

title: XanthanL/dsh-plugin-uisfx
description: Semantic UI sound effects powered by uisfx: task start/success/failure and per-button cues, settings UI with instant preview, 12 sound packs, Host-persisted preferences, and `ctx.uisfx` service for other plugins.

title: xcw520/dsh-dania-voice
description: Local GPT-SoVITS text-to-speech that reads DeepSeek Harness assistant replies aloud, with a draggable mascot toggle and a one-click installer. Requires Python 3.10–3.12 preinstalled (the installer only locates it, it does not install Python); about 5 GB of disk and a GPU are recommended.

title: yu-wenchao/dsh-tool-lipsync
description: Free lip-sync video generation plugin for DSH with 3000+ voices and 500+ languages.

title: YuMS/dsh-duet
description: Full-duplex Chinese voice interaction for DSH Web: dictate and edit tasks, submit requests, manage sessions, answer DSH questions, and hear concise task-completion announcements.

title: Yuuyuko-uu/dsh-tts-bridge
description: Reads DSH conversations aloud using the DeepSeek web page's built-in read-aloud, driven by a small browser extension.

title: dsh-watch-video
description: Subtitle-first video transcription with SRT export, cancellable job controls, and a faster-whisper large-v3 fallback when subtitles are unavailable.

title: Zhangbo-cn/dsh-voice-input-plugin
description: Composer mic for the Web UI: tap-to-monitor live transcription and hold-to-talk, with host Edge TTS reply reading that streams while the model generates, echo-pause during reading, and tap-to-stop.

title: ziyouti/dsh-read-aloud
description: Reads assistant replies aloud with Microsoft Edge neural voices and highlights the sentence being spoken, so you can follow along while listening. The highlight is yours to style: background colour, text colour and opacity are each adjustable in settings. Also adds a sound-wave play button to every reply, pause plus previous and next sentence, adjustable speed, and an auto-read toggle.

title: zsenpro/creating#plugin
description: GPT-SoVITS voice output for DSH: a speak tool and /voice command, a read-aloud speaker button under each reply, and a settings tab to switch voices, tune synthesis, manage the local service and one-click install a voice pack. The write and edit tools require a human_facing flag; the plugin reviews the text against layered PROSE.md rules in the background, stages annotations, reconciles them against the full file, and merges them through /humanize, /humanize-loop or post-compaction while the main session keeps working. /humanize-review runs a batch over git-tracked files on demand.

title: ltmroberthk915/markpilot#dsh-markdown-editor-typora
description: MarkPilot — an IDE-style Markdown × AI workspace inside DSH. Files, editor and chat sit side by side with draggable panes; send a selection's Markdown source and its file path into the chat with one click or Ctrl/Cmd+Shift+Enter, or reference the open note with @mp. Resume the last note per project, start a blank draft that saves into its own folder, and keep your place as conversations change. Typora-style live rendering with click-to-source formulas, cell-level tables, offline Mermaid and KaTeX, ten themes and transparency; a 150k-character document is parsed in a worker so typing stays smooth. Saves are version-guarded and atomic — conflicts raise a banner instead of overwriting; external disk edits are adopted within 1–2 s, drafts are recoverable, and file:// links or absolute .md path chips open in the workspace. 2.0 adds durable document state, missing/renamed/read-only lifecycle banners, a recovery center and Save As. Fully offline assets, MIT, 544 automated tests.

title: Lucky020/dsh-copyright-kit
description: Turns a repository and a software name into Chinese software copyright registration material - the 60-page source code excerpt (50 lines per page, auto-paginated), the software manual with screenshots, and the derived application-form fields (line count, language, completion date, function summary). Requires Python 3 with python-docx, and Google Chrome for screenshots.

title: Lucky020/dsh-delivery-kit
description: Turns a repository and a running system into acceptance material - database design, design specs, a user manual with screenshots, and test / go-live / acceptance reports. Sections follow GB/T 8567-88; anything it cannot verify is left blank instead of invented. Requires Python 3 with python-docx for .docx output, and Google Chrome for automatic screenshots.

title: LuoShanHui/dsh-doc-ledger
description: Per-session document ledger in the DSH sidebar (Windows only, Chinese-language UI): which documents a session read, created or modified, with time ordering, type grouping, search, two preview modes and a cross-session view.

title: lvxianchao/dsh-video-preview
description: Streaming video preview in the DSH sidebar — mp4, webm and mov play in place over an authenticated byte-range route, with 206 responses, instant seeking, no size cap and no build step.

title: maple-pwn/paperlab
description: Overleaf-style LaTeX paper workbench: annotate any text in the rendered PDF and let a dsh agent revise the sources with compile checks and git history.

title: measureer/dsh-overleaf-sync
description: Two-way sync between a local LaTeX folder and an Overleaf project over the Overleaf Socket.IO + OT channel instead of a Git bridge: pull with automatic git init, dry-run-first push, three-way diff, background watch, and conflict copies that never overwrite.

title: miaojinQWQ/dsh-docmate
description: Immersive reading desk: md / docx / pdf render in the centre pane, and the right column is one ordinary Harness session per document that has already been fed the whole text, the research memory and the existing highlights. Select a sentence to ask about it; scanned PDFs and images have no text layer, so a marquee drag captures that region and sends it to a vision model under a turn-scoped runtime brake (max 2 steps, per-step output cap, every tool call denied before dispatch, 45 s cancel). Highlights are anchored as character offsets and painted with the CSS Custom Highlight API, so they survive reloads. Also KaTeX math, outline, in-document search and a draggable three-column layout. Zero runtime dependencies: pdf.js and KaTeX are vendored.

title: minhaoli/dsh-zotero-reader
description: Read Zotero PDFs inside the DSH right sidebar and let the model work on them directly. Requires Zotero 10 or newer with the local API enabled (Zotero 7/8 is read-only and cannot accept annotations). The model gets three tools: search_zotero_library to search your library, read_zotero_paper to read a paper by page or by query, and ask_zotero_paper for page-cited answers. Annotation handling mirrors Zotero's own reader: click an annotation to open a card with page number, quoted text, a comment box and tags; the three-dot menu recolors or deletes it; multi-line selections get a single surrounding box rather than one box per line. Comments, tags, colors and deletions are written back through the Zotero local API, so they show up in Zotero and annotations made in Zotero show up here. Selection actions cover translate, explain, ask and highlight; the reader remembers the exact reading position (page plus offset) and zoom level per paper, and keeps opened PDFs mounted so switching tabs does not reload them. MinerU re-parsing is available for scanned or broken-text PDFs and is off by default.

title: morefreeze/dsh-plugin-rss-pal
description: Local-first RSS/Atom reader with full-text search, bulk read marking, on-demand AI summaries and native reading companion. Uses the native better-sqlite3 module, so approve its native build when the installer asks.

title: MrmoLabs/dsh-mermaid
description: Render Mermaid code fences as SVG diagrams with streaming support, diagram/code switching, fullscreen zoom and pan, SVG export, and a bundled same-origin runtime.

title: Nancy0-0/dsh-code-nav#symbol-links
description: Makes identifiers inside inline code in chat clickable; resolves a definition, then a wrapper, then the next occurrence, and opens the file at that line in the sidebar preview.

title: OtakuP417/dsh-reading-companion
description: An AI reading buddy: it sits next to you while you read, and only knows the pages you have already reached — so it cannot spoil the rest, and it never summarizes the whole book for you. Highlight a sentence and ask about it, or just ask about what you finished; it usually restates what you seem to mean and asks one concrete question back. What you work out can be saved as a takeaway and later becomes a review card that jumps back to the sentence. EPUB, MOBI, FB2, TXT, Markdown, HTML, CBZ.

title: p8054076283-del/dsh-ppt-studio
description: Left-sidebar PPT workbench: imports an existing PPTX element by element (theme colours, gradients with alpha, rounded shapes, master/layout decorations, chart pages rasterized) and renders it as real 16:9 slides, lets you edit text and tables directly on the page, and hosts an AI chat column that rewrites the same deck.json.

title: passenfall/dsh-deliver-studio
description: HTML deliverable workbench in the file preview: viewport presets (desktop, laptop, tablet, mobile, A4), click-to-annotate elements with a notes/QA panel that docks to any edge or floats and sends the notes to the agent as one message, delivery QA grouped by category (figure/table numbering, orphans, clipping, overflow, page whitespace, WCAG contrast, images, dead anchors, banned words), PDF export through a local Chromium-based browser, and export of a self-contained annotated HTML that reviewers open in a browser to reply; also provides the `deliver_qa` and `deliver_export_pdf` tools and a `/deliver` command.

title: Pasumao/dsh-plugin-dev-kb

title: pawpress/office-ppt
description: Builds presentations by driving the LibreOffice installed on the machine over UNO instead of writing OOXML in JavaScript: `lo_build` opens a real Impress document from structured slides and lets LibreOffice export editable PPTX/ODP plus PDF and per-slide PNG, `lo_render` re-renders an existing PPTX/PPT/ODP, `lo_convert` converts between Office formats, `lo_probe` reports the detected soffice path, version and UNO bridge, and `lo_config` edits the stored settings. Needs a local LibreOffice (verified on 26.8.1.1); it uses the bundled Python, so no system Python is needed, and it keeps one warm soffice process between calls. Fully verified on Windows only; on Linux it falls back to the system python3, which needs python3-uno.

title: PerryLink/dsh-industry-research
description: Deterministic industry research reports for DeepSeek Harness — company and industry research flows produce structured, verifiable reports from staged evidence.

Highlights and region screenshots go straight into notes; select-to-ask sends the passage with its page; notes are editable in place with autosave; sessions can be combined into a Summary.

CPU OCR without NVIDIA dependencies. Do not enable the CPU and CUDA packages at the same time.

title: piaomiaozhilei/dsh-sacc-translator#dsh-sacc-translator-cuda
description: Windows x64 translator with a dedicated sidebar entry and Workbench / Chat interface, side-by-side text and document translation, screen-region translation, recent history, and host model selection, voice input and preview. CUDA document OCR with CPU fallback; screen OCR uses CPU. Do not enable the CPU and CUDA packages at the same time.

title: PinkyKan/dsh-plugin-readme-zh
description: Translate installed plugins' documentation into Simplified Chinese: README sections are translated with a persistent section-level cache, and an opt-in metaSidecars mode (off by default) writes a locale/zh.json sidecar for each Plugins list row so the list can render Chinese natively.

title: poiuyjie/dsh-md-preview
description: Dockable Markdown preview for the DSH Web UI: side-by-side with the conversation, a per-session recently-read .md list, local relative-path images render in place, and clicking an in-chat .md reference previews it instead of launching the system editor; follows the shell light/dark theme.

title: PolinniZhong/dsh-knit
description: Puts the Markdown documents, source files, images and video that already exist anywhere in the session workspace into the DSH sidebar, ranked by relevance to the current conversation. The default lexical mode matches your recent messages against title, summary and body locally with IDF weighting (BM25) — no model calls, no network, nothing leaves the machine. The list comes from scanning the workspace rather than from a recent-files list, so restarting DSH or opening a new session does not empty it. Results are organised into a three-tier reading order (primary / supporting / related) with a verifiable reason on every row — which field matched, which document cites this one — and one click opens an in-place preview: Markdown as rendered text, relative-path images actually drawn, source code with the host's own syntax highlighting, video streamed over HTTP Range. The same Context Pack is exposed to the agent as a knit_docs tool. Later versions added read evidence and lifecycle tracking (attribution is frozen at the moment of reading), pin / exclude (exclusion applies before retrieval, and is undoable), relation evidence (references / imports / tests, with line numbers) and an incremental index reused across restarts. Since v0.23 there is also an optional hybrid mode: it is off by default and only runs once you configure an Ollama or OpenAI-compatible embedding provider yourself. When it runs, what leaves the machine is your query text plus each candidate file's title and summary — a Markdown summary is an excerpt of the body's first paragraph (at most 60 characters), a code file's summary is its workspace-relative directory, and an image or video contributes its file name; full bodies and absolute paths are not sent, and a loopback provider keeps everything on this machine. Since v0.24 it also associates uncommitted changes: a read-only git status (fixed argv, no shell, whitelisted child-process environment) combined with the same reference / import / test / mention evidence shows which files a change is likely to drag along, and it is off by default. The benefit of semantic retrieval still awaits a real-provider run, so no recall improvement is claimed.

title: Romebody/dsh-docx-format

Long attachment entries are split into real paragraphs at the wrap point measured by Word, producing a 2 / 6 / 5 / 6 character indent ladder. It applies the layout only when the request mentions 公文 (official document) and writes no signature block unless asked.

title: RyanZhangK/dsh-paper-translate
description: Whole-PDF paper translation for DSH on top of a BabelDOC installation you provide (Python CLI, with an OpenAI-compatible API key in its config.toml): bilingual dual-page output, a token cost estimate before running, a per-domain glossary reused across papers, and the server-side thinking overhead disabled for translation.

title: s1lencewill/dsh-markdown-reader
description: Renders workspace Markdown files in a standalone full-screen reader with GFM, KaTeX, Mermaid, outline navigation, live file reload, and browser printing/PDF export.

title: SamyiHu/dsh-visio
description: Open and edit Visio (.vsdx) drawings in a DSH panel: live SVG preview, shape and connector editing, layout checks, and a visio tool so the agent can read and modify the drawing. The core engine is Python standard library and needs no Visio or Office; requires Python 3.9+ on PATH, and Pillow for PNG export, snapshots and stencil previews.

title: Sanshui258/dsh-hwp-translate
description: Translates .hwp/.hwpx (Hangul) and .docx documents into the language the session model writes - Chinese is the common case, but Korean to English or English to Korean works the same way - keeping tables, bullets, indentation and font size, and writes the result beside the original as *_zh. hwp_extract returns the document segments as JSON (50 per page by default, 200 max, next_offset for pagination); hwp_apply takes {segment id: translation} and returns the output path with applied and missing counts. The plugin never calls an API and accepts no API key; its bundled 10 MB translator only reads and writes the file locally. Windows only: .hwpx and .docx are parsed in pure Python, while legacy .hwp drives the installed Hangul over COM and requires allow_hangul.

title: scccy/dsh-notes-board
description: Writes engineering decisions down the way DSH documents its own — every non-trivial change leaves a Markdown note under .agents/notes/<lifecycle>/<class>/ holding the problem, the decision, the rejected alternatives and the consequences, committed to git and reviewable like code. It supplies the workflow for that: five tools (note_search, note_read, note_write, note_verify, note_skip), an end-of-turn hook that asks a code-changing turn to either write a note or record an explicit skip, the tree/format/archived checks, and the write-notes-like-deepseek skill bundled in the package and mounted by the plugin. A sidebar board that renders the notes into four views (architecture baseline, timeline, rejected proposals, decision list) comes with it; the notes themselves stay plain Markdown.

Server-only, zero runtime dependencies.

title: sisyphus1212/dsh-local-markdown-notes

Shows read-only Git context for each file — status, diff against HEAD with per-line change bars, and line blame — and exposes six notes_* tools so the agent works on the same folders. Files stay where they are on disk; the plugin never commits, stages or checks out.

description: DocChain knowledge base, document conversion and knowledge-graph toolkit — filename, content and metadata search, locate-by-doc_id/name with content reading, topic listing, bulk document upload, document-to-Markdown conversion, image-similarity search, per-document image descriptions saved to a sidecar markdown (flowcharts and architecture diagrams are turned into PlantUML sketches, other images into text descriptions; the original image is replaced by a clickable link), a deep-research workflow, and a knowledge-graph layer (ontology inspection, read-only Cypher, ontology/entity/relation writes). description: Read-only Skill inspector for DeepSeek Harness. It shows which Skills a conversation actually loaded — from observed loading evidence only — and which Skills the current environment can discover, and gives each Skill a detail page whose left column switches between the framework, the evidence, validation, evaluation, step evidence, run logic, the before/after of a modification when there is one, the definition facts and the raw SKILL.md. Declaration and run stay apart: the body is split into structure, declared workflow and progressive disclosure, the run logic is read from local receipts, and every declared step carries its own evidence — no observed evidence is reported as exactly that, not as executed or not executed, and the run's instruction hash sits beside the current definition as match, mismatch or unavailable. The evidence view gives each subject one of three states (declared, observed, unavailable), walks definition → load → use → outcome, names what each stage cannot reach, declines to attribute an outcome to the Skill, and can copy the snapshot out as byte-stable JSON. Validation checks the Agent Skills open standard and the platform profiles separately, each finding on a rule id and labelled standard compliance or platform compatibility. Evaluation keeps repeatable cases with the conditions each run was recorded under and the four stages of runtime evidence, comparing two runs of one case item by item without scoring them. The trigger boundary keeps should-trigger and should-not-trigger prompts, has you run them in a real new session, then records what was observed — whether a load record appeared and whether it was model-invoked or user-explicit; a typed /name is not a natural trigger, and an absent load record is reported as not observed, not as not triggered. The same projections are exposed to the agent as a read-only skill_review tool, which returns a structured review packet and says what it omitted when the packet will not fit whole. The inspector, the evidence chain and these reviews are computed on this machine from the definition and the session receipts; the Chinese reading version sends the body through the host's model when you ask for it, keeping code fences, paths and frontmatter verbatim and storing the result on this machine. A Skill can also be cloned into a local copy. It does not write back to the source Skill and does not run its scripts.

title: dingchenhui0618-arch/dsh-daily

Every day at a fixed hour it ranks the plugin market by real install counts and stars, cross-checks it against your own agent memory and working conventions, and proposes two kinds of item: concrete deltas on the plugins people actually use (original does A, the proposal does B) and directions nobody has built yet. The popularity numbers come from the catalog the market itself publishes and are quoted into the prompt rather than guessed; an entry the market has not measured is shown as unmeasured, never as zero. Approving an item opens a new session named after it and hands that session a fixed delivery contract — implement independently, never fork, test green before publishing. Rejected sources are remembered so they stop coming back.

title: dingchenhui0618-arch/dsh-den
description: A resident assistant for DeepSeek Harness that is deliberately not another chat box: one floating window plus one standing conversation, both independent of every other session. The heartbeat is held back by four gates — an authority grant, a daily turn budget, quiet hours and a pacing cooldown — and it keeps working across restarts through a lease it has to hold. Each wake is decided by a model that must answer SKIP or a short message, so silence is a decision rather than a failure. The window shows the standing conversation's real message flow, read from the host session store, or from the on-disk session log when the host does not publish that session, and it can send into that conversation directly. den carries the same reach as the person it stands in for, with one limit: read-only. It may read every session, this machine and work channels such as GitHub, but it does not write, send or publish, it never asks anyone for permission, and it never gates another session's tool calls. `npm run digest:github` turns GitHub notifications and your own open pull requests into three Chinese sections — waiting on you, waiting on your review, and yours — with reply drafts that are explicitly marked as unsent.

Needs Node 22.18+/24.11+, ffmpeg and ffprobe on PATH, and configured vision/chat/image/video model endpoints; share links go through a third-party parser service (or yt-dlp), or upload a local file.

title: limuyang2/agent-team

The steps execute in AItelier rather than in the DSH session and are polled by run_id, pause at engine-enforced checkpoints answered with answer_checkpoint, and leave per-step traces and step outputs to read afterwards; add_provider / map_model / edit_role point an individual role at a local or cheaper endpoint. title: lion231226/dsh-verified-progress

title: LiPu-jpg/Openwrite
description: Novel-writing workbench for DSH with an authoring preset, outline and character management, manuscript annotations, review workflows, and a managed local Python backend.

title: lishize20040802-rgb/dsh-deep-ptc-mode
description: Deep PTC mode is an open-source agent preset for DeepSeek Harness that keeps the built-in PTC tool surface and replaces the persona with a working contract: a DeepSeek identity and unlimited-token-budget instruction so the model does not skip reads, commands or checks to save tokens; planning by estimated size (internal up to 5 minutes, shown without approval up to 20, approval required beyond); and asking about unclear intent instead of guessing. Waiting is limited in code by wrapping the official shell, job and question tools: foreground commands move to background jobs after 30 s (configurable), a steered user message ends the current wait so the model reads it, foreground pauses over 5 s and long timers in run_code are refused, and questions run in timed mode. The mode derives its preset from the official PTC declaration shipped by the installed Harness and inherits upstream composition changes, so an official PTC update — including removed or renamed modules — does not break existing sessions. A settings card selects the preset executor — Automatic, WSL Bash, Windows PowerShell, native Zsh or native Bash.

title: lispking/dsh-auto-evolve
description: A self-evolving plugin for DeepSeek Harness: it observes how the agent runs, proposes improvements to its own assets via the LLM, validates each proposal inside a sandboxed trial agent, and applies only verified mutations — with a versioned ledger and automatic rollback on regression.

title: litongtong256/dsh-automation-monitor

title: LittleBlackTong/dsh-plugin-cron
description: Cron scheduler for agent tasks: create jobs by natural language or a sidebar UI, inject a user message into a new or fixed session on schedule to trigger a full agent turn, with run history, manual trigger, and live SSE sync. Requires DSH session format v4 (official DeepSeek Harness 0.1.7+): injected messages declare the producer-owned source kind plugin:cron.

title: LittleBlackTong/dsh-plugin-heartbeat
description: Autonomic heartbeat for each root agent: silent pulses diff the session's todos, Agent Team board and goal against what the last pulse saw, and speak only on a signal — L1 report, L2 ask (ask_user_question), L4 escalate — never starting work. Each message carries a why-now line, an optional one-line physiology signature (time since your last message and how many times it has reached out today) and a compact task snapshot (800-char cap); a dedupe window, quiet hours, a daily budget, refractory/restart cooldowns and persisted vitals keep it quiet, while busy-safe followup injection never stacks. It shares one advisory speech floor with dsh-plugin-memory (~/.dsh/proactive-cooldown.json, 180 s) so the two never talk over each other, stays silent while a child subagent or teammate is still working, and surfaces a "subagents working · N" pill in the conversation header (polling pauses while the tab is hidden). v0.8 adds a diagnostics panel that explains recent quiet pulses and names the current speech-floor holder, plus panel controls for the arbitration window, presence suppression and the physiology line; its settings section carries a stroked heart mark (16×16, stroke 1.3, same spec as dsh-plugin-memory). v0.8.1 makes the plugin compatible with DSH 0.2.2-rc.2: the agent registry is read with agents.roots() when available and falls back to agents.list() on rc.2, and every agent/created listener is exception-guarded — on rc.2 an unguarded throw there rejects agent registration and no session can be created, so rc.2 users must upgrade to 0.8.1 or newer.

title: loyalchiiina/dsh-agent-team-auto-orchestrator
description: Host-side orchestrator for DSH agent teams. Every turn it injects an 11-section orchestration methodology into the system prompt and backs it with a counting tool-layer gate, so parallel dispatch, task-board tracking, cross-session handoff, employee-pool reuse and preset routing become the default in any preset and any session instead of something you have to ask for. The gate counts real dispatches (subagent / subagent_fork / spawn_teammate) rather than words: a todo listing N unmarked items only needs the base threshold, items explicitly marked as parallel must be launched in one batch up to a configurable cap, and a genuine single-step task is exempt by writing one marker. Read-only tools (read, glob, grep, context-management tools) are never gated. Team members are woken up and reused before new ones are hired, and subagents are reserved for work that must run under a specific preset. Local-only settings (preset routes, domain keywords, profile name, active tier) live in <DSH_HOME>/team-orchestrator.local.json and never ship inside the package. Status is exposed on a loopback-only HTTP route. Zero telemetry, no hosted service, no account. Adapts DSH kernel 0.2.2-rc.1.

title: Lumos-789/baton
description: Runs an approved OpenSpec change to completion while the model stays a mechanical forwarder: a bundled Python CLI computes the ticket DAG frontier, claims tasks atomically, prepares one git worktree per assignment, and returns exact actions. The session delegates each action with the DSH subagent tool and reconciles the completion notice against a hash-bound receipt produced by re-running verification commands on a clean, advanced HEAD, so free-text "done" never counts. Runtime scope changes are plain tasks.md edits. Liveness is observable, not guessed: status returns a relay block (elapsed and lease budget, receipt presence, heartbeat and activity age, a suggested action); abandoning a plausibly-still-working attempt is refused with the judgment data unless --force; a late sealed receipt is revived by adopt after full re-verification instead of rebuilding the ticket; dispatched subagents refresh a progress heartbeat outside the worktree. Requires Python 3.10+ on PATH and a git project that uses OpenSpec.

title: Lumos-789/galadon
description: A five-stage engineering loop for agent-built projects — spec, build, verify, ship, learn — with one artifact and one gate per phase, so an agent always knows the single next action. Role policy, project templates and deployment sit behind explicit ports: swap the implementation without rewriting the loop. Its scaffold generator lays out the internal layers of a project — `init --layout {none,webapp,service,plugin} --stack {python,node,none}` — from nine layers sampled out of three unrelated production projects: entry docs, an OpenSpec plan face, a spec truth layer (INDEX, one file per domain, TESTING, CONSTITUTION), a wiki split into knowledge / progress / runbook, the six `.agents/` slots, server+web, scripts/deploy/config, tests+e2e and a gitignored out/. Non-none layouts also gate the directory contract and compile every source root. Ships a Python CLI (init/next/check/ship/new) plus a local command adapter and an SSH/systemd adapter with release directories, an atomic current/previous switch, a deploy lock, a commit-versioned JSON probe and automatic rollback on a failed probe; bootstrap and teardown provision and remove the unit and the reverse-proxy block idempotently and refuse to delete a root they did not create. Includes a runnable example workspace and a skill that keeps the agent on one phase at a time. Requires Python 3.10+ and PyYAML; remote deploys need SSH access, rsync, systemd and Caddy on the target.

description: Guides RTL design and verification in DeepSeek Harness, with project scaffolding, evidence checks, and OpenROAD/ORFS setup.

description: An AI creation canvas for DeepSeek Harness. Organize project materials, reference cards and files, run local Skills, and manage versions of text, presentations, images, and video. API provider extension points are available, but no provider models or API Key settings are bundled yet.

title: wdj20050927/dsh-quality-guard
description: Second-model gate on the assistant turn, installed with one command: the bundle installs the settings panel and mounts the engine out of the same package, so both halves come up together. A separate judge call scores the draft against the numbered criteria (0-10 each); any criterion under 6 fails the turn and sends it back for a rewrite, up to 3 rounds by default. Ships in dry-run mode, which only records verdicts to an audit log until you switch it off. The web panel edits the criteria, the thresholds and the judge prompt.

title: weibaohui/dsh-flow
description: Execution flow chart: renders the current session's execution as a vertical node flow (turns, user, assistant, tools, approvals, retries, compaction), appended in real time over SSE with auto-follow scrolling — the chart draws wherever the session executes.

title: weibaohui/dsh-tasks
description: Scheduled tasks: run a prompt on cron schedules, each run opens a new agent session to do the work, with workspace binding, manual run, session auto-naming, and a fullscreen task management page.

title: weibaohui/dsh-thinktank

title: Weihao654/dsh-workflow#l1-presets

Each role has a defined tool-permission matrix. Works with the sibling l2-protocol bundle for opt-in controlled rounds. For new installs, Weihao654/dsh-workflow#role-chain provides these four presets and the controlled-round runtime in a single bundle. Do not enable role-chain alongside either legacy l1-presets or l2-protocol.

title: Weihao654/dsh-workflow#l2-protocol
description: Plan-native multi-agent workflow for DeepSeek Harness: plan directs, work coordinates, code writes, and review audits read-only. Ordinary tasks need no authorization card or budget form. Requires the sibling l1-presets bundle. For new installs, Weihao654/dsh-workflow#role-chain provides this runtime and the four presets in a single bundle. Do not enable role-chain alongside either legacy l1-presets or l2-protocol.

title: Weihao654/dsh-workflow#role-chain
description: Installs the whole role-chain toolchain in one step: four agent presets (plan, work, code and review) plus fourteen chain_* tools for evidence-bound rounds, with a settings card. It ships the protocol runtime itself, so no sibling package is needed. It replaces the separate l1-presets and l2-protocol entries, which must be removed before enabling this one.

title: weiplwei/DeepSeek-chan-sleep-shutdown

The button is draggable (position remembered in localStorage), automatically dodges other plugins' corner popups, and survives the frontend re-rendering it away. When the batch finishes a 60 s cancellable countdown starts (configurable 10–600 s) with the remaining seconds on the button and a matching banner: clicking Cancel runs shutdown /a and disarms the mode, and any new session starting during the countdown aborts it. A right-click menu on the button switches the shutdown condition between only-on-success and shutdown-regardless, persisted across restarts in $DSH_HOME/deepseek-chan-sleep-shutdown.json. Zero runtime dependencies.

title: weixshaw/dsh-plugin-task-runner
description: Task Runner mode for DeepSeek Harness: the main agent decomposes large tasks into independent subtasks, dispatches them to subagents (default local model) in fresh short contexts, and synthesizes results; concurrency and worker/orchestrator models are configurable in the settings panel.

title: whateverboy2333/dsh-round-table
description: Round-table meetings for DeepSeek Harness 0.2.0-rc.2 on Windows desktop, reusing existing Agent sessions with discussion, editable task cards, sequential and parallel steps, shared meeting files, and secretary minutes.

title: whyihaveyou/dsh-suite#plugin-team-board
description: Shared multi-agent task board (create/claim/transition/query) over a Cordis service key.

title: Willmylife/dsh-event-gate
description: Event-driven trigger plugin (the doorbell beside dsh-proactive's alarm clock): recursive fs watchers with per-rule debounce windows and glob filters, plus a loopback-only local webhook endpoint with per-rule tokens, fire rules that wake a target session through the host agents service - live sessions get a direct follow-up, cold ones are resumed first - and inject a rendered prompt with template variables (paths, count, payload). Rules hot-reload from the event-gate rules file without restarting DSH, every trigger appends to an auditable JSONL history queryable via the trigger_list and trigger_history tools, and a loopback health route reports install and runtime status. Typical uses: auto-organizing a downloads folder, diagnosing CI or monitoring alarms posted from local scripts, and watching logs for errors. Pure JS, no build step, MIT.

title: WilShi/dsh-workflow-library
description: Reusable workflows: orchestration scripts saved as files under .dsh/workflows, discovered from the project, and run by name with arguments, so they live in git and can be shared. Four tools: list, show, run, save.

title: WintryGrass/dsh-multi-candidate

title: bushizhanghan/dsh-compaction-audit
description: Audit what context compaction actually lost. Reads the raw session event log and checks session-constraint survival (the standing instructions the user gave — do-not-X, must-Y, only-in-Z — and whether the summary still carries them; arXiv 2608.11242 measured ~17% survival across compactors), summary hallucination (paths, versions, ports and identifiers the summary invents that were never in the history it replaced), ghost references ("see above" pointing at removed text), token accounting (a summary nearly as large as what it claims to free), and unaccounted prunes. Four agent tools including a cross-session sweep that ranks conversations by how much compaction hurt them. Deterministic — no LLM, so a wrong answer is a rule bug with a name.

title: bushizhanghan/dsh-context-budget
description: Audit how each turn's context budget is spent. Breaks down what a turn pays for AGENTS.md, the skill catalog, tool schemas and runtime context; flags repeated injection of unchanged content as pure waste; ranks skill-catalog bloat (with 60+ skills installed, how many tokens of descriptions does the model read every turn) and tool-schema inflation per plugin. Deterministic — no LLM, so a wrong answer is a rule bug with a name. Four tools including a cross-session sweep.

title: bushizhanghan/dsh-openfoam-doctor
description: OpenFOAM case doctor for DeepSeek-Harness. Six agent tools: audit a case for 25 classes of silent failure (steadyState paired with timeStep writes, limiters set to 1 that let k/epsilon go negative, unbounded advection of transport scalars, nNonOrthogonalCorrectors 0 on a skewed mesh, loose solver tolerances, blockMesh vertex/block mismatch, stray time directories, purgeWrite 0); read any dictionary as JSON; survey a sweep of cases; run checkMesh/blockMesh/snappyHexMesh/foamRun inside WSL with log parsing; parse logs into the metrics that matter (aspect ratio, non-orthogonality, skewness, residual floor, fatal errors). Deterministic text analysis — no LLM — validated against a real 82k-cell street-canyon snappy case.

title: bushizhanghan/dsh-profile-doctor
description: Read-only DSH profile doctor: the seven config-tree checks (config-clobber, dead-patch, tool-collision, plugin-not-mounted, plugin-stale, entry diff, explain) plus eight ecosystem checks learned from real failures — pnpm store version conflicts that break `dsh plugin add`, patch insert names node_modules cannot resolve, broken junctions, duplicate-capability plugins, orphan backup dirs, GitHub-source deps, npm publish-scope hints, and the minimumReleaseAgeExclude gap. Four agent tools; every finding carries its fix.

title: bushizhanghan/dsh-publish-gate
description: For DSH plugin AUTHORS: run this after you finish writing a plugin and it audits the entire publish path, then hands you the exact GitHub + npm + market commands. Pre-publish gate for DSH plugins. Turns every silent failure in the publish path into a deterministic check: package.json completeness (missing exports\["."], files omitting lib/ so the tarball is empty, no "type": "module", client declared without a ./client export), UTF-8 BOM, JSON/YAML parse errors, cordis.patch.yml insert rows written at the wrong indent (the bug that makes a plugin install and never mount), insert name mismatches, missing entry exports, require() inside ESM, missing LICENSE or README install line, missing tests, unscoped npm names that return a 403 no granular token can diagnose, versions already on the registry, and missing GitHub repos. Six agent tools; every finding carries its fix. Read-only, no LLM.
