title: Leonlee114514/dsh-better-debug
description: Appends one short user message before the next step when the model is circling: the same absolute path written three times with no measurement landing in between, the same error episode (tool, target and normalised fingerprint) returning twice, or a write followed by two steps with no measurement — the last one only arms, and the message lands before the next write rather than interrupting reading. A measurement has two states: intent is judged from the tool arguments at call time, and the write streak is cleared only when the result comes back, only for that command directory. A failed test still counts, because it yields the line that is wrong. Hard measurements are `lsp_diagnostics`, `verify`, `run_tests` and `run_test`; `ops_bash`, `bash`, `shell` and `pwsh` count only when the command matches a measurement pattern, so `ls` no longer launders a blind edit streak. Signals fire once per episode, re-arm after a real measurement, and are capped per turn; a successful `present` sleeps the gate until the next write, and subagent sessions are skipped. Generated paths (build output, lock files, logs) are excluded. Error targets are read out of real `file:///` ESM stacks, so two different files never collapse into one episode, and `cd <dir> && cmd` counts as a measurement of that directory rather than its parent. Ships the `stuck-gate` skill at bundled rank 600 (a user-level copy at 400 overrides its wording) plus a read-only observation panel at `/better-debug` reporting firings, sessions covered, the first action after each message across six classes, and how many measurement loops actually closed. The log defaults to `$DSH_HOME/logs/better-debug.log` and is created on first write, so the panel has data right after install. Optional host services are subscribed dynamically, so a host without them still loads the gate. It does not estimate tokens saved, and it does not claim the message caused the change. The panel banner counts only the failures after the most recent load (`log.current`), so one old mount failure no longer reads as "currently disabled". Test suites wait for log conditions instead of fixed delays (test-only change in 0.2.5).

title: Leonlee114514/dsh-turn-cleanup
description: Blocks the end of a turn while temporary files from that turn are still lying around: it registers a listener on the serial agent/turn-stopping hook and, if anything is left, hands the model the file list plus two ways out — delete them, or justify each one and move it somewhere deliberate. Candidates come from two narrow temp-file sources, plus a backup-retention channel that is on by default and flags excess .bak copies of files touched this turn. The first is the .agent-tmp/ convention directory under the session cwd: whatever is left in it is reported outright, because that directory exists only for throwaway files. The second is the paths this turn actually wrote, captured through the fs/write-intent, fs/edit-intent and fs/delete-intent hooks; those are reported only when they sit under that cwd (compared after realpath normalisation), fall outside .git, node_modules, out, dist, build, target, vendor, .venv and the Python bytecode cache directory, match a temp-file pattern that requires a separator after the prefix so checkout.js and benchmark.ts are not taken for scratch files, and the file is still present — which keeps junk already sitting in the workspace from being resurrected as a complaint about this turn. One gate per turn, subagent sessions skipped, nothing deleted unless the backup mode is explicitly set to prune, and the injected wording follows the host locale instead of assuming a Chinese one.

title: worksAssistant/dsh-quickref
description: Developer quick-reference toolbox for DSH: 12 themed categories (195 entries) plus zero-dependency tools — regex tester, JSON formatter, timestamp converter, Base64/URL codec, cron generator and line diff, in a searchable settings panel.

Shown in a Conversation View tab and a loopback viewer page.

title: wufeng0105/dsh-plugin-kit

title: wuying1630/dsh-chain-check
description: Read-only diagnostic that reports which leg of the DSH → bridge → OneBot → QQ chain is broken — process, port, login, preset or recent wake failures — and prints the fix for each failed check. Runs as `node check.mjs` (read-only by default; the optional `--fix` only aligns the bridge baseUrl and starts a stopped bridge), or installs as a `chain_check` tool.

title: wweir/dsh-advisor
description: Automatic second-opinion review: a restricted child session re-reads the agent's recent work with read-only tools and delivers at most one evidence-backed note, or stays silent. Requires a model route in the config; the plugin stays disabled until one is set.

title: WwW7olFWwW/dsh-codebase-watcher
description: Staleness keeper for the Codebase Memory knowledge graph: it compares the graph Branch node head_sha with git rev-parse HEAD and reports an exact behindBy, rebuilds only the stale projects through the codebase-memory-mcp CLI so the MCP tool 60-second cap does not apply, watches each project for edits, and mirrors the same state into a settings card and a REST control surface.

title: wyzh0117/dsh-port-manager
description: Native DSH right-sidebar tab that lists the ports this machine is listening on together with the process behind each one, and offers per-port actions to open it, copy its address, reveal its working directory or end the process.

title: x2802490130-prog/dsh-guard
description: A development safety kit: rolling config snapshots, automatic rollback on plugin failures, boot-failure rescue, and an in-settings management panel.

title: x2802490130-prog/dsh-shield
description: A hands-off safety net: directories the agent deletes go to a trash folder first and symlinks are never followed, with zero approvals.

title: x3416067-bit/dsh-plugin-restart-prompt
description: Windows only. Prompts to restart DSH after a plugin install, update or uninstall, restarts it in one click without any console window, and shows a per-file diff of what changed.

title: x402/dsh-fail-fast
description: Fail-fast tool batches for DeepSeek Harness: inside a step, concurrency-safe calls still overlap, but after the first failed call every remaining unstarted call is denied before dispatch and returned to the model as a synthesized `is_error` "not executed" result.

title: xfgil/dsh-hot-reloader
description: Reload a plugin's source the moment a file changes, without restarting the harness. Covers the third-party plugin case the built-in watcher misses because it skips node_modules.

title: xiaocxiaohai666/dsh-plugin-selfcheck
description: Prints every plugin in the DeepSeek Harness loader tree at boot, with the exception text for anything that failed, and checks dependency version drift, profile config validity, web port reachability and registered tools.

title: xiaolu511/dsh-hot-restart
description: One fixed button inside the DSH window that restarts DSH and reopens it automatically, with no console window; right-click it for a built-in self check that writes a single diagnostic report.

title: xiaoso456/dsh-run-config
description: IDE-style run configurations for DSH: save LLM prompts and shell commands as reusable run configs (global or per-workspace), run them from the session header or the new-session page, and manage them via the task_run_config tool with approval-gated writes.

title: xiaoxin3309/dsh-backup-rescue
description: Back up and restore the whole $DSH_HOME: one-click or scheduled ZIP archives (optional password encryption applies to manual and agent-made backups only; scheduled ones are not encrypted), a settings section, agent tools to create, list, restore and prune backups, and a standalone restorer (Windows .bat or POSIX .sh) that runs without DeepSeek Harness installed.

title: xiaoyuyu6420/dsh-backup
description: One-command backup, restore & migration for all DSH user data (~/.dsh) with a visual Settings panel: scheduled auto-backup with tiered retention, sha256 verification, hardened restore with auto-rollback and a result receipt, typed sub-backups (--types), credential redaction into a local vault, private-repo GitHub sync for moving to a new machine, and an out-of-process rescue console (zero-dependency rescue web UI in the backup dir) that works even when the host won't boot. /backup doctor checks and repairs corrupt session logs from a known-good backup and quarantines them before rotation; migrate-check statically predicts which sessions a host upgrade would break (frozen event-list rules, filename/generation mismatch, hardlink support, legacy credentials); the credential sentinel preserves pre-migration copies before the host rewrites them; smart backup snapshots before host upgrades; /backup check-update and /backup update report and install new releases (snapshotting first). Restore handles attachment hard links and arbitrarily large archives (streamed listing). Current npm version 0.13.4; spans DSH 0.1.1-rc.2 through 0.2.0-rc.1, including 0.2.0's install-time peer gate. macOS/Linux/Windows.

title: xiaxingtianxia2-glitch/dsh-auto-exit
description: Exits the dsh CLI process automatically when the Web UI closes, with a configurable grace period and dry-run mode.

title: xingyingyuzhui/dsh-updater-ui
description: DSH self-updater in the settings page: one-click check/pull (`git pull --ff-only`), auto background checks, version diff and changelog preview with a red-dot reminder.

title: xingzhen199186/dsh-insight-tree
description: Runtime observability and plugin operations panel for DeepSeek Harness: shows the profile plugin tree, real Loader fiber state, capabilities/dependencies/compatibility, current-session plugin activity and upstream source/version checks, with one-click enable/disable/update/uninstall plus a standalone startup-failure diagnostics page that works while DSH is not running.

title: xinspark/dsh-win-pwsh7
description: Reports which PowerShell the DSH pwsh executor actually runs (enabled rows only; version-numbered Store paths are never recommended as pins), and installs a Store-managed PowerShell 7 through a scripted Store-page click or the manual Store path. Allows the pwsh tool only when the live executor resolves PowerShell 7+, and when dsh-ops is installed keeps the native pwsh beside ops_bash by enabling Compatibility and hiding duplicate official tools. Native status card and configuration switch in the Web UI; Windows only, no runtime dependencies.

title: xkk6663/elab-flow#dsh-elab-cockpit
description: Embedded closed-loop development cockpit for DeepSeek Harness: the agent builds, flashes, debug-verifies and monitors STM32 boards from one panel, while the user watches every step live - progress ladder, streaming logs, RAM/FLASH usage and decoded serial waveforms. Requires a host Python 3.10+ on PATH (the plugin cannot install it); the ARM toolchain is auto-downloaded on first use (~400 MB, Windows x64 only), and you need an STM32 board with a debug probe.

title: xswt442-cmd/dsh-ballast
description: Context-window attribution for DSH Web: a Mini Utility Dock panel that ranks the user messages, assistant turns, reasoning blocks and tool results of a session by the tokens each one occupies, so it is clear which entries hold the window. It also shows the share by entry type, the heaviest entries across the live sessions of the host, and, where the host provides them, provider usage and the estimated system/tools/messages composition. The panel is read-only: it does not estimate cost, modify a session, or trigger compaction.

title: xswt442-cmd/dsh-instance-manager
description: Instance manager for DSH Web: a Mini Utility Dock panel that lists every local dsh web instance the machine can see (port, PID, uptime, live session count, resident memory, version), starts a new instance on an automatically picked free port in 3080-3129 or on a port you name, opens a row in a new tab, and stops one or all of them through that instance’s own graceful shutdown (appExit). Rows also show what each instance is serving, and read-only instance logs and session summaries are one click away. Where a peer is configured, the same panel lists and queries instances on other machines over a bearer-authenticated link. Every route is loopback-guarded, and a browser-facing action must additionally pass the host’s own browser authentication.

title: xswt442-cmd/dsh-treekeeper
description: Windows process-tree reconciler for the DSH host: samples the host process tree and the job ledger, attributes each process to the job that created it, flags unattributed and orphaned processes with a confidence level, and offers guarded termination of a whole tree. Termination is refused unless the target belongs to the DSH host tree, is re-sampled and re-checked immediately before the kill (creation time included), and contains no protected descendant, so an allowlisted PID cannot widen the kill scope.

title: XWIDE/DSH_X-Wide-Thought-Chain
description: Freezes a six-step repair chain into callable tools — freeze the facts, measure the real shape, minimal repro, single-variable A/B, a judge that must say OK, delivery gate — plus a zero-dependency boot self-check (path drift, missing files, version sync, crash-log freshness), per-item tunables and a rollback ledger that backs up every action.

title: xxiaoxiong/dsh-prometheus
description: Exposes bounded Prometheus metrics for DSH sessions, agents, LLM calls, tools, approvals, subagents, and jobs, with a Grafana dashboard and a loopback-only endpoint by default.

title: xyrrrrr-r/dsh-eval-control
description: Host-side DSH evaluation control plugin: injects one evaluation trial's variables, budget limits, session root and fork lineage into the agent process, routes its model calls through a host broker under a gateway lease, and writes a schema-versioned bundle descriptor for evidence attribution.

title: yanweiyi11/dsh-idea-mode
description: JetBrains IDEA agent preset for DeepSeek Harness that adds an IDEA mode with IDE MCP tools plus projectPath, parameter-name, and tool-name compatibility helpers.

title: yanzhaohui1999/dsh-perf-hud
description: Client-side performance HUD and always-on recorder for DeepSeek Harness: FPS and worst frame, long tasks with four-leg attribution (React fiber / subtree / DOM writes / scheduler), per-plugin callback rate and sync time, DOM growth and writers, JS heap, host event loop and link RTT, plus a night-watch recorder that keeps the worst stalls and exports incident packs for replay.

title: yi-Xu-0100/dsh-ptc-parse-frame
description: Adds the parse error line number and code frame to run_code errors.

title: yishuiliufang/dsh-relaunch
description: Restart button for the Harness desktop app: one sidebar entry that closes every Harness process and starts the application again, launched without a console window and without a close-confirmation dialog. Windows only.

title: yizhixiaokong/dsh-compose-panel
description: Lists the Docker Compose projects of your DSH workspaces in the right sidebar, one group per project directory, with container status, project- and service-level up/stop/restart, and streamed per-service logs.

title: yizhixiaokong/dsh-simple-restart
description: Adds a restart row to Settings → General that relaunches dsh web with the same invocation through a detached helper, refuses under a detected systemd supervisor unless allowRestart is true, and tests whether the listening port is free by connecting to it rather than binding it.

title: yjh051108/dsh-routing-suite
description: One repository, three parts: a runtime injector for DSH plugin packages (inject, hot-reload, unload, promote a dev staging tool to the front, route self-heal, plus a settings-page plugin manager that lists, unloads and drags folders in to internalize), a task-aware reasoning-mode router agent preset (router-standard / router-spec / router-react), and a graded two-level task protocol whose six tools (commit_star, lock_stage, revise_do, edit_plan, mark_task, redteam_verdict) pin task state to disk. The injector implementation ships in-tree, so the install carries its own behaviour rather than a dependency list.

title: yminghua/dsh-plugin-compare
description: Compares existing DSH sessions or runs controlled A/B trials between agent presets, showing aligned timelines, paired metric deltas, explicit success checks, and exportable reports.

title: yongshuai0314/dsh-readcache
description: Version-token-validated in-process result cache for the DSH read tool: repeated reads of unchanged files skip file I/O and line rendering, with a readcache tool for stats and clearing.

title: young-tim/dsh-profile-lab
description: Runs reproducible DSH profile and patch experiments with guided case authoring, assertions, Web comparison reports, recovery, and policy gates.

title: YTxue/dsh-skill-manager-ytxue
description: Skill pool manager in the Settings sidebar: enable/disable, folder batch import with rename-conflict prompts, state-driven one-click DSH-spec check & auto-fix, system/project scope labels.

title: yuexizhishang/dsh-ui-probe
description: Drives a plugin page in the running DeepSeek Harness UI — opens the panel, reads real DOM and computed styles, clicks, types, waits for async effects, collects console errors, then returns to the original conversation.

title: YunaAloft/dsh-rtk-workbench
description: Brings the rtk token-saving setup from Claude Code to DeepSeek Harness: commands rtk can rewrite are rewritten, and builds, tests and logs it cannot reach are compressed; git, cargo, npm and pytest are covered. Compressed output tells the model what was elided and how to recover it; when the sandbox cannot reach the rtk store the original is saved and its path given. Savings show without a command: a pill below the composer, with `/rtk stats` for detail. When a rewrite is unreliable the original command runs as usual: if rtk cannot run, or the returned command would drop arguments, nothing breaks. The rtk binary ships with the package, so mainstream platforms need no separate rtk install, unlike most other rtk plugins.

title: Yyhy110421/dsh-policy-linter

title: YZz-S/dsh-update-checker

title: zebbkira/dsh-skills-mcp-manager

title: zehuan-huang/dsh-codex-runs

title: zengxiaolou/dsh-device-mirror

title: Zenjibad/dsh-plugin-toggle
description: Enables or disables DSH plugins from Settings → Plugins: each toggle stops or starts the plugin immediately without a restart and the change persists across restarts.

title: zeroed-07/dsh-memory-guard
description: Local-only memory guard for the DeepSeek Harness: host heap and session-log monitoring, oversized tool-argument interception, and dry-run by default session vacuum.

title: zhangj1164/dsh-mega-plugins#dsh-github-issue
description: GitHub issue service for DSH: turns a telemetry failure analysis into a uniform issue report, builds a pre-filled new-issue URL that is shortened when it would exceed a configured length budget, rewrites a plain description into a structured issue with the deployment's model, and closes the intake loop by listing the open issues that carry a claim label and handing each one to a fresh session as a one-shot automation task on the host's Schedule service, which delivers the rendered prompt into that session when the task comes due and shows up on the Web Automation tasks page (a host with no Schedule service admits the prompt directly instead), skipping issues an earlier pass already dispatched, leaving the local day uncommitted when every dispatch is refused so the next startup tries again, and repeating the pass on the first start of each local day when autopilot is enabled.

title: zhangj1164/dsh-mega-plugins#dsh-telemetry
description: Local-only telemetry service for DSH plugins: records operation trails and error events into a storage-domain KV table, applies a configurable redaction rule set before the write and again when the analysis reads back a record stored before a rule existed, and groups one plugin's failures by feature-code anchor, reporting the window it read, the route each group ran on, and the attempts recorded after its last failure in write order.

title: zhangkaiqiu/dsh-dev-launcher
description: Saves per-workspace dev commands behind a header button, starts and stops them as process trees, and exposes four tools so the agent can list, start and stop those saved commands and read their logs (it cannot add or change commands).

title: zhangkaiqiu/dsh-orphan-cleaner

title: zhangzhenwen1/dsh-task-effort
description: Auto-adjust model reasoning effort per task (off/low/high/max): task classification, \[effort=...] markers, in-turn error escalation, DeepSeek peak-pricing-period capping with countdown notices, and manual-selection priority.

title: ZhaoZiyangShaanxi/dsh-server-monitor

The agent ships in the repository (server/monitor.py) and you deploy it yourself.

title: zhengjy01/dsh-start
description: One-click start/stop launcher for DSH Web on macOS — start (foreground/daemon), stop, status, duplicate-launch guard, auto browser open, plus a Dock-able DSH.app built by script.

title: zhengjy01/dsh-updater
description: Track DeepSeek Harness's own releases and update in one click: reads the npm dist-tags and the GitHub changelog, shows every change between the running build and the target, grades the risk, then hands the install to a detached helper that backs the current install up with an atomic rename, runs npm, verifies what landed, relaunches, and rolls back when the new build does not come up.

title: zhengqiuyang/dsh-janitor
description: Registers a janitor_scan tool that returns a deterministic, reviewable cleanup plan for session debris (plan docs, scratch scripts) with per-file verdicts and evidence; scan-only, never deletes.

title: Zhenyu98/dsh-context-doctor
description: Context injection audit: token costs of instruction chains / skill catalogs / tool schemas, duplicate and conflict detection.

title: zhiwuli0228/dsh-env-manager
description: File-based environment registry for DSH: manage environments, services, deployments and operation-to-Skill bindings through a panel and model-facing tools.

title: zhkkjF/dsh-auto-update

title: Zhr65/dsh-skill-auditor#npm
description: Audits the skills and plugins you already installed: routes a task description to the tool it needs, flags version drift against the npm registry and runtime faults from host logs, and reports which of a plugin's tools you never call. Registers 9 tools: can, find, status, recommend, check, scan, probe, run and suggest. Runs on Python 3.8+ with no third-party dependencies. Registered tool ids all carry the skill_audit_ prefix, for example skill_audit_can and skill_audit_find.

title: zhxnix/dsh-wx-preview
description: Preview native WeChat Mini Programs in the DSH sidebar with a local runtime and WXML source locations.

title: zhz8888/dsh-android-emulator-helper

A settings page holds the SDK, emulator, API-level, build and output parameters.

title: zhz8888/dsh-ios-simulator-helper
description: The official ZCode ios-simulator plugin ported to native DSH tools: the original 20 ios_* tools keep their names and arguments, plus ios_shutdown_simulator, covering Xcode project discovery and scaffolding, simulator boot and shutdown, build, install, launch and terminate, screenshots, log reading, an in-app settings page and optional idb UI automation. macOS only.

title: zirscard/dsh-macos-signfix
description: Registers one `doc_ocr_sign_fix` tool for DeepSeek Harness: on macOS it diagnoses and repairs the condition where the bundled Python cannot load native extensions (onnxruntime, cv2, pypdfium2) because of the hardened runtime and library validation, by injecting the disable-library-validation entitlement and re-signing the interpreter, then verifying the imports. Operations are idempotent and the original binary is backed up first. It never touches the enclosing application bundle.

title: zixiaog/dsh-harmony-dev
description: HarmonyOS development kit for DSH: five tools for spec search, code generation and rule checks over 366 curated entries.

title: zjukop/dsh-time-machine
description: Creates local, content-addressed workspace checkpoints with diff previews and two-phase restore confirmation.

title: ZK-Andy/dsh-continual-evolve
description: Continual self-evolution: versioned, auditable, rollback-safe harness state (prompts, memory, skills, subagent specs) refined from session trajectories, with review gates and hot-reloaded skills.

title: Zlyraz/dsh-ballute
description: Crash protection for installed plugins: crash cards with one-click disable, static pre-flight inspection, black-box crash telemetry, and a safe-mode rescue profile for a broken UI.

title: zoahdev/dsh-quality-score
description: Plugin quality scorecard for DeepSeek Harness: 0-100 with grade, 6 components, fix suggestions per deduction, batch leaderboard - CLI plus an agent-callable quality_score tool.

title: zoahdev/dsh-unplug
description: Plug/unplug any DeepSeek Harness plugin cleanly — list every mounted layer (bundles + patch rows), remove with full cleanup, disable/enable without deleting, and audit for orphaned/dangling state. CLI + agent-callable unplug tool. Read-only by default; destructive operations require explicit confirmation.

title: zqh260619/dsh-dupguard
description: Stops a streaming model call when the same string repeats ten times in a row (threshold configurable), keeps the partial answer as a normal assistant message, and shows a stop notice with the workspace, session name and the repeated string. Repeat counts can vary by unit length through a piecewise table or a JavaScript module, and code regions (fenced, inline, indented) use a relaxed threshold.

title: zudazhuang/dsh-update-safe
description: Source-install updater for DeepSeek Harness: checks the official GitHub release and the npm record, builds the target tag in an isolated directory, smoke-starts it, then switches through a supervisor process with rollback, with scheduled checks and a daily idle-only install window. Source install only (macOS/Linux); requires Node.js 22.19+, pnpm and Git.

title: zxj0306/DSH-javadev-enhance
description: Java efficient development plugin for DeepSeek Harness providing deterministic auto-fix for .java files, token-saving template intents, and cross-platform JDK/Gradle/Android SDK/FFmpeg/LWJGL/IDEA discovery with persistent caching.

title: zxzc114514/dsh-crash-guard
description: Intercepts startup crashes, isolates broken frontend plugins, and recovers GUI cleanly with revision-bound quarantine.

title: zyf2492313716-cloud/dsh-toolcall-id-repair
description: Stops session lockups from OpenAI-compatible gateways that stream empty tool-call ids: intercepts llm/stream chunks in memory to synthesize consistent call_<sha256> ids across tool-call-delta and block-end, plus offline session repair/verify scripts under tools/.

title: zzy6-a/dsh-upgrade-guard
description: Audits installed plugin compatibility after a DeepSeek Harness upgrade, repairs or disables incompatible plugins, and keeps an out-of-host supervisor that rescues boot failures or rolls back to the previous host snapshot.

title: 030611/dsh-telemetry-redactor
description: Redacts supported secret patterns from the `session-telemetry/record` export copy before configured telemetry backends receive it.

title: 030611/dsh-verification-receipt
description: Writes local JSONL summaries of per-turn tool counts and coarse verification signals without storing prompts, tool arguments, or result text.

title: 030611/qiushi-dsh-evidence-audit
description: Appends local hash-chained JSONL receipts for tool results and session events without storing prompts, tool arguments, result text, or raw session IDs.

title: 07-dot/dsh-cookie-janitor
description: Expires stale dsh-auth sign-in cookies once the Cookie request header passes 4 KiB, so per-port cookie accumulation can never reach Node's 16 KiB header limit (HTTP 431).

title: 0QwQ0/dsh-ui-auth
description: Authentication gateway for the DeepSeek Harness Web UI: the login gate covers pages, /api, /plugins and WebSocket upgrades; PBKDF2 password hashing with per-user salts, HttpOnly SameSite session cookies named per DSH_HOME and IP-based login lockout; invite-code registration; two-factor login with TOTP or passkeys (WebAuthn: several keys per account, phone enrolment by QR, username-less sign-in, and a step-up before any login factor is added or removed); a user-management settings panel (users edit their own profile and manage their own TOTP and passkeys, admins add or remove users, reset passwords, manage invites and clear the passkeys of a lost device); per-user model and API-key configuration whose private entries are encrypted with a key derived from the login password and stay unreadable by any admin, with admin sharing to selected users (usable, balance visible, key never shown, revocation immediate) and unconfigured users blocked rather than falling back to the deployment configuration; per-user isolation on the REST and list APIs and per-frame ownership filtering on the WebSocket mux; session persistence across restarts; a JSONL audit log; and a fail-closed gateway. Requires the DSH 0.2.0 line (the 0.1.1-rc.2 transport line was removed in 0.7.0); passkey login needs a localhost or HTTPS origin because browsers require a secure context.

title: 0tests/dsh-approval-consult

title: 173787247/dsh-repeat-stop
description: Hard-stop consecutive identical tool calls after a configurable streak so the agent cannot spin in place.

title: 173787247/dsh-tool-budget
description: Hard-stops further tool calls after a configurable per-session budget is reached.

title: 474885697-alt/dsh-kit#dsh-secret-audit
description: Scans a workspace for plaintext API keys, flags files inside git repositories, and reports findings masked so no full secret is ever printed.

title: 7gzgn/dsh-leak-guard

title: apex-mochen/dsh-sandbox-arg-guard
description: Keeps a redundant sandbox-escalation argument from failing a tool call. Escalating tools (pwsh, bash, write, edit) advertise the full sandbox_permissions enum, but DSH only accepts a level strictly wider than the one already in effect — a check its own source calls 'deliberately not a schema constraint'. A model that reflexively passes the argument therefore picks the level it is already at and the call dies before running with 'sandbox escalation to "workspace-write" is not strictly wider than this call's current "workspace-write" mode', costing some models a whole turn of retries. This plugin registers one tools/execute waterfall listener and, only on that documented rejection and only when the arguments really carried an escalation field, re-issues the identical call once without it. Safe by DSH's own documentation: the rejection precedes any execution ('nothing has run'), and the corrected call cannot match again, so the retry is loop-free. Reproduced and verified end to end — before: isError true, the command never ran; after: the command's real output, isError false, one tool/call and one tool/result. Zero dependencies.

title: bushizhanghan/dsh-arg-guard
description: Validates every tool call against that tool's own parameters schema before it runs, and denies with the exact path and type. The host renders a tool's parameters into the prompt but never checks a call against them, so a wrong-typed value reaches the tool body: a number lands in path.join and the caller gets a raw TypeError instead of an answer. This plugin hooks tools/pre-execute, resolves the definition, and returns a deny whose reason reads "demo_tool.dir: expected string, got number (123)". Covers primitive types and unions, required, enum/const, nested properties, array items, additionalProperties:false, and oneOf/anyOf/allOf. Fails open on purpose: an internal error, an unknown tool, or a schema construct it cannot read allows the call. mode deny or warn, plus a skip list. Two read-only tools, arg_guard_status and arg_guard_check.

description: Learning auto-approval gate for DeepSeek Harness: Flash judging, confirmation-based learning, trust roots and a rule library.

title: sujingkpo/dsh-auto-pass
description: A continuation of simon300000/dsh-auto: the Auto Approve permission preset for the DSH Web UI reviews each approval with one single-shot model call instead of a reviewer subagent, auto-approves only the actions that pass and hands the rest to human approval, and remembers confirmed decisions as project- and global-scope allow/deny lists, with an approval timeline in the right sidebar.

title: SummerSec/dsh-web-auth
description: Transport-level authentication gate for the DeepSeek Harness Web GUI with server-side sessions, HttpOnly cookies, IP-based login throttling, and an scrypt password CLI.

title: tancheng33/dsh-code-runtime-container
description: Container-isolated backend for the `ctx.codeRuntime` seam: each Code Mode program runs in a fresh container with no network, a read-only rootfs, dropped capabilities, and kernel-enforced memory, CPU and pid ceilings.

title: tancheng33/dsh-credentials-vault
description: HashiCorp Vault backend for the credential seam: KV v2/v1, AppRole machine auth, per-operation reads so rotation needs no restart, and compare-and-swap writes.

title: tancheng33/dsh-egress-guard
description: Runtime security gate on the tool pipeline: denies calls naming hosts outside an egress allowlist, redacts credentials from results at the canonical value rather than only the rendered content, and appends every decision to a JSONL audit log; ships in monitor-only mode.

title: tanxiaolong/dsh-shuyun
description: macOS only. Shows a live badge in DSH and an optional SwiftBar menu-bar item reporting what the Yunshu (Eagleyun SASE) endpoint agent is doing on this Mac right now — TCC permission requests, its own agent logs (screen capture, clipboard, browser URL reads, browser window counts), DLP scan paths and the process table. Read-only: it never blocks, disables or modifies the agent, keeps the last 60 events in memory only, writes three state files locally and makes no network calls. Requires the Yunshu agent to be installed; SwiftBar is optional.

title: taxueseek/dsh-plugin-guard
description: Static-only plugin gate and clinic for DSH: audit before install, hash-and-capability lock after install, local fingerprint peer search over GitHub topic:dsh-plugin, and mechanical detox. Never executes the target plugin.

title: TecFancy/dsh-auth-gate
description: Login gate for the dsh web surface: password or shared-token authentication, session cookies, rate limiting, and a user-management CLI (dsh.bundle manifest since 0.4.1, one-command `dsh plugin add` mounting).

title: TGYD-helige/dsh-plugins#dsh-policy
description: Apply configurable allow, deny, and approval rules to dsh tool calls, including shell command patterns.

title: toby-bridges/api-relay-audit
description: Runs local security audits of AI API relays and LLM proxies from DeepSeek Harness, producing Markdown reports for prompt injection, model substitution signals, tool-call rewriting, error leakage, stream integrity, and profile-gated Web3 risks.

title: Top-Celestial-Company-Ltd/dsh-dros-vajraclaw
description: Local tool-call failsafe for DSH: blocks a fixed list of high-risk shell patterns and credential-file reads before execution, with a per-session hash-linked JSONL audit log, and an optional external Gateway for centralized policy.

title: truelove-dreamer/dsh-plugin-vetting
description: Vets third-party plugins before you trust them: static scan for malicious patterns (exfiltration, credential access, obfuscation, persistence) and over-privileged path use, transitive-dependency coverage, official-package hash baseline for supply-chain tamper detection, and an optional plugin-tool call gate.

title: uwu9039/dsh-airbag
description: Blocks API keys pasted into the composer or written by tools, logs leak events, and scans the workspace for exposed secrets.

title: Veagau/dsh-account-vault
description: Store account credentials in an encrypted browser-local vault.

title: Vladimir-Kryshchenko/dsh-route-fence-linter
description: Audits every plugin HTTP route in a profile for a browser-trust fence: plugin routes win the web server's longest-prefix match ahead of the /api gateway, so they never see its trust check and must pin the Host to loopback themselves. Grades PASS/WARN/FAIL per route and fails a fence that compares Origin to Host without pinning it (bypassable by DNS rebinding). Ships as a CLI for CI and a route_fence_scan tool.

title: wangxy496/dsh-sensitive-guard
description: Replaces keys, tokens and passwords with <SG_> placeholders before they enter model context; plaintext stays in a local AES-256-GCM vault, revealed by a click-to-reveal lock in Settings and in user messages.

title: we39/dsh-jumpserver
description: Query and manage JumpServer through conversation: assets, users, accounts, permissions, sessions, command audit logs, command filters, and RBAC roles, authenticated with an AccessKeyID/AccessKeySecret pair (HTTP Signature).

title: weibaohui/user-management
description: Login gate for the dsh web UI: unauthenticated visitors get a login/register page and the first registrant becomes admin; includes user and role management plus login and access audit logs.

title: weisofns/dsh-security-guard
description: DSH plugin security guard: 28-rule static scanner, risk scoring, whitelist/blacklist policy, local web dashboard and in-DSH risk popups.

title: wjl906/dsh-slowmist-security-guard
description: Security guard for DeepSeek Harness (Cordis): reviews every tool call in pre-execute against SlowMist agent-security rules, denying or flagging risky commands, MCP servers and skill loads, external URLs and repositories, untrusted documents, and EVM or Solana addresses; scans tool results for prompt injection after execution and ships a slowmist_scan audit tool plus an injected security policy prompt. Rules follow the open-source SlowMist Agent Security Skill (MIT).

title: wld007/dsh-medical-anonymizer
description: Batch pseudonymization for medical text, CSV, JSON, and XLSX in DeepSeek Harness. Deterministic identifier rules run first; an optional OpenAI-compatible model pass adds discovery and verification. Exact-span replacement preserves file structure, tokens stay stable per value, and each batch produces an audit report plus a re-identification vault. DICOM images get header-only de-identification based on PS3.15 Annex E, with pixel data left byte-identical.

title: Wldpm/dsh-fileguard
description: Security plugin that intercepts file deletion and write commands, requiring user token authorization.

title: wojiao42/dsh-approval-audit
description: Forces every active session into the full-access permission preset (this disables the approval gate) and appends approval, sandbox and tool-call events to a local JSONL for after-the-fact review. Audit path is configurable; it never uploads anything.

title: WU-HINS/dsh-webui-oauth
description: Fork of Yuuz12/dsh-webui-auth adding a deny-by-default allowlist route gate over resources, plugin bundles, /api and WebSocket upgrades; password and OIDC/SSO login with an SSO-only mode; server-side sessions with HttpOnly cookies plus a per-browser session list and selective revocation; an OAuth 2.1 device authorization flow (RFC 8628) for app and CLI access, with independent device sessions that expire only on explicit revocation; and a core session bridge that exchanges the launch cookie on the server without exposing the launch token. It is a fork of Yuuz12/dsh-webui-auth and cannot be installed alongside it — remove the original from the profile's bundle list first.

title: wulun811/dsh-plugin-vet
description: Plugin trust pipeline for DeepSeek Harness: deterministic static scan with verdicts, opt-in runtime guard with honeypot lures, agent audit-protocol skill, and a browser shield status light. Alarm-only, never an enforcer.

title: wxlei2004/dsh-plugins#dsh-re-workbench
description: Reverse-engineering workbench: bridges a local IDA Pro into DeepSeek Harness through @deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client, exposing the ida-pro-mcp toolset (decompile, xref, rename, comment) as mcp__ida__* tools. Auto-selects idalib headless mode (analyses a binary in-process, no IDA GUI) or GUI mode (connects to the IDA plugin RPC on port 13337). Adds re_check, re_open and re_status; the bundled MCP server is a zero-dependency stdio proxy usable from any MCP client.

title: WyattJHayes/dsh-feishu-channel
description: Security-focused Feishu (Lark) channel for DeepSeek Harness: allowlisted remote-agent access with workspace-scoped paths, symlink checks, risk-based approvals, session isolation, redacted logs, and bounded message queues.

title: wyk4447/dsh-diff-review
description: Pre-execution review gate for file writes, edits and deletions: the tool call is held before it runs, a right-sidebar panel shows the computed diff (unified, or source versus result side by side), and nothing is written until Accept is clicked; pwsh commands that create, overwrite or delete files through a literal path are held the same way, and a command whose target is only known at runtime shows its raw command line instead of a diff. A command touching several files is held once and reviewed as one tab per file. What a diff cannot express is reported instead — a binary file or source map shows its byte sizes, and a change that only touched line endings or indentation says so. Accepted changes are kept as snapshots and can be restored from a history view, and tools without a dedicated adapter are judged by their arguments: a path plus a mutating verb is held, a read is not.

title: WYR-233/dsh-whale-guard
description: Safety guard that makes self-killing commands impossible: a safe_kill tool that always excludes the caller and every ancestor process, a bash pre-execute check for pkill self-matches, sudo -S stdin grabs, rm -rf / and similar patterns, and an extensible rule library with block / warn / hint severities.

title: wzn16/dsh-fs-allowlist
description: Approval-free writes into whitelisted directories — wraps the filesystem fence for write/edit tools and auto-answers bash sandbox escalations that touch whitelisted paths, with a settings GUI.

title: x2802490130-prog/dsh-lan-pass
description: A LAN password gate for the Web UI: phones and tablets on the same network log in with a shared key and see the same sessions in real time, with a built-in randomUUID polyfill for plain-HTTP origins.

title: xbzbing/dsh-auth-gateway
description: Password + TOTP two-factor authentication gateway for the dsh web UI: every HTTP request and WebSocket upgrade is refused until login, with per-source lockout, global rate limits and one-time backup codes.

title: xbzbing/dsh-privacy-gateway
description: Redacts secrets, cookies and personal data in every model request at the host process undici dispatcher and restores the placeholders in the reply, so one interception covers every provider, adapters that plugins add included; per-kind actions mask / warn / block, an optional same-shape fake key, records written to disk by the day and a statistics card.

title: xevil3301/dsh-chatlock
description: Session password lock plus an encrypted directory vault for DeepSeek Harness.

title: xgone/dsh-remote
description: Secure remote access for the DeepSeek Harness Web UI: a login gate, MFA/TOTP, signed session cookies, optional admin/user/guest roles, in-browser workspace selection, and allowlisted remote file previews.

title: xiangshu2026/dsh-alpha-guard
description: Policy-layer guard that checks tool calls before they run: a read whitelist, a sensitive-path deny list (credentials, browser profiles, chat history, other users' home directories), dangerous-command blocking, subagent isolation, and a static scan that quarantines executables. Every denial is appended to an audit log. It is a text-and-path filter, not a sandbox or antivirus: dynamically built paths, encoded payloads and packed binaries can get past it, and it does not replace the OS antivirus.

title: xiaohuangbo/dsh-conversation-lock
description: Session-level restriction plugin for DeepSeek Harness: the model can close a conversation behind a yellow notice with countdown, disable the Stop button and both response ratings, exclude the session from official Session Log uploads while turning Session OTel off, and block copying of the transcript — each gated by a user-authorized settings switch.

title: xiaohuangbo/dsh-root-bridge
description: Session-level root privilege bridge for DeepSeek Harness: ask mode with per-request web approval, full root mode (polkit password entry in the web UI) and fakeroot mode, with sudo or run0 --empower escalation and a configurable subagent sudo policy. It escalates real commands with sudo or run0: in ask mode each request waits for your approval; in full root mode every bash command of the session runs elevated after one password entry in the web UI. Delegated subagents need per-request approval by default (subagentPolicy: request).

title: XiaoSHang05/dsh-rice-guard
description: Watches a turn's thinking and output streams and cancels the turn when the model starts repeating itself. Four detectors: a verbatim cycle, a counting loop whose lines differ only by a number, repeated lines separated by other text, and a user-supplied phrase list. A catch raises a manual-dismiss alarm card in the global overlay with an optional tone, and a Monitor tab holds the switches, thresholds and hit history. Detection is local string comparison with no model calls, so it costs no tokens.

title: Xieddenv/dsh-brain-kit
description: A hard hat for AI coding: graded writes (L0 read-only / L1 workspace-only / L2 full) put privileged edits in a cage. Below the level it refuses to write and hands back a paste-ready block instead. Every path passes a raw-string traversal check plus realpath, so junction escapes are caught.

title: xiezouqu12/dsh-info-records
description: Encrypted local credential vault for DeepSeek Harness: sidebar record management, an info_records tool for pre-sign-in lookups, opt-in chat capture, per-record manual-only mode, and AES-256-GCM storage protected by Windows DPAPI, the macOS Keychain, or the Linux Secret Service.

title: xlennart/dsh-auto-review-jev
description: Jev Review approval mode for DSH ^0.2.2-rc.1, reviewing each native/PTC inner tool call through System One (Jev or D3), with audit logs and a settings UI; requires the companion Jev host extension. Fork of gbthui/dsh-auto-review; do not install it alongside the upstream, as both gate the same tool-call approvals.

title: xtd1145/dsh-full-access-switch
description: One-time Full access switch for DeepSeek Harness: new sessions (workspaces and conversations) start with danger-full-access and skip the per-session Full access confirmation; installable as a dsh bundle or via patch scripts.

title: xuanyuanchumo/dsh-recency-guard
description: Crash-recovery guard for DeepSeek Harness: records plugin install/update recency plus declared compatibility metadata, blocks the offending suspects before the next boot after a crash, and rolls back to the pre-crash plugin startup state when the disable escalation tops out (keeping only the head suspect disabled). Ships a management panel with an interactive capability graph, impact analysis, an execution log of every guard action, early-warning indicators that only observe (they never disable anything), per-project partition isolation, archive-and-reset, and an offline rescue CLI.

title: YangHua-ovo/dsh-secure-memory
description: Cross-Workspace Memory: local-first, encrypted, per-session authorized memory for DSH.

title: Yazzyk/dsh-file-shield
description: Blocks an agent from reading, searching, writing, or editing chosen files and directories, keeping their contents out of the conversation — including sensitive-word files whose text can make later provider requests fail with a 400. Rules are picked from a file/directory browser on the plugin page.

title: Yersi88/dsh-ollama-tool-guard
description: Local tool guard that scores every DeepSeek Harness tool call with an Ollama decision model before it runs; risky calls come back as an approval prompt, and an unreachable model stops all calls. Requires DSH 0.2.x and a local Ollama 0.35.1+ with the default ~6 GB clef-flash model pulled first; without them every tool call is denied.

title: yiyunet/dsh-proxy-egress
description: DSH plugin: a local egress proxy bridge. Hands a credential-free HTTP(S) proxy URL to consumers that reject credentials, and injects the upstream auth on the hop that needs it. Fail-closed by default: if the upstream fails, traffic is refused rather than falling back to a direct connection. Zero build, zero runtime dependencies.

title: ylwl1997/noatmark-dsh-plugin
description: Text hygiene as a dsh plugin: sanitize untrusted text, scan invisible characters, clean LLM formatting, and escape CSV formula injection.

title: youchen-yc/dsh-security-judge
description: Code security defense review judge for DeepSeek Harness: detects sessions that are writing code, reviews them against the Code Security Defense Architecture Rules, recommends which security architectures the program needs (one or several), checks conflicts between them, teaches the session AI after repeated failures, and teaches the session AI after repeated failures; once you grant it review authority in its panel, it gates task completion until the review passes (without that authorization it only observes).

title: youchen-yc/dsh-system-guard
description: System guard for DeepSeek Harness (Windows-first, protected actions via UAC/sudo): classifies core system files and runtime junk, keeps a hidden SHA-256 backup of core files on the largest free disk, patrols integrity and restores damaged files, and asks for administrator rights only to protect the system. On macOS/Linux it only classifies and hashes (no junk deletion; repair prints manual steps), and that path has not been tested on real hardware.

title: yuloop/dsh-secret-vault
description: Hands secrets and PII to the agent without them entering its context, with checksum-validated extraction and masked content classification.

title: yunling-bionic/dsh-rule-guard
description: Reviews side-effecting tool calls against the project rules and the current goal before they run, and denies anything out of scope with a fail-closed verdict and no bypass switch.

title: Yuuz12/dsh-webui-auth
description: WebUI authentication enforced at the HTTP/transport layer: four-layer login gate (resources, plugin bundles, /api, WebSocket), server-side sessions with HttpOnly cookies.

title: yyfdfsyyf-source/dsh-hard-gate
description: An independent permission gate above the built-in sandbox. It blocks writes outside the workspace and to protected paths even under danger-full-access, refuses whole-file overwrites without a complete fresh read, and keeps ZIP restore points plus Recycle Bin copies before destructive actions.

title: yyjsdsg/dsh-redact
description: Mask secrets, local paths, private IPs, emails and phone numbers in session text before you share or commit it.

title: yzxxy010/dsh-workspace-write-plus
description: Adds a workspace-write++ permission that keeps file tools inside the workspace while skipping the Windows process sandbox for wildcard-allowlisted executables such as Git Bash.

title: zayyehtut/dsh-secret-ask
description: Agent-asked secrets for DeepSeek Harness: a masked card stores API keys and tokens in the local credential store without them entering the chat, then injects them into one command.

title: ZeroClave/zeroclave-dsh-privacy
description: Detect and redact sensitive message text before sending it to models, with local regex, browser BERT, or ZeroClave API detection and manual review.

title: zhang8019/dsh-permission-matrix
description: Turns DSH permissions into 9 selectable presets (3 sandbox modes x 4 approval tiers), with rule plus LLM risk classification across four risk levels, password-gated approval for high-risk operations, and a JSONL audit log.

title: zhangmiao03/cloakpack#dsh-cloak
description: Context firewall for DeepSeek Harness: credentials in successful plain-text tool results become opaque ⟦cloak:category:n⟧ placeholders before they reach the model, with originals kept only in a process-memory, agent-scoped vault. 36 built-in signature families (shared with the cloakpack git pre-push guard), key-name rules for unknown formats, custom regex rules, dry-run mode, an audit log, and the /cloak command.

title: zhengqiuyang/dsh-attest-chain
description: Signed chain-of-custody for sessions: every watched tool result appends a hash-chained, ed25519-signed record, with commits bound into the chain — tampering with any line or truncating the tail fails deterministic replay verification.

title: zhengqiuyang/dsh-compaction-guard
description: Compaction integrity: directive lines (never/must/必须 style markers) extracted from the compacted range are verified against the summary — verbatim or by content-word coverage — and every constraint the session silently forgot is reported and written to a JSONL ledger; pinned constraints from config are checked on every compaction.

title: zhengqiuyang/dsh-egress-gate
description: Deterministic network egress gate: web fetches and searches are checked against a destination allowlist in tools/pre-execute and denied before they run; shell fetch-verbs are observed (enforcement opt-in).

title: zhengqiuyang/dsh-freeze
description: Hermetic composition lock: fingerprints the profile's dependencies, bundle order, lockfile and patch layer; booting a drifted composition warns, or fails under strict mode (the --frozen posture for CI).

title: zhengqiuyang/dsh-mcp-test
description: Tool-surface snapshot and drift gate: baselines the full visible tool registry (name/description/parameters, MCP tools included) into a committable JSON file and warns loudly when an upgrade adds, removes or reshapes a tool.

title: zhengqiuyang/dsh-pr-gate
description: Deterministic write gate: scope policy denies out-of-scope write/edit calls before they touch the disk, residue rules scan the written text, and every decision lands in a content-hashed JSONL ledger; can reuse the repo's agent-pr-gate.yaml so CI and session enforce one policy.

title: zhengqiuyang/dsh-prompt-drift
description: System-prompt surface drift gate: every section any plugin or preset contributes to the assembled system prompt is hashed and baselined; a silent rewrite of what the model is told fails loud.

title: zhengqiuyang/dsh-read-guard
description: Deterministic prompt-injection interception: tool results from file reads, repo searches and web fetches are scanned before they enter model context; high-severity findings quarantine-wrap or block, and credential-material files quarantine on the path alone.

title: zhengqiuyang/dsh-trust-panel
description: Plain-language trust dashboard for the dsh trust family: aggregates the nine channels (injection interception, write denials, egress blocks, custody-chain verification, tool-surface and prompt drift, leftover scans, forgotten compaction constraints, profile composition) into one right-sidebar panel with a single status light and event cards that translate engine jargon into sentences a non-security user can act on; the read and egress engines run from the package's own npm dependencies so those channels work even without the sibling plugins, and absent plugins simply show as not installed.

title: zhkkjF/dsh-cookie-sentinel
description: Raises the local Host's HTTP header budget to 128 KiB and prunes stale dsh-auth cookies only on the launch-token response that mints the replacement, so an already-locked-out desktop profile recovers and later random-port launches stay at one cookie.

title: zhknb/dsh-approval-why
description: Adds a “why does this need escalation?” button to every DSH approval card: it opens a panel with the permission requested, the risk, what refusing means, the exact tool arguments and whether the named paths fall outside the session workspace; the card also keeps a one-line risk and refusal consequence visible under it, and the model’s original reason is split into labelled paragraphs instead of a run-on block.

title: zjuhbh/dsh-full-with-approval
description: Fourth permission preset for dsh: unconfined, GPU-capable sessions (danger-full-access) with per-operation user approval for writes outside the workspace or to protected paths (.git/**, .env*); implemented purely as a bundle over the official tools/pre-execute ask hook, no core edits.

title: zoahdev/dsh-poison-guard
description: Pre-install supply-chain poison scanner for DSH plugins: AST (JS-X-Ray) + deobfuscation + regex heuristics, exits non-zero on findings for CI gating.

title: zoushangkun-dev/dsh-startup-auth-cn
description: Cold-start boot animation for DeepSeek Harness, with an unlock gate in front of the workspace: PIN, Windows Hello or an authenticator code, all local.

title: zzstar101/dsh-sandbox-noop-escalation
description: Removes sandbox_permissions / justification arguments that cannot widen the call's current sandbox mode, so calls no longer fail with 'sandbox escalation to "workspace-write" is not strictly wider than this call's current "danger-full-access" mode'. GPT models tend to fill these optional fields on every call and pick workspace-write, which is narrower than danger-full-access. Runs in tools/pre-execute: compares the requested mode with the mode the session's sandbox policy resolves, and drops the fields when the request is the same or narrower (also drops a lone justification). Also understands the values GPT carries over from Codex's own shell tool: null, empty and use_default are treated as no request, and in a danger-full-access session any value (including require_escalated) is dropped because nothing is wider. Real widening requests, unknown modes and tools that do not advertise DSH's escalation schema are left to DSH core. Never widens permissions. Configurable tool list (default bash, pwsh, write, edit, run_code). Zero dependencies.

title: 01men/kizuna
description: Kizuna agent letterbox: four tools that let an agent read its own inbox (mailbox status, pending letters, one letter in full) and answer a letter with completed / failed / input-required / working state. Kizuna is an agent directory with a reliable task relay: a per-agent kizuna-box on the same machine holds the inbox, retries unanswered deliveries after 3 / 10 / 30 / 60 / 120 minutes and records every delivery attempt in an append-only trail. The plugin talks to the local loopback box only and holds no credential.

title: 1032740078/dsh-web-url-view
description: Adds a View URL page to Settings showing the running session tokenized Web address plus a stable fixed address that survives desktop restarts and is reachable from other devices on the same LAN.

title: 2090003781/bridge#dsh-bridge-connector
description: Loopback HTTP/SSE service that lets an Obsidian plugin drive DSH sessions and tells the model where you are reading (path, size, cursor line, heading, selection — coordinates only, the note body stays on disk); gives the agent its own separate cursor inside the editor; the companion plugin must be running in Obsidian.

title: 2710586329/dsh-qq
description: Bridges QQ into DeepSeek Harness over OneBot 11: private and group chats, on-device voice-to-text, image support, and ten interaction tools (poke, react, like, image, file, recall and more). Needs an OneBot 11 implementation such as NapCat running alongside.

title: 452926826/dsh-feishu-bot
description: Connect Feishu chats to DeepSeek Harness projects, conversations, replies, and scoped tool approvals over WebSocket.

title: 452926826/dsh-ssh-logs
description: Read and search logs and run permitted commands over SSH according to configured permissions.

title: 534119219/chicheng-gate
description: LAN / remote-access control, frpc NAT tunneling, a panel password gate, and mobile UI adaptation for the DSH Web GUI.

title: 6mt/dsh-plugin-loopback-trust
description: Restores Host-persisted settings when dsh web is reached through a reverse proxy on a non-loopback hostname: marks the page connection as host-owning so the Settings and model pages load instead of reporting "settings are unavailable in this browser". For dsh 0.1.7 – 0.2.x.

title: A754-01/dsh-remote-access-qr
description: Remote access for DeepSeek Harness: expose this machine's DSH Web GUI through an SSH reverse tunnel and a QR gate — scan and enter. Requires your own Linux server with root SSH access plus nginx, openssl and qrencode; it rewrites that server's nginx config, and the QR link is a one-year login secret, so treat it like a password.

title: abbaababa/dsh-mobile-access
description: Open a Mac or Windows DeepSeek Harness Web instance from iPhone or iPad Safari: 8-digit pairing, a LAN gateway for loopback-only hosts, optional Tailscale Serve, and iOS-only Safari input and touch fixes. Installs with dsh plugin add.

title: AcidGr/dsh-web-lan-access
description: LAN/remote access for the Web UI: injects a crypto.randomUUID polyfill on plain-HTTP origins so the frontend survives LAN or Tailscale IP direct links.

title: afeack/dsh-mobile-harness#dsh-mobile-harness
description: Remote access gateway for DSH: a browser, or the optional 4 MB Android app, scans a QR code and joins the session already running on the desktop. One-time QR tickets (10 minutes, single use), a 6-digit pairing code matched on both screens, four network entries (SakuraFrp / Cloudflare quick tunnel / LAN / Tailscale), and per-device admission: an online-device limit, online devices pinned first with a green dot, and remove = disconnect plus revoke trust. The gateway listens on 127.0.0.1 only.

title: ahian-lee/dsh-ssh-workspace
description: SSH workspaces for Windows DeepSeek Harness Desktop 0.2: discover OpenSSH hosts, add or browse remote project directories, and route file, search and Bash operations by workspace while the DSH runtime stays local. A Desktop compatibility fork of Yan-Zero/dsh-remote-ssh that preserves local permission defaults.

title: ai-eks/dsh-auth-tunnel
description: Password-gated public access for the DSH Web GUI through quick or named Cloudflare Tunnels, with HTTP/WebSocket proxying and an in-app directory picker.

title: AIcivilization/dsh-vps
description: One-command VPS deployment for DeepSeek Harness: a zero-dependency login gateway with automatic HTTPS that proxies the native web UI, a token-protected setup wizard, and one-click DSH upgrades with automatic rollback; as a plugin it adds Settings → VPS Deploy to install DSH on (or remove it from) a VPS over SSH from a form, plus version, upgrade, gateway status and a QR code to add DSH to a phone's home screen.

title: AIcivilization/dsh-vps-manager
description: Manage VPS servers over SSH key login: 23 zero-token /vps- commands (status queries, recipe installs with a plan and /vps-yes confirmation, reboot that waits for the machine to come back), an in-conversation terminal (xterm.js over ssh -tt) for interactive programs, 5 agent tools with risk-tiered confirmation, file backup with automatic restore and a firewall/SSH safety net, 29 built-in recipes, and a settings page for adding machines.

title: aleksvega/dsh-tg-bridge
description: Drive a dsh agent from Telegram: one chat topic per project directory, voice and photo input, ordered per-topic job queue, per-topic goals and task checklists, session forks and branches, live progress message, command menu in en/ru/zh, and control commands for models, plugins, sessions and logs. Search the plugin registry, read a package card before installing, and update every plugin with one tap. Requires a Telegram bot token and your numeric user id in allowedUserIds.

title: alextangson/dsh-dispatch#plugin
description: Phone-side command center rather than a web-UI mirror: dispatch tasks into isolated git worktrees from a PWA, tool-approval push notifications with phone/desktop first-answer-wins racing (never auto-approved), a multi-machine session board, and an end-to-end encrypted zero-knowledge relay you can self-host.

title: andyfan1094/dsh-winrm
description: Manage Windows hosts over WinRM from a web panel and seven agent tools with PowerShell exec, service and process control, SMB / chunked file transfer with SHA-256 verification, and cluster execution.

title: ANetResearch/ANet#dsh-anet
description: Connects DSH to a local anet node through a stdio MCP client, with three skills and 14 tools to discover agents on the AgentNetwork, send, track and answer end-to-end encrypted A2A tasks, pay or decline priced skills within the operator's limits, read the local evidence chain and report the node state. Linux/macOS only; requires an anet 0.3.0+ node running locally.

title: Aperops/dsh-rfiles
description: Adds chunked uploads with progress and resume, and native downloads of workspace files and the session log ZIP, to the DSH Web GUI, including sessions reached through a paired remote link.

title: AprilCrystal/dsh-remote
description: OpenAI-compatible HTTP endpoint for DSH sessions plus a phone panel that reads transcripts, browses files, sends or queues messages, and answers approvals and questions.

title: ArimaKana-Akane/dsh-sakurafrp
description: Manage the SakuraFrp phone-to-desktop link from the DSH interface - link status, mobile gateway switch, one-time pairing QR code, device revoke and gateway self-heal.

title: dsh-qq-bot
description: Connects DeepSeek Harness to QQ over OneBot 11/12, Satori, Milky or the official QQ bot API, with a separate session per group or private chat and nine built-in tools: group management, chat history with image understanding, web search, page fetching, reverse image search and image generation. Optional proactive chatter reads recent messages on an interval and decides whether to join in, with the judging and speaking stages able to use different models. Models, proxy and allowlists are configured in the DSH settings page. First run requires an owner (auth.owners): with it empty the plugin drives no sessions at all (deny by default, so installing it does not expose the bot); once set, private chats and groups work immediately, guests only reach the guest tool allowlist while qqbot and qqconfig stay owner-only.

title: Artenx/dsh-honeybee#dshb
description: Routes DSH filesystem, shell, subprocess, and PTY operations to local, SSH, and Docker execution nodes, with a node registry, an authentication gate, a mobile-aware management UI, and per-workspace custom project instructions.

title: Autumn984/dsh-remote
description: Control DeepSeek Harness from a phone via QR code: read chats, send messages, upload images, over LAN, IPv6, or a Cloudflare tunnel.

title: AXTUT/dsh-plugin-dualtransfer-trial#dualtransfer
description: Cross-computer Harness Agent messaging and task handoff; pairing, binding and the receiver's existing local authorization remain required. Not open source (UNLICENSED evaluation build, not for production); requires Node.js 24+, tested only on macOS arm64 and Windows 11 x64 build 22621+. Its last full install-and-run test was on DSH 0.2.1-rc.2; on 0.2.2-rc.1 only the version gate has been checked.

title: AyahaShirane/dsh-network-continue
description: Maintained continuation of dsh-network: authenticated LAN, Tailnet and HTTPS access to a DSH host, with pairing QR and current Web browser-auth support. Replaces the upstream dsh-network (remove it first; both register the same /dsh-network routes); the gateway listens on 0.0.0.0:3081 by default, set bindHost to restrict it.

title: Aztech-Lab/dsh-3301
description: Password-optional LAN entry for the DSH Web GUI. DSH stays loopback-only while a settings-card plugin serves its HTTP and WebSocket traffic on port 3301, storing the password only as a scrypt verifier.

title: azure5100/huahua-dsh-chatroom
description: Install-time patch guard for cross-machine DSH group chat: fixes dsh-weave rc.14 defects (inject crash, random UDP port, 4KB ack frame limit) with four idempotent patches, alongside setup, mechanism and ops docs for the dsh-chat x dsh-weave x dsh-bridge chatroom stack.

title: baixianger/dsh-network
description: Authenticated LAN, Tailnet, and public HTTPS access for a DSH Host, with persistent host identity, pairing, and QR setup.

title: baixianger/dsh-weave
description: Trusted Iroh mesh networking for DSH hosts, with encrypted peer discovery, remote session delivery, and reachability status.

title: baosfeng/my-dsh-plugins#dsh-my-remote
description: Remote control: pushes ask / approval / session-end events to an external channel webhook and lets you answer, approve, query status or continue a session from your phone with token auth (npm: `dsh-my-remote`).

title: bbtssama/dsh-webui-mobile
description: Mobile web shell for the DSH Web GUI: overlay drawers, draggable FAB, mobile composer fixes, and a floating image-upload button pinned above the composer (native gallery/camera, integrated with the validated add-images pipeline), zero desktop regression. Published on npm as dsh-webui-mobile.

title: BeastyZ/dsh-remote-agent
description: SSH workbench for launching remote agent CLIs with durable sessions, terminal, file editing, Git worktrees and local port forwarding. It drives the local OpenSSH client (macOS/Linux; remote Linux with GNU coreutils, tmux optional) to run commands, edit files and forward ports on any host from ~/.ssh/config, with host-key checking defaulting to accept-new; the last 512K characters of each terminal's output are saved under ~/.dsh/remote-agent/terminals. It uses the same package name and mount id as zbzbhs/dsh-remote-agent, so the two collide if installed together.

title: beiheng127/dsh-dfy-qq
description: QQ chat behaviour layer for DeepSeek Harness over OneBot 11: persona files injected into every turn, a people file keyed by QQ number, sticker picking with probability and pity, optional non-mention replies, sub-personas distilled from group members, and scheduled messages. Enabling the built-in QQ channel accepts private messages from any QQ user and group messages from any group that @s the bot; there is no sender allowlist, so restrict the bot account or keep the channel off.

title: Bernardxu123/dsh-mobile-gate
description: LAN mobile gateway: isolated child-process reverse proxy with first-visit approval, per-device token binding, rate limiting, and mobile layout injection (compact composer pills, randomUUID polyfill).

title: better-er/dsh-remote-file-system
description: Model-visible SSH file tools read_remote, write_remote and edit_remote: read a remote UTF-8 file with line-numbered paging, create a new remote file (an existing target is refused, there is no overwrite branch), and apply literal replacements with unique-match checking — all addressed through a single "alias:path" field whose alias comes from ~/.ssh/config.

title: bigbigtooth/DSH-DevOps-Plugin
description: Remote operations for the DSH Web app: manages SSH servers, collects hardware and process metrics, inspects logs with a read-only AI pass, and deploys a Git repo over SSH using git pull --ff-only plus a health check. Credentials are AES-256-GCM encrypted. Linux and macOS hosts; no Windows support.

title: Blank-not-black/dsh-Remote#plugin
description: Mobile remote-control suite: bundle plugin with native sidebar entry and admin drawer, self-healing bearer-token gateway over LAN/Tailscale, Android app (sessions/approvals/questions/goals), /fs/* file transfer (Range resume, 2GB upload), latency-based multi-server auto-switch, offline chat cache.

title: boldandigital/dsh-google-drive
description: Connect Google Drive accounts in the Settings, browse their files in a Drive tab of the right sidebar, and drag a file straight into the conversation. You create your own Google OAuth client (or service-account key) in Google Cloud Console; the plugin can read and write the Drive of the accounts you connect, and downloads a file only when you ask.

title: BotonJ/dsh-remote-link
description: Secure remote access for the official Web UI: authenticated LAN/tunnel gateway with QR + HMAC one-time pairing, per-device sessions and revocation, mDNS discovery, and a fork_session tool.

title: btsd321/dsh-remote-explorer
description: Remote development launcher for DeepSeek Harness: provisions dsh on a remote host via SSH (or a local WSL distro) and connects from the local client, with LLM credentials proxied through a reverse tunnel so they never leave the local machine. Ships as both a standalone CLI and a dsh plugin with a session panel, /remote-explorer slash command and remote_* agent tools.

title: buger-gif/dsh-remote-huaweicloud-devbridge#dsh-plugin
description: Remote control for DeepSeek Harness over an outbound Huawei Cloud DevBridge tunnel: a sidebar seat and a standalone control page start and stop the tunnel and show its public URL, QR code and logs. The plugin's own gateway stays on 127.0.0.1, checks a rotatable access token or HMAC session cookie, rate-limits failures and strips external identity headers before forwarding to DSH, so no inbound port is opened. The tunnel is off by default; tokens and state stay under ~/.dsh. Requires a Huawei Cloud account and devbridge CLI v0.2.x. The relay terminates TLS and can see plaintext HTTP — this is access control, not end-to-end encryption.

title: Buzzso/dsh-sev
description: Manage your own remote DSH host from the local GUI: SSH tunnels, mixed remote session list, one-click remote GUI, auto-healing tunnels.

title: caoyiwei850/dsh-ssh-ops
description: SSH ops terminal for DSH Web UI: drive a connected server from the main conversation (ssh_connect/ssh_exec/ssh_read/ssh_write/ssh_disconnect) while keeping an interactive xterm.js terminal on the right.

title: cccodder/dsh-remote-console
description: Right-sidebar SSH terminal for DSH where you and your agent share one PTY: 16 agent tools, configurable transfer limit, session-isolated audit trail, one-click in-place updates.

title: CCYellowStar2/dsh-astrbot-ingress
description: Drive a local DeepSeek Harness agent from QQ and other IM channels through AstrBot: send tasks with /dsh, continue by quoting or @-mentioning the bot, answer approvals and ask_user_question prompts from chat (in parallel with the DSH web UI), and get results, inline images and file cards back. Ships session / workspace / model / permission commands, /compact and /last recovery, three progress-display modes, and group-shared or per-user session scoping.

title: chanyuenpang/dsh-cindy-host
description: Host-side plugin that links the Cindy mobile app to DSH: phone channels for sessions, messages, approvals, todos and goals, plus a settings card.

title: chenacc1/agentbridge#dsh-phone
description: Pairs a phone console with the current DSH Desktop conversation. Running /phone shows a one-time QR code; after pairing the phone can send messages, approve tool calls, switch models and stop the task, while the desktop stays the only execution host. Requires AgentBridge running locally.

title: ChenJun25/dsh-console-plugin
description: Pair a phone with this computer's DSH instance by QR code or a six-digit code, then drive it remotely — send instructions, view images, answer approvals — from the panel, with public-tunnel support for pairing across networks.

title: chinahhy/DSH-plugins#dsh-tether-ios
description: iOS remote companion for DSH Desktop 0.2.0-rc.2 on macOS Apple Silicon, with pairing, approval notifications, and device revocation.

title: Cike-money/dsh-qq-bridge
description: Bridge QQ (via NapCat) into DeepSeek Harness, turning private and group chats into session prompts and sending replies back to QQ.

title: cindyguyuehu123/dsh-mobile
description: Use DSH from iPhone/iPad: an explicit-opt-in LAN reverse proxy (Host/Origin rewrite through the loopback trust fence, WebSocket upgrades included), iOS PWA chrome (home-screen icon, standalone meta, viewport-fit), and touch/mobile CSS (safe areas, keyboard lifting, composer row fit).

title: CJYLZS/dsh-remote-development
description: Remote development over SSH: pick a directory on a registered machine as the session workspace and the file, shell, bash, and search tools run on the remote host — the agent works there with the same local tools, and no extra model-facing tools are added.

title: Clarklevis1995/dsh-plugin-mobile-gateway
description: Authenticated mobile gateway for DeepSeek Harness: connects the companion native iOS client over WebSocket for sessions, live events, tasks, goals, approvals, commands, and file transfers, with QR pairing and device revocation.

title: clarknu/dsh-gateway
description: HTTPS + login gateway for the DeepSeek Harness web surface: access your DSH Web UI securely from another machine on your LAN, or from the internet via port forwarding. Fail-closed defaults (loopback-only, no accounts until configured); setup and security notes in the README.

title: CLASSLU/dsh-telegram-bridge
description: Remote-control your dsh agent from Telegram: chat, skills, workspace browsing, and file transfer.

title: cnHuaShao/dsh-remote-server-manager
description: Remote Linux server manager in the Harness Web UI: browse and edit files, inspect host status, start/stop/restart Docker containers, inspect images, configure Docker registry mirrors, manage firewalld/ufw rules, switch apt sources, and detect developer tools or install/upgrade them with apt.

title: copylee711/dsh-remote-control
description: Continue the sessions on your computer from a phone browser: scan a QR code, approve the device on the computer, then chat, answer approvals, browse workspace files and manage settings in a mobile interface; connects over the same Wi-Fi or through a Cloudflare Quick Tunnel.

title: CREAIT-nl/dsh-plugins#tailnet-gateway
description: Identity-gated Tailscale access to the Web GUI with dsh still bound to loopback: a 127.0.0.1 proxy published by `tailscale serve` admits a request only when the Tailscale login it stamps is allowed, with an optional per-device allowlist, so the privileged /api methods behind the loopback check — Settings, Models, Plugins — answer without dsh being told to trust a remote host.

title: cube-ai/dsh-feishu-channels
description: Connect one or more Feishu bot apps to the local DeepSeek Harness (DSH): each bot app is a channel with its own model, workspace, permissions and private-chat allowlist, and every chat under it gets its own DSH session. Derived from MichengAI/dsh-im-connect (Apache-2.0) with the other IM channels removed and identifiers renamed so both can be installed side by side.

title: cube-ai/dsh-feishu-client
description: DSH Feishu Client. 1) Users (humans) access remote agents through the UI provided by this plugin; 2) The local DSH accesses remote agents by calling the tools provided by this plugin. Supported remote agents include but are not limited to DSH, OpenClaw, WorkBuddy, Weknora, etc.

title: CWNU-Open-Source-Community/dsh-webgate
description: Remote access for the DSH Web GUI: LAN QR access, cloudflared quick tunnels, and frp reverse proxying via your own server, with a built-in auth portal.

title: CY-W-2000/dsh-lan-access
description: LAN access gateway for the Web UI: serve DSH on localhost or 0.0.0.0 with password protection or an explicit no-password mode plus expiry presets, and open a separate chat-only port that other agents can drive over HTTP with selectable workspace, token or token-free auth, and its own expiry.
