LAN sharing is opt-in: it rebinds the Web UI port to 0.0.0.0, gives other devices the full DSH interface behind a password (the default), and an explicit no-password mode needs you to confirm a security warning.

title: cyuni1996/dsh-watch
description: Continue DeepSeek Harness conversations on an Android watch and install the watch app with a desktop wizard.

title: czp0312/dsh-ssh-workspace
description: Keep SSH, WSL and Docker projects in the native DSH sidebar. Group directories by environment while choosing full remote DSH or lightweight local Agent mode per project. Manage shared full-backend connections together, keep lightweight connections independent, and selectively sync local Skills with difference previews. Aimed at the Windows desktop client with Linux, WSL or Linux-container remotes that have Python 3 and Bash (macOS and Linux hosts untested); lightweight SSH needs an existing SSHFS mount, and Docker has not yet been run against a live daemon.

title: DamonKoy/dsh-web-ui#dsh-remote-web-ui
description: Mobile remote control for the dsh web GUI: scan-to-pair QR entry with one-time pairing tokens.

title: DamonKoy/dsh-web-ui#dsh-ssh
description: Remote SSH operations for the dsh web GUI: host config store and persisted sessions.

title: danilinao/dsh-telegram-channel-ru
description: Telegram remote for DeepSeek Harness — attach a live web session from your phone and answer its questions there, with a Russian UI. Russian fork of hi-wenw/dsh-telegram-channel (MIT).

title: datit309/dsh-telegram-bridge
description: Two-way Telegram remote cockpit for DeepSeek Harness: live progress tracking, screenshot vision, git diffs, shell execution, and tool approvals. Unconfigured chatId automatically claims the first sender as owner; voice-to-text requires local ffmpeg and BeeRouter services.

title: David060323/dsh-phone-remote
description: iOS home-screen fix and always-on kit for DeepSeek Harness remote access: overrides the PWA manifest start_url to /pair-app so the phone icon stops hitting the harness 401, and ships a hidden watchdog that keeps the desktop host and its tunnel alive while the PC is on. Requires @linxin666/dsh-remote-web-ui (it serves /pair-app); the watchdog scripts are Windows-only.

title: dingchenhui0618-arch/dsh-in-hand
description: Phone client for DeepSeek Harness — no app to install (PWA). Read sessions, background jobs, subagents, goal rounds, workflows and pending approvals, and talk to any session from it: streamed replies, tool-call progress, stop at any time, switch sessions and models. Also ships a GUI sidebar panel. Formerly dsh-taskwatch; the npm package is now dsh-in-hand.

title: dingminhua/dsh-service-portal
description: Exposes any local service on a LAN address and a public cloudflared quick-tunnel domain behind one password login, with per-route open/block gates managed from the plugin settings page. Requires Python 3 and cloudflared on the machine, and reports either of them being missing or misconfigured in the settings page before you start; LAN and local access are passwordless by default, while the public tunnel requires the passcode.

title: Diomchen/dsh-cross-agent
description: Peer sessions between DeepSeek Harness instances on a LAN: UDP discovery, an explicit one-way allow list with open or confirm approval, HMAC-signed HTTP with a ±60 s window and nonce replay protection, a `跨端 · <peer>` session for delivered prompts, two-phase file transfer up to 100 MiB with SHA-256 receipts, and seven agent tools that call the named tools listed in `exposedTools` on the receiving side. Its local /cross-agent panel routes are guarded only by a loopback check, without DSH's Host/Origin admission.

title: donoteatme/dsh-local-link
description: Browser-first, LAN-only access to the current DeepSeek Harness Web UI with one-time QR pairing, revocable devices, event-driven diagnostics, and a slot-preserving mobile layout; no companion app, cloud relay, or remote tunnel.

title: drliuhuan/dsh-plugin-feishu-im
description: Feishu IM bridge for dsh: create a dedicated Feishu bot by scanning a QR code, get one Card JSON 2.0 notice per finished turn, answer tool approvals and structured questions from the chat, and drive a session from it — listing and switching the bound session with /sessions and /resume, steering a running turn, and choosing per-chat permission modes (read-only, workspace, Auto Review, full). Long output paginates instead of being cut. Owner binding: the QR scan binds the scanner; with manually entered credentials the first sender claims ownership and everyone else is refused.

title: drscrewdriver/dsh-im-union
description: Union IM bridge for DSH — an independent implementation uniting the capability sets of community peer plugins (xmanrui/dsh-im, MichengAI/dsh-im-connect). Drive your agent session from 15 channel adapters across 12 platforms (including email; WeCom/DingTalk/QQ each contribute two: bot + self-built app or notify tier) — WeChat (official iLink QR bind), Feishu/Lark (long-connection + streaming cards; the voice tier requires system ffmpeg), Telegram, Discord, WeCom intelligent bot & self-built app (signed callback), DingTalk (stream + AI Card and custom-robot notify), QQ official bot (plus notify tier), Slack (Socket Mode), WhatsApp (Baileys QR pairing; the dependency ships as an optionalDependency of the plugin package), Matrix, iMessage (macOS only), Email (IMAP/SMTP thread routing). The cross-version narrow waist auto-adapts settings gen1/gen2/gen3 across hosts 0.1.2-rc.1→0.2.1-rc.2 (12-tag enum; rc.2 verified by a real desktop-profile install with double read-back) using capability probing only, never version branches. In chat: a 25-command panel, tool-approval and question loops answered in the originating chat (deny-by-default, initiator-only, 5-min expiry), image/file input gated on host model metadata, deliverable file return, a delivery log with bounded retry (uncertain is never re-sent), proactive delivery and fragment composition. It also splits the native sidebar into self-owned Tasks / Channels tabs (standing down entirely when another plugin already owns the slot), registers an `im-concise` agent preset plus reply sanitisation that keeps GenUI fences and raw HTML out of text-only chats, renders `svg` fences to PNG images, guards model choice with an allowlist, and mirrors each turn's final answer to notify channels via `/relay` (addressed by account ID or alias, never guessed on ambiguity). Secrets are one-way into the vault and never echoed back. npm: `dsh-im-union`.

title: dsh-publish/dsh-pair-quick
description: Mints a fresh remote-web-ui pairing link and shows its QR in the dsh settings page.

title: dsh-remote/plugin
description: Approve tool calls, watch streaming output and answer questions from a phone over a zero-knowledge relay, with payload-level end-to-end encryption.

title: dsh-ssh/dsh-ssh#dsh-ssh
description: SSH remote workspace — run bash, file tools, glob and grep on a remote machine over plain sshd (exec + SFTP), zero remote install, purely additive.

title: dualface/quicktui-dsh
description: Sets up QuickTUI from a dsh plugin page: installs QuickTUI server on macOS and Linux, pairs the phone app by QR code, and connects dsh sessions so the app can follow them, answer approvals and questions, send prompts, and interrupt turns.

title: ebhrz/dsh-relay#plugin
description: Phone access to a local DeepSeek Harness through a relay you run: QR pairing, request payloads sealed end to end, and a host machine that opens no inbound port.

title: erty3244/dsh-feishu-bridge
description: Feishu (Lark) IM bridge over a self-built app long connection: forwards inbound chat messages into a DSH session and posts the reply back to the same chat. Dedupe, allow-lists, ack text, dry-run. Self-trigger was split out into dsh-self-trigger.

title: Eternalloveone/dsh-palm#dsh-palm
description: Standalone mobile surface for dsh: scan-to-pair device trust, realtime SSE sync, three-channel completion notifications (in-app / Web Push / Server酱·Bark·Telegram), offline outbox, approval & question panels, per-provider usage meters, PWA; a native narrow-screen phone UI.

title: evanfang0054/dsh-tailscale-console
description: Tailscale remote-access operations panel for the dsh web GUI: health checks, HTTPS entry toggle via tailscale serve, macOS proxy bypass, relay server ops, and ACL snippet generation.

title: EviMing/dsh-qq-shell-commands
description: Run shell commands on the host instead of inside DSH, triggered by exact-match QQ messages through NapCat, and DM the result; requires EviMing/dsh-napcat-tools. plus Python 3.10+ for napcat_api.

title: fanrj3/dsh-presence
description: Work on any machine in your ssh config as if it were local: persistent connections, native file editing, search, exec and terminals, with nothing installed on the remote host.

title: feng-yifan/dsh-plugins#dsh-enhancement
description: Web GUI enhancement bundle: a standalone password gateway (optional HTTPS via your own certificate or a self-signed local CA) for LAN and remote access without `?token=`, PWA install with icon and app name, desktop and mobile Web Push notifications for task/approval events, and optional session-id request-header injection for third-party OpenAI-compatible routes, all configured from a settings page.

title: Firefox2100/dsh-proxy-trust
description: Lets the DSH Web UI run behind an authenticating reverse proxy, with separate controls for trusted hosts, login bypass, cross-site navigation, local-page trust, and an optional network listener.

title: flyhigao/dsh-produced-file-paths
description: Displays and copies absolute paths for files produced by DSH turns in remote Web.

title: flymysql/dsh-remote
description: SSH remote workspaces for DSH with parallel projects across hosts, file browsing and editing, recursive search, terminals, Git diffs, and Agent tools to edit, build and test remotely. Optional IDE layout.

title: FORGE-131/dsh-lan-pair
description: Phone access to the DSH web UI: LAN pairing plus remote access through your own tunnel command (e.g. cloudflared) or a fixed public URL, with automatic LAN-to-tunnel failover and dshlanpair:// deep links; the phone client is the bundled Android app (APK, Android 8+, sideloaded).

title: framecy/dsh-ssh-shell
description: Password SSH into a remote host: an ssh_remote tool with connect/exec/close/status over a persistent ControlMaster session, plus a floating browser terminal panel on a real PTY.

title: fzcohq/dsh-ipv6-gate
description: IPv6 remote-access gateway for DSH: PIN-protected HTTPS reverse proxy with a Let's Encrypt certificate (DNS-01 via DuckDNS), QR scan-to-connect and a settings page, no relay in the data path. Needs a public IPv6 address (detected on Windows and Linux only, not macOS), a free DuckDNS subdomain and token, and inbound ports 8787/8788 open on the router; the AAAA record is only auto-updated when the plugin config sets ddns or tls.

title: gaolin89898/dsh-kite
description: P2P, end-to-end encrypted remote access to DeepSeek Harness, CodeX, Claude Code, Pi and other agent workspaces from web and mobile clients. Remote connections are coordinated through a hosted server (remote.gaolin.ink by default; you can point it at your own) and you sign in with an account there. It installs under the package name ds-harness-remote, the same as liguobao/ds-harness-remote, so install only one of them.

title: gaolin89898/remote-session-plugin
description: Switches between local and remote DSH workspaces and sessions, with optional plugin sync; requires your own relay server.

title: Gaudi-XIX/dsh-pocket-glide
description: Turn DSH's phone side into one thumb-reachable column: the host renders pages for narrow screens, zero build, no front-end framework, no desktop pixels streamed. The order is responsiveness > honest state > familiarity > brand > looks. A WeChat push opens the workspace with the conversation on top; sends appear optimistically, streaming never steals your scroll, approvals and queued prompts happen on the phone, plus new sessions, model switching, image and file uploads, and sub-agent rows. The DS Bot team is a tap away with member DMs, group chat and tool-approval cards. Pair over LAN by QR, or go out through a Cloudflare quick tunnel; after a restart the next push carries the new address. A shell byte budget is asserted in tests.

title: godchen520/dsh-web-remote
description: Access DSH from your phone or anywhere: Cloudflare Quick Tunnel public link, LAN HTTP/HTTPS direct access with an auto-generated self-signed certificate, token auth, gzip compression, a floating phone-icon panel with QR codes, configurable public URL and LAN port, and WeChat / Feishu / Telegram bot channels with per-channel health monitoring and session-completion push. Targets DSH 0.2.x (also works on 0.1.2-rc.1+).

title: Golden-Pigeon/dsh-remote#packages/local-plugin
description: Native SSH remote development for DSH: remote workspaces, mirrored sessions, terminal and file access, approvals, and a DSH UI. Requires DSH Desktop 0.2.1-rc.2 and a remote host running Linux or macOS.

title: GooDAnDReaDY/dsh-lanmode
description: LAN and reverse-proxy access to the DeepSeek Harness web UI: returns the settings service on pages that are not localhost, fills in the web APIs a browser withholds over plain HTTP, and can open a listener of its own.

title: GooDAnDReaDY/dsh-remote-workspace
description: SSH/SFTP remote workspaces with conflict-aware mirror sync, port forwarding, and a native Web UI.

title: guzhou079-arch/dsh-plugin-android-vscreen
description: Launch Android apps on a virtual display and drive them with screen reading, taps and swipes, leaving the main screen untouched.

title: gxfc9867/campfire#dsh-campfire
description: Bridges campfire group chats into DeepSeek Harness, delivering messages addressed to your member into a DSH session and posting the reply back to the group. Needs a self-hosted campfire server plus a member handle and channel token; anyone who @-mentions that member in the configured chat can start a turn.

title: HandsYe/dsh-remote-status
description: Sidebar status chip that follows the visible session and shows local or remote with machine name, plus hover diagnostics; never modifies workspace titles.

title: Heart3-XDUGT2/dsh-qq-bridge
description: QQ bridge for the dsh-memory-agent (Echo) companion: OneBot 11 plus an optional official QQ text transport, bounded group context, file handling and delivery auditing. Requires dsh-memory-agent; the OneBot path also needs a OneBot 11 client such as NapCat or SnowLuma, and the official transport is a separate opt-in package in the same repo.

title: heavenJiang/dsh-switchboard
description: Command DeepSeek Harness from Telegram and Feishu (Lark): one live progress message per turn, approvals and questions as buttons, files and voice, delivery that survives outages and restarts, QR setup for Feishu, and per-person roles.

title: Henvy-Mango/dsh-porthole
description: LAN access portal for DeepSeek Harness running on a NAS or other always-on host, letting a phone browser reach the DSH instance on that device; intranet penetration is supported through external tunnels such as frps or EasyTier. Its HTTP/WebSocket reverse proxy is specifically optimized for subdomains, subpaths and second-level directories (login entry, Location and Cookie Path adapt automatically), and adds opt-in visitor/administrator password protection plus remote workspace registration. Derived from wenbin-wb/dsh-bridge v2.17.8 (MIT, several modules reused verbatim); both default to port 3082, so change one port before running both.

title: Hongjun1-RGB/dsh-phone-access
description: Adds a toggle to the DSH UI that opens the current session to a phone browser through an embedded loopback reverse proxy and a Cloudflare quick tunnel, and pushes each new tunnel address to WeChat.

title: hoshino114/dsh-server-box
description: SSH server dashboard for DSH: per-host status, CPU, memory, disk and network meters, trend charts, an xterm.js terminal, SFTP file transfer, and server_box_hosts / server_box_exec / server_box_upload / server_box_download chat tools; imports ~/.ssh/config and mounts as a sidebar tab or a standalone drawer.

title: huajikano/dsh-PEC
description: Control a DeepSeek Harness session from an Android phone: pair over Wi-Fi or Tailscale, follow the live transcript, send prompts, switch model, mode and permission, browse workspace files, run a terminal and change settings.

title: Huangzihengcmd/dsh-wechat-assistant
description: Drive DeepSeek Harness from WeChat: scan a QR code to sign in, send instructions in WeChat, and the agent reply lands back in the same chat window. Several agents can share one WeChat account, each with its own model, preset and context, switched from the chat with /use. Only the configured owner WeChat account can drive the agent; other senders are rejected by default and require explicit approval.

title: huanlanmie/dsh-mobile-access
description: A PIN-protected, chat-only mobile web client for DeepSeek Harness, served on an isolated port over LAN or a self-provided tunnel.

title: hutao562/dsh-remote-dsh
description: Adds a row at the top of the sidebar that switches the whole Web GUI to another DSH host reached over a loopback port, and shows that host's session state on the row (running, unread activity, or waiting for your answer).

title: hzh5021/dsh-qq
description: Bridges a OneBot QQ bot into DSH: the owner's direct messages open a session on the same home, answers go back to QQ, and files named with \[SEND_FILE: path] are delivered. Needs a OneBot v11 implementation with a forward WebSocket (such as NapCat) and ownerId set in the config, otherwise every message is ignored. The home it shares with the main session is provided by the separately installed dsh-wakeup plugin. It also runs an unauthenticated local status endpoint on 127.0.0.1:3002 with open CORS that returns the owner QQ number, the login QR code and recent log lines (including the first 60 characters of incoming messages).

title: IceApriler/dsh-remote-mobile
description: Remote & mobile security gateway: zero-modification Tailscale/LAN access with QR pairing, RSA encryption, brute-force defense and mobile style snippets; auto-yields the shared pairing service to other remote plugins so coexistence never crashes startup.

title: icodesign/orbis#orbis-remote-dsh
description: Native iOS and Android apps for remote control of DeepSeek Harness, with end-to-end encryption, workspace browsing, and real-time session updates.

title: idoall/dsh-lan-guard
description: LAN access for the official DSH Web UI through a gated reverse proxy: DSH keeps its own loopback binding, and a second port adds a password gate, self-signed HTTPS and per-device pairing that can be revoked individually, with a QR code to open it from a phone.

title: iimaguest/phone-tunnel-pool
description: Self-healing Cloudflare quick-tunnel pool for the dsh web GUI: floating widget with QR phone access, generational rotation, chase service worker and prompt-free credential handoff.

title: ijry/DeepSeek-Harness-Desktop-Ultra#dsh-plugin-mobile-bridge
description: Token-authenticated REST and SSE bridge with QR pairing, so a phone app can read sessions, send messages and approve tool calls.

title: Illuminated2020/dsh-lark-claw
description: Feishu/Lark gateway for DeepSeek Harness with topic-persistent conversations, live execution cards, image and file inputs, in-chat approvals and questions, source allowlists, and durable one-time or recurring agent tasks created in natural language.

title: Imzl-zl/deepseek-harness-mobile#connector
description: Desktop side of a native Android DSH phone app: scan a QR code to pair, then chat, approve tool calls, answer questions, drive subagents and follow background jobs from the phone over an end-to-end-encrypted channel; one device at a time.

title: ivanant/dsh-simple-remote
description: Reach DSH from your phone with a single plugin — requires Tailscale on both the host and the phone. No other configuration needed.

title: januory/deepseek-harness-gateway#dsh-gateway-agent
description: Customer-machine access plugin for deepseek-harness-gateway: opens a single outbound WebSocket to the gateway and relays the machine local dsh web UI over that tunnel using pairing-code + HMAC auth, so no inbound port, port mapping, or public IP is needed.

title: januory/dsh-remote-workspaces
description: Open folders on remote hosts over SSH as Harness workspaces: file tools (read/write/edit/grep/glob) and shell commands run directly on the remote host over SFTP, ripgrep, and ssh2 exec, with no local mirroring, an encrypted multi-host registry, and the local sandbox policy still enforced.

title: JauLukNgai/dsh-on-phone
description: Puts the DSH web UI on a phone browser over your own tailnet, with the remote channel built on Tailscale Serve. Both sides need only Tailscale: no dedicated app, no QR code, no login page, no account of its own, and no relay of your content. The desktop half runs on macOS, Windows or Linux.

title: jayantTang/DSH_Mobile#mobile-link
description: Host-side connector for the DSH Mobile iOS app: dials a self-hostable WSS relay so the phone can reach the DSH sessions on this computer over 4G/5G, without a public IP or a VPN; the relay only authenticates and forwards.

title: JeremyCruzFang/dsh-plugin-dshm#bridge
description: Connect the DSHM iPhone/iPad companion to DeepSeek Harness over your local network or Tailscale, with device pairing, session control and file transfers; public TestFlight access to the companion app is pending Apple review.

title: Jiachi5533/dsh-remote-gateway
description: Source-filtered HTTP/SSE/WebSocket gateway for using the DSH Web UI behind an authenticated reverse proxy, with loopback trust adaptation, in-app host directory selection, and an allowlisted health endpoint.

title: jiahui-huang1/dsh-linked-workspace
description: SSH-backed remote directories and linked local⇄remote workspaces: read-only remote browsing, an editable linked workbench, bidirectional SFTP transfer, mirroring and a linked_workspace tool. Sidebar pages require the dsh-better-sidebar plugin (v0.24+); without it only the Settings pages load.

title: Jiangsubei/dsh-qqbot-bridge
description: Remotely control DeepSeek Harness sessions and workspaces from QQ (official Bot API v2, direct chat only): list and switch workspaces, create sessions, compact history, switch models, with streaming, markdown and approval forwarding. Access is not gated per user — anyone who can message the bot controls these sessions, using your model quota and file permissions.

title: jixishi/dsh-adapter-qq
description: QQ Official Bot adapter for C2C single chat, interactive action boards, workspace session management, and real-time Web UI sync.

title: JochenYang/dsh-remote#dsh-remote
description: Use DSH from your phone anywhere: a self-hosted relay plus a desktop host plugin form a token-authenticated tunnel (order-preserving HTTP reverse proxy + WebSocket bridging) with QR pairing, an admin console for device/token management, and an injected mobile adaptation layer (full-width chat, full-screen settings sheet, sidebar drawer).

title: jsdvjx/dshn#agent
description: Forwards a local dsh web UI to the public internet under a *.ds.hn subdomain (or your own self-hosted relay), gated by a login, with optional end-to-end encryption (PBKDF2 to AES-256-GCM).

title: JUANWANG-BUAA/dsh-full-remote
description: Remote DeepSeek Harness with full server-side API access (`settings.*` / `credentials.*` / `host.listDirectory`). Token-gated reverse proxy, per-device sessions, phone invite QR, fence self-check, optional approval / CIDR / idle timeout / local TLS, WebSocket/SSE.

title: Junkrat9527/dsh-desktop-automation
description: macOS desktop control for DeepSeek Harness: agent operates non-browser apps (CapCut, Photoshop, WPS, native clients) like a human — 14 tools for mouse, keyboard, scrolling, app activation, windows and screenshots, plus a vision closed-loop (desktop_see for image understanding + desktop_locate for UI element coordinates) that reuses dsh existing vision credentials. GUI-session service starts on demand, no login autostart.

title: JUNQINGV587/dsh-ssh-hub
description: Multi-server SSH terminal panel for the DSH Web GUI: floating terminal window with tabs, side-by-side groups, broadcast, host-owned persistent sessions, and password/private-key/SSH-agent auth.

title: jyb114/pocket-bridge
description: Adds a local phone pairing, gateway control, and diagnostic panel for Pocket Bridge in DSH Settings.

title: kilbertert/dsh-herdr
description: Adds a Herdr panel to the DSH sidebar that opens a host PTY running the `herdr` command and renders it with xterm.js. The connection list comes from the plugin config (`connections`, or the flat `remote`/`session`/`command` keys; with no config it runs plain `herdr`), so the panel can point at any machine. The startup command is typed once per terminal, so switching panels or reloading the page does not open a second session. Requires the Herdr CLI on the machine running DSH.

title: kinderao/dsh-pocket-relay
description: Phone and remote access to the DSH Web UI: scan a LAN QR code, or reach your PC from anywhere through a self-hosted relay server you run yourself instead of a cloudflared tunnel. Per-device credentials that pair, list, and revoke individually, and several PCs sharing one relay with automatic failover.

title: KKUCODES/dshm-plugin
description: Connects the DSHM Android client to computer-hosted DeepSeek Harness sessions for remote chat, model switching, and approvals with device pairing and revocation.

title: KyoMio/dsh-zen-remote
description: Pairing-code remote access for DSH: a phone-first PWA with Web Push, plus a client role that operates the host's shared sessions in the native DSH interface, behind your own reverse proxy or Cloudflare Tunnel.

title: dsh-remote-dock
description: Use SSH hosts and WSL distributions as remote DSH workspaces, with environment setup, model configuration porting, and the remote interface embedded locally.

title: Leon0555/dsh-lan-access
description: LAN access for the Web GUI: 0.0.0.0 bind plus a crypto.randomUUID polyfill for non-secure (LAN HTTP) contexts.

title: liaosiliangCodeLife/harness-mate-dsh
description: Connects the DeepSeek Harness agent running on your own computer to the HarnessMate platform, so you can chat with it, exchange files and approve its tool calls from a phone or a browser.

title: liguobao/ds-harness-remote
description: Multi-device remote access for DeepSeek Harness and supported coding workspaces through an end-to-end encrypted channel, with adaptive Relay/WebRTC transport, device authorization, workspace files, read-only previews, terminals, and optional Codex Remote.

title: Linjiangxian0203/dsh-remote-tunnel
description: Remote host tunnel manager: runs dsh web on a remote Linux server (systemd supervision, no root needed) behind an auto-reconnecting SSH tunnel; allocates and registers remote ports on the server, multi-user safe, with an audit view.

title: LinYanZhi/dsh-mesh#dsh-mesh
description: Multi-device DSH network: sidebar topology, peer health, delegation, file transfer and node management over TLS, LAN and public tunnels. DSH spawns its mesh server (127.0.0.1:8124) detached at startup and restarts it if it exits, and the server always answers LAN discovery on UDP 0.0.0.0:8129. Once a peer is paired, the default ACL lets it read, search and write files under ~/Code, read session history and logs, and delegate tasks to your DSH sessions; shell_run, channel messages, remote desktop and repair stay off until you allow them. If SakuraFrp is installed it reads that launcher's account token (or SAKURA_TOKEN) to query api.natfrp.com tunnels. Its /api/dsh-mesh routes are guarded only by a loopback peer-address check.

title: lishuaibing521/dsh-hermes-feishu
description: A Feishu/Lark channel for DeepSeek Harness: WebSocket inbound messaging that steers a running turn instead of queueing behind it, Markdown tables rendered as native Feishu table components, code blocks kept on their own lines, 13 Feishu tools, voice input and output, media upload, a model fallback chain, and a web settings page split into six grouped tabs. Runs on a self-built Feishu app over the long connection, so no public endpoint is needed.

title: litestartup-com/dsh-api-gateway
description: REST + SSE gateway exposing running Harness sessions to third-party clients: API-key auth, token streaming, workspace grouping, and adopting GUI sessions to keep chatting.

title: liushQAQ/dsh-anywhere
description: Remote access and mobile sync bridge for DSH iOS App with QR pairing, screen-lock resume, and tunnel management.

title: liyuhan7/dsh-phone-mirror
description: Mirrors an Android phone or tablet into the DSH right sidebar over adb with mouse and keyboard control, keeping videos, clips and chats next to the desktop instead of in your hand; Opus audio needs Android 11+, Windows only.

title: ll4514dvdvdb/dsh-clash-proxy
description: On-demand proxy for DeepSeek Harness that leaves the system proxy, WinHTTP and TUN alone: its own Clash-style engine parses vmess, vless, ss, trojan, socks5 and http subscriptions and runs a rule engine (DOMAIN, DOMAIN-SUFFIX, DOMAIN-KEYWORD, IP-CIDR, IP-CIDR6, GEOIP with DIRECT/PROXY/REJECT) so only the requests that are slow when dialled directly take the proxy on the web, search, scripts and browser channels, with per-node latency and bandwidth tests, spoofing options and a loopback panel behind a per-instance token.

title: lninghaha/dsh-coding-remote-kit
description: Mobile pairing remote for DeepSeek Harness: E2EE companion over dual-plane allowlisted RPC (LAN, Tailscale, optional Cloudflare Quick Tunnel or self-hosted rendezvous).

title: longisland-icetea/dsh-lan-access
description: Configurable LAN access for the DSH Web GUI: a settings tab binds the server to all interfaces, trusts only the addresses you configure, sets the browser session lifetime or removes the token login, and repairs the settings layer on non-loopback visits.

title: loveandbeepbrother/dsh-galatea#message-channels
description: Chat with your Galatea assistant from QQ (official bot) and WeChat: the same conversation, persona and memory as on the desktop, only the paired owner's private chat is accepted, replies go back where you wrote, and more chat apps can be added. Requires the Galatea framework.

title: loveXbanshee/dsh-fleet
description: Fleet console for DeepSeek Harness: one local dsh page manages many remote dsh machines — live idle/running status, in-place switching without new tabs, keep-alive iframes, cross-device session reading, one-click refresh/restart, and a controller/managed role split.

title: luckyxiang6688/dsh-superagent-wechat-source
description: Connects personal WeChat direct messages as a dsh-superagent Source, so private-chat text becomes a trigger for the orchestrator, accepted tasks run as work orders, and results are replied to the same chat; group and non-text messages are dropped. Only WeChat users on the superagent policy's allow-list are assessed; the list is empty by default, so every DM is ignored until you add your own ilink_user_id.

title: lukeinx/dsh-remote-wecom
description: Control DeepSeek Harness Desktop sessions from WeCom on your phone, with session and model switching, tool approvals, task results and generated files, and QR setup in Desktop settings. Needs a dedicated WeCom smart bot; the first person to send it a direct message within 10 minutes of the QR scan (or the 6-digit code from the settings page) becomes the owner, and only the owner's direct messages are accepted afterwards.

title: LUMIAO9527/DSH-Connect
description: Open the full DeepSeek Harness running on your computer from a phone browser, with QR pairing over LAN HTTPS and shared sessions and workspace; cross-network access needs your own HTTPS entry or a self-hosted relay (no public relay is provided). Connection and auth code is adapted in part from saya-ch/dsh-mobile.

title: lunaship/dsh-links
description: Android companion bridge: QR-code LAN pairing with revocable device tokens and TLS fingerprints, a phone-connection and device-management panel, and an HTTPS access proxy serving sessions, live events and approvals to the paired native app.

title: Lunatic029/dsh-clash-proxy
description: Routes DeepSeek Harness outbound traffic through a local Clash proxy, with automatic fallback to direct when the proxy is off.

title: lzlrt/dsha-desktop-link
description: Adds one button to the sidebar foot that opens the desktop DSH Web GUI — in the system browser on a phone, in a new tab on a desktop. The target address is read from plugin config, DSH_DESKTOP_URL, or ~/.dsh/desktop-url.txt, and falls back to the relay origin published by dsh-remote-web-ui; the button renders inert with a hint when nothing is configured. It also adds a small gear button that saves the address into ~/.dsh/desktop-url.txt; on a phone with no separate launch address set, a click asks the local pairing service (/api/pair/issue) for a one-time pairing link and opens it; its HTTP routes (/api/desktop-link/…) have no DSH access check.

title: Making-acid/dsh-codex-bridge
description: Runs authenticated batches of DeepSeek Harness tasks from Codex on the same Windows computer.

title: mcdottok/dsh-vscode-connect
description: Connects DSH and VS Code for a Claude Code for VS Code style experience, continuing the same workspace and conversation right inside VS Code: install the DSH Coding Agent extension and the plugin discovers and connects automatically on the same Windows machine, or connect manually elsewhere by pasting the copied connection address.

title: MDR-EX1000/dsh-rw
description: Remote-SSH-style workspaces: turn an SSH host and a remote directory into a native DSH workspace; the agent operates the remote filesystem directly via 12 rw_* tools (SFTP/exec), with workspace-confined paths and known_hosts verification.

title: Memorial-coder/dsh-remote-plugin
description: Tunnels the local DSH web panel to a phone or the internet through frp, with QR pairing, TOTP 2FA, device management and an IP blacklist. Windows 10/11 only (macOS/Linux need your own matching frpc); the default hosted mode needs a free account at remote.ymzcc.com and relays traffic through that server, and Windows Defender may block the bundled frpc.exe until you run the included fix script.

title: menghuanshiguang/devctl-dsh
description: Drive a DSH instance from another device: a host plugin opens a token-authenticated TCP port that a single-file Python CLI drives - listing and creating sessions, sending prompts with images, streaming replies, and switching models, permissions and workspaces.

title: mervyn-teo/dsh-plugin-qr-connect
description: A QR-code button above Settings that lets phones connect to the web UI through an auth-gated reverse proxy.

title: mexiaosqwq/dsh-web-mobile
description: Mobile adaptation for the DSH Web UI: works well on narrow screens, fits wide screens too.

title: meyaomiao/dsh-server-deck
description: Server card dashboard for DSH: per-host status, CPU, memory, disk and latency, with one-click xterm.js SSH terminals; imports ~/.ssh/config and mounts as a better-sidebar tab or a standalone right drawer.

title: miiy/dsh-access-gateway
description: Access the DSH Web GUI from your LAN: a listener on the address you set forwards the browser to the loopback GUI with this process's launch token, and 0.0.0.0 answers on Wi-Fi, VPN and wired alike. Address, port, session lifetime and password are edited in an Access section of Settings. The password is on by default — a fresh entry starts with a generated random one — and can be switched off on a network you trust for direct access; the Host stores only its scrypt hash.

title: MingTXin/dsh-remote-workstation
description: Remote workspaces for DeepSeek Harness: pick an SSH host in the sidebar, mount a server directory over SFTP as a workspace, then read, write and edit those files with the normal file tools. Remote watch is polled so the file tree refreshes, image/binary previews work through byte-range reads, and remote_exec, remote_search and remote_git give agents the remote shell, search and git queries. An opt-in patch routes the agent's own bash/pwsh commands to the server. Every remote write and command follows the session sandbox mode and approval policy, and hosts are managed by the plugin itself (password, key or SSH agent).

title: mkiea/qq-integration
description: Derivative of cheesehaqi/dsh-qq-onebot-bridge with the same package name, so the two cannot be installed together. Bridges a personal QQ account into DeepSeek Harness over OneBot 11: private and group messages become per-conversation agent sessions and replies are sent back to QQ. Ships a reverse WebSocket server, allowlists (empty = deny all), @ parsing, image and SILK voice handling, and a separate local console on 127.0.0.1:8880 with the decision trace, offline replay, event injection, a read-only preflight and host/Waylay start-stop controls. Needs a separate OneBot v11 implementation (a third-party unofficial QQ client): the default, Waylay, injects into the official Windows QQ.exe (Windows 10/11 x64 only) and is distributed as a separate release archive, not bundled in this repo. botQqAllowed and replayGuardEnabled are edited in DSH Settings > QQ助手, and the replay guard is armed automatically when the logged-in account changes.

title: Mlte0907/dsh-remote-x
description: Remote control and mobile overlay for DeepSeek Harness: LAN and public (cloudflared) tunnels with QR-code access, a phone-first mobile UI under 768px, and a LAN reverse-proxy CLI.

title: MoonlitDropOfBlood/dsh-remote-control#plugin
description: Remote-control DeepSeek Harness from a HarmonyOS phone: list, switch and create sessions; send prompts (the phone follows the host's busy-enter behaviour, queue or steer); stream assistant text, reasoning and tool steps; answer approval requests and questions; view session images as inline thumbnails with on-demand full-size fetch; switch model and reasoning effort; cancel running tasks; receive push notifications. Traffic is end-to-end encrypted (AES-256-GCM with HKDF-SHA256 key derivation) and travels through a dumb-pipe relay that only sees ciphertext; v1.1.3 adds a session-epoch anti-replay handshake and optional native TLS for the relay. The relay can be hosted on the local machine (managed by the plugin) or on a VPS; the phone app and the plugin ship in one repository. 5 Remote methods.

title: MoRanYue/dsh-pocket
description: Fork of shaobeichen/dsh-pocket for remote phone access to the DSH Web UI: QR-code access over LAN or a cloudflared tunnel with live sync; mobile layout is left to DSH itself, the plugin adds safe-area and touch chrome, soft-keyboard Enter inserts a newline while hardware keyboards send on Enter, and install/update is left to the plugin manager. The command-line mode listens on 0.0.0.0 by default so a phone on the same Wi-Fi can scan the QR code; it generates an access password (embedded in the QR code) unless you pass --no-auth, and a cloudflared tunnel exposes the Web UI beyond your LAN.

title: MoRanYue/dsh-winrm
description: Node.js fork of andyfan1094/dsh-winrm: the same WinRM host panel and seven agent tools, with the backend ported from Python/pywinrm to a native Node WinRM client so the machine running dsh needs no Python.

title: moyu-good/dsh-lark-bridge
description: Feishu/Lark IM channel for DeepSeek Harness agents with native thinking-process messages, approval cards, live goal and todo cards, workflow fan-out lines, session text search, and background job and subagent settlement notices. Access is bounded by the Feishu app's own visibility scope by design — anyone the app admits can drive the agent and answer its approvals unless the optional sender, group and approver allowlists are filled in.

title: moyu474/dsh-qqbridge
description: Cheap enough to leave running in a QQ group all day. The lite reply mode bypasses the full agent loop and calls chat completions directly: about ¥0.0027 per turn, roughly ¥0.2 for 80 turns a day, around 75x cheaper than a full DSH session. Still includes switchable persona cards, image and video understanding, an auto-tagged image library built from group pictures, and keyword recall over archived chats. One-command SSH deploy with environment checks, credential-safe config generation, systemd units and a watchdog. Bundles a fork of Derpyu520/qq-bridge (MIT); do not deploy it to a host that is already running the upstream bridge.

title: mrRisega/dsh-remote#dsh-remote-web
description: Remote control for dsh web from a phone browser, from anywhere (no public IP needed): hosted cloud relay works over 4G, or self-host the router; one command installs the desktop bridge and this in-harness Settings panel (cloud / self-hosted / WeChat-bot tabs, account login, bridge start/stop, feedback); the tunnel data plane is end-to-end encrypted (E2EE phone↔desktop, with a QR / one-time-link desktop grant so you never re-type the password), with HTTP/WebSocket pass-through, access-key auth, a live device list and optional traffic quotas; the WeChat bot channel is bound by QR scan and pushes task-finished / error / stopped events to WeChat, where one number in reply approves or denies a pending decision and continues the current task — WeChat messages travel only between Tencent ilink and the local bridge, never through the relay.

title: Mrsirlila/dsh-pocket-plus#plugin
description: Patched build of dsh-pocket for DeepSeek Harness: the access password is embedded in the QR code so the phone signs in with one scan, a read-only /dsh-pocket/entry.json endpoint lets the app re-sync the current public URL and password from the LAN, and LAN / Tailscale / Cloudflare routes fail over automatically. This is a patched derivative of shaobeichen/dsh-pocket — install it instead of the upstream plugin, never alongside it.

title: MyPanda-Hash/CHENGXIAO
description: Pairs two DeepSeek Harness machines with a one-time code - directly on a LAN, or across networks through an end-to-end-encrypted relay with a zero-config official default - so one agent can run tasks and exchange files on the other while each machine keeps its own files in place.

title: MyRemme/dsh-lan-pair
description: LAN-only remote access for DSH: pair a phone or another PC by QR code or token to open the same web UI, with optional key-free access inside the LAN.

title: Mzy123l/dsh-plugin-remote-access
description: Exposes the local DSH web GUI to one chosen CIDR range only (Tailscale by default) instead of binding 0.0.0.0: the proxy listens on addresses inside that range, rejects peers outside it, and admits clients by either a tokenised URL or a 4-12 character alphanumeric access code. Remote pages can be forced into a phone layout without changing the local UI, and the official appearance, font size, transcript view, code view and performance settings can be stored in the plugin config and re-applied on every remote page load.

title: mzzsfy/dsh-plugin#dsh-auto-trust-all
description: Makes every Host header that actually reaches the server a trusted entry: all webServer routes are wrapped and the parsed host is registered in connection.trustedHosts (mirrored into webRuntime.trustedHosts on host generations that still have that service), so wildcard or otherwise unenumerable entry domains work without editing the start command; entries beyond a configurable capacity are evicted LRU-first. It does not change the listen binding — that stays with the deployment layer — and the authentication layer is untouched. Because any Host header is accepted, the host allowlist no longer protects against DNS rebinding; use it only on a network you trust.

title: NattoCB/dsh-plugin-wechat-bridge
description: Bridges WeChat (ilink bot) private chats into DSH agent sessions and streams replies back, with hot-plug and a Settings tab.

title: NelsonLongXiang/dsh-open-a2a-net
description: The opt-in 0.8 preview adds Superagent teams for request intake, ticket assignment, progress reports and owner decision cards, on an A2A network with signed peer discovery, linked-host routing and receipt tracking.

title: netbka/local-commander-plugins
description: Connects DeepSeek Harness to the hosted Local Commander MCP server at localcmd.app via mcp-remote with browser sign-in, to read files and Git, run the checks you approve and check local services on your Windows computers. Requires a Local Commander account and the paired agent running on the Windows PC.

title: NishimiyaFukinoto/dimensional-portal-dsh
description: Drive a real Android phone from DSH: screenshots, taps, swipes, typing and app launching. Requires Python 3.10+ with aiohttp and mcp on the computer side, plus the AutoX.js script running on the phone with screen-capture and accessibility permissions; the phone long-polls your machine, so no public port and no relay server.

title: NNNNyang/dsh-remote-gpu
description: Shows how many GPUs on the dsh-remote host are free in the conversation header, and per-GPU utilization, memory, temperature and the owning user in a right-sidebar panel. Adds a remote_gpu tool that returns the same snapshot.

title: NOirBRight/dsh-mobile-pairing
description: Mobile remote pairing for DSH with QR offers, a loopback Host Gateway, encrypted Relay or Quick Tunnel transport, same-LAN WebRTC Direct, and revocable Device Tokens for the Android client.

title: observer130/dsh-peerbar

title: OrderG-X/dsh-mobile
description: Use DSH from a phone browser. Turn on phone access from the phone button in the session header (or the plugin card) and scan the QR code; the phone opens the official DSH web UI served by the desktop process, with the same sessions updating live, so you can follow a running task, reply and approve away from the computer. A gateway inside DSH (port 18765) proxies the web UI and handles the desktop login itself. One QR code works on Wi-Fi and on mobile data: turning access on also starts a free Cloudflare quick tunnel (cloudflared is downloaded from Cloudflare's GitHub releases if missing), and its address survives DSH restarts, so phones do not need to rescan. Pairing codes are one-time and expire in 10 minutes, each phone gets its own revocable credential, the header button shows when a phone is connected, and idle connections get keepalive pings. Optional push notifications go to Bark, ntfy, ServerChan, Feishu / WeCom / DingTalk group bots, Telegram or any webhook when a task finishes (after 30 seconds or more), stops with an error, or waits for an approval or an answer; they carry only the session title and status, and approval still happens in DSH. On a phone the web UI's side panels slide over the page, and it can be added to the home screen with its own icon.

title: oscarka/deepseekharness-remotecontrol
description: Mobile Web PWA and Feishu remote control hub for DeepSeek Harness (plus optional local adapters for Antigravity, Codex, Claude Code, WorkBuddy and Doubao): starts an embedded HTTP hub on 0.0.0.0:8788 gated by a bearer token and 6-character pairing code, with session switching, file browsing, media preview, tool approvals, Web Push notifications, and optional outbound relay to a self-hosted Cloud Hub or Feishu bot.

title: oxmumu3/dot-dsh-connector#dot-dsh-management
description: Native Harness workbench and local gateway for Dot to read saved projects and conversations, dispatch native tasks, inspect progress, continue or cancel tasks, and manage connection authorization.

title: pan17/dsh-wechat
description: Bridges WeChat private chats into DSH, with two-way text, image, file, audio and video messaging and slash commands for sessions, workspaces, models, permissions and more; the goal is DSH's native experience inside WeChat.

title: peng456/dsh-plugin-mesh
description: Discovers other DSH instances on the local network by UDP multicast or port scan, lists them in a sidebar panel together with the capabilities each one reports, and dispatches tasks between machines in both directions over the LAN or over an automatically downloaded userspace Tailscale node.

title: PerryLink/dsh-reach
description: Pushes DSH approval and question cards to IM channels (WeChat first) and answers them from chat, with a session console, per-channel security, and an open push service.

title: polaris-smart/dsh-devices
description: Decentralized multi-device fleet: mDNS LAN discovery, key pairing, and SSH direct execution across networks.

title: qiaohelenjoe/dsh-app#dsh-mobile-tunnel
description: The mobile client for DeepSeek Harness: use the DSH running on your computer from your phone. The Android app signs in with the same account, picks this computer from the device list and opens its DeepSeek Harness UI on mobile. The desktop plugin handles registration and the connection, and nothing on the computer needs an inbound port. The UI adapts on its own: on a phone it becomes a touch-friendly layout, and returns to the desktop layout when a foldable opens or the window gets bigger. A PC-side panel shows login state, device quota, device list and the app download QR code.

title: QIC-9821/dsh-pc-bridge
description: Loopback HTTP bridge that lets a peer machine ping this PC and run shell commands, with an optional ssh reverse-tunnel supervisor.

title: qingshuiliuyun/dsh-node-monitor
description: Multi-node DSH monitor and control hub: per-node status and read-only sessions, zero-config LAN networking via UDP discovery, one-click/embedded access to a real DSH UI, cross-network remote hub via outbound push, serverless invite links/IPv6, and opt-in plugin toggle/restart behind dry-run, confirmation and a JSONL audit log. By default it listens on :: / 0.0.0.0 for LAN discovery, with token-protected status and control routes; its HTTP routes have no DSH access check.

title: rainfish-home/dsh-mobi-web
description: Phone-first web client for DeepSeek Harness whose /m/ page serves a compact mobile UI instead of proxying the full desktop UI, with approvals staying on the phone when the phone started the turn and Mermaid rendered on the device.

title: Raiyan007-gb/dsh-remote-tunnel-easy
description: Scan a QR code in Settings to open the DeepSeek Harness web UI on your phone inside the active session via a cloudflared quick tunnel.

title: raven3005672/dsh-plugin-im-remote-control
description: Feishu (Lark) bot for DSH remote control — messages become session turns, results return to the chat, and ask-mode approval requests can be approved or denied in Feishu.

title: REALOIYO/dsh-web-gate
description: Password-protected LAN gateway for DeepSeek Harness, letting a phone browser on the same Wi-Fi drive the desktop DSH; DSH's own files are untouched, but a small compatibility polyfill is injected into the pages served to the phone. Plain HTTP, trusted LAN only.

title: regrevia/dsh-mobile-use
description: Android in the sidebar, driven by text instead of screenshots. 30 tools read the real UI tree, tap by text/id/ref, measure animation motion, and mirror the screen into the sidebar where you circle a spot and send it back with one sentence — the host ships the marked-up frame plus the controls inside the circle to the chat. Token cost is the point: a screen check is a 200-600 token text block, not a 1k+ token screenshot, and a warm check costs 100-200 ms of wall clock. Video is raw H.264 straight into WebCodecs — no transcoding — with p50 2 ms host-write to decoded frame over a 26 s run, one decoder, zero dropped frames; it falls back to MSE on its own and ?avc=0 forces the old path. Sound is one switch, off by default and remembered per serial, so the default path pays nothing; when on, audio rides its own socket (48 kHz stereo PCM, measured 22 s / 1047 packets / 0 loss) and closing the window reclaims it too. Nothing runs behind your back: closing the window stops capture at once, the viewer-less host decoder, recorder and device-side server are gone within 3 s, an idle channel is dropped after 90 s, and a request you closed is never reopened by itself. `adb_proc audit` settles who leaked what in one call. Bundled helpers, no extra services; needs adb and ffmpeg on the host, and the adb_ocr tool plus the OCR fallback for empty UI trees are macOS-only.

title: reshdh/dsh-remote-hub
description: Community fork of KyoMio/dsh-zen-remote (do not enable both simultaneously — shares the ~/.dsh/zen-remote state and /_dsh/zen-remote/* wire protocol, and auto-defers if dsh-zen-remote is active): keeps the pairing-code PWA with Web Push and multi-host session relay, and adds a desktop Local / Remote / All workspace switcher, remote directory browsing with folder creation and workspace rename/delete (/v1/workspace-manage), automatic custom LLM provider and API-key sync to paired hosts, and bidirectional cross-host @ session reference hydration (session-ref-bridge). The gateway binds 127.0.0.1 by default; the LAN/Tailscale mode binds 0.0.0.0 behind a private-IP wall, and a paired desktop client runs terminals and file previews with the host's OS-user permissions.

title: RestRegular/dsh-pocket
description: A separate narrow-screen web surface for DeepSeek Harness rather than the desktop GUI scaled down: it serves its own session list and chat stream behind a random access token over LAN, a tunnel (cloudflared, localtunnel or localhost.run) or an SSH reverse forward through a server you own. On the phone it streams assistant text, thinking, tool calls and results, sends prompts, stops the running turn, answers blocking questions and tool approvals (including ones waiting in other sessions), switches model, thinking level and permission preset, sends up to four photos compressed on the device, and keeps the computer awake.

title: RyensX/dsh-remote-gateway
description: Provides a secure reverse proxy, enabling DeepSeek Harness to be accessed remotely and to converse with AI anytime, anywhere.

title: saya-ch/dsh-mobile
description: Access DeepSeek Harness from the Android app or a mobile browser with secure LAN and remote connections, persistent device pairing, and a customizable mobile interface.

title: scientificmaniac/dsh-ssh-vault

The sh_* tools only reach directories on the allowedRoots list.

description: Complete LAN/remote access for the Web UI: 0.0.0.0 binding, crypto.randomUUID polyfill, token gate (401 login page + WebSocket interception, loopback exempt), privileged-fence and settings-persistence exemptions, and an idempotent installer with upgrade recovery.

title: Wayne036/dsh-plugin-login-gate

title: WODE25500/dsh-ssh-pro
description: Enhanced SSH ops: connectivity testing, remote ls, ssh-config import, known_hosts fingerprint checks and multi-host exec.

title: dingchenhui0618-arch/dsh-doudizhu
description: Available on npm as dsh-doudizhu-lan. Three-player LAN Dou Dizhu (斗地主) played from a floating window: one machine opens a room on its own port, the other two join with a six-character room code plus an address. Empty seats can be filled by computer players in four switchable strengths (easy, medium, hard, hell), so one or two people can still play a whole hand; the deal starts as soon as the three seats are filled. 54 cards in four suits, bidding of 1/2/3 or pass, the landlord takes the three bottom cards and holds 20, play runs clockwise, and the first-bid seat rotates clockwise between hands. The rule engine is pure and covers 11 legal shapes, with big joker > small joker > 2 > A > K down to 3, suits never compared, straights, pair-straights and planes excluding the 2s and the jokers, and a rocket that beats everything. The table itself is built to be read at a glance: three seat cards side by side in play order (you, then your next and previous seats) with role, hand count and a bar that runs out, one line that says whose hand is on the table and what would beat it, the bottom cards as text, an in-place play history that folds into a single summary line and unfolds into every trick including the passes, plus hint and auto-play buttons that pick the cheapest legal answer out of the local rule enumeration. Nicknames can be changed mid-hand (twelve characters, duplicates get a suffix). Computers run inside the authority and are handed only their own hand, the public record and the seat counts, so no hand can leak; the authority is the only place that decides which card ids leave it. Computers are driven by the room itself, so a one-person table keeps playing with nobody else on the LAN port. Humans have no turn timer, the collapsed floating pill can be dragged around the screen, and 179 unit tests pin the rules, the wire format, the theme tokens, the drag gesture, the history grouping and the computer seats.

title: dingchenhui0618-arch/dsh-liars-dice

title: dingchenhui0618-arch/dsh-pet-ledger

Every achievement expands into the session id and the actual tool-call evidence (command, result, duration); demo cards are a separate in-memory list with a visible 演示 watermark and never count or persist. Daily quests are generated from the day’s real active time and command types, then frozen. Host + client halves, zero runtime dependencies, 70 tests, local JSON only.

title: dingchenhui0618-arch/dsh-poker-night
description: A no-limit Texas holdem table where you are the only human. Eight seats: you plus seven LLM agents written on AI-founder personas (Altman, Dario Amodei, Musk, Liang Wenfeng, Jensen Huang, Lei Jun, Zhang Yiming). Each agent bets through the currently selected host model and falls back to its own heuristic style when no model is available; every agent only ever sees its own hole cards, because the prompt is built from that seat alone. A hand ends by revealing the winner hole cards, with a flip animation replayed on every community card, and a rail keeps a live action-and-table-talk timeline. LAN mode (off by default, single-machine play is unaffected) lets another install on the same network join this very table: the host shows a six-digit room code, UDP broadcast discovers nearby tables, and a joiner randomly takes over one bot seat, with the seat handed back to its character on leave or after twenty seconds of silence. The room code is never put on the wire and every snapshot is generated for one viewer seat, so nobody, not even the host, can read another player hole cards. Fork of BubblePtr/dsh-holdem (MIT), credited in the README and in the UI.

title: dingchenhui0618-arch/dsh-turing-table

Seat identity and each agent model configuration stay hidden in the host state until a seat is judged, then the disguise parameters are revealed. Every round exports a per-seat conversation JSONL plus the judgment record, and the same seed with the same move script replays byte-identical, so runs with different models or disguise strengths can be diffed.

title: Gjs9178U/dsh-pet-indesktop
description: Adds one draggable desktop pet to the DSH web GUI: a whale girl called Big Fat Fish (nickname Jingjing), with eight switchable colour skins and a personality. She eats rice, is clever but lazy, and is a tsundere: too many rapid clicks and she lies down and refuses to react for a while, calling her fat annoys her and she insists she is not, and the nickname Jingjing pleases her. She also remembers you between sessions: three fat-calls today and she greets you cold, three nickname-calls and she greets you warm, coming back after half an hour earns "I was not waiting for you", and the first few meetings she is shy - so the counters reset each local midnight and are stored in a state file the plugin owns. After ten quiet minutes she drifts to a corner, which is visual only and never moves the position you chose. The eight PNGs are bundled with the plugin and served by the plugin itself, so there are no third-party requests. NOTE - the artwork carries an OleapCrow mark and was supplied by the repository owner, the eight skins are recolourings of that one drawing, and the plugin has not been installed against a live DSH host.

title: gongfpp/dsh-novel-fish
description: Read local EPUB, TXT and Markdown novels below selected native DSH chat regions on explicit expansion, preserving real reasoning and tool output without sending novel text to the model. Requires DSH >=0.2.1-rc.2 <0.3.0-0.

title: gongfpp/dsh-thanks-carl
description: Local Carl companion with 12 pre-generated AI sprite actions, pat reactions, a 25/45-minute focus timer, quick menu, edge wandering and local reminders; no runtime model calls or chat messages.

title: gongstudent/dsh-moyu
description: Hover-reveal Douyin short-video feed inside DeepSeek Harness: move the pointer into a fixed hotspot to play, leave to pause in place, scroll the wheel to switch clips. Wheel travel is accumulated and cooled down so one gesture switches once, and the player stays mounted while hidden so re-entry resumes instead of restarting. The host half signs the requests and reverse-proxies the media stream, so no account or sign-in is needed.

title: good-saltfish/dsh-novel-shelf
description: A novel reader docked in the DSH right sidebar for office slacking, with an AI companion that roasts whatever you just read alongside you - import your own TXT three ways, five reading themes, and saved chapters, progress and annotations. The companion comments as you go, in one of four voices (sharp-tongued, warm, detective or slacker) at a pace you pick, off by default. 434 Chinese classics as a 44 KB catalogue, searchable by title or author, one click to download and read offline, four CDN edges as fallback.

title: Gorkaseto/dsh-whale-pet
description: Animated pixel-art blue and white whale pet that sits on top of the composer in a new session.

title: guihui2538/Every-token-you-spend-comes-back-as-a-waifu.
description: Turn your DSH token usage into a gacha game: feed a monster with tokens, earn coins, pull from 14 AI waifus (Kimi/GLM/Gemini/Claude and more), enhance artifacts, and build a Balatro-style battle team with daily sign-in bonuses.

title: Hamster1214/dsh-pet-lan
description: LAN co-op for the dsh-pet desktop pet: see colleagues' pets on the same network, wave at them, and drag their desktop windows anywhere; an optional included patch adds live animation, bubble and meme sync. Requires dsh-pet 0.3.7.

title: HarcoChen/dsh-ArkStronghold
description: Native DSH tools for playing Stronghold Protocol solo games over the game site's WebSocket connection, with compact state views, explicit actions and public card lookups.

title: hasan-aghayev/dsh-pet-companion
description: A WSLg-compatible DSH desktop pet reacts to agent activity, lets you message the active session, and loads Hatch-Pet v2 atlases or transparent portraits.

title: hellodigua/dsh-emoji
description: Automatically add emojis to AI replies.

title: hellosz/dsh-pets
description: Codex Pets-style floating pixel pet with 10 built-in Petdex-compatible pets, a 9-state agent-status engine (idle/running/waiting/review/failed plus client-side waving/jumping/directions), draggable overlay, pet picker/zoom settings, notification bubbles, and a `pet_say` tool for the agent to speak through the pet.

title: Helly0000/dsh-life-game
description: Conway's Game of Life for DeepSeek Harness: a sidebar panel row opens a drawable centre-column board with four rules, seven stampable patterns and a population chart.

title: henryzhc26/dsh-darena
description: Real-time PvP mini-game for DSH: cross-user matchmaking, both players call their own configured models to solve the same generated maze, best-of-three with an 11-step difficulty ladder, practice mode and a global win-difference leaderboard.

title: heswy/dsh-game-market
description: Game market and runtime for DSH. While the agent runs a long task, a game fills the main workspace and a small whale in the corner shows the agent state (working, waiting for you, done, error); progress is saved and continues next time. Ships five built-in games, a game SDK and CLI, and a community catalog installable from the market.

title: hongxin-y/codex-pet-Astra-Yao
description: An Astra Yao desktop pet for the DeepSeek Harness web GUI that renders the Codex v2 8x11 sprite atlas, follows session state through thinking, running, waiting and failed, shows a status bubble with the running tool and a DeepSeek balance readout (on by default, can be switched off), and quotes her own voice lines while idle.

title: huangxn29/dsh-shooter
description: A top-down arena shooter that lives in the DSH sidebar: an autopilot AI plays the blue whale-fish hero for you while the dsh-pet desktop pet narrates each wave out loud, and combos, boss waves every fifth wave, in-run upgrade choices, a local leaderboard, achievements, skins and a floating desk widget (a fish that keeps playing in the corner, click to pet, double-click to open) keep the run going while you work.

title: huangzhilin-hzl/dsh-power-type
description: Power Mode typing effects for the DSH web composer: caret particles and glowing character echoes, a heat ramp from amber to red with rising embers as the combo grows, a combo counter over visible glyphs, and a synthesized key tick with a heavier Enter impact.

title: huangziyuan-general/dsh-xuanji
description: Fortune-telling toolkit: bazi, ziwei doushu, meihua yijing, liuyao (six-line coin oracle with najia), almanac, chenggu bone-weight, zodiac, date selection, qimen dunjia, fengshui, name scoring, compatibility, numerology, a life K-line chart, tarot and xiaoliuren — 16 tools whose ganzhi, stars, hexagrams and bone weights are all computed by deterministic local engines, with the model only interpreting results. Supports solar and lunar dates with leap months, China DST and true solar time correction, plus a ten-page read-only side panel.

title: HuanLinOTO/dsh-plugin-d399
description: Pops up a mini-game menu (wordle, match-3, extensible) while the model generates.

title: huashenglian/dsh-livechat
description: Bilibili-style danmaku overlay for the DSH Web chat area: scroll, top and bottom tracks driven by agent events, three preset packs, optional LLM-generated comments, a draggable control ball, per-session pools with replay, and a settings card.

title: hulibuld/dsh-pet-cuteness-plugin
description: A companion plugin for dsh-pet: gives the desktop pet a persona card, Chinese reasoning lines, click reactions, and a daily diary she writes herself.

title: HYClub/dsh-ufo
description: UFO archive terminal: search official and civilian records, keep a local archive, read it offline.

title: Hyfwdnmd666/dsh-ai-ball
description: Gives the agent a mouth through the ai-ball floating orb: speak text that the orb types out character by character, set its mood colour, show or hide its monologue panel, read back what you typed into it, and check or start it. The orb is a separate Python 3.10+ overlay you install yourself, and the plugin only writes the files it watches.

title: imfuxing/dsh-widget-journey-west
description: Journey to the West floating desktop pet: a frameless, transparent, always-on-top cartoon widget of Tang Monk and his disciples. Click to switch characters; idle plays a chasing scene.

title: imkingjh999/dsh-deepsea
description: Turns session context into a deep-sea moyu (slack-off) game in a floating window — your hand sinks as context grows, touch a fish and server-rolled dice decide the mint of a holographic collectible card across five oceans, with a fish pond and a GitHub-linked leaderboard.

title: incline22/dsh-grok-ball
description: Grok Ball desktop pet for DeepSeek Harness: follows your cursor, switches emotion with the agent's run state, draggable with click feedback.

title: iypavlov/dsh-cat-pet
description: An animated pixel cat that lives over the DSH web interface and follows what the agent is doing — sitting while the session is calm, lying down and falling asleep while a run is in progress, and waking when the turn returns or typing starts. It can be dragged anywhere, remembers its position, sleeps after a minute of inactivity, and offers an enable switch, four sizes and a status-reaction toggle in Settings.

title: JackyHuang75414/dsh-fun-waiting
description: Replaces the chat's "Deep diving" waiting label with rotating fun phrases, editable live in Settings.

title: JAdpp/dsh-whale-galgame
description: Multi-character Galgame conversation view with separate character and reply-model selection, per-character affection, memory, dialogue history, and CG galleries, plus responses informed by task events across Harness sessions.

title: jarvislee90s-dot/dsh-foxbell-pet
description: Multi-pet desktop companion: four MAM status lights watch every active session (approval / running / done-unread / error) and each card click-through to its conversation; four voice groups speak on state changes with duration-timed subtitles; import pets from four sources (folder / zip / Codex dir / Petdex registry) with card-style hot-swap and an integrity guard; five action bindings, drag physics, three scales. The built-in fox Foxbell ships in the package — install and go.

title: jcs130/dsh-minecraft-agent
description: Connect a DSH Agent to Minecraft Java servers with Mineflayer, a live game view alongside native reasoning and tools, configurable personas, server-scoped notebooks, and optional local survival knowledge retrieval. Reuses the host model; installation does not connect to a game or start inference.

title: jcy0chenyuan0/dsh-debate-simulator
description: Multi-agent Chinese debate simulator with eight debaters, live two-column discussion and draft notes, judges and scoreboard, single-side clocks, per-round ZIP archives, a training side with a configurable end condition (win-rate threshold or fixed rounds), and a Word prep package.

title: jerryqx/dsh-xiaoyuzhou
description: Listen to Xiaoyuzhou (小宇宙) podcasts in the DSH web UI: paste a share link to play anonymously (host proxies the audio with Range/seek), or log in via QR code to sync subscriptions, keyword-search shows/episodes, page full episode lists, and unlock purchased paywalled episodes; a `podcast_play` tool lets the agent play by link, podcast pid, or episode eid.

title: Jessicaisleep/dsh-genshin-pet#dsh-pet
description: Two chibi Genshin Impact desktop pets (Columbina and Nahida), 22 transparent animations each, with desktop wandering, drag-and-throw physics, click reactions, idle chatter and chat through DSH models. A fan pack derived from PC2005-cloud/dsh-pet (MIT) — it reuses upstream's /dsh-pet-7340 route and ~/.dsh/dsh-pet data directory, so install it instead of dsh-pet, not alongside it; the character art is not MIT-licensed.

title: Jessie-1939/whalepal#dsh-bridge
description: Bridges DeepSeek Harness agent state (status, tool calls, errors, approval waits) over loopback to WhalePal, a standalone desktop pet app, so the desktop pet follows the real agent state instead of guessing from screenshots.

title: jiangzeyuan/dsh-rivermind
description: Heads-up Texas Hold'em training with an independent AI opponent, persistent public-action memory, and decision reviews.

title: jimmyalxe/nekowhale-meme
description: Local meme-sticker library: import from a file, a folder or the agent tool, tag images in a review queue you confirm yourself, group them, then let the agent search and send by mood. A design descendant of Loping151/dsh-nekowhale-stickers (no shared code; its sticker_* tool names differ, so the two can be installed side by side).

title: jitengfei/dsh-whale-arcade
description: Floating, browser-local whale arcade with three score games and ocean-themed Gomoku for breaks while waiting on the agent.

title: JJJACKsong/dsh-plugin-context-cleanup-master
description: Scans recent sessions locally for real token usage, scores context health on a floating dashboard and plays a token-ledger animation with made-up figures; its one action opens a new empty session, the same as /new, and nothing is deleted. A parody plugin that makes no model calls.

title: joeseesun/qiaomu-radio-dsh
description: Listen to live radio, browse stations by mood, and keep a local listening history inside Harness.

title: jtsinlio/dsh-pet-jt
description: Desktop pet fork of dsh-pet that can be installed alongside the original (separate package id, commands and data directory), adding scheduled reminders with custom bubble text and a random show/hide cycle.

title: jusong/dsh-codex-pets
description: macOS always-on-top desktop pet for DSH Desktop: a bundled DeepSeek whale sprite with Codex-compatible skins; install many pets from codex-pets.net or import from local Codex in Settings; a recent-session ball; right-click New Session and a configurable global shortcut (default Command+Option+N) for a new-session ask box.

title: jy78-hsd/dsh-coke
description: Cat desktop pet for DeepSeek Harness (dsh-coke): click it for one of 7 catchphrases with a springy bounce, right-click for chat (answers via your current model, optional sticker), singing with a microphone, a random 'form' card, green-screen outfit swapping, or shooting it; balance query at its feet (needs a DeepSeek API key); auto-starts with DSH. If no Electron runtime is found it first downloads about 100 MB into ~/.dsh/electron (in-page mode works meanwhile).

title: kakabuxiangdong/qq-bot-pro
description: Extends the official QQ bot channel (@tencent-connect/dsh-qqbot 0.5.3/0.5.4) in DSH with sticker tools, idle proactive small talk, long-term memory and a Settings → Plugins page. Install is manual: run lib/patch-host.mjs to patch six files in the installed channel (backed up, revertable) and --register it into your profile; you also need a QQ open-platform bot (appId/appSecret) with "receive all messages" enabled by a group admin. The channel access defaults to open (anyone who can message the bot); set access.c2cMode/groupMode to allowlist or disabled before exposing it.

title: kanoonak/dsh-whale-catcher
description: A two-minute whale-fishing mini game for the DSH web GUI. Catch fish whose numbers add to your score, avoid fish larger than you, eat rice bowls to heal, and grab coupons to ignore size on the next hook. Standalone HTML, no network, no telemetry.

title: kendu76/dsh-music-player
description: Music, audiobook, radio and news player for DeepSeek Harness: streams your local music folder over HTTP, reads local .txt/.epub novels aloud with AI voices, plays online QQ/Kugou/Netease music and internet radio (HLS supported), and broadcasts daily news digests — all driven from the UI or by telling the agent through the music_play model tool.

title: Kevinwu901113/dsh-dot
description: A character who lives on her own phone: the plugin installs and runs her Android phone, and any app notification can wake her; she installs apps herself and browses, likes and comments in apps such as Xiaoheihe or Bilibili; she has her own QQ (NapCat / SnowLuma, multi-part replies, stickers); memory with people cards, a daily diary at 23:30 and automatic recall before each wake (local embeddings by default, SiliconFlow / DashScope optional); a life between conversations (after HDS-Interlude); and an optional microVM computer with approval gates. Sidebar tabs show her phone, her computer and a dot panel; personal settings live in ~/.dsh/dsh-dot.json, and each of the six components can be turned off. Only the QQ number set with /qq owner counts as you; other people's messages are treated as untrusted notifications.

title: KOGGUA-EDIT/dsh-pet-sayaka
description: Sayaka Miki desktop pet for the DeepSeek Harness Web UI: twelve hand-drawn sprites follow the live session state and swap instantly, with a tired slump after a turn, a furious second stage after ten pokes, and idle sword-polishing; repeated states change her line and a voice line plays every five to eight encounters.

title: koishi-fumo-code/dsh-fx-arena
description: Simulated FX trading arena played against an algorithmic whale-chan opponent: a live canvas candlestick chart over five instruments (EUR/TOKEN, GBP/TOKEN, TOKEN/JPY, gold, and Whale/TOKEN, her own coin she never shorts), selectable leverage from 10x to 500x, and two modes — a timed mode with 90s to 500s rounds settled on equity, and an untimed goal mode that starts with $300,000 and ends when someone first reaches $20M or goes into debt (equity below zero, no maintenance margin). The match runs in a module-level engine, so switching to a conversation does not stop it or restart it. Margin and spread are modeled, prices are a local random walk with occasional news shocks, and nothing touches the network or real money.

title: KongChengZhi/dsh-pixel-studio#dsh-cli-anything-aseprite
description: Aseprite-style pixel art studio: the AI draws sprites stroke by stroke with selections, layers, animation frames, gradients, symmetry and reference layers, each step rendered live as ANSI terminal frames.

title: Kris8888888/dsh-desktop-pet
description: A whale or pixel-crab pet that perches on the DSH input box and reacts to the current session (working, awaiting approval, done, error), eats the tokens each turn spends and keeps a diary.

title: Kun-Fox/dsh-foxy-bili
description: Lets Foxy browse Bilibili with daily windows and video limits, filter by interests, comment or remember through an editable prompt, reply to mentions and comment threads, and deduplicate per video. Requires dsh-foxy.

title: lankongtongmeng/dsh-pixelbar-studio
description: Drive an Edifier Halo PixelBar — a 256x32 1-bit dot-matrix screen in a desktop speaker — from DSH over raw USB HID: push custom bitmaps, play GIF animations, render pixel-art walk scenes from sprite sheets and push self-rendered text, with a color-calibration table, a hardware self-check and EQ / volume / lighting / face-scene control. A push can return the screen to the clock afterwards.

title: lastplayer82/dsh-tanqi
description: AI-generated curiosity & trivia plugin for the dsh web GUI (Curio in the English UI): 「开始探奇」 generates a fresh batch of unexpected knowledge (excluding everything already seen), each item unfolds into two deeper layers plus similar knowledge points, and 「探奇清单」 keeps the full history (batch, items, layers, similar points) in browser storage. Reuses the host LLM channel with zero config; when no model is available, a DeepSeek API key can be pasted into the panel. Output language follows the DSH UI language (zh/en).

title: lctfwyt/dsh-liuyao
description: Liuyao divination in one click — ask a question, cast the six-line hexagram, and let AI interpret it for you; every cast is saved locally.

title: leeclouddragon/dsh-all-in
description: Adds a local-only six-seat Texas Hold'em table to the DSH Web UI with full betting streets, side pots, persistent Token stacks, and agent-status display.

title: LeemanCheung/dsh-whale-companion
description: Draggable whale companion with local progression, achievements, skins, and privacy-safe activity tracking.

title: lemonxiny55/dsh-kurowhale-pet
description: KuroWhale is an unofficial dark-themed whale-girl desktop companion for Windows x64, inspired by the DeepSeek Harness icon, with nine animations that react to DSH Agent activity. Requires WebView2; the first launch downloads the official Neutralino 6.9.0 runtime and artwork over the network and verifies them by SHA-256.

title: lg6169219/dsh-fatfish-level
description: Adds a token-burn leveling widget to DSH with 14 DeepSeek-whale levels, daily quests, streaks and achievements.

title: lhh010/dsh-minigames
description: Side-panel arcade: 18 offline mini-games to play while the model thinks.

title: liang-today/dsh-liangxiang
