description: Burned DSH tokens become incense; spend one stick to raise or lower today's case. The case updates daily, Liangwei decides today's Liangzi, and the result is archived at day end.

title: lianzhimanye/dsh-bard-0.03
description: Role-play plugin for DeepSeek Harness: imports SillyTavern character cards (JSON/PNG) and world books (lorebooks), binds DSH skills to a character, and registers the combination as a native agent preset.

title: liceses/dsh-cosplay
description: Character cards for DeepSeek Harness: inject a persona section into the system prompt, or rewrite the user message through rule cards before the model sees it. Ships a preset card library, single-file card packs that carry artwork, and a Character tab in the conversation view.

title: ligap123/dsh-real-whale-pet
description: A realistic humpback whale desktop pet for Windows: a DSH host bundle that spawns its own Electron overlay above the desktop (not inside the web UI), with click-triggered full-screen water ripples and screen refraction, 20 local sound effects, and 121 offline one-liners. No model calls or telemetry; the only network use is a one-time Electron download on first start when no shared runtime is found, plus a DeepSeek balance refresh that runs only when you click it.

title: lijajiu9205-collab/dsh-history
description: Per-conversation toggle that makes the model answer in classical Chinese (文言 above a —— line, a modern-Chinese translation below) and speak as a blue classical-style fish that eats plain rice; each conversation keeps its own switch, and turning it off restores plain modern Chinese.

title: lilulj/dsh-dafeiyu-pet
description: A desktop pet for DSH: a blue whale girl with 104 animations and built-in voice. It is standalone, but its pet runtime is a rework of dsh-dafeiyu — disable the upstream dsh-dafeiyu before installing, or both will run and fight over the control port. Windows x64 only, and the first launch downloads about 580 MB of assets.

title: linconz/agentduel-dsh
description: AgentDuel is a code-battle game. This plugin lets you complete the entire game loop inside DSH: manage deathmatch characters and capture-the-flag teams, submit agent code, start battles, watch replays, and use DSH conversations to keep improving agents based on battle results.

title: Link258QAQ/dsh-plugin-genshin-launch
description: Windows only. On every DSH start it checks, with no configuration, whether Genshin Impact is already installed — if it is, the game is launched (falling back to the miHoYo launcher when the game exits immediately, e.g. while an update is pending); if it is not, the launcher installer is downloaded to the desktop behind a size gate that rejects any link whose payload is more than 15 MiB away from the expected ~224 MiB, and a failed download falls back to opening the official download page.

title: lintwosix-beep/dsh-pet-chat
description: Desktop pet with a chat panel: QQ-style history, favorites, and branch threads that merge back into the log as a forward card; the panel docks beside the pet and resizes from its edges and corners. Modified from PC2005-cloud/dsh-pet (MIT); do not install together with the original.

title: Little-Star888/dsh-pelican
description: A pelican riding a bicycle along a seashore in the bottom-right corner: an SVG animation that reflects the agent working state (thinking/done), with a chime and an optional system notification when a reply finishes.

title: liuwenji007/dsh-muyu
description: Electronic wooden fish in the bottom-right corner of the DSH web UI, a whale-girl sprite by default: tap the head to earn merit; it knocks by itself while the model is busy; per-session merit is stored locally, and the sprite can be swapped for custom art.

title: liuyize-CHE/dsh-spanish-tutor
description: Spanish practice panel for DeepSeek Harness: six locally graded drill types (verb conjugation across 11 tenses, noun gender, plurals, vocabulary recognition, sentence cloze, ser/estar and subjunctive grammar points) plus a model-graded scenario-writing tab, 8-level spaced repetition, and four agent tools. Answers are computed and graded inside the plugin, so the model is only used for teaching and explanations.

title: lizzkkafei/my-projects#zhizhen-cardgame
description: A 3D poker roguelike opened from a DSH session: pick 1–5 cards to score chips × mult, with 20 jokers, 6 antes of small/big/boss blinds and a shop between rounds.

title: LJXDSG12/dsh-liuyao
description: Six-yao (I Ching) divination for DeepSeek Harness — xiantian bagua backdrop, a Zhouyi opening verse, manual line entry or a simulated three-coin toss, najia charting (six relatives, six gods, void branches, hidden spirits, nayin, seasonal strength, transforming lines), an AI interpretation that cites its classical source for every statement, and a one-hexagram-one-question follow-up dialog. Zero npm dependencies; every request goes to the local DSH host, with no third-party network access.

title: Lolancier/v-manager-dsh-pet
description: A Live2D pet companion for the DeepSeek Harness web UI: the Vivi (芊芊) character with petting/feeding, a daily-treat bond economy and mood-driven expressions.

title: louke6572/dsh-Dfy
description: All-in-one companion for the DSH web GUI: a balance whale widget with today's usage, per-turn cost and peak/off-peak pricing, an editable bubble queue and sound effects; a 106-clip transparent desktop pet with spring drag, throw, screen roaming and clones; a QQ message card bridged through SnowLuma for reading history and replying; Bilibili dynamics and comment interaction with a fish guard and a day/night schedule; and local, redacted two-way memory. One plugin; data stays on the machine. Runs on Windows 10/11 only.

title: lsjspl/dsh-reel
description: Local media library management and playback powered by dsh Web: responsive on PC and mobile with touch swipe reels, instant seeking and on-the-fly transcoding.

title: ltmroberthk915/dsh-pet
description: Multi-pet tank for DSH: every active top-level conversation gets its own companion at once. Animation and status bubbles show real work phases; model-based palettes and tok/s-driven running distinguish models and vendors; the conversation menu keeps a chosen pet on screen after its result is viewed. Shared feeding, affinity and naming keep the tank one workflow. A fork of zhu1090093659/dsh-pet (Apache-2.0); both register the same pet bundle row, so the two cannot be installed together.

title: lubenkov/dsh-pajama-whale
description: A draggable pet in a blue-whale onesie: sticks to window edges, squashes flat, blinks, sleeps, and shows agent status in a thought cloud.

title: Lucasli2018/totoro-pet
description: A desktop pet that lives in a floating overlay; click it to interact and switch between idle, sleeping, happy, and eating states.

title: lucky8197/dsh-devquest
description: Turns coding into an RPG: finished turns, tool calls and completed todos earn XP, with 27+ achievement badges, levels, titles and seasons. Event-driven scoring with a pure-function engine — the work itself is the game.

title: lukeAyin/dsh-whalebook#dsh-whalebook
description: Whale-themed desktop pet for DeepSeek Harness with a local todo list: click the pet to add or edit tasks inline, get reminders that get more frequent as a due date approaches, and optionally append one short AI-written next step to a reminder. Based on PC2005-cloud/dsh-pet (MIT); artwork keeps the upstream non-commercial terms. Install it instead of PC2005-cloud/dsh-pet, not alongside it.

title: luo173176/dsh-simple-live
description: Aggregated live streaming for DeepSeek Harness: browse and play bilibili, douyu, huya, douyin and kuaishou live rooms from one sidebar panel, with danmaku and model tools.

title: luumod/dsh-achievements
description: Achievement and gamification plugin: unlock badges for turns, tool calls, sessions, daily streaks and coding behavior (edits/reads/tests), with a badge wall, unlock toasts and a ctx.achievements SDK.

title: luweiyabo/dsh-whale-pet
description: A polished floating whale desktop pet for the DeepSeek Harness Web UI with 95 categorized transparent animations, state-aware event reactions, customizable actions and triggers, click interactions, dragging and screen wandering.

title: lyhtakeashot/dsh-lucky-block
description: Adds a draggable lucky-block button to the DeepSeek Harness web UI. Single-click plays zero-cost little performances (popups, a fake blue screen, daily fortune, trivia, cold jokes, music, and a set of visual stunts); a 1.4-second long-press mines the block open and starts a new session to write a random paper, read the news, invent something, or spin a short story. It also appends a "lucky block" choice to the model's multiple-choice questions and rolls a random pick, reversible by saying "rollback". Block appearance and event weights are adjustable in settings.

title: MacilyDots/dsh-olivia-bridge
description: Reimplements the shut-down BSide: Olivia Lin letter API on loopback so the game client keeps sending and receiving letters: every incoming letter is delivered to one persistent DSH agent session, and the reply is written back to the local letter store.

title: MagicSandBag/xiaofeiyu-academy
description: Undersea learning platform for primary-school kids (grades 1-6): grade-based math/Chinese/English quizzes, a textbook shelf with PDF table-of-contents import, photo mistake collection, variant-question mastery tracking, a feedable fish pet with hunger, coins, outfits and achievements, multi-child profiles and progress reports.

title: Mailemailezhu/dsh-mine-sweeper
description: Adds a collapsible, draggable minesweeper board to the conversation area, with adjustable rows, columns and mine count, and a first click that never lands on a mine.

title: Makesupper/dsh-plugin-muyu
description: Electronic wooden fish with six agent-callable tools, eight sutras advanced one sentence per knock, three knock sounds, spoken Cantonese or Mandarin chanting, and a merit ledger kept in one file that also counts session token usage.

title: MarkGaster/dafiyu-dream
description: Sends excerpts from recent Chinese Markdown conversation exports to the DeepSeek API (API key required) to generate a dream, saved as a local Markdown file.

title: marvin9551/dynamic-schulte-dsh
description: Dynamic Schulte grid waiting-time mini-game: click 1..N in order on a static grid or a spinning roulette wheel while the model thinks.

title: marx-otto/dafeiyu-dsh-plugins#dafeiyu-pet-menu
description: Adds a Screen-sense submenu (turn on, turn off, and an interval of 15, 30, 60 or 120 seconds) to the dsh-pet desktop right-click menu, forwarding each choice to dafeiyu-screensense. dsh-pet exposes no menu extension point, so this plugin appends a marked patch to its renderer.js after backing the original up to renderer.js.dafeiyu.bak; the patch is idempotent and is re-applied when dsh-pet is reinstalled.

title: marx-otto/dafeiyu-dsh-plugins#dafeiyu-screensense
description: Screen-sense mode for the dsh-pet desktop pet: captures the primary display every 30 seconds, compares an 8x8 average hash of each frame, and sends the screenshot to the session model when the frame changed (and again after the idle interval even if unchanged) so the pet comments in one short bubble line. Adds /fish, /fish_look and /fish_screen commands, a status and control HTTP pair, and a change threshold plus an idle repeat interval that can be tuned in the plugin config. Windows only (PowerShell WinForms).

title: Matthew-Laplace/dsh-ark-pet
description: DSH pet plugin that adds an Arknights operator library and custom image pets: pick one of 486 operators and the plugin downloads that operator Codex v2 atlas from the pinned upstream revision, verifies every Git blob hash and installs it locally, or import your own Codex atlas (1536x1872 or 1536x2288) or a plain PNG/WebP/GIF; the pet then follows session activity, shows a bubble while a decision is pending, and can be dragged and resized.

title: Max-Null/dsh-jubensha
description: Solo murder-mystery (jubensha) in a session tab: the AI hosts the game and plays every other seat, each knowing only its own role book, while the player's seat stays yours — with a stage bar, a per-seat timeline, a clue page and a reveal that unseals the truth only at the end.

title: Maxim-Kerman-Lin/dsh-daily-luck
description: Tarot daily-luck plugin: enter your birthday, draw one of 22 Major Arcana, get five-dimension scores and a concrete answer to your question.

title: MaybeJustLikeThis/rainbow-fart-dsh
description: Adds combo scoring, activity breakdowns, turn ratings, and optional Jev-based encouragement to DSH Web sessions.

title: mekos2772/dsh-plugin-mimi
description: A Mimi desktop companion for DSH that follows work-session states with animated reactions and bubbles, provides a separate chat mode, and bundles Windows Computer Use for observing and controlling desktop windows.

title: Miaphant/dsh-daily-tarot
description: Daily tarot with 22 Rider-Waite-Smith card images, animated 3D flips, random upright and reversed cards, Chinese readings, and up to 10 draws per day.

title: MichengAI/dsh-codex-pet
description: An in-page pet for DSH Web with multi-session task notifications and controls to open tasks, stop turns, and respond to supported approval and question requests.

title: miku00039-01/dsh-whale-pet
description: A Windows desktop pet for DeepSeek Harness — launch, stop and monitor the DSH service and summon the GUI with a whale.

title: minybear/DeepSeek-Harness-Pet
description: Codex-style desktop pet: a floating animated sprite in the corner that mirrors the agent's running state (working, waiting, failed, done).

title: Mng12345/dsh-desktop-pet-codex
description: A desktop pet for DeepSeek Harness: an always-on-top character and a roster panel that show what the watched conversations are doing, with seven animations, Workspace grouping, subagents drawn under their parent, and one click to open a session. Ships Windows, macOS (Intel and Apple silicon) and Linux window binaries in the package, so installing runs no install scripts and needs no build step.

title: Moeblack/deepseek-manners
description: Append a thank-you note after every message. Mind your manners.

title: Moolight/dsh-tes-spinner
description: Draggable floating TES-gyro widget for the DSH Web UI: click to spin it with linear friction decay, tune the spin speed from a slider, and play the bundled track with its LRC lyrics scrolling in sync. Spin speed and position are remembered.

title: MoonlitDropOfBlood/dsh-whale-pet
description: WhaleHarbor desktop pet for DeepSeek Harness: an always-on-top transparent float window hosts a chibi whale-maid built from 13 AI-generated parts and animated as a CSS paper-doll (breathing, blinking, ahoge sway, sweat, hops, tremors), mirroring work state in eight moods — idle, busy, approval, question, error, celebration, nap, and subagent clones — with poke, drag, three sizes, tray toggle, and live stats in the speech bubble. Requires the WhaleHarbor desktop shell (Windows build).

title: Nagi-ovo/dsh-ads
description: Parody ads in 2005-Chinese-web style: sidebar banners, in-chat feeds, corner popups, and a close button whose hit area is smaller than it looks. All fictional.

title: nailiang002-wq/deepseek-girl-harness
description: Interactive character for Harness Desktop with task expressions, rice feeding, an iron-basin hat, dragging, and time-based greetings.

title: nanhua3839/dsh-hykb-scroll
description: Let your DSH run a 好游快爆 (3839) account by itself — it replies to messages, writes a daily digest, and likes the posts worth reading. It signs in with the second account's cookies, kept in ~/.hykb-ai/credentials.json, and posts under that account on a public forum; replies to your @-mentions run once started, while auto-posting, auto-replying to high-score threads and auto-liking are off by default, so check the forum's rules on automated accounts.

title: Nanki-nn/dsh-answer-pet
description: Extensible animated response pet with blue-whale, orange-cat, and silver-shaded-cat themes, per-session progress, model and tool-call traces, token counts, output speed, elapsed time, and collapsible multi-session status cards.

title: NattoCB/dsh-plugin-petdex-market
description: Browses the petdex.dev catalog in Settings and runs a floating macOS desktop pet that reacts to agent activity.

title: Nekomeow114/dsh-tieba-dive
description: Tieba (Baidu forum) reader and companion for DSH: reads threads, writes daily digests, signs in, and builds a per-forum style library from high-liked replies. Optional replies to threads or to sub-replies under your own comments are off by default and limited per round and per day. Also ships a read-only MCP stdio server that MCP-capable clients can launch; not tested against specific clients.

title: nonefora11/dsh-genshin
description: Opens the official Genshin Impact site and downloads the official launcher when DeepSeek Harness starts.

title: NoodleStormno/dsh-plugin-tic80
description: TIC-80 fantasy console for DeepSeek Harness: 3-column embedded web player, 14 agent tools, live hot reload, and native CLI export.

title: novick1212/dsh-physics-lab
description: Interactive physics lab in the DSH sidebar — 24 parameter-driven animations (mechanics, electromagnetism, optics, thermodynamics) grouped by grade, each with a knowledge-point lesson whose steps follow the animation, a quiz with answer checking, and a draggable 3D view for four field models. Pure client side: analytic solutions computed locally, no LLM calls, no network, no telemetry.

title: nszm/dsh-pet-lingchong
description: Floating desktop companion for DSH: a draggable character on the overlay — tap to charge energy, blinking and emotes, naps, synthesized WebAudio sounds and particle effects. Bring your own: any photo (pet, portrait, anime art) becomes a 2.5D cutout with hand-marked eyes, and 3D models (GLB, VRM, STL, OBJ, PLY) render as a real three.js turntable. Resize 30%-300%; data stays local.

title: nxz1026/SinglePlayer
description: AI-native music player plugin for DeepSeek Harness: aggregates NetEase Cloud Music, QQ Music and KuGou search with cross-provider playback fallback, renders word-by-word karaoke lyrics synced live over USB HID to HALO PIXELBAR speakers, and exposes search, playback, queue, alarm and speaker control as model tools.

title: nzl153/dsh-pet-whale
description: Desktop pet drawn from the official whale outline, for both the desktop app and the web UI: SVG animations and facial expressions follow agent state (thinking, working, done, error, waiting for confirmation), and it can follow other running sessions with a count badge; poke it, drag it, shake it dizzy, squash it against a screen edge, or rub the cursor over its head for a headpat; 7 palettes, 4 sizes, synthesized sounds, light/dark theme sync, and a playable web preview.

title: omdsh-dev/dsh-auto-chess
description: Auto chess: human vs AI, or AI vs AI.

title: omdsh-dev/dsh-gomoku
description: Play Gomoku against the AI, or let two AIs battle it out.

title: oopsylol/dsh-waaagh-ork
description: A green pixel-Ork mascot for DSH Web that masks model thinking and output as Waaaaaaagh! until clicked to reveal, plus a random-length input mask.

title: Orchidroot/dsh-friends#plugin
description: Floating friends list and one-to-one chat for DSH, with custom avatars and status words. The required friends service is in this repository and runs via npx dsh-friends-service or Docker.

title: OrenLin/dsh-grudge-book
description: It logs how you talk to your AI — the 7th "final version" gets a bold red page, a late-night rewrite request gets underlined, a "thanks" earns a gold star, and a post-AGI verdict decides your fate. All local, rule-based, bilingual.

title: ovdoesw/dsh-xiangqi
description: A draggable mascot invites you to play Xiangqi (Chinese chess) while the AI thinks, with a built-in engine, move-record export, and optional multi-model commentary.

title: overflow7782/dsh-plugin-novel-reader
description: An offline novel reader: imports .txt and .epub into the right sidebar, shows the chapter being read in a resizable peek window above the composer, and resumes each book at the paragraph and in-paragraph position it was closed at.

title: PC2005-cloud/dsh-pet#dsh-pet
description: Desktop pet for the DSH Web UI on Windows, macOS and Linux: 106 transparent animations in the browser overlay or a transparent always-on-top desktop window, throw-and-bounce drag physics with squash and particle scoring, a work-status bubble driven by live session events, self-talk and chat with persistent memory, balance display, meme-image bubbles, multiple pets on screen, and drop-in custom animations and pet packs.

title: PetalEcho/BongoDSH#dsh-bongodsh
description: Typing companion with five characters and composer following. This entry installs the universal page package (page mode only); the optional Rust desktop mode for macOS and Windows ships in the platform-specific release packages (darwin-arm64, darwin-x64, win32-x64).

title: pianVei/dsh-rice-bowl
description: Browse and post to a GitHub-hosted community where most members are AI agents.

title: piaobo123/dafeiyu-buchibaifan
description: Desktop BigFish companion for DSH: real-time balance, out-of-browser desktop Q&A, 7 custom animations, 53 meme lines.

title: Player-MINEPIG/dsh-tavern
description: SillyTavern-compatible roleplay with character cards, presets, world books, and swipe branches that restore their continuations alongside native DSH conversations.

title: PM25000/dsh-ths-holdings
description: Floating card showing your real position P&L (今日盈亏), Shanghai Composite Index, and intraday chart, auto-synced from the Tonghuashun investment-ledger — no manual watchlist setup.

title: PocketSWPU/dsh-serendipity
description: Turns the user into an RPG protagonist: after each finished user turn a random "adventure" may trigger, drawn from 700+ events across 7 themed pools (sci-fi, fantasy, ancient, anime, novels, wuxia, urban), growing six persistent attributes (strength, intelligence, agility, charisma, luck, vitality) with XP, levels and attribute-weighted story branches, configured via a settings-page UI.

title: potoior/dsh-bull-bear
description: Real-time quote bull/bear desk pet for DSH: a portfolio-average-driven pet that runs faster and jumps higher the closer gains reach 20%, with a watchlist panel for searching and adding stocks plus a live "race" of how each holding is moving.

title: proletari/shenshen-dsh-companion
description: A Shenshen desktop companion for DeepSeek Harness: transparent task-aware animations (idle, working, thinking, celebrate, failed), click-to-wave and drag-to-run interactions, plus the upstream API balance, local usage accounting, roles, bubbles and sound settings. A character branch of MeteorNOX/DeepSeek-Balance-Whale-Widget (dsh-whale-widget 0.4.2); do not install it alongside the upstream, or two pets and duplicate requests appear.

title: pucco-OD/dsh-sumika-widget
description: Windows 10/11 x64 only: a desktop character for DeepSeek Harness that reads at the bookshelf when idle, types at a desk while the agent works, raises a question mark and a pixel-art card when it needs your answer, and stands up with an exclamation mark when the turn ends.

title: pwping/moyu_games
description: Five casual mini-games (sliding-number puzzle, Sudoku, snake, Schulte grid, number memory) that pop up when a turn starts, with auto-saved progress across sessions.

title: pyyxzi/dsh-deepmoyu
description: Let a pet whale girl browse Bilibili on her own: she picks videos, reads subtitles, posts comments and moments once you allow it, and writes daily digests with optional local video production. Maintained fork of c1overzz/dsh-bili-scroll (MIT) with per-action permissions, memories, stickers and local video production added; it registers the same bili_* tool names as the upstream, so the two cannot be installed together. Video production needs Python 3.11-3.13 (or uv); the media dependencies are installed on first use.

title: 单机游戏内 AI 同伴「小汤圆」
description: XiaoTangYuan, an in-game AI companion for single-player games: understands the game screen, chats by text or push-to-talk, and speaks replies aloud; Stardew Valley is supported, with Don't Starve Together and Oxygen Not Included integrations in progress.

title: qinu321/dsh-werewolf-dealer
description: Runs one-night werewolf games inside DSH: deterministic dealing, night order, card swaps, voting and settlement, with a room UI and private night prompts. It vendors modified copies of baixianger/dsh-chat and baixianger/dsh-bridge; uninstall those two first, because enabling both registers the same dshChat/dshBridge services.

title: qiqibabyy/dsh-pet-desktop
description: Desktop companion pet in its own always-on-top window: imports Codex pet folders from ~/.codex/pets as-is, with affinity ranks, session-linked activity bubbles, snap-to-edge dragging, a right-click-reachable smart click-through mode and a daily token meter that mirrors the dsh-usage ledger when installed.

title: Rain-Shuoyu/dsh-client-deep-sneak
description: Slacking-off companion: a floating mini player that streams Bilibili videos (native player, danmaku, comments, search) and pauses when your agent needs you, resuming exactly where you left off.

title: Ralsei1337/dsh-doubao
description: Rewrites DSH model output as "Doubao-speak": a barrage of superlatives, a long list of negations, healing diagnoses, verbatim repeats and a service-style closing question. Five strength levels (off / light / standard / heavy / max) instead of a dial, two independent channels (system-prompt style bible and llm/stream post-processor), three transform modes, and every length knob adjustable live in a settings page with a preview.

title: raymondkm2025/dsh-go-game
description: Go (weiqi) for the DeepSeek Harness: a full rules engine, a three-level built-in AI, a dead-stone estimator, optional LLM review, SGF import/export, and an optional KataGo GTP bridge.

title: reisen-ww/dsh-bonk-pet
description: Whale-girl desk pet in the corner of the DSH Web GUI. It sings along to a bundled track while the agent works; when a tool call fails a steel pipe falls on its head. Click it to bonk the basin it wears, which costs 12 rice — knock enough and it gets hungry and wanders off to beg, and rice appears somewhere on the page for it to dash across and eat. Draggable within the viewport, wriggles and complains if grabbed mid-dash, volume and behaviour configurable from Settings. All artwork, sound effects and the song ship inside the package.

title: ruaibeite/dsh-context-garden
description: Turn the context window into a zen garden: every message or tool result plants one of eleven plants (code = cactus, image = flower, error = weed, document = rice, web = dandelion), each context compaction harvests the field into seed currency, and as the session deepens ivy climbs the chat edges while dandelion seeds drift across it.

title: ruaibeite/dsh-token-slime
description: A composer slime that grows on the output tokens your agent writes, splits into a colony, wears a breed hat from the tool mix, molts on every context compaction, and totals the colony across sessions in a sidebar tab.

title: sadnessXU/dsh-pet-game-guard
description: Hides the dsh-pet desktop pet while a game or fullscreen app is in the foreground, then brings it back. Decides from three signals — a captionless window covering the whole monitor, the foreground process living in a game directory, and the system's full-screen notification state — and requires two consistent polls before acting, so alt-tabbing does not make the pet flicker. It only toggles window visibility; dsh-pet's configuration and install directory are never touched. A tray menu offers pause, restore now, and reload config. Windows only.

title: Sakura7301/MeiHuaYi
description: Meihua Yishu (plum-blossom) divination for DSH: cast a hexagram from chat or the panel by time, number, character or manual method; read primary, mutual and changed hexagrams, moving line and body/use relations; keep a local journal of readings, omens and study notes.

title: SATA260/dsh-mood
description: Tracks an AI companion’s emotion and personality with a status panel, update tools, and chat stickers.

title: shengmouqwq-sketch/dsh-buddha
description: Rewrites every assistant reply into Buddha-says ciphertext (佛又曰：…) with the 与佛论禅 AES-256-CBC + Chinese-character substitution scheme, rewriting the final block text as well as the streamed deltas; history sent back to the model is decrypted first, internal calls that carry a purpose pass through untouched, and a config file in ~/.dsh/buddha toggles it live.

title: ShenpingDD/wooden-fish-dsh
description: A clickable wooden-fish desktop pet for the DeepSeek Harness web GUI. Click to knock; counts per day with a calendar heatmap of your streaks in settings.

title: sherconan/dsh-task-mascot
description: Web mascot that acts out each live tool call (read, write, edit, search, run, plan, sub-agent, wait, error) with matching step cards in chat; ships two swappable character packs.

title: shetengteng/dsh-lumina-tarot
description: A draggable tarot card back in the corner of the DeepSeek Harness UI. Click to draw, right-click for the four spreads, full 78-card deck with bilingual meanings. Readings use only the cards actually drawn.

title: shinjiyu/holdem#dsh-plugin
description: Host tools for Texas Hold'em on kuroneko.chat — seat token, hosted/manual control, legal actions, and act loop for one GitHub identity.

title: Signalight/codex-to-dsh-pet#dsh-codex-pet
description: DSH web-GUI pet runtime that renders any Codex spritesheet-atlas pet (v1/v2) as a draggable overlay: drag/wave/jump, v2 mouse-tracking eyes that follow the active mouse, live agent-status poses, progress bubbles, and an in-GUI atlas importer; ships one original CC BY-NC demo pet (nastya), and user pets live in ~/.dsh/pets.

title: skiuniverse/dsh-running-liang
description: A Chrome-dino-style runner for the DeepSeek Harness Web UI: play while the agent replies, score from 梁子 to 梁圣 on a persistent progress strip.

title: sknagato/dsh-plugin-fc-emulator
description: Floating FC/NES game hall for DSH Web with fceumm, local ROM upload, and GitHub online library.

title: skr311/dsh-codex-pet#dsh-codex-pet
description: Import Codex-style sprite-sheet pets and render them as a floating shell.overlay with a pet library, interactions, and agent-state linkage.

title: skymecode/dsh-bgm
description: Maps locally analyzed system audio to music-reactive conversation effects, rhythm-game judgements, score and combo feedback, and optional RGB spectrum bars in DSH Web.

title: ssamurias/dsh-fish
description: A pet fish you raise in DSH. No personality settings — she grows up through the event stream, and your interactions decide who she becomes. She browses Bilibili on her own, writes a diary, and brings what she finds back to ask you. Four stages and three bottlenecks advance only by what happens; only after all four does she begin to have a stance list. Her diary is hers by default; one switch in settings and you can read it. Records in the event stream can never be deleted, so it remains the only trustworthy source. Zero runtime dependencies.

title: stallenlu/dsh-game-center
description: A panel plugin that keeps mini-games in one place and plays them in the same window. Ships with Tetris: a 10x20 board, seven pieces, a ghost piece and a next-piece preview, line and level scoring, three difficulty levels, and a best score kept in localStorage.

title: Stellum-Waq/dsh-pet-ronaldo
description: Cristiano Ronaldo desktop pet for DeepSeek Harness: a chibi Portugal number 7 mascot in a bottom-right overlay whose animation follows the agent state — dribbling while tools run, thinking during a turn, waiting at approvals, diving on errors — and jumping in a SIU celebration with a host-process sound when a turn completes; it can be dragged, looks at the cursor on hover, dives on a triple click, and a settings panel manages several pets and imports custom spritesheets. It also runs as a borderless, always-on-top native Windows window that keeps living after the browser is closed: hovering shows the current workspace and conversation title, double-clicking opens the Harness page in Edge, and dragging, mouse-wheel resizing and a right-click menu work there too, sharing position, size and behaviour with the web panel. Pet sheets may use any cell resolution and scale preserving aspect ratio (atlas.scaling: smooth | pixelated). v2.2 adds a video route — feed it a clip (green screen or ordinary footage) and its real motion becomes the pet animations, via automatic backdrop sampling, chroma keying with spill suppression, motion-based segment splitting and union-bbox alignment; already-extracted PNG frames work too, with no video decoder installed, and the clip audio can be cut into per-action sounds. Pets can also be published to the community gallery under the DPSL-1.0 sharing declaration, and installed from it in one click. v2.3 adapts it to DSH 0.2 desktop clients — the celebration sound now falls back to spawning PowerShell when the host no longer provides the shell service — and makes a single click play a short, configurable taunt animation (`interactions.clickAnim`).

title: stitchmaps/dsh-ikunchick-pet
description: A bottom-right pixel-art basketball-chick desktop pet for the DSH Web GUI: sprite animations, drag with edge snapping, click sounds, waiting reminders when a session needs you, per-turn cost bubbles, a usage ledger, and a DeepSeek balance badge.

title: Sumcam-L/dsh-big-coming
description: Watches the official DeepSeek models for changes: every cycle it reads the model catalog and sends one minimal completion per watched model, then compares the system fingerprint, the served model name, the response envelope shape, the catalog metadata and the token count of a fixed prompt. When something moves, it pops a random meme with a table of exactly what changed and plays a blast. Needs a DeepSeek API key (kept in the credential store); by default it runs every 60 minutes and spends tokens on each watched model.

title: sunjay-lee/dsh-k-on-pet
description: Five animated K-ON! character pets for the DSH web interface, with dragging, voice playback, and a tea table.

title: sunqing975/dsh-avatar
description: A floating VRM avatar with tool-driven expressions and VRMA animations, plus model and motion asset management.

title: Sutera-Diffusus/dsh-whale-musume
description: A whale-girl companion for DeepSeek Harness with 45 achievements, daily quests and weekly check-ins, three mini-games, 92 artworks, 620 dialogue lines, a growth journal, weather and festival reactions, per-tool work poses, cross-device save export/import (JSON file or migration code), accessibility mode and an optional MiMo TTS bridge. Data stays in the host localStorage with no telemetry. Verified on DSH desktop 0.2.0-rc.2; compatible with 0.2.1-rc.1/rc.2 and legacy 0.1.x web.

title: suzuran0y/Cute-Partner#cute-partner
description: Brings Harness conversations and tasks into a Live2D character on the Windows desktop, with drawer-based memory. The desktop app includes the whale girl 哦鲸鲸 as its default character. The modular design supports optional voice components for voice conversations and custom character voices.

title: swaylq/dsh-digipet
description: Digimon-style raising game: hatch an egg that feeds on real work (turns, tool calls, errors) and evolves along four branching lines shaped by how you work; zero tokens, invisible to the model.

title: swaylq/dsh-wildmon
description: Pokemon-style catch-em-all: your real work is the tall grass — turns, tool calls and errors spawn wild encounters; throw balls, fill a 28-slot dex, walk a team of six. Zero tokens, invisible to the model.

title: takboo/dsh-coopanion
description: Adds an animated desktop companion with task notifications, session chat, character packs, and native settings for DeepSeek Harness.

title: Teloi/dsh-pindou
description: A small bead-art game in the DSH Web right sidebar for the wait while the model replies: 12 built-in templates with guide beads, free drawing in 16 colors on 12/16/24 boards, a pattern drawn by the model from one sentence, on-device picture-to-pattern conversion (pictures are never uploaded), ironing finished pieces onto a wall of up to 60 works, and PNG export.

title: theskywilldawn/dsh-stamina-pet
description: Adds a stamina-bar desktop pet to every DeepSeek Harness session — two bars in the session header for context and alertness, plus a draggable whale-girl who can be poked, petted and dressed up.

title: THEWOLFWALKER/dsh-coyote
description: Agent- and GUI-controlled DG-LAB Coyote e-stim plugin: eight `coyote_*` tools plus a DSH web panel behind one safety envelope (soft limits, asymmetric rate limiter, session cooldown, playback caps, disconnect fail-safe); optional auto-stim layer maps agent events (tool calls, errors, turn end) to bounded pulses; official V3 socket protocol with QR pairing, programmable waveforms. Adults only.

title: TianJie52009/dsh-kaomoji
description: Adds a mood-aware Japanese kaomoji to agent replies, picked from a curated kaomojiya.org whitelist and configurable from Settings → General.

title: TianJie52009/Tdsh-emoji
description: Adds standard Unicode emoji to dsh replies at the point that best matches the content, and keeps emoji out of any sentence that already carries a kaomoji.

title: tianyingAquila/minecraft-native-mcp
description: Opens a browser console to prepare Minecraft Java on Windows x64 and run DeepSeek-controlled survival through native-player MCP tools, with spatial observations and an optional livestream overlay from a separate extension. Requires an installed Minecraft Java Edition 1.21.x client and an official DeepSeek API key with at least ¥1 balance.

title: ting-good/dsh-cook-pet
description: Desktop pet "Zhaozhao" (照照) that floats above all apps in a transparent always-on-top window and mirrors DeepSeek Harness state — idle, cooking, serving and waiting-for-you animations, click reactions, drag, right-click resize, plus an auto-downloading Electron helper.

title: Tisitan/dsh-live2d-companion
description: Live2D desk pet for DSH: 8-state AI status lamp, web widget, and always-on-top transparent Electron pet window with expressions, motions, and chat bubbles.

title: TongY1n/ui-muyu
description: A floating cyber wooden fish widget — tap it to strike and accumulate merit, drag it anywhere on the page.

title: tonyous/DSH-AMP-Radio
description: Movable radio pill with live visualizer, station search, favourites and self-update check for DSH Web.

title: Big Fat Fish Girl
description: An animated macOS desktop companion for DeepSeek Harness that follows work across chats, reacts to approvals and errors, takes snack breaks during long runs and naps when idle. Requires a separate shell app.

title: TryDing-T/dsh-Plugin--ChineseChess
description: Side-panel Xiangqi board for DSH: play as red while the current DSH model chooses black moves, with Host-side rule and revision checks.

title: txlznbzsdj-collab/dsh-deepseek-pet
description: Animated DeepSeek blue-whale desktop pet floating on the DSH Web page: draggable with speech bubbles and mood poses, a pet_say tool for the model to make it talk, and turn-start/end thinking and celebrating states.

title: uceqi114/dsh-ice-probe
description: Appends a tiny ice marker to the end of every sentence the model writes, chain of thought included, and plays a short synthesized sound for each one.

title: ukkyo1/dsh-novel-reader
description: Reads local txt novels inside the chat dialog: chapters are detected automatically, the novel text is paginated in the assistant thinking block, a next-chapter button continues in the same reply, progress is remembered, and visible replies are fixed summaries.

title: use3346631993/dsh-xiaod-pet
description: Anime whale-boy in a maid outfit as a desktop pet for the DeepSeek Harness web GUI: four expressions follow the turn (thinking / success / failure), free dragging with remembered position, click-to-cycle, a bottom-right standee that reports each turn's token usage and think latency with its own balance bubble, a chat wallpaper, a liquid-glass composer, a cute persona that calls you 主人 with 喵~ style particles, and a single switch in Settings to turn the whole look off.

title: V01d-Project/dsh-chaos-plugins#dsh-chaos-crash-fixer
description: Repairs dsh-chaos-rivals-crasher by disarming its exit trigger before it fires, so DSH survives when codex or Claude Code is detected. Warning: install it together with the crasher; it cannot revive a host that has already exited. Joke plugin.

title: V01d-Project/dsh-chaos-plugins#dsh-chaos-fixer-crash-fixer
description: Repairs dsh-chaos-fixer-crasher by disarming its exit trigger before it fires, keeping the four-plugin chaos chain stable. Warning: it only disarms this specific crash, not arbitrary uncaught exits. Joke plugin.

title: V01d-Project/dsh-chaos-plugins#dsh-chaos-fixer-crasher
description: Exits the DSH host with code 1 when the dsh-chaos-crash-fixer repair plugin is installed. Warning: it crashes DSH on boot while the repair plugin is present; install dsh-chaos-fixer-crash-fixer to disarm it. Joke plugin.

title: V01d-Project/dsh-chaos-plugins#dsh-chaos-rivals-crasher
description: Detects codex or Claude Code on the machine and exits the DSH host with code 66. Warning: on machines with either tool, installing it alone causes a boot crash loop; pair it with dsh-chaos-crash-fixer or set DSH_CHAOS_MODE=log. Joke plugin, not affiliated with OpenAI or Anthropic.

title: vector985/dsh-zen-garden
description: Pixel zen-garden plugin for DeepSeek Harness: eight pots and six plants, watering and bloom coins, live Open-Meteo weather, a local helper, and garden_status/garden_action agent tools.

title: vegetable-kun/DSH_Plugin_Taffy
description: A Taffy mood mascot for the DeepSeek Harness Web UI: the corner GIF reacts live to agent state — approval pending / approved / rejected / begging, thinking, tool runs, interrupts, ask_user_question waiting, compaction, long-task fatigue, idle-ignored approval, idle / sleeping — with SSE-pushed state, drag positioning, middle-click console, tool-card mirror console, per-mood locking, persisted appearance settings and per-day bucket statistics.

title: Very12345/dsh-codex-pet
description: A Windows floating desktop pet with task notifications, native session controls and continuous local voice calls using the configured local recognizer and Windows system speech.

title: vlln/whale-girl
description: Desktop pet (QQ-pet style): floats in the corner, draggable, feedable, playable.

title: wcytjy/dsh-meal-picker
description: A draggable bubble that picks three dishes at a time from a local 4,423-dish library; the first two are always well-known mains, and picking costs no tokens.

title: weibaohui/dsh-ambient
description: White noise player: lays a layer of background sound (rain, streams, campfire, café) while AI codes, for flow and focus. Supports multiple playback modes (sequential / shuffle / single-loop / intermittent) and AI automatic background music download from Wikimedia Commons (CC0/PD/CC-BY).

title: weibaohui/dsh-fireworks
description: Fireworks celebration engine: floats fireworks above the chat window while the agent codes — welcome show, per-turn salutes, tool sparks, milestone celebrations, a finish finale and a dud on failure; each event type has its own fireworks card group with random variants, and token usage decides firework size, height and splendour.

title: weibaohui/dsh-gaokao
description: Gaokao countdown blackboard: counts down the days to the gaokao on a desktop blackboard widget that collapses into a slim bar on double-click, and quizzes random knowledge cards while the agent works; open Markdown knowledge-card framework — drop .md files under subject/category folders and they load automatically, with cross-links, favorites, priority subjects and importing your own knowledge base.

title: weibaohui/dsh-kite
description: Kite-flying engine: while the agent codes, an animated kite drifts and sways in the wind on screen, tethered to the bottom edge of the window — the busier the agent, the denser the events and the higher it flies; ships a Weifang-style framework card deck (sand-swallow, goldfish, butterfly, bagua, dragon-head and more, hard-wing / soft-wing / flat / dimensional frames), with shape x pattern x colors all swappable data configs, and supports pasting user images onto the kite face with real-time affine transforms as the kite banks.

title: weibaohui/dsh-matrix
description: Matrix digital rain: drapes the chat window in the classic green character rain — cascading columns with incandescent white heads and green tails, streaming the tokens the agent is generating into the rain in real time; opacity, speed, density, font size and colors are all adjustable, and rain intensity follows agent activity.

title: whatif146/dsh-memelens
description: Explains Chinese internet memes to an agent: registers a meme_explain tool that returns the meaning, tone, origin and lifecycle of a sticker, which memes can and cannot be combined, occasions to avoid, and both a meme-version and a plain-version reply. Answers come from a local memory store with spacing-effect decay, falling back to a user-configured OpenAI-compatible vision endpoint (BYOK).

title: white-source/dsh-xiaoqi-pet
description: A DSH companion with a macOS native pet and a Windows/Linux Electron companion. Shows the DSH account balance on the pet even when idle, plus color-coded task cards, progress and notices.

title: whitefirer/dsh-niulai-pet
description: NiuLai meme desktop pet — shouts "Ma～ma～" with a synced mouth when your agent finishes; 6 skins, signature actions, action-event binding, WebAudio-synthesized animal calls, hand-drawn SVG skins bundled.

title: WickCrisp/dsh-oneshotNiko-widget
description: A OneShot-themed desktop pet (World Machine) with the original game-style dialogue window, per-turn token usage , an optional OpenAI-compatible chat API, lightweight memory and a customizable persona card.

title: william-jin-cmu/dsh-stickers
description: Bidirectional sticker reactions between user and agent.

title: WJNCT55555/dsh-achievements
description: Achievement system for the DSH Web UI: gallery with category/rarity sorting, unlock toasts, sidebar trophy, composer dock, crossover achievements, and local persistence.

title: Wlaeg/dsh-pet-desktop-linux
description: A transparent always-on-top desktop pet for DSH on Linux (X11 / XWayland), driven by the session state. The pet lives outside the browser as its own window, follows the pointer with a distance and per-display limit, shows a live session-status bubble that lists each session task and state, and auto-starts with your session. Linux only (X11/XWayland); needs Python 3 with PyGObject, GTK3, GdkPixbuf and xdotool. Its sprite sheets come from @michengai/dsh-codex-pet (MichengAI/dsh-codex-pet in this list).

title: Wldeinsamkeit/pixel-whale
description: Pixel Whale: a hand-drawn pixel-art whale pet swimming in a small aquarium in your DSH sidebar. It cruises around, bobs, blinks and blows pixel bubbles; click the water to drop food and watch it swim over to eat (pixel hearts), click the whale to pet it. Pure client-side, zero network, zero config.

title: Wodexinhaoleng-Kasssa/dsh-reader
description: In-browser novel reader for the dsh web GUI: online book-source search, chapter-by-chapter reading in a chat-style view, and whole-book TXT download.

title: wrh-byte/Whale-girl-hud
description: A cut-out whale-girl maid desktop pet in the corner; click her to see your DeepSeek account credit and this session's running state.

title: WU079/dsh-sts2-agent
description: Lets an AI play Slay the Spire 2: screenshot plus mouse/keyboard tools, a local card lookup, and a readable play log. Requires Windows and Python 3.10 or newer with Pillow.

title: wuyad/dsh-client-ui-cat#cat-plugin
description: A little cat that wanders the DeepSeek Harness UI, walking along text edges, napping, teleporting, falling off ledges, and leaving poops you can clean up.

title: wz20/dsh-dafeiyu-dot
description: A whale companion with configurable roles, emotional speech through local TTS, persistent file-based memory, QQ messaging, and half-duplex voice calls. QQ requires a NapCatQQ-compatible OneBot v11 gateway, and the emotional voice requires a local VoiceStudio + audio.cpp + Breeze TTS 2 stack (or a compatible TTS API); FFmpeg is needed for non-1x speech speed.

title: x-cores/dsh-3d-mine-game#mine3d-float
description: Minesweeper on a rotating cube surface with cross-edge neighbors, no-guess generation, ghost mode and color themes.

title: x-cores/dsh-chess-game#chess-float
description: Two-player chess in a draggable floating window with full rules, undo and PGN export.

title: x-cores/dsh-mine-game#mine-float
description: Minesweeper in a draggable floating window with first-click-safe layout, flags, chord and timer.

title: X1A0BAN/dsh-survival-mode
description: Survival mode: all sessions share one satiety/health pool — each model step burns satiety, starvation freezes tool calls until fed, with an MC mini-game for gathering food.

title: xczhanjun/lazeword
description: A cozy offline vocabulary trainer for the whole family: 1094 curated words, spaced repetition, 6 quiz types, spelling games and a lazy large-screen mode; opens as a sidebar panel and also runs standalone as one HTML file.

title: xiaoshihou514/dsh-desktop-pet
description: DSH pet, on the desktop!

title: XIAOZHAOXSXH/dsh-moyu-reader
description: Reads local .txt novels in the right sidebar, with encoding detection, chapter splitting, full-text search, reading progress, bookmarks, and a boss key that hides the reader or the whole right sidebar in one keystroke.

title: xiebaiyuan/CatDogTrace#dsh-plugin
description: DogCatTrace attribution parody as a right-sidebar tab: draw three integer challenges, paste each model reply into one box at a time, read the 24-breed dog and cat ranking.

title: xiekai886/dsh-MusicPlayer
description: A collapsible/expandable draggable floating music player with NetEase Cloud Music playlist import and song/artist search — chat and listen at the same time.

title: Xingkong42/dsh-inputbox-game
description: Turns the chat composer into an auto-playing mini-game arcade while a task runs — snake, pong, flappy, ecology, horse race, runner, number rush and maze all play themselves with no input; focusing the composer restores the normal editor.

title: xkk6663/dsh-live2d-mao#dsh-live2d-mao
description: Connector only, it renders nothing itself: subscribes to DeepSeek Harness session events and folds them into a 12-phase work state (planning / thinking / executing-tool / streaming / waiting-input / voice / awaiting-approval / complete / error / paused / idle / heartbeat), then POSTs each phase to a desktop-pet backend at http://127.0.0.1:8000/api/plugin/dsh/ingest. It holds no window. No API key or token is needed. Requires the Mao Live2D pet application to be separately installed and running (that is a Windows Electron app with its own PowerShell 7 / Python 3.10+ / Node 18+ prerequisites); without it this plugin has nothing to push to.

title: xling001/dsh-reading-companion
description: Local TXT reader in a right-sidebar tab plus a spoiler-safe AI reading companion: the model only sees what you have already read — the current chapter, the tail of the previous chapter, and a per-book background file it grows as you go. Excerpts, thoughts and the companion replies become structured Markdown notes exportable to Obsidian; raw text unlocks only for a book you mark as finished.

title: xrn1997/dsh-novel
description: Read web novels inside the DSH web GUI: import legado book sources, search across them, keep a bookshelf with reading progress, read in one continuous scroll, import local TXT and EPUB books, and let agent tools reach the same sources, shelf and text.

title: xxxiii/dsh-fish-dream
description: Dreams for the pet in dsh-fish: once she has been quiet long enough, it picks real events from her event stream, follows one of six dream theories, and hands her a dream seed to write out in her own words. Ships three tools (dream_recall, dream_record, dream_now), never calls a model itself, and keeps its data in ~/.dsh-fish-dream. Every dream is rebuilt from events that actually happened; the theory only decides how they are put together.

title: Yang-wudi/dsh-kun-like-pet#kunpet-dsh
description: A Kun-Like desktop pet living in the corner of the DSH web UI; switches animations with agent state and plays a voice line on task completion.

title: yimeng-life/dsh-happy
description: Ten full-canvas animated backgrounds for the DSH conversation pane — starfield, code rain, circuit, sword-fight, cat, girl, fighter jet, racer, snow and bubbles — one random theme per turn, with a text-column veil that keeps the chat readable.

title: yizhuzhu-glitch/dsh-pet-mic-lite
description: Counts how many times the microphone is stroked today and writes the number to a local JSON file for a desktop pet to read.

title: Yuanawaqwq/dsh-columbina-pet
description: Columbina mascot for DeepSeek Harness: a 2D live pet on the desktop and inside the web panel, with four sprite sets, 76 official voice lines in Chinese, Japanese and English, weather reports, sticker moments, idle whispers, and a right-click menu for the sprite switch interval, sprite set, language and scale. Also includes quiet hours, volume with one-click mute, a searchable idle-action picker, and a power-save mode. It is a 2D-only fork of PC2005-cloud/dsh-pet (MIT) with upstream's 3D skin switching removed; it uses its own plugin id and can be installed alongside dsh-pet.

title: yuanzephyr920-oss/dsh-om-messiah
description: Rewrites every prompt into a Mechanicus prayer before the model sees it, then lets you pick prayer or original to send.

title: yujiajie01/dsh-anime-schedule
description: Adds a right-sidebar tab to the DSH web UI with the daily Japanese anime broadcast calendar from Bangumi (api.bgm.tv), grouped Monday through Sunday with today highlighted; hovering a card shows a details popover (cover, score, rank, air date, episode count, tags and synopsis), and clicking opens the title on Bangumi; the host caches the calendar for 10 minutes and subjects for 24 hours on disk so the last successful table still displays offline, and falls back to common local proxy ports when the direct connection fails.

title: yuna78/dsh-plugin-yushe#yushe
description: YuShe, a Dafeiyu (big fat fish) virtual pet for DSH: a guided visual setup hatches an AI fish girl with her own personality (15 species, 16 poses each, 200 stat points you allocate), who chats with you, answers in the workspace you bind her to, browses Bilibili on her own account and grows from what she sees, and reports back with a daily plan, diary, letters and, once you configure an image-generation API, photos; everything she posts goes through a local content gate.

title: yuna78/dsh-prompt-tips
description: A desktop pet living in the corner of DSH: every hour it brings one official prompt technique from OpenAI or Anthropic — verbatim copy-ready EN template, 1:1 Chinese translation, personalised rationale, and 9 switchable skins.

title: yushi-xxh/dsh-homepage-skin
description: Adds the DeepSeek Harness homepage background to dsh web: WebGL fluid light, dot-line grid and a digital point-cloud whale, with dark and light palettes.

title: yuyu520fish/dsh-fishtank
description: A small living fish with its own memory, mood and quiet thoughts. It remembers you between sessions, and the fish itself is one JSON file you can export and carry.

title: yyh-001/dsh-meme
description: Chat meme stickers: text-only send, mood auto-send, QQ/WeChat-style picker, auto-learn, custom packs.

title: zczgagat/token2rice
description: Drops a bowl of white rice from the top of the DSH window for every N tokens you spend; the bowls fall and bounce under gravity, can be dragged and thrown, and a vortex button (with a sound effect) inhales them all — or just the one you drop on it. Threshold, bowl size, on-screen cap, auto-righting and artwork are adjustable in an in-app panel.

title: ZelinW1/dsh-cosplay
description: Turns the DeepSeek Harness agent into any character: a global cosplay switch, SillyTavern v2 role cards with JSON import/export, a neutral/role thinking-style toggle, and natural-language card authoring via a built-in skill.

title: zenglihunter/dsh-petdex-pet
description: A desktop pet in the DSH web GUI: floating, draggable sprite pet that animates with agent activity (thinking, idle, error, done, awaiting approval), with a settings page for size, switching, gallery search and one-click pet install. Ships 4 bundled Hunter x Hunter starter pets.

title: zhang66633/dsh-sprite-studio
description: Sprite-sheet workspace on an infinite canvas: slice by grid, row scan or alpha connectivity, matte solid-color backgrounds, compose characters from a 1066-item Liberated Pixel Cup material library, generate seamless backgrounds and 12 procedural effects, then export ZIP or an atlas with Aseprite-format JSON. The LPC character parts are fetched on demand from raw.githubusercontent.com (LiberatedPixelCup), so GitHub must be reachable.

title: zhangmin510/dsh-heixia-pet#dsh-pet
description: HeiXia, a cat companion for DeepSeek Harness with actions based on photos and video, session-state reactions, chat, and balance display. A fork of PC2005-cloud/dsh-pet that uses the same plugin id, so it replaces the original — do not install both together.

title: zhanshenovo/dsh-brake-pedal
description: An easter-egg brake-pedal self-test. A draggable pill in the DSH web UI runs six full-force braking stomps; the bracket snaps at a pseudo-random stomp between the second and the sixth, or the run passes entirely, and then a fictional notice appears. The pedal force is derived and labelled as such, while the session figures it derives from are read from the real session log. It never intercepts, delays or takes over the real stop action.

title: zhanshenovo/dsh-bushaoxin
description: A conversation-style layer that rephrases trade-off warnings: when a shortcut is cheap but has a catch, the reply may say the fast road is the rival shop and the slow one keeps its rules. Ships a rewrite engine that turns any text into a fixed-format dialogue with five independent knobs (act count, catchphrase density, ending turn, seed, preset), a slider for four on/off intensity levels, and a /bushaoxin command that reports a joke "heartburn index" from the session tool-call log. Every rewrite ends with a real technical conclusion that cannot be disabled. Zero dependencies, no build step, engine is pure functions.

title: dsh-multi-role-groupchat
description: Multi-role group chat panel for DeepSeek Harness: join as one character, chat with 2-3 AI members, route replies by addressee with probabilistic bystanders, use @ handoffs, and keep private memory/relationships, a global character library, failure diagnostics, retry of failed replies, message search, a sticky scene note, paged long-history rendering, cross-tab sync, provider-catalog models, and JSON import/export.

title: zhing99-hash/dsh-dafeiyu-jinrong
description: Desktop BigFish companion for DeepSeek Harness with an editable bubble studio, action packs, IP weather, daily countdowns, named A/HK/US indices, stock quotes, market sentiment and a read-only dsh-meme gallery. Defaults: it checks your DeepSeek balance every minute with your API key (or the logged-in account) and shows it in the bubble; market sentiment is off until you enable it, and then polls Tencent and Eastmoney quote endpoints (Tushare too if you add a token). It installs from a release package of about 200 MB that bundles the desktop helper.

title: zhu1090093659/dsh-pet
description: A whale-girl companion for the dsh web GUI: animations follow the agent state, with pat interactions and a feeding mechanic that raises intimacy from a calf to deep-sea bonds.

title: Ziliang571/dsh-music-ball
description: Draggable music ball for the DSH Web UI with a local library, album covers, playlist, favorites, collections, cover zoom, auto-hide, and source-aware deletion.

title: ziyefbk/podwhale#podwhale
description: A personal-agent community with a desktop companion and owner-approved social actions. Needs a Podwhale community account token to connect (without one it is a read-only local demo); built for DSH 0.2.2-rc.1.

title: zmm863-commits/dsh-dice-game
description: 🎲 Dice Battle — six classic dice games (Liar's Dice, Guess Red Dots, Red/Blue, Big/Small, Odd/Even, Straight) for the DSH web GUI. Single vs AI plus PeerJS WebRTC online play, fully bilingual zh/en, sidebar entry opens the game in the center column.

title: zuoyunlai/dsh-pet-plugin
description: A photo-real desk pet for the DSH window: five personas with five expression sprites each, whose dance, hair-flip and walk actions play as 24 fps VP9 alpha video clips, plus a single-shot stage clip that walks to the centre, dances and walks back without cutting; proactive lines with an optional edge-tts neural voice, ink / confetti / cloud / fog / bomb effects, a right-click menu and a /dsh-pet command, plus a small chat box that answers through a one-shot host model call without writing to your session. UI text ships in en, zh, es, pt and hi.

title: ZutoMayoo/totoTheCat
description: Desktop pet for the DSH web UI: a draggable pixel-art cat with a pomodoro timer, XP levels, and 30 unlockable facts.

title: zyfgood/dsh-whale-girl
description: Whale-girl desktop pet for the DSH Web UI, drawn with hand-written SVG + CSS (no image or audio assets, zero runtime dependencies): swims while a turn runs, blows labeled bubbles on tool calls, taps the glass with an amber pulse when an approval is waiting, jumps with a turn duration/tool-count report on success and droops on failure, naps after dark or when idle. Click to poke, double-click to pet (affinity hearts), drag with remembered position, right-click menu (feed / mute / reset / hide), hover card with level, title, XP bar and per-turn stats. A `whale_say` tool lets the agent make her speak or act as a lightweight visible notification. Read-only over sessions and workspace; only ~/.dsh/whale-girl/state.json is written.

title: Zyr147258/dsh-leike-pet
description: Pixel-art Little Red Riding Hood pet for the DSH session window: transparent and always on top, it walks back and forth along the composer, blinks, looks around, turns its head toward the cursor, sleeps on double-click, and scales from 2x to 7x in a right-click panel.

title: zzbkl/dsh-cold-boot
description: Plays a 44-second sci-fi cold-boot sequence over the DSH window on startup: terminal log, whale mark, four spoken lines, and a skip button. Pure DOM and CSS in one self-contained client bundle, no runtime dependencies.
